By approximating the benefits of real in-domain data, SDC effectively reduces label bias without requiring access to actual domain-specific inputs. Experimental evaluations on 279 classification and multiple-choice tasks from the Super-NaturalInstructions benchmark. The results show that SDC significantly reduces label bias, achieving an average Bias Score reduction of 57.5%, and outperforming all competitive baselines. Moreover, when combined with Leave-One-Out Calibration (LOOC), further improves performance, underscoring its effectiveness and generalizability in enhancing the reliability of LLMs.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在上下文学习 (ICL) 方面表现出令人印象深刻的能力，但容易出现标签偏差，即倾向于某些答案的不良倾向。现有的校准方法通过利用域内数据来减轻偏差，但此类数据在现实场景中通常不可用。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了 SDC（合成数据校准），这是一种简单而有效的方法，可以从一些上下文演示中生成合成的域内数据，并利用它进行校准。通过近似真实域内数据的好处，SDC 可以有效减少标签偏差，而无需访问实际的特定域输入。对 Super-NaturalInstructions 基准的 279 个分类和多项选择任务进行实验评估。结果表明，SDC 显着降低了标签偏差，平均偏差分数降低了 57.5%，并且优于所有竞争基线。此外，与留一校准 (LOOC) 结合使用时，可进一步提高性能，强调其在提高大语言模型可靠性方面的有效性和通用性。

title: Just Put a Human in the Loop? InvestigatingLLM-Assisted Annotation for Subjective Tasks
abstract_en: LLM use in annotation is becoming widespread, and given LLMs’ overall promising performance and speed, putting humans in the loop to simply “review” LLM annotations can be tempting. In subjective tasks with multiple plausible answers, this can impact both evaluation of LLM performance, and analysis using these labels in a social science task downstream. In a pre-registered experiment with 350 unique annotators and 7,000 annotations across 4 conditions, 2 models, and 2 datasets, we find that presenting crowdworkers with LLM-generated annotation suggestions did not make them faster annotators, but did improve their self-reported confidence in the task. More importantly, annotators strongly took the LLM suggestions, significantly changing the label distribution compared to the baseline. We show that when these labels created with LLM assistance are used to evaluate LLM performance, reported model performance significantly increases. We show how changes in label distributions as a result of LLM assistance can affect conclusions drawn by analyzing even “human-approved” LLM-annotated datasets. We believe our work underlines the importance of understanding the impact of LLM-assisted annotation on subjective, qualitative tasks, on the creation of gold data for training and testing, and on the evaluation of NLP systems on subjective tasks.
abstract_zh: LLM 在注释中的使用正在变得越来越广泛，并且考虑到 LLM 总体上有前途的性能和速度，让人类参与简单地“审查”LLM 注释可能很诱人。在具有多个合理答案的主观任务中，这可能会影响大语言模型绩效的评估以及在下游社会科学任务中使用这些标签的分析。在一项预先注册的实验中，涉及 4 个条件、2 个模型和 2 个数据集的 350 个独特注释器和 7,000 个注释，我们发现向众包工作者提供 LLM 生成的注释建议并没有使他们成为更快的注释器，但确实提高了他们自我报告的对任务的信心。更重要的是，注释者强烈采纳了 LLM 的建议，与基线相比显着改变了标签分布。我们表明，当使用 LLM 协助创建的这些标签来评估 LLM 性能时，报告的模型性能显着提高。我们展示了 LLM 协助导致的标签分布变化如何影响通过分析“人类认可的”LLM 注释数据集得出的结论。我们相信我们的工作强调了理解大语言模型辅助注释对主观定性任务、创建用于训练和测试的黄金数据以及评估 NLP 系统对主观任务的影响的重要性。

title: Multilingual Definition Modeling
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose the first multilingual study on definition modeling. We use monolingual dictionary data for four new languages (Spanish, French, Portuguese, and German) and perform an in-depth empirical study to test the performance of pre-trained multilingual language models on definition modeling of monosemic words when finetuned on this data. Furthermore, we use a zero-shot approach to test the multilingual capabilities of two popular chat-based Large Language Models (LLMs) in the task. Results show that multilingual language models can perform on-pair with English but cannot leverage potential cross-lingual synergies, with LLMs generally offering better performance overall. A comprehensive human evaluation of the LLM-generated definition highlights the zero and few-shot capabilities of these models in this new task, also showing their shortcomings. Finally, we show that performance on our task via BERTScore strongly correlates to the performance on multilingual LLM benchmarks, suggesting that our task offers a viable compute-constrained, stable and natural alternative to these.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了第一个关于定义建模的多语言研究。我们使用四种新语言（西班牙语、法语、葡萄牙语和德语）的单语词典数据，并进行了深入的实证研究，以测试预训练的多语言语言模型在对这些数据进行微调时在单义词定义建模方面的性能。此外，我们使用零样本方法来测试任务中两种流行的基于聊天的大型语言模型（LLM）的多语言能力。结果表明，多语言语言模型可以与英语配对执行，但无法利用潜在的跨语言协同效应，而大语言模型通常会提供更好的整体性能。对大语言模型生成的定义进行的全面人工评估突出了这些模型在这项新任务中的零样本和少样本能力，同时也显示了它们的缺点。最后，我们通过 BERTScore 证明我们的任务性能与多语言 LLM 基准测试的性能密切相关，这表明我们的任务为这些任务提供了一种可行的计算受限、稳定且自然的替代方案。

title: Text2World: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Symbolic World Model Generation
abstract_en: Recently, there has been growing interest in leveraging large language models (LLMs) to generate symbolic world models from textual descriptions. Although LLMs have been extensively explored in the context of world modeling, prior studies encountered several challenges, including evaluation randomness, dependence on indirect metrics, and a limited domain scope. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel benchmark, Text2World, based on planning domain definition language (PDDL), featuring hundreds of diverse domains and employing multi-criteria, execution-based metrics for a more robust evaluation. We benchmark current LLMs using Text2World and find that reasoning models trained with large-scale reinforcement learning outperform others. However, even the best-performing model still demonstrates limited capabilities in world modeling. Building on these insights, we examine several promising strategies to enhance the world modeling capabilities of LLMs, including test-time scaling, agent training, and more. We hope that Text2World can serve as a crucial resource, laying the groundwork for future research in leveraging LLMs as world models.
abstract_zh: 最近，人们对利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 从文本描述生成符号世界模型越来越感兴趣。尽管大语言模型在世界建模的背景下得到了广泛的探索，但先前的研究遇到了一些挑战，包括评估随机性、对间接指标的依赖以及有限的领域范围。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了一种新颖的基准 Text2World，它基于规划域定义语言 (PDDL)，具有数百个不同的域，并采用多标准、基于执行的指标来进行更稳健的评估。我们使用 Text2World 对当前的大语言模型进行了基准测试，发现经过大规模强化学习训练的推理模型优于其他模型。然而，即使是性能最好的模型在世界建模方面仍然表现出有限的能力。基于这些见解，我们研究了几种有前景的策略来增强大语言模型的世界建模能力，包括测试时间扩展、代理培训等。我们希望 Text2World 能够作为重要资源，为未来利用大语言模型作为世界模型的研究奠定基础。

title: Protecting Users From Themselves: Safeguarding Contextual Privacy in Interactions with Conversational Agents
abstract_en: Conversational agents are increasingly woven into individuals’ personal lives, yet users often underestimate the privacy risks associated with them. The moment users share information with these agents —such as large language models (LLMs)— their private information becomes vulnerable to exposure. In this paper, we characterize the notion of contextual privacy for user interactions with LLM-based Conversational Agents (LCAs). It aims to minimize privacy risks by ensuring that users (sender) disclose only information that is both relevant and necessary for achieving their intended goals when interacting with LCAs (untrusted receivers). Through a formative design user study, we observe how even “privacy-conscious” users inadvertently reveal sensitive information through indirect disclosures. Based on insights from this study, we propose a locally deployable framework that operates between users and LCAs, identifying and reformulating out-of-context information in user prompts. Our evaluation using examples from ShareGPT shows that lightweight models can effectively implement this framework, achieving strong gains in contextual privacy while preserving the user’s intended interaction goals. Notably, about 76% of participants in our human evaluation preferred the reformulated prompts over the original ones, validating the usability and effectiveness of contextual privacy in our proposed framework. We open source the code at https://github.com/IBM/contextual-privacy-LLM.
abstract_zh: 对话代理越来越多地融入个人的个人生活，但用户往往低估了与之相关的隐私风险。当用户与这些代理（例如大型语言模型（LLM））共享信息时，他们的私人信息就很容易暴露。在本文中，我们描述了用户与基于 LLM 的会话代理 (LCA) 交互的上下文隐私概念。它旨在通过确保用户（发送者）在与 LCA（不受信任的接收者）交互时仅披露与实现其预期目标相关且必要的信息来最大程度地降低隐私风险。通过形成性设计用户研究，我们观察到即使是“有隐私意识”的用户也是如何通过间接披露无意中泄露敏感信息的。根据这项研究的见解，我们提出了一个可本地部署的框架，该框架在用户和 LCA 之间运行，识别并重新表述用户提示中的脱离上下文的信息。我们使用 ShareGPT 示例进行的评估表明，轻量级模型可以有效地实现该框架，在上下文隐私方面取得巨大收益，同时保留用户预期的交互目标。值得注意的是，在我们的人工评估中，大约 76% 的参与者更喜欢重新制定的提示，而不是原始的提示，这验证了我们提出的框架中上下文隐私的可用性和有效性。我们在 https://github.com/IBM/contextual-privacy-LLM 开源代码。

title: LLM-as-an-Interviewer: Beyond Static Testing Through DynamicLLMEvaluation
abstract_en: We introduce LLM-as-an-Interviewer, a novel paradigm for evaluating large language models (LLMs). This approach leverages multi-turn interactions where the LLM interviewer actively provides feedback on responses and poses follow-up questions to the evaluated LLM. At the start of the interview, the LLM interviewer dynamically modifies datasets to generate initial questions, mitigating data contamination. We apply the LLM-as-an-Interviewer framework to evaluate six models on the reasoning, factuality and instruction-following tasks. Our results show that the framework effectively provides insights into LLM performance, including the quality of initial responses, adaptability to feedback, and ability to address follow-up queries like clarification or additional knowledge requests. The framework also addresses key limitations of conventional methods like LLM-as-a-Judge, including verbosity bias and inconsistency across runs. Finally, we propose the Interview Report, which aggregates insights from the interview process, providing examples and a comprehensive analysis of the LLM’s strengths and weaknesses. This report offers a detailed snapshot of the model’s real-world applicability.
abstract_zh: 我们引入了 LLM-as-an-Interviewer，这是一种评估大型语言模型 (LLM) 的新颖范式。这种方法利用多回合互动，大语言模型面试官积极提供反馈反馈，并向评估的大语言模型提出后续问题。在面试开始时，大语言模型面试官会动态修改数据集以生成初始问题，从而减少数据污染。我们应用大语言模型作为面试官框架来评估六个模型的推理、事实性和指令遵循任务。我们的结果表明，该框架有效地提供了对大语言模型绩效的洞察，包括初始响应的质量、反馈的适应性以及解决后续查询（如澄清或其他知识请求）的能力。该框架还解决了大语言模型作为法官等传统方法的主要局限性，包括冗长偏差和运行之间的不一致。最后，我们提出面试报告，该报告汇总了面试过程中的见解，提供了实例并对大语言模型的优势和劣势进行了全面分析。该报告提供了该模型在现实世界中的适用性的详细快照。

title: Mind Your Theory: Theory of Mind Goes Deeper Than Reasoning
abstract_en: Theory of Mind (ToM) capabilities in LLMs have recently become a central object of investigation, sparking debates and discussions. In this position paper, we explore many lines of work in different communities in AI and cognitive science. Inspired by cognitive work, we view ToM tasks as a two-step process: (I) first, determining whether and how to invoke ToM, which includes setting the appropriate Depth of Mentalizing (DoM); and (II) second, applying correct inference given the appropriate DoM. We identify that many works about ToM in LLMs, such as benchmarks and add-on modules, tend to unjustly overlook the first step and focus exclusively on the second one, which can be framed as a logic-reasoning task. We support our distinction with empirical evidence about the difficulty of the different steps in existing benchmarks. We conclude with suggestions for improved evaluation of ToM capabilities, inspired by dynamic environments used in cognitive tasks in biological agents.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型的心智理论（ToM）能力最近成为调查的中心对象，引发了争论和讨论。在这篇立场文件中，我们探讨了人工智能和认知科学领域不同社区的许多工作。受认知工作的启发，我们将 ToM 任务视为一个两步过程：（I）首先，确定是否以及如何调用 ToM，其中包括设置适当的心智化深度（DoM）； (II) 其次，在给定适当的 DoM 的情况下应用正确的推论。我们发现，大语言模型中关于 ToM 的许多工作，例如基准测试和附加模块，往往会不公正地忽视第一步，而只关注第二步，而第二步可以被视为逻辑推理任务。我们用关于现有基准中不同步骤的难度的经验证据来支持我们的区分。最后，受生物代理认知任务中使用的动态环境的启发，我们提出了改进 ToM 能力评估的建议。

title: DICE-BENCH: Evaluating the Tool-Use Capabilities of Large Language Models in Multi-Round, Multi-Party Dialogues
abstract_en: Existing function-calling benchmarks focus on single-turn interactions. However, they overlook the complexity of real-world scenarios. To quantify how existing benchmarks address practical applications, we introduce DICE-SCORE, a metric that evaluates the dispersion of tool-related information such as function name and parameter values throughout the dialogue. Analyzing existing benchmarks through DICE-SCORE reveals notably low scores, highlighting the need for more realistic scenarios. To address this gap, we present DICE-BENCH, a framework that constructs practical function-calling datasets by synthesizing conversations through a tool graph that maintains dependencies across rounds and a multi-agent system with distinct personas to enhance dialogue naturalness. The final dataset comprises 1,607 high-DICE-SCORE instances. Our experiments on 19 LLMs with DICE-BENCH show that significant advances are still required before such models can be deployed effectively in real-world settings. Our code and data are all publicly available.
abstract_zh: 现有的函数调用基准侧重于单轮交互。然而，他们忽视了现实世界场景的复杂性。为了量化现有基准如何解决实际应用，我们引入了 DICE-SCORE，这是一种评估工具相关信息（例如函数名称和参数值）在整个对话中的分散程度的指标。通过 DICE-SCORE 分析现有基准显示分数明显较低，凸显了对更现实场景的需求。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了 DICE-BENCH，这是一个框架，它通过工具图合成对话来构建实用的函数调用数据集，该工具图维护跨轮依赖关系，以及具有不同角色的多代理系统，以增强对话自然性。最终数据集包含 1,607 个高 DICE-SCORE 实例。我们使用 DICE-BENCH 对 19 名大语言模型进行的实验表明，在将此类模型有效部署到现实环境中之前，仍需要取得重大进展。我们的代码和数据都是公开的。

title: MOZ-Smishing: A Benchmark Dataset for Detecting Mobile Money Frauds
abstract_en: Despite the increasing prevalence of smishing attacks targeting Mobile Money Transfer systems, there is a notable lack of publicly available SMS phishing datasets in this domain. This study seeks to address this gap by creating a specialized dataset designed to detect smishing attacks aimed at Mobile Money Transfer users. The data set consists of crowd-sourced text messages from Mozambican mobile users, meticulously annotated into two categories: legitimate messages (ham) and fraudulent smishing attempts (spam). The messages are written in Portuguese, often incorporating microtext styles and linguistic nuances unique to the Mozambican context.We also investigate the effectiveness of LLMs in detecting smishing. Using in-context learning approaches, we evaluate the models’ ability to identify smishing attempts without requiring extensive task-specific training. The data set is released under an open license at the following link: huggingface-Anonymous
abstract_zh: 尽管针对移动汇款系统的网络钓鱼攻击越来越普遍，但该领域明显缺乏公开可用的短信网络钓鱼数据集。本研究旨在通过创建专门的数据集来解决这一差距，该数据集旨在检测针对移动汇款用户的短信攻击。该数据集由来自莫桑比克移动用户的众包文本消息组成，经过精心注释分为两类：合法消息（火腿）和欺诈性短信尝试（垃圾邮件）。这些消息是用葡萄牙语写成的，通常包含缩微文本风格和莫桑比克语境特有的语言细微差别。我们还研究了大语言模型在检测短信诈骗方面的有效性。使用上下文学习方法，我们评估模型识别短信攻击尝试的能力，而无需进行大量的特定任务训练。该数据集在开放许可下发布，链接如下：huggingface-Anonymous

title: Tore-Klose: Record Scorer, Goal Hunter, Machine? Human Association Norms forGerman Personal Name Compounds
abstract_en: We present a collection of human association norms to German personal name compounds (PNCs) such as “Tore-Klose” (goal-Klose) and corresponding full names (Miroslav Klose), thus providing a novel testbed for PNC evaluation, i.e., analogical vs. contrastive positive vs. negative perception effects. The associations are obtained in an online experiment with German native speakers, analyzed regarding our novel intertwined PNC–person association setup, and accompanied by an LLM synthetic generation approach for augmentation.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一系列德国人名复合词（PNC）的人类关联规范，例如“Tore-Klose”（目标-Klose）和相应的全名（Miroslav Klose），从而为 PNC 评估（即类比与对比的积极与消极感知效果）提供了一个新颖的测试平台。这些关联是通过对德语为母语的人进行的在线实验获得的，对我们新颖的相互交织的 PNC-人关联设置进行了分析，并辅以 LLM 合成生成方法进行增强。

title: Prompting Metaphoricity: Soft Labeling with Large Language Models in Popular Communication of Science Tweets inSpanish
abstract_en: In this paper, we explore how large language models (LLMs) can be used to assign soft labels for metaphoricity in Popular Communication of Science (PCS) tweets written in Spanish. Instead of treating metaphors as a binary yes/no phenomenon, we focus on their graded nature and the variability commonly found in human annotations. Through a combination of prompt design and quantitative evaluation over a stratified sample of our dataset, we show that GPT-4 can assign probabilistic scores not only for general metaphoricity but also for specific metaphor types with consistency (Direct, Indirect, and Personification). The results show that, while LLMs align reasonably well with average human judgments for some categories, capturing the subtle patterns of inter-annotator disagreement remains a challenge. We present a corpus of 3,733 tweets annotated with LLM-generated soft labels, a valuable resource for further metaphor analysis in scientific discourse and figurative language annotation with LLMs.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们探讨了如何使用大型语言模型 (LLM) 为用西班牙语编写的大众科学传播 (PCS) 推文中的隐喻性分配软标签。我们没有将隐喻视为二元的是/否现象，而是关注它们的分级性质和人类注释中常见的可变性。通过将提示设计和对数据集分层样本的定量评估相结合，我们表明 GPT-4 不仅可以为一般隐喻性分配概率分数，还可以为具有一致性的特定隐喻类型（直接、间接和拟人化）分配概率分数。结果表明，虽然大语言模型在某些类别上与人类的平均判断相当一致，但捕捉注释者之间分歧的微妙模式仍然是一个挑战。我们提供了由大语言模型生成的软标签注释的 3,733 条推文的语料库，这是用于进一步科学话语中的隐喻分析和大语言模型的比喻语言注释的宝贵资源。

title: HATS:Hindi Analogy Test Set for Evaluating Reasoning in Large Language Models
abstract_en: Analogies test a model’s ability to infer implicit relationships between concepts, making them a key benchmark for evaluating reasoning capabilities. While large language models (LLMs) are widely evaluated for reasoning in English, their abilities in Indic languages remain understudied, limiting our understanding of whether these models generalize across languages. To address this gap, we introduce a new Hindi Analogy Test Set (HATS), comprising 405 multiple-choice questions sourced from Indian government exams. We benchmark state-of-the-art multilingual LLMs using various prompting strategies and introduce a grounded Chain of Thought approach that leverages cognitive theories of analogical reasoning. This approach improves model performance on Hindi analogy questions. Our experiments show that models perform best with English prompts, irrespective of the prompting strategy. Our test set addresses the lack of a critical resource to evaluate LLM reasoning capabilities in Hindi. The test set is publicly available for research purposes here https://github.com/Inequilazitive/HATS-Hindi_Analogy_Test_Set
abstract_zh: 类比测试模型推断概念之间隐含关系的能力，使其成为评估推理能力的关键基准。虽然大型语言模型 (LLM) 在英语推理方面得到了广泛评估，但它们在印度语言中的能力仍未得到充分研究，这限制了我们对这些模型是否可以跨语言泛化的理解。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了新的印地语类比测试集 (HATS)，其中包含来自印度政府考试的 405 道多项选择题。我们使用各种提示策略对最先进的多语言大语言模型进行基准测试，并引入利用类比推理认知理论的扎根思维链方法。这种方法提高了模型在印地语类比问题上的性能。我们的实验表明，无论提示策略如何，模型在英语提示下表现最佳。我们的测试集解决了缺乏评估印地语 LLM 推理能力的关键资源的问题。该测试集可在此处公开用于研究目的 https://github.com/Inequilazitive/HATS-Hindi_Analogy_Test_Set

title: Can Stories HelpLLMs Reason? Curating Information Space Through Narrative
abstract_en: Narratives are widely recognized as a powerful tool for structuring information and facilitating comprehension of complex ideas in various domains such as science communication. This paper explores whether generating narratives can serve “as a specialized mode of thinking” that improves the reasoning abilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). We introduce Story of Thought (SoT), a novel prompt-driven reasoning framework that guides LLMs to construct narratives around the problem statement to solve the task more effectively. SoT enables LLMs to integrate narrative techniques such as metaphor and analogy into their reasoning process. Our experiments show that SoT significantly improves the LLMs’ problem-solving abilities on various tasks, including physics, chemistry, and biology in both JEEBench and GPQA (e.g., SoT resulted in 13% improvement compared to CoT when using GPT-4). To validate LLM-based evaluation for generated narratives, we conduct a human annotation of the narrative techniques used by LLMs. Our results show strong inter-annotator agreement between Llama 3 70B and human annotators. This work brings LLM reasoning closer to human cognitive processes by mirroring mechanisms such as analogical problem-solving, which are central to how humans understand and process complex ideas.
abstract_zh: 叙述被广泛认为是在科学传播等各个领域构建信息和促进理解复杂思想的强大工具。本文探讨了生成叙述是否可以作为“一种专门的思维模式”来提高大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。我们引入了思想故事（SoT），这是一种新颖的提示驱动推理框架，可指导大语言模型围绕问题陈述构建叙述，以更有效地解决任务。 SoT 使大语言模型能够将隐喻和类比等叙事技巧融入到他们的推理过程中。我们的实验表明，SoT 显着提高了大语言模型在 JEEBench 和 GPQA 中解决物理、化学和生物学等各种任务的问题的能力（例如，使用 GPT-4 时，与 CoT 相比，SoT 提高了 13%）。为了验证基于大语言模型对生成叙述的评估，我们对大语言模型使用的叙述技术进行了人工注释。我们的结果显示 Llama 3 70B 和人类注释者之间存在很强的注释者间一致性。这项工作通过镜像类比问题解决等机制，使大语言模型的推理更接近人类的认知过程，而类比问题解决是人类如何理解和处理复杂想法的核心。

title: Multi-AgentLLMDebate Unveils the Premise Left Unsaid
abstract_en: Implicit premise is central to argumentative coherence and faithfulness, yet remain elusive in traditional single-pass computational models. We introduce a multi-agent framework that casts implicit premise recovery as a dialogic reasoning task between two LLM agents. Through structured rounds of debate, agents critically evaluate competing premises and converge on the most contextually appropriate interpretation. Evaluated on a controlled binary classification benchmark for premise selection, our approach achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, outperforming both neural baselines and single-agent LLMs. We find that accuracy gains stem not from repeated generation, but from agents refining their predictions in response to opposing views. Moreover, we show that forcing models to defend assigned stances degrades performance—engendering rhetorical rigidity to flawed reasoning. These results underscore the value of interactive debate in revealing pragmatic components of argument structure.
abstract_zh: 隐式前提对于论证的连贯性和忠实性至关重要，但在传统的单通道计算模型中仍然难以捉摸。我们引入了一个多智能体框架，它将隐式前提恢复作为两个 LLM 智能体之间的对话推理任务。通过结构化的多轮辩论，代理人批判性地评估相互竞争的前提，并集中在最适合上下文的解释上。在用于前提选择的受控二元分类基准上进行评估，我们的方法实现了最先进的准确性，优于神经基线和单代理大语言模型。我们发现准确性的提高不是来自重复生成，而是来自智能体针对相反观点改进其预测。此外，我们表明，强迫模型捍卫指定的立场会降低性能——导致有缺陷的推理的修辞僵化。这些结果强调了互动辩论在揭示论证结构的实用组成部分方面的价值。

title: CriticalBrew atCQs-Gen 2025: Collaborative Multi-Agent Generation and Evaluation of Critical Questions for Arguments
abstract_en: This paper presents theCriticalBrewsubmission to the CQs-Gen 2025 shared task, which focuses on generating critical questions (CQs) for a given argument. Our approach employs a multi-agent framework containing two sequential components: 1)Generation: machine society simulation for generating CQs and 2)Evaluation: LLM-based evaluation for selecting the top three questions. The first models collaboration as a sequence of thinking patterns (e.g.,debate→reflect). The second assesses the generated questions using zero-shot prompting, evaluating them against several criteria (e.g., depth). Experiments with different open-weight LLMs (small vs. large) consistently outperformed the baseline, a single LLM with zero-shot prompting. Two configurations, agent count and thinking patterns, significantly impacted the performance in the shared task’s CQ-usefulness evaluation, whereas different LLM-based evaluation strategies (e.g., scoring) had no impact. Our code is available on GitHub.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 CriticalBrew 对 CQs-Gen 2025 共享任务的提交，该任务侧重于为给定的论点生成关键问题 (CQ)。我们的方法采用包含两个连续组件的多代理框架：1）生成：用于生成 CQ 的机器社会模拟和 2）评估：基于 LLM 的评估，用于选择前三个问题。第一个将协作建模为一系列思维模式（例如，辩论→反思）。第二个使用零样本提示评估生成的问题，根据几个标准（例如深度）对其进行评估。不同开放权重大语言模型（小型与大型）的实验始终优于基线，即具有零样本提示的单一大语言模型。代理数量和思维模式这两种配置显着影响了共享任务的 CQ 有用性评估的性能，而不同的基于 LLM 的评估策略（例如评分）则没有影响。我们的代码可以在 GitHub 上找到。

title: TriLLaMa atCQs-Gen 2025: A Two-StageLLM-Based System for Critical Question Generation
abstract_en: This paper presents a new system for generating critical questions in debates, developed for the Critical Questions Generation shared task. Our two-stage approach, combining generation and classification, utilizes LLaMA 3.1 Instruct models (8B, 70B, 405B) with zero-/few-shot prompting. Evaluations on annotated debate data reveal several key insights: few-shot generation with 405B yielded relatively high-quality questions, achieving a maximum possible punctuation score of 73.5. The 70B model outperformed both smaller and larger variants on the classification part. The classifiers showed a strong bias toward labeling generated questions as Useful, despite limited validation. Further, our system, ranked 6 extsuperscriptth, out-performed baselines by 3%. These findings stress the effectiveness of large-sized models for question generation and medium-sized models for classification, and suggest the need for clearer task definitions within prompts to improve classification accuracy.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在辩论中生成关键问题的新​​系统，该系统是为关键问题生成共享任务而开发的。我们的两阶段方法结合了生成和分类，利用 LLaMA 3.1 Instruct 模型（8B、70B、405B）和零/少样本提示。对带注释的辩论数据的评估揭示了几个关键见解：405B 的小样本生成产生了相对高质量的问题，达到了 73.5 的最大可能标点得分。 70B 模型在分类部分的表现优于较小和较大的变体。尽管验证有限，但分类器表现出强烈的偏见，倾向于将生成的问题标记为“有用”。此外，我们的系统排名第 6，比基线高出 3%。这些发现强调了用于问题生成的大型模型和用于分类的中型模型的有效性，并表明需要在提示中提供更清晰的任务定义，以提高分类准确性。

title: Comparing human andLLMproofreading inL2 writing: Impact on lexical and syntactic features
abstract_en: This study examines the lexical and syntactic interventions of human and LLM proofreading aimed at improving overall intelligibility in identical second language writings, and evaluates the consistency of outcomes across three LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, Llama3.1-8b, Deepseek-r1-8b). Findings show that both human and LLM proofreading enhance bigram lexical features, which may contribute to better coherence and contextual connectedness between adjacent words. However, LLM proofreading exhibits a more generative approach, extensively reworking vocabulary and sentence structures, such as employing more diverse and sophisticated vocabulary and incorporating a greater number of adjective modifiers in noun phrases. The proofreading outcomes are highly consistent in major lexical and syntactic features across the three models.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了人类和大语言模型校对的词汇和句法干预，旨在提高相同第二语言写作的整体可理解性，并评估了三个大语言模型（ChatGPT-4o、Llama3.1-8b、Deepseek-r1-8b）结果的一致性。研究结果表明，人工校对和大语言模型校对都增强了二元组词汇特征，这可能有助于提高相邻单词之间的连贯性和上下文关联性。然而，LLM 校对展示了一种更具生成性的方法，广泛地重新设计词汇和句子结构，例如采用更加多样化和复杂的词汇，以及在名词短语中纳入更多数量的形容词修饰语。三个模型的校对结果在主要词汇和句法特征上高度一致。

title: Alignment Drift inCEFR-promptedLLMs for InteractiveSpanish Tutoring
abstract_en: This paper investigates the potentials of Large Language Models (LLMs) as adaptive tutors in the context of second-language learning. In particular, we evaluate whether system prompting can reliably constrain LLMs to generate only text appropriate to the student’s competence level. We simulate full teacher-student dialogues in Spanish using instruction-tuned, open-source LLMs ranging in size from 7B to 12B parameters. Dialogues are generated by having an LLM alternate between tutor and student roles with separate chat histories. The output from the tutor model is then used to evaluate the effectiveness of CEFR-based prompting to control text difficulty across three proficiency levels (A1, B1, C1). Our findings suggest that while system prompting can be used to constrain model outputs, prompting alone is too brittle for sustained, long-term interactional contexts - a phenomenon we term alignment drift. Our results provide insights into the feasibility of LLMs for personalized, proficiency aligned adaptive tutors and provide a scalable method for low-cost evaluation of model performance without human participants.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）作为第二语言学习背景下的自适应导师的潜力。特别是，我们评估系统提示是否可以可靠地限制大语言模型仅生成适合学生能力水平的文本。我们使用经过指令调整的开源 LLM 模拟完整的西班牙语师生对话，参数大小从 7B 到 12B 不等。对话是通过让大语言模型在导师和学生角色之间交替并具有单独的聊天历史来生成的。然后，导师模型的输出用于评估基于 CEFR 的提示的有效性，以控制三个熟练级别（A1、B1、C1）的文本难度。我们的研究结果表明，虽然系统提示可以用来限制模型输出，但单独的提示对于持续、长期的交互环境来说太脆弱了——我们将这种现象称为对齐漂移。我们的结果提供了关于大语言模型对于个性化、熟练程度一致的自适应导师的可行性的见解，并提供了一种可扩展的方法，可以在没有人类参与者的情况下对模型性能进行低成本评估。

title: COGENT: A Curriculum-oriented Framework for Generating Grade-appropriate Educational Content
abstract_en: While Generative AI has demonstrated strong potential and versatility in content generation, its application to educational contexts presents several challenges. Models often fail to align with curriculum standards and maintain grade-appropriate reading levels consistently. Furthermore, STEM education poses additional challenges in balancing scientific explanations with everyday language when introducing complex and abstract ideas and phenomena to younger students.In this work, we propose COGENT, a curriculum-oriented framework for generating grade-appropriate educational content. We incorporate three curriculum components (science concepts, core ideas, and learning objectives), control readability through length, vocabulary, and sentence complexity, and adopt a “wonder-based” approach to increase student engagement and interest. We conduct a multi-dimensional evaluation via both LLM-as-a-judge and human expert analysis. Experimental results show that COGENT consistently produces grade-appropriate passages that are comparable or superior to human references. Our work establishes a viable approach for scaling adaptive and high-quality learning resources.
abstract_zh: 虽然生成式人工智能在内容生成方面表现出了强大的潜力和多功能性，但其在教育环境中的应用提出了一些挑战。模型通常无法与课程标准保持一致，也无法始终保持适合年级的阅读水平。此外，在向年轻学生介绍复杂抽象的思想和现象时，STEM 教育在平衡科学解释与日常语言方面提出了额外的挑战。在这项工作中，我们提出了 COGENT，一个以课程为导向的框架，用于生成适合年级的教育内容。我们整合了三个课程组成部分（科学概念、核心思想和学习目标），通过长度、词汇和句子复杂性控制可读性，并采用“基于奇迹”的方法来提高学生的参与度和兴趣。我们通过大语言模型法官和人类专家分析进行多维度评估。实验结果表明，COGENT 始终能够生成与人类参考相当或优于人类参考的适合等级的通道。我们的工作建立了一种可行的方法来扩展适应性和高质量的学习资源。

title: LookAlike: Consistent Distractor Generation in MathMCQs
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate distractors for multiple-choice questions (MCQs), especially in domains like math education. However, existing approaches are limited in ensuring that the generated distractors are consistent with common student errors. We propose LookAlike, a method that improves error–distractor consistency via preference optimization. Our two main innovations are: (a) mining synthetic preference pairs from model inconsistencies, and (b) alternating supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to stabilize training. Unlike prior work that relies on heuristics or manually annotated preference data, LookAlike uses its own generation inconsistencies as dispreferred samples, thus enabling scalable and stable training. Evaluated on a real-world dataset of 1,400+ math MCQs, LookAlike achieves 51.6% accuracy in distractor generation and 57.2% in error generation under LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, outperforming an existing state-of-the-art method (45.6% / 47.7%). These improvements highlight the effectiveness of preference-based regularization and inconsistency mining for generating consistent math MCQ distractors at scale.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地用于生成多项选择题 (MCQ) 的干扰项，尤其是在数学教育等领域。然而，现有的方法在确保生成的干扰项与常见学生错误一致方面受到限制。我们提出了 LookAlike，一种通过偏好优化来提高错误干扰一致性的方法。我们的两项主要创新是：（a）从模型不一致中挖掘合成偏好对，以及（b）交替监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化（DPO）以稳定训练。与依赖启发式或手动注释偏好数据的先前工作不同，LookAlike 使用其自身生成的不一致性作为不偏好样本，从而实现可扩展且稳定的训练。在包含 1,400 多个数学 MCQ 的真实数据集上进行评估后，在大语言模型作为法官的评估下，LookAlike 的干扰项生成准确率达到 51.6%，错误生成准确率达到 57.2%，优于现有的最先进方法 (45.6% / 47.7%)。这些改进凸显了基于偏好的正则化和不一致性挖掘对于大规模生成一致的数学 MCQ 干扰因素的有效性。

title: AutomatedL2 Proficiency Scoring: Weak Supervision, Large Language Models, and Statistical Guarantees
abstract_en: Weakly supervised learning (WSL) is a machine learning approach used when labeled data is scarce or expensive to obtain. In such scenarios, models are trained using weaker supervision sources instead of human-annotated data. However, these sources are often noisy and may introduce unquantified biases during training. This issue is particularly pronounced in automated scoring (AS) of second language (L2) learner output, where high variability and limited generalizability pose significant challenges.In this paper, we investigate analytical scoring of L2 learner responses under weak and semi-supervised learning conditions, leveraging Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) to provide statistical guarantees on score validity. We compare two approaches: (1) synthetic scoring using large language models (LLMs), and (2) a semi-supervised setting in which a machine learning model, trained on a small gold-standard set, generates predictions for a larger unlabeled corpus. In both cases, PPI is applied to construct valid confidence intervals for assessing the reliability of the predicted scores.Our analysis, based on a dataset of L2 learner conversations with an AI agent, shows that PPI is highly informative for evaluating the quality of weakly annotated data. Moreover, we demonstrate that PPI can increase the effective sample size by over 150% relative to the original human-scored subset, enabling more robust inference in educational assessment settings where labeled data is scarce.
abstract_zh: 弱监督学习 (WSL) 是一种在标记数据稀缺或获取成本昂贵时使用的机器学习方法。在这种情况下，模型是使用较弱的监督源而不是人工注释的数据来训练的。然而，这些来源通常很嘈杂，并且可能在训练期间引入未量化的偏差。这个问题在第二语言 (L2) 学习者输出的自动评分 (AS) 中尤为明显，其中高变异性和有限的泛化性构成了重大挑战。在本文中，我们研究了弱监督和半监督学习条件下 L2 学习者反应的分析评分，利用预测驱动推理 (PPI) 为分数有效性提供统计保证。我们比较了两种方法：（1）使用大型语言模型（LLM）进行综合评分，以及（2）半监督设置，其中机器学习模型在小型黄金标准集上进行训练，为更大的未标记语料库生成预测。在这两种情况下，PPI 都用于构建有效的置信区间，以评估预测分数的可靠性。我们的分析基于 L2 学习者与 AI 代理的对话数据集，表明 PPI 对于评估弱注释数据的质量具有丰富的信息。此外，我们证明，相对于原始人类评分子集，PPI 可以将有效样本量增加 150% 以上，从而在标记数据稀缺的教育评估环境中实现更稳健的推理。

title: Costs and Benefits ofAI-Enabled Topic Modeling inP-20 Research: The Case of School Improvement Plans
abstract_en: As generative AI tools become increasingly integrated into educational research workflows, large language models (LLMs) have shown substantial promise in automating complex tasks such as topic modeling. This paper presents a user study that evaluates AI-enabled topic modeling (AITM) within the domain of P-20 education research. We investigate the benefits and trade-offs of integrating LLMs into expert document analysis through a case study of school improvement plans, comparing four analytical conditions. Our analysis focuses on three dimensions: (1) the marginal financial and environmental costs of AITM, (2) the impact of LLM assistance on annotation time, and (3) the influence of AI suggestions on topic identification. The results show that LLM increases efficiency and decreases financial cost, but potentially introduce anchoring bias that awareness prompts alone fail to mitigate.
abstract_zh: 随着生成式人工智能工具越来越多地集成到教育研究工作流程中，大型语言模型 (LLM) 在自动化复杂任务（例如主题建模）方面显示出了巨大的前景。本文提出了一项用户研究，评估 P-20 教育研究领域内的人工智能主题建模 (AITM)。我们通过学校改进计划的案例研究，比较四种分析条件，调查了将大语言模型纳入专家文件分析的好处和权衡。我们的分析主要集中在三个维度：（1）AITM 的边际财务和环境成本，（2）LLM 协助对注释时间的影响，以及（3）AI 建议对主题识别的影响。结果表明，大语言模型提高了效率并降低了财务成本，但可能会引入锚定偏差，而仅靠意识提示无法缓解这种偏差。

title: Exploiting theEnglish Vocabulary Profile forL2 word-level vocabulary assessment withLLMs
abstract_en: Vocabulary use is a fundamental aspect of second language (L2) proficiency. To date, its assessment by automated systems has typically examined the context-independent, or part-of-speech (PoS) related use of words. This paper introduces a novel approach to enable fine-grained vocabulary evaluation exploiting the precise use of words within a sentence. The scheme combines large language models (LLMs) with the English Vocabulary Profile (EVP). The EVP is a standard lexical resource that enables in-context vocabulary use to be linked with proficiency level. We evaluate the ability of LLMs to assign proficiency levels to individual words as they appear in L2 learner writing, addressing key challenges such as polysemy, contextual variation, and multi-word expressions. We compare LLMs to a PoS-based baseline. LLMs appear to exploit additional semantic information that yields improved performance.We also explore correlations between word-level proficiency and essay-level proficiency. Finally, the approach is applied to examine the consistency of the EVP proficiency levels. Results show that LLMs are well-suited for the task of vocabulary assessment.
abstract_zh: 词汇使用是第二语言 (L2) 熟练程度的一个基本方面。迄今为止，自动化系统的评估通常检查与上下文无关的或词性 (PoS) 相关的单词使用。本文介绍了一种新颖的方法，可以利用句子中单词的精确使用来进行细粒度的词汇评估。该方案将大语言模型 (LLM) 与英语词汇概况 (EVP) 相结合。 EVP 是一种标准词汇资源，可将上下文词汇使用与熟练程度联系起来。我们评估大语言模型为第二语言学习者写作中出现的单个单词分配熟练程度的能力，解决多义词、上下文变异和多词表达等关键挑战。我们将大语言模型与基于 PoS 的基线进行比较。大语言模型似乎利用了额外的语义信息来提高表现。我们还探讨了单词级别的熟练程度和论文级别的熟练程度之间的相关性。最后，应用该方法来检查 EVP 熟练程度的一致性。结果表明，大语言模型非常适合词汇评估任务。

title: Name of Thrones: How DoLLMs Rank Student Names in Status Hierarchies Based on Race and Gender?
abstract_en: Across cultures, names tell a lot about their bearers as they carry deep personal, historical, and cultural significance. Names have also been found to serve as powerful signals of gender, race, and status in the social hierarchy–a pecking order in which individual positions shape others’ expectations on their perceived competence and worth (Podolny, 2005). With the widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) in education and given that names are often an input for LLMs, it is crucial to evaluate whether LLMs may sort students into status positions based on first and last names and, if so, whether it is in an unfair, biased fashion. While prior work has primarily investigated biases in first names, little attention has been paid to last names and even less to the combined effects of first and last names. In this study, we conduct a large-scale analysis with bootstrap standard errors of 45,000 name variations across 5 ethnicities to examine how AI-generated responses exhibit systemic name biases. Our study investigates three key characteristics of inequality and finds that LLMs reflect, construct, and reinforce status hierarchies based on names that signal gender and ethnicity as they encode differential expectations of competence, leadership, and economic potential. Contrary to the common assumption that AI tends to favor Whites, we show that East and, in some contexts, South Asian names receive higher rankings. We also disaggregate Asians, a population projected to be the largest immigrant group in the U.S. by 2055. Our results challenge the monolithic Asian model minority assumption, illustrating a more complex and stratified model of bias. Additionally, spanning cultural categories by adopting Western first names improves AI-perceived status for East and Southeast Asian students, particularly for girls. Our findings underscore the importance of intersectional and more nuanced understandings of race, gender, and mixed identities in the evaluation of LLMs, rather than relying on broad, monolithic, and mutually exclusive categories. By examining LLM bias and discrimination in our multicultural contexts, our study illustrates potential harms of using LLMs in education as they do not merely reflect implicit biases but also actively construct new social hierarchies that can unfairly shape long-term life trajectories. An LLM that systematically assigns lower grades or subtly less favorable evaluations to students with certain name signals reinforces a tiered system of privilege and opportunity. Some groups may face structural disadvantages, while others encounter undue pressure from inflated expectations.
abstract_zh: 在不同的文化中，名字可以讲述很多关于其持有者的信息，因为它们具有深刻的个人、历史和文化意义。人们还发现，名字可以作为社会等级中性别、种族和地位的有力信号——个人的地位决定了他人对其能力和价值的期望（Podolny，2005）。随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 在教育领域的广泛采用，并且鉴于姓名通常是 LLM 的输入，因此评估 LLM 是否可以根据名字和姓氏对学生进行身份地位排序至关重要，如果是这样，是否以不公平、有偏见的方式进行分类。虽然之前的工作主要调查名字的偏差，但很少关注姓氏，更不用说名字和姓氏的综合影响。在这项研究中，我们对 5 个种族的 45,000 个姓名变体的引导标准误差进行了大规模分析，以研究人工智能生成的响应如何表现出系统性姓名偏差。我们的研究调查了不平等的三个关键特征，发现大语言模型反映、构建和强化了基于象征性别和种族的名字的地位等级制度，因为它们编码了对能力、领导力和经济潜力的不同期望。与人工智能倾向于偏向白人的普遍假设相反，我们发现东方以及在某些情况下南亚的名字排名更高。我们还对亚洲人进行了分类，预计到 2055 年，亚洲人将成为美国最大的移民群体。我们的结果挑战了单一的亚洲模型少数族裔假设，说明了一个更加复杂和分层的偏见模型。此外，通过采用西方名字来跨越文化类别，可以提高东亚和东南亚学生（尤其是女孩）对人工智能的认知地位。我们的研究结果强调了在大语言模型评估中对种族、性别和混合身份进行交叉和更细致的理解的重要性，而不是依赖于广泛的、单一的和相互排斥的类别。通过研究多元文化背景下的大语言模型偏见和歧视，我们的研究说明了在教育中使用大语言模型的潜在危害，因为它们不仅反映了隐性偏见，而且还积极构建了新的社会等级制度，从而不公平地塑造了长期的生活轨迹。大语言模型系统地为具有某些名字信号的学生分配较低的成绩或不太有利的评估，强化了特权和机会的分层制度。一些群体可能面临结构性劣势，而另一些群体则因期望过高而面临过度压力。

title: Exploring task formulation strategies to evaluate the coherence of classroom discussions withGPT-4o
abstract_en: Engaging students in a coherent classroom discussion is one aspect of high-quality instruction and is an important skill that requires practice to acquire. With the goal of providing teachers with formative feedback on their classroom discussions, we investigate automated means for evaluating teachers’ ability to lead coherent discussions in simulated classrooms. While prior work has shown the effectiveness of large language models (LLMs) in assessing the coherence of relatively short texts, it has also found that LLMs struggle when assessing instructional quality. We evaluate the generalizability of task formulation strategies for assessing the coherence of classroom discussions across different subject domains using GPT-4o and discuss how these formulations address the previously reported challenges—the overestimation of instructional quality and the inability to extract relevant parts of discussions. Finally, we report lack of generalizability across domains and the misalignment with humans in the use of evidence from discussions as remaining challenges.
abstract_zh: 让学生参与连贯的课堂讨论是高质量教学的一个方面，也是一项需要练习才能获得的重要技能。为了向教师提供课堂讨论的形成性反馈，我们研究了评估教师在模拟课堂中引导连贯讨论的能力的自动化方法。虽然之前的工作已经证明了大型语言模型 (LLM) 在评估相对较短的文本的连贯性方面的有效性，但也发现 LLM 在评估教学质量时遇到了困难。我们使用 GPT-4o 评估了用于评估不同学科领域课堂讨论连贯性的任务制定策略的普遍性，并讨论了这些制定策略如何解决之前报告的挑战——对教学质量的高估和无法提取讨论的相关部分。最后，我们报告缺乏跨领域的普遍性以及在使用讨论证据时与人类的不一致作为仍然存在的挑战。

title: Improving In-context Learning Example Retrieval for Classroom Discussion Assessment with Re-ranking and Label Ratio Regulation
abstract_en: Recent advancements in natural language processing, particularly large language models (LLMs), are making the automated evaluation of classroom discussions more achievable. In this work, we propose a method to improve the performance of LLMs on classroom discussion quality assessment by utilizing in-context learning (ICL) example retrieval. Specifically, we leverage example re-ranking and label ratio regulation, which forces a specific ratio of different types of examples on the ICL examples.While a standard ICL example retrieval approach shows inferior performance compared to using a predetermined set of examples, our approach improves performance in all tested dimensions. We also conducted experiments to examine the ineffectiveness of the generic ICL example retrieval approach and found that the lack of positive and hard negative examples can be a potential cause. Our analyses emphasize the importance of maintaining a balanced distribution of classes (positive, non-hard negative, and hard negative examples) in creating a good set of ICL examples, especially when we can utilize educational knowledge to identify instances of hard negative examples.
abstract_zh: 自然语言处理，特别是大型语言模型 (LLM) 的最新进展，使得课堂讨论的自动评估变得更加容易实现。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种利用情境学习（ICL）示例检索来提高大语言模型在课堂讨论质量评估方面的表现的方法。具体来说，我们利用示例重新排序和标签比例调节，这强制 ICL 示例上不同类型示例的特定比例。虽然与使用预定示例集相比，标准 ICL 示例检索方法显示出较差的性能，但我们的方法提高了所有测试维度的性能。我们还进行了实验来检查通用 ICL 示例检索方法的无效性，并发现缺乏正面和严格的负面示例可能是一个潜在原因。我们的分析强调了在创建一组良好的 ICL 示例时保持类（正例、非难负例和难负例）的平衡分布的重要性，特别是当我们可以利用教育知识来识别难负例的实例时。

title: Span Labeling with Large Language Models: Shell vs. Meat
abstract_en: We present a method for labeling spans of text with large language models (LLMs) and apply it to the task of identifying shell language, language which plays a structural or connective role without constituting the main content of a text. We compare several recent LLMs by evaluating their “annotations” against a small human-curated test set, and train a smaller supervised model on thousands of LLM-annotated examples. The described method enables workflows that can learn complex or nuanced linguistic phenomena without tedious, large-scale hand-annotations of training data or specialized feature engineering.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种用大语言模型（LLM）标记文本跨度的方法，并将其应用于识别 shell 语言的任务，shell 语言起着结构或连接作用，但不构成文本的主要内容。我们通过根据一个小型的人工策划测试集评估它们的“注释”来比较最近的几个大语言模型，并在数千个大语言模型注释的例子上训练一个较小的监督模型。所描述的方法使得工作流程能够学习复杂或微妙的语言现象，而无需对训练数据或专门的特征工程进行繁琐的大规模手工注释。

title: Temporalizing Confidence: Evaluation of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning with Signal Temporal Logic
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown impressive performance in mathematical reasoning tasks when guided by Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting. However, they tend to produce highly confident yet incorrect outputs, which poses significant risks in domains like education, where users may lack the expertise to assess reasoning steps. To address this, we propose a structured framework that models stepwise confidence as a temporal signal and evaluates it using Signal Temporal Logic (STL). In particular, we define formal STL-based constraints to capture desirable temporal properties and compute robustness scores that serve as structured, interpretable confidence estimates. Our approach also introduces a set of uncertainty reshaping strategies to enforce smoothness, monotonicity, and causal consistency across the reasoning trajectory. Experiments show that our approach consistently improves calibration metrics and provides more reliable uncertainty estimates than conventional confidence aggregation and post-hoc calibration.
abstract_zh: 在思维链 (CoT) 提示的指导下，大型语言模型 (LLM) 在数学推理任务中表现出了令人印象深刻的性能。然而，它们往往会产生高度自信但不正确的输出，这在教育等领域带来了重大风险，因为用户可能缺乏评估推理步骤的专业知识。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个结构化框架，将逐步置信度建模为时间信号，并使用信号时间逻辑（STL）对其进行评估。特别是，我们定义了基于 STL 的正式约束，以捕获所需的时间属性并计算鲁棒性分数，作为结构化、可解释的置信度估计。我们的方法还引入了一组不确定性重塑策略，以增强整个推理轨迹的平滑性、单调性和因果一致性。实验表明，我们的方法持续改进校准指标，并提供比传统置信度聚合和事后校准更可靠的不确定性估计。

title: STAIR-AIG: Optimizing the Automated Item Generation Process through Human-AICollaboration for Critical Thinking Assessment
abstract_en: The advent of artificial intelligence (AI) has marked a transformative era in educational measurement and evaluation, particularly in the development of assessment items. Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as promising tools for scalable automatic item generation (AIG), yet concerns remain about the validity of AI-generated items in various domains. To address this issue, we propose STAIR-AIG (Systematic Tool for Assessment Item Review in Automatic Item Generation), a human-in-the-loop framework that integrates expert judgment to optimize the quality of AIG items. To explore the functionality of the tool, AIG items were generated in the domain of critical thinking. Subsequently, the human expert and four OpenAI LLMs conducted a review of the AIG items. The results show that while the LLMs demonstrated high consistency in their rating of the AIG items, they exhibited a tendency towards leniency. In contrast, the human expert provided more variable and strict evaluations, identifying issues such as the irrelevance of the construct and cultural insensitivity. These findings highlight the viability of STAIR-AIG as a structured human-AI collaboration approach that facilitates rigorous item review, thus optimizing the quality of AIG items. Furthermore, STAIR-AIG enables iterative review processes and accumulates human feedback, facilitating the refinement of models and prompts. This, in turn, would establish a more reliable and comprehensive pipeline to improve AIG practices.
abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）的出现标志着教育测量和评估，特别是评估项目的发展进入了变革时代。大型语言模型 (LLM) 已成为可扩展自动项目生成 (AIG) 的有前途的工具，但人们仍然对人工智能生成的项目在各个领域的有效性感到担忧。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 STAIR-AIG（自动项目生成中评估项目审查的系统工具），这是一个人机交互框架，集成了专家判断来优化 AIG 项目的质量。为了探索该工具的功能，AIG 项目是在批判性思维领域生成的。随后，人类专家和四位 OpenAI 大语言模型对 AIG 项目进行了审查。结果表明，虽然大语言模型对 AIG 项目的评级表现出高度一致性，但他们表现出宽大的倾向。相比之下，人类专家提供了更多变量和更严格的评估，识别诸如结构无关和文化不敏感等问题。这些发现凸显了 STAIR-AIG 作为一种结构化的人机协作方法的可行性，该方法有助于严格的项目审查，从而优化 AIG 项目的质量。此外，STAIR-AIG 支持迭代审核流程并积累人工反馈，从而促进模型和提示的细化。反过来，这将建立一个更可靠、更全面的渠道来改进 AIG 的实践。

title: CanGPTZero’sAIVocabulary Distinguish BetweenLLM-Generated and Student-Written Essays?
abstract_en: Despite recent advances in AI detection methods, their practical application, especially in education, remains limited. Educators need functional tools pointing to AI indicators within texts, rather than merely estimating whether AI was used. GPTZero’s new AI Vocabulary feature, which highlights parts of a text likely to be AI-generated based on frequent words and phrases from LLM-generated texts, offers a potential solution. However, its effectiveness has not yet been empirically validated.In this study, we examine whether GPTZero’s AI Vocabulary can effectively distinguish between LLM-generated and student-written essays. We analyze the AI Vocabulary lists published from October 2024 to March 2025 and evaluate them on a subset of the Ghostbuster dataset, which includes student and LLM essays. We train multiple Bag-of-Words classifiers using GPTZero’s AI Vocabulary terms as features and examine their individual contributions to classification.Our findings show that simply checking for the presence, not the frequency, of specific AI terms yields the best results, particularly with ChatGPT-generated essays. However, performance drops to near-random when applied to Claude-generated essays, indicating that GPTZero’s AI Vocabulary may not generalize well to texts generated by LLMs other than ChatGPT. Additionally, all classifiers based on GPTZero’s AI Vocabulary significantly underperform compared to Bag-of-Words classifiers trained directly on the full dataset vocabulary. These findings suggest that fixed vocabularies based solely on lexical features, despite their interpretability, have limited effectiveness across different LLMs and educational writing contexts.
abstract_zh: 尽管人工智能检测方法最近取得了进展，但它们的实际应用，特别是在教育领域，仍然有限。教育工作者需要指向文本中人工智能指标的功能工具，而不仅仅是估计是否使用了人工智能。 GPTZero 的新 AI 词汇功能提供了一个潜在的解决方案，该功能突出显示了可能根据 LLM 生成文本中的常用单词和短语由 AI 生成的文本部分。然而，其有效性尚未得到实证验证。 在本研究中，我们检验了 GPTZero 的 AI Vocabulary 是否能够有效地区分 LLM 生成的论文和学生撰写的论文。我们分析了 2024 年 10 月至 2025 年 3 月发布的 AI 词汇列表，并在 Ghostbuster 数据集的子集（包括学生和大语言模型论文）上对其进行评估。我们使用 GPTZero 的 AI 词汇术语作为特征来训练多个词袋分类器，并检查它们各自对分类的贡献。我们的研究结果表明，仅检查特定 AI 术语的存在而不是频率会产生最佳结果，特别是对于 ChatGPT 生成的论文。然而，当应用于 Claude 生成的论文时，性能下降到接近随机，这表明 GPTZero 的 AI 词汇可能无法很好地推广到除 ChatGPT 之外的大语言模型生成的文本。此外，与直接在完整数据集词汇上训练的词袋分类器相比，所有基于 GPTZero 的 AI 词汇的分类器都明显表现不佳。这些发现表明，仅基于词汇特征的固定词汇尽管具有可解释性，但在不同的大语言模型和教育写作环境中的有效性有限。

title: End-to-End Automated Item Generation and Scoring for AdaptiveEnglish Writing Assessment with Large Language Models
abstract_en: Automated item generation (AIG) is a key enabler for scaling language proficiency assessments. We present an end-to-end methodology for automated generation, annotation, and integration of adaptive writing items for the EF Standard English Test (EFSET), leveraging recent advances in large language models (LLMs). Our pipeline uses few-shot prompting with state-of-the-art LLMs to generate diverse, proficiency-aligned prompts, rigorously validated by expert reviewers. For robust scoring, we construct a synthetic response dataset via majority-vote LLM annotation and fine-tune a LLaMA 3.1 (8B) model. For each writing item, a range of proficiency-aligned synthetic responses, designed to emulate authentic student work, are produced for model training and evaluation. These results demonstrate substantial gains in scalability and validity, offering a replicable framework for next-generation adaptive language testing.
abstract_zh: 自动项目生成 (AIG) 是扩展语言能力评估的关键推动因素。我们利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 的最新进展，提出了一种端到端方法，用于自动生成、注释和集成 EF 标准英语测试 (EFSET) 的自适应写作项目。我们的流程使用最先进的大语言模型的少样本提示来生成多样化、与熟练程度相符的提示，并经过专家评审员的严格验证。为了获得稳健的评分，我们通过多数票 LLM 注释构建了一个综合响应数据集，并微调了 LLaMA 3.1 (8B) 模型。对于每个写作项目，都会生成一系列与熟练程度相符的综合答案，旨在模拟真实的学生作业，用于模型训练和评估。这些结果表明在可扩展性和有效性方面取得了巨大的进步，为下一代自适应语言测试提供了可复制的框架。

title: MSAatBEA2025 Shared Task: Disagreement-Aware Instruction Tuning for Multi-Dimensional Evaluation ofLLMs as Math Tutors
abstract_en: We present MSA-MathEval, our submission to the BEA 2025 Shared Task on evaluating AI tutor responses across four instructional dimensions: Mistake Identification, Mistake Location, Providing Guidance, and Actionability. Our approach uses a unified training pipeline to fine-tune a single instruction-tuned language model across all tracks, without any task-specific architectural changes. To improve prediction reliability, we introduce a disagreement-aware ensemble inference strategy that enhances coverage of minority labels. Our system achieves strong performance across all tracks, ranking 1st in Providing Guidance, 3rd in Actionability, and 4th in both Mistake Identification and Mistake Location. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of scalable instruction tuning and disagreement-driven modeling for robust, multi-dimensional evaluation of LLMs as educational tutors.
abstract_zh: 我们展示了 MSA-MathEval，这是我们向 BEA 2025 共享任务提交的内容，旨在评估 AI 导师在四个教学维度上的反应：错误识别、错误位置、提供指导和可操作性。我们的方法使用统一的训练管道来跨所有轨道微调单个指令调整的语言模型，而不需要任何特定于任务的架构更改。为了提高预测的可靠性，我们引入了一种分歧感知的集成推理策略，可以增强少数标签的覆盖范围。我们的系统在所有方面都取得了强劲的表现，在提供指导方面排名第一，在可操作性方面排名第三，在错误识别和错误定位方面排名第四。这些结果证明了可扩展的教学调整和分歧驱动的建模对于大语言模型作为教育导师的稳健、多维评估的有效性。

title: Two Outliers atBEA2025 Shared Task: Tutor Identity Classification usingDiReC, a Two-Stage Disentangled Contrastive Representation
abstract_en: This paper presents DiReC (Disentangled Contrastive Representation), a novel two-stage framework designed to address the BEA 2025 Shared Task 5: Tutor Identity Classification. The task involves distinguishing between responses generated by nine different tutors, including both human educators and large language models (LLMs). DiReC leverages a disentangled representation learning approach, separating semantic content and stylistic features to improve tutor identification accuracy. In Stage 1, the model learns discriminative content representations using cross-entropy loss. In Stage 2, it applies supervised contrastive learning on style embeddings and introduces a disentanglement loss to enforce orthogonality between style and content spaces. Evaluated on the validation set, DiReC achieves strong performance, with a macro-F1 score of 0.9101 when combined with a CatBoost classifier and refined using the Hungarian algorithm. The system ranks third overall in the shared task with a macro-F1 score of 0.9172, demonstrating the effectiveness of disentangled representation learning for tutor identity classification.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了 DiReC（解缠结对比表示），这是一种新颖的两阶段框架，旨在解决 BEA 2025 共享任务 5：教师身份分类。该任务涉及区分九位不同导师（包括人类教育工作者和大型语言模型（LLM））生成的响应。 DiReC 利用解缠结的表示学习方法，将语义内容和风格特征分开，以提高导师识别的准确性。在第一阶段，模型使用交叉熵损失来学习有区别的内容表示。在第二阶段，它将监督对比学习应用于风格嵌入，并引入解缠结损失以强制风格和内容空间之间的正交性。在验证集上进行评估，DiReC 实现了强大的性能，与 CatBoost 分类器结合并使用匈牙利算法进行细化时，宏观 F1 得分为 0.9101。该系统在共享任务中总体排名第三，宏观 F1 得分为 0.9172，证明了解纠缠表示学习对于导师身份分类的有效性。

title: CaseReportCollective: A Large-ScaleLLM-Extracted Dataset for Structured Medical Case Reports
abstract_en: Case reports provide critical insights into rare and atypical diseases, but extracting structured knowledge remains challenging due to unstructured text and domain-specific terminology. We introduce CaseReportCollective, an LLM-extracted dataset of 85,961 open-access case reports spanning 37 years across 14 medical domains, validated through programmatic and human evaluation. Our dataset reveals key publication and demographic trends, including a significant increase in open-access case reports over the past decade, shifts in focus from oncology to COVID-19, and sex disparities in reporting across different medical conditions. Over time, the gap between male and female case reports has narrowed, suggesting greater equity in case reporting. Using CaseReportCollective, we further explore embedding-based retrieval for similar medical topics through accumulated similarity scores across extracted structured information. We also conducted detailed error analyses on the retrieval ranking, finding that high-reported topics dominate retrieval. Such retrieval is driven by lexical overlap rather than underlying clinical relevance, often failing to distinguish between semantically similar yet mechanistically distinct conditions. Future work should focus on clinical-aware embeddings adjusted for long-tailed case distributions to improve retrieval accuracy.
abstract_zh: 病例报告提供了对罕见和非典型疾病的重要见解，但由于非结构化文本和特定领域的术语，提取结构化知识仍然具有挑战性。我们引入了 CaseReportCollective，这是一个大语言模型提取的数据集，包含 37 年跨 14 个医学领域的 85,961 份开放获取病例报告，并通过程序和人工评估进行验证。我们的数据集揭示了关键的出版物和人口趋势，包括过去十年开放获取病例报告的显着增加、焦点从肿瘤学转向 COVID-19，以及不同医疗状况报告中的性别差异。随着时间的推移，男性和女性病例报告之间的差距已经缩小，这表明病例报告更加公平。使用 CaseReportCollective，我们通过提取的结构化信息中累积的相似度分数进一步探索基于嵌入的相似医学主题检索。我们还对检索排名进行了详细的错误分析，发现高报道主题主导检索。这种检索是由词汇重叠驱动的，而不是潜在的临床相关性，通常无法区分语义上相似但机制上不同的条件。未来的工作应重点关注针对长尾病例分布进行调整的临床感知嵌入，以提高检索准确性。

title: VirtualCRISPR: CanLLMs PredictCRISPRScreen Results?
abstract_en: CRISPR-Cas systems enable systematic investigation of gene function, but experimental CRISPR screens are resource-intensive. Here, we investigate the potential of Large Language Models (LLMs) to predict the outcomes of CRISPR screens in silico, thereby prioritizing experiments and accelerating biological discovery. We introduce a benchmark dataset derived from BioGRID-ORCS and manually curated sources, and evaluate the performance of several LLMs across various prompting strategies, including chain-of-thought and few-shot learning. Furthermore, we develop a novel, efficient prediction framework using LLM-derived embeddings, achieving significantly improved performance and scalability compared to direct prompting. Our results demonstrate the feasibility of using LLMs to guide CRISPR screen experiments.
abstract_zh: CRISPR-Cas 系统可以对基因功能进行系统研究，但实验性 CRISPR 筛选需要大量资源。在这里，我们研究了大型语言模型 (LLM) 在计算机模拟中预测 CRISPR 筛选结果的潜力，从而确定实验优先级并加速生物发现。我们引入了源自 BioGRID-ORCS 和手动管理来源的基准数据集，并评估了多个大语言模型在各种提示策略（包括思维链和少样本学习）中的表现。此外，我们使用 LLM 派生的嵌入开发了一种新颖、高效的预测框架，与直接提示相比，显着提高了性能和可扩展性。我们的结果证明了使用大语言模型指导 CRISPR 筛选实验的可行性。

title: GigaEmbeddings — EfficientRussian Language Embedding Model
abstract_en: We introduce GigaEmbeddings, a novel framework for training high-performance Russian-focused text embeddings through hierarchical instruction tuning of the decoder-only LLM designed specifically for Russian language (GigaChat-3B). Our three-stage pipeline, comprising large-scale contrastive pre-training in web-scale corpora, fine-tuning with hard negatives, and multitask generalization across retrieval, classification, and clustering tasks, addresses key limitations of existing methods by unifying diverse objectives and leveraging synthetic data generation. Architectural innovations include bidirectional attention for contextual modeling, latent attention pooling for robust sequence aggregation, and strategic pruning of 25% of transformer layers to enhance efficiency without compromising performance. Evaluated on the ruMTEB benchmark spanning 23 multilingual tasks, GigaEmbeddings achieves state-of-the-art results (69.1 avg. score), outperforming strong baselines with a larger number of parameters.
abstract_zh: 我们介绍了 GigaEmbeddings，这是一种新颖的框架，用于通过专为俄语 (GigaChat-3B) 设计的纯解码器 LLM 的分层指令调整来训练高性能俄语文本嵌入。我们的三阶段流程包括网络规模语料库中的大规模对比预训练、硬阴性微调以及跨检索、分类和聚类任务的多任务泛化，通过统一不同的目标和利用合成数据生成来解决现有方法的主要局限性。架构创新包括用于上下文建模的双向注意力、用于稳健序列聚合的潜在注意力池以及对 25% 的转换器层进行战略性修剪以在不影响性能的情况下提高效率。在涵盖 23 个多语言任务的 ruMTEB 基准评估中，GigaEmbeddings 取得了最先进的结果（平均得分为 69.1），优于具有更多参数的强大基线。

title: PL-Guard: Benchmarking Language Model Safety forPolish
abstract_en: We present a benchmark dataset for evaluating language model safety in Polish, addressing the underrepresentation of medium-resource languages in existing safety assessments. Our dataset includes both original and adversarially perturbed examples. We fine-tune and evaluate multiple models—LlamaGuard-3-8B, a HerBERT-based classifier, and PLLuM—and find that the HerBERT-based model outperforms others, especially under adversarial conditions.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个用于评估波兰语语言模型安全性的基准数据集，解决了现有安全评估中中等资源语言代表性不足的问题。我们的数据集包括原始示例和对抗性扰动示例。我们微调和评估了多个模型——LlamaGuard-3-8B、基于 HerBERT 的分类器和 PLLuM——并发现基于 HerBERT 的模型优于其他模型，尤其是在对抗条件下。

title: Bridging the Gap withRedSQL: ARussian Text-to-SQLBenchmark for Domain-Specific Applications
abstract_en: We present the first domain-specific text-to-SQL benchmark in Russian, targeting fields with high operational load where rapid decision-making is critical. The benchmark spans across 9 domains, including healthcare, aviation, and others, and comprises 409 curated query pairs. It is designed to test model generalization under domain shift, introducing challenges such as specialized terminology and complex schema structures. Evaluation of state-of-the-art large language models (LLM) reveals significant performance drop in comparison to open-domain academic benchmarks, highlighting the need for domain-aware approaches in text-to-SQL. The benchmark is available at: https://github.com/BrodskaiaIrina/functional-text2sql-subsets
abstract_zh: 我们推出了第一个俄语版特定于领域的文本到 SQL 基准测试，针对快速决策至关重要的高操作负载领域。该基准跨越 9 个领域，包括医疗保健、航空等，包含 409 个精选查询对。它旨在测试领域转移下的模型泛化，引入专业术语和复杂模式结构等挑战。对最先进的大型语言模型 (LLM) 的评估显示，与开放域学术基准相比，性能显着下降，这凸显了文本到 SQL 领域对域感知方法的需求。该基准可在以下位置获取：https://github.com/BrodskaiaIrina/function-text2sql-subsets

title: Judging It, Washing It: Scoring and Greenwashing Corporate Climate Disclosures using Large Language Models
abstract_en: We study the use of large language models (LLMs) to both evaluate and greenwash corporate climate disclosures. First, we investigate the use of the LLM-as-a-Judge (LLMJ) methodology for scoring company-submitted reports on emissions reduction targets and progress. Second, we probe the behavior of an LLM when it is prompted to greenwash a response subject to accuracy and length constraints. Finally, we test the robustness of the LLMJ methodology against responses that may be greenwashed using an LLM. We find that two LLMJ scoring systems, numerical rating and pairwise comparison, are effective in distinguishing high-performing companies from others, with the pairwise comparison system showing greater robustness against LLM-greenwashed responses.
abstract_zh: 我们研究使用大型语言模型（LLM）来评估和绿化企业气候披露。首先，我们研究了大语言模型法官（LLMJ）方法对公司提交的减排目标和进展报告进行评分的情况。其次，我们探讨了大语言模型在被提示对受准确性和长度限制的响应进行绿色化处理时的行为。最后，我们针对可能使用 LLM 进行绿色清洗的响应来测试 LLMJ 方法的稳健性。我们发现，数字评级和成对比较这两种 LLMJ 评分系统可以有效地将高绩效公司与其他公司区分开来，其中成对比较系统对 LLM 绿化反应表现出更大的鲁棒性。

title: BridgingAIand Carbon Capture: A Dataset forLLMs in Ionic Liquids andCBEResearch
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional performance in general knowledge and reasoning tasks across various domains. However, their effectiveness in specialized scientific fields like Chemical and Biological Engineering (CBE) remains underexplored. Addressing this gap requires robust evaluation benchmarks that assess both knowledge and reasoning capabilities in these niche areas, which are currently lacking. To bridge this divide, we present a comprehensive empirical analysis of LLM reasoning capabilities in CBE, with a focus on Ionic Liquids (ILs) for carbon sequestration—an emerging solution for mitigating global warming. We develop and release an expert-curated dataset of 5,920 examples designed to benchmark LLMs’ reasoning in this domain. The dataset incorporates varying levels of difficulty, balancing linguistic complexity and domain-specific knowledge. Using this dataset, we evaluate three open-source LLMs with fewer than 10 billion parameters. Our findings reveal that while smaller general-purpose LLMs exhibit basic knowledge of ILs, they lack the specialized reasoning skills necessary for advanced applications. Building on these results, we discuss strategies to enhance the utility of LLMs for carbon capture research, particularly using ILs. Given the significant carbon footprint of LLMs, aligning their development with IL research presents a unique opportunity to foster mutual progress in both fields and advance global efforts toward achieving carbon neutrality by 2050. Dataset link: https://github.com/sougata-ub/llms_for_ionic_liquids
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在各个领域的一般知识和推理任务中表现出了卓越的性能。然而，它们在化学和生物工程 (CBE) 等专业科学领域的有效性仍未得到充分探索。解决这一差距需要强有力的评估基准来评估这些利基领域的知识和推理能力，而这是目前所缺乏的。为了弥合这一分歧，我们对 CBE 中的大语言模型推理能力进行了全面的实证分析，重点关注用于碳封存的离子液体 (IL)——一种缓解全球变暖的新兴解决方案。我们开发并发布了由专家策划的包含 5,920 个示例的数据集，旨在对大语言模型在该领域的推理进行基准测试。该数据集包含不同的难度级别，平衡语言复杂性和特定领域的知识。使用此数据集，我们评估了三个开源大语言模型，其参数少于 100 亿个。我们的研究结果表明，虽然规模较小的通用大语言模型展示了 IL 的基本知识，但他们缺乏高级应用程序所需的专业推理技能。基于这些结果，我们讨论了增强大语言模型在碳捕获研究中的效用的策略，特别是使用离子液体。鉴于大语言模型的巨大碳足迹，将其发展与 IL 研究结合起来提供了一个独特的机会，可以促进两个领域的共同进步，并推动全球努力在 2050 年实现碳中和。数据集链接：https://github.com/sougata-ub/llms_for_ionic_liquids

title: Applying the Character-Role Narrative Framework withLLMs to Investigate Environmental Narratives in Scientific Editorials and Tweets
abstract_en: Communication aiming to persuade an audience uses strategies to frame certain entities in ‘character roles’ such as hero, villain, victim, or beneficiary, and to build narratives around these ascriptions. The Character-Role Framework is an approach to model these narrative strategies, which has been used extensively in the Social Sciences and is just beginning to get attention in Natural Language Processing (NLP). This work extends the framework to scientific editorials and social media texts within the domains of ecology and climate change. We identify characters’ roles across expanded categories (human, natural, instrumental) at the entity level, and present two annotated datasets: 1,559 tweets from the Ecoverse dataset and 2,150 editorial paragraphs from Nature & Science. Using manually annotated test sets, we evaluate four state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) (GPT-4o, GPT-4, GPT-4-turbo, LLaMA-3.1-8B) for character-role detection and categorization, with GPT-4 achieving the highest agreement with human annotators. We then apply the best-performing model to automatically annotate the full datasets, introducing a novel entity-level resource for character-role analysis in the environmental domain.
abstract_zh: 旨在说服受众的沟通使用策略来构建“角色角色”中的某些实体，例如英雄、恶棍、受害者或受益人，并围绕这些归属构建叙事。角色角色框架是一种对这些叙事策略进行建模的方法，已广泛应用于社会科学领域，并且刚刚开始在自然语言处理（NLP）领域受到关注。这项工作将框架扩展到生态和气候变化领域的科学社论和社交媒体文本。我们在实体级别识别了扩展类别（人类、自然、工具）中的角色角色，并提供了两个带注释的数据集：来自 Ecoverse 数据集的 1,559 条推文和来自 Nature & Science 的 2,150 个编辑段落。使用手动注释的测试集，我们评估了四种最先进的大型语言模型 (LLM)（GPT-4o、GPT-4、GPT-4-turbo、LLaMA-3.1-8B）用于字符角色检测和分类，其中 GPT-4 与人类注释者达到了最高一致性。然后，我们应用性能最佳的模型来自动注释完整的数据集，引入一种新颖的实体级资源，用于环境领域的角色角色分析。

title: LLM-Driven Estimation of Personal Carbon Footprint from Dialogues
abstract_en: Personal Carbon Footprint (PCF) Estimation is crucial for raising individual environmental awareness by linking daily activities to their environmental impact. However, existing tools are limited by fragmented scenarios and labor-intensive manual data entry. We present PCCT, an LLM-powered system that combines conversational understanding with emission knowledge grounding for PCF Estimation. We address two key challenges: (1) resolving incomplete activity information across turns through knowledge-guided and context-aware tracking, and (2) accurately mapping emission factors using multi-step LLM inference and vector-based similarity search. The system dynamically combines knowledge-guided activity extraction, and context-aware memory management, generating accurate carbon footprint estimates. We validate the effectiveness with theCarbonDialog-1Kbenchmark, comprising 1,028 annotated user activity narratives. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms baseline systems in accuracy, while subjective evaluations show superior appropriateness, usability, efficiency, and naturalness.
abstract_zh: 个人碳足迹 (PCF) 估算对于通过将日常活动与其环境影响联系起来来提高个人环境意识至关重要。然而，现有工具受到碎片化场景和劳动密集型手动数据输入的限制。我们介绍 PCCT，这是一个由大语言模型支持的系统，它将对话理解与 PCF 估算的排放知识基础相结合。我们解决了两个关键挑战：（1）通过知识引导和上下文感知跟踪解决不完整的活动信息，以及（2）使用多步骤 LLM 推理和基于向量的相似性搜索准确映射排放因子。该系统动态地结合了知识引导的活动提取和上下文感知内存管理，生成准确的碳足迹估计。我们使用 CarbonDialog-1K 基准测试验证了有效性，该基准测试包含 1,028 个带注释的用户活动叙述。实验结果表明，我们的方法在准确性方面优于基线系统，而主观评估则显示出优越的适用性、可用性、效率和自然性。

title: Can ReasoningLLMs Synthesize Complex Climate Statements?
abstract_en: Accurately synthesizing climate evidence into concise statements is crucial for policy making and fostering public trust in climate science. Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly the emergence of reasoning-optimized variants, which excel at mathematical and logical tasks, present a promising yet untested opportunity for scientific evidence synthesis. We evaluate state-of-the-art reasoning LLMs on two key tasks: (1) *contextual confidence classification*, assigning appropriate confidence levels to climate statements based on evidence, and (2) *factual summarization of climate evidence*, generating concise summaries evaluated for coherence, faithfulness, and similarity to expert-written versions. Using a novel dataset of 612 structured examples constructed from the Sixth Assessment Report (AR6) of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), we find reasoning LLMs outperform general-purpose models in confidence classification by 8 percentage points in accuracy and macro-F1 scores. However, for summarization tasks, performance differences between model types are mixed. Our findings demonstrate that reasoning LLMs show promise as auxiliary tools for confidence assessment in climate evidence synthesis, while highlighting significant limitations in their direct application to climate evidence summarization. This work establishes a foundation for future research on the targeted integration of LLMs into scientific assessment workflows.
abstract_zh: 将气候证据准确地综合成简明的陈述对于政策制定和培养公众对气候科学的信任至关重要。大型语言模型 (LLM) 的最新进展，特别是擅长数学和逻辑任务的推理优化变体的出现，为科学证据合成提供了一个有前途但未经检验的机会。我们在两个关键任务上评估最先进的推理大语言模型：（1）*上下文置信度分类*，根据证据为气候陈述分配适当的置信度，以及（2）*气候证据的事实总结*，生成简明的摘要，评估其与专家编写版本的连贯性、忠实性和相似性。使用根据政府间气候变化专门委员会 (IPCC) 第六次评估报告 (AR6) 构建的包含 612 个结构化示例的新颖数据集，我们发现推理大语言模型在置信度分类方面的准确性和宏观 F1 分数比通用模型高出 8 个百分点。然而，对于摘要任务，模型类型之间的性能差异是混合的。我们的研究结果表明，推理大语言模型有望作为气候证据合成中置信度评估的辅助工具，同时强调其直接应用于气候证据总结的重大局限性。这项工作为未来有针对性地将大语言模型纳入科学评估工作流程的研究奠定了基础。

title: WinoWhat: A Parallel Corpus of ParaphrasedWinoGrande Sentences with Common Sense Categorization
abstract_en: In this study, we take a closer look at how Winograd schema challenges can be used to evaluate common sense reasoning in LLMs. Specifically, we evaluate generative models of different sizes on the popular WinoGrande benchmark. We release WinoWhat, a new corpus, in which each instance of the WinoGrande validation set is paraphrased. Additionally, we evaluate the performance on the challenge across five common sense knowledge categories, giving more fine-grained insights on what types of knowledge are more challenging for LLMs. Surprisingly, all models perform significantly worse on WinoWhat, implying that LLM reasoning capabilities are overestimated on WinoGrande. To verify whether this is an effect of benchmark memorization, we match benchmark instances to LLM trainingdata and create two test-suites. We observe that memorization has a minimal effect on model performance on WinoGrande.
abstract_zh: 在这项研究中，我们仔细研究了如何使用 Winograd 模式挑战来评估大语言模型中的常识推理。具体来说，我们在流行的 WinoGrande 基准上评估不同大小的生成模型。我们发布了 WinoWhat，一个新的语料库，其中对 WinoGrande 验证集的每个实例进行了释义。此外，我们还评估了五个常识知识类别的挑战表现，从而就哪些类型的知识对大语言模型更具挑战性提供了更细粒度的见解。令人惊讶的是，所有模型在 WinoWhat 上的表现都明显较差，这意味着 LLM 推理能力在 WinoGrande 上被高估了。为了验证这是否是基准记忆的影响，我们将基准实例与 LLM 训练数据进行匹配并创建两个测试套件。我们观察到记忆对 WinoGrande 上的模型性能影响很小。

title: BabyLM’s First Words: Word Segmentation as a Phonological Probing Task
abstract_en: Language models provide a key framework for studying linguistic theories based on prediction, but phonological analysis using large language models (LLMs) is difficult; there are few phonological benchmarks beyond English and the standard input representation used in LLMs (subwords of graphemes) is not suitable for analyzing the representation of phonemes. In this work, we demonstrate how word segmentation can be used as a phonological probing task, allowing us to study the representations learned by phoneme-based language models trained on child-directed speech across 31 languages. Following computational models of word segmentation, we present unsupervised methods for extracting word boundaries from a trained model using the observation that prediction-error peaks at the start of words. We also use linear probes to identify that these models implicitly track word boundaries, even when they do not appear in training. This cross-lingual work corroborates statistical learning theories of acquisition and empirically motivates new methods for training subword tokenizers.
abstract_zh: 语言模型为研究基于预测的语言理论提供了关键框架，但使用大型语言模型（LLM）进行音系分析很困难；除了英语之外，几乎没有音系基准，并且大语言模型（字素的子词）中使用的标准输入表示不适合分析音素的表示。在这项工作中，我们演示了如何将分词用作语音探测任务，使我们能够研究基于音素的语言模型所学到的表示，这些模型是在 31 种语言的儿童定向语音上训练的。根据分词的计算模型，我们提出了无监督方法，通过观察预测误差在单词开头达到峰值来从训练模型中提取单词边界。我们还使用线性探针来识别这些模型隐式跟踪单词边界，即使它们没有出现在训练中。这项跨语言工作证实了习得的统计学习理论，并从经验上激发了训练子词标记器的新方法。

title: Human-likeness ofLLMs in the Mental Lexicon
abstract_en: Recent research has increasingly focused on the extent to which large language models (LLMs) exhibit human-like behavior. In this study, we investigate whether the mental lexicon in LLMs resembles that of humans in terms of lexical organization. Using a word association task—a direct and widely used method for probing word meaning and relationships in the human mind—we evaluated the lexical representations of GPT-4 and Llama-3.1. Our findings reveal that LLMs closely emulate human mental lexicons in capturing semantic relatedness but exhibit notable differences in other properties, such as association frequency and dominant lexical patterns (e.g., top associates). Specifically, LLM lexicons demonstrate greater clustering and reduced diversity compared to the human lexicon, with KL divergence analysis confirming significant deviations in word association patterns. Additionally, LLMs fail to fully capture word association response patterns in different demographic human groups. Among the models, GPT-4 consistently exhibited a slightly higher degree of human-likeness than Llama-3.1. This study highlights both the potential and limitations of LLMs in replicating human mental lexicons, offering valuable insights for applications in natural language processing and cognitive science research involving LLMs.
abstract_zh: 最近的研究越来越关注大型语言模型（LLM）表现出类人行为的程度。在这项研究中，我们调查了大语言模型的心理词汇在词汇组织方面是否与人类相似。使用单词关联任务（一种直接且广泛使用的方法，用于探索人类思维中的单词含义和关系），我们评估了 GPT-4 和 Llama-3.1 的词汇表示。我们的研究结果表明，大语言模型在捕捉语义相关性方面密切模仿人类心理词典，但在其他属性上表现出显着差异，例如关联频率和主要词汇模式（例如顶级关联）。具体来说，与人类词典相比，LLM 词典表现出更大的聚类性和更少的多样性，KL 散度分析证实了单词关联模式的显着偏差。此外，大语言模型无法完全捕捉不同人口群体中的单词关联反应模式。在这些模型中，GPT-4 始终表现出比 Llama-3.1 稍高的人类相似度。这项研究强调了大语言模型在复制人类心理词典方面的潜力和局限性，为涉及大语言模型的自然语言处理和认知科学研究的应用提供了宝贵的见解。

title: Correcting Hallucinations in News Summaries: Exploration of Self-CorrectingLLMMethods with External Knowledge
abstract_en: While large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities to generate coherent text, they suffer from the issue of hallucinations – factually inaccurate statements. Among numerous approaches to tackle hallucinations, especially promising are the self-correcting methods. They leverage the multi-turn nature of LLMs to iteratively generate verification questions inquiring additional evidence, answer them with internal or external knowledge, and use that to refine the original response with the new corrections. These methods have been explored for encyclopedic generation, but less so for domains like news summaries. In this work, we investigate two state-of-the-art self-correcting systems by applying them to correct hallucinated summaries, using evidence from three search engines. We analyze the results and provide insights into systems’ performance, revealing interesting practical findings on the benefits of search engine snippets and few-shot prompts, as well as high alignment of G-Eval and human evaluation.
abstract_zh: 虽然大型语言模型 (LLM) 已显示出生成连贯文本的卓越能力，但它们存在幻觉问题，即事实上不准确的陈述。在众多解决幻觉的方法中，特别有前途的是自我纠正方法。他们利用大语言模型的多轮性质来迭代生成验证问题，询问额外的证据，用内部或外部知识回答这些问题，并用它来通过新的更正来完善原始响应。这些方法已经被探索用于百科全书生成，但对于新闻摘要等领域的探索较少。在这项工作中，我们利用来自三个搜索引擎的证据，研究了两种最先进的自我纠正系统，将它们应用于纠正幻觉摘要。我们分析结果并提供对系统性能的见解，揭示有关搜索引擎片段和少量提示的好处的有趣的实际发现，以及 G-Eval 和人类评估的高度一致性。

title: KazBench-KK: A Cultural-Knowledge Benchmark forKazakh
abstract_en: We introduce KazBench-KK, a comprehensive 7,111-question multiple-choice benchmark designed to assess large language models’ understanding of culturally grounded Kazakh knowledge. By combining expert-curated topics with LLM-assisted web mining, we create a diverse dataset spanning 17 culturally salient domains, including pastoral traditions, social hierarchies, and contemporary politics. Beyond evaluation, KazBench-KK serves as a practical tool for field linguists, enabling rapid lexical elicitation, glossing, and topic prioritization. Our benchmarking of various open-source LLMs reveals that reinforcement-tuned models outperform others, but smaller, domain-focused fine-tunes can rival larger models in specific cultural contexts.
abstract_zh: 我们推出 KazBench-KK，这是一个包含 7,111 个问题的综合性多项选择基准，旨在评估大型语言模型对哈萨克语文化知识的理解。通过将专家策划的主题与大语言模型辅助的网络挖掘相结合，我们创建了一个涵盖 17 个文化显着领域的多样化数据集，包括田园传统、社会等级制度和当代政治。除了评估之外，KazBench-KK 还可以作为现场语言学家的实用工具，实现快速词汇引出、注释和主题优先级排序。我们对各种开源大语言模型的基准测试表明，强化调整模型优于其他模型，但较小的、以领域为中心的微调可以在特定文化背景下与较大的模型相媲美。

title: Assessing the Reliability ofLLMs Annotations in the Context of Demographic Bias and Model Explanation
abstract_en: Understanding the sources of variability in annotations is crucial for developing fair NLP systems, especially for tasks like sexism detection where demographic bias is a concern. This study investigates the extent to which annotator demographic features influence labeling decisions compared to text content. Using a Generalized Linear Mixed Model, we quantify this influence, finding that while statistically present, demographic factors account for a minor fraction (~8%) of the observed variance, with tweet content being the dominant factor. We then assess the reliability of Generative AI (GenAI) models as annotators, specifically evaluating if guiding them with demographic personas improves alignment with human judgments. Our results indicate that simplistic persona prompting often fails to enhance, and sometimes degrades, performance compared to baseline models. Furthermore, explainable AI (XAI) techniques reveal that model predictions rely heavily on content-specific tokens related to sexism, rather than correlates of demographic characteristics. We argue that focusing on content-driven explanations and robust annotation protocols offers a more reliable path towards fairness than potentially persona simulation.
abstract_zh: 了解注释中变异性的来源对于开发公平的 NLP 系统至关重要，尤其是对于性别歧视检测等需要关注人口统计学偏见的任务。本研究调查了与文本内容相比，注释者人口统计特征对标签决策的影响程度。使用广义线性混合模型，我们量化了这种影响，发现虽然统计上存在，人口统计因素只占观察到的方差的一小部分（~8%），而推文内容是主要因素。然后，我们评估生成人工智能（GenAI）模型作为注释者的可靠性，特别是评估用人口统计角色指导它们是否可以提高与人类判断的一致性。我们的结果表明，与基线模型相比，简单的角色提示通常无法提高绩效，有时甚至会降低绩效。此外，可解释的人工智能（XAI）技术表明，模型预测很大程度上依赖于与性别歧视相关的特定内容标记，而不是人口特征的相关性。我们认为，专注于内容驱动的解释和强大的注释协议比潜在的角色模拟提供了更可靠的公平途径。

title: Tag-First: Mitigating Distributional Bias in Synthetic User Profiles through Controlled Attribute Generation
abstract_en: Addressing the critical need for robust bias testing in AI systems, current methods often rely on overly simplistic or rigid persona templates, limiting the depth and realism of fairness evaluations. We introduce a novel framework and an associated tool designed to generate high-quality, diverse, and configurable personas specifically for nuanced bias assessment. Our core innovation lies in a two-stage process: first, generating structured persona tags based solely on user-defined configurations (specified manually or via an included agent tool), ensuring attribute distributions are controlled and crucially, are not skewed by an LLM’s inherent biases regarding attribute correlations during the selection phase. Second, transforming these controlled tags into various realistic outputs—including natural language descriptions, CVs, or profiles—suitable for diverse bias testing scenarios. This tag-centric approach preserves ground-truth attributes for analyzing correlations and biases within the generated population and downstream AI applications. We demonstrate the system’s efficacy by generating and validating 1,000 personas, analyzing both the adherence of natural language descriptions to the source tags and the potential biases introduced by the LLM during the transformation step. The provided dataset, including both generated personas and their source tags, enables detailed analysis. This work offers a significant step towards more reliable, controllable, and representative fairness testing in AI development.
abstract_zh: 为了满足人工智能系统中稳健偏差测试的迫切需求，当前的方法通常依赖于过于简单或僵化的角色模板，限制了公平性评估的深度和现实性。我们引入了一个新颖的框架和一个相关工具，旨在生成高质量、多样化和可配置的角色，专门用于细致入微的偏见评估。我们的核心创新在于两个阶段的过程：首先，仅根据用户定义的配置（手动指定或通过附带的代理工具指定）生成结构化角色标签，确保属性分布受到控制，最重要的是，不会因大语言模型在选择阶段关于属性相关性的固有偏见而产生偏差。其次，将这些受控标签转换为各种实际输出，包括自然语言描述、简历或配置文件，适用于不同的偏差测试场景。这种以标签为中心的方法保留了真实属性，用于分析生成的群体和下游人工智能应用程序中的相关性和偏差。我们通过生成和验证 1,000 个角色、分析自然语言描述对源标签的遵守情况以及大语言模型在转换步骤中引入的潜在偏差来展示系统的功效。提供的数据集（包括生成的角色及其源标签）可以进行详细分析。这项工作为人工智能开发中更加可靠、可控和具有代表性的公平性测试迈出了重要一步。

title: Surface Fairness, Deep Bias: A Comparative Study of Bias in Language Models
