abstract_zh: 语言建模的最新进展表明需要高质量的特定领域训练数据，特别是对于需要专业知识的任务。通用模型虽然用途广泛，但由于特定领域信息有限，通常缺乏专家级任务所需的深度。领域适应训练可以增强这些模型，但它需要大量、高质量的数据。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 ORBIT，这是一种经济高效的方法，用于从嘈杂的网络资源中整理大量、高质量的特定领域数据集，专为训练专业大型语言模型而定制。使用天文学作为主要案例研究，我们将 1.3T 代币 FineWeb-Edu 数据集细化为专注于天文学的高质量、10B 代币子集。在 1B 代币天文学子集上微调 LLaMA-3-8B，将 MMLU 天文学基准的性能从 69% 提高到 76%，并在天文学特定基准 AstroBench 上取得了最高结果。此外，我们的模型 (Orbit-LLaMA) 优于 LLaMA-3-8B-base，GPT-4o 评估在 1000 个天文学特定问题中 73% 的情况下更喜欢它。此外，我们通过将 ORBIT 应用于法律和医学来验证其普遍性，与未经过滤的基线相比，实现了数据质量的显着提高。我们开源了 ORBIT 方法，包括精选的数据集、代码库和生成的模型。

title: Improve Language Model and Brain Alignment via Associative Memory
abstract_en: Associative memory engages in the integration of relevant information for comprehension in the human cognition system. In this work, we seek to improve alignment between language models and human brain while processing speech information by integrating associative memory. After verifying the alignment between language model and brain by mapping language model activations to brain activity, the original text stimuli expanded with simulated associative memory are regarded as input to computational language models. We find the alignment between language model and brain is improved in brain regions closely related to associative memory processing. We also demonstrate large language models after specific supervised fine-tuning better align with brain response, by building the Association dataset containing 1000 samples of stories, with instructions encouraging associative memory as input and associated content as output.
abstract_zh: 联想记忆参与人类认知系统中相关信息的整合以供理解。在这项工作中，我们寻求通过整合联想记忆来提高语言模型和人脑之间的一致性，同时处理语音信息。通过将语言模型激活映射到大脑活动来验证语言模型和大脑之间的一致性后，用模拟联想记忆扩展的原始文本刺激被视为计算语言模型的输入。我们发现，在与联想记忆处理密切相关的大脑区域中，语言模型和大脑之间的一致性得到了改善。我们还通过构建包含 1000 个故事样本的关联数据集，以及鼓励联想记忆作为输入和关联内容作为输出的指令，展示了经过特定监督微调后更好地与大脑反应保持一致的大型语言模型。

title: Large Vocabulary Size Improves Large Language Models
abstract_en: This paper empirically investigates the relationship between subword vocabulary size and the performance of large language models (LLMs) to provide insights on how to define the vocabulary size. Experimental results show that larger vocabulary sizes lead to better performance in LLMs. Moreover, we consider a continual training scenario where a pre-trained language model is trained on a different target language. We introduce a simple method to use a new vocabulary instead of the pre-defined one. We show that using the new vocabulary outperforms the model with the vocabulary used in pre-training.
abstract_zh: 本文实证研究了子词词汇量大小与大型语言模型 (LLM) 性能之间的关系，以提供有关如何定义词汇量大小的见解。实验结果表明，词汇量越大，大语言模型的表现越好。此外，我们考虑了一种持续训练场景，其中预训练的语言模型在不同的目标语言上进行训练。我们介绍一种简单的方法来使用新词汇而不是预定义的词汇。我们表明，使用新词汇的模型优于使用预训练中使用的词汇的模型。

title: Do Language Models Understand the Cognitive Tasks Given to Them? Investigations with the N-Back Paradigm
abstract_en: Cognitive tasks originally developed for humans are now increasingly used to study language models. While applying these tasks is often straightforward, interpreting their results can be challenging. In particular, when a model underperforms, it is often unclear whether this results from a limitation in the cognitive ability being tested or a failure to understand the task itself. A recent study argues that GPT 3.5’s declining performance on 2-back and 3-back tasks reflects a working memory capacity limit similar to humans (Gong et al., 2024). By analyzing a range of open-source language models of varying performance levels on these tasks, we show that the poor performance is due at least in part to a limitation in task comprehension and task set maintenance. We challenge the best-performing model with progressively harder versions of the task (up to 10-back) and experiment with alternative prompting strategies, before analyzing model attentions. Our larger aim is to contribute to the ongoing conversation around refining methodologies for the cognitive evaluation of language models.
abstract_zh: 最初为人类开发的认知任务现在越来越多地用于研究语言模型。虽然应用这些任务通常很简单，但解释其结果可能具有挑战性。特别是，当模型表现不佳时，通常不清楚这是否是由于所测试的认知能力的限制或未能理解任务本身造成的。最近的一项研究认为，GPT 3.5 在 2-back 和 3-back 任务上的性能下降反映了与人类类似的工作记忆容量限制（Gong et al., 2024）。通过分析这些任务上不同性能水平的一系列开源语言模型，我们表明性能不佳至少部分归因于任务理解和任务集维护的限制。在分析模型注意力之前，我们用逐渐困难的任务版本（最多 10 回）来挑战表现最好的模型，并尝试替代的提示策略。我们更大的目标是为围绕改进语言模型认知评估方法的持续对话做出贡献。

title: Tracr-Injection: Distilling Algorithms into Pre-trained Language Models
abstract_en: Motivated by the surge of large language models, there has been a push to formally characterize the symbolic abilities intrinsic to the transformer architecture. A programming language, called RASP, has been proposed, which can be directly compiled into transformer weights to implement these algorithms. However, the tasks that can be implemented in RASP are often uncommon to learn from natural unsupervised data, showing a mismatch between theoretical capabilities of the transformer architecture, and the practical learnability of these capabilities from unsupervised data. We propose tracr-injection, a method that allows us to distill algorithms written in RASP directly into a pre-trained language model. We showcase our method by injecting 3 different algorithms into a language model. We show how our method creates an interpretable subspace within the model’s residual stream, which can be decoded into the variables present in the code of the RASP algorithm. Additionally, we found that the proposed method can improve out-of-distribution performance compared to our baseline, indicating that indeed a more symbolic mechanism is taking place in the inner workings of the model. We release the code used to run our experiments.
abstract_zh: 在大型语言模型激增的推动下，人们一直在推动正式表征 Transformer 架构固有的符号能力。人们提出了一种称为 RASP 的编程语言，可以直接将其编译为变换器权重来实现这些算法。然而，可以在 RASP 中实现的任务通常很少从自然无监督数据中学习，这表明 Transformer 架构的理论功能与从无监督数据中这些功能的实际可学习性之间不匹配。我们提出了 tracr-injection，这种方法允许我们将用 RASP 编写的算法直接提取到预先训练的语言模型中。我们通过将 3 种不同的算法注入到语言模型中来展示我们的方法。我们展示了我们的方法如何在模型的残差流中创建可解释的子空间，该子空间可以解码为 RASP 算法代码中存在的变量。此外，我们发现与我们的基线相比，所提出的方法可以提高分布外性能，这表明模型的内部工作确实正在发生更具象征意义的机制。我们发布了用于运行实验的代码。

title: Revisiting Weak-to-Strong Generalization in Theory and Practice: ReverseKLvs. ForwardKL
abstract_en: As large language models advance toward superhuman performance, ensuring their alignment with human values and abilities grows increasingly complex. Weak-to-strong generalization offers a promising approach by leveraging predictions from weaker models to guide stronger systems, but its effectiveness could be constrained by the inherent noise and inaccuracies in these weak predictions. To address this, we propose a theoretically grounded approach that replaces forward KL divergence—whose mass-covering behavior risks overfitting to imperfect weak signals—with reverse KL divergence. Reverse KL divergence’s zero-forcing effect prioritizes high-confidence predictions, effectively mitigating the influence of unreliable weak supervision. Theoretically, we extend existing bounds and derive tighter lower bounds for both forward and reverse KL divergence. Notably, when a sufficiently pre-trained strong model is fine-tuned on the last linear layer, reverse KL guarantees that it outperforms its weak supervisor by the magnitude of their disagreement. Empirically, we demonstrate that reverse KL and reverse cross-entropy not only enable strong models to outperform those trained with forward KL and standard cross-entropy across most settings, but also exhibit greater robustness to noisy labels.
abstract_zh: 随着大型语言模型向超人性能迈进，确保其与人类价值观和能力的一致性变得越来越复杂。弱到强泛化提供了一种有前途的方法，它利用较弱模型的预测来指导更强的系统，但其有效性可能会受到这些弱预测中固有的噪声和不准确性的限制。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种基于理论的方法，用反向 KL 散度取代正向 KL 散度（其质量覆盖行为存在对不完美的弱信号过度拟合的风险）。反向KL散度的零强迫效应优先考虑高置信度预测，有效减轻不可靠弱监督的影响。理论上，我们扩展了现有的界限，并为正向和反向 KL 散度推导出更严格的下限。值得注意的是，当在最后一个线性层上对经过充分预训练的强模型进行微调时，反向 KL 保证其在分歧程度方面优于其弱监督者。根据经验，我们证明反向 KL 和反向交叉熵不仅使强大的模型能够在大多数设置中优于使用正向 KL 和标准交叉熵训练的模型，而且还对噪声标签表现出更大的鲁棒性。

title: Initializing and Retrofitting Key-Value Adaptors for Traceable Model Editing
abstract_en: As the insight of knowledge storage in language models deepens, the ability to perform CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations on language models becomes increasingly indispensable for satisfying the demands of managing rapidly updating knowledge. Considering the high cost of fine-tuning language models, model editing methods with low cost are usually required to manipulate models’ knowledge. The evidence suggests that modules carrying knowledge in a Transformer module are primarily the MLP blocks, thus we propose iReVa, a method that explicitly initializes and retrofits key-value pairs into MLP blocks to construct a new mapping of a piece of knowledge without damaging the irrelevant knowledge. In comparison to existing methods, iReVa reveals better interpretability and a stronger capacity for carrying traceable edits. Experiment results on a series of GPT series models show our prominent performance on edit success and generalization without influencing specificity. We also made the first attempt to conduct a knowledge withdrawal test of iReVa. Our codes are available at https://github.com/timberflow/iReVa.
abstract_zh: 随着对语言模型知识存储的深入了解，对语言模型执行CRUD（创建、读取、更新、删除）操作的能力对于满足管理快速更新的知识的需求变得越来越不可或缺。考虑到微调语言模型的成本很高，通常需要低成本的模型编辑方法来操纵模型的知识。有证据表明，Transformer 模块中承载知识的模块主要是 MLP 块，因此我们提出了 iReVa，一种将键值对显式初始化并改造为 MLP 块的方法，以构建知识的新映射，而不会损坏不相关的知识。与现有方法相比，iReVa 具有更好的可解释性和更强的可追溯编辑能力。一系列 GPT 系列模型的实验结果表明，我们在不影响特异性的情况下，在编辑成功和泛化方面表现出色。我们还首次尝试对iReVa进行知识撤回测试。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/timberflow/iReVa 获取。

title: CLIX: Cross-Lingual Explanations of Idiomatic Expressions
abstract_en: Automated definition generation systems have been proposed to support vocabulary expansion for language learners. The main barrier to the success of these systems is that learners often struggle to understand definitions due to the presence of potentially unfamiliar words and grammar, particularly when non-standard language is involved. To address these challenges, we propose CLIX, the task of Cross-Lingual explanations of Idiomatic eXpressions. We explore the capabilities of current NLP models for this task, and observe that while it remains challenging, large language models show promise. Finally, we perform a detailed error analysis to highlight the key challenges that need to be addressed before we can reliably incorporate these systems into educational tools.
abstract_zh: 已经提出自动定义生成系统来支持语言学习者的词汇扩展。这些系统成功的主要障碍是，由于存在可能不熟悉的单词和语法，学习者常常难以理解定义，特别是在涉及非标准语言时。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 CLIX，即惯用表达的跨语言解释任务。我们探索了当前 NLP 模型执行此任务的能力，并观察到虽然它仍然具有挑战性，但大型语言模型显示出了希望。最后，我们进行了详细的错误分析，以强调在我们能够可靠地将这些系统纳入教育工具之前需要解决的关键挑战。

title: Packing Analysis: Packing Is More Appropriate for Large Models or Datasets in Supervised Fine-tuning
abstract_en: Packing, initially utilized in the pre-training phase, is an optimization technique designed to maximize hardware resource efficiency by combining different training sequences to fit the model’s maximum input length. Although it has demonstrated effectiveness during pre-training, there remains a lack of comprehensive analysis for the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) stage on the following points: (1) whether packing can effectively enhance training efficiency while maintaining performance, (2) the suitable size of the model and dataset for fine-tuning with the packing method, and (3) whether packing unrelated or related training samples might cause the model to either excessively disregard or over-rely on the context.In this paper, we perform extensive comparisons between SFT methods using padding and packing, covering SFT datasets ranging from 69K to 1.2M and models from 8B to 70B. This provides the first comprehensive analysis of the advantages and limitations of packing versus padding, as well as practical considerations for implementing packing in various training scenarios. Our analysis covers various benchmarks, including knowledge, reasoning, and coding, as well as GPT-based evaluations, time efficiency, and other fine-tuning parameters. We also open-source our code for fine-tuning and evaluation and provide checkpoints fine-tuned on datasets of different sizes, aiming to advance future research on packing methods.
abstract_zh: 打包最初在预训练阶段使用，是一种优化技术，旨在通过组合不同的训练序列以适应模型的最大输入长度来最大化硬件资源效率。尽管在预训练期间已经证明了其有效性，但对监督微调（SFT）阶段仍然缺乏对以下几点的全面分析：（1）打包是否可以在保持性能的同时有效提高训练效率，（2）通过打包方法进行微调的模型和数据集的合适大小，以及（3）打包不相关或相关的训练样本是否会导致模型过度忽视或过度依赖上下文。在本文中，我们对使用打包方法的SFT方法进行了广泛的比较填充和打包，涵盖69K到1.2M的SFT数据集和8B到70B的模型。这首次全面分析了打包与填充的优点和局限性，以及在各种训练场景中实施打包的实际考虑因素。我们的分析涵盖各种基准，包括知识、推理和编码，以及基于 GPT 的评估、时间效率和其他微调参数。我们还开源了用于微调和评估的代码，并提供了针对不同大小的数据集进行微调的检查点，旨在推进未来对打包方法的研究。

title: Persona-judge: Personalized Alignment of Large Language Models via Token-level Self-judgment
abstract_en: Aligning language models with human preferences presents significant challenges, particularly in achieving personalization without incurring excessive computational costs. Existing methods rely on reward signals and additional annotated data, limiting their scalability and adaptability to diverse human values. To address these challenges, we introduce Persona-judge, a novel discriminative paradigm that enables training-free personalized alignment with unseen preferences. Instead of optimizing policy parameters through external reward feedback, Persona-judge leverages the intrinsic preference judgment capabilities of the model. Specifically, a draft model generates candidate tokens conditioned on a given preference, while a judge model, embodying another preference, cross-validates the predicted tokens whether to be accepted. Experimental results demonstrate that Persona-judge, using the inherent preference evaluation mechanisms of the model, offers a scalable and computationally efficient solution to personalized alignment, paving the way for more adaptive customized alignment. Our code is available here.
abstract_zh: 将语言模型与人类偏好保持一致提出了重大挑战，特别是在不产生过多计算成本的情况下实现个性化。现有方法依赖于奖励信号和附加注释数据，限制了它们的可扩展性和对不同人类价值观的适应性。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了 Persona-judge，这是一种新颖的判别范式，可以实现无需培训的个性化调整与看不见的偏好。 Persona-judge 不是通过外部奖励反馈来优化政策参数，而是利用模型的内在偏好判断能力。具体来说，草案模型根据给定的偏好生成候选令牌，而体现另一个偏好的判断模型则交叉验证预测的令牌是否被接受。实验结果表明，Persona-judge 利用模型固有的偏好评估机制，为个性化对齐提供了可扩展且计算高效的解决方案，为更具适应性的定制对齐铺平了道路。我们的代码可以在这里找到。

title: BlockPruner: Fine-grained Pruning for Large Language Models
abstract_en: With the rapid growth in the size and complexity of large language models (LLMs), the costs associated with their training and inference have escalated significantly. Research indicates that certain layers in LLMs harbor substantial redundancy, and pruning these layers has minimal impact on the overall performance. While various layer pruning methods have been developed based on this insight, they generally overlook the finer-grained redundancies within the layers themselves. In this paper, we delve deeper into the architecture of LLMs and demonstrate that finer-grained pruning can be achieved by targeting redundancies in multi-head attention (MHA) and multi-layer perceptron (MLP) blocks. We propose a novel, training-free structured pruning approach called BlockPruner. Unlike existing layer pruning methods, BlockPruner segments each Transformer layer into MHA and MLP blocks. It then assesses the importance of these blocks using perplexity measures and applies a heuristic search for iterative pruning. We applied BlockPruner to LLMs of various sizes and architectures and validated its performance across a wide range of downstream tasks. Experimental results show that BlockPruner achieves more granular and effective pruning compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
abstract_zh: 随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 的规模和复杂性的快速增长，与其训练和推理相关的成本显着上升。研究表明，LLM 中的某些层存在大量冗余，修剪这些层对整体性能的影响很小。虽然基于这种见解开发了各种层修剪方法，但它们通常忽略了层本身内更细粒度的冗余。在本文中，我们深入研究了 LLM 的架构，并证明可以通过针对多头注意力（MHA）和多层感知器（MLP）块中的冗余来实现更细粒度的修剪。我们提出了一种新颖的、免训练的结构化修剪方法，称为 BlockPruner。与现有的层剪枝方法不同，BlockPruner 将每个 Transformer 层分割为 MHA 和 MLP 块。然后，它使用困惑度度量来评估这些块的重要性，并应用启发式搜索进行迭代修剪。我们将 BlockPruner 应用于各种规模和架构的大语言模型，并在各种下游任务中验证了其性能。实验结果表明，与最先进的基线相比，BlockPruner 实现了更精细、更有效的剪枝。

title: REALM: A Dataset of Real-WorldLLMUse Cases
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs), such as the GPT series, have driven significant industrial applications, leading to economic and societal transformations. However, a comprehensive understanding of their real-world applications remains limited.To address this, we introduce **REALM**, a dataset of over 94,000 LLM use cases collected from Reddit and news articles. **REALM** captures two key dimensions: the diverse applications of LLMs and the demographics of their users. It categorizes LLM applications and explores how users’ occupations relate to the types of applications they use.By integrating real-world data, **REALM** offers insights into LLM adoption across different domains, providing a foundation for future research on their evolving societal roles. An interactive dashboard ([https://realm-e7682.web.app/](https://realm-e7682.web.app/)) is provided for easy exploration of the dataset.
abstract_zh: GPT 系列等大型语言模型 (LLM) 推动了重要的工业应用，带来了经济和社会变革。然而，对其实际应用的全面了解仍然有限。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 **REALM**，这是一个从 Reddit 和新闻文章中收集的超过 94,000 个 LLM 用例的数据集。 **REALM** 抓住了两个关键维度：大语言模型的多样化应用及其用户的人口统计数据。它对 LLM 应用程序进行分类，并探讨用户的职业与他们使用的应用程序类型之间的关系。通过集成现实世界的数据，**REALM** 提供了不同领域 LLM 采用情况的见解，为未来研究其不断变化的社会角色奠定了基础。提供了交互式仪表板（[https://realm-e7682.web.app/](https://realm-e7682.web.app/)），以便轻松探索数据集。

title: Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse
abstract_en: Narrative frames are a powerful way of conceptualizing and communicating complex, controversial ideas, however automated frame analysis to date has mostly overlooked this framing device. In this paper, we connect elements of narrativity with fundamental aspects of framing, and present a framework which formalizes and operationalizes such aspects. We annotate and release a data set of news articles in the climate change domain, analyze the dominance of narrative frame components across political leanings, and test LLMs in their ability to predict narrative frames and their components. Finally, we apply our framework in an unsupervised way to elicit components of narrative framing in a second domain, the COVID-19 crisis, where our predictions are congruent with prior theoretical work showing the generalizability of our approach.
abstract_zh: 叙事框架是概念化和传达复杂、有争议的想法的一种强大方式，然而迄今为止的自动框架分析大多忽略了这种框架装置。在本文中，我们将叙事元素与框架的基本方面联系起来，并提出了一个将这些方面形式化和可操作化的框架。我们注释并发布了气候变化领域新闻文章的数据集，分析了跨政治倾向的叙事框架组成部分的主导地位，并测试了大语言模型预测叙事框架及其组成部分的能力。最后，我们以无监督的方式应用我们的框架来引出第二个领域（即 COVID-19 危机）中叙事框架的组成部分，其中我们的预测与先前的理论工作一致，显示了我们方法的普遍性。

title: Clarifying Underspecified Discourse Relations in Instructional Texts
abstract_en: Discourse relations contribute to the structure of a text and can optionally be realized through explicit connectives such as “but” and “while”. But when are these connectives necessary to avoid possible misunderstandings? We investigate this question by first building a corpus of 4,274 text revisions in each of which a connective was explicitly inserted. For a subset of 250 cases, we collect plausibility annotations on other connectives to check whether they would represent suitable alternative relations. The results of this annotation show that several relations are often perceived as plausible in our data. Furthermore, we analyze the extent to which large language models can identify instances with multiple plausible relations as a possible source of misunderstandings. We find that the models predict plausibility of individual connectives with up to 66% accuracy, but they are not reliable in estimating when multiple relations are plausible.
abstract_zh: 话语关系有助于文本的结构，并且可以选择通过诸如“但是”和“同时”等显式连接词来实现。但是什么时候需要使用这些连接词来避免可能的误解呢？我们通过首先构建一个包含 4,274 个文本修订的语料库来研究这个问题，每个修订中都明确插入了一个连接词。对于 250 个案例的子集，我们收集了其他连接词的合理性注释，以检查它们是否代表合适的替代关系。该注释的结果表明，在我们的数据中，几种关系通常被认为是合理的。此外，我们分析了大型语言模型可以在多大程度上识别具有多种合理关系的实例作为可能的误解来源。我们发现这些模型预测单个连接词的合理性的准确度高达 66%，但它们在估计多重关系何时合理时并不可靠。

title: ConFit v2: Improving Resume-Job Matching using Hypothetical Resume Embedding and Runner-Up Hard-Negative Mining
abstract_en: A reliable resume-job matching system helps a company recommend suitable candidates from a pool of resumes and helps a job seeker find relevant jobs from a list of job posts. However, since job seekers apply only to a few jobs, interaction labels in resume-job datasets are sparse. We introduce ConFit v2, an improvement over ConFit to tackle this sparsity problem. We propose two techniques to enhance the encoder’s contrastive training process: augmenting job data with hypothetical reference resume generated by a large language model; and creating high-quality hard negatives from unlabeled resume/job pairs using a novel hard-negative mining strategy. This method also simplifies the representation space of the encoder. We evaluate ConFit v2 on two real-world datasets and demonstrate that it outperforms ConFit and prior methods (including BM25 and OpenAI text-embedding-003), achieving an average absolute improvement of 13.8% in recall and 17.5% in nDCG across job-ranking and resume-ranking tasks.
abstract_zh: 可靠的简历职位匹配系统可以帮助公司从简历库中推荐合适的候选人，并帮助求职者从职位列表中找到相关职位。然而，由于求职者只申请少数工作，因此简历工作数据集中的交互标签很少。我们引入了 ConFit v2，它是对 ConFit 的改进，旨在解决这个稀疏问题。我们提出了两种技术来增强编码器的对比训练过程：使用大型语言模型生成的假设参考简历来增强工作数据；并使用新颖的硬负片挖掘策略从未标记的简历/工作对中创建高质量的硬负片。该方法还简化了编码器的表示空间。我们在两个真实数据集上评估 ConFit v2，并证明它优于 ConFit 和之前的方法（包括 BM25 和 OpenAI text-embedding-003），在职位排名和简历排名任务中，召回率平均绝对提高 13.8%，nDCG 平均绝对提高 17.5%。

title: Towards Explainable Hate Speech Detection
abstract_en: Recent advancements in deep learning have significantly enhanced the efficiency and accuracy of natural language processing (NLP) tasks. However, these models often require substantial computational resources, which remains a major drawback. Reducing the complexity of deep learning architectures, and exploring simpler yet effective approaches can lead to cost-efficient NLP solutions. This is also a step towards explainable AI, i.e., uncovering how a particular task is carried out. For this analysis, we chose the task of hate speech detection. We address hate speech detection by introducing a model that employs a weighted sum of valence, arousal, and dominance (VAD) scores for classification. To determine the optimal weights and classification strategies, we analyze hate speech and non-hate speech words based on both their individual and summed VAD-values. Our experimental results demonstrate that this straightforward approach can compete with state-of-the-art neural network methods, including GPT-based models, in detecting hate speech.
abstract_zh: 深度学习的最新进展显着提高了自然语言处理（NLP）任务的效率和准确性。然而，这些模型通常需要大量的计算资源，这仍然是一个主要缺点。降低深度学习架构的复杂性并探索更简单但有效的方法可以带来具有成本效益的 NLP 解决方案。这也是迈向可解释人工智能的一步，即揭示特定任务是如何执行的。对于此分析，我们选择仇恨言论检测任务。我们通过引入一种模型来解决仇恨言论检测问题，该模型采用效价、唤醒度和支配性 (VAD) 分数的加权和进行分类。为了确定最佳权重和分类策略，我们根据仇恨言论和非仇恨言论的单独和总 VAD 值进行分析。我们的实验结果表明，这种简单的方法在检测仇恨言论方面可以与最先进的神经网络方法（包括基于 GPT 的模型）竞争。

title: World Knowledge Resolves Some Aspectual Ambiguity
abstract_en: Annotating event descriptions with their aspectual features is often seen as a pre-requisite to temporal reasoning. However, a recent study by Pruś et al. (2024) has shown that non-experts’ annotations of the aspectual class of English verb phrases can disagree with both expert linguistic annotations and each another. They hypothesised that people use their world knowledge to tacitly conjure their own contexts, leading to disagreement between them. In this paper, we test that hypothesis by adding context to Pruś et al.’s examples and mirroring their experiment. Our results show that whilst their hypothesis explains some of the disagreement, some examples continue to yield divided responses even with the additional context. Finally, we show that outputs from GPT-4, despite to some degree capturing the aspectual class division, are not an accurate predictor of human answers.
abstract_zh: 用其方面特征来注释事件描述通常被视为时间推理的先决条件。然而，Pruś 等人最近的一项研究。 (2024) 表明，非专家对英语动词短语体类的注释可能与专家语言注释不一致，而且彼此之间也可能不一致。他们假设人们利用他们的世界知识来默认他们自己的背景，从而导致他们之间的分歧。在本文中，我们通过为 Pruś 等人的示例添加上下文并反映他们的实验来检验该假设。我们的结果表明，虽然他们的假设解释了一些分歧，但即使有额外的背景，一些例子仍然会产生分歧的反应。最后，我们表明，GPT-4 的输出尽管在某种程度上捕获了方面类别划分，但并不能准确预测人类答案。

title: Not quite Sherlock Holmes: Language model predictions do not reliably differentiate impossible from improbable events
abstract_en: Can language models reliably predict that possible events are more likely than merely improbable ones? By teasing apart possibility, typicality, and contextual relatedness, we show that despite the results of previous work, language models’ ability to do this is far from robust. In fact, under certain conditions, all models tested—including Llama 3, Gemma 2, and Mistral NeMo—perform at worse-than-chance level, assigning higher probabilities to impossible sentences such as ‘the car was given a parking ticket by the brake’ than to merely unlikely sentences such as ‘the car was given a parking ticket by the explorer’.
abstract_zh: 语言模型能否可靠地预测可能发生的事件比不可能发生的事件更有可能发生？通过梳理可能性、典型性和上下文相关性，我们表明，尽管之前的工作取得了成果，但语言模型执行此操作的能力还远远不够强大。事实上，在某些条件下，所有测试的模型（包括 Llama 3、Gemma 2 和 Mistral NeMo）的表现都比偶然水平更差，为不可能的句子（例如“汽车被刹车给了停车罚单”）分配了更高的概率，而不是为不太可能的句子（例如“汽车被探险家给了停车罚单”）分配了更高的概率。

title: LDIR: Low-Dimensional Dense and Interpretable Text Embeddings with Relative Representations
abstract_en: Semantic text representation is a fundamental task in the field of natural language processing. Existing text embedding (e.g., SimCSE and LLM2Vec) have demonstrated excellent performance, but the values of each dimension are difficult to trace and interpret. Bag-of-words, as classic sparse interpretable embeddings, suffers from poor performance. Recently, Benara et al. (2024) propose interpretable text embeddings using large language models, which forms ”0/1” embeddings based on responses to a series of questions. These interpretable text embeddings are typically high-dimensional (larger than 10,000). In this work, we propose Low-dimensional (lower than 500) Dense and Interpretable text embeddings with Relative representations (LDIR). The numerical values of its dimensions indicate semantic relatedness to different anchor texts through farthest point sampling, offering both semantic representation as well as a certain level of traceability and interpretability. We validate LDIR on multiple semantic textual similarity, retrieval, and clustering tasks. Extensive experimental results show that LDIR performs close to the black-box baseline models and outperforms the interpretable embeddings baselines with much fewer dimensions.
abstract_zh: 语义文本表示是自然语言处理领域的一项基本任务。现有的文本嵌入（例如 SimCSE 和 LLM2Vec）已表现出出色的性能，但每个维度的值难以追踪和解释。词袋作为经典的稀疏可解释嵌入，性能不佳。最近，贝纳拉等人。 (2024) 提出使用大型语言模型的可解释文本嵌入，该模型根据对一系列问题的回答形成“0/1”嵌入。这些可解释的文本嵌入通常是高维的（大于 10,000）。在这项工作中，我们提出了具有相对表示（LDIR）的低维（低于 500）密集且可解释的文本嵌入。其维度的数值通过最远点采样表明与不同锚文本的语义相关性，既提供语义表示，又提供一定程度的可追溯性和可解释性。我们在多个语义文本相似性、检索和聚类任务上验证 LDIR。大量的实验结果表明，LDIR 的性能接近黑盒基线模型，并且优于维度更少的可解释嵌入基线。

title: Harnessing Large Language Models for Disaster Management: A Survey
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across various domains, including their emerging role in mitigating threats to human life, infrastructure, and the environment during natural disasters. Despite increasing research on disaster-focused LLMs, there remains a lack of systematic reviews and in-depth analyses of their applications in natural disaster management. To address this gap, this paper presents a comprehensive survey of LLMs in disaster response, introducing a taxonomy that categorizes existing works based on disaster phases and application scenarios. By compiling public datasets and identifying key challenges and opportunities, this study aims to provide valuable insights for the research community and practitioners in developing advanced LLM-driven solutions to enhance resilience against natural disasters.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在各个领域都展现出了非凡的能力，包括它们在减轻自然灾害期间对人类生命、基础设施和环境的威胁方面的新兴作用。尽管对以灾害为重点的大语言模型的研究越来越多，但仍然缺乏对其在自然灾害管理中的应用的系统评价和深入分析。为了解决这一差距，本文对灾害响应中的大语言模型进行了全面调查，引入了一种根据灾害阶段和应用场景对现有工作进行分类的分类法。通过编译公共数据集并确定关键挑战和机遇，本研究旨在为研究界和从业者开发先进的大语言模型驱动的解决方案以增强抵御自然灾害的能力提供宝贵的见解。

title: Enhancing the Comprehensibility of Text Explanations via Unsupervised Concept Discovery
abstract_en: Concept-based explainable approaches have emerged as a promising method in explainable AI because they can interpret models in a way that aligns with human reasoning. However, their adaption in the text domain remains limited. Most existing methods rely on predefined concept annotations and cannot discover unseen concepts, while other methods that extract concepts without supervision often produce explanations that are not intuitively comprehensible to humans, potentially diminishing user trust. These methods fall short of discovering comprehensible concepts automatically. To address this issue, we propose ECO-Concept, an intrinsically interpretable framework to discover comprehensible concepts with no concept annotations. ECO-Concept first utilizes an object-centric architecture to extract semantic concepts automatically. Then the comprehensibility of the extracted concepts is evaluated by large language models. Finally, the evaluation result guides the subsequent model fine-tuning to obtain more understandable explanations using relatively comprehensible concepts. Experiments show that our method achieves superior performance across diverse tasks. Further concept evaluations validate that the concepts learned by ECO-Concept surpassed current counterparts in comprehensibility.
abstract_zh: 基于概念的可解释方法已成为可解释人工智能中一种有前途的方法，因为它们可以以符合人类推理的方式解释模型。然而，它们在文本领域的适应仍然有限。大多数现有方法依赖于预定义的概念注释，无法发现看不见的概念，而其他在没有监督的情况下提取概念的方法通常会产生人类无法直观理解的解释，可能会降低用户的信任。这些方法无法自动发现可理解的概念。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 ECO-Concept，这是一个本质上可解释的框架，用于发现无需概念注释的可理解概念。 ECO-Concept首先利用以对象为中心的架构来自动提取语义概念。然后通过大型语言模型评估提取的概念的可理解性。最后，评估结果指导后续模型微调，使用相对容易理解的概念获得更容易理解的解释。实验表明，我们的方法在不同的任务中取得了优异的性能。进一步的概念评估验证了 ECO-Concept 所学到的概念在可理解性方面超越了当前的同行。

title: The Impact of Name Age Perception on Job Recommendations inLLMs
abstract_en: Names often carry generational connotations, with certain names stereotypically associated with younger or older age groups. This study examines implicit age-related name bias in LLMs used for job recommendations. Analyzing six LLMs and 117 American names categorized by perceived age across 30 occupations, we find systematic bias: older-sounding names are favored for senior roles, while younger-sounding names are linked to youth-dominant jobs, reinforcing generational stereotypes. We also find that this bias is based on perceived rather than real ages associated with the names.
abstract_zh: 名字通常带有代际含义，某些名字通常与较年轻或较年长的年龄群体相关。本研究调查了用于工作推荐的大语言模型中隐含的与年龄相关的姓名偏见。通过分析 30 个职业中按感知年龄分类的 6 个大语言模型和 117 个美国名字，我们发现了系统性偏见：听起来年长的名字更适合担任高级职位，而听起来年轻的名字则与年轻人主导的工作相关，这强化了代际刻板印象。我们还发现这种偏见是基于与名字相关的感知年龄而不是实际年龄。

title: Position Paper:MeMo: Towards Language Models with Associative Memory Mechanisms
abstract_en: Memorization is a fundamental ability of Transformer-based Large Language Models, achieved through learning. In this position/theory paper, we propose a paradigm shift by designing an architecture to memorize text directly, bearing in mind the principle that memorization precedes learning. We introduce MeMo, a novel architecture for language modeling that explicitly memorizes sequences of tokens in layered associative memories. By design, MeMo offers transparency and the possibility of model editing, including forgetting texts. We experimented with the MeMo architecture, showing the memorization power of the one-layer and the multi-layer configurations.
abstract_zh: 记忆是基于 Transformer 的大型语言模型的一项基本能力，是通过学习实现的。在这篇立场/理论论文中，我们提出了一种范式转变，通过设计一种直接记忆文本的架构，牢记记忆先于学习的原则。我们引入了 MeMo，一种新颖的语言建模架构，它可以显式地记住分层关联记忆中的标记序列。从设计上来说，MeMo 提供了透明度和模型编辑的可能性，包括忘记文本。我们对 MeMo 架构进行了实验，展示了单层和多层配置的记忆能力。

title: AdParaphrase v2.0: Generating Attractive Ad Texts Using a Preference-Annotated Paraphrase Dataset
abstract_en: Identifying factors that make ad text attractive is essential for advertising success. This study proposes AdParaphrase v2.0, a dataset for ad text paraphrasing, containing human preference data, to enable the analysis of the linguistic factors and to support the development of methods for generating attractive ad texts. Compared with v1.0, this dataset is 20 times larger, comprising 16,460 ad text paraphrase pairs, each annotated with preference data from ten evaluators, thereby enabling a more comprehensive and reliable analysis. Through the experiments, we identified multiple linguistic features of engaging ad texts that were not observed in v1.0 and explored various methods for generating attractive ad texts. Furthermore, our analysis demonstrated the relationships between human preference and ad performance, and highlighted the potential of reference-free metrics based on large language models for evaluating ad text attractiveness.The dataset is publicly available at: https://github.com/CyberAgentAILab/AdParaphrase-v2.0.
abstract_zh: 确定使广告文字具有吸引力的因素对于广告的成功至关重要。本研究提出了 AdParaphrase v2.0，这是一个用于广告文本释义的数据集，包含人类偏好数据，可以分析语言因素并支持开发有吸引力的广告文本方法。与v1.0相比，该数据集扩大了20倍，包含16,460个广告文本释义对，每个释义对都注释有来自10个评估者的偏好数据，从而可以进行更全面、更可靠的分析。通过实验，我们发现了 v1.0 中未观察到的多种引人入胜的广告文本的语言特征，并探索了生成有吸引力的广告文本的各种方法。此外，我们的分析证明了人类偏好与广告效果之间的关系，并强调了基于大型语言模型的无参考指标在评估广告文本吸引力方面的潜力。该数据集公开发布于：https://github.com/Cyber​​AgentAILab/AdParaphrase-v2.0。

title: Do Large Language Models Have “Emotion Neurons”? Investigating the Existence and Role
abstract_en: This study comprehensively explores whether there actually exist “emotion neurons” within large language models (LLMs) that selectively process and express certain emotions, and what functional role they play. Drawing on the representative emotion theory of the six basic emotions, we focus on six core emotions. Using synthetic dialogue data labeled with emotions, we identified sets of neurons that exhibit consistent activation patterns for each emotion. As a result, we confirmed that principal neurons handling emotion information do indeed exist within the model, forming distinct groups for each emotion, and that their distribution varies with model size and architectural depth. We then validated the functional significance of these emotion neurons by analyzing whether the prediction accuracy for a specific emotion significantly decreases when those neurons are artificially removed. We observed that in some emotions, the accuracy drops sharply upon neuron removal, while in others, the model’s performance largely remains intact or even improves, presumably due to overlapping and complementary mechanisms among neurons. Furthermore, by examining how prediction accuracy changes depending on which layer range and at what proportion the emotion neurons are masked, we revealed that emotion information is processed in a multilayered and complex manner within the model.
abstract_zh: 这项研究全面探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）中是否确实存在选择性处理和表达某些情绪的“情绪神经元”，以及它们发挥的功能作用。借鉴六种基本情绪的代表情绪理论，我们重点关注六种核心情绪。使用标记有情绪的合成对话数据，我们识别出对每种情绪表现出一致激活模式的神经元组。结果，我们确认处理情绪信息的主要神经元确实存在于模型中，为每种情绪形成不同的组，并且它们的分布随着模型大小和架构深度而变化。然后，我们通过分析当这些神经元被人为移除时，特定情绪的预测准确性是否会显着降低，从而验证了这些情绪神经元的功能意义。我们观察到，在某些情绪中，神经元移除后准确性急剧下降，而在其他情绪中，模型的性能基本上保持不变甚至有所提高，这可能是由于神经元之间的重叠和互补机制。此外，通过检查预测精度如何根据情感神经元被屏蔽的层范围和比例而变化，我们发现情感信息在模型中以多层且复杂的方式进行处理。

title: Generalizable Cross-Lingual Cognitive Distortion Detection with Standardized Annotations and Multi-Task Learning
abstract_en: Cognitive distortion is a critical issue in psychology, with most existing studies based on Burns’ cognitive distortion theory. However, differences in annotation standards lead to variations in building analysis tools, resulting in inconsistent analyses and limiting the generalizability of findings, especially in large-scale and cross-linguistic contexts. To address this issue, we collected all publicly available datasets (four in total) and conducted a series of experiments to evaluate the generalizability of various cross-linguistic models. The results indicate that models exhibit significant performance differences across datasets, highlighting the generalization problem. To mitigate this issue, we propose two solutions. First, we propose a multi-task learning model based on teacher student architecture solution, which demonstrates improved generalization performance in our experiments. Second, we introduce a new dataset (~5,000 samples) derived from reannotating existing open datasets to ensure standardized alignment. The annotation process we provided is interpretable and grounded in psychological principles. Based on this, we constructed large language models with cognitive reasoning chains, enhancing both generalizability and interpretability. This study identifies the generalization challenge in cognitive distortion research, and our experiments show that the proposed solutions significantly improve model performance. The dataset and code are publicly available at: https://github.com/HongzhiQ/CrossLinCD.
abstract_zh: 认知扭曲是心理学中的一个关键问题，现有的大多数研究都是基于伯恩斯的认知扭曲理论。然而，注释标准的差异导致构建分析工具的变化，导致分析不一致并限制研究结果的普遍性，特别是在大规模和跨语言的背景下。为了解决这个问题，我们收集了所有公开可用的数据集（总共四个），并进行了一系列实验来评估各种跨语言模型的普遍性。结果表明，模型在不同数据集上表现出显着的性能差异，突出了泛化问题。为了缓解这个问题，我们提出了两种解决方案。首先，我们提出了一种基于教师学生架构解决方案的多任务学习模型，该模型在我们的实验中证明了泛化性能的提高。其次，我们引入了一个新的数据集（约 5,000 个样本），该数据集源自重新注释​​现有的开放数据集，以确保标准化对齐。我们提供的注释过程是可解释的并且基于心理学原理。在此基础上，我们构建了具有认知推理链的大型语言模型，增强了泛化性和可解释性。这项研究确定了认知扭曲研究中的泛化挑战，我们的实验表明，所提出的解决方案显着提高了模型性能。数据集和代码可公开获取：https://github.com/hongzhiQ/CrossLinCD。

title: Eliciting Textual Descriptions from Representations of Continuous Prompts
abstract_en: Continuous prompts, or “soft prompts”, are a widely-adopted parameter-efficient tuning strategy for large language models, but are often less favorable due to their opaque nature. Prior attempts to interpret continuous prompts relied on projecting individual prompt tokens onto the vocabulary space. However, this approach is problematic as performant prompts can yield arbitrary or contradictory text, and it individually interprets each prompt token. In this work, we propose a new approach to interpret continuous prompts that elicits textual descriptions from their representations during model inference. Using a Patchscopes variant (Ghandeharioun et al., 2024) called InSPEcT over various tasks, we show our method often yields accurate task descriptions which become more faithful as task performance increases. Moreover, an elaborated version of InSPEcT reveals biased features in continuous prompts, whose presence correlates with biased model predictions. Providing an effective interpretability solution, InSPEcT can be leveraged to debug unwanted properties in continuous prompts and inform developers on ways to mitigate them.
abstract_zh: 连续提示或“软提示”是大型语言模型广泛采用的参数高效调整策略，但由于其不透明的性质，通常不太受欢迎。先前解释连续提示的尝试依赖于将单个提示标记投影到词汇空间上。然而，这种方法是有问题的，因为高性能提示可能会产生任意或矛盾的文本，并且它会单独解释每个提示标记。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新方法来解释连续提示，在模型推理过程中从其表示中引出文本描述。在各种任务上使用称为 InSPEcT 的 Patchscopes 变体（Ghandeharioun 等人，2024），我们表明我们的方法通常会产生准确的任务描述，随着任务性能的提高，这些描述会变得更加忠实。此外，InSPEcT 的详细版本揭示了连续提示中的偏差特征，其存在与偏差模型预测相关。 InSPEcT 提供了有效的可解释性解决方案，可用于调试连续提示中不需要的属性，并告知开发人员缓解这些问题的方法。

title: On the Generalization vs Fidelity Paradox in Knowledge Distillation
abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a key technique for compressing large language models into smaller ones while preserving performance. Despite the recent traction of KD research, its effectiveness for smaller language models (LMs) and the mechanisms driving knowledge transfer remain underexplored. In this work, we present the first large-scale empirical and statistical analysis of KD across models ranging from 0.5B to 7B parameters on 14 complex reasoning tasks in a zero-shot setting. Our findings reveal that KD can improve the average performance of smaller models by up to 10%, with a peak task specific gain of 22%, while providing only marginal benefits (∼ 1.3%) for larger models. Surprisingly, teacher performance has a minimal impact on student outcomes, while teacher task expertise impacts KD effectiveness. A correlation study indicates that smaller LMs benefit more from KD, whereas larger LMs show diminished gains. Additionally, we uncover a misalignment between improvements in student performance and reasoning fidelity, suggesting that while KD enhances accuracy, it does not always maintain the structured decision-making processes of the teacher. Our ablation study further highlights the importance of teacher signals and logit smoothing in influencing students’ performance after distillation. Overall, our study offers a comprehensive empirical and statistical assessment of KD, highlighting both its benefits and trade-offs when distilling knowledge from larger to smaller LMs.
abstract_zh: 知识蒸馏（KD）是将大型语言模型压缩为较小的语言模型同时保持性能的关键技术。尽管 KD 研究最近备受关注，但其对小型语言模型 (LM) 的有效性以及驱动知识转移的机制仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们首次对零样本设置下 14 个复杂推理任务的 0.5B 到 7B 参数模型的 KD 进行了大规模实证和统计分析。我们的研究结果表明，KD 可以将较小模型的平均性能提高高达 10%，峰值任务特定增益为 22%，而对于较大模型仅提供边际效益（∼ 1.3%）。令人惊讶的是，教师的表现对学生成绩的影响很小，而教师的任务专业知识会影响 KD 的有效性。相关研究表明，较小的 LM 从 KD 中受益更多，而较大的 LM 则显示收益减少。此外，我们发现学生成绩的提高和推理保真度之间存在不一致，这表明虽然 KD 提高了准确性，但它并不总是能维持教师的结构化决策过程。我们的消融研究进一步强调了教师信号和逻辑平滑在影响蒸馏后学生表现方面的重要性。总的来说，我们的研究对 KD 进行了全面的实证和统计评估，强调了从较大的 LM 向较小的 LM 提取知识时的好处和权衡。

title: PromptCoT: Synthesizing Olympiad-level Problems for Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models
abstract_en: The ability of large language models to solve complex mathematical problems has progressed significantly, particularly for tasks requiring advanced reasoning. However, the scarcity of sufficiently challenging problems, particularly at the Olympiad level, hinders further advancements. In this work, we introduce PromptCoT, a novel approach for automatically generating high-quality Olympiad-level math problems. The proposed method synthesizes complex problems based on mathematical concepts and the rationale behind problem construction, emulating the thought processes of experienced problem designers. We provide a theoretical analysis demonstrating that an optimal rationale should maximize both the likelihood of rationale generation given the associated concepts and the likelihood of problem generation conditioned on both the rationale and the concepts. Our method is evaluated on standard benchmarks including GSM8K, MATH-500, and AIME2024, where it consistently outperforms existing problem generation methods. Furthermore, we demonstrate that PromptCoT exhibits superior scalability, consistently maintaining high performance as the dataset size increases, outperforming the baselines.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型解决复杂数学问题的能力已经显着进步，特别是对于需要高级推理的任务。然而，缺乏足够具有挑战性的问题，特别是在奥林匹克级别，阻碍了进一步的进步。在这项工作中，我们介绍了 PromptCoT，这是一种自动生成高质量奥林匹克级数学问题的新颖方法。所提出的方法基于数​​学概念和问题构造背后的基本原理来综合复杂的问题，模仿经验丰富的问题​​设计者的思维过程。我们提供的理论分析表明，最佳基本原理应该最大化给定相关概念的基本原理生成的可能性以及基于基本原理和概念的问题生成的可能性。我们的方法在 GSM8K、MATH-500 和 AIME2024 等标准基准上进行评估，其性能始终优于现有的问题生成方法。此外，我们证明 PromptCoT 具有卓越的可扩展性，随着数据集大小的增加始终保持高性能，优于基线。

title: Privacy Ripple Effects from Adding or Removing Personal Information in Language Model Training
abstract_en: Due to the sensitive nature of personally identifiable information (PII), its owners may have the authority to control its inclusion or request its removal from large-language model (LLM) training. Beyond this, PII may be added or removed from training datasets due to evolving dataset curation techniques, because they were newly scraped for retraining, or because they were included in a new downstream fine-tuning stage. We find that the amount and ease of PII memorization is a dynamic property of a model that evolves throughout training pipelines and depends on commonly altered design choices. We characterize three such novel phenomena: (1) similar-appearing PII seen later in training can elicit memorization of earlier-seen sequences in what we call assisted memorization, and this is a significant factor (in our settings, up to 1/3); (2) adding PII can increase memorization of other PII; and (3) removing PII can lead to other PII being memorized.
abstract_zh: 由于个人身份信息 (PII) 的敏感性，其所有者可能有权控制其包含或要求将其从大语言模型 (LLM) 培训中删除。除此之外，由于数据集管理技术的不断发展，PII 可能会从训练数据集中添加或删除，因为它们是新刮取的用于再训练，或者因为它们被包含在新的下游微调阶段。我们发现，PII 记忆的数量和难易程度是模型的动态属性，该属性在整个训练流程中不断演变，并且取决于通常更改的设计选择。我们描述了三个这样的新现象：（1）在训练中后来看到的相似的 PII 可以在我们所谓的辅助记忆中引发对先前看到的序列的记忆，这是一个重要因素（在我们的设置中，高达 1/3）； (2)添加PII可以增加对其他PII的记忆； (3)删除PII会导致其他PII被记住。

title: The Lies Characters Tell: Utilizing Large Language Models to Normalize AdversarialUnicode Perturbations
abstract_en: Homoglyphs, Unicode characters that are visually homogeneous to Latin letters, are widely used to mask offensive content. Dynamic strategies are needed to combat homoglyphs as the Unicode library is ever-expanding and new substitution possibilities for Latin letters continuously emerge. The present study investigated two novel mitigation approaches that do not rely on strict mappings but instead harness the power of large language models to neutralize both known and unknown homoglyphs: (1) indirectly normalizing homoglyphs by replacing non-Latin characters with a delimiter and prompting large language models to “fill in the blanks” and (2) directly normalizing homoglyphs by using large language models to determine which characters should be replaced with Latin letters. We found that GPT-4o-mini constructed normalized text with an average cosine similarity score of 0.91 to the original tweets when applying our indirect method and 0.96 to the original tweets when applying our direct method. This study indicates that large language model-based normalization techniques can effectively unmask offensive content concealed by homoglyphs. Code and data are available in our GitHub repository: https://github.com/pcoopercoder/The-Lies-Characters-Tell.
abstract_zh: 同形文字（在视觉上与拉丁字母相似的 Unicode 字符）被广泛用于掩盖攻击性内容。随着 Unicode 库的不断扩展以及拉丁字母的新替代可能性的不断出现，需要动态策略来对抗同形文字。本研究调查了两种新颖的缓解方法，这些方法不依赖于严格的映射，而是利用大型语言模型的力量来中和已知和未知的同形文字：（1）通过用分隔符替换非拉丁字符并提示大型语言模型“填补空白”来间接标准化同形文字；（2）通过使用大型语言模型来确定哪些字符应该用拉丁字母替换来直接标准化同形文字。我们发现，当应用我们的间接方法时，GPT-4o-mini 构建的标准化文本与原始推文的平均余弦相似度得分为 0.91，而当应用我们的直接方法时，与原始推文的平均余弦相似度得分为 0.96。这项研究表明，基于大型语言模型的规范化技术可以有效地揭露同形文字隐藏的攻击性内容。代码和数据可在我们的 GitHub 存储库中获取：https://github.com/pcoopercoder/The-Lies-Characters-Tell。

title: Speech Act Patterns for Improving Generalizability of Explainable Politeness Detection Models
abstract_en: The lack of explainability in state-of-the-art Natural Language Understanding (NLU) classification models has increased interest in developing techniques for improving explainable linear feature-based models (e.g., Logistic Regression/SVM). Politeness detection is a task that exemplifies this interest. While those techniques perform well on the task when applied to data from the same domain as the training data, they lack generalizability and thus fall short when applied to data from other domains. This is due to their reliance on discovering domain-specific word-level features. We introduce a method for improving the generalizability of explainable politeness models by relying on speech act patterns instead of words, leveraging speech act labels assigned by the GPT-4 model. This approach goes beyond the mere words and injects intent into politeness classification models, enhancing their generalizability. Results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy in the cross-domain setting among explainable methods, while falling short in the in-domain setting. Our findings illustrate that explainable models can benefit from Large Language Models.
abstract_zh: 最先进的自然语言理解 (NLU) 分类模型缺乏可解释性，这增加了人们对开发用于改进可解释的基于线性特征的模型（例如逻辑回归/SVM）的技术的兴趣。礼貌检测是体现这种兴趣的任务。虽然这些技术在应用于来自与训练数据相同领域的数据时在任务上表现良好，但它们缺乏通用性，因此在应用于来自其他领域的数据时表现不佳。这是因为他们依赖于发现特定领域的字级特征。我们引入了一种方法，通过依赖言语行为模式而不是单词，利用 GPT-4 模型分配的言语行为标签来提高可解释礼貌模型的泛化性。这种方法超越了单纯的词语，并将意图注入到礼貌分类模型中，从而增强了它们的普遍性。结果表明，所提出的方法在可解释方法中的跨域设置中实现了最先进的准确性，但在域内设置中却表现不佳。我们的研究结果表明，可解释的模型可以从大型语言模型中受益。

title: The Impact of Large Language Models in Academia: from Writing to Speaking
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly impacting human society, particularly in textual information. Based on more than 30,000 papers and 1,000 presentations from machine learning conferences, we examined and compared the words used in writing and speaking, representing the first large-scale study of how LLMs influence the two main modes of verbal communication and expression within the same group of people. Our empirical results show that LLM-style words such as significant have been used more frequently in abstracts and oral presentations. The implicit impact on human expression like writing and speaking is beginning to emerge and is likely to grow in the future. We take the first step in building an automated monitoring platform to record its longitudinal changes to call attention to the implicit influence and ripple effect of LLMs on human society.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）对人类社会的影响越来越大，特别是在文本信息方面。基于机器学习会议上的 30,000 多篇论文和 1,000 多份演示文稿，我们检查并比较了写作和口语中使用的词语，这是第一个关于大语言模型如何影响同一群体中口头交流和表达的两种主要模式的大规模研究。我们的实证结果表明，LLM 风格的单词（例如“significant”）在摘要和口头陈述中使用得更频繁。对人类表达（如写作和说话）的隐性影响已经开始显现，并且在未来可能会增长。我们第一步建立了一个自动化监测平台，记录其纵向变化，以引起人们对LLM对人类社会的隐性影响和连锁反应的关注。

title: How DoLLMs Acquire New Knowledge? A Knowledge Circuits Perspective on Continual Pre-Training
abstract_en: Despite exceptional capabilities in knowledge-intensive tasks, Large Language Models (LLMs) face a critical gap in understanding how they internalize new knowledge, particularly how acquired knowledge becomes structurally embedded in their neural computations. We address this issue through the lens of knowledge circuit evolution, identifying computational subgraphs that facilitate knowledge storage and processing. Our systematic analysis of circuit evolution throughout continual pre-training reveals several key findings: (1) the acquisition of new knowledge is influenced by its relevance to pre-existing knowledge; (2) the evolution of knowledge circuits exhibits a distinct phase shift from formation to optimization; (3) the evolution of knowledge circuits follows a deep-to-shallow pattern. These insights not only advance our theoretical understanding of the mechanisms of new knowledge acquisition in LLMs, but also provide potential implications for improving continual pre-training strategies to enhance model performance.
abstract_zh: 尽管在知识密集型任务中具有出色的能力，但大型语言模型（LLM）在理解如何内化新知识方面面临着严重的差距，特别是所获得的知识如何结构性地嵌入到其神经计算中。我们通过知识电路演化的视角来解决这个问题，识别促进知识存储和处理的计算子图。我们对整个持续预训练过程中的电路演化的系统分析揭示了几个关键发现：（1）新知识的获取受到其与预先存在的知识的相关性的影响； （2）知识回路的演化呈现出从形成到优化的明显相移； (3)知识回路的演化遵循由深到浅的规律。这些见解不仅增进了我们对大语言模型新知识获取机制的理论理解，而且还为改进持续预训练策略以提高模型性能提供了潜在的影响。

title: FRAME: BoostingLLMs with A Four-Quadrant Multi-Stage Pretraining Strategy
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly advanced human language understanding and generation, with pretraining data quality and organization being crucial to their performance. Multi-stage pretraining is a promising approach, but existing methods often lack quantitative criteria for data partitioning and instead rely on intuitive heuristics. In this paper, we propose the novel Four-quadRAnt Multi-stage prEtraining strategy (FRAME), guided by the established principle of organizing the pretraining process into four stages to achieve significant loss reductions four times. This principle is grounded in two key findings: first, training on high Perplexity (PPL) data followed by low PPL data, and second, training on low PPL difference (PD) data followed by high PD data, both causing the loss to drop significantly twice and performance enhancements. By partitioning data into four quadrants and strategically organizing them, FRAME achieves a remarkable 16.8% average improvement over random across MMLU and CMMLU for the 3B model, effectively boosting LLM performance.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 显着提高了人类语言理解和生成能力，预训练数据质量和组织对其性能至关重要。多阶段预训练是一种很有前途的方法，但现有方法通常缺乏数据划分的定量标准，而是依赖于直观的启发式方法。在本文中，我们提出了新颖的四象限多阶段预训练策略（FRAME），以将预训练过程组织为四个阶段的既定原则为指导，以实现四次显着的损失减少。这一原则基于两个关键发现：首先，先对高 Perplexity (PPL) 数据进行训练，然后再对低 PPL 数据进行训练；其次，对低 PPL 差异 (PD) 数据进行训练，然后再对高 PD 数据进行训练，这都会导致损失显着下降两倍并提高性能。通过将数据划分为四个象限并进行策略性组织，FRAME 在 3B 模型的 MMLU 和 CMMLU 中比随机模型平均提高了 16.8%，有效提升了 LLM 性能。

title: When Large Language Models Meet Speech: A Survey on Integration Approaches
abstract_en: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have spurred interest in expanding their application beyond text-based tasks. A large number of studies have explored integrating other modalities with LLMs, notably speech modality, which is naturally related to text. This paper surveys the integration of speech with LLMs, categorizing the methodologies into three primary approaches: text-based, latent-representation-based, and audio-token-based integration. We also demonstrate how these methods are applied across various speech-related applications and highlight the challenges in this field to offer inspiration for future research.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 的最新进展激发了人们将其应用扩展到基于文本的任务之外的兴趣。大量研究探索了将其他模式与大语言模型相结合，特别是与文本自然相关的语音模式。本文调查了语音与大语言模型的集成，将方法分为三种主要方法：基于文本、基于潜在表示和基于音频令牌的集成。我们还演示了如何将这些方法应用于各种语音相关应用，并强调该领域的挑战，为未来的研究提供灵感。

title: The Elephant in the Room: Exploring the Role of Neutral Words in Language Model Group-Agnostic Debiasing
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into our daily lives, raising significant ethical concerns, especially about perpetuating stereotypes.While group-specific debiasing methods have made progress, they often fail to address multiple biases simultaneously. In contrast, group-agnostic debiasing has the potential to mitigate a variety of biases at once, but remains underexplored.In this work, we investigate the role of neutral words—the group-agnostic component—in enhancing the group-agnostic debiasing process. We first reveal that neutral words are essential for preserving semantic modeling, and we propose𝜖-DPCE, a method that incorporates a neutral word semantics-based loss function to effectively alleviate the deterioration of the Language Modeling Score (LMS) during the debiasing process. Furthermore, by introducing the SCM-Projection method, we demonstrate that SCM-based debiasing eliminates stereotypes by indirectly disrupting the association between attribute and neutral words in the Stereotype Content Model (SCM) space. Our experiments show that neutral words, which often embed multi-group stereotypical objects, play a key role in contributing to the group-agnostic nature of SCM-based debiasing.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地融入我们的日常生活，引发了重大的道德问题，特别是关于长期存在刻板印象的问题。虽然特定群体的消除偏见方法取得了进展，但它们往往无法同时解决多种偏见。相比之下，与群体无关的去偏见有可能同时减轻各种偏见，但仍然没有得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们研究了中性词（与群体无关的成分）在增强与群体无关的去偏见过程中的作用。我们首先揭示了中性词对于保留语义建模至关重要，并且我们提出了𝜖-DPCE，一种结合了基于中性词语义的损失函数的方法，可以有效缓解去偏过程中语言建模分数（LMS）的恶化。此外，通过引入 SCM 投影方法，我们证明基于 SCM 的去偏通过间接破坏刻板印象内容模型（SCM）空间中属性和中性词之间的关联来消除刻板印象。我们的实验表明，中性词通常嵌入多组刻板对象，在促进基于 SCM 的去偏见的组不可知性质中发挥着关键作用。

title: Preference Curriculum:LLMs Should Always Be Pretrained on Their Preferred Data
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) generally utilize a consistent data distribution throughout the pretraining process. However, as the model’s capability improves, it is intuitive that its data preferences dynamically change, indicating the need for pretraining with different data at various training stages. To achieve it, we propose the Perplexity Difference (PD) based Preference Curriculum learning (PDPC) framework, which always perceives and uses the data preferred by LLMs to train and boost them. First, we introduce the PD metric to quantify the difference in how challenging a sample is for weak versus strong models. Samples with high PD are more challenging for weak models to learn and are more suitable to be arranged in the later stage of pretraining. Second, we propose the preference function to approximate and predict the data preference of the LLM at any training step, so as to complete the arrangement of the dataset offline and ensure continuous training without interruption. Experimental results on 1.3B and 3B models demonstrate that PDPC significantly surpasses baselines. Notably, the 3B model trained on 1T tokens achieves an increased average accuracy of over 8.1% across MMLU and CMMLU.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 通常在整个预训练过程中使用一致的数据分布。然而，随着模型能力的提高，直观地看到其数据偏好会动态变化，这表明需要在不同的训练阶段使用不同的数据进行预训练。为了实现这一目标，我们提出了基于困惑差异（PD）的偏好课程学习（PDPC）框架，该框架始终感知并使用大语言模型偏好的数据来训练和提升他们。首先，我们引入 PD 指标来量化样本对于弱模型和强模型的挑战性差异。 PD高的样本对于弱模型来说学习起来更有挑战性，更适合安排在预训练的后期。其次，我们提出偏好函数来近似和预测LLM在任何训练步骤的数据偏好，从而完成离线数据集的整理并确保不间断的连续训练。 1.3B 和 3B 模型的实验结果表明，PDPC 显着超过基线。值得注意的是，在 1T 令牌上训练的 3B 模型在 MMLU 和 CMMLU 上的平均准确度提高了 8.1% 以上。

title: Is ItJUSTSemantics? A Case Study of Discourse Particle Understanding inLLMs
abstract_en: Discourse particles are crucial elements that subtly shape the meaning of text. These words, often polyfunctional, give rise to nuanced and often quite disparate semantic/discourse effects,as exemplified by the diverse uses of the particle *just* (e.g., exclusive, temporal, emphatic). This work investigates the capacity of LLMs to distinguish the fine-grained senses of English *just*, a well-studied example in formal semantics, using data meticulously created and labeled by expert linguists. Our findings reveal that while LLMs exhibit some ability to differentiate between broader categories, they struggle to fully capture more subtle nuances, highlighting a gap in their understanding of discourse particles.
abstract_zh: 语篇助词是微妙地塑造文本含义的关键元素。这些词通常具有多种功能，会产生微妙且通常截然不同的语义/话语效果，例如助词“just”的多种用法（例如，排他性、时间性、强调性）。这项工作调查了大语言模型区分英语*just*的细粒度含义的能力，这是形式语义学中经过充分研究的例子，使用由语言专家精心创建和标记的数据。我们的研究结果表明，虽然大语言模型表现出一定的区分更广泛类别的能力，但他们很难充分捕捉更微妙的细微差别，这凸显了他们对话语粒子的理解上的差距。

title: Explain then Rank: Scale Calibration of Neural Rankers Using Natural Language Explanations fromLLMs
abstract_en: In search settings, calibrating the scores during the ranking process to quantities such as click-through rates or relevance levels enhances a system’s usefulness and trustworthiness for downstream users. While previous research has improved this notion of calibration for low complexity learning-to-rank models, the larger data demands and parameter count specific to modern neural text rankers produce unique obstacles that hamper the efficacy of methods intended for the learning-to-rank setting.This paper proposes exploiting large language models (LLMs) to provide relevance and uncertainty signals for these neural text rankers to produce scale-calibrated scores through Monte Carlo sampling of natural language explanations (NLEs). Our approach transforms the neural ranking task from ranking textual query-document pairs to ranking corresponding synthesized NLEs. Comprehensive experiments on two popular document ranking datasets show that the NLE-based calibration approach consistently outperforms past calibration methods and LLM-based methods for ranking, calibration, and query performance prediction tasks.
abstract_zh: 在搜索设置中，在排名过程中将分数校准为点击率或相关级别等数量，可以增强系统对下游用户的实用性和可信度。虽然之前的研究改进了低复杂度学习排序模型的校准概念，但现代神经文本排序器特有的较大数据需求和参数计数产生了独特的障碍，阻碍了学习排序设置方法的有效性。本文建议利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 为这些神经文本排序器提供相关性和不确定性信号，通过自然语言解释 (NLE) 的蒙特卡罗采样生成尺度校准分数。我们的方法将神经排序任务从对文本查询-文档对进行排序转变为对相应的合成 NLE 进行排序。对两个流行的文档排名数据集的综合实验表明，基于 NLE 的校准方法在排名、校准和查询性能预测任务方面始终优于过去的校准方法和基于 LLM 的方法。

title: Pruning General Large Language Models into Customized Expert Models
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed natural language processing, yet their substantial model sizes often demand significant computational resources. To preserve computing resources and accelerate inference speed, it is crucial to prune redundant parameters, especially for experienced users who often need expert models tailored to specific downstream scenarios. However, current pruning methods primarily focus on maintaining models’ general capabilities, either requiring extensive post-training or performing poorly due to coarse-grained pruning. In this work, we design a̲Custom̲Pruning method (Cus-Prun) to prune a large general model into a smaller lightweight expert model, which is positioned along the “language”, “domain” and “task” dimensions. By identifying and pruning irrelevant neurons of each dimension,Cus-Pruncreates expert models without any post-training. Our experiments demonstrate thatCus-Prunconsistently outperforms other methods, achieving minimal loss in both expert and general capabilities across various models from different model families and sizes.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 已经改变了自然语言处理，但其庞大的模型规模通常需要大量的计算资源。为了节省计算资源并加快推理速度，修剪冗余参数至关重要，特别是对于经常需要针对特定​​下游场景定制专家模型的经验丰富的用户。然而，当前的剪枝方法主要侧重于维持模型的一般能力，要么需要大量的后期训练，要么由于粗粒度剪枝而表现不佳。在这项工作中，我们设计了一种自定义剪枝方法（Cus-Prun），将大型通用模型剪枝为较小的轻量级专家模型，该模型沿着“语言”、“领域”和“任务”维度定位。通过识别和修剪每个维度的不相关神经元，Cus-Prun 创建专家模型，无需任何后期训练。我们的实验表明，Cus-Prun 始终优于其他方法，在不同模型系列和规模的各种模型中实现了专家和一般能力的最小损失。

title: Task Facet Learning: A Structured Approach To Prompt Optimization
abstract_en: Given a task in the form of a basic description and its training examples, prompt optimization is the problem of synthesizing the given information into a text prompt for a large language model. Humans solve this problem by also considering the different facets that define a task (e.g., counter-examples, explanations, analogies) and including them in the prompt. However, it is unclear whether existing algorithmic approaches, based on iteratively editing a given prompt or automatically selecting a few in-context examples, can cover the multiple facets required to solve a complex task. In this work, we view prompt optimization as that of learning multiple facets of a task from a set of training examples. We exploit structure in the prompt optimization problem and break down a prompt into loosely coupled semantic sections. The proposed algorithm, UniPrompt, (1) clusters the input space and uses clustered batches so that each batch likely corresponds to a different facet of the task, and (2) utilizes a feedback mechanism to propose adding, editing or deleting a section, which in turn is aggregated over a batch to capture generalizable facets. Empirical evaluation on multiple datasets and a real-world task shows that prompts generated using UniPrompt obtain higher accuracy than human-tuned prompts and those from state-of-the-art methods. In particular, our algorithm can generate long, complex prompts that existing methods are unable to generate.
abstract_zh: 给定基本描述形式的任务及其训练示例，提示优化是将给定信息合成为大型语言模型的文本提示的问题。人类通过考虑定义任务的不同方面（例如反例、解释、类比）并将它们包含在提示中来解决这个问题。然而，目前尚不清楚基于迭代编辑给定提示或自动选择一些上下文示例的现有算法方法是否可以涵盖解决复杂任务所需的多个方面。在这项工作中，我们将即时优化视为从一组训练示例中学习任务的多个方面。我们利用提示优化问题中的结构，并将提示分解为松散耦合的语义部分。所提出的算法 UniPrompt，(1) 对输入空间进行聚类并使用聚类批次，以便每个批次可能对应于任务的不同方面，(2) 利用反馈机制建议添加、编辑或删除一个部分，然后将其聚合在一个批次上以捕获可概括的方面。对多个数据集和现实世界任务的实证评估表明，使用 UniPrompt 生成的提示比人工调整的提示和最先进的方法生成的提示具有更高的准确性。特别是，我们的算法可以生成现有方法无法生成的长而复杂的提示。

title: Unveiling and Addressing Pseudo Forgetting in Large Language Models
abstract_en: Although substantial efforts have been made to mitigate catastrophic forgetting in continual learning, the intrinsic mechanisms are not well understood. In this work, we demonstrate the existence of “pseudo forgetting”: the performance degradation in previous tasks is not attributed to a loss of capabilities, but rather to the failure of the instructions to activate the appropriate model capabilities. We show that the model’s performance on previous tasks can be restored through two simple interventions: (1) providing partial external correct rationale, and (2) appending semantically meaningless suffixes to the original instructions, to guide the generation of correct rationales. Through empirical analysis of the internal mechanisms governing rationale generation, we reveal that models exhibiting pseudo forgetting show reduced instruction dependence during rationale generation, leading to suboptimal activation of their inherent capabilities. Based on this insight, we propose Rationale-Guidance Difficulty based Replay (RGD-R) framework that dynamically allocates replay data based on the model’s ability to correctly leverage the intrinsic capabilities. Experimental results demonstrate that RGD-R effectively mitigates pseudo forgetting while maintaining model plasticity.
abstract_zh: 尽管人们已经做出了大量努力来减轻持续学习中的灾难性遗忘，但其内在机制尚不清楚。在这项工作中，我们证明了“伪遗忘”的存在：之前任务中的性能下降并不是由于能力的丧失，而是由于指令未能激活适当的模型能力。我们表明，可以通过两种简单的干预来恢复模型在先前任务上的性能：（1）提供部分外部正确的基本原理，以及（2）在原始指令中附加语义上无意义的后缀，以指导正确基本原理的生成。通过对控制基本原理生成的内部机制的实证分析，我们发现，表现出伪遗忘的模型在基本原理生成过程中表现出指令依赖性降低，导致其固有能力的激活不理想。基于这一见解，我们提出了基于原理指导难度的重放（RGD-R）框架，该框架根据模型正确利用内在功能的能力动态分配重放数据。实验结果表明，RGD-R 有效减轻伪遗忘，同时保持模型可塑性。

title: ShouldITrust You? Detecting Deception in Negotiations using CounterfactualRL
abstract_en: An increasingly common socio-technical problem is people being taken in by offers that sound “too good to be true”, where persuasion and trust shape decision-making. This paper investigates how AI can help detect these deceptive scenarios. We analyze how humans strategically deceive each other in Diplomacy, a board game that requires both natural language communication and strategic reasoning. This requires extracting logical forms representing proposals—agreements that players suggest during communication—and computing their relative rewards using agents’ value functions. Combined with text-based features, this can improve our deception detection. Our method detects human deception with a high precision when compared to a Large Language Model approach that flags many true messages as deceptive. Future human-AI interaction tools can build on our methods for deception detection by triggering friction to give users a chance of interrogating suspicious proposals.
abstract_zh: 一个日益常见的社会技术问题是，人们被听起来“好得令人难以置信”的优惠所欺骗，说服和信任影响着决策。本文研究了人工智能如何帮助检测这些欺骗性场景。我们分析了人类如何在《外交》（一款需要自然语言交流和战略推理的棋盘游戏）中战略性地相互欺骗。这需要提取代表建议的逻辑形式（玩家在沟通过程中建议的协议），并使用代理的价值函数计算他们的相对奖励。与基于文本的特征相结合，这可以改进我们的欺骗检测。与将许多真实消息标记为欺骗性的大型语言模型方法相比，我们的方法可以高精度检测人类欺骗。未来的人机交互工具可以建立在我们的欺骗检测方法的基础上，通过触发摩擦，让用户有机会询问可疑的建议。

title: Research Community Perspectives on “Intelligence” and Large Language Models
abstract_en: Despite the widespread use of ‘artificial intelligence’ (AI) framing in Natural Language Processing (NLP) research, it is not clear what researchers mean by ”intelligence”. To that end, we present the results of a survey on the notion of ”intelligence” among researchers and its role in the research agenda. The survey elicited complete responses from 303 researchers from a variety of fields including NLP, Machine Learning (ML), Cognitive Science, Linguistics, and Neuroscience.We identify 3 criteria of intelligence that the community agrees on the most: generalization, adaptability, & reasoning.Our results suggests that the perception of the current NLP systems as ”intelligent” is a minority position (29%).Furthermore, only 16.2% of the respondents see developing intelligent systems as a research goal, and these respondents are more likely to consider the current systems intelligent.
abstract_zh: 尽管“人工智能”（AI）框架在自然语言处理（NLP）研究中广泛使用，但研究人员所说的“智能”是什么意思尚不清楚。为此，我们提出了一项关于研究人员“智力”概念及其在研究议程中的作用的调查结果。这项调查得到了来自 NLP、机器学习 (ML)、认知科学、语言学和神经科学等多个领域的 303 位研究人员的完整回答。我们确定了社区最认同的 3 个智能标准：泛化性、适应性和推理。我们的结果表明，认为当前 NLP 系统“智能”的只是少数人 (29%)。此外，只有 16.2% 的受访者认为正在开发智能系统作为研究目标，这些受访者更有可能认为当前系统是智能化的。

title: What Language Do Non-English-Centric Large Language Models Think in?
abstract_en: In this study, we investigate whether non-English-centric large language models, ‘think’ in their specialized language. Specifically, we analyze how intermediate layer representations, when projected into the vocabulary space, favor certain languages during generation—termed as latent languages. We categorize non-English-centric models into two groups: CPMs, which are English-centric models with continued pre-training on its specialized language, and BLMs, which are pre-trained on a balanced mix of multiple languages from scratch. Our findings reveal that while English-centric models rely exclusively on English as their latent language, non-English-centric models activate multiple latent languages, dynamically selecting the most similar one based on both the source and target languages. This also influences responses to culture difference questions, reducing English-centric biases in non-English models. This study deepens our understanding of language representation in non-English-centric LLMs, shedding light on the intricate dynamics of multilingual processing at the representational level.
abstract_zh: 在这项研究中，我们调查了非英语中心的大型语言模型是否用其专业语言“思考”。具体来说，我们分析了中间层表示在投影到词汇空间时如何在生成过程中偏向某些语言（称为潜在语言）。我们将非英语为中心的模型分为两类：CPM（以英语为中心的模型，对其专业语言进行持续的预训练）和 BLM（从头开始对多种语言的平衡混合进行预训练）。我们的研究结果表明，虽然以英语为中心的模型完全依赖英语作为其潜在语言，但非英语为中心的模型激活了多种潜在语言，根据源语言和目标语言动态选择最相似的一种。这也会影响对文化差异问题的回答，减少非英语模型中以英语为中心的偏见。这项研究加深了我们对非以英语为中心的大语言模型中语言表征的理解，揭示了表征层面上多语言处理的复杂动态。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Contrastive Decoding
abstract_en: Large language models excel in a wide range of natural language processing tasks, but generating factually accurate and consistent outputs remains a challenge. To improve text reliability, Contrastive Decoding (CD) refines token selection by leveraging differences between an expert and base model, penalizing low-quality token choices. However, CD employs static weighting between models, making it sensitive to variations in model architecture and input characteristics, often resulting in suboptimal token selection and error propagation throughout generation. We propose Uncertainty-Aware Contrastive Decoding (UCD), a method that dynamically adjusts model contributions at each decoding step based on uncertainty. We introduce a cumulative energy function, where uncertainty is quantified as the negative log-sum-exp over logits, and decomposed into entropy and expected logit components. This energy serves as a dynamic confidence signal, guiding adaptive model weighting during generation. We demonstrate through extensive experiments that UCD significantly improves factual accuracy and reliability over existing decoding methods. Finally, we provide a theoretical analysis showing that our energy function serves as a well-defined uncertainty metric capturing model confidence. Our code is available at: https://github.com/MLAI-Yonsei/UCD.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型在广泛的自然语言处理任务中表现出色，但生成事实上准确且一致的输出仍然是一个挑战。为了提高文本可靠性，对比解码 (CD) 通过利用专家模型和基础模型之间的差异来优化标记选择，惩罚低质量的标记选择。然而，CD 在模型之间采用静态加权，使其对模型架构和输入特征的变化敏感，通常会导致代币选择次优和错误在整个生成过程中传播。我们提出了不确定性感知对比解码（UCD），这是一种根据不确定性在每个解码步骤动态调整模型贡献的方法。我们引入了累积能量函数，其中不确定性被量化为 logit 上的负 log-sum-exp，并分解为熵和预期 logit 分量。该能量充当动态置信信号，在生成过程中指导自适应模型加权。我们通过大量实验证明，UCD 比现有解码方法显着提高了事实准确性和可靠性。最后，我们提供了理论分析，表明我们的能量函数可以作为捕获模型置信度的明确定义的不确定性度量。我们的代码位于：https://github.com/MLAI-Yonsei/UCD。

title: A Constrained Text Revision Agent via Iterative Planning and Searching
abstract_en: Existing text revision systems are capable of generating fluent and coherent text, but struggle with constrained text revision (CTR), which requires adherence to specific constraints. Furthermore, adapting these systems to diverse constraints is challenging. To bridge this gap, we introduce TRIPS, a Text Revision agent via Iterative Planning and Searching, focusing on CTR. TRIPS utilizes a planner, a reviser (i.e., a large language model), and adaptable tools to generate revisions tailored to different scenarios. Specifically, we propose an iterative self-training alignment method to construct the planner, which generates tool usage and text revision plans. Furthermore, we propose Tool-Guided Monte Carlo Tree Search (TG-MCTS), a novel CTR algorithm that extends MCTS with tool-guided expansion and evaluation, enabling the search for optimal revision strategies across various scenarios. To evaluate TRIPS, we introduce ConsTRev, a dataset with multi-level constrained instructions for paragraph-level revision. Experimental results show that TRIPS outperforms baselines in both constraint adherence and revision quality. Furthermore, TRIPS exhibits robust performance across diverse use cases, including plain text and LaTeX revision.
abstract_zh: 现有的文本修订系统能够生成流畅且连贯的文本，但难以应对受约束的文本修订 (CTR)，这需要遵守特定的约束。此外，使这些系统适应不同的约束是具有挑战性的。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了 TRIPS，这是一种通过迭代规划和搜索的文本修订代理，专注于点击率。 TRIPS 利用规划器、修订器（即大型语言模型）和适应性工具来生成针对不同场景的修订。具体来说，我们提出了一种迭代自训练对齐方法来构建规划器，该规划器生成工具使用和文本修订计划。此外，我们提出了工具引导蒙特卡罗树搜索（TG-MCTS），这是一种新颖的 CTR 算法，它通过工具引导的扩展和评估扩展了 MCTS，从而能够在各种场景中搜索最佳修订策略。为了评估 TRIPS，我们引入了 ConsTRev，这是一个具有用于段落级修订的多级约束指令的数据集。实验结果表明，TRIPS 在约束遵守和修订质量方面均优于基线。此外，TRIPS 在不同的用例中表现出强大的性能，包括纯文本和 LaTeX 修订。

title: Old but Gold:LLM-Based Features and Shallow Learning Methods for Fine-Grained Controversy Analysis inYouTube Comments
abstract_en: Online discussions can either bridge differences through constructive dialogue or amplify divisions through destructive interactions. paper proposes a computational approach to analyze dialogical relation patterns in YouTube comments, offering a fine-grained framework for controversy detection, enabling also analysis of individual contributions. experiments demonstrate that shallow learning methods, when equipped with these theoretically-grounded features, consistently outperform more complex language models in characterizing discourse quality at both comment-pair and conversation-chain levels.studies confirm that divisive rhetorical techniques serve as strong predictors of destructive communication patterns. work advances understanding of how communicative choices shape online discourse, moving beyond engagement metrics toward nuanced examination of constructive versus destructive dialogue patterns.
abstract_zh: 在线讨论可以通过建设性对话弥合分歧，也可以通过破坏性互动扩大分歧。论文提出了一种计算方法来分析 YouTube 评论中的对话关系模式，为争议检测提供了细粒度的框架，还可以分析个人贡献。实验表明，当浅层学习方法配备了这些基于理论的特征时，在描述评论对和对话链层面的话语质量方面，其表现始终优于更复杂的语言模型。研究证实，分裂性修辞技巧可以作为破坏性沟通模式的强有力预测因素。这项工作增进了对交流选择如何塑造在线话语的理解，超越参与度指标，转向对建设性与破坏性对话模式的细致审查。

title: Overview of the Critical Questions Generation Shared Task
abstract_en: The proliferation of AI technologies has reinforced the importance of developing critical thinking skills. We propose leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to facilitate the generation of critical questions: inquiries designed to identify fallacious or inadequately constructed arguments. This paper presents an overview of the first shared task on Critical Questions Generation (CQs-Gen). Thirteen teams investigated various methodologies for generating questions that critically assess arguments within the provided texts. The highest accuracy achieved was 67.6, indicating substantial room for improvement in this task. Moreover, three of the four top-performing teams incorporated argumentation scheme annotations to enhance their systems. Finally, while most participants employed open-weight models, the two highest-ranking teams relied on proprietary LLMs.
abstract_zh: 人工智能技术的激增强化了培养批判性思维技能的重要性。我们建议利用大型语言模型（LLM）来促进关键问题的生成：旨在识别错误​​或构造不充分的论点的查询。本文概述了关键问题生成 (CQs-Gen) 的第一个共享任务。十三个团队研究了各种生成问题的方法，这些问题严格评估所提供文本中的论点。达到的最高准确度为 67.6，表明这项任务还有很大的改进空间。此外，四个表现最好的团队中的三个纳入了论证方案注释来增强他们的系统。最后，虽然大多数参与者采用开放权重模型，但排名最高的两个团队依赖于专有的大语言模型。

title: CanLLMs Effectively Simulate Human Learners? Teachers’ Insights from TutoringLLMStudents
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer many opportunities for scalably improving the teaching and learning process, for example, by simulating students for teacher training or lesson preparation. However, design requirements for building high-fidelity LLM-based simulations are poorly understood. This study aims to address this gap from the perspective of key stakeholders—teachers who have tutored LLM-simulated students. We use a mixed-method approach and conduct semi-structured interviews with these teachers, grounding our interview design and analysis in the Community of Inquiry and Scaffolding frameworks. Our findings indicate several challenges in LLM-simulated students, including authenticity, high language complexity, lack of emotions, unnatural attentiveness, and logical inconsistency. We end by categorizing four types of real-world student behaviors and provide guidelines for the design and development of LLM-based student simulations. These include introducing diverse personalities, modeling knowledge building, and promoting questions.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 提供了许多可扩展地改进教学和学习过程的机会，例如，通过模拟学生进行教师培训或备课。然而，人们对构建基于 LLM 的高保真模拟的设计要求知之甚少。本研究旨在从关键利益相关者（辅导过大语言模型模拟学生的教师）的角度来解决这一差距。我们采用混合方法，对这些教师进行半结构化访谈，将我们的访谈设计和分析建立在探究社区和脚手架框架的基础上。我们的研究结果表明，大语言模型模拟学生面临着一些挑战，包括真实性、语言复杂性高、缺乏情感、不自然的注意力和逻辑不一致。最后，我们对现实世界的学生行为进行了分类，并为基于大语言模型的学生模拟的设计和开发提供了指导原则。其中包括引入不同的个性、建模知识构建和提出问题。

title: Down the Cascades of Omethi: Hierarchical Automatic Scoring in Large-Scale Assessments
abstract_en: We present the framework Omethi, which is aimed at scoring short text responses in a semi-automatic fashion, particularly fit to international large-scale assessments. We evaluate its effectiveness for the massively multilingual PISA tests. Responses are passed through a conditional flow of hierarchically combined scoring components to assign a score. Once a score is assigned, hierarchically lower components are discarded. Models implemented in this study ranged from lexical matching of normalized texts—with excellent accuracy but weak generalizability—to fine-tuned large language models—with lower accuracy but high generalizability. If not scored by any automatic component, responses are passed on to manual scoring. The paper is the first to provide an evaluation of automatic scoring on multilingual PISA data in eleven languages (including Arabic, Finnish, Hebrew, and Kazakh) from three domains (n = 3.8million responses). On average, results show a manual effort reduction of 71 percent alongside an agreement of𝜅 = .957, when including manual scoring, and𝜅 = .804for only the automatically scored responses. The evaluation underscores the framework’s effective adaptivity and operational feasibility with its shares of used components varying substantially across domains and languages while maintaining homogeneously high accuracy.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了 Omethi 框架，旨在以半自动方式对短文本响应进行评分，特别适合国际大规模评估。我们评估其在大规模多语言 PISA 测试中的有效性。响应通过分层组合评分组件的条件流传递以分配分数。一旦分配了分数，层次较低的组件就会被丢弃。本研究中实现的模型范围从规范化文本的词汇匹配（具有出色的准确性但泛化性较弱）到微调的大型语言模型（准确性较低但泛化性较高）。如果没有由任何自动组件评分，则答案将传递给手动评分。该论文首次对来自三个领域（n = 380 万份回复）的 11 种语言（包括阿拉伯语、芬兰语、希伯来语和哈萨克语）的多语言 PISA 数据进行自动评分评估。平均而言，结果显示手动工作量减少了 71%，并且当包括手动评分时，一致性为 𝜅 = 0.957，仅对于自动评分的响应，𝜅 = 0.804。该评估强调了该框架的有效适应性和操作可行性，其使用的组件份额在不同领域和语言之间存在很大差异，同时保持一致的高精度。

title: Enhancing Security and Strengthening Defenses in Automated Short-Answer Grading Systems
abstract_en: This study examines vulnerabilities in transformer-based automated short-answer grading systems used in medical education, with a focus on how these systems can be manipulated through adversarial gaming strategies. Our research identifies three main types of gaming strategies that exploit the system’s weaknesses, potentially leading to false positives. To counteract these vulnerabilities, we implement several adversarial training methods designed to enhance the system’s robustness. Our results indicate that these methods significantly reduce the susceptibility of grading systems to such manipulations, especially when combined with ensemble techniques like majority voting and Ridge regression, which further improve the system’s defense against sophisticated adversarial inputs. Additionally, employing large language models suchasGPT-4with varied prompting techniques has shown promise in recognizing and scoring gaming strategies effectively. The findings underscore the importance of continuous improvements in AI-driven educational tools to ensure their reliability and fairness in high-stakes settings.
abstract_zh: 这项研究检查了医学教育中使用的基于变压器的自动简答评分系统的漏洞，重点是如何通过对抗性博弈策略来操纵这些系统。我们的研究确定了三种主要类型的博弈策略，这些策略利用了系统的弱点，可能导致误报。为了应对这些漏洞，我们实施了几种旨在增强系统稳健性的对抗性训练方法。我们的结果表明，这些方法显着降低了评分系统对此类操作的敏感性，特别是与多数投票和岭回归等集成技术相结合时，这进一步提高了系统对复杂对抗性输入的防御能力。此外，采用大型语言模型（例如 GPT-4）和各种提示技术已在有效识别和评分游戏策略方面显示出希望。研究结果强调了持续改进人工智能驱动的教育工具的重要性，以确保其在高风险环境中的可靠性和公平性。

title: Comparing Behavioral Patterns ofLLMand Human Tutors: A Population-level Analysis with theCIMADataset
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer exciting potential as educational tutors, and much research explores this potential. Unfortunately, there’s little research in understanding the baseline behavioral pattern differences that LLM tutors exhibit, in contrast to human tutors. We conduct a preliminary study of these differences with the CIMA dataset and three state-of-the-art LLMs (GPT-4o, Gemini Pro 1.5, and LLaMA 3.1 450B).
