Furthermore, we show the effectiveness of LIME and Integrated Gradients as backbone attribution methods for FitCF and find that the number of demonstrations has the largest effect on performance. Finally, we reveal a strong correlation between the faithfulness of feature attribution scores and the quality of generated counterfactuals, which we hope will serve as an importantfinding for future research in this direction.
abstract_zh: 反事实示例广泛应用于自然语言处理 (NLP) 中，作为改进模型的宝贵数据，并广泛应用于可解释的人工智能 (XAI) 中以理解模型行为。即使对于大型语言模型（LLM）来说，自动生成反事实示例仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务，尽管它们在许多任务上的表现令人印象深刻。在本文中，我们首先介绍 ZeroCF，这是一种利用从特征归因方法派生的重要单词在零样本设置中生成反事实示例的忠实方法。其次，我们提出了一个新的框架 FitCF，它通过标签翻转验证进一步验证上述反事实，然后将它们插入作为小样本提示的演示，其性能优于三个最先进的基线。通过消融研究，我们通过翻转率、困惑度和相似性度量来评估 FitCF 的每个核心组件在提高反事实质量方面的重要性。此外，我们展示了 LIME 和综合梯度作为 FitCF 骨干归因方法的有效性，并发现演示数量对性能的影响最大。最后，我们揭示了特征归因分数的忠实度与生成的反事实的质量之间的强相关性，我们希望这将成为该方向未来研究的重要发现。

title: Domain Regeneration: How well doLLMs match syntactic properties of text domains?
abstract_en: Recent improvement in large language model performance have, in all likelihood, been accompanied by improvement in how well they can approximate the distribution of their training data. In this work, we explore the following question: which properties of text domains do LLMs faithfully approximate, and how well do they do so? Applying observational approaches familiar from corpus linguistics, we prompt a commonly used, opensource LLM to regenerate text from two domains of permissively licensed English text which are often contained in LLM training data—Wikipedia and news text. This regeneration paradigm allows us to investigate whether LLMs can faithfully match the original human text domains in a fairly semantically-controlled setting. We investigate varying levels of syntactic abstraction, from more simple properties like sentence length, and article readability, to more complex and higher order properties such as dependency tag distribution, parse depth, and parse complexity. We find that the majority of the regenerated distributions show a shifted mean, a lower standard deviation, and a reduction of the long tail, as compared to the human originals.
abstract_zh: 最近大型语言模型性能的改进很可能伴随着它们逼近训练数据分布的能力的改进。在这项工作中，我们探讨了以下问题：大语言模型忠实地近似了文本域的哪些属性，以及它们做得如何？应用语料库语言学中熟悉的观察方法，我们促使常用的开源大语言模型从两个许可的英语文本领域重新生成文本，这两个领域通常包含在大语言模型训练数据中——维基百科和新闻文本。这种再生范式使我们能够研究大语言模型是否可以在相当语义控制的环境中忠实地匹配原始人类文本域。我们研究不同级别的句法抽象，从更简单的属性（如句子长度和文章可读性）到更复杂和更高阶的属性（如依赖标签分布、解析深度和解析复杂性）。我们发现，与人类原始分布相比，大多数再生分布均显示出均值偏移、标准差较低以及长尾减少。

title: SYNTHVERIFY: Enhancing Zero-Shot Claim Verification through Step-by-Step Synthetic Data Generation
abstract_en: Claim verification is a fundamental task in natural language processing (NLP), involving the assessment of whether available evidence supports or refutes a given claim. While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in this area, they continue to struggle with domain-specific knowledge. Synthetic data generation has emerged as an effective solution to this challenge. However, existing methods are often either inefficient to scale across multiple domains or overly reliant on external documents. We introduce SYNTHVERIFY, a novel step-by-step prompting-based synthetic data generation framework designed to enhance zero-shot claim verification. Our core insight is that guiding generation with domain-specific claim patterns and structured evidence plans can bridge LLMs’ knowledge gaps in specialized domains without requiring access to external corpora or sacrificing generalizability. Using SYNTHVERIFY, we construct a diverse synthetic dataset for zero-shot verification, enabling instruction fine-tuning tailored to the verification task. Empirical results across multiple specialized domains demonstrate significant accuracy improvements, including a 20.1-point gain on the Llama-3-8B model. Our results highlight the effectiveness of structured synthetic data generation in addressing the limitations of verification systems, particularly in domain-specific tasks.
abstract_zh: 声明验证是自然语言处理 (NLP) 中的一项基本任务，涉及评估可用证据是否支持或反驳给定声明。虽然大型语言模型 (LLM) 在该领域显示出前景，但它们仍然在特定领域知识方面遇到困难。合成数据生成已成为应对这一挑战的有效解决方案。然而，现有方法通常要么无法有效地跨多个领域扩展，要么过度依赖外部文档。我们推出了 SYNTHVERIFY，这是一种新颖的基于逐步提示的合成数据生成框架，旨在增强零样本索赔验证。我们的核心见解是，利用特定领域的主张模式和结构化证据计划来指导生成可以弥合大语言模型在专业领域的知识差距，而无需访问外部语料库或牺牲普遍性。使用 SYNTHVERIFY，我们构建了用于零样本验证的多样化合成数据集，从而能够根据验证任务进行指令微调。跨多个专业领域的实证结果表明，准确性显着提高，包括 Llama-3-8B 模型提高了 20.1 点。我们的结果强调了结构化合成数据生成在解决验证系统的局限性方面的有效性，特别是在特定领域的任务中。

title: LLM-Forest: Ensemble Learning ofLLMs with Graph-Augmented Prompts for Data Imputation
abstract_en: Missing data imputation is a critical challenge in various domains, such as healthcare and finance, where data completeness is vital for accurate analysis. Large language models (LLMs), trained on vast corpora, have shown strong potential in data generation, making them a promising tool for data imputation. However, challenges persist in designing effective prompts for a finetuning-free process and in mitigating biases and uncertainty in LLM outputs. To address these issues, we propose a novel framework, LLM-Forest, which introduces a “forest” of few-shot learning LLM “trees” with their outputs aggregated via confidence-based weighted voting based on LLM self-assessment, inspired by the ensemble learning (Random Forest). This framework is established on a new concept of bipartite information graphs to identify high-quality relevant neighboring entries with both feature and value granularity. Extensive experiments on 9 real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of LLM-Forest. The implementation is available at https://github.com/Xinrui17/LLM-Forest
abstract_zh: 缺失数据插补是医疗保健和金融等各个领域的一项严峻挑战，其中数据完整性对于准确分析至关重要。在庞大的语料库上进行训练的大型语言模型（LLM）在数据生成方面表现出了强大的潜力，使其成为一种很有前途的数据插补工具。然而，在为免微调过程设计有效的提示以及减轻大语言模型输出中的偏差和不确定性方面仍然存在挑战。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一个新颖的框架，即LLM-Forest，它引入了一个由少量学习LLM“树”组成的“森林”，其输出通过基于LLM自我评估的基于置信度的加权投票进行聚合，受到集成学习（随机森林）的启发。该框架建立在二分信息图的新概念之上，以识别具有特征和值粒度的高质量相关相邻条目。对 9 个真实世界数据集的广泛实验证明了 LLM-Forest 的有效性和效率。该实现可在 https://github.com/Xinrui17/LLM-Forest 获取

title: Crabs: Consuming Resource via Auto-generation forLLM-DoSAttack under Black-box Settings
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across diverse tasks yet still are vulnerable to external threats, particularly LLM Denial-of-Service (LLM-DoS) attacks. Specifically, LLM-DoS attacks aim to exhaust computational resources and block services. However, existing studies predominantly focus on white-box attacks, leaving black-box scenarios underexplored. In this paper, we introduce Auto-Generation for LLM-DoS (AutoDoS) attack, an automated algorithm designed for black-box LLMs. AutoDoS constructs the DoS Attack Tree and expands the node coverage to achieve effectiveness under black-box conditions. By transferability-driven iterative optimization, AutoDoS could work across different models in one prompt.Furthermore, we reveal that embedding the Length Trojan allows AutoDoS to bypass existing defenses more effectively.Experimental results show that AutoDoS significantly amplifies service response latency by over250×↑, leading to severe resource consumption in terms of GPU utilization and memory usage. Our work provides a new perspective on LLM-DoS attacks and security defenses.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在各种任务中表现出了卓越的性能，但仍然容易受到外部威胁，特别是 LLM 拒绝服务 (LLM-DoS) 攻击。具体来说，LLM-DoS 攻击旨在耗尽计算资源并阻止服务。然而，现有的研究主要集中在白盒攻击上，而对黑盒场景的探索还不够。在本文中，我们介绍了 LLM-DoS (AutoDoS) 攻击的自动生成，这是一种专为黑盒 LLM 设计的自动化算法。 AutoDoS构建DoS攻击树并扩大节点覆盖范围以在黑盒条件下发挥作用。通过可转移性驱动的迭代优化，AutoDoS 可以一次性跨不同模型工作。此外，我们还发现，嵌入 Length 木马可以使 AutoDoS 更有效地绕过现有防御。实验结果表明，AutoDoS 使服务响应延迟显着增加超过 250×↑，导致 GPU 利用率和内存使用方面的资源消耗严重。我们的工作为 LLM-DoS 攻击和安全防御提供了新的视角。

title: Learning to Select In-Context Demonstration Preferred by Large Language Model
abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) enables large language models (LLMs) to adapt to new tasks during inference using only a few demonstrations. However, ICL performance is highly dependent on the selection of these demonstrations. Recent work explores retrieval-based methods for selecting query-specific demonstrations, but these approaches often rely on surrogate objectives such as metric learning, failing to directly optimize ICL performance. Consequently, they struggle to identify truly beneficial demonstrations. Moreover, their discriminative retrieval paradigm is ineffective when the candidate pool lacks sufficient high-quality demonstrations. To address these challenges, we propose GenICL, a novel generative preference learning framework that leverages LLM feedback to directly optimize demonstration selection for ICL. Experiments on 19 datasets across 11 task categories demonstrate that GenICL achieves superior performance than existing methods in selecting the most effective demonstrations, leading to better ICL performance.
abstract_zh: 上下文学习 (ICL) 使大型语言模型 (LLM) 能够在推理过程中仅使用少量演示来适应新任务。然而，ICL 性能很大程度上取决于这些演示的选择。最近的工作探索了基于检索的方法来选择特定于查询的演示，但这些方法通常依赖于度量学习等替代目标，无法直接优化 ICL 性能。因此，他们很难确定真正有益的示威活动。此外，当候选池缺乏足够的高质量演示时，他们的区分性检索范式是无效的。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 GenICL，一种新颖的生成偏好学习框架，它利用 LLM 反馈来直接优化 ICL 的演示选择。对 11 个任务类别的 19 个数据集进行的实验表明，GenICL 在选择最有效的演示方面比现有方法具有更优越的性能，从而获得更好的 ICL 性能。

title: Large Language Models are Miscalibrated In-Context Learners
abstract_en: When adapting ICL with or without fine-tuning, we are curious about whether the instruction-tuned language model is able to achieve well-calibrated results without suffering from the problem of overconfidence (i.e., miscalibration) considering its strong instruction following ability, especially in such limited data setups. In this work, we deliver an in-depth analysis of the behavior across different choices of learning methods from the perspective of both performance and calibration. Through extensive controlled experiments, we observe that the miscalibration problem exists across all learning methods in low-resource setups. To achieve simultaneous gain for both in-task performance and calibration, we then study the potential of self-ensembling applied at different modeling stages (e.g., variations of in-context examples or variations in prompts or different ensembling strategies) to make the predictions more calibrated and have comparable or even better performance. We find that self-ensembling with max probability produces robust and calibrated predictions. Our work reveals the potential calibration problem of using ICL despite the improvements in task performance and sheds light on which learning paradigm to choose. We also provide practical guidelines for choosing learning paradigms depending on whether the data has been seen by the model before and a worthwhile solution via self-ensembling on how to enhance both task performance and calibration of LMs, which we hope could encourage further study.
abstract_zh: 当采用或不进行微调的 ICL 时，我们很好奇，考虑到其强大的指令跟踪能力，特别是在如此有限的数据设置中，指令调整的语言模型是否能够获得良好校准的结果，而不会遭受过度自信（即错误校准）的问题。在这项工作中，我们从性能和校准的角度对不同学习方法选择的行为进行了深入分析。通过广泛的受控实验，我们观察到在资源匮乏的情况下，所有学习方法都存在校准错误问题。为了同时实现任务内性能和校准的增益，我们然后研究在不同建模阶段应用自集成的潜力（例如，上下文示例的变化或提示的变化或不同的集成策略），以使预测更加校准并具有可比较甚至更好的性能。我们发现具有最大概率的自集成可以产生稳健且经过校准的预测。我们的工作揭示了尽管任务性能有所提高，但使用 ICL 的潜在校准问题，并揭示了选择哪种学习范式。我们还提供了选择学习范式的实用指南，具体取决于模型之前是否见过数据，以及通过自集成如何提高 LM 的任务性能和校准的有价值的解决方案，我们希望这可以鼓励进一步的研究。

title: Selecting Demonstrations for Many-Shot In-Context Learning via Gradient Matching
abstract_en: In-Context Learning (ICL) empowers Large Language Models (LLMs) for rapid task adaptation without Fine-Tuning (FT), but its reliance on demonstration selection remains a critical challenge. While many-shot ICL shows promising performance through scaled demonstrations, the selection method for many-shot demonstrations remains limited to random selection in existing work. Since the conventional instance-level retrieval is not suitable for many-shot scenarios, we hypothesize that the data requirements for in-context learning and fine-tuning are analogous. To this end, we introduce a novel gradient matching approach that selects demonstrations by aligning fine-tuning gradients between the entire training set of the target task and the selected examples, so as to approach the learning effect on the entire training set within the selected examples. Through gradient matching on relatively small models, e.g., Qwen2.5-3B or Llama3-8B, our method consistently outperforms random selection on larger LLMs from 4-shot to 128-shot scenarios across 9 diverse datasets. For instance, it surpasses random selection by 4% on Qwen2.5-72B and Llama3-70B, and by around 2% on 5 closed-source LLMs. This work unlocks more reliable and effective many-shot ICL, paving the way for its broader application.
abstract_zh: 情境学习 (ICL) 使大型语言模型 (LLM) 能够在无需微调 (FT) 的情况下快速适应任务，但其对演示选择的依赖仍然是一个关键挑战。虽然多镜头 ICL 通过规模化演示显示出有希望的性能，但多镜头演示的选择方法仍然仅限于现有工作中的随机选择。由于传统的实例级检索不适合多镜头场景，因此我们假设上下文学习和微调的数据要求是类似的。为此，我们引入了一种新颖的梯度匹配方法，通过调整目标任务的整个训练集和所选示例之间的微调梯度来选择演示，从而接近所选示例中整个训练集的学习效果。通过对相对较小的模型（例如 Qwen2.5-3B 或 Llama3-8B）进行梯度匹配，我们的方法在 9 个不同数据集的 4-shot 到 128-shot 场景中始终优于较大 LLM 的随机选择。例如，它在 Qwen2.5-72B 和 Llama3-70B 上超过随机选择 4%，在 5 个闭源 LLM 上超过随机选择约 2%。这项工作解锁了更可靠、更有效的多次 ICL，为其更广泛的应用铺平了道路。

title: Dual Debiasing for Noisy In-Context Learning for Text Generation
abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) relies heavily on high-quality demonstrations drawn from large annotated corpora. Existing approaches detect noisy annotations by ranking local perplexities, presuming that noisy samples yield higher perplexities than their clean counterparts. However, this assumption breaks down when the noise ratio is high and many demonstrations are flawed.We re-examine the perplexity-based paradigm for text generation under noisy annotations, highlighting two sources of bias in perplexity: the annotation itself and the domain-specific knowledge inherent in large language models (LLMs). To overcome these biases, we introduce a dual-debiasing framework that uses synthesized neighbors to explicitly correct perplexity estimates, yielding a robustSample Cleanliness Score. This metric uncovers absolute sample cleanliness regardless of the overall corpus noise level.Extensive experiments demonstrate our method’s superior noise-detection capabilities and show that its final ICL performance is comparable to that of a fully clean demonstration corpus. Moreover, our approach remains robust even when noise ratios are extremely high.
abstract_zh: 情境学习（ICL）在很大程度上依赖于从大型注释语料库中提取的高质量演示。现有的方法通过对局部困惑度进行排名来检测噪音注释，假设噪音样本比干净的样本产生更高的困惑度。然而，当噪声比很高并且许多演示存在缺陷时，这种假设就会失效。我们重新审视了噪声注释下基于困惑度的文本生成范式，强调了困惑度偏差的两个来源：注释本身和大型语言模型（LLM）中固有的特定领域知识。为了克服这些偏差，我们引入了一个双重去偏差框架，该框架使用合成的邻居来明确纠正困惑度估计，从而产生稳健的样本清洁度分数。无论整体语料库噪声水平如何，该指标都可以揭示样本的绝对清洁度。大量实验证明了我们的方法卓越的噪声检测能力，并表明其最终 ICL 性能与完全干净的演示语料库的性能相当。此外，即使噪声比极高，我们的方法仍然保持稳健。

title: Dynamic Steering With Episodic Memory For Large Language Models
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit emergent in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, allowing them to adapt to unseen tasks based on example demonstrations. Traditional ICL embeds examples within the prompt, while activation steering, uses a vector derived from examples to guide the latent states of LLMs toward desired behaviors. However, traditional ICL is difficult to control quantitatively and consumes valuable context space. Existing activation steering methods apply a single sentence-level steering vector uniformly across all tokens, ignoring LLMs’ token-wise, auto-regressive nature. This coarse control can lead to inconsistencies and suboptimal adjustments during generation. To address this problem, we introduce Dynamic Steering with Episodic Memory (DSEM), a novel training-free framework that aligns LLMs to given demonstrations by steering at the token level conditioned on the input query. DSEM employs a key-value memory to store associations between generated tokens and steering vectors. During inference, it uses a nearest-neighbor mechanism to dynamically compute steering vectors for each token chunk, enabling more precise and adaptive guidance. Our method surpasses strong baselines across diverse alignment tasks - including safety, style transfer, and role-playing - demonstrating improved alignment as demonstration size scales.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 展现出紧急的上下文学习 (ICL) 功能，使它们能够根据示例演示来适应看不见的任务。传统的 ICL 在提示中嵌入示例，而激活引导则使用从示例派生的向量来引导 LLM 的潜在状态实现所需的行为。然而，传统的ICL难以定量控制并且消耗宝贵的上下文空间。现有的激活引导方法在所有 token 上统一应用单个句子级引导向量，忽略了 LLM 的 token-wise、自回归性质。这种粗略控制可能会导致生成过程中的不一致和次优调整。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了带有情节记忆的动态转向（DSEM），这是一种新颖的免训练框架，通过根据输入查询条件在令牌级别进行转向，将 LLM 与给定的演示对齐。 DSEM 采用键值存储器来存储生成的标记和引导向量之间的关联。在推理过程中，它使用最近邻机制动态计算每个令牌块的引导向量，从而实现更精确和自适应的引导。我们的方法超越了各种对齐任务（包括安全性、风格迁移和角色扮演）的强大基线，展示了随着演示规模的扩大，对齐得到了改善。

title: Eeyore: Realistic Depression Simulation via Expert-in-the-Loop Supervised and Preference Optimization
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been previously explored for mental healthcare training and therapy client simulation, but they still fall short in authentically capturing diverse client traits and psychological conditions. We introduceEeyore, an 8B model optimized for realistic depression simulation through a structured alignment framework, incorporating expert input at every stage.First, we systematically curate real-world depression-related conversations, extracting depressive traits to guide data filtering and psychological profile construction, and use this dataset to instruction-tune Eeyore for profile adherence. Next, to further enhance realism, Eeyore undergoes iterative preference optimization—first leveraging model-generated preferences and then calibrating with a small set of expert-annotated preferences.Throughout the entire pipeline, we actively collaborate with domain experts, developing interactive interfaces to validate trait extraction and iteratively refine structured psychological profiles for clinically meaningful role-play customization.Despite its smaller model size, the Eeyore depression simulation outperforms GPT-4o with SOTA prompting strategies, both in linguistic authenticity and profile adherence.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）之前已被探索用于心理保健培训和治疗客户模拟，但它们在真实捕捉不同客户特征和心理状况方面仍然存在不足。我们推出了 Eeyore，这是一种通过结构化对齐框架针对现实抑郁症模拟进行优化的 8B 模型，在每个阶段都纳入了专家的输入。首先，我们系统地策划现实世界中与抑郁症相关的对话，提取抑郁特征来指导数据过滤和心理档案构建，并使用该数据集对 Eeyore 进行指令调整，以实现档案依从性。接下来，为了进一步增强真实感，Eeyore 进行了迭代偏好优化——首先利用模型生成的偏好，然后用一小组专家注释的偏好进行校准。在整个流程中，我们积极与领域专家合作，开发交互式界面来验证特征提取，并迭代地完善结构化心理概况，以实现有临床意义的角色扮演定制。尽管模型规模较小，但 Eeyore 抑郁症模拟在语言方面均优于采用 SOTA 提示策略的 GPT-4o。真实性和个人资料遵守情况。

title: Enhancing Tool Learning in Large Language Models with Hierarchical Error Checklists
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly advanced natural language processing, particularly through the integration of external tools and APIs. However, their effectiveness is frequently hampered by parameter mis-filling during tool calling. In this paper, we propose the Hierarchical Tool Error Checklist (HiTEC) framework to systematically diagnose and mitigate tool-calling errors without relying on extensive real-world interactions. HiTEC introduces a two-tiered approach: a global error checklist that identifies common, cross-tool issues, and a local error checklist that targets tool-specific and contextual failures. Building on this structure, we propose two deployments: HiTEC-In Context Learning (HiTEC-ICL) and HiTEC-Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (HiTEC-KTO). HiTEC-ICL embeds the global checklist in the initial prompts and leverages a two-round conversational interaction to dynamically refine parameter handling, while HiTEC-KTO generates high-quality negative examples to drive fine-tuning via preference-based optimization. Extensive experiments across five public datasets demonstrate that our framework significantly improves parameter-filling accuracy and tool-calling success rates compared to baseline methods.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 具有显着先进的自然语言处理能力，特别是通过外部工具和 API 的集成。然而，它们的有效性经常受到工具调用期间参数错误填充的影响。在本文中，我们提出了分层工具错误检查表（HiTEC）框架来系统地诊断和减轻工具调用错误，而不依赖于广泛的现实世界交互。 HiTEC 引入了一种两层方法：识别常见跨工具问题的全局错误检查表，以及针对特定工具和上下文故障的本地错误检查表。在此结构的基础上，我们提出了两种部署：HiTEC-In Context Learning (HiTEC-ICL) 和 HiTEC-Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (HiTEC-KTO)。 HiTEC-ICL 在初始提示中嵌入全局检查表，并利用两轮对话交互动态优化参数处理，而 HiTEC-KTO 生成高质量的负面示例，通过基于偏好的优化来驱动微调。五个公共数据集的广泛实验表明，与基线方法相比，我们的框架显着提高了参数填充准确性和工具调用成功率。

title: FANNO: Augmenting High-Quality Instruction Data with Open-SourcedLLMs Only
abstract_en: Instruction tuning stands as a crucial advancement in leveraging large language models (LLMs) for enhanced task performance. However, the annotation of instruction datasets has traditionally been expensive and laborious, often relying on manual annotations or costly proprietary LLMs. Recent works explore approaches to synthesize data with open-sourced LLMs but require high-quality human-crafted seed data. In this work, we introduce , an end-to-end framework to synthesize high-quality instruction data with open-sourced LLMs and sampled unlabeled documents, eliminating the necessity for seed data. Starting from diverse pre-screened documents, the framework synthesizes complex and diverse high-quality instruction and response pairs in different stages. We propose a tagging-based prompt method to generate diverse and complex seed data and a UCB-based approach to augment more instruction data with the seed data. A novelThink Differentprompt is proposed to address the distributional limitations of the seeds, further boosting the data diversity. Experiments prove that the can generate diverse and complex high-quality data even with a opensource small teacher model. The synthesized instruction data demonstrates performance that is comparable to, or even surpasses, baseline annotation methods with proprietary LLMs or open-sourced LLMs while requiring fewer instruction data samples.
abstract_zh: 指令调优是利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 来增强任务性能的关键进步。然而，教学数据集的注释传统上是昂贵且费力的，通常依赖于手动注释或昂贵的专有大语言模型。最近的工作探索了利用开源大语言模型合成数据的方法，但需要高质量的人工种子数据。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种端到端框架，可以利用开源大语言模型和采样的未标记文档来合成高质量的指令数据，从而消除了对种子数据的需求。该框架从不同的预筛选文档开始，在不同阶段合成复杂多样的高质量指令和响应对。我们提出了一种基于标记的提示方法来生成多样化且复杂的种子数据，以及一种基于 UCB 的方法来用种子数据增强更多指令数据。提出了一种新颖的Think Differentprompt来解决种子的分布限制，进一步提高数据多样性。实验证明，即使使用开源的小型教师模型，也可以生成多样化且复杂的高质量数据。合成的指令数据表现出与专有大语言模型或开源大语言模型的基线注释方法相当甚至超越的性能，同时需要更少的指令数据样本。

title: Tag-Instruct: Controlled Instruction Complexity Enhancement through Structure-based Augmentation
abstract_en: High-quality instruction data is crucial for developing large language models (LLMs), yet existing approaches struggle to effectively control instruction complexity. We present Tag-Instruct, a novel framework that enhances instruction complexity through structured semantic compression and controlled difficulty augmentation. Unlike previous prompt-based methods operating on raw text, Tag-Instruct compresses instructions into a compact tag space and systematically enhances complexity through RL-guided tag expansion. Through extensive experiments, we show that Tag-Instruct outperforms existing instruction complexity augmentation approaches. Our analysis reveals that operating in tag space provides superior controllability and stability across different instruction synthesis frameworks.
abstract_zh: 高质量的指令数据对于开发大型语言模型 (LLM) 至关重要，但现有方法难以有效控制指令复杂性。我们提出了 Tag-Instruct，这是一种新颖的框架，它通过结构化语义压缩和受控难度增强来增强指令复杂性。与之前基于提示的原始文本操作方法不同，Tag-Instruct 将指令压缩到紧凑的标签空间中，并通过 RL 引导的标签扩展系统地增强复杂性。通过大量的实验，我们表明 Tag-Instruct 优于现有的指令复杂性增强方法。我们的分析表明，在标签空间中进行操作可以在不同的指令合成框架中提供卓越的可控性和稳定性。

title: A General Framework to Enhance Fine-tuning-basedLLMUnlearning
abstract_en: Unlearning has been proposed to remove copyrighted and privacy-sensitive data from Large Language Models (LLMs). Existing approaches primarily rely on fine-tuning-based methods, which can be categorized into gradient ascent-based (GA-based) and suppression-based methods. However, they often degrade model utility (the ability to respond to normal prompts). In this work, we aim to develop a general framework that enhances the utility of fine-tuning-based unlearning methods. To achieve this goal, we first investigate the common property between GA-based and suppression-based methods. We unveil that GA-based methods unlearn by distinguishing the target data (i.e., the data to be removed) and suppressing related generations—essentially the same strategy employed by suppression-based methods. Inspired by this finding, we introduce Gated Representation UNlearning (GRUN) which has two components: a soft gate function for distinguishing target data and a suppression module using Representation Fine-tuning (ReFT) to adjust representations rather than model parameters. Experiments show that GRUN significantly improves the unlearning and utility. Meanwhile, it is general for fine-tuning-based methods, efficient and promising for sequential unlearning.
abstract_zh: 有人提议取消学习，以从大型语言模型（LLM）中删除受版权保护和隐私敏感的数据。现有的方法主要依赖于基于微调的方法，可以分为基于梯度上升（基于GA）和基于抑制的方法。然而，它们通常会降低模型的实用性（响应正常提示的能力）。在这项工作中，我们的目标是开发一个通用框架，增强基于微调的忘却方法的实用性。为了实现这一目标，我们首先研究基于遗传算法和基于抑制的方法之间的共同属性。我们揭示了基于 GA 的方法通过区分目标数据（即要删除的数据）和抑制相关生成来进行忘却——本质上与基于抑制的方法采用的策略相同。受这一发现的启发，我们引入了门控表示取消学习（GRUN），它有两个组成部分：用于区分目标数据的软门函数和使用表示微调（ReFT）来调整表示而不是模型参数的抑制模块。实验表明，GRUN 显着提高了遗忘性和效用性。同时，它对于基于微调的方法具有通用性，对于顺序遗忘来说是高效且有前景的。

title: PromptWizard: Optimizing Prompts via Task-Aware, Feedback-Driven Self-Evolution
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed AI across diverse domains, with prompting being central to their success in guiding model outputs. However, manual prompt engineering is both labor-intensive and domain-specific, necessitating the need for automated solutions. We introduce PromptWizard, a novel, fully automated framework for discrete prompt optimization, utilizing a self-evolving, self-adapting mechanism. Through a feedback-driven critique and synthesis process, PromptWizard achieves an effective balance between exploration and exploitation, iteratively refining both prompt instructions and in-context examples to generate human-readable, task-specific prompts. This guided approach systematically improves prompt quality, resulting in superior performance across 45 tasks. PromptWizard excels even with limited training data, smaller LLMs, and various LLM architectures. Additionally, our cost analysis reveals a substantial reduction in API calls, token usage, and overall cost, demonstrating PromptWizard’s efficiency, scalability, and advantages over existing prompt optimization strategies.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已经改变了不同领域的人工智能，提示是其成功指导模型输出的核心。然而，手动提示工程既是劳动密集型的，又是针对特定领域的，因此需要自动化解决方案。我们引入 PromptWizard，这是一种新颖的、全自动的离散提示优化框架，利用自我进化、自适应机制。通过反馈驱动的批判和综合过程，PromptWizard 在探索和利用之间实现了有效的平衡，迭代地完善提示指令和上下文示例，以生成人类可读的、特定于任务的提示。这种指导方法系统地提高了提示质量，从而在 45 项任务中实现了卓越的性能。即使训练数据有限、LLM 规模较小以及各种 LLM 架构，PromptWizard 也能表现出色。此外，我们的成本分析显示 API 调用、令牌使用和总体成本大幅减少，证明了 PromptWizard 的效率、可扩展性以及相对于现有提示优化策略的优势。

title: TABGEN-ICL: Residual-Aware In-Context Example Selection for Tabular Data Generation
abstract_en: Large Language models (LLMs) have achieved encouraging results in tabular data generation. However, existing approaches require fine-tuning, which is computationally expensive. This paper explores an alternative: prompting a fixed LLM with in-context examples. We observe that using randomly selected in-context examples hampers the LLM’s performance, resulting in sub-optimal generation quality. To address this, we propose a novel in-context learning framework: TabGen-ICL, to enhance the in-context learning ability of LLMs for tabular data generation. TabGen-ICL operates iteratively, retrieving a subset of real samples that represent the residual between currently generated samples and true data distributions. This approach serves two purposes: locally, it provides more effective in-context learning examples for the LLM in each iteration; globally, it progressively narrows the gap between generated and real data. Extensive experiments on five real-world tabular datasets demonstrate that TabGen-ICL significantly outperforms the random selection strategy. Specifically, it reduces the error rate by a margin of up to 42.2% on the fidelity metric. We demonstrate for the first time that prompting a fixed LLM can yield high-quality synthetic tabular data.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在表格数据生成方面取得了令人鼓舞的成果。然而，现有的方法需要微调，这在计算上是昂贵的。本文探讨了一种替代方案：通过上下文示例提示固定的大语言模型。我们观察到，使用随机选择的上下文示例会阻碍大语言模型的性能，导致生成质量次优。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的上下文学习框架：TabGen-ICL，以增强大语言模型用于表格数据生成的上下文学习能力。 TabGen-ICL 迭代运行，检索代表当前生成的样本与真实数据分布之间残差的真实样本子集。这种方法有两个目的：在本地，它在每次迭代中为大语言模型提供更有效的上下文学习示例；在全球范围内，它逐渐缩​​小了生成数据与真实数据之间的差距。对五个真实世界表格数据集的广泛实验表明，TabGen-ICL 显着优于随机选择策略。具体来说，它在保真度指标上将错误率降低了高达 42.2%。我们首次证明，提示固定的大语言模型可以产生高质量的合成表格数据。

title: Uncertainty Unveiled: Can Exposure to More In-context Examples Mitigate Uncertainty for Large Language Models?
abstract_en: Recent advances in handling long sequences have unlocked new possibilities for long-context in-context learning (ICL). While existing research predominantly focuses on performance gains driven by additional in-context examples, the impact on the trustworthiness of generated responses remains underexplored. This paper addresses this gap by investigating how increased examples influence predictive uncertainty—an essential aspect in trustworthiness. We begin by systematically quantifying uncertainty across different “shot” configurations in ICL, emphasizing the role of example quantity. Through uncertainty decomposition, we introduce a novel perspective on performance enhancement, focusing on epistemic uncertainty (EU). Our results reveal that additional examples reduce total uncertainty in both simple and complex tasks by injecting task-specific knowledge, thereby diminishing EU and enhancing performance. For complex tasks, these advantages emerge only after addressing the increased noise and uncertainty associated with longer inputs. Finally, we investigate the progression of internal confidence across layers, uncovering the underlying mechanisms that drive the reduction in uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 处理长序列的最新进展为长上下文上下文学习（ICL）带来了新的可能性。虽然现有的研究主要关注由额外的上下文示例驱动的性能提升，但对生成的响应的可信度的影响仍未得到充分探索。本文通过研究增加的示例如何影响预测不确定性（可信度的一个重要方面）来解决这一差距。我们首先系统地量化 ICL 中不同“镜头”配置的不确定性，强调示例数量的作用。通过不确定性分解，我们引入了一种关于绩效增强的新颖视角，重点关注认知不确定性（EU）。我们的结果表明，额外的例子通过注入特定任务的知识来减少简单和复杂任务的总体不确定性，从而减少 EU 并提高绩效。对于复杂的任务，只有在解决与较长输入相关的增加的噪声和不确定性之后，这些优势才会显现出来。最后，我们研究了内部信心跨层的进展，揭示了推动不确定性减少的潜在机制。

title: How Personality Traits ShapeLLMRisk-Taking Behaviour
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents for simulation and decision-making, necessitating a deeper understanding of their decision-making behaviour under risk. We investigate the relationship between LLMs’ personality traits and risk-propensity, applying Cumulative Prospect Theory (CPT) and the Big Five personality framework. We compare the behaviour of several LLMs to human baselines. Our findings show that the majority of the models investigated are risk-neutral rational agents, whilst displaying higher Conscientiousness and Agreeableness traits, coupled with lower Neuroticism. Interventions on Big Five traits, particularly Openness, influence the risk-propensity of several LLMs. Advanced models mirror human personality-risk patterns, suggesting that cognitive biases can be surfaced by optimal prompting. However, their distilled variants show no cognitive bias, suggesting limitations to knowledge transfer processes. Notably, Openness emerges as the most influential factor to risk-propensity, aligning with human baselines. In contrast, less advanced models demonstrate inconsistent generalization of the personality-risk relationship. This research advances our understanding of LLM behaviour under risk and highlights the potential and limitations of personality-based interventions in shaping LLM decision-making.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地被部署为模拟和决策的自主代理，因此需要更深入地了解其在风险下的决策行为。我们应用累积前景理论（CPT）和大五人格框架研究大语言模型的人格特质和风险倾向之间的关系。我们将几个大语言模型的行为与人类基线进行比较。我们的研究结果表明，大多数被调查的模型都是风险中性的理性主体，同时表现出较高的责任心和宜人性特征，以及较低的神经质。对大五特征（尤其是开放性）的干预会影响一些大语言模型的风险倾向。先进的模型反映了人类的人格风险模式，表明认知偏差可以通过最佳提示来显现。然而，他们的提炼变体没有表现出认知偏见，这表明知识转移过程存在局限性。值得注意的是，开放性成为对风险倾向影响最大的因素，与人类基线保持一致。相比之下，不太先进的模型表现出人格风险关系的概括不一致。这项研究增进了我们对大语言模型风险行为的理解，并强调了基于人格的干预措施在塑造大语言模型决策方面的潜力和局限性。

title: Q-STRUMDebate: Query-Driven Contrastive Summarization for Recommendation Comparison
abstract_en: Query-driven recommendation with unknown items poses a challenge for users to understand why certain items are appropriate for their needs. Query-driven Contrastive Summarization (QCS) is a methodology designed to address this issue by leveraging language-based item descriptions to clarify contrasts between them. However, existing state-of-the-art contrastive summarization methods such as STRUM-LLM fall short of this goal. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Q-STRUM Debate, a novel extension of STRUM-LLM that employs debate-style prompting to generate focused and contrastive summarizations of item aspects relevant to a query. Leveraging modern large language models (LLMs) as powerful tools for generating debates, Q-STRUM Debate provides enhanced contrastive summaries. Experiments across three datasets demonstrate that Q-STRUM Debate yields significant performance improvements over existing methods on key contrastive summarization criteria, thus introducing a novel and performant debate prompting methodology for QCS.
abstract_zh: 未知项目的查询驱动推荐给用户带来了理解为什么某些项目适合他们的需求的挑战。查询驱动的对比总结 (QCS) 是一种旨在通过利用基于语言的项目描述来澄清它们之间的对比来解决此问题的方法。然而，现有最先进的对比总结方法（例如 STRUM-LLM）未能实现这一目标。为了克服这些限制，我们引入了 Q-STRUM Debate，这是 STRUM-LLM 的一种新颖扩展，它采用辩论式提示来生成与查询相关的项目方面的集中和对比摘要。 Q-STRUM Debate 利用现代大语言模型 (LLM) 作为生成辩论的强大工具，提供增强的对比摘要。跨三个数据集的实验表明，Q-STRUM Debate 在关键对比总结标准上比现有方法产生了显着的性能改进，从而为 QCS 引入了一种新颖且高性能的辩论提示方法。

title: Predicting Depression in Screening Interviews from Interactive Multi-Theme Collaboration
abstract_en: Automatic depression detection provides cues for early clinical intervention by clinicians. Clinical interviews for depression detection involve dialogues centered around multiple themes. Existing studies primarily design end-to-end neural network models to capture the hierarchical structure of clinical interview dialogues. However, these methods exhibit defects in modeling the thematic content of clinical interviews: 1) they fail to explicitly capture intra-theme and inter-theme correlation, and 2) they do not allow clinicians to intervene and focus on themes of interest. To address these issues, this paper introduces an interactive depression detection framework, namely Predicting Depression in Screening Interviews from Interactive Multi-Theme Collaboration (PDIMC). PDIMC leverages in-context learning techniques to identify themes in clinical interviews and then models both intra-theme and inter-theme correlation. Additionally, it employs AI-driven feedback to simulate the interests of clinicians, enabling interactive adjustment of theme importance. PDIMC achieves absolute improvements of 12% on Recall and 35% on F1-dep. metrics, compared to the previous state-of-the-art model on the depression detection dataset DAIC-WOZ, which demonstrates the effectiveness of capturing theme correlation and incorporating interactive external feedback.
abstract_zh: 自动抑郁症检测为临床医生的早期临床干预提供线索。抑郁症检测的临床访谈涉及围绕多个主题的对话。现有研究主要设计端到端神经网络模型来捕获临床访谈对话的层次结构。然而，这些方法在对临床访谈的主题内容进行建模时表现出缺陷：1）它们无法明确捕获主题内和主题间的相关性，2）它们不允许临床医生干预并关注感兴趣的主题。为了解决这些问题，本文引入了一种交互式抑郁症检测框架，即交互式多主题协作筛选访谈中的预测抑郁症（PDIMC）。 PDIMC 利用情境学习技术来识别临床访谈中的主题，然后对主题内和主题间的相关性进行建模。此外，它采用人工智能驱动的反馈来模拟临床医生的兴趣，从而实现主题重要性的交互式调整。 PDIMC 在召回率上实现了 12% 的绝对改进，在 F1-dep 上实现了 35% 的绝对改进。与之前抑郁症检测数据集 DAIC-WOZ 上最先进的模型相比，该模型展示了捕获主题相关性和纳入交互式外部反馈的有效性。

title: Removing Prompt-template Bias in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has become an essential technique for enhancing pre-trained large language models (LLMs) to generate responses that align with human preferences and societal values. Although RLHF has shown promise, the training of reward models (RMs) still faces the challenge ofreward hacking, motivating recent works to prevent RMs from finding shortcuts that bypass the intended optimization objectives by identifying simplistic patterns such as response length. Besides the issue oflength bias, our work firstly reveals thatprompt-template biaslearned by RMs can also causereward hackingwhen dealing with some marginal samples, resulting in LLMs preferring to generate responses in a specific format after RLHF fine-tuning, regardless of the format requested in the prompt. To this end, we propose a low-cost but effective method, namely Prompt Bias Calibration (PBC), to estimate theprompt-template biasterm during reward modeling, which can be utilized to calibrate reward scores in the following RL fine-tuning process. Then, we show that our PBC method can be flexibly combined with existing algorithms of removinglength bias, leading to a further improvement in the aspect of enhancing the quality of generated responses.
abstract_zh: 人类反馈强化学习 (RLHF) 已成为增强预训练大型语言模型 (LLM) 以生成符合人类偏好和社会价值观的响应的基本技术。尽管 RLHF 已显示出希望，但奖励模型 (RM) 的训练仍然面临奖励黑客的挑战，这促使最近的工作通过识别响应长度等简单模式来防止 RM 找到绕过预期优化目标的捷径。除了长度偏差问题之外，我们的工作首先揭示了 RM 学习到的提示模板偏差在处理一些边际样本时也会导致奖励黑客，导致 LLM 在 RLHF 微调后更喜欢以特定格式生成响应，而不管提示中要求的格式如何。为此，我们提出了一种低成本但有效的方法，即提示偏差校准（PBC），来估计奖励建模过程中的提示模板偏差项，该方法可用于在后续强化学习微调过程中校准奖励分数。然后，我们表明我们的 PBC 方法可以与现有的消除长度偏差的算法灵活结合，从而在提高生成响应的质量方面得到进一步的改进。

title: Iterative Repair with Weak Verifiers for Few-shot Transfer inKBQAwith Unanswerability
abstract_en: Real-world applications of KBQA require models to detect different types of unanswerable questions with a limited volume of in-domain labeled training data. We propose the novel task of few-shot transfer for KBQA with unanswerable questions. The state-of-the-art KBQA few-shot transfer model (FuSIC-KBQA) uses an iterative repair strategy that assumes that all questions are answerable. As a remedy, we present FUn-FuSIC – a novel solution for our task that extends FuSIC-KBQA with Feedback for Unanswerability (FUn), which is an iterative repair strategy for answerable as well as unanswerable questions. FUn uses feedback from a suite of strong and weak verifiers, and an adaptation of self-consistency for unanswerability for assessing answerability of questions. Our experiments show that FUn-FuSIC significantly outperforms suitable adaptations of multiple LLM-based and supervised SoTA models on our task, while establishing a new SoTA performance for answerable few-shot transfer as well. We have made datasets and other resources publicly available at https://github.com/dair-iitd/funfusic/.
abstract_zh: KBQA 的实际应用需要模型使用有限数量的域内标记训练数据来检测不同类型的无法回答的问题。我们针对无法回答的问题提出了 KBQA 的少样本迁移的新任务。最先进的 KBQA 少样本传输模型 (FuSIC-KBQA) 使用迭代修复策略，假设所有问题都是可回答的。作为一种补救措施，我们提出了 FUn-FuSIC——一种针对我们的任务的新颖解决方案，它通过不可回答性反馈（FUn）扩展了 FuSIC-KBQA，这是一种针对可回答和不可回答问题的迭代修复策略。 FUn 使用来自一组强验证者和弱验证者的反馈，以及对不可回答性的自我一致性的调整来评估问题的可回答性。我们的实验表明，FUn-FuSIC 在我们的任务中显着优于对多个基于 LLM 和监督的 SoTA 模型的适当调整，同时也为可响应的少样本传输建立了新的 SoTA 性能。我们已在 https://github.com/dair-iitd/funfusic/ 上公开提供数据集和其他资源。

title: Mixture-of-Personas Language Models for Population Simulation
abstract_en: Advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) paved the way for their emerging applications in various domains, such as human behavior simulations, where LLMs could augment human-generated data in social science research and machine learning model training. However, pretrained LLMs often fail to capture the behavioral diversity of target populations due to the inherent variability across individuals and groups. To address this, we proposeMixture of Personas(MoP), aprobabilisticprompting method that aligns LLM responses with the target population. MoP is a contextual mixture model, where each component is an LM agent characterized by a persona and an exemplar that represents the behaviors of subpopulation. The persona and the exemplar are randomly chosen according to the learned mixing weights to elicit diverse LLM responses during simulation. MoP is flexible, does not require model fine-tuning, and is transferable between base models. Experiments for synthetic data generation show that MoP outperforms competing methods in alignment and diversity metrics.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 的进步为其在各个领域的新兴应用铺平了道路，例如人类行为模拟，LLM 可以在社会科学研究和机器学习模型训练中增强人类生成的数据。然而，由于个人和群体之间固有的可变性，预训练的大语言模型通常无法捕捉目标人群的行为多样性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Mixture of Personas（MoP），这是一种概率提示方法，可以将大语言模型的回答与目标人群保持一致。 MoP 是一个上下文混合模型，其中每个组件都是一个 LM 智能体，其特征是角色和代表子群体行为的样本。根据学习到的混合权重随机选择角色和范例，以在模拟过程中引发不同的 LLM 响应。 MoP 非常灵活，不需要模型微调，并且可以在基础模型之间转移。合成数据生成实验表明，MoP 在对齐和多样性指标方面优于竞争方法。

title: Answer When Needed, Forget When Not: Language Models Pretend to Forget via In-Context Knowledge Unlearning
abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) are applied across diverse domains, the ability to selectively unlearn specific information is becoming increasingly essential. For instance, LLMs are expected to selectively provide confidential information to authorized internal users, such as employees or trusted partners, while withholding it from external users, including the general public and unauthorized entities.Therefore, we propose a novel method termed ìn-context knowledge unlearning”, which enables the model to selectively forget information in test-time based on the query context.Our method fine-tunes pre-trained LLMs to enable prompt unlearning of target knowledge within the context, while preserving unrelated information. Experiments on TOFU, AGE and RWKU datasets using Llama2-7B/13B and Mistral-7B models demonstrate that our method achieves up to 95% forget accuracy while retaining 80% of unrelated knowledge, significantly outperforming baselines in both in-domain and out-of-domain scenarios.Further investigation of the model’s internal behavior revealed that while fine-tuned LLMs generate correct predictions in the middle layers and preserve them up to the final layer. However, the decision to forget is made only at the last layer, i.e. LLMs pretend to forget”.Our findings offer valuable insight into the improvement of the robustness of the unlearning mechanisms in LLMs, laying a foundation for future research in the field.
abstract_zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）在不同领域的应用，选择性忘记特定信息的能力变得越来越重要。例如，LLM 需要有选择地向授权的内部用户（例如员工或值得信赖的合作伙伴）提供机密信息，同时不对外部用户（包括公众和未经授权的实体）提供机密信息。因此，我们提出了一种称为“上下文知识忘却”的新方法，该方法使模型能够根据查询上下文在测试时选择性地忘记信息。我们的方法对预先训练的 LLM 进行微调，以能够在上下文中快速忘却目标知识，同时保留不相关的信息。使用 Llama2-7B/13B 和 Mistral-7B 模型的 TOFU、AGE 和 RWKU 数据集表明，我们的方法实现了高达 95% 的遗忘准确率，同时保留了 80% 的不相关知识，在域内和域外场景中均显着优于基线。对模型内部行为的进一步研究表明，虽然经过微调的 LLM 在中间层生成正确的预测并将其保留到最后一层，但我们决定这样做。遗忘仅在最后一层发生，即大语言模型假装忘记”。我们的研究结果为提高大语言模型遗忘机制的鲁棒性提供了宝贵的见解，为该领域的未来研究奠定了基础。

title: Do Language Models Mirror Human Confidence? Exploring Psychological Insights to Address Overconfidence inLLMs
abstract_en: Psychology research has shown that humans are poor at estimating their performance on tasks, tending towards underconfidence on easy tasks and overconfidence on difficult tasks. We examine three LLMs, Llama-3-70B-instruct, Claude-3-Sonnet, and GPT-4o, on a range of QA tasks of varying difficulty, and show that models exhibit subtle differences from human patterns of overconfidence: less sensitive to task difficulty, and when prompted to answer based on different personas—e.g., expert vs layman, or different race, gender, and ages—the models will respond with stereotypically biased confidence estimations even though their underlying answer accuracy remains the same. Based on these observations, we propose Answer-Free Confidence Estimation (AFCE) to improve confidence calibration and LLM interpretability in these settings. AFCE is a self-assessment method that employs two stages of prompting, first eliciting only confidence scores on questions, then asking separately for the answer. Experiments on the MMLU and GPQA datasets spanning subjects and difficulty show that this separation of tasks significantly reduces overconfidence and delivers more human-like sensitivity to task difficulty.
abstract_zh: 心理学研究表明，人类不善于估计自己在任务中的表现，往往对简单的任务缺乏信心，而对困难的任务则过度自信。我们研究了三位大语言模型（Llama-3-70B-instruct、Claude-3-Sonnet 和 GPT-4o）在一系列不同难度的 QA 任务上的表现，结果表明，模型与人类的过度自信模式表现出微妙的差异：对任务难度不太敏感，并且当根据不同的角色（例如，专家与外行，或不同的种族、性别和年龄）提示回答时，模型将做出带有刻板印象的有偏见的置信估计，即使它们的底层答案准确度保持不变。基于这些观察，我们提出了无答案置信度估计 (AFCE)，以改善这些设置中的置信度校准和 LLM 可解释性。 AFCE 是一种自我评估方法，采用两个阶段的提示，首先仅引出问题的置信度分数，然后单独询问答案。在涵盖主题和难度的 MMLU 和 GPQA 数据集上进行的实验表明，这种任务分离显着减少了过度自信，并对任务难度提供了更像人类的敏感性。

title: PLAY2PROMPT: Zero-shot Tool Instruction Optimization forLLMAgents via Tool Play
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated with specialized external tools, yet many tasks demand zero-shot tool usage with minimal or noisy documentation. Existing solutions rely on manual rewriting or labeled data for validation, making them inapplicable in true zero-shot settings. To address these challenges, we propose PLAY2PROMPT, an automated framework that systematically “plays” with each tool to explore its input-output behaviors. Through this iterative trial-and-error process, PLAY2PROMPT refines tool documentation and generates usage examples without any labeled data. These examples not only guide LLM inference but also serve as validation to further enhance tool utilization. Extensive experiments on real-world tasks demonstrate that PLAY2PROMPT significantly improves zero-shot tool performance across both open and closed models, offering a scalable and effective solution for domain-specific tool integration.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地与专用外部工具集成，但许多任务需要零样本工具使用以及最少或嘈杂的文档。现有的解决方案依赖于手动重写或标记数据进行验证，这使得它们不适用于真正的零样本设置。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 PLAY2PROMPT，这是一个自动化框架，可以系统地“玩”每个工具以探索其输入输出行为。通过这种迭代试错过程，PLAY2PROMPT 完善了工具文档并生成了没有任何标记数据的使用示例。这些例子不仅可以指导LLM推理，还可以作为进一步提高工具利用率的验证。对现实世界任务的大量实验表明，PLAY2PROMPT 显着提高了开放式和封闭式模型中的零样本工具性能，为特定领域的工具集成提供了可扩展且有效的解决方案。

title: Revisiting In-Context Learning with Long Context Language Models
abstract_en: In-Context Learning (ICL) is a technique by which language models make predictions based on examples provided in their input context. Previously, their context window size imposed a limit on the number of examples that can be shown, making example selection techniques crucial for identifying the maximally effective set of examples. However, the recent advent of Long Context Language Models (LCLMs) has significantly increased the number of examples that can be included in context, raising an important question of whether ICL performance in a many-shot regime is still sensitive to the method of sample selection. To answer this, we revisit these approaches in the context of LCLMs through extensive experiments on 18 datasets spanning 4 tasks. Surprisingly, we observe that sophisticated example selection techniques do not yield significant improvements over a simple random sample selection method. Instead, we discover that the advent of LCLMs has fundamentally shifted the challenge of ICL from that of selecting the most effective examples to that of collecting sufficient examples to fill the context window. Specifically, in certain datasets, including all available examples does not fully utilize the context window; however, by augmenting the examples in context with a simple data augmentation approach, we substantially improve ICL performance by 5%.
abstract_zh: 上下文学习 (ICL) 是一种语言模型根据输入上下文中提供的示例进行预测的技术。以前，它们的上下文窗口大小对可以显示的示例数量施加了限制，这使得示例选择技术对于识别最有效的示例集至关重要。然而，最近出现的长上下文语言模型 (LCLM) 显着增加了上下文中可以包含的示例数量，从而提出了一个重要问题：多镜头机制中的 ICL 性能是否仍然对样本选择方法敏感。为了回答这个问题，我们通过对涵盖 4 个任务的 18 个数据集进行广泛的实验，在 LCLM 的背景下重新审视这些方法。令人惊讶的是，我们观察到复杂的示例选择技术并没有比简单的随机样本选择方法产生显着的改进。相反，我们发现 LCLM 的出现从根本上将 ICL 的挑战从选择最有效的示例转变为收集足够的示例来填充上下文窗口。具体来说，在某些数据集中，包括所有可用示例并没有充分利用上下文窗口；然而，通过使用简单的数据增强方法来增强上下文中的示例，我们将 ICL 性能大幅提高了 5%。

title: “The Facts Speak for Themselves”:GPTand Fallacy Classification
abstract_en: Fallacies are not only part and parcel of human communication, they are also important for generative models in that fallacies can be tailored to self-verify the output they generate. Previous work has shown that fallacy detection and classification is tricky, but the question that still remains is whether the use of theoretical explanations in prompting Large Language Models (LLMs) on the task enhances the performance of the models. In this paper we show that this is not the case: Using the pragma-dialectics approach to fallacies (van Eemeren, 1987), we show that three GPT models struggle with the task. Based on our own PD-oriented dataset of fallacies and an extension of an existing fallacy dataset from Jin et al. (2022), we show that this is not only the case for fallacies “in the wild”, but also for textbook examples of fallacious arguments. Our paper also supports the claim that LLMs generally lag behind in fallacy classification in comparison to smaller-scale neural models.
abstract_zh: 谬误不仅是人类交流的重要组成部分，它们对于生成模型也很重要，因为可以定制谬误来自我验证它们生成的输出。先前的工作表明，谬误检测和分类很棘手，但仍然存在的问题是，使用理论解释来提示大型语言模型（LLM）执行任务是否可以提高模型的性能。在本文中，我们表明情况并非如此：使用语用辩证法来解决谬误（van Eemeren，1987），我们表明三个 GPT 模型难以完成该任务。基于我们自己的面向 PD 的谬误数据集以及 Jin 等人现有谬误数据集的扩展。 （2022），我们证明这不仅适用于“野外”的谬误，而且也适用于教科书上错误论证的例子。我们的论文还支持这样一种说法，即与较小规模的神经模型相比，大语言模型在谬误分类方面通常落后。

title: ExploringLLMPriming Strategies for Few-Shot Stance Classification
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are effective in predicting the labels of unseen target instances if instructed for the task and training instances via the prompt. LLMs generate a text with higher probability if the prompt contains text with similar characteristics, a phenomenon, called priming, that especially affects argumentation. An open question in NLP is how to systematically exploit priming to choose a set of instances suitable for a given task. For stance classification, LLMs may be primed with few-shot instances prior to identifying whether a given argument is pro or con a topic. In this paper, we explore two priming strategies for few-shot stance classification: one takes those instances that are most semantically similar, and the other chooses those that are most stance-similar. Experiments on three common stance datasets suggest that priming an LLM with stance-similar instances is particularly effective in few-shot stance classification compared to baseline strategies, and behaves largely consistently across different LLM variants.
abstract_zh: 如果通过提示指示任务和训练实例，大型语言模型 (LLM) 可以有效地预测未见过的目标实例的标签。如果提示包含具有相似特征的文本，大语言模型会以更高的概率生成文本，这种现象称为启动，尤其会影响论证。 NLP 中的一个悬而未决的问题是如何系统地利用启动来选择一组适合给定任务的实例。对于立场分类，大语言模型可能会在确定给定论点是赞成还是反对某个主题之前先用少量实例进行准备。在本文中，我们探索了两种用于少镜头姿态分类的启动策略：一种采用语义最相似的实例，另一种选择姿态最相似的实例。对三个常见立场数据集的实验表明，与基线策略相比，用立场相似的实例启动 LLM 在少样本立场分类中特别有效，并且在不同的 LLM 变体中表现基本一致。

title: On IntegratingLLMs Into an Argument Annotation Workflow
abstract_en: Given the recent success of LLMs across different NLP tasks, their usability for data annotation has become a promising area of research. In this work, we investigate to what extent LLMs can be used as annotators for argument components and their semantic types in German tweets through a series of experiments combining different models and prompt configurations. Each prompt is constructed from modular components, such as class definitions or contextual information. Our results suggest that LLMs can indeed perform argument annotation, particularly of semantic argument types, if provided with precise class definitions. However, a fine-tuned BERT baseline remains a strong contender, often matching or exceeding LLM performance. These findings highlight the importance of considering not only model performance, but also ecological and financial costs when defining an annotation workflow.
abstract_zh: 鉴于大语言模型最近在不同 NLP 任务上取得的成功，它们在数据注释方面的可用性已成为一个有前途的研究领域。在这项工作中，我们通过一系列结合不同模型和提示配置的实验，研究大语言模型可以在多大程度上用作德语推文中参数组件及其语义类型的注释器。每个提示都是由模块化组件构建的，例如类定义或上下文信息。我们的结果表明，如果提供精确的类定义，大语言模型确实可以执行参数注释，特别是语义参数类型。然而，经过微调的 BERT 基线仍然是一个强有力的竞争者，通常可以匹配或超过 LLM 的性能。这些发现强调了在定义注释工作流程时不仅要考虑模型性能，还要考虑生态和财务成本的重要性。

title: Investigating Methods for Mapping Learning Objectives to Bloom’s Revised Taxonomy in Course Descriptions for Higher Education
abstract_en: Aligning Learning Objectives (LOs) in course descriptions with educational frameworks such as Bloom’s revised taxonomy is an important step in maintaining educational quality, yet it remains a challenging and often manual task. With the growing availability of large language models (LLMs), a natural question arises: can these models meaningfully automate LO classification, or are non-LLM methods still sufficient? In this work, we systematically compare LLM- and non-LLM-based methods for mapping LOs to Bloom’s taxonomy levels, using expert annotations as the gold standard. LLM-based methods consistently outperform non-LLM methods and offer more balanced distributions across taxonomy levels. Moreover, contrary to common concerns, we do not observe significant biases (e.g. verbosity or positional) or notable sensitivity to prompt structure in LLM outputs. Our results suggest that a more consistent and precise formulation of LOs, along with improved methods, could support both automated and expert-driven efforts to better align LOs with taxonomy levels.
abstract_zh: 将课程描述中的学习目标 (LO) 与教育框架（例如布鲁姆修订后的分类法）保持一致是保持教育质量的重要一步，但这仍然是一项具有挑战性且通常是手动的任务。随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 的可用性不断增加，一个自然的问题出现了：这些模型能否有意义地自动化 LO 分类，或者非 LLM 方法是否仍然足够？在这项工作中，我们使用专家注释作为黄金标准，系统地比较了基于 LLM 和非 LLM 的方法，将 LO 映射到 Bloom 的分类级别。基于大语言模型的方法始终优于非大语言模型方法，并在分类级别上提供更平衡的分布。此外，与普遍关注的相反，我们没有观察到大语言模型输出中的显着偏差（例如冗长或位置）或对提示结构的显着敏感性。我们的结果表明，更加一致和精确的 LO 表述以及改进的方法可以支持自动化和专家驱动的工作，以更好地将 LO 与分类水平保持一致。

title: Advances in Auto-Grading with Large Language Models: A Cross-Disciplinary Survey
abstract_en: With the rise and widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) in recent years, extensive research has been conducted on their applications across various domains. One such domain is education, where a key area of interest for researchers is investigating the implementation and reliability of LLMs in grading student responses. This review paper examines studies on the use of LLMs in grading across six academic sub-fields: educational assessment, essay grading, natural sciences and technology, social sciences and humanities, computer science and engineering, and mathematics. It explores how different LLMs are applied in automated grading, the prompting techniques employed, the effectiveness of LLM-based grading for both structured and open-ended responses, and the patterns observed in grading performance. Additionally, this paper discusses the challenges associated with LLM-based grading systems, such as inconsistencies and the need for human oversight. By synthesizing existing research, this paper provides insights into the current capabilities of LLMs in academic assessment and serves as a foundation for future exploration in this area.
abstract_zh: 近年来，随着大型语言模型（LLM）的兴起和广泛采用，人们对其在各个领域的应用进行了广泛的研究。其中一个领域是教育，研究人员感兴趣的一个关键领域是调查大语言模型在对学生反应进行评分时的实施和可靠性。这篇评论文章探讨了大语言模型在六个学术子领域的评分中的使用研究：教育评估、论文评分、自然科学与技术、社会科学与人文、计算机科学与工程以及数学。它探讨了不同的大语言模型如何应用于自动评分、所采用的提示技术、基于大语言模型的评分对于结构化和开放式回答的有效性，以及评分表现中观察到的模式。此外，本文还讨论了与基于 LLM 的评分系统相关的挑战，例如不一致和人工监督的需要。通过综合现有研究，本文深入了解了大语言模型目前在学术评估方面的能力，并为该领域未来的探索奠定了基础。

title: EyeLLM: Using Lookback Fixations to Enhance Human-LLMAlignment for Text Completion
abstract_en: Recent advances in LLMs offer new opportunities for supporting student writing, particularly through real-time, composition-level feedback. However, for such support to be effective, LLMs need to generate text completions that align with the writer’s internal representation of their developing message, a representation that is often implicit and difficult to observe. This paper investigates the use of eye-tracking data, specifically lookback fixations during pauses in text production, as a cue to this internal representation. Using eye movement data from students composing texts, we compare human-generated completions with LLM-generated completions based on prompts that either include or exclude words and sentences fixated during pauses. We find that incorporating lookback fixations enhances human-LLM alignment in generating text completions. These results provide empirical support for generating fixation-aware LLM feedback and lay the foundation for future educational tools that deliver real-time, composition-level feedback grounded in writers’ attention and cognitive processes.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型的最新进展为支持学生写作提供了新的机会，特别是通过实时的作文级别反馈。然而，为了使这种支持有效，大语言模型需要生成与作者对其正在发展的信息的内部表示相一致的文本完成，这种表示通常是隐含的且难以观察。本文研究了眼动追踪数据的使用，特别是文本生成暂停期间的回顾注视，作为这种内部表征的提示。使用撰写文本的学生的眼动数据，我们根据包含或排除停顿期间固定的单词和句子的提示，将人类生成的完成与大语言模型生成的完成进行比较。我们发现，结合回顾固定可以增强人类与大语言模型在生成文本补全方面的一致性。这些结果为产生注视感知的大语言模型反馈提供了实证支持，并为未来的教育工具奠定了基础，这些工具可以提供基于作家注意力和认知过程的实时、作文级别的反馈。

title: TeamXSZatBioLaySumm2025: Section-Wise Summarization, Retrieval-AugmentedLLM, and Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning for Lay Summaries
abstract_en: We propose a unified, multi-stage lay summarization pipeline for BioLaySumm 2025 (Subtask 1.1) that (1) selects and summarizes key article sections via BioBART, (2) retrieves K-shot demonstrations using BGE embeddings for in-context Llama 3 8B prompting, (3) applies LoRA adapters to Llama 3 8B for supervised fine-tuning, (4) merges section summaries with a second BioBART pass, and (5) refines outputs through reinforcement learning (PPO & GRPO) using a composite reward of factuality (AlignScore, SummaC), relevance (ROUGE-L, BERTScore), and readability (LENS, FKGL, DCRS, CLI). On PLOS and eLife validation sets, our complete systemreduces DCRS from 9.23 to 8.56 and reduces CLI from 12.98 to 12.65, ranking 3rd in readability. and outperforms llama3 finetune baseline in AlignScore 0.722 to 0.862, ranking 5th in factuality, demonstrating balanced gains across readability, relevance, and factuality.
abstract_zh: 我们为 BioLaySumm 2025（子任务 1.1）提出了一个统一的多阶段总结管道，（1）通过 BioBART 选择和总结关键文章部分，（2）使用 BGE 嵌入检索 K-shot 演示以进行上下文中的 Llama 3 8B 提示，（3）将 LoRA 适配器应用于 Llama 3 8B 进行监督微调，（4）合并部分摘要(5) 使用事实性（AlignScore、SummaC）、相关性（ROUGE-L、BERTScore）和可读性（LENS、FKGL、DCRS、CLI）的复合奖励，通过强化学习（PPO 和 GRPO）完善输出。在 PLOS 和 eLife 验证集上，我们的完整系统将 DCRS 从 9.23 降低到 8.56，将 CLI 从 12.98 降低到 12.65，可读性排名第三。在 AlignScore 0.722 至 0.862 上优于 llama3 微调基线，在真实性方面排名第五，展示了在可读性、相关性和真实性方面的平衡收益。

title: What Makes YouCLIC: Detection ofCroatian Clickbait Headlines
abstract_en: Online news outlets operate predominantly on an advertising-based revenue model, compelling journalists to create headlines that are often scandalous, intriguing, and provocative – commonly referred to as clickbait. Automatic detection of clickbait headlines is essential for preserving information quality and reader trust in digital media and requires both contextual understanding and world knowledge. For this task, particularly in less-resourced languages, it remains unclear whether fine-tuned methods or in-context learning (ICL) yield better results. In this paper, we compile clic, a novel dataset for clickbait detection of Croatian news headlines spanning a 20-year period and encompassing mainstream and fringe outlets. Furthermore, we fine-tune the BERTić model on the task of clickbait detection for Croatian and compare its performance to LLM-based ICL methods with prompts both in Croatian and English. Finally, we analyze the linguistic properties of clickbait. We find that nearly half of the analyzed headlines contain clickbait, and that finetuned models deliver better results than general LLMs.
abstract_zh: 在线新闻媒体主要采用基于广告的收入模式，迫使记者创造往往具有诽谤性、耐人寻味和挑衅性的头条新闻——通常被称为点击诱饵。自动检测标题诱饵对于保持信息质量和读者对数字媒体的信任至关重要，并且需要上下文理解和世界知识。对于这项任务，特别是在资源较少的语言中，目前尚不清楚微调方法或上下文学习（ICL）是否能产生更好的结果。在本文中，我们编译了 clic，这是一个新颖的数据集，用于检测克罗地亚新闻标题的点击诱饵，涵盖 20 年的时间段，涵盖主流和边缘媒体。此外，我们在克罗地亚语点击诱饵检测任务上对 BERTić 模型进行了微调，并将其性能与基于 LLM 的 ICL 方法进行比较，并提供克罗地亚语和英语提示。最后，我们分析了标题诱饵的语言特性。我们发现近一半的分析标题包含点击诱饵，并且经过微调的模型比一般大语言模型能提供更好的结果。

title: Multilabel Classification of Persuasion Techniques with self-improvingLLMagent:SlavicNLP2025 Shared Task
abstract_en: We present a system for the SlavicNLP 2025 Shared Task on multilabel classification of 25 persuasion techniques across Slavic languages. We investigate the effectiveness of in-context learning with one-shot classification, automatic prompt refinement, and supervised fine-tuning using self-generated annotations. Our findings highlight the potential of LLM-based system to generalize across languages and label sets with minimal supervision.
abstract_zh: 我们为 SlavicNLP 2025 共享任务提出了一个系统，该系统对跨斯拉夫语言的 25 种说服技术进行多标签分类。我们研究了上下文学习的有效性，包括一次性分类、自动提示细化和使用自生成注释的监督微调。我们的研究结果凸显了基于大语言模型的系统在最少监督的情况下跨语言和标签集进行推广的潜力。

title: Integrating Expert Labels intoLLM-based Emission Goal Detection: Example Selection vs Automatic Prompt Design
abstract_en: We address the detection of emission reduction goals in corporate reports, an important task for monitoring companies’ progress in addressing climate change. Specifically, we focus on the issue of integrating expert feedback in the form of labeled example passages into LLM-based pipelines, and compare the two strategies of (1) a dynamic selection of few-shot examples and (2) the automatic optimization of the prompt by the LLM itself. Our findings on a public dataset of 769 climate-related passages from real-world business reports indicate that automatic prompt optimization is the superior approach, while combining both methods provides only limited benefit. Qualitative results indicate that optimized prompts do indeed capture many intricacies of the targeted emission goal extraction task.
abstract_zh: 我们在企业报告中解决减排目标的检测问题，这是监测企业应对气候变化进展的一项重要任务。具体来说，我们重点关注将标记示例段落形式的专家反馈集成到基于 LLM 的流程中的问题，并比较以下两种策略：（1）动态选择少量示例和（2）LLM 本身自动优化提示。我们对现实世界商业报告中 769 个气候相关段落的公共数据集的研究结果表明，自动提示优化是更好的方法，而结合这两种方法只能带来有限的好处。定性结果表明，优化的提示确实捕获了目标排放目标提取任务的许多复杂性。

title: OldJoe atAVeriTeC: In-context learning for fact-checking
abstract_en: In this paper, we present the system proposed by our team OldJoe, for the 8th edition of the AVeriTeC shared task, as part of the FEVER workshop. The objective of this task is to verify the factuality of real-world claims. Our approach integrates open source large language models, SQL, and in-context learning. We begin with embedding the knowledge store using a pretrained embedding language model then storing the outputs in a SQL database. Subsequently, we prompt an LLM to craft relevant questions based on the input claim, which are then used to guide the retrieval process. We further prompt the LLM to generate answers to the questions and predict the veracity of the original claim. Our system scored 0.49 on the HU-METEOR AVeriTeC score on the dev set and 0.15 on the Ev2R recall on the test set. Due to the time constraint we were unable to conduct additional experiments or further hyperparameter tuning. As a result, we adopted this pipeline configuration centered on the Qwen3-14B-AWQ model as our final submission strategy. The full pipeline is available on GitHub: https://github.com/farahft/OldJoe
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了我们的团队 OldJoe 在第 8 版 AVeriTeC 共享任务中提出的系统，作为 FEVER 研讨会的一部分。此任务的目的是验证现实世界声明的真实性。我们的方法集成了开源大型语言模型、SQL 和上下文学习。我们首先使用预训练的嵌入语言模型嵌入知识存储，然后将输出存储在 SQL 数据库中。随后，我们提示大语言模型根据输入的声明提出相关问题，然后用于指导检索过程。我们进一步提示大语言模型生成问题的答案并预测原始主张的准确性。我们的系统在开发集上的 HU-METEOR AVeriTeC 得分为 0.49，在测试集上的 Ev2R 召回得分为 0.15。由于时间限制，我们无法进行额外的实验或进一步的超参数调整。因此，我们采用了以Qwen3-14B-AWQ模型为中心的管道配置作为我们最终的提交策略。完整的管道可在 GitHub 上找到：https://github.com/farahft/OldJoe

title: AreLLMs (Really) Ideological? AnIRT-based Analysis and Alignment Tool for Perceived Socio-Economic Bias inLLMs
abstract_en: We introduce an Item Response Theory (IRT)-based framework to detect and quantify ideological bias in large language models (LLMs) without relying on subjective human judgments. Unlike prior work, our two-stage approach distinguishes between response avoidance and expressed bias by modeling ‘Prefer Not to Answer’ (PNA) behaviors and calibrating ideological leanings based on open-ended responses. We fine-tune two LLM families to represent liberal and conservative baselines, and validate our approach using a 105-item ideological test inventory. Our results show that off-the-shelve LLMs frequently avoid engagement with ideological prompts, calling into question previous claims of partisan bias. This framework provides a statistically grounded and scalable tool for LLM alignment and fairness assessment. The general methodolody can also be applied to other forms of bias and languages.
abstract_zh: 我们引入了基于项目响应理论（IRT）的框架来检测和量化大型语言模型（LLM）中的意识形态偏见，而不依赖于人类的主观判断。与之前的工作不同，我们的两阶段方法通过模拟“不愿回答”（PNA）行为并根据开放式反应校准意识形态倾向来区分反应回避和表达偏见。我们对两个大语言模型系列进行微调，以代表自由派和保守派基线，并使用 105 项意识形态测试清单来验证我们的方法。我们的研究结果表明，现成的大语言模型经常避免参与意识形态提示，这对之前关于党派偏见的说法提出了质疑。该框架为大语言模型一致性和公平性评估提供了一个基于统计且可扩展的工具。一般方法也可以应用于其他形式的偏见和语言。

title: Free-text Rationale Generation under Readability Level Control
abstract_en: Free-text rationales justify model decisions in natural language and thus become likable and accessible among approaches to explanation across many tasks. However, their effectiveness can be hindered by misinterpretation and hallucination. As a perturbation test, we investigate how large language models (LLMs) perform rationale generation under the effects of readability level control, i.e., being prompted for an explanation targeting a specific expertise level, such as sixth grade or college. We find that explanations are adaptable to such instruction, though the observed distinction between readability levels does not fully match the defined complexity scores according to traditional readability metrics. Furthermore, the generated rationales tend to feature medium level complexity, which correlates with the measured quality using automatic metrics. Finally, our human annotators confirm a generally satisfactory impression on rationales at all readability levels, with high-school-level readability being most commonly perceived and favored.
abstract_zh: 自由文本原理证明了自然语言模型决策的合理性，因此在许多任务的解释方法中变得讨人喜欢且易于理解。然而，它们的有效性可能会因误解和幻觉而受到阻碍。作为扰动测试，我们研究大型语言模型（LLM）如何在可读性水平控制的影响下执行基本原理生成，即提示针对特定专业水平（例如六年级或大学）的解释。我们发现解释适用于此类指令，尽管观察到的可读性级别之间的区别并不完全符合根据传统可读性指标定义的复杂性分数。此外，生成的理由往往具有中等复杂性，这与使用自动指标测量的质量相关。最后，我们的人类注释者确认了所有可读性级别的基本原理普遍令人满意的印象，其中高中级别的可读性最普遍被感知和青睐。

title: Memorization: A Close Look at Books
abstract_en: To what extent can entire books be extracted from LLMs? Using the Llama 3 70B family of models, and the “prefix-prompting” extractiontechnique, we were able to auto-regressively reconstruct, with a very high level of similarity, one entire book (Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland) from just the first 500 tokens. We were also able to obtain high extraction rates on several other books, piece-wise. However, these successes do not extend uniformly to all books. We show that extraction rates of books correlate with book popularity and thus, likely duplication in the training data. We also confirm the undoing of mitigations in the instruction-tuned Llama 3.1, following recent work (Nasr et al., 2025). We further find that this undoing comes from changes to only a tiny fraction of weights concentrated primarily in the lower transformer blocks. Our results provide evidence of the limits of current regurgitation mitigation strategies and introduce a framework for studying how fine-tuning affects the retrieval of verbatim memorization in aligned LLMs.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型可以在多大程度上提取整本书？使用 Llama 3 70B 系列模型和“前缀提示”提取技术，我们能够仅从前 500 个标记中以非常高的相似度自动回归重建一整本书（爱丽丝梦游仙境）。我们还能够在其他几本书上分段获得高提取率。然而，这些成功并不适用于所有书籍。我们表明，书籍的提取率与书籍的受欢迎程度相关，因此可能与训练数据中的重复相关。根据最近的工作（Nasr 等人，2025），我们还确认了指令调整的 Llama 3.1 中缓解措施的撤销。我们进一步发现，这种破坏来自于主要集中在较低变压器块中的一小部分权重的变化。我们的结果提供了当前反流缓解策略的局限性的证据，并引入了一个框架来研究微调如何影响对齐的大语言模型逐字记忆的检索。

title: RL+ Transformer = A General-Purpose Problem Solver
abstract_en: What if artificial intelligence could not only solve problems for which it was trained but also teach itself to tackle novel tasks? In this paper, we finetune Llama 3.1 using reinforcement learning on the grid-world game Frozen Lake and investigate its ability to solve maps it has never encountered—a phenomenon recently termed In-Context Reinforcement Learning (ICRL). Without additional training, the transformer demonstrates the capacity to adapt to both in-distribution and out-of-distribution environment parameterizations. Moreover, it remains effective when trained on data that blends optimal and suboptimal behavior, combines strategies from its context (behavior-stitching), and dynamically adapts to non-stationary environments. These proof-of-concept findings suggest that in-context learning via reinforcement-tuned transformers may form the basis of a promising general-purpose problem-solver.
abstract_zh: 如果人工智能不仅能够解决训练过的问题，还能自学解决新任务，结果会怎样呢？在本文中，我们在网格世界游戏 Frozen Lake 上使用强化学习对 Llama 3.1 进行微调，并研究其解决从未遇到过的地图的能力，这种现象最近被称为上下文强化学习 (ICRL)。无需额外培训，变压器即可展现适应配电内和配电外环境参数化的能力。此外，当对混合最佳和次优行为的数据进行训练、结合其上下文中的策略（行为缝合）并动态适应非静态环境时，它仍然有效。这些概念验证的结果表明，通过强化调整变压器进行的情境学习可能构成有前途的通用问题解决器的基础。

title: A.M.PatSciHal2025: Automated Hallucination Detection in Scientific Content viaLLMs and Prompt Engineering
abstract_en: This paper presents our system developed for SciHal2025: Hallucination Detection for Scientific Content. The primary goal of this task is to detect hallucinated claims based on the corresponding reference. Our methodology leverages strategic prompt engineering to enhance LLMs’ ability to accurately distinguish between factual assertions and hallucinations in scientific contexts. Moreover, we discovered that aggregating the fine-grained classification results from the more complex subtask (subtask 2) into the simplified label set required for the simpler subtask (subtask 1) significantly improved performance compared to direct classification for subtask 1. This work contributes to the development of more reliable AI-powered research tools by providing a systematic framework for hallucination detection in scientific content.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们为 SciHal2025 开发的系统：科学内容的幻觉检测。此任务的主要目标是根据相应的参考来检测幻觉声明。我们的方法利用战略提示工程来增强大语言模型在科学背景下准确区分事实断言和幻觉的能力。此外，我们发现，与子任务 1 的直接分类相比，将更复杂的子任务（子任务 2）的细粒度分类结果聚合到更简单的子任务（子任务 1）所需的简化标签集中可以显着提高性能。这项工作通过为科学内容中的幻觉检测提供系统框架，有助于开发更可靠的人工智能研究工具。

title: BERTastic atSemEval-2025 Task 10: State-of-the-Art Accuracy in Coarse-Grained Entity Framing forHindi News
abstract_en: We describe our system for SemEval-2025 Task 10 Subtask 1 on coarse-grained entity framing in Hindi news, exploring two complementary strategies. First, we experiment with LLM prompting using GPT-4o, comparing hierarchical multi-step prompting with native single-step prompting for both main and fine-grained role prediction. Second, we conduct an extensive study on fine-tuning XLM-R, analyzing different context granularities (full article, paragraph, or sentence-level entity mentions), monolingual vs. multilingual settings, and main vs. fine-grained role labels. Our best system, trained on fine-grained role annotations across languages using sentence-level context, achieved 43.99% exact match, 56.56 % precision, 47.38% recall, and 51.57% F1-score. Notably, our system set a new state-of-the-art for main role prediction on Hindi news, achieving 78.48 % accuracy - outperforming the next best model at 76.90%, as per the official leaderboard. Our findings highlight effective strategies for entity framing in multilingual and low-resource settings.
abstract_zh: 我们描述了关于印地语新闻中粗粒度实体框架的 SemEval-2025 任务 10 子任务 1 的系统，探索了两种互补策略。首先，我们使用 GPT-4o 进行 LLM 提示实验，将分层多步提示与本机单步提示进行主要和细粒度角色预测进行比较。其次，我们对 XLM-R 的微调进行了广泛的研究，分析了不同的上下文粒度（整篇文章、段落或句子级实体提及）、单语言与多语言设置以及主要与细粒度角色标签。我们最好的系统使用句子级上下文对跨语言的细粒度角色注释进行了训练，实现了 43.99% 的精确匹配率、56.56% 的精确度、47.38% 的召回率和 51.57% 的 F1 分数。值得注意的是，我们的系统为印地语新闻的主要角色预测设定了新的最先进水平，达到了 78.48% 的准确率，根据官方排行榜，其表现优于第二佳模型的 76.90%。我们的研究结果强调了多语言和资源匮乏环境中实体框架的有效策略。

title: madhans476 atSemEval-2025 Task 9: Multi-Model Ensemble and Prompt-Based Learning for Food Hazard Prediction
abstract_en: This paper presents a hybrid approach to food hazard detection for SemEval-2025 Task 9, combining traditional machine learning with advanced language models. For hazard classification (Sub-Task 1), we implemented a novel ensemble system integrating XGBoost with fine-tuned GPT-2 Large and LLaMA 3.1 1B models. For vector detection (Sub-Task 2), we employed a prompt-engineered approach using Flan-T5-XL, highlighting challenges in exact vector matching. Our analysis demonstrates the effectiveness of combining complementary models while revealing opportunities for improvement in rare category detection and extraction precision.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种针对 SemEval-2025 任务 9 的食品危害检测混合方法，将传统机器学习与高级语言模型相结合。对于危险分类（子任务 1），我们实现了一种新颖的集成系统，将 XGBoost 与微调的 GPT-2 Large 和 LLaMA 3.1 1B 模型集成。对于矢量检测（子任务 2），我们采用了使用 Flan-T5-XL 的即时工程方法，突出了精确矢量匹配方面的挑战。我们的分析证明了组合互补模型的有效性，同时揭示了改进稀有类别检测和提取精度的机会。

title: LATE-GIL-nlp atSemeval-2025 Task 10: ExploringLLMs and transformers for Characterization and extraction of narratives from online news
abstract_en: This paper tackles SemEval~2025 Task~10, “Multilingual Characterization and Extraction of Narratives from Online News,” focusing on the Ukraine-Russia War and Climate Change domains. Our approach covers three subtasks: (1) {textbf{Entity Framing}}, assigning protagonist-antagonist-innocent roles with a prompt-based Llama~3.1~(8B) method; (2) {textbf{Narrative Classification}}, a multi-label classification using XLM-RoBERTa-base; and (3) {textbf{Narrative Extraction}}, generating concise, text-grounded explanations via FLAN-T5. Results show a unified multilingual transformer pipeline, combined with targeted preprocessing and fine-tuning, achieves substantial gains over baselines while effectively capturing complex narrative structures despite data imbalance and varied label distributions.
abstract_zh: 本文解决了 SemEval~2025 任务~10，“在线新闻中的多语言特征描述和叙述提取”，重点关注乌克兰-俄罗斯战争和气候变化领域。我们的方法涵盖三个子任务：（1）{textbf{Entity Framing}}，使用基于提示的 Llama~3.1~(8B) 方法分配主角-对手-无辜角色； (2) {textbf{Narrative Classification}}，使用 XLM-RoBERTa-base 的多标签分类； (3) {textbf{叙事提取}}，通过 FLAN-T5 生成简洁的、基于文本的解释。结果显示，统一的多语言转换器管道与有针对性的预处理和微调相结合，在数据不平衡和标签分布不同的情况下，在基线上取得了显着的进步，同时有效地捕获了复杂的叙述结构。

title: MSAatSemEval-2025 Task 3: High Quality Weak Labeling andLLMEnsemble Verification for Multilingual Hallucination Detection
abstract_en: This paper describes our submission for SemEval-2025 Task 3: Mu-SHROOM, the Multilingual Shared-task on Hallucinations and Related Observable Overgeneration Mistakes. The task involves detecting hallucinated spans in text generated by instruction-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) across multiple languages. Our approach combines task-specific prompt engineering with an LLM ensemble verification mechanism, where a primary model extracts hallucination spans and three independent LLMs adjudicate their validity through probability-based voting. This framework simulates the human annotation workflow used in the shared task validation and test data. Additionally, a fuzzy matching algorithm is utilized to improve span alignment. Our system ranked 1st in Arabic and Basque, 2nd in German, Swedish, and Finnish, and 3rd in Czech, Farsi, and French.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们提交的 SemEval-2025 任务 3：Mu-SHROOM，关于幻觉和相关可观察到的过度生成错误的多语言共享任务。该任务涉及检测跨多种语言的指令调整大型语言模型 (LLM) 生成的文本中的幻觉跨度。我们的方法将特定于任务的提示工程与大语言模型集成验证机制相结合，其中一个主要模型提取幻觉跨度，三个独立的大语言模型通过基于概率的投票来裁决其有效性。该框架模拟共享任务验证和测试数据中使用的人工注释工作流程。此外，还利用模糊匹配算法来改进跨度对齐。我们的系统在阿拉伯语和巴斯克语中排名第一，在德语、瑞典语和芬兰语中排名第二，在捷克语、波斯语和法语中排名第三。

title: SRCBatSemEval-2025 Task 9:LLMFinetuning Approach based on External Attention Mechanism in The Food Hazard Detection
abstract_en: This paper reports on the performance of SRCB’s system in SemEval-2025 Task 9: The Food Hazard Detection Challenge. We develop a system in the form of a pipeline consisting of two parts: 1. Candidate Recall Module, which selects the most probable correct labels from a large number of labels based on BERT model; 2. LLM Prediction Module, which is used to generate the final prediction based on Large Language Models(LLM). Additionally, to address the issue of long prompts caused by an excessive number of labels, we propose a model architecture to reduce resource consumption and improve performance. Our submission achieves the macro-F1 score of 80.39 on Sub-Task 1 and the macro-F1 score of 54.73 on Sub-Task 2. Our system is released at https://github.com/Doraxgui/Document_Attention
abstract_zh: 本文报告了 SRCB 系统在 SemEval-2025 任务 9：食品危害检测挑战中的表现。我们开发了一个管道形式的系统，由两部分组成：1.候选召回模块，它基于BERT模型从大量标签中选择最可能的正确标签； 2. LLM预测模块，用于基于大型语言模型（LLM）生成最终预测。此外，为了解决标签过多导致提示过长的问题，我们提出了一种模型架构来减少资源消耗并提高性能。我们提交的子任务 1 的宏观 F1 得分为 80.39，子任务 2 的宏观 F1 得分为 54.73。我们的系统发布于 https://github.com/Doraxgui/Document_Attention

title: DNB-AI-Project atSemEval-2025 Task 5: AnLLM-Ensemble Approach for Automated Subject Indexing
abstract_en: This paper presents our system developed for the SemEval-2025 Task 5: LLMs4Subjects: LLM-based Automated Subject Tagging for a National Technical Library’s Open-Access Catalog.Our system relies on prompting a selection of LLMs with varying examples of intellectually annotated records and asking the LLMs to similarly suggest keywords for new records. This few-shot prompting technique is combined with a series of post-processing steps that map the generated keywords to the target vocabulary, aggregate the resulting subject terms to an ensemble vote and, finally, rank them as to their relevance to the record.Our system is fourth in the quantitative ranking in the all-subjects track, but achieves the best result in the qualitative ranking conducted by subject indexing experts.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们为 SemEval-2025 任务 5 开发的系统：LLMs4Subjects：为国家技术图书馆的开放获取目录提供基于 LLM 的自动主题标记。我们的系统依赖于提示大语言模型选择不同的智能注释记录示例，并要求大语言模型类似地建议新记录的关键字。这种少量提示技术与一系列后处理步骤相结合，将生成的关键词映射到目标词汇，将生成的主题词聚合为整体投票，最后根据它们与记录的相关性对它们进行排名。我们的系统在所有主题跟踪的定量排名中排名第四，但在主题索引专家进行的定性排名中取得了最好的结果。

title: HowardUniversity-AI4PCatSemEval-2025 Task 10: EnsemblingLLMs for Multi-lingual Multi-Label and Multi-Class Meta-Classification
abstract_en: This paper describes our approach and submission to the SemEval 2025 shared task on “Multilingual Characterization and Extraction of Narratives from Online News”. The purpose of this task was to assign primary and fine-grained roles to named entities in news articles from five different languages, on the topics of Climate Change and Ukraine-Russia War. In this paper, we explain how we approached the task by utilizing multiple LLMs via Prompt Engineering and combining their results into a final task result through an ensemble meta-classification technique. Our experimental results demonstrate that this integrated approach outperforms the provided baseline in detecting bias, deception, and manipulation in news media across multiple languages.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了我们对 SemEval 2025 共享任务“在线新闻中的多语言表征和叙述提取”的方法和提交。这项任务的目的是为五种不同语言的新闻文章中的命名实体分配主要和细粒度的角色，主题涉及气候变化和乌克兰-俄罗斯战争。在本文中，我们解释了如何通过 Prompt Engineering 利用多个 LLM 并通过集成元分类技术将其结果组合成最终任务结果来完成该任务。我们的实验结果表明，这种集成方法在检测跨多种语言的新闻媒体中的偏见、欺骗和操纵方面优于所提供的基线。

title: Swushroomsia atSemEval-2025 Task 3: ProbingLLMs’ Collective Intelligence for Multilingual Hallucination Detection
abstract_en: This paper introduces a system designed for SemEval-2025 Task 3: Mu-SHROOM, which focuses on detecting hallucinations in multilingual outputs generated by large language models (LLMs). Our approach leverages the collective intelligence of multiple LLMs by prompting several models with three distinct prompts to annotate hallucinations. These individual annotations are then merged to create a comprehensive probabilistic annotation. The proposed system demonstrates strong performance, achieving high accuracy in span detection and strong correlation between predicted probabilities and ground truth annotations.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一个为 SemEval-2025 任务 3 设计的系统：Mu-SHROOM，该系统专注于检测大型语言模型 (LLM) 生成的多语言输出中的幻觉。我们的方法利用多个大语言模型的集体智慧，通过三个不同的提示来提示多个模型来注释幻觉。然后将这些单独的注释合并以创建全面的概率注释。所提出的系统表现出强大的性能，实现了跨度检测的高精度以及预测概率和地面实况注释之间的强相关性。

title: UCSCatSemEval-2025 Task 3: Context, Models and Prompt Optimization for Automated Hallucination Detection inLLMOutput
abstract_en: Hallucinations pose a significant challenge for large language models when answering knowledge-intensive queries. As LLMs become more widely adopted, it is crucial not only to detect if hallucinations occur but also to pinpoint where they arise. SemEval 2025 Task 3, Mu-SHROOM: Multilingual Shared-task on Hallucinations and Related Observable Overgeneration Mistakes, is a recent effort in this direction. This paper describes our solution to the shared task. We propose a framework that first retrieves relevant context, next identifies false content from the answer, and finally maps them back to spans.
