These rationales connect prior knowledge with new tasks, acting as self-distillation targets to regulate the training process. By jointly training on reference translations and self-generated rationales, the model can learn new translation skills while preserving its general abilities across other tasks. Additionally, RaDis provides a fresh perspective on using rationales in the CL field and has the potential to serve as a general continual learning method for a variety of tasks.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在众多 NLP 任务中取得了令人印象深刻的结果，并且针对机器翻译 (MT) 对它们进行微调提高了它们的性能。然而，普通的微调往往会导致灾难性的遗忘，损害大语言模型的广泛一般能力并引入潜在的安全风险。这些能力是使用专有且不可用的训练数据开发的，使得简单的数据重放方法变得无效。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种称为 **Ra**tionale **Di**tillation 的新方法。 RaDis 利用大语言模型强大的生成能力来创建训练数据的基本原理，然后“重播”这些数据以防止遗忘。这些基本原理将先验知识与新任务联系起来，作为自我蒸馏目标来规范培训过程。通过对参考翻译和自我生成的基本原理进行联合训练，该模型可以学习新的翻译技能，同时保留其在其他任务中的一般能力。此外，RaDis 提供了在 CL 领域使用基本原理的全新视角，并且有潜力作为各种任务的通用持续学习方法。

title: Spatial Coordinates as a Cell Language: A Multi-Sentence Framework for Imaging Mass Cytometry Analysis
abstract_en: Image mass cytometry (IMC) enables high-dimensional spatial profiling by combining mass cytometry’s analytical power with spatial distributions of cell phenotypes. Recent studies leverage large language models (LLMs) to extract cell states by translating gene or protein expression into biological context. However, existing single-cell LLMs face two major challenges: (1) Integration of spatial information—they struggle to generalize spatial coordinates and effectively encode spatial context as text, and (2) Treating each cell independently—they overlook cell-cell interactions, limiting their ability to capture biological relationships. To address these limitations, we propose Spatial2Sentence, a novel framework that integrates both single-cell expression and spatial information into natural language using a multi-sentence approach. Given an expression matrix and spatial coordinates, Spatial2Sentence constructs expression similarity and distance matrices, pairing spatially adjacent and expressionally similar cells as positive pairs while using distant and dissimilar cells as negatives. These multi-sentence representations are processed by LLMs, enabling them to learn cellular interactions in both expression and spatial contexts. Equipped with multi-task learning, Spatial2Sentence outperforms existing single-cell LLMs on preprocessed IMC datasets for diabetes and brain tumors, improving cell-type classification by 5.98% and clinical status prediction by 4.18% on the diabetes dataset while enhancing interpretability. The source code can be found here:https://github.com/UNITES-Lab/Spatial2Sentence.
abstract_zh: 图像质量细胞术 (IMC) 通过将质量细胞术的分析能力与细胞表型的空间分布相结合，实现高维空间分析。最近的研究利用大语言模型（LLM）通过将基因或蛋白质表达翻译成生物背景来提取细胞状态。然而，现有的单细胞大语言模型面临两个主要挑战：（1）空间信息的整合——他们努力概括空间坐标并有效地将空间上下文编码为文本；（2）独立处理每个细胞——他们忽视细胞与细胞的相互作用，限制了他们捕捉生物关系的能力。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了 Spatial2Sentence，这是一种新颖的框架，它使用多句子方法将单细胞表达和空间信息集成到自然语言中。给定表达矩阵和空间坐标，Spatial2Sentence 构建表达相似性和距离矩阵，将空间相邻且表达相似的细胞配对为正对，同时使用远处和不相似的细胞作为负对。这些多句子表示由大语言模型处理，使他们能够学习表达和空间环境中的细胞相互作用。 Spatial2Sentence 配备多任务学习功能，在糖尿病和脑肿瘤的预处理 IMC 数据集上优于现有的单细胞大语言模型，将糖尿病数据集上的细胞类型分类提高了 5.98%，将临床状态预测提高了 4.18%，同时增强了可解释性。源代码可以在这里找到：https://github.com/UNITES-Lab/Spatial2Sentence。

title: Lost in Translation: Benchmarking Commercial Machine Translation Models for Dyslexic-Style Text
abstract_en: Dyslexia can affect writing, leading to unique patterns such as letter and homophone swapping. As a result, text produced by people with dyslexia often differs from the text typically used to train natural language processing (NLP) models, raising concerns about their effectiveness for dyslexic users. This paper examines the fairness of four commercial machine translation (MT) systems towards dyslexic text through a systematic audit using both synthetically generated dyslexic text and real writing from individuals with dyslexia. By programmatically introducing various dyslexic-style errors into the WMT dataset, we present insights on how dyslexic biases manifest in MT systems as the text becomes more dyslexic, especially with real-word errors. Our results shed light on the NLP biases affecting people with dyslexia – a population that often relies on NLP tools as assistive technologies, highlighting the need for more diverse data and user representation in the development of foundational NLP models.
abstract_zh: 阅读障碍会影响写作，导致独特的模式，例如字母和同音词交换。因此，阅读障碍者生成的文本通常与通常用于训练自然语言处理 (NLP) 模型的文本不同，引发了人们对其对阅读障碍用户的有效性的担忧。本文通过使用合成生成的阅读障碍文本和阅读障碍患者的真实写作进行系统审核，检查了四种商业机器翻译 (MT) 系统对阅读障碍文本的公平性。通过以编程方式将各种诵​​读困难式错误引入 WMT 数据集中，我们深入了解当文本变得更加诵读困难时，诵读困难偏差如何在 MT 系统中表现出来，尤其是真实单词错误。我们的结果揭示了影响阅读障碍人群的 NLP 偏见——该群体经常依赖 NLP 工具作为辅助技术，强调在基础 NLP 模型的开发中需要更多样化的数据和用户表示。

title: KnowCoder-X: Boosting Multilingual Information Extraction via Code
abstract_en: Empirical evidence indicates that LLMs exhibit spontaneous cross-lingual alignment. However, although LLMs show promising cross-lingual alignment in Information Extraction (IE), a significant imbalance across languages persists, highlighting an underlying deficiency. To address this, we propose KnowCoder-X, a powerful code LLM with advanced cross-lingual and multilingual capabilities for universal IE. Firstly, it standardizes the representation of multilingual schemas using Python classes, ensuring a consistent ontology across different languages. Then, IE across languages is formulated as a unified code generation task. Secondly, we conduct IE cross-lingual alignment instruction tuning on the translated instance prediction task to enhance the model’s cross-lingual transferability. During this phase, we also construct a high-quality and diverse bilingual IE parallel dataset with 257k samples, called ParallelNER, synthesized by our proposed robust three-stage pipeline, with manual annotation to ensure quality. Although without training in 29 unseen languages, KnowCoder-X surpasses ChatGPT by 30.17% and SoTA by 20.03%, thereby demonstrating superior cross-lingual IE capabilities. Comprehensive evaluations on 64 IE benchmarks in Chinese and English under various settings demonstrate that KnowCoder-X significantly enhances cross-lingual IE transfer through boosting the IE alignment. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/ICT-GoKnow/KnowCoder.
abstract_zh: 经验证据表明大语言模型表现出自发的跨语言一致性。然而，尽管大语言模型在信息提取（IE）方面显示出有希望的跨语言一致性，但跨语言的显着不平衡仍然存在，凸显了潜在的缺陷。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 KnowCoder-X，这是一个功能强大的代码大语言模型，具有针对通用 IE 的高级跨语言和多语言功能。首先，它使用 Python 类标准化多语言模式的表示，确保不同语言之间的本体一致。然后，将跨语言的IE制定为统一的代码生成任务。其次，我们对翻译实例预测任务进行IE跨语言对齐指令调整，以增强模型的跨语言可迁移性。在此阶段，我们还构建了一个包含 257k 个样本的高质量且多样化的双语 IE 并行数据集，称为 ParallelNER，由我们提出的稳健的三阶段管道合成，并通过手动注释来确保质量。尽管没有经过 29 种未见过的语言的训练，KnowCoder-X 却超越了 ChatGPT 30.17% 和 SoTA 20.03%，从而展示了卓越的跨语言 IE 能力。对各种环境下的 64 个中英文 IE 基准的综合评估表明，KnowCoder-X 通过增强 IE 对齐，显着增强了跨语言 IE 迁移。我们的代码和数据集位于：https://github.com/ICT-GoKnow/KnowCoder。

title: PAM: ParaphraseAMR-Centric Evaluation Metric
abstract_en: Paraphrasing is rooted in semantics, which makes evaluating paraphrase generation systems hard. Current paraphrase generators are typically evaluated using borrowed metrics from adjacent text-to-text tasks, like machine translation or text summarization. These metrics tend to have ties to the surface form of the reference text. This is not ideal for paraphrases as we typically want variation in the lexicon while persisting semantics. To address this problem, and inspired by learned similarity evaluation on plain text, we propose PAM, a Paraphrase AMR-Centric Evaluation Metric. This metric uses AMR graphs extracted from the input text, which consist of semantic structures agnostic to the text surface form, making the resulting evaluation metric more robust to variations in syntax or lexicon. Additionally, we evaluated PAM on different semantic textual similarity datasets and found that it improves the correlations with human semantic scores when compared to other AMR-based metrics.
abstract_zh: 释义植根于语义，这使得评估释义生成系统变得困难。当前的释义生成器通常使用从相邻文本到文本任务（例如机器翻译或文本摘要）借用的指标进行评估。这些指标往往与参考文本的表面形式有联系。这对于释义来说并不理想，因为我们通常希望在保留语义的同时词汇有所变化。为了解决这个问题，并受到纯文本学习相似性评估的启发，我们提出了 PAM，一种以 AMR 为中心的释义评估指标。该指标使用从输入文本中提取的 AMR 图，其中包含与文本表面形式无关的语义结构，从而使生成的评估指标对语法或词汇的变化更加稳健。此外，我们在不同的语义文本相似性数据集上评估了 PAM，发现与其他基于 AMR 的指标相比，它提高了与人类语义得分的相关性。

title: Visualising Policy-Reward Interplay to Inform Zeroth-Order Preference Optimisation of Large Language Models
abstract_en: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) with first-order methods like back-propagation is computationally intensive. Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimisation uses function evaluations instead of gradients, reducing memory usage, but suffers from slow convergence in high-dimensional models. As a result, ZO research in LLMs has mostly focused on classification, overlooking more complex generative tasks. In this paper, we introduce ZOPrO, a novel ZO algorithm designed for *Preference Optimisation* in LLMs. We begin by analysing the interplay between policy and reward models during traditional (first-order) Preference Optimisation, uncovering patterns in their relative updates. Guided by these insights, we adapt Simultaneous Perturbation Stochastic Approximation (SPSA) with a targeted sampling strategy to accelerate convergence. Through experiments on summarisation, machine translation, and conversational assistants, we demonstrate that our method consistently enhances reward signals while achieving convergence times comparable to first-order methods. While it falls short of some state-of-the-art methods, our work is the first to apply Zeroth-Order methods to Preference Optimisation in LLMs, going beyond classification tasks and paving the way for a largely unexplored research direction. Code and visualisations are available at https://github.com/alessioGalatolo/VisZOPrO.
abstract_zh: 使用反向传播等一阶方法微调大型语言模型 (LLM) 需要大量计算。零阶 (ZO) 优化使用函数评估而不是梯度，减少了内存使用，但在高维模型中收敛速度较慢。因此，大语言模型的 ZO 研究主要集中在分类上，忽视了更复杂的生成任务。在本文中，我们介绍了 ZOPrO，这是一种专为大语言模型中的“偏好优化”而设计的新型 ZO 算法。我们首先分析传统（一阶）偏好优化期间政策和奖励模型之间的相互作用，揭示它们相对更新的模式。在这些见解的指导下，我们采用同步扰动随机逼近（SPSA）和有针对性的采样策略来加速收敛。通过摘要、机器翻译和会话助理的实验，我们证明了我们的方法能够持续增强奖励信号，同时实现与一阶方法相当的收敛时间。虽然它缺乏一些最先进的方法，但我们的工作是第一个将零阶方法应用于大语言模型的偏好优化，超越了分类任务，并为很大程度上未经探索的研究方向铺平了道路。代码和可视化可在 https://github.com/alessioGalatolo/VisZOPrO 获取。

title: AskQE: Question Answering as Automatic Evaluation for Machine Translation
abstract_en: How can a monolingual English speaker determine whether an automatic translation in French is good enough to be shared? Existing MT error detection and quality estimation (QE) techniques do not address this practical scenario. We introduce AskQE, a question generation and answering framework designed to detect critical MT errors and provide actionable feedback, helping users decide whether to accept or reject MT outputs even without the knowledge of the target language. Using ContraTICO, a dataset of contrastive synthetic MT errors in the COVID-19 domain, we explore design choices for AskQE and develop an optimized version relying on LLaMA-3 70B and entailed facts to guide question generation. We evaluate the resulting system on the BioMQM dataset of naturally occurring MT errors, where AskQE has higher Kendall’s Tau correlation and decision accuracy with human ratings compared to other QE metrics.
abstract_zh: 只会说英语的人如何确定法语自动翻译是否足以共享？现有的 MT 错误检测和质量估计 (QE) 技术无法解决这一实际场景。我们推出了 AskQE，这是一个问题生成和回答框架，旨在检测关键的 MT 错误并提供可操作的反馈，帮助用户即使在不了解目标语言的情况下也决定是否接受或拒绝 MT 输出。使用 ContraTICO（COVID-19 领域中对比合成 MT 错误的数据集），我们探索 AskQE 的设计选择，并开发一个依赖于 LLaMA-3 70B 的优化版本，并包含事实来指导问题生成。我们在自然发生的 MT 错误的 BioMQM 数据集上评估生成的系统，其中与其他 QE 指标相比，AskQE 具有更高的 Kendall Tau 相关性和与人类评分的决策准确性。

title: Each graph is a new language: Graph Learning withLLMs
abstract_en: Natural language has been extensively used for modeling text-attributed graphs with LLMs. Natural language is used to describe the graph for LLMs to understand or serve as component of the graph, e.g., textual attributes for embedding generation. However, natural language is inherently redundant and unstructured, making it unsuitable for modeling high-order neighbors with LLMs. Specifically, (i) graph descriptions become verbose, overwhelming LLMs, and (ii) only relying on attribute embeddings limits LLM’s ability to capture the adequate graph structural information. These limitations make it difficult to model graphs both concisely and adequately using sole natural language with LLMs.Inspired by the observation that LLMs pre-trained on one language can achieve exceptional performance on another with minimal additional training, we propose Graph-Defined Language for Large Language Model (GDL4LLM). This novel framework enables LLMs to transfer their powerful language understanding capabilities to graph-structured data. GDL4LLM translates the graph into a graph language corpus instead of graph descriptions and pre-trains LLMs on this corpus to adequately understand the graph. This corpus represents the subgraph centered around target nodes concisely with only a few tokens during fine-tuning on downstream tasks. By treating the graph as a new language, GDL4LLM enables LLMs to model text-attributed graph adequately and concisely. Extensive experiments on five datasets demonstrate that GDL4LLM outperforms description-based and embedding-based baselines by efficiently modeling different orders of neighbors.
abstract_zh: 自然语言已广泛用于大语言模型对文本属性图进行建模。自然语言用于描述图，供大语言模型理解或充当图的组成部分，例如用于嵌入生成的文本属性。然而，自然语言本质上是冗余和非结构化的，这使得它不适合用大语言模型来建模高阶邻居。具体来说，（i）图描述变得冗长，令大语言模型难以承受，（ii）仅依赖属性嵌入限制了大语言模型捕获足够的图结构信息的能力。这些限制使得使用 LLM 的单一自然语言来简洁且充分地对图进行建模变得困难。 受观察到，在一种语言上预训练的 LLM 可以通过最少的额外训练在另一种语言上实现优异的性能，我们提出了大型语言模型的图定义语言（GDL4LLM）。这种新颖的框架使大语言模型能够将其强大的语言理解能力转移到图结构数据上。 GDL4LLM 将图转换为图语言语料库，而不是图描述，并在此语料库上预训练 LLM 以充分理解图。该语料库简明地表示了以目标节点为中心的子图，在下游任务的微调过程中仅使用几个标记。通过将图视为一种新语言，GDL4LLM 使大语言模型能够充分、简洁地对文本属性图进行建模。对五个数据集的大量实验表明，GDL4LLM 通过有效地建模不同顺序的邻居，优于基于描述和基于嵌入的基线。

title: Sign2Vis: Automated Data Visualization from Sign Language
abstract_en: Data visualizations, such as bar charts and histograms, are essential for analyzing and exploring data, enabling the effective communication of insights. While existing methods have been proposed to translate natural language descriptions into visualization queries, they focus solely on spoken languages, overlooking sign languages, which comprise about 200 variants used by 70 million Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (DHH) individuals. To fill this gap, this paper proposes Sign2Vis, a sign language interface that enables the DHH community to engage more fully with data analysis. We first construct a paired dataset that includes sign language pose videos and their corresponding visualization queries. Using this dataset, we evaluate a variety of models, including both pipeline-based and end-to-end approaches. Extensive experiments, along with a user study involving 15 participants, demonstrate the effectiveness of Sign2Vis. Finally, we share key insights from our evaluation and highlight the need for more accessible and user-centered tools to support the DHH community in interactive data analytics.
abstract_zh: 数据可视化（例如条形图和直方图）对于分析和探索数据、实现见解的有效交流至关重要。虽然现有方法已被提出将自然语言描述翻译成可视化查询，但它们仅关注口语，而忽略了手语，手语由 7000 万聋人和听力障碍 (DHH) 人士使用的约 200 种变体组成。为了填补这一空白，本文提出了 Sign2Vis，这是一种手语界面，使 DHH 社区能够更充分地参与数据分析。我们首先构建一个配对数据集，其中包括手语姿势视频及其相应的可视化查询。使用该数据集，我们评估了各种模型，包括基于管道的方法和端到端方法。广泛的实验以及涉及 15 名参与者的用户研究证明了 Sign2Vis 的有效性。最后，我们分享了评估中的重要见解，并强调需要更易于访问且以用户为中心的工具来支持 DHH 社区的交互式数据分析。

title: The Devil Is in the Word Alignment Details: On Translation-Based Cross-Lingual Transfer for Token Classification Tasks
abstract_en: Translation-based strategies for cross-lingual transfer XLT such as translate-train—training on noisy target language data translated from the source language—and translate-test—evaluating on noisy source language data translated from the target language—are competitive XLT baselines. In XLT for token classification tasks, however, these strategies include label projection, the challenging step of mapping the labels from each token in the original sentence to its counterpart(s) in the translation. Although word aligners (WAs) are commonly used for label projection, the low-level design decisions for applying them to translation-based XLT have not been systematically investigated. Moreover, recent marker-based methods, which project labeled spans by inserting tags around them before (or after) translation, claim to outperform WAs in label projection for XLT. In this work, we revisit WAs for label projection, systematically investigating the effects of low-level design decisions on token-level XLT: (i) the algorithm for projecting labels between (multi-)token spans, (ii) filtering strategies to reduce the number of noisily mapped labels, and (iii) the pre-tokenization of the translated sentences. We find that all of these substantially impact translation-based XLT performance and show that, with optimized choices, XLT with WA offers performance at least comparable to that of marker-based methods. We then introduce a new projection strategy that ensembles translate-train and translate-test predictions and demonstrate that it substantially outperforms the marker-based projection. Crucially, we show that our proposed ensembling also reduces sensitivity to low-level WA design choices, resulting in more robust XLT for token classification tasks.
abstract_zh: 基于翻译的跨语言迁移 XLT 策略，例如翻译训练（对从源语言翻译而来的噪声目标语言数据进行训练）和翻译测试（对从目标语言翻译而来的噪声源语言数据进行评估）是有竞争力的 XLT 基线。然而，在用于标记分类任务的 XLT 中，这些策略包括标签投影，这是将原始句子中每个标记的标签映射到翻译中对应标记的具有挑战性的步骤。尽管字对齐器 (WA) 通常用于标签投影，但将其应用于基于翻译的 XLT 的低级设计决策尚未得到系统研究。此外，最近基于标记的方法通过在翻译之前（或之后）在标记范围周围插入标签来投影标记范围，声称在 XLT 的标签投影方面优于 WA。在这项工作中，我们重新审视标签投影的 WA，系统地研究低级设计决策对标记级 XLT 的影响：(i) 在（多）标记跨度之间投影标签的算法，(ii) 减少噪声映射标签数量的过滤策略，以及 (iii) 翻译句子的预标记化。我们发现所有这些都会极大地影响基于翻译的 XLT 性能，并表明，通过优化选择，带有 WA 的 XLT 提供的性能至少可与基于标记的方法相媲美。然后，我们引入了一种新的投影策略，该策略集成了翻译训练和翻译测试预测，并证明它大大优于基于标记的投影。至关重要的是，我们表明我们提出的集成还降低了对低级 WA 设计选择的敏感性，从而为令牌分类任务带来更稳健的 XLT。

title: Smotrom tvoja på ander drogoj verden! Resurrecting Dead Pidgin with Generative Models: Russenorsk Case Study
abstract_en: Russenorsk, a pidgin language historically used in trade interactions between Russian and Norwegian speakers, represents a unique linguistic phenomenon. In this paper, we attempt to analyze its lexicon using modern large language models (LLMs), based on surviving literary sources. We construct a structured dictionary of the language, grouped by synonyms and word origins. Subsequently, we use this dictionary to formulate hypotheses about the core principles of word formation and grammatical structure in Russenorsk and show which hypotheses generated by large language models correspond to the hypotheses previously proposed ones in the academic literature. We also develop a “reconstruction” translation agent that generates hypothetical Russenorsk renderings of contemporary Russian and Norwegian texts.
abstract_zh: 俄罗斯诺斯克语是一种洋泾浜语言，历史上用于俄语和挪威语之间的贸易互动，代表了一种独特的语言现象。在本文中，我们尝试使用基于现存文学资料的现代大语言模型（LLM）来分析其词典。我们构建了该语言的结构化词典，按同义词和词源分组。随后，我们使用这本词典制定有关俄罗斯语构词和语法结构的核心原理的假设，并展示大型语言模型生成的哪些假设与学术文献中先前提出的假设相对应。我们还开发了一种“重建”翻译代理，可以生成当代俄罗斯和挪威文本的假设俄罗斯翻译。

title: Asymmetric Conflict and Synergy in Post-training forLLM-based Multilingual Machine Translation
abstract_en: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) has advanced the multilingual machine translation (MMT), yet the Curse of Multilinguality (CoM) remains a major challenge. Existing work in LLM-based MMT typically mitigates this issue via scaling up training and computation budget, which raises a critical question: Is scaling up the training and computation budget truly necessary for high-quality MMT, or can a deeper understanding of CoM provide a more efficient solution? To explore this problem, we analyze the linguistic conflicts and synergy, the underlying mechanism of CoM during post-training phase. We identify an asymmetric phenomenon in linguistic conflicts and synergy: the dominance of conflicts and synergy varies in different translation directions, leading to sub-optimal adaptation in existing post-training methods. We further find that a significant bottleneck in MMT appears to lie in post-training rather than multilingual pre-training, suggesting the need for more effective adaptation strategies. Building on these new insights, we propose a direction-aware training approach, combined with group-wise model merging, to address asymmetry in linguistic conflicts and synergy explicitly. Leveraging this strategy, our method fine-tunes X-ALMA-13B-Pretrain—trained only with multilingual pre-training—achieving comparable performance to XALMA-13B (only SFT) while using only 20B pretraining tokens and 17B parameters—5.5× fewer pretraining-tokens and 1.7x fewer model size—with just 0.85 COMET drop on Flores-200 testsets of 50 languages.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的出现推动了多语言机器翻译（MMT）的发展，但多语言诅咒（CoM）仍然是一个重大挑战。基于 LLM 的 MMT 的现有工作通常通过扩大训练和计算预算来缓解这个问题，这提出了一个关键问题：扩大训练和计算预算对于高质量 MMT 真的有必要吗？或者对 CoM 的更深入理解可以提供更有效的解决方案吗？为了探讨这个问题，我们分析了训练后阶段 CoM 的潜在机制——语言冲突和协同。我们发现了语言冲突和协同作用中的不对称现象：冲突和协同作用的主导地位在不同的翻译方向上有所不同，导致现有的后训练方法的适应次佳。我们进一步发现，MMT 的一个重要瓶颈似乎在于训练后而不是多语言预训练，这表明需要更有效的适应策略。基于这些新见解，我们提出了一种方向感知训练方法，与分组模型合并相结合，以明确解决语言冲突和协同作用中的不对称问题。利用这一策略，我们的方法对 X-ALMA-13B-Pretrain 进行了微调（仅使用多语言预训练进行训练），仅使用 20B 预训练标记和 17B 参数，即可实现与 XALMA-13B（仅 SFT）相当的性能（预训练标记减少 5.5 倍，模型大小减少 1.7 倍），在包含 50 个样本的 Flores-200 测试集上，COMET 下降仅为 0.85语言。

title: MiniKV: Pushing the Limits of 2-BitKVCache via Compression and System Co-Design for Efficient Long Context Inference
abstract_en: State-of-the-art 2-bit KV cache quantization techniques achieve excellent results in accelerating LLM inference while retaining accuracy on long context tasks. However, further pushing the compression ratio fails to deliver performance gains. In this work, we revisit these approaches by considering, additionally, adaptive KV methods that retain LLM accuracy with only a subset of KV states. This leads us to propose a method based on 2-bit KV cache quantization with adaptive KV policies. In addition, we take an algorithm and system co-design approach by developing hardware-friendly kernels to accelerate LLM inference while making MiniKV compatible with existing memory-efficient attention techniques such as FlashAttention, effectively translating algorithmic improvements into system performance gains. Experiments on a wide range of long context tasks show that MiniKV effectively achieves >80% KV cache compression while retaining accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art methods while achieving excellent latency, throughput, and memory consumption improvements in long context inference.
abstract_zh: 最先进的 2 位 KV 缓存量化技术在加速 LLM 推理方面取得了优异的结果，同时保持了长上下文任务的准确性。然而，进一步提高压缩比并不能带来性能提升。在这项工作中，我们通过另外考虑自适应 KV 方法来重新审视这些方法，该方法仅使用 KV 状态的子集保留 LLM 精度。这促使我们提出一种基于 2 位 KV 缓存量化和自适应 KV 策略的方法。此外，我们采用算法和系统协同设计的方法，通过开发硬件友好的内核来加速 LLM 推理，同时使 MiniKV 与 FlashAttention 等现有的内存高效注意力技术兼容，有效地将算法改进转化为系统性能增益。对各种长上下文任务的实验表明，MiniKV 在保持准确性的同时有效实现了 >80% 的 KV 缓存压缩，超越了最先进的方法，同时在长上下文推理中实现了出色的延迟、吞吐量和内存消耗改进。

title: Training BilingualLMs with Data Constraints in the Targeted Language
abstract_en: Large language models are trained on massive scrapes of the web, as required by current scaling laws. Most progress is made for English, given its abundance of high-quality pretraining data. For most other languages, however, such high quality pretraining data is unavailable. In this work, we study how to boost pretrained model performance in a target language with insufficient pretraining data for training a high performing language model by enlisting data from an auxiliary language for which high quality data is available. We study this by quantifying the performance gap between training with data in a data-rich auxiliary language compared with training in the target language, exploring the benefits of translation systems, studying the limitations of model scaling when data is limited in the target languages, and proposing new methods for upsampling data from the auxiliary language. Our results show that stronger auxiliary datasets result in performance gains without modification to the model or training objective for close languages, and, in particular, that performance gains due to the development of more information-rich English pretraining datasets can extend to targeted language settings with limited data.
abstract_zh: 根据当前缩放法则的要求，大型语言模型是在大量网络数据上进行训练的。鉴于英语拥有丰富的高质量预训练数据，取得了最大的进步。然而，对于大多数其他语言来说，无法获得如此高质量的预训练数据。在这项工作中，我们研究了如何通过从可获得高质量数据的辅助语言中获取数据来提高预训练数据不足的目标语言的预训练模型性能，以训练高性能语言模型。我们通过量化数据丰富的辅助语言中的数据训练与目标语言中的训练之间的性能差距来研究这一问题，探索翻译系统的好处，研究目标语言中数据有限时模型扩展的局限性，并提出从辅助语言中对数据进行上采样的新方法。我们的结果表明，更强大的辅助数据集可以在不修改模型或接近语言的训练目标的情况下带来性能提升，特别是，由于开发信息更丰富的英语预训练数据集而带来的性能提升可以扩展到数据有限的目标语言设置。

title: UnrealLLM: Towards Highly Controllable and Interactable 3DScene Generation byLLM-powered Procedural Content Generation
abstract_en: The creation of high-quality 3D scenes is essential for applications like video games and simulations, yet automating this process while retaining the benefits of Procedural Content Generation (PCG) remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce UnrealLLM, a novel multi-agent framework that connects natural language descriptions with the professional PCG system (Unreal Engine 5) to automate scene generation. UnrealLLM constructs a comprehensive knowledge base to translate text into executable PCG blueprints and a diverse asset library that guarantees high-quality scene generation. Additionally, it also introduces a text-based blueprint system with a spline-based control mechanism for geometric arrangement, enabling natural language interaction and enhancing interactivity in 3D environments using UE5’s advanced capabilities. Through extensive experiments, we show that UnrealLLM achieves competitive performance in technical metrics and aesthetic quality, offering unique advantages in generation scale and interactivity. This work makes a valuable contribution to automated 3D content creation, benefiting both novice users and professional designers.
abstract_zh: 创建高质量 3D 场景对于视频游戏和模拟等应用至关重要，但在保留程序内容生成 (PCG) 优势的同时实现此过程自动化仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们介绍了UnrealLLM，这是一种新颖的多智能体框架，它将自然语言描述与专业的PCG系统（虚幻引擎5）连接起来以自动生成场景。 UnrealLLM构建了一个全面的知识库，可将文本转换为可执行的PCG蓝图，以及保证高质量场景生成的多样化资源库。此外，它还引入了基于文本的蓝图系统，具有基于样条线的几何排列控制机制，支持自然语言交互，并利用 UE5 的高级功能增强 3D 环境中的交互性。通过大量的实验，我们表明UnrealLLM在技术指标和美学质量方面取得了具有竞争力的表现，在生成规模和交互性方面具有独特的优势。这项工作为自动化 3D 内容创建做出了宝贵的贡献，使新手用户和专业设计师都受益。

title: InImageTrans: MultimodalLLM-based Text Image Machine Translation
abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across various downstream tasks. However, when MLLMs are transferred to the text image machine translation (TiMT) task, preliminary experiments reveal that MLLMs suffer from serious repetition and omission hallucinations. To alleviate these issues, this paper first designs an efficient MLLM named InImageTrans for TiMT and then proposes a simple and effective method named multi-conditional direct preference optimization (mcDPO) for advancing the TiMT. Particularly, the proposed mcDPO not only guides the MLLM in rejecting repetition output by creating text output preference pairs automatically, but also guides the MLLM in paying more attention to text information in images by creating image input preference pairs. Furthermore, we build a high-quality benchmark called MCiT for comprehensively evaluating the TiMT capabilities of InImageTrans. Experimental results show that the proposed method significantly outperforms existing open-source MLLMs on MCiT.
abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在各种下游任务中表现出了卓越的能力。然而，当MLLM转移到文本图像机器翻译（TiMT）任务时，初步实验表明MLLM会出现严重的重复和遗漏幻觉。为了缓解这些问题，本文首先为 TiMT 设计了一种名为 InImageTrans 的高效 MLLM，然后提出了一种简单有效的方法，名为多条件直接偏好优化（mcDPO）来推进 TiMT。特别是，所提出的 mcDPO 不仅通过自动创建文本输出偏好对来指导 MLLM 拒绝重复输出，而且还通过创建图像输入偏好对来指导 MLLM 更多地关注图像中的文本信息。此外，我们还构建了一个名为 MCiT 的高质量基准，用于全面评估 InImageTrans 的 TiMT 能力。实验结果表明，所提出的方法明显优于 MCiT 上现有的开源 MLLM。

title: LLMs Can Achieve High-quality Simultaneous Machine Translation as Efficiently as Offline
abstract_en: When the complete source sentence is provided, Large Language Models (LLMs) perform excellently in offline machine translation even with a simple prompt “Translate the following sentence from [src lang] into [tgt lang]:”. However, in many real scenarios, the source tokens arrive in a streaming manner and simultaneous machine translation (SiMT) is required, then the efficiency and performance of decoder-only LLMs are significantly limited by their auto-regressive nature. To enable LLMs to achieve high-quality SiMT as efficiently as offline translation, we propose a novel paradigm that includes constructing supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data for SiMT, along with new training and inference strategies. To replicate the token input/output stream in SiMT, the source and target tokens are rearranged into an interleaved sequence, separated by special tokens according to varying latency requirements. This enables powerful LLMs to learn read and write operations adaptively, based on varying latency prompts, while still maintaining efficient auto-regressive decoding. Experimental results show that, even with limited SFT data, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance across various SiMT benchmarks and different evaluation metrics, and preserves the original capabilities of offline translation. Moreover, our approach generalizes well to document-level SiMT setting without requiring specific fine-tuning, even beyond the offline translation model.
abstract_zh: 当提供完整的源句子时，即使有简单的提示“将以下句子从 [src lang] 翻译成 [tgt lang]：”，大型语言模型 (LLM) 在离线机器翻译中也能表现出色。然而，在许多实际场景中，源令牌以流式方式到达并且需要同步机器翻译（SiMT），那么仅解码器的LLM的效率和性能受到其自回归性质的显着限制。为了使大语言模型能够像离线翻译一样高效地实现高质量的 SiMT，我们提出了一种新颖的范式，其中包括为 SiMT 构建监督微调（SFT）数据，以及新的训练和推理策略。为了在 SiMT 中复制令牌输入/输出流，源令牌和目标令牌被重新排列成交错序列，并根据不同的延迟要求由特殊令牌分隔。这使得强大的大语言模型能够根据不同的延迟提示自适应地学习读写操作，同时仍然保持高效的自回归解码。实验结果表明，即使使用有限的 SFT 数据，我们的方法也能在各种 SiMT 基准和不同的评估指标上实现最先进的性能，并保留离线翻译的原始功能。此外，我们的方法可以很好地推广到文档级 SiMT 设置，无需特定的微调，甚至超越离线翻译模型。

title: Generative Error Correction for Emotion-aware Speech-to-text Translation
abstract_en: This paper explores emotion-aware speech-to-text translation (ST) using generative error correction (GER) by large language models (LLMs). Despite recent advancements in ST, the impact of the emotional content has been overlooked. First, we enhance the translation of emotional speech by adopting the GER paradigm: Finetuned an LLM to generate the translation based on the decoded N-best hypotheses. Moreover, we combine the emotion and sentiment labels into the LLM finetuning process to enable the model to consider the emotion content. In addition, we project the ST model’s latent representation into the LLM embedding space to further improve emotion recognition and translation. Experiments on an English-Chinese dataset show the effectiveness of the combination of GER, emotion and sentiment labels, and the projector for emotion-aware ST. Our code is available at https://github.com/N-Orien/EmoST.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了大型语言模型 (LLM) 使用生成纠错 (GER) 的情感感知语音到文本翻译 (ST)。尽管最近 ST 取得了进展，但情感内容的影响却被忽视了。首先，我们通过采用 GER 范例来增强情感语音的翻译：微调 LLM 以根据解码的 N 最佳假设生成翻译。此外，我们将情感和情感标签结合到LLM微调过程中，使模型能够考虑情感内容。此外，我们将 ST 模型的潜在表示投影到 LLM 嵌入空间中，以进一步提高情感识别和翻译。在英汉数据集上的实验表明了 GER、情感和情感标签相结合以及情感感知 ST 投影仪的有效性。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/N-Orien/EmoST 获取。

title: Matina: A Culturally-AlignedPersian Language Model Using MultipleLoRAExperts
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are powerful tools for a variety of applications, but to interact effectively with users, they must align with the cultural values and linguistic nuances of their audience. However, existing LLMs often fall short in adequately modeling underrepresented languages and cultures, such as Persian, limiting their applicability and acceptance. To address this, we construct diverse, high-quality datasets specifically tailored to Persian linguistic and cultural contexts, ensuring a more authentic and context-aware training process. Using these datasets, we develop Matina, a Persian-focused multi-expert model designed to embody Iranian cultural values and linguistic structures. Matina is trained by fine-tuning LLaMA3.1 8B-Instruct models across five domains: culinary, tourism, socio-culture, translation, and summarization. These experts are combined using a classifier to create a unified multi-expert system. By leveraging culturally aligned datasets, Matina outperforms baseline models in both task performance and user satisfaction, demonstrating the importance of data-driven cultural adaptation in LLM development.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 是适用于各种应用的强大工具，但为了与用户有效交互，它们必须符合受众的文化价值观和语言细微差别。然而，现有的大语言模型往往无法充分模拟波斯语等代表性不足的语言和文化，从而限制了其适用性和接受度。为了解决这个问题，我们构建了专门针对波斯语言和文化背景的多样化、高质量数据集，以确保更加真实和情境感知的培训过程。使用这些数据集，我们开发了 Matina，这是一个以波斯语为中心的多专家模型，旨在体现伊朗文化价值观和语言结构。 Matina 通过微调 LLaMA3.1 8B-Instruct 模型进行训练，涉及五个领域：烹饪、旅游、社会文化、翻译和摘要。使用分类器将这些专家组合起来，创建一个统一的多专家系统。通过利用文化一致的数据集，Matina 在任务绩效和用户满意度方面均优于基线模型，证明了数据驱动的文化适应在大语言模型开发中的重要性。

title: Modal Dependency Parsing via Biaffine Attention with Self-Loop
abstract_en: A modal dependency structure represents a web of connections between events and sources of information in a document that allows for tracing of who-said-what with what levels of certainty, thereby establishing factuality in an event-centric approach. Obtaining such graphs defines the task of modal dependency parsing, which involves event and source identification along with the modal relations between them. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective solution based on biaffine attention that specifically optimizes against the domain-specific challenges of modal dependency parsing by integrating self-loop. We show that our approach, when coupled with data augmentation by leveraging the Large Language Models to translate annotations from one language to another, outperforms the previous state-of-the-art on English and Chinese datasets by 2% and 4% respectively.
abstract_zh: 模态依赖结构表示文档中的事件和信息源之间的连接网络，允许以何种程度的确定性追踪谁说了什么，从而在以事件为中心的方法中建立事实性。获取此类图定义了模态依赖解析的任务，其中涉及事件和源识别以及它们之间的模态关系。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于双仿射注意力的简单而有效的解决方案，该解决方案通过集成自循环专门针对模态依赖解析的特定领域挑战进行优化。我们表明，我们的方法与利用大型语言模型将注释从一种语言翻译成另一种语言的数据增强相结合，在英语和中文数据集上的性能分别比之前最先进的方法高出 2% 和 4%。

title: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Cross-Lingual Stance Detection Using Chain-of-Thought Alignment
abstract_en: Cross-lingual stance detection identifies users’ attitudes toward specific targets in texts by transferring knowledge from source languages to target languages. Previous studies have typically facilitated this transfer by translating and aligning labels or targets. However, these methods cannot effectively perform cross-lingual transfer of the complex reasoning processes in stance detection. To address this challenge, we propose a reinforcement learning framework using cross-lingual Chain-of-Thought (CoT) alignment, referred to as RCCA. Specifically, we adopt a cross-lingual CoT alignment strategy to obtain the high-quality CoTs generated from target language inputs. After that, we leverage reinforcement learning by sampling CoTs and assigning rewards according to predefined rules, aiming to enhance the model’s generalization capabilities in the target language. Experimental results on four multilingual datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms competitive methods.
abstract_zh: 跨语言立场检测通过将知识从源语言转移到目标语言来识别用户对文本中特定目标的态度。以前的研究通常通过翻译和对齐标签或目标来促进这种转移。然而，这些方法无法有效地执行姿态检测中复杂推理过程的跨语言迁移。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种使用跨语言思维链（CoT）对齐的强化学习框架，称为 RCCA。具体来说，我们采用跨语言 CoT 对齐策略来获得从目标语言输入生成的高质量 CoT。之后，我们通过对 CoT 进行采样并根据预定义规则分配奖励来利用强化学习，旨在增强模型在目标语言中的泛化能力。四个多语言数据集的实验结果表明，我们的方法优于竞争方法。

title: The Structural Safety Generalization Problem
abstract_en: LLM jailbreaks are a widespread safety challenge. Given this problem has not yet been tractable, we suggest targeting a key failure mechanism: the failure of safety to generalize across semantically equivalent inputs. We further focus the target by requiring desirable tractability properties of attacks to study: explainability, transferability between models, and transferability between goals. We perform red-teaming within this framework by uncovering new vulnerabilities to multi-turn, multi-image, and translation-based attacks. These attacks are semantically equivalent by our design to their single-turn, single-image, or untranslated counterparts, enabling systematic comparisons; we show that the different structures yield different safety outcomes. We then demonstrate the potential for this framework to enable new defenses by proposing a Structure Rewriting Guardrail, which converts an input to a structure more conducive to safety assessment. This guardrail significantly improves refusal of harmful inputs, without over-refusing benign ones. Thus, by framing this intermediate challenge—more tractable than universal defenses but essential for long-term safety—we highlight a critical milestone for AI safety research.
abstract_zh: LLM 越狱是一个广泛的安全挑战。鉴于这个问题尚未解决，我们建议针对一个关键的失败机制：安全性无法泛化到语义等效的输入上。我们通过要求研究攻击的可处理性属性来进一步关注目标：可解释性、模型之间的可转移性以及目标之间的可转移性。我们通过发现多回合、多图像和基于翻译的攻击的新漏洞，在此框架内执行红队行动。根据我们的设计，这些攻击在语义上等同于单轮、单图像或未翻译的攻击，从而能够进行系统比较；我们表明，不同的结构会产生不同的安全结果。然后，我们通过提出结构重写护栏来展示该框架实现新防御的潜力，该护栏将输入转换为更有利于安全评估的结构。这种护栏显着提高了对有害输入的拒绝，而不会过度拒绝良性输入。因此，通过构建这一中间挑战（比通用防御更容易处理，但对长期安全至关重要），我们强调了人工智能安全研究的一个重要里程碑。

title: Toward GlobalAIInclusivity: A Large-Scale Multilingual Terminology Dataset (GIST)
abstract_en: The field of machine translation has achieved significant advancements, yet domain-specific terminology translation, particularly in AI, remains challenging. This work introduces GIST, a large-scale multilingual AI terminology dataset containing 5K terms extracted from top AI conference papers spanning 2000 to 2023. The terms were translated into Arabic, Chinese, French, Japanese, and Russian using a hybrid framework that combines LLMs for extraction with human expertise for translation. The dataset’s quality was benchmarked against existing resources, demonstrating superior translation accuracy through crowdsourced evaluation. GIST was integrated into translation workflows using post-translation refinement methods that required no retraining, where LLM prompting consistently improved BLEU and COMET scores. A web demonstration on the ACL Anthology platform highlights its practical application, showcasing improved accessibility for non-English speakers. We address a critical gap in AI terminology resources and fosters global inclusivity and collaboration in AI research.
abstract_zh: 机器翻译领域已经取得了显着的进步，但特定领域的术语翻译，特别是人工智能领域的术语翻译仍然具有挑战性。这项工作介绍了 GIST，这是一个大规模多语言 AI ​​术语数据集，包含从 2000 年至 2023 年顶级 AI 会议论文中提取的 5K 术语。使用混合框架将这些术语翻译成阿拉伯语、中文、法语、日语和俄语，该框架将大语言模型提取与人类专业翻译相结合。该数据集的质量以现有资源为基准，通过众包评估展示了卓越的翻译准确性。 GIST 使用不需要重新训练的翻译后细化方法集成到翻译工作流程中，其中 LLM 促使 BLEU 和 COMET 分数持续提高。 ACL Anthology 平台上的网络演示强调了其实际应用，展示了对非英语使用者的可访问性的改进。我们解决人工智能术语资源的关键缺口，并促进人工智能研究的全球包容性和协作。

title: SignMusketeers: An Efficient Multi-Stream Approach for Sign Language Translation at Scale
abstract_en: A persistent challenge in sign language video processing, including the task of sign language to written language translation, is how we train efficient model given the nature of videos. Informed by the nature and linguistics of signed languages, our proposed method focuses on just the most relevant parts in a signing video: the face, hands and body posture of the signer. However, instead of using pose estimation coordinates from off-the-shelf pose tracking models, which have inconsistent performance for hands and faces, we propose to learn the complex handshapes and rich facial expressions of sign languages in a self-supervised fashion. Our approach is based on learning from individual frames (rather than video sequences) and is therefore much more efficient than prior work on sign language pre-training. Compared to a recent model trained on publicly avaiable data that established a new state of the art in sign language translation on the How2Sign dataset, our approach yields similar translation performance, using less than 3% of the compute.
abstract_zh: 手语视频处理（包括手语到书面语言翻译的任务）中持续存在的挑战是我们如何在考虑到视频性质的情况下训练有效的模型。根据手语的性质和语言学，我们提出的方法只关注手语视频中最相关的部分：手语者的脸部、手部和身体姿势。然而，我们建议以自我监督的方式学习手语的复杂手形和丰富的面部表情，而不是使用现成的姿势跟踪模型中的姿势估计坐标，这些模型对手和面部的性能不一致。我们的方法基于从单个帧（而不是视频序列）中学习，因此比之前的手语预训练工作要高效得多。与最近使用公开数据训练的模型相比，该模型在 How2Sign 数据集上建立了手语翻译的新技术水平，我们的方法产生了类似的翻译性能，但使用的计算量不到 3%。

title: Tell, Don’t Show: Leveraging Language Models’ Abstractive Retellings to Model Literary Themes
abstract_en: Conventional bag-of-words approaches for topic modeling, like latent Dirichlet allocation (LDA), struggle with literary text. Literature challenges lexical methods because narrative language focuses on immersive sensory details instead of abstractive description or exposition: writers are advised to *show, don’t tell*. We propose Retell, a simple, accessible topic modeling approach for literature. Here, we prompt resource-efficient, generative language models (LMs) to *tell* what passages *show*, thereby translating narratives’ surface forms into higher-level concepts and themes. By running LDA on LMs’ retellings of passages, we can obtain more precise and informative topics than by running LDA alone or by directly asking LMs to list topics. To investigate the potential of our method for cultural analytics, we compare our method’s outputs to expert-guided annotations in a case study on racial/cultural identity in high school English language arts books.
abstract_zh: 用于主题建模的传统词袋方法（例如潜在狄利克雷分配 (LDA)）难以处理文学文本。文学挑战词汇方法，因为叙事语言注重沉浸式感官细节，而不是抽象描述或阐述：建议作家“展示，而不是讲述”。我们提出了 Retell，一种简单、易于理解的文学主题建模方法。在这里，我们提示资源高效的生成语言模型（LM）来“告诉”段落“显示”什么，从而将叙事的表面形式转化为更高层次的概念和主题。通过在 LM 复述段落上运行 LDA，我们可以获得比单独运行 LDA 或直接要求 LM 列出主题更精确和信息丰富的主题。为了研究我们的方法在文化分析方面的潜力，我们将我们的方法的输出与高中英语语言艺术书籍中种族/文化身份的案例研究中专家指导的注释进行了比较。

title: Inductive Linguistic Reasoning with Large Language Models
abstract_en: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) on their linguistic reasoning capabilities is an important task to understand the gaps in their skills that may surface during large-scale adoption. In this work, we investigate the abilities of such models to perform abstract multilingual reasoning through the lens of linguistic puzzles on extremely low-resource languages. As these translation tasks involve inductive and deductive reasoning from reference instances, we examine whether diverse auxiliary demonstrations can be automatically induced from seed exemplars, through analogical prompting. We employ a two-stage procedure, first generating analogical exemplars with a language model, and then applying them in-context along with provided target language exemplars. Our results on the modeLing dataset show that analogical prompting is effective in eliciting models’ knowledge of language grammar similarities, boosting the performance of GPT-4o by as much as 8.1% and Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct by 5.9% over chain-of-thought approaches. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our method generalizes to other tasks present in Linguistics Olympiad competitions, achieving state-of-the-art results across nearly all problem types and difficulty levels in the LINGOLY dataset.
abstract_zh: 评估大型语言模型 (LLM) 的语言推理能力是一项重要任务，可以了解其在大规模采用过程中可能出现的技能差距。在这项工作中，我们通过对资源极少的语言的语言难题的视角来研究此类模型执行抽象多语言推理的能力。由于这些翻译任务涉及从参考实例进行归纳和演绎推理，我们研究是否可以通过类比提示从种子样本中自动归纳出不同的辅助演示。我们采用两阶段过程，首先使用语言模型生成类比范例，然后将它们与提供的目标语言范例一起应用在上下文中。我们在 modelLing 数据集上的结果表明，类比提示可以有效地引出模型对语言语法相似性的了解，与思维链方法相比，GPT-4o 的性能提高了 8.1%，Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct 的性能提高了 5.9%。此外，我们证明我们的方法可以推广到语言学奥林匹克竞赛中的其他任务，在 LINGOLY 数据集中的几乎所有问题类型和难度级别上都取得了最先进的结果。

title: LegoMT2: Selective Asynchronous Sharded Data Parallel Training for Massive Neural Machine Translation
abstract_en: It is a critical challenge to learn a single model for massive languages. Prior methods focus on increasing the model size and training data size. However, large models are difficult to optimize efficiently even with distributed parallel training and translation capacity can interfere among languages. To address the challenge, we propose LegoMT2, an efficient training approach with an asymmetric multi-way model architecture for massive multilingual neural machine translation. LegoMT2 shards 435 languages into 8 language-centric groups and attributes one local encoder for each group’s languages and a mix encoder-decoder for all languages. LegoMT2 trains the model through local data parallel and asynchronous distributed updating of parameters. LegoMT2 is 16.2×faster than the distributed training method for M2M-100-12B (which only for 100 languages) while improving the translation performance by an average of 2.2 BLEU onFlores-101, especially performing better for low-resource languages .
abstract_zh: 学习海量语言的单一模型是一个严峻的挑战。先前的方法侧重于增加模型大小和训练数据大小。然而，即使采用分布式并行训练，大型模型也难以有效优化，并且翻译能力可能会在语言之间产生干扰。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 LegoMT2，这是一种高效的训练方法，具有非对称多路模型架构，适用于大规模多语言神经机器翻译。 LegoMT2 将 435 种语言分为 8 个以语言为中心的组，并为每个组的语言分配一个本地编码器，为所有语言分配一个混合编码器-解码器。 LegoMT2通过本地数据并行和异步分布式参数更新来训练模型。 LegoMT2 比 M2M-100-12B（仅适用于 100 种语言）的分布式训练方法快 16.2 倍，同时在 Flores-101 上将翻译性能平均提高 2.2 BLEU，特别是对于资源匮乏的语言表现更好。

title: ImprovingMLLM’s Document Image Machine Translation via Synchronously Self-reviewing ItsOCRProficiency
abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong performance in document image tasks, especially Optical Character Recognition (OCR). However, they struggle with Document Image Machine Translation (DIMT), which requires handling both cross-modal and cross-lingual challenges. Previous efforts to enhance DIMT capability through Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on the DIMT dataset often result in the forgetting of the model’s existing monolingual abilities, such as OCR. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel fine-tuning paradigm, named Synchronously Self-Reviewing (SSR) its OCR proficiency, inspired by the concept “Bilingual Cognitive Advantage”. Specifically, SSR prompts the model to generate OCR text before producing translation text, which allows the model to leverage its strong monolingual OCR ability while learning to translate text across languages. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the proposed SSR learning helps mitigate catastrophic forgetting, improving the generalization ability of MLLMs on both OCR and DIMT tasks. The code will be released upon acceptance.
abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 在文档图像任务中表现出强大的性能，尤其是光学字符识别 (OCR)。然而，他们在文档图像机器翻译（DIMT）方面遇到了困难，这需要处理跨模式和跨语言的挑战。之前通过对 DIMT 数据集进行监督微调 (SFT) 来增强 DIMT 能力的努力通常会导致忘记模型现有的单语言能力，例如 OCR。为了应对这些挑战，受“双语认知优势”概念的启发，我们引入了一种新颖的微调范例，名为同步自我审查（SSR）其 OCR 能力。具体来说，SSR 会提示模型在生成翻译文本之前生成 OCR 文本，这使得模型可以利用其强大的单语 OCR 能力，同时学习跨语言翻译文本。综合实验表明，所提出的 SSR 学习有助于减轻灾难性遗忘，提高 MLLM 在 OCR 和 DIMT 任务上的泛化能力。该代码将在接受后发布。

title: COVER: Context-Driven Over-Refusal Verification inLLMs
abstract_en: We introduce the concept of context-driven over-refusal, an abstention arising when model’s safety guardrails are triggered by the grounding knowledge provided alongside the user’s request. Distinct from question-driven over-refusal, this occurs in both retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and natural language processing (NLP) task completion (e.g. summarization, translation) where external content can unexpectedly trigger refusals. In this work, we present a novel two-stage evaluation framework named COVER, designed to quantify and analyze this behavior. Through a comprehensive empirical study on two public corpora, we show that over-refusal rates strongly depend on the task, system prompts, model family, and the number of retrieved documents. We observe that tasks such as translation and summarization yield disproportionately high over-refusal rates, while question-answering remains relatively robust, especially in newer models. Moreover, increasing the number of contextual documents tends to reduce refusals, yet broadens the pool of prompts at risk of encountering at least one “unsafe” text. Interestingly, strict system prompts do not necessarily lead to higher over-refusal rates, suggesting that in the absence of explicit directives, some models may default to a more cautious behavior. These findings highlight the need for fine-grained alignment and benchmarking strategies sensitive to both user intent and contextual nuances, offering a roadmap for future research in model training and evaluation.
abstract_zh: 我们引入了上下文驱动的过度拒绝的概念，当模型的安全护栏被用户请求所提供的基础知识触发时，就会出现放弃。与问题驱动的过度拒绝不同，这种情况发生在检索增强生成（RAG）和自然语言处理（NLP）任务完成（例如摘要、翻译）中，外部内容可能意外地触发拒绝。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种名为 COVER 的新型两阶段评估框架，旨在量化和分析这种行为。通过对两个公共语料库的全面实证研究，我们表明过度拒绝率很大程度上取决于任务、系统提示、模型族和检索到的文档数量。我们观察到，翻译和摘要等任务会产生不成比例的高过度拒绝率，而问答仍然相对稳健，尤其是在较新的模型中。此外，增加上下文文档的数量往往会减少拒绝，但会扩大面临至少遇到一个“不安全”文本的风险的提示池。有趣的是，严格的系统提示并不一定会导致更高的过度拒绝率，这表明在没有明确指示的情况下，某些模型可能会默认为更加谨慎的行为。这些发现强调需要对用户意图和上下文细微差别敏感的细粒度调整和基准测试策略，为模型训练和评估的未来研究提供路线图。

title: SCOPE: Compress Mathematical Reasoning Steps for Efficient Automated Process Annotation
abstract_en: Process Reward Models (PRMs) have demonstrated promising results in mathematical reasoning, but existing process annotation approaches, whether through human annotations or Monte Carlo simulations, remain computationally expensive. In this paper, we introduce Step COmpression for Process Estimation (SCOPE), a novel compression-based approach that significantly reduces annotation costs. We first translate natural language reasoning steps into code and normalize them through Abstract Syntax Tree, then merge equivalent steps to construct a prefix tree. Unlike simulation-based methods that waste numerous samples on estimation, SCOPE leverages a compression-based prefix tree where each root-to-leaf path serves as a training sample, reducing the complexity fromO(NMK)to O(N) We construct a large-scale dataset containing 509K samples with only 5% of the computational resources required by previous methods. Empirical results demonstrate that PRMs trained on our dataset consistently outperform existing automated annotation approaches on both Best-of-N strategy and ProcessBench.
abstract_zh: 过程奖励模型（PRM）在数学推理中展示了有希望的结果，但现有的过程注释方法，无论是通过人工注释还是蒙特卡罗模拟，在计算上仍然昂贵。在本文中，我们介绍了用于过程估计的步骤压缩（SCOPE），这是一种基于压缩的新颖方法，可以显着降低注释成本。我们首先将自然语言推理步骤翻译成代码并通过抽象语法树对其进行规范化，然后合并等效步骤以构造前缀树。与在估计上浪费大量样本的基于模拟的方法不同，SCOPE 利用基于压缩的前缀树，其中每个根到叶路径都用作训练样本，将复杂性从 O(NMK) 降低到 O(N) 我们构建了一个包含 509K 样本的大规模数据集，而所需的计算资源仅为以前方法的 5%。实证结果表明，在我们的数据集上训练的 PRM 在 Best-of-N 策略和 ProcessBench 上始终优于现有的自动注释方法。

title: Semantics-aware prompting for translatingNOtices ToAirMen
abstract_en: A NOTAM or NOtice To AirMen is a crucial notice for different aviation stakeholders, particularly flight crews. It delivers essential notifications about abnormal conditions of Aviation System components such as changes to facilities, hazards, service, procedure that are not known far enough in advance to be publicized through other means. NOTAM messages are short, contain acronyms, and look cryptic in most of the cases. Writing and understanding these messages put heavy cognitive load on its end users. In this work, we take up the task of translating NOTAMs into English natural language using LLMs. Since NOTAMs do not adhere to English grammar rules and have their own decoding rules, large language models (LLMs) cannot translate them without effective prompting. In this paper, we develop a framework to come up with effective prompts to achieve the translations. Our approach uses context-aware semantic prompting techniques, paired with domain-specific rules, to improve the accuracy and clarity of translations. The framework is evaluated using comprehensive experiments (6 LLMs of varying sizes, and with 5 different prompting setups for each) and eight evaluation metrics measuring different aspects of the translation. The results demonstrate that our methodology can produce clear translations that accurately convey the information contained in NOTAMs.
abstract_zh: NOTAM 或致飞行员的通知对于不同的航空利益相关者，特别是机组人员来说是一个重要的通知。它提供有关航空系统组件异常情况的重要通知，例如设施、危险、服务、程序的变化，这些变化事先无法通过其他方式公布。 NOTAM 消息很短，包含首字母缩略词，并且在大多数情况下看起来很神秘。编写和理解这些消息会给最终用户带来沉重的认知负担。在这项工作中，我们承担了使用大语言模型将 NOTAM 翻译成英语自然语言的任务。由于 NOTAM 不遵守英语语法规则，并且有自己的解码规则，因此大型语言模型 (LLM) 在没有有效提示的情况下无法翻译它们。在本文中，我们开发了一个框架来提出有效的提示来实现翻译。我们的方法使用上下文感知语义提示技术，与特定领域的规则相结合，以提高翻译的准确性和清晰度。该框架使用综合实验（6 个不同规模的大语言模型，每个都有 5 个不同的提示设置）和八个衡量翻译不同方面的评估指标进行评估。结果表明，我们的方法可以产生清晰的翻译，准确传达航行通告中包含的信息。

title: MultiTEND: A Multilingual Benchmark for Natural Language toNoSQLQuery Translation
abstract_en: Natural language interfaces for NoSQL databases are increasingly vital in the big data era, enabling users to interact with complex, unstructured data without deep technical expertise. However, most recent advancements focus on English, leaving a gap for multilingual support. This paper introduces MultiTEND, the first and largest multilingual benchmark for natural language to NoSQL query generation, covering six languages: English, German, French, Russian, Japanese and Mandarin Chinese.Using MultiTEND, we analyze challenges in translating natural language to NoSQL queries across diverse linguistic structures, including lexical and syntactic differences. Experiments show that performance accuracy in both English and non-English settings remains relatively low, with a 4%-6% gap across scenarios like fine-tuned SLM, zero-shot LLM, and RAG for LLM.To address the aforementioned challenges, we introduce MultiLink, a novel framework that bridges the multilingual input to NoSQL query generation gap through a Parallel Linking Process. It breaks down the task into multiple steps, integrating parallel multilingual processing, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to tackle lexical and structural challenges inherent in multilingual NoSQL generation. MultiLink shows enhancements in all metrics for every language against the top baseline, boosting execution accuracy by about 15% for English and averaging a 10% improvement for non-English languages.
abstract_zh: NoSQL 数据库的自然语言界面在大数据时代变得越来越重要，使用户无需深厚的技术专业知识即可与复杂的非结构化数据进行交互。然而，最近的进展主要集中在英语上，为多语言支持留下了空白。本文介绍了 MultiTEND，这是第一个也是最大的自然语言到 NoSQL 查询生成的多语言基准，涵盖六种语言：英语、德语、法语、俄语、日语和普通话。使用 MultiTEND，我们分析了跨不同语言结构将自然语言转换为 NoSQL 查询的挑战，包括词汇和句法差异。实验表明，英语和非英语环境下的性能准确性仍然相对较低，在微调 SLM、零样本 LLM 和 RAG for LLM 等场景中存在 4%-6% 的差距。为了解决上述挑战，我们引入了 MultiLink，这是一种新颖的框架，它通过并行链接过程弥合多语言输入与 NoSQL 查询生成差距。它将任务分解为多个步骤，集成并行多语言处理、思维链 (CoT) 推理和检索增强生成 (RAG)，以解决多语言 NoSQL 生成中固有的词汇和结构挑战。 MultiLink 显示每种语言的所有指标均较最高基线有所增强，英语的执行准确性提高了约 15%，非英语语言的执行准确性平均提高了 10%。

title: Tool learning via Inference-time Scaling and Cycle Verifier
abstract_en: In inference-time scaling, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) plays a crucial role in enabling large language models (LLMs) to exhibit reasoning capabilities. However, in many scenarios, high-quality CoT data is scarce or even unavailable. In such cases, STaR-like methods can help LLMs synthesize CoT based on user queries and response, but they inevitably suffer from the risk of compounding errors. In this work, we tackle an even more challenging scenario: tool learning in the absence of user queries. We design a data scaling method using back-translation, which establishes an inference cycle to synthesize both user queries and CoT data. To reudce the compounding error of inference time, we introduce two rule-based verifiers to assess the validity of the synthesized CoT data. In particular, the Cycle Verifier facilitates performance improvement by continuously accumulating new data over multiple iterations. Our approach achieves a75.4%pass rate and a79.6%win rate using small models (7B) in StableToolBench. Notably, these results are obtained exclusively from self-synthesized high-quality data, without relying on external supervision or expert trajectories for warm-up.
abstract_zh: 在推理时间扩展中，思维链 (CoT) 在使大型语言模型 (LLM) 展现推理能力方面发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，在很多场景下，高质量的CoT数据是稀缺的，甚至是无法获得的。在这种情况下，类似 STaR 的方法可以帮助大语言模型根据用户查询和响应综合 CoT，但它们不可避免地面临复合错误的风险。在这项工作中，我们解决了一个更具挑战性的场景：在没有用户查询的情况下进行工具学习。我们设计了一种使用反向翻译的数据扩展方法，该方法建立了一个推理循环来综合用户查询和 CoT 数据。为了减少推理时间的复合误差，我们引入了两个基于规则的验证器来评估合成的 CoT 数据的有效性。特别是，Cycle Verifier 通过在多次迭代中不断积累新数据来促进性能改进。我们的方法在 StableToolBench 中使用小模型 (7B) 实现了 75.4% 的通过率和 79.6% 的获胜率。值得注意的是，这些结果完全是从自我合成的高质量数据中获得的，而不依赖于外部监督或专家轨迹进行预热。

title: LIST: Linearly IncrementalSQLTranslator for Single-Hop Reasoning, Generation and Verification
abstract_en: SQL languages often feature nested structures that require robust interaction with databases. Aside from the well-validated schema linking methods on PLMs and LLMs, we introduce the Linearly Incremental SQL Translator (LIST), a novel algorithmic toolkit designed to leverage the notable reasoning and tool interaction capabilities inherent in LLMs. LIST transforms complex SQL queries into grammatically verifiable sub-queries which are arranged sequentially to reflect single-hop reasoning steps, enhancing both the granularity and accuracy of database interactions. With in-context learning, our experiments demonstrated significant improvements, achieving notable performance of 60.56% and 56.32% on the BIRD dataset with GPT-4o and Llama-3-70B-Instruct. To the best of our knowledge, this achieves SOTA performance among non-schema linking methods, also surpassing a series of schema linking based approaches at a comparable or better cost.
abstract_zh: SQL 语言通常具有嵌套结构，需要与数据库进行可靠的交互。除了 PLM 和 LLM 上经过充分验证的模式链接方法之外，我们还引入了线性增量 SQL 转换器 (LIST)，这是一种新颖的算法工具包，旨在利用 LLM 固有的显着推理和工具交互功能。 LIST 将复杂的 SQL 查询转换为语法上可验证的子查询，这些子查询按顺序排列以反映单跳推理步骤，从而增强数据库交互的粒度和准确性。通过上下文学习，我们的实验展示了显着的改进，使用 GPT-4o 和 Llama-3-70B-Instruct 在 BIRD 数据集上实现了 60.56% 和 56.32% 的显着性能。据我们所知，这在非模式链接方法中实现了 SOTA 性能，并且以相当或更好的成本超越了一系列基于模式链接的方法。

title: Low-Resource Grammatical Error Correction: Selective Data Augmentation with Round-Trip Machine Translation
abstract_en: Supervised state-of-the-art methods for grammatical error correction require large amounts of parallel data for training. Due to lack of gold-labeled data, techniques that create synthetic training data have become popular. We show that models trained on synthetic data tend tocorrect a limited range of grammar and spelling mistakes that involve character-level changes, but perform poorly on (more complex) phenomena that require word-level changes. We propose to address the performance gap on such errors by generating synthetic data through selective data augmentation via round-trip machine translation. We show that the proposed technique, SeLex-RT, is capable of generating mistakes that are similar to those observed with language learners. Using the approach with two types of state-of-the-art learning frameworks and two low-resource languages (Russian and Ukrainian), we achieve substantial improvements, compared to training on synthetic data produced with standard techniques. Analysis of the output reveals that models trained on data noisified with the SeLex-RT approach are capable of making word-level changes and correct lexical errors common with language learners.
abstract_zh: 最先进的语法错误纠正监督方法需要大量并行数据进行训练。由于缺乏黄金标记数据，创建合成训练数据的技术变得流行。我们表明，在合成数据上训练的模型倾向于纠正涉及字符级更改的有限范围的语法和拼写错误，但在需要单词级更改的（更复杂）现象上表现不佳。我们建议通过往返机器翻译选择性数据增强生成合成数据，以解决此类错误的性能差距。我们表明，所提出的技术 SeLex-RT 能够产生与语言学习者观察到的错误类似的错误。与使用标准技术生成的合成数据进行训练相比，使用该方法结合两种最先进的学习框架和两种低资源语言（俄语和乌克兰语），我们取得了显着的进步。对输出的分析表明，使用 SeLex-RT 方法噪声数据训练的模型能够进行单词级别的更改并纠正语言学习者常见的词汇错误。

title: BridGMT: EnhancingLLMs’ Machine Translation Capabilities with Sentence Bridging and GradualMT
abstract_en: Recent Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive translation performance without requiring fine-tuning on additional parallel corpora. However, they still face significant challenges in certain scenarios, particularly when translating low-resource languages. A common approach to address this issue is to provide external knowledge, such as few-shot examples, to assist LLMs in translating specific source sentences. However, this method is fundamentally limited by the quality or quantity of relevant sources, which cannot always be guaranteed. To reduce LLMs’ reliance on external sources, we propose BridG MT, a method that combines Sentence Bridging, which generates a sequence of sentences as a bridge that gradually transition from easy-to-translate to more difficult, and Gradual MT, which sequentially translates these sentences using earlier translations as few-shot examples for subsequent ones. Experiments conducted on four LLMs across seven languages demonstrate that our method effectively enhances translation performance, even outperforming translation methods that rely on a large number of few-shot examples.
abstract_zh: 最近的大型语言模型 (LLM) 已展现出令人印象深刻的翻译性能，无需对额外的并行语料库进行微调。然而，他们在某些情况下仍然面临重大挑战，特别是在翻译资源匮乏的语言时。解决这个问题的一个常见方法是提供外部知识，例如少数例子，以协助大语言模型翻译特定的源句子。然而，这种方法从根本上受到相关来源的质量或数量的限制，并且不能总是得到保证。为了减少大语言模型对外部资源的依赖，我们提出了 BridG MT，这是一种结合了句子桥接（Sentence Bridging）和渐进式机器翻译（Gradual MT）的方法，前者生成一系列句子作为桥梁，逐渐从易于翻译过渡到更困难，后者使用早期翻译作为后续翻译的少数示例来顺序翻译这些句子。对七种语言的四位大语言模型进行的实验表明，我们的方法有效地提高了翻译性能，甚至优于依赖大量小样本示例的翻译方法。

title: RomanLens: The Role Of LatentRomanization In Multilinguality InLLMs
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong multilingual performance despite being predominantly trained on English-centric corpora. This raises a fundamental question: How do LLMs achieve such multilingual capabilities? Focusing on languages written in non-Roman scripts, we investigate the role of Romanization—the representation of non-Roman scripts using Roman characters—as a potential bridge in multilingual processing. Using mechanistic interpretability techniques, we analyze next-token generation and find that intermediate layers frequently represent target words in Romanized form before transitioning to native script, a phenomenon we term Latent Romanization. Further, through activation patching experiments, we demonstrate that LLMs encode semantic concepts similarly across native and Romanized scripts, suggesting a shared underlying representation. Additionally, for translation into non-Roman script languages, our findings reveal that when the target language is in Romanized form, its representations emerge earlier in the model’s layers compared to native script. These insights contribute to a deeper understanding of multilingual representation in LLMs and highlight the implicit role of Romanization in facilitating language transfer.
abstract_zh: 尽管主要是在以英语为中心的语料库上进行训练，但大型语言模型 (LLM) 仍表现出强大的多语言性能。这就提出了一个基本问题：大语言模型如何实现这种多语言能力？我们以非罗马文字书写的语言为重点，研究了罗马化（使用罗马字符表示非罗马文字）作为多语言处理中潜在桥梁的作用。使用机械可解释性技术，我们分析下一代令牌生成，发现中间层经常在转换为本地脚本之前以罗马化形式表示目标单词，我们将这种现象称为潜在罗马化。此外，通过激活修补实验，我们证明了大语言模型在本机和罗马化脚本中对语义概念进行了类似的编码，这表明了共享的底层表示。此外，对于翻译成非罗马脚本语言，我们的研究结果表明，当目标语言采用罗马化形式时，与本地脚本相比，其表示形式更早地出现在模型的各层中。这些见解有助于更深入地理解大语言模型的多语言表达，并强调罗马化在促进语言迁移中的隐含作用。

title: Knowledge Base Construction for Knowledge-Augmented Text-to-SQL
abstract_en: Text-to-SQL aims to translate natural language queries into SQL statements, which is practical as it enables anyone to easily retrieve the desired information from databases. Recently, many existing approaches tackle this problem with Large Language Models (LLMs), leveraging their strong capability in understanding user queries and generating corresponding SQL code. Yet, the parametric knowledge in LLMs might be limited to covering all the diverse and domain-specific queries that require grounding in various database schemas, which makes generated SQLs less accurate oftentimes. To tackle this, we propose constructing the knowledge base for text-to-SQL, a foundational source of knowledge, from which we retrieve and generate the necessary knowledge for given queries. In particular, unlike existing approaches that either manually annotate knowledge or generate only a few pieces of knowledge for each query, our knowledge base is comprehensive, which is constructed based on a combination of all the available questions and their associated database schemas along with their relevant knowledge, and can be reused for unseen databases from different datasets and domains. We validate our approach on multiple text-to-SQL datasets, considering both the overlapping and non-overlapping database scenarios, where it outperforms relevant baselines substantially.
abstract_zh: Text-to-SQL 旨在将自然语言查询转换为 SQL 语句，这很实用，因为它使任何人都可以轻松地从数据库中检索所需的信息。最近，许多现有方法通过大型语言模型 (LLM) 来解决这个问题，利用其理解用户查询和生成相应 SQL 代码的强大能力。然而，LLM 中的参数化知识可能仅限于涵盖所有需要基于各种数据库模式的多样化和特定领域的查询，这使得生成的 SQL 通常不太准确。为了解决这个问题，我们建议构建文本到 SQL 的知识库，这是一个基础知识来源，我们可以从中检索并生成给定查询所需的知识。特别是，与手动注释知识或为每个查询仅生成几条知识的现有方法不同，我们的知识库是全面的，它是基于所有可用问题及其关联的数据库模式及其相关知识的组合而构建的，并且可以重用于来自不同数据集和领域的看不见的数据库。我们在多个文本到 SQL 数据集上验证了我们的方法，考虑到重叠和非重叠数据库场景，它的性能大大优于相关基线。

title: skLEP: ASlovak General Language Understanding Benchmark
abstract_en: In this work, we introduce skLEP, the first comprehensive benchmark specifically designed for evaluating Slovak natural language understanding (NLU) models. We have compiled skLEP to encompass nine diverse tasks that span token-level, sentence-pair, and document-level challenges, thereby offering a thorough assessment of model capabilities. To create this benchmark, we curated new, original datasets tailored for Slovak and meticulously translated established English NLU resources. Within this paper, we also present the first systematic and extensive evaluation of a wide array of Slovak-specific, multilingual, and English pre-trained language models using the skLEP tasks. Finally, we also release the complete benchmark data, an open-source toolkit facilitating both fine-tuning and evaluation of models, and a public leaderboard athttps://github.com/slovak-nlp/sklepin the hopes of fostering reproducibility and drive future research in Slovak NLU.
abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们介绍了 skLEP，这是第一个专门为评估斯洛伐克自然语言理解 (NLU) 模型而设计的综合基准。我们编译了 skLEP，以涵盖九个不同的任务，涵盖令牌级别、句子对和文档级别的挑战，从而提供对模型功能的全面评估。为了创建这个基准，我们策划了专为斯洛伐克语定制的新的原始数据集，并精心翻译了现有的英语 NLU 资源。在本文中，我们还使用 skLEP 任务对各种斯洛伐克语、多语言和英语预训练语言模型进行了首次系统和广泛的评估。最后，我们还发布了完整的基准数据、促进模型微调和评估的开源工具包，以及 https://github.com/slovak-nlp/sklepin 上的公共排行榜，希望能够提高可重复性并推动斯洛伐克 NLU 的未来研究。

title: How Programming Concepts and Neurons Are Shared in Code Language Models
abstract_en: Several studies have explored the mechanisms of large language models (LLMs) in coding tasks, but most have focused on programming languages (PLs) in a monolingual setting. In this paper, we investigate the relationship between multiple PLs and English in the concept space of LLMs. We perform a few-shot translation task on 21 PL pairs using two Llama-based models. By decoding the embeddings of intermediate layers during this task, we observe that the concept space is closer to English (including PL keywords) and assigns high probabilities to English tokens in the second half of the intermediate layers. We analyze neuron activations for 11 PLs and English, finding that while language-specific neurons are primarily concentrated in the bottom layers, those exclusive to each PL tend to appear in the top layers. For PLs that are highly aligned with multiple other PLs, identifying language-specific neurons is not feasible. These PLs also tend to have a larger keyword set than other PLs and are closer to the model’s concept space regardless of the input/output PL in the translation task. Our findings provide insights into how LLMs internally represent PLs, revealing structural patterns in the model’s concept space. Code is available at https://github.com/cisnlp/code-specific-neurons.
abstract_zh: 一些研究探索了编码任务中大语言模型 (LLM) 的机制，但大多数研究都集中在单语言环境中的编程语言 (PL)。在本文中，我们研究了大语言模型概念空间中多种PL和英语之间的关系。我们使用两个基于 Llama 的模型对 21 个 PL 对执行少量翻译任务。通过在此任务期间解码中间层的嵌入，我们观察到概念空间更接近英语（包括 PL 关键字），并为中间层后半部分的英语标记分配了高概率。我们分析了 11 个 PL 和英语的神经元激活，发现虽然特定于语言的神经元主要集中在底层，但每个 PL 专有的神经元往往出现在顶层。对于与多个其他 PL 高度一致的 PL，识别特定于语言的神经元是不可行的。这些 PL 也往往比其他 PL 具有更大的关键字集，并且更接近模型的概念空间，无论翻译任务中的输入/输出 PL 为何。我们的研究结果提供了关于大语言模型如何在内部表示 PL 的见解，揭示了模型概念空间中的结构模式。代码可在 https://github.com/cisnlp/code-specific-neurons 获取。

title: Building a Functional Machine Translation Corpus forKpelle
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce the first publicly available English-Kpelle dataset for machine translation, comprising over 2,000 sentence pairs drawn from everyday communication, religious texts, and educational materials. By fine-tuning Metas No Language Left Behind (NLLB) model on two versions of the dataset, we achieved BLEU scores of up to 30 in the Kpelle-to-English direction, demonstrating the benefits of data augmentation. Our findings align with NLLB-200 benchmarks on other African languages, underscoring Kpelles potential for competitive performance despite its low-resource status. Beyond machine translation, this dataset enables broader NLP tasks, including speech recognition and language modeling. We conclude with a roadmap for future dataset expansion, emphasizing orthographic consistency, community-driven validation, and interdisciplinary collaboration to advance inclusive language technology development for Kpelle and other low-resourced Mande languages.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了第一个公开可用的机器翻译 English-Kpelle 数据集，其中包含来自日常交流、宗教文本和教育材料的 2,000 多个句子对。通过在两个版本的数据集上微调 Metas No Language Left Behind (NLLB) 模型，我们在 Kpelle 到英语方向上获得了高达 30 分的 BLEU 分数，展示了数据增强的优势。我们的研究结果与其他非洲语言的 NLLB-200 基准一致，强调了 Kpelles 尽管资源匮乏，但仍具有竞争表现的潜力。除了机器翻译之外，该数据集还支持更广泛的 NLP 任务，包括语音识别和语言建模。最后，我们制定了未来数据集扩展的路线图，强调拼写一致性、社区驱动的验证和跨学科合作，以推进 Kpelle 和其他资源匮乏的 Mande 语言的包容性语言技术开发。

title: SabiYarn: Advancing Low Resource Languages with MultitaskNLPPretraining
abstract_en: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has revolutionized natural language processing, yet a significant challenge persists: the under representation of low-resource languages. This paper introduces SabiYarn, a novel 125M parameter decoder-only language model specifically designed to address this gap for Nigerian languages.Our research demonstrates that a relatively small language model can achieve remarkable performance across multiple languages even in a low-resource setting when trained on carefully curated task-specific datasets. We introduce a multitask learning framework designed for computational efficiency, leveraging techniques such as sequence packing to maximize token throughput per batch. This allows SabiYarn to make the most of a limited compute budget while achieving strong performance across multiple NLP tasks.This paper not only highlights the effectiveness of our approach but also challenges the notion that only massive models can achieve high performance in diverse linguistic contexts, outperforming models over 100 times its parameter size on specific tasks such as translation (in both directions), Named Entity Recognition, Text Diacritization, and Sentiment Analysis in the low-resource languages it was trained on. SabiYarn-125M represents a significant step towards democratizing NLP technologies for low-resource languages, offering a blueprint for developing efficient, high-performing models tailored to specific linguistic regions. Our work paves the way for more inclusive and culturally sensitive AI systems, potentially transforming how language technologies are developed and deployed in linguistically diverse areas like Nigeria and beyond.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的快速发展彻底改变了自然语言处理，但仍然存在一个重大挑战：低资源语言的代表性不足。本文介绍了 SabiYarn，这是一种新颖的 125M 参数解码器语言模型，专门为解决尼日利亚语言的这一差距而设计。我们的研究表明，当在精心策划的特定任务数据集上进行训练时，即使在资源匮乏的环境中，相对较小的语言模型也可以在多种语言上实现卓越的性能。我们引入了一个旨在提高计算效率的多任务学习框架，利用序列打包等技术来最大化每批的令牌吞吐量。这使得 SabiYarn 能够充分利用有限的计算预算，同时在多个 NLP 任务中实现强大的性能。本文不仅强调了我们方法的有效性，还挑战了这样一种观念，即只有大规模模型才能在不同的语言环境中实现高性能，在特定任务上的性能优于其参数大小 100 倍以上的模型，例如翻译（双向）、命名实体识别、文本变音和低资源语言的情感分析。 SabiYarn-125M 代表了低资源语言 NLP 技术民主化的重要一步，为开发针对特定语言区域的高效、高性能模型提供了蓝图。我们的工作为更具包容性和文化敏感性的人工智能系统铺平了道路，有可能改变语言技术在尼日利亚及其他语言多样化地区的开发和部署方式。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Meets Local Languages for Improved Drug Information Access and Comprehension.
abstract_en: Medication errors are among the leading causes of avoidable harm in healthcare systems across the world. A large portion of these errors stem from inefficient information retrieval processes and lack of comprehension of drug information. In low-resource settings, these issues are exacerbated by limited access to updated and reliable sources, technological constraints, and linguistic barriers. Innovations to improve the retrieval and comprehension of drug-related information are therefore poised to reduce medication errors and improve patient outcomes. This research employed open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) integrated with multilingual translation and Text-to-Speech (TTS) systems. Using open-source tools, a corpus was created from prominent sources of medical information in Nigeria and stored as high-level text embeddings in a Chroma database. Upon user query, relevant drug information is retrieved and synthesized using a large language model. This can be translated into Yoruba, Igbo, and Hausa languages, and converted into speech through the TTS system, addressing the linguistic accessibility gap. Evaluation of the system by domain experts indicated impressive overall performance in translation, achieving an average accuracy of 73%, and the best performance observed in Hausa and Yoruba. TTS results were moderately effective (mean = 57%), with Igbo scoring highest in speech clarity (68%). However, tonal complexity, especially in Yoruba, posed challenges for accurate pronunciation, highlighting the need for language-specific model fine-tuning. Addressing these linguistic nuances is essential to optimize comprehension and practical utility in diverse healthcare settings. The results demonstrates systems the potential to improve access to drug information, enhance comprehension, and reduce linguistic barriers. These technologies could substantially mitigate medication errors and improve patient safety. This study offers valuable insights and practical guidelines for future implementations aimed at strengthening global medication safety practices.
abstract_zh: 用药错误是世界各地医疗保健系统中可避免伤害的主要原因之一。这些错误很大一部分源于低效的信息检索过程和缺乏对药品信息的理解。在资源匮乏的环境中，这些问题因获取最新可靠来源的机会有限、技术限制和语言障碍而加剧。因此，改进药物相关信息的检索和理解的创新有望减少用药错误并改善患者的治疗结果。这项研究采用了开源检索增强生成 (RAG) 与多语言翻译和文本转语音 (TTS) 系统的集成。使用开源工具，根据尼日利亚重要的医疗信息来源创建了一个语料库，并将其作为高级文本嵌入存储在 Chroma 数据库中。根据用户查询，使用大语言模型检索并合成相关药品信息。它可以翻译成约鲁巴语、伊博语和豪萨语，并通过 TTS 系统转换为语音，解决语言可及性差距。领域专家对该系统的评估表明，翻译的整体性能令人印象深刻，平均准确率达到 73%，并且在豪萨语和约鲁巴语中观察到最好的性能。 TTS 结果中等有效（平均值 = 57%），伊博语在语音清晰度方面得分最高（68%）。然而，音调的复杂性，尤其是约鲁巴语的音调复杂性，给准确发音带来了挑战，凸显了针对特定语言的模型微调的需要。解决这些语言上的细微差别对于优化不同医疗环境中的理解和实用性至关重要。结果表明，系统具有改善药物信息获取、增强理解和减少语言障碍的潜力。这些技术可以大大减少用药错误并提高患者安全。这项研究为未来旨在加强全球药物安全实践的实施提供了宝贵的见解和实用指南。

title: Story Generation with Large Language Models forAfrican Languages
abstract_en: The development of Large Language Models (LLMs) for African languages has been hindered by the lack of large-scale textual data. Previous research has shown that relatively small language models, when trained on synthetic data generated by larger models, can produce fluent, short English stories, providing a data-efficient alternative to large-scale pretraining. In this paper, we apply a similar approach to develop and evaluate small language models for generating childrens stories in isiZulu and Yoruba, using synthetic datasets created through translation and multilingual prompting. We train six language-specific models varying in dataset size and source, and based on the GPT-2 architecture. Our results show that models trained on synthetic low-resource data are capable of producing coherent and fluent short stories in isiZulu and Yoruba. Models trained on larger synthetic datasets generally perform better in terms of coherence and grammar, and also tend to generalize better, as seen by their lower evaluation perplexities. Models trained on datasets generated through prompting instead of translation generate similar or more coherent stories and display more creativity, but perform worse in terms of generalization to unseen data. In addition to the potential educational applications of the automated story generation, our approach has the potential to be used as the foundation for more data-efficient low-resource language models.
abstract_zh: 由于缺乏大规模文本数据，非洲语言大型语言模型（LLM）的发展受到阻碍。先前的研究表明，相对较小的语言模型在使用较大模型生成的合成数据进行训练时，可以产生流畅、简短的英语故事，为大规模预训练提供了一种数据高效的替代方案。在本文中，我们采用类似的方法来开发和评估用于生成 isiZulu 和约鲁巴语儿童故事的小语言模型，使用通过翻译和多语言提示创建的合成数据集。我们基于 GPT-2 架构训练了六种数据集大小和来源各异的特定语言模型。我们的结果表明，基于合成低资源数据训练的模型能够用 isiZulu 语和约鲁巴语创作连贯且流畅的短篇故事。在较大的综合数据集上训练的模型通常在连贯性和语法方面表现更好，并且也往往具有更好的泛化能力，从其较低的评估困惑度可以看出。在通过提示而不是翻译生成的数据集上训练的模型会生成相似或更连贯的故事，并表现出更多的创造力，但在对未见过的数据的泛化方面表现较差。除了自动故事生成的潜在教育应用之外，我们的方法还有可能被用作数据效率更高的低资源语言模型的基础。

title: Challenges and Limitations in Gathering Resources for Low-Resource Languages: The Case ofMedumba
abstract_en: Low-resource languages face significant challenges in natural language processing due to the scarcity of annotated data, linguistic resources, and the lack of language standardization, which leads to variations in grammar, vocabulary, and writing systems. This issue is particularly observed in many African languages, which significantly reduces their usability. To bridge this barrier, this paper investigates the challenges and limitations of collecting datasets for the Medumba language, a Grassfields Bantu language spoken in Cameroon, in the context of extremely low-resource natural language processing. We mainly focus on the specificity of this language, including its grammatical and lexical structure. Our findings highlight key barriers, including (1) the challenges in typing and encoding Latin scripts, (2) the absence of standardized translations for technical and scientific terms, and (3) the challenge of limited digital resources and financial constraints, highlighting the need to improve data strategies and collaboration to advance computational research on African languages. We hope that our study informs the development of better tools and policies to make knowledge platforms more accessible to extremely low-resource language speakers. We further discuss the representation of the language, data collection, parallel corpus development.
abstract_zh: 由于注释数据、语言资源的稀缺以及语言标准化的缺乏，导致语法、词汇和书写系统的变化，低资源语言在自然语言处理方面面临着重大挑战。这个问题在许多非洲语言中尤其明显，这大大降低了它们的可用性。为了弥合这一障碍，本文研究了在资源极少的自然语言处理背景下收集 Medumba 语言（喀麦隆使用的一种草原班图语言）数据集的挑战和局限性。我们主要关注这种语言的特殊性，包括其语法和词汇结构。我们的研究结果强调了主要障碍，包括（1）输入和编码拉丁文字的挑战，（2）缺乏技术和科学术语的标准化翻译，以及（3）有限的数字资源和财务限制的挑战，强调需要改进数据策略和协作以推进非洲语言的计算研究。我们希望我们的研究能够为开发更好的工具和政策提供信息，使资源极其匮乏的语言使用者更容易使用知识平台。我们进一步讨论了语言的表示、数据收集、平行语料库的开发。

title: YodiV3:NLPforTogolese Languages with Eyaa-Tom Dataset and the Lom Metric
abstract_en: Most of the 40+ languages spoken in Togo are severely under-represented in Natural Language Processing (NLP) resources. We present YodiV3, a comprehensive approach to developing NLP for ten Togolese languages (plus two major lingua francas) covering machine translation, speech recognition, text-to-speech, and language identification. We introduce Eyaa-Tom, a new multi-domain parallel corpus (religious, healthcare, financial, etc.) for these languages. We also propose the Lom metric, a scoring framework to quantify the AI-readiness of each language in terms of available resources. Our experiments demonstrate that leveraging large pretrained models (e.g.NLLB for translation, MMS for speech) with YodiV3 leads to significant improvements in low-resource translation and speech tasks. This work highlights the impact of integrating diverse data sources and pretrained models to bootstrap NLP for under-served languages, and outlines future steps for expanding coverage and capability.
abstract_zh: 多哥使用的 40 多种语言中的大多数在自然语言处理 (NLP) 资源中的代表性严重不足。我们推出了 YodiV3，这是一种为十种多哥语言（加上两种主要通用语言）开发 NLP 的综合方法，涵盖机器翻译、语音识别、文本到语音和语言识别。我们引入了 Eyaa-Tom，这是一个针对这些语言的新的多领域并行语料库（宗教、医疗保健、金融等）。我们还提出了 Lom 指标，这是一个评分框架，用于根据可用资源量化每种语言的人工智能就绪程度。我们的实验表明，利用 YodiV3 的大型预训练模型（例如用于翻译的 NLLB、用于语音的 MMS）可以显着改善低资源翻译和语音任务。这项工作强调了集成不同数据源和预训练模型对服务不足的语言引导 NLP 的影响，并概述了扩大覆盖范围和能力的未来步骤。

title: In-DomainAfrican Languages Translation UsingLLMs and Multi-armed Bandits
abstract_en: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) systems face significant challenges when working with low-resource languages, particularly in domain adaptation tasks. These difficulties arise due to limited training data and suboptimal model generalization, As a result, selecting an optimal model for translation is crucial for achieving strong performance on in-domain data, particularly in scenarios where fine-tuning is not feasible or practical. In this paper, we investigate strategies for selecting the most suitable NMT model for a given domain using bandit-based algorithms, including Upper Confidence Bound, Linear UCB, Neural Linear Bandit, and Thompson Sampling. Our method effectively addresses the resource constraints by facilitating optimal model selection with high confidence.
