abstract_en: This paper presents our approach and findings in the SemEval-2025 Task 6: Multinational, Multilingual, Multi-industry Promise Verification (PromiseEval), which focuses on verifying promises in the industrial Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reports. Specifically, we participate in the first subtask of the PromiseEval shared task, promise identification. We tackle this subtask by building an ensemble of four BERT models trained in different experimental configurations, and deploying logistic regression as meta-model. Each configuration has a different combination of two variables: whether augmented data is used, and whether English translation is used. We find out that the BERT model trained without augmented data or English translation not only has the best evaluation results on the test data in most languages, but also has higher robustness than the meta-model. We submitted results from the meta-model to the leaderboard, and rank the first place in Japanese and Korean, the second place in French and Chinese, and the seventh place in English.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们在 SemEval-2025 任务 6：跨国、多语言、多行业承诺验证 (PromiseEval) 中的方法和结果，重点是验证工业环境、社会和治理 (ESG) 报告中的承诺。具体来说，我们参与 PromiseEval 共享任务的第一个子任务，promise 识别。我们通过构建在不同实验配置中训练的四个 BERT 模型的集合，并将逻辑回归部署为元模型来解决此子任务。每个配置都有两个变量的不同组合：是否使用增强数据，以及是否使用英语翻译。我们发现，在没有增强数据或英文翻译的情况下训练的 BERT 模型不仅在大多数语言的测试数据上具有最好的评估结果，而且比元模型具有更高的鲁棒性。我们将元模型的结果提交到排行榜，日语和韩语排名第一，法语和中文排名第二，英语排名第七。

title: sonrobok4 Team atSemEval-2025 Task 8: Question Answering over Tabular Data Using Pandas and Large Language Models
abstract_en: This paper describes the system of the son robok4 team for the SemEval-2025 Task 8: DataBench, Question-Answering over Tabular Data. The task requires answering questions based on the given question and dataset ID, ensuring that the responses are derived solely from the provided table. We address this task by using large language models (LLMs) to translate natural language questions into executable Python code for querying Pandas DataFrames. Furthermore, we employ techniques such as a rerun mechanism for error handling, structured metadata extraction, and dataset preprocessing to enhance performance. Our best-performing system achieved 89.46% accuracy on Subtask 1 and placed in the top 4 on the private test set. Additionally, it achieved 85.25% accuracy on Subtask 2 and placed in the top 9. We mainly focus on Subtask 1. We analyze the effectiveness of different LLMs for structured data reasoning and discuss key challenges in tabular question answering.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了子 robok4 团队针对 SemEval-2025 任务 8：DataBench、表格数据问答的系统。该任务需要根据给定的问题和数据集 ID 回答问题，确保答案仅来自提供的表。我们通过使用大型语言模型 (LLM) 将自然语言问题转换为用于查询 Pandas DataFrame 的可执行 Python 代码来解决此任务。此外，我们还采用错误处理重新运行机制、结构化元数据提取和数据集预处理等技术来提高性能。我们表现​​最好的系统在子任务 1 上达到了 89.46% 的准确率，并在私人测试集上排名前 4。此外，它在子任务 2 上达到了 85.25% 的准确率，排在前 9 名。我们主要关注子任务 1。我们分析了不同大语言模型在结构化数据推理方面的有效性，并讨论了表格问答中的关键挑战。

title: YNU-HPCCatSemEval-2025 Task 2: Local Cache and Online Retrieval-Based method for Entity-Aware Machine Translation
abstract_en: This paper presents methods for {textbf{SemEval-2025 Task 11}} on text-based emotion detection across three tracks: Multi-label Emotion Detection, Emotion Intensity Prediction, and Cross-lingual Emotion Detection. We apply approaches such as supervised fine-tuning, preference-based reinforcement learning, and few-shot learning to enhance performance. Our combined strategies result in improved accuracy, particularly in multi-label and cross-lingual emotion detection, demonstrating the effectiveness of these methods in diverse linguistic settings.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 {textbf{SemEval-2025 Task 11}} 跨三个轨道的基于文本的情感检测方法：多标签情感检测、情感强度预测和跨语言情感检测。我们应用监督微调、基于偏好的强化学习和小样本学习等方法来提高性能。我们的组合策略提高了准确性，特别是在多标签和跨语言情感检测方面，证明了这些方法在不同语言环境中的有效性。

title: MRTatSemEval-2025 Task 8: Maximizing Recovery from Tables with Multiple Steps
abstract_en: In this paper we expose our approach to solve the SemEval 2025 Task 8: Question-Answering over Tabular Data challenge. Our strategy leverages Python code generation with LLMs to interact with the table and get the answer to the questions. The process is composed of multiple steps: understanding the content of the table, generating natural language instructions in the form of steps to follow in order to get the answer, translating these instructions to code, running it and handling potential errors or exceptions. These steps use open source LLMs and fine grained optimized prompts for each task (step). With this approach, we achieved a score of 70.50% for subtask 1.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们展示了解决 SemEval 2025 任务 8：表格数据问答挑战的方法。我们的策略利用 LLM 的 Python 代码生成来与表格交互并获得问题的答案。该过程由多个步骤组成：理解表的内容，以要遵循的步骤的形式生成自然语言指令以获得答案，将这些指令转换为代码，运行它并处理潜在的错误或异常。这些步骤使用开源 LLM 和针对每个任务（步骤）的细粒度优化提示。通过这种方法，我们在子任务 1 上取得了 70.50% 的分数。

title: FIIthe Best atSemEval 2025 Task 2: Steering State-of-the-art Machine Translation Models with Strategically Engineered Pipelines for Enhanced Entity Translation
abstract_en: Entity-Aware Machine Translation (EAMT) aims to enhance the accuracy of machine translation (MT) systems in handling named entities, including proper names, domain-specific terms, and structured references. Conventional MT models often struggle to accurately translate these entities, leading to errors that affect comprehension and reliability. In this paper, we present a promising approach for SemEval 2025 Task 2, focusing on improving EAMT in ten target languages. The methodology is based on two complementary strategies: (1) multilingual Named Entity Recognition (NER) and structured knowledge bases for preprocessing and integrating entity translations, and (2) large language models (LLMs) enhanced with optimized prompts and validation mechanisms to improve entity preservation. By combining structured knowledge with neural approaches, this system aims to mitigate entity-related translation errors and enhance the overall performance of MT models. Among the systems that do not use gold information, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or fine-tuning, our approach ranked 1st with the second strategy and 3rd with the first strategy.
abstract_zh: 实体感知机器翻译 (EAMT) 旨在提高机器翻译 (MT) 系统处理命名实体（包括专有名称、特定领域术语和结构化引用）的准确性。传统的机器翻译模型通常难以准确翻译这些实体，从而导致影响理解和可靠性的错误。在本文中，我们为 SemEval 2025 任务 2 提出了一种有前途的方法，重点是改进 10 种目标语言的 EAMT。该方法基于两种互补策略：(1) 多语言命名实体识别 (NER) 和用于预处理和集成实体翻译的结构化知识库，以及 (2) 通过优化的提示和验证机制增强大型语言模型 (LLM)，以改善实体保存。通过将结构化知识与神经方法相结合，该系统旨在减少与实体相关的翻译错误并提高机器翻译模型的整体性能。在不使用黄金信息、检索增强生成（RAG）或微调的系统中，我们的方法在第二个策略中排名第一，在第一个策略中排名第三。

title: G-MACTatSemEval-2025 Task 8: Exploring Planning and Tool Use in Question Answering over Tabular Data
abstract_en: This paper describes our system submitted to SemEval-2024 Task 8 “Question Answering over Tabular Data.”The shared task focuses on tackling real-life table question answering (TQA) involving extremely large tables with the additional challenges of interpreting complex questions. To address these issues, we leverage a framework of Multi-Agent Collaboration with Tool use (MACT), a method that combines planning and tool use. The planning module breaks down a complex question by designing a step-by-step plan. This plan is translated into Python code by a coding model, and a Python interpreter executes the code to generate an answer. Our system demonstrates competitive performance in the shared task and is ranked 5th out of 38 in the open-source model category. We provide a detailed analysis of our model, evaluating the effectiveness and the efficiency of each component, and identify common error patterns. Our paper offers essential insights and recommendations for future advancements in developing TQA systems.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了我们提交给 SemEval-2024 任务 8“表格数据问答”的系统。共享任务的重点是解决现实生活中的表格问答 (TQA)，涉及非常大的表格以及解释复杂问题的额外挑战。为了解决这些问题，我们利用多智能体协作与工具使用（MACT）框架，这是一种结合规划和工具使用的方法。规划模块通过设计分步计划来分解复杂的问题。该计划通过编码模型翻译成Python代码，并且Python解释器执行代码以生成答案。我们的系统在共享任务中表现出有竞争力的性能，在开源模型类别的 38 个模型中排名第 5。我们对模型进行详细分析，评估每个组件的有效性和效率，并识别常见错误模式。我们的论文为开发 TQA 系统的未来进步提供了重要的见解和建议。

title: ABCDatSemEval-2025 Task 9:BERT-based and Generation-based models combine with advanced weighted majority soft voting strategy
abstract_en: This paper illustrates our ABCD team system approach in ACL 2025 - SemEval-2025 Task 9: The Food Hazard Detection Challenge, aim to solving both Task 1: Text classification for food hazard prediction, predicting the type of hazard and product, and Task 2: Food hazard and product “vector” detection, predicting the exact hazard and product. Precisely, we received a food report and our system needed to automatically detect which category of hazard and product the food belonged to. However, in Task 2, we must classify the food report into the exact name of the food hazard and category. To tackle Task 1, we implement and investigate various solutions, including (1) experimenting with a large battery of BERT-based models; and (2) utilizing generation-based models, and (3) taking advantage of a custom ensemble learning method. In addition, to address Task 2, we make use of different data augmentation techniques like synonym replacement and back-translation. To enhance the context of input, we cleaned some special characters that bring more clarity into text input. Our best official results on Task 1 and Task 2 are 0.786 and 0.458 in terms of F1-score, respectively—finally, our team solution achieved top 8th in task 1 and top 10th in task 2.
abstract_zh: 本文阐述了我们在 ACL 2025 - SemEval-2025 任务 9：食品危害检测挑战中的 ABCD 团队系统方法，旨在解决任务 1：食品危害预测的文本分类，预测危害和产品的类型，以及任务 2：食品危害和产品“向量”检测，预测确切的危害和产品。准确地说，我们收到了一份食品报告，我们的系统需要自动检测食品属于哪一类危害和产品。然而，在任务2中，我们必须将食品报告分类为食品危害的确切名称和类别。为了解决任务 1，我们实施并研究了各种解决方案，包括 (1) 试验大量基于 BERT 的模型； (2) 利用基于生成的模型，以及 (3) 利用定制的集成学习方法。此外，为了解决任务 2，我们利用了不同的数据增强技术，例如同义词替换和反向翻译。为了增强输入的上下文，我们清理了一些特殊字符，使文本输入更加清晰。我们在任务 1 和任务 2 上的最佳官方成绩（F1 分数）分别为 0.786 和 0.458，最终，我们团队的解决方案在任务 1 中获得了前 8 名，在任务 2 中获得了前 10 名。

title: Sakura atSemEval-2025 Task 2: Enhancing Named Entity Translation with Fine-Tuning and Preference Optimization
abstract_en: Translating name entities can be challenging, as it often requires real-world knowledge rather than just performing a literal translation. The shared task “Entity-Aware Machine Translation” in SemEval-2025 encourages participants to build machine translation models that can effectively handle the translation of complex named entities.In this paper, we propose two methods to improve the accuracy of name entity translation from English to Japanese. One approach involves fine-tuning the model on entries, or lists of entries, of the dictionary. The second technique focuses on preference optimization, guiding the model on which translation it should generate.
abstract_zh: 翻译名称实体可能具有挑战性，因为它通常需要现实世界的知识，而不仅仅是执行字面翻译。 SemEval-2025 中的共享任务“实体感知机器翻译”鼓励参与者构建能够有效处理复杂命名实体翻译的机器翻译模型。在本文中，我们提出了两种方法来提高从英语到日语的名称实体翻译的准确性。一种方法涉及对字典的条目或条目列表微调模型。第二种技术侧重于偏好优化，指导模型应生成哪种翻译。

title: SALTatSemEval-2025 Task 2: ASQL-based Approach forLLM-Free Entity-Aware-Translation
abstract_en: Entity-aware machine translation faces significant challenges when translating culturally-adapted named entities that require knowledge beyond the source text. We present SALT (SQL-based Approach for LLM-Free Entity-Aware-Translation), a parameter-efficient system for the SemEval-2025 Task 2. Our approach combines SQL-based entity retrieval with constrained neural translation via logit biasing and explicit entity annotations. Despite its simplicity, it achieves state-of-the-art performance (First Place) among approaches not using gold-standard data, while requiring far less computation than LLM-based methods. Our ablation studies show simple SQL-based retrieval rivals complex neural models, and strategic model refinement outperforms increased model complexity. SALT offers an alternative to resource-intensive LLM-based approaches, achieving comparable results with only a fraction of the parameters.
abstract_zh: 在翻译需要源文本之外的知识的文化适应命名实体时，实体感知机器翻译面临着重大挑战。我们提出了 SALT（基于 SQL 的 LLM-Free 实体感知翻译方法），这是一个用于 SemEval-2025 任务 2 的参数高效系统。我们的方法通过 logit 偏差和显式实体注释将基于 SQL 的实体检索与约束神经翻译相结合。尽管它很简单，但它在不使用黄金标准数据的方法中实现了最先进的性能（第一名），同时比基于 LLM 的方法所需的计算量少得多。我们的消融研究表明，简单的基于 SQL 的检索可以与复杂的神经模型相媲美，并且策略模型细化的效果优于增加的模型复杂性。 SALT 提供了一种基于资源密集型的 LLM 方法的替代方案，只需一小部分参数即可实现可比较的结果。

title: TeamUBDatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Balancing Class and Task Importance for Emotion Detection
abstract_en: This article presents the systems used by Team UBD in Task 11 of SemEval-2025. We participated in all three sub-tasks, namely Emotion Detection, Emotion Intensity Estimation and Cross-Lingual Emotion Detection. In our solutions we make use of publicly available Language Models (LMs) already fine-tuned for the Emotion Detection task, as well as open-sourced models for Neural Machine Translation (NMT). We robustly adapt the existing LMs to the new data distribution, balance the importance of all emotions and classes and also use a custom sampling scheme.We present fine-grained results in all sub-tasks and analyze multiple possible sources for errors for the Cross-Lingual Emotion Detection sub-task.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 UBD 团队在 SemEval-2025 任务 11 中使用的系统。我们参与了所有三个子任务，即情绪检测、情绪强度估计和跨语言情绪检测。在我们的解决方案中，我们利用已针对情绪检测任务进行微调的公开语言模型 (LM)，以及神经机器翻译 (NMT) 的开源模型。我们使现有的 LM 稳健地适应新的数据分布，平衡所有情绪和类别的重要性，并使用自定义采样方案。我们在所有子任务中提供细粒度的结果，并分析跨语言情绪检测子任务的多个可能的错误来源。

title: HausaNLPatSemEval-2025 Task 2: Entity-Aware Fine-tuning vs. Prompt Engineering in Entity-Aware Machine Translation
abstract_en: This paper presents our findings for SemEval 2025 Task 2, a shared task on entity-aware machine translation (EA-MT). The goal of this task is to develop translation models that can accurately translate English sentences into target languages, with a particular focus on handling named entities, which often pose challenges for MT systems. The task covers 10 target languages with English as the source. In this paper, we describe the different systems we employed, detail our results, and discuss insights gained from our experiments.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们对 SemEval 2025 任务 2 的研究结果，这是一项关于实体感知机器翻译 (EA-MT) 的共享任务。该任务的目标是开发能够准确地将英语句子翻译成目标语言的翻译模型，特别关注处理命名实体，这通常会给机器翻译系统带来挑战。该任务涵盖 10 种目标语言，以英语为源语言。在本文中，我们描述了我们使用的不同系统，详细说明了我们的结果，并讨论了从我们的实验中获得的见解。

title: Firefly Team atSemEval-2025 Task 8: Question-Answering over Tabular Data usingSQL/Python generation with Closed-Source Large Language Models
abstract_en: In this paper, we describe our official system of the Firefly team for two main tasks in the SemEval-2025 Task 8: Question-Answering over Tabular Data. Our solution employs large language models (LLMs) to translate natural language queries into executable code, specifically Python and SQL, which are then used to generate answers categorized into five predefined types. Our empirical evaluation highlights the superiority of Python code generation over SQL for this challenge. Besides, the experimental results show that our system has achieved competitive performance in two subtasks. In Subtask I: Databench QA, where we rank the Top 9 across datasets of any size. Besides, our solution achieved competitive results and ranked 5th place in Subtask II: Databench QA Lite, where datasets are restricted to a maximum of 20 rows.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们描述了 Firefly 团队的官方系统，用于执行 SemEval-2025 任务 8 中的两项主要任务：表格数据问答。我们的解决方案采用大型语言模型 (LLM) 将自然语言查询转换为可执行代码，特别是 Python 和 SQL，然后用于生成分为五种预定义类型的答案。我们的实证评估强调了针对这一挑战，Python 代码生成相对于 SQL 的优越性。此外，实验结果表明我们的系统在两个子任务中取得了有竞争力的性能。在子任务 I：Databench QA 中，我们对任意大小的数据集的前 9 名进行排名。此外，我们的解决方案取得了有竞争力的结果，在子任务 II：Databench QA Lite 中排名第五，其中数据集限制为最多 20 行。

title: Zero atSemEval-2025 Task 2: Entity-Aware Machine Translation: Fine-TuningNLLBfor Improved Named Entity Translation
abstract_en: Machine Translation (MT) is an essential tool for communication amongst people across different cultures, yet Named Entity (NE) translation remains a major challenge due to its rarity in occurrence and ambiguity. Traditional approaches, like using lexicons or parallel corpora, often fail to generalize to unseen entities, and hence do not perform well. To address this, we create a silver dataset using the Google Translate API and fine-tune the facebook/nllb200-distilled-600M model with LoRA (LowRank Adaptation) to enhance translation accuracy while also maintaining efficient memory use. Evaluated with metrics such as BLEU, COMET, and M-ETA, our results show that fine-tuning a specialized MT model improves NE translation without having to rely on largescale general-purpose models.
abstract_zh: 机器翻译（MT）是跨文化人们之间交流的重要工具，但命名实体（NE）翻译由于其罕见性和歧义性仍然是一个重大挑战。传统方法，例如使用词典或平行语料库，通常无法泛化到看不见的实体，因此表现不佳。为了解决这个问题，我们使用 Google Translate API 创建了一个银色数据集，并使用 LoRA（低阶适应）对 facebook/nllb200-distilled-600M 模型进行了微调，以提高翻译准确性，同时保持高效的内存使用。通过 BLEU、COMET 和 M-ETA 等指标进行评估，我们的结果表明，微调专门的 MT 模型可以改善 NE 翻译，而无需依赖大规模通用模型。

title: VerbaNexAIatSemEval-2025 Task 11 Track A: ARoBERTa-Based Approach for the Classification of Emotions in Text
abstract_en: Emotion detection in text has become a highly relevant research area due to the growing interest in understanding emotional states from human interaction in the digital world. This study presents an approach for emotion detection in text using a RoBERTa-based model, optimized for multi-label classification of the emotions joy, sadness, fear, anger, and surprise in the context of the SemEval 2025 - Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection competition. Advanced preprocessing strategies were incorporated, including the augmentation of the training dataset through automatic translation to improve the representativeness of less frequent emotions. Additionally, a loss function adjustment mechanism was implemented to mitigate class imbalance, enabling the model to enhance its detection capability for underrepresented categories. The experimental results reflect competitive performance, with a macro F1 of 0.6577 on the development set and 0.6266 on the test set. In the competition, the model ranked 47th, demonstrating solid performance against the challenge posed.
abstract_zh: 由于人们对数字世界中人类交互中的情绪状态的理解日益浓厚，文本中的情绪检测已成为一个高度相关的研究领域。本研究提出了一种使用基于 RoBERTa 的模型进行文本情绪检测的方法，该模型针对 SemEval 2025 - 任务 11：弥合基于文本的情绪检测竞赛中的差距，对快乐、悲伤、恐惧、愤怒和惊讶情绪的多标签分类进行了优化。结合了先进的预处理策略，包括通过自动翻译增强训练数据集，以提高不常见情绪的代表性。此外，还实施了损失函数调整机制来减轻类别不平衡，使模型能够增强对代表性不足类别的检测能力。实验结果反映了竞争性能，开发集上的宏观 F1 为 0.6577，测试集上的宏观 F1 为 0.6266。在比赛中，该模型排名第 47 位，在挑战中表现出了扎实的表现。

title: VerbaNexAIatSemEval-2025 Task 2: Enhancing Entity-Aware Translation withWikidata-EnrichedMarianMT
abstract_en: This paper presents the VerbaNexAi Lab system for SemEval-2025 Task 2: Entity-Aware Machine Translation (EA-MT), focusing on translating named entities from English to Spanish across categories such as musical works, foods, and landmarks. Our approach integrates detailed data preprocessing, enrichment with 240,432 Wikidata entity pairs, and fine-tuning of the MarianMT model to enhance entity translation accuracy. Official results reveal a COMET score of 87.09, indicating high fluency, an M-ETA score of 24.62, highlighting challenges in entity precision, and an Overall Score of 38.38, ranking last among 34 systems. While Wikidata improved translations for common entities like “Águila de San Juan,” our static methodology underperformed compared to dynamic LLM-based approaches.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了用于 SemEval-2025 任务 2：实体感知机器翻译 (EA-MT) 的 VerbaNexAi Lab 系统，重点是将命名实体从英语翻译成西班牙语，涵盖音乐作品、食物和地标等类别。我们的方法集成了详细的数据预处理、240,432 个维基数据实体对的丰富以及对 MarianMT 模型的微调，以提高实体翻译的准确性。官方结果显示，COMET 得分为 87.09，流畅度较高；M-ETA 得分为 24.62，凸显实体精度方面的挑战；总分为 38.38，在 34 个系统中排名垫底。虽然维基数据改进了“Águila de San Juan”等常见实体的翻译，但与基于大语言模型的动态方法相比，我们的静态方法表现不佳。

title: AILS-NTUAatSemEval-2025 Task 3: Leveraging Large Language Models and Translation Strategies for Multilingual Hallucination Detection
abstract_en: Multilingual hallucination detection stands as an underexplored challenge, which the Mu-SHROOM shared task seeks to address. In this work, we propose an efficient, training-free LLM prompting strategy that enhances detection by translating multilingual text spans into English. Our approach achieves competitive rankings across multiple languages, securing two first positions in low-resource languages. The consistency of our results highlights the effectiveness of our translation strategy for hallucination detection, demonstrating its applicability regardless of the source language.
abstract_zh: 多语言幻觉检测是一个尚未充分探索的挑战，Mu-SHROOM 共享任务旨在解决这一问题。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种高效、免培训的 LLM 提示策略，通过将多语言文本跨度翻译成英语来增强检测。我们的方法在多种语言中实现了竞争性排名，在资源匮乏的语言中获得了两个第一名。我们结果的一致性凸显了我们的幻觉检测翻译策略的有效性，证明了其适用性，无论源语言如何。

title: Word2winners atSemEval-2025 Task 7: Multilingual and Crosslingual Fact-Checked Claim Retrieval
abstract_en: This paper describes our system for SemEval 2025 Task 7: Previously Fact-Checked Claim Retrieval. The task requires retrieving relevant fact-checks for a given input claim from the extensive, multilingual MultiClaim dataset, which comprises social media posts and fact-checks in several languages. To address this challenge, we first evaluated zero-shot performance using state-of-the-art English and multilingual retrieval models and then fine-tuned the most promising systems, leveraging machine translation to enhance crosslingual retrieval. Our best model achieved an accuracy of 85% on crosslingual data and 92% on monolingual data.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们用于 SemEval 2025 任务 7 的系统：先前经过事实检查的索赔检索。该任务需要从广泛的多语言 MultiClaim 数据集中检索给定输入声明的相关事实核查，该数据集包括社交媒体帖子和多种语言的事实核查。为了应对这一挑战，我们首先使用最先进的英语和多语言检索模型评估零样本性能，然后对最有前途的系统进行微调，利用机器翻译来增强跨语言检索。我们最好的模型在跨语言数据上的准确率达到 85%，在单语言数据上的准确率达到 92%。

title: AILS-NTUAatSemEval-2025 Task 8: Language-to-Code prompting and Error Fixing for Tabular Question Answering
abstract_en: In this paper, we present our submission to SemEval-2025 Task 8: Question Answering over Tabular Data. This task, evaluated on the DataBench dataset, assesses Large Language Models’ (LLMs) ability to answer natural language questions over structured data while addressing topic diversity and table size limitations in previous benchmarks. We propose a system that employs effective LLM prompting to translate natural language queries into executable code, enabling accurate responses, error correction, and interpretability. Our approach ranks first in both subtasks of the competition in the proprietary model category, significantly outperforming the organizer’s baseline.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提交了 SemEval-2025 任务 8：表格数据问答。这项任务在 DataBench 数据集上进行评估，评估大型语言模型 (LLM) 通过结构化数据回答自然语言问题的能力，同时解决先前基准测试中的主题多样性和表大小限制。我们提出了一个系统，该系统采用有效的大语言模型提示将自然语言查询转换为可执行代码，从而实现准确的响应、纠错和可解释性。我们的方法在专有模型类别竞赛的两个子任务中均排名第一，显着优于组织者的基线。

title: SheffieldGATEatSemEval-2025 Task 2: Multi-Stage Reasoning with Knowledge Fusion for Entity Translation
abstract_en: This paper describes the machine translation system submitted to the SemEval-2025 Entity-Aware Machine Translation Task by the SheffieldGATE Team. We proposed a multi-agent entity-aware machine translation system that operates through three distinct reasoning stages: entity recognition, knowledge enhancement, and translation decision-making. The innovation in our approach lies in leveraging large language models to generate contextually relevant queries during the knowledge enhancement stage, extracting candidate entities and their translations from external knowledge bases. In the final translation decision-making stage, we employ fine-tuned large language models to denoise the retrieved knowledge, selecting the most relevant entity information to ensure accurate translation of the original text. Experimental results demonstrate our system’s effectiveness. In emEval-2025 Task 2, our system ranks first among all systems in Spanish entity translation metrics and third in Italian. For systems that do not use gold standard entity IDs during test set inference, ours achieves the highest overall scores across four language pairs: German, French, Italian, and Spanish.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了 SheffieldGATE 团队提交给 SemEval-2025 实体感知机器翻译任务的机器翻译系统。我们提出了一种多代理实体感知机器翻译系统，该系统通过三个不同的推理阶段进行操作：实体识别、知识增强和翻译决策。我们方法的创新在于利用大型语言模型在知识增强阶段生成上下文相关的查询，从外部知识库中提取候选实体及其翻译。在最终的翻译决策阶段，我们采用微调的大型语言模型对检索到的知识进行去噪，选择最相关的实体信息以确保原文的准确翻译。实验结果证明了我们系统的有效性。在 emEval-2025 任务 2 中，我们的系统在西班牙语实体翻译指标中在所有系统中排名第一，在意大利语中排名第三。对于在测试集推理期间不使用黄金标准实体 ID 的系统，我们的系统在四种语言对（德语、法语、意大利语和西班牙语）中获得了最高的总体分数。

title: UncleLMatSemEval-2025 Task 11:RAG-Based Few-Shot Learning and Fine-Tuned Encoders for Multilingual Emotion Detection
abstract_en: This paper presents our approach for SemEval-2025 Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection. We investigate multiple methodologies, including fine-tuning transformer models and few-shot learning with GPT-4o-mini, incorporating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for emotion intensity estimation. Our approach also leverages back-translation for data augmentation and threshold optimization to improve multi-label emotion classification. The experiments evaluate performance across multiple languages, including low-resource settings, with a focus on enhancing cross-lingual emotion detection.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们用于 SemEval-2025 任务 11 的方法：弥合基于文本的情绪检测的差距。我们研究了多种方法，包括微调 Transformer 模型和使用 GPT-4o-mini 进行少样本学习，并结合检索增强生成 (RAG) 进行情绪强度估计。我们的方法还利用反向翻译进行数据增强和阈值优化，以改进多标签情感分类。这些实验评估了多种语言的性能，包括资源匮乏的环境，重点是增强跨语言情绪检测。

title: HUatSemEval-2025 Task 9: LeveragingLLM-Based Data Augmentation for Class Imbalance
abstract_en: This paper presents a solution to the food hazard detection challenge in the SemEval-2025 Task 9, focusing on overcoming class imbalance using data augmentation techniques. We employ large language models (LLMs) like GPT-4o, Gemini Flash 1.5, and T5 to generate synthetic data, alongside other methods like synonym replacement, back-translation, and paraphrasing. These augmented datasets are used to fine-tune transformer-based models such as DistilBERT, improving their performance in detecting food hazards and categorizing products. Our approach achieves notable improvements in macro-F1 scores for both subtasks, although challenges remain in detecting implicit hazards and handling extreme class imbalance. The paper also discusses various techniques, including class weighting and ensemble modeling, as part of the training process. Despite the improvements, further work is necessary to refine hazard detection, particularly for rare and implicit categories.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了 SemEval-2025 任务 9 中食品危害检测挑战的解决方案，重点是使用数据增强技术克服类别不平衡。我们采用 GPT-4o、Gemini Flash 1.5 和 T5 等大型语言模型 (LLM) 来生成合成数据，以及同义词替换、回译和释义等其他方法。这些增强的数据集用于微调基于 Transformer 的模型（例如 DistilBERT），提高其在检测食品危害和产品分类方面的性能。尽管在检测隐性危险和处理极端类别不平衡方面仍然存在挑战，但我们的方法在两个子任务的宏观 F1 分数上均取得了显着提高。本文还讨论了作为训练过程一部分的各种技术，包括类别加权和集成建模。尽管有所改进，但仍需要进一步的工作来完善危险检测，特别是对于罕见和隐含类别。

title: FunghiFunghi atSemEval-2025 Task 3: Mu-SHROOM, the Multilingual Shared-task on Hallucinations and Related Observable Overgeneration Mistakes
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) often generate hallucinated content, which is factually incorrect or misleading, posing reliability challenges. The Mu-SHROOM shared task addresses hallucination detection in multilingualLLM-generated text. This study employsSpanBERT, a transformer model optimized forspan-based predictions, to identify hallucinatedspans across multiple languages. To addresslimited training data, we apply dataset augmentation through translation and synthetic generation. The model is evaluated using Intersection over Union (IoU) for span detectionand Spearman’s correlation for ranking consistency. While the model detects hallucinatedspans with moderate accuracy, it struggles withranking confidence scores. These findings highlight the need for improved probability calibration and multilingual robustness. Future workshould refine ranking methods and explore ensemble models for better performance.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 经常生成幻觉内容，这些内容实际上不正确或具有误导性，从而带来可靠性挑战。 Mu-SHROOM 共享任务解决了多语言LLM 生成的文本中的幻觉检测问题。本研究采用 SpanBERT（一种针对基于跨度的预测而优化的变压器模型）来识别多种语言的幻觉跨度。为了解决训练数据有限的问题，我们通过翻译和合成生成来应用数据集增强。该模型使用 Intersection over Union (IoU) 进行跨度检测，并使用 Spearman 相关性进行排名一致性评估。虽然该模型以中等准确度检测幻觉跨度，但它在对置信度得分进行排名方面遇到了困难。这些发现凸显了改进概率校准和多语言鲁棒性的必要性。未来的工作应该完善排名方法并探索集成模型以获得更好的性能。

title: Habib University atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection
abstract_en: Emotion detection in text has emerged as a pivotal challenge in Natural Language Processing (NLP), particularly in multilingual and cross-lingual contexts. This paper presents our participation in SemEval 2025 Task 11, focusing on three subtasks: Multi-label Emotion Detection, Emotion Intensity Prediction, and Cross-lingual Emotion Detection. Leveraging state-of-the-art transformer models such as BERT and XLM-RoBERTa, we implemented baseline models and ensemble techniques to enhance predictive accuracy. Additionally, innovative approaches like data augmentation and translation-based cross-lingual emotion detection were used to address linguistic and class imbalances. Our results demonstrated significant improvements in F1 scores and Pearson correlations, showcasing the effectiveness of ensemble learning and transformer-based architectures in emotion recognition. This work advances the field by providing robust methods for emotion detection, particularly in low-resource and multilingual settings.
abstract_zh: 文本中的情绪检测已成为自然语言处理（NLP）中的一个关键挑战，特别是在多语言和跨语言环境中。本文介绍了我们参与 SemEval 2025 任务 11 的情况，重点关注三个子任务：多标签情绪检测、情绪强度预测和跨语言情绪检测。利用 BERT 和 XLM-RoBERTa 等最先进的 Transformer 模型，我们实施了基线模型和集成技术来提高预测准确性。此外，还使用数据增强和基于翻译的跨语言情感检测等创新方法来解决语言和类别不平衡问题。我们的结果证明了 F1 分数和 Pearson 相关性的显着改善，展示了集成学习和基于 Transformer 的架构在情感识别中的有效性。这项工作通过提供强大的情绪检测方法推动了该领域的发展，特别是在资源匮乏和多语言环境中。

title: UAlberta atSemEval-2025 Task 2: Prompting and Ensembling for Entity-Aware Translation
abstract_en: We describe the methods used by our UAlberta team for the SemEval-2025 Task 2 on Entity-Aware Machine Translation (EA-MT). Our methods leverage large language models with prompt engineering strategies suited to this task, including retrieval augmented generation and in-context learning. Our best results overall are obtained with ensembles of multiple models, leveraging named entity knowledge in the dataset. Finally, we provide proof-of-concept experiments showing that lexico-semantic knowledge can be used to identify high-quality translations. We further demonstrate that our methods can function even without gold named entity translations, by using an alternative knowledge base such as BabelNet.
abstract_zh: 我们描述了阿尔伯塔大学团队在实体感知机器翻译 (EA-MT) 的 SemEval-2025 任务 2 中使用的方法。我们的方法利用大型语言模型以及适合此任务的即时工程策略，包括检索增强生成和上下文学习。总体而言，我们的最佳结果是通过多个模型的集成，利用数据集中的命名实体知识获得的。最后，我们提供了概念验证实验，表明词汇语义知识可用于识别高质量的翻译。通过使用 BabelNet 等替代知识库，我们进一步证明，即使没有黄金命名实体翻译，我们的方法也可以发挥作用。

title: HowardUniversity-AI4PCatSemEval-2025 Task 2: Improving Machine Translation With Context-Aware Entity-Only Pre-translations withGPT4o
abstract_en: This paper presents our work on a 3-Step GPT translation system developed for SemEval-2025 Task 2 to enhance the translation of named entities within machine translation. Our approach integrates (1) entity extraction via wikidata, (2) GPT-based refinement of entity translations, and (3) final context-aware GPT translation. Results from the original dataset of six languages show significant improvements in the handling of named entities compared to direct GPT-based translation baselines. We further discuss replicability, observed challenges, and outline future research directions.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们为 SemEval-2025 任务 2 开发的 3 步 GPT 翻译系统的工作，以增强机器翻译中命名实体的翻译。我们的方法集成了（1）通过 wikidata 进行实体提取，（2）基于 GPT 的实体翻译细化，以及（3）最终的上下文感知 GPT 翻译。六种语言的原始数据集的结果显示，与直接基于 GPT 的翻译基线相比，命名实体的处理有了显着改进。我们进一步讨论可复制性、观察到的挑战，并概述未来的研究方向。

title: TreeSearch atSemEval-2025 Task 8:MonteCarlo Tree Search for Question-Answering over Tabular Data
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) can answer diverse questions but often generate factually incorrect responses. SemEval-2025 Task 8 focuses on table-based question-answering, providing 65 real-world tabular datasets and 1,300 questions that require precise filtering and summarization of underlying tables.We approach this problem as a neuro-symbolic code generation task, translating natural language queries into executable Python code to ensure contextually relevant and factually accurate answers. We formulate LLM decoding as a Markov Decision Process, enabling Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) as a lookahead-based planning algorithm while decoding from the underlying code-generating LLM, instead of standard beam search.Execution success on synthetic tests and real datasets serves as a reward signal, allowing MCTS to explore multiple code-generation paths, validate outcomes, assign value to partial solutions, and refine code iteratively rather than merely maximizing sequence likelihood in a single step. Our approach improves accuracy by 2.38x compared to standard decoding.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 可以回答各种问题，但通常会生成事实上不正确的答案。 SemEval-2025 任务 8 专注于基于表格的问答，提供 65 个真实世界的表格数据集和 1,300 个需要对基础表格进行精确过滤和汇总的问题。我们将此问题视为神经符号代码生成任务，将自然语言查询转换为可执行的 Python 代码，以确保上下文相关且事实上准确的答案。我们将 LLM 解码制定为马尔可夫决策过程，使蒙特卡罗树搜索 (MCTS) 成为一种基于前瞻的规划算法，同时从底层代码生成 LLM 进行解码，而不是标准波束搜索。综合测试和真实数据集上的执行成功作为奖励信号，允许 MCTS 探索多个代码生成路径、验证结果、为部分解决方案分配值以及迭代地细化代码，而不仅仅是在单个步骤中最大化序列似然。与标准解码相比，我们的方法将准确性提高了 2.38 倍。

title: UCSCatSemEval-2025 Task 8: Question Answering over Tabular Data
abstract_en: Table question answering (Table QA) remains challenging due to the varied structures of tables and the complexity of queries, which often require specialized reasoning. We introduce a system that leverages large language models (LLMs) to generate executable code as an intermediate step for answering questions on tabular data. The methodology uniformly represents tables as dataframes and prompts an LLM to translate natural-language questions into code that can be executed on these tables. This approach addresses key challenges by handling diverse table formats, enhancing interpretability through code execution. Experimental results on the DataBench benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed code-then-execute approach achieves high accuracy. Moreover, by offloading computation to code execution, the system requires fewer LLM invocations, thereby improving efficiency. These findings highlight the effectiveness of an LLM-based coding approach for reliable, scalable, and interpretable Table QA.
abstract_zh: 由于表结构的多样性和查询的复杂性，表问答（表 QA）仍然具有挑战性，这通常需要专门的推理。我们引入了一个系统，该系统利用大型语言模型（LLM）生成可执行代码，作为回答有关表格数据的问题的中间步骤。该方法统一将表格表示为数据帧，并提示大语言模型将自然语言问题翻译成可以在这些表格上执行的代码。这种方法通过处理不同的表格式、通过代码执行增强可解释性来解决关键挑战。 DataBench 基准测试的实验结果表明，所提出的先编码后执行的方法实现了高精度。此外，通过将计算卸载到代码执行，系统需要更少的 LLM 调用，从而提高效率。这些发现强调了基于 LLM 的编码方法在可靠、可扩展和可解释的表 QA 方面的有效性。

title: TIFINIndia atSemEval-2025: Harnessing Translation to Overcome MultilingualIRChallenges in Fact-Checked Claim Retrieval
abstract_en: We address the challenge of retrieving previously fact-checked claims in mono-lingual and cross-lingual settings - a critical task given the global prevalence of disinformation. Our approach follows a two-stage strategy: a reliable baseline retrieval system using a fine-tuned embedding model and an LLM-based reranker. Our key contribution is demonstrating how LLM-based translation can overcome the hurdles of multilingual information retrieval. Additionally, we focus on ensuring that the bulk of the pipeline can be replicated on a consumer GPU. Our final integrated system achieved a success@10 score of 0.938 (~0.94) and 0.81025 on the monolingual and crosslingual test sets respectively.
abstract_zh: 我们解决了在单语言和跨语言环境中检索先前经过事实核查的主张的挑战——考虑到全球虚假信息的普遍存在，这是一项至关重要的任务。我们的方法遵循两阶段策略：使用微调嵌入模型的可靠基线检索系统和基于 LLM 的重新排序器。我们的主要贡献是展示基于大语言模型的翻译如何克服多语言信息检索的障碍。此外，我们专注于确保大部分管道可以在消费级 GPU 上复制。我们最终的集成系统在单语和跨语言测试集上分别取得了 0.938 (~0.94) 和 0.81025 的 success@10 分数。

title: AKCITatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Investigating Data Quality inPortuguese Emotion Recognition
abstract_en: This paper investigates the impact of data quality and processing strategies on emotion recognition in Brazilian Portuguese (PTBR) texts. We focus on data distribution, linguistic context, and augmentation techniques such as translation and synthetic data generation. To evaluate these aspects, we conduct experiments on the PTBR portion of the BRIGHTER dataset, a manually curated multilingual dataset containing nearly 100,000 samples, of which 4,552 are in PTBR. Our study encompasses both multi-label emotion detection (presence/absence classification) and emotion intensity prediction (0 to 3 scale), following the SemEval 2025 Track 11 setup. Results demonstrate that emotion intensity labels enhance model performance after discretization, and that smaller multilingual models can outperform larger ones in low-resource settings. Our official submission ranked 6th, but further refinements improved our ranking to 3rd, trailing the top submission by only 0.047, reinforcing the significance of a data-centric approach in emotion recognition.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了数据质量和处理策略对巴西葡萄牙语 (PTBR) 文本中情感识别的影响。我们专注于数据分布、语言环境和增强技术，例如翻译和合成数据生成。为了评估这些方面，我们对 BRIGHTER 数据集的 PTBR 部分进行了实验，这是一个手动策划的多语言数据集，包含近 100,000 个样本，其中 4,552 个样本位于 PTBR 中。我们的研究涵盖多标签情绪检测（存在/不存在分类）和情绪强度预测（0 到 3 级），遵循 SemEval 2025 Track 11 设置。结果表明，情感强度标签在离散化后增强了模型性能，并且在资源匮乏的环境中，较小的多语言模型可以胜过较大的模型。我们的官方提交排名第 6，但进一步的改进将我们的排名提升至第 3，仅落后排名靠前的提交 0.047，这强化了以数据为中心的方法在情感识别中的重要性。

title: MultiMind atSemEval-2025 Task 7: Crosslingual Fact-Checked Claim Retrieval via Multi-Source Alignment
abstract_en: This paper presents our system for SemEval-2025 Task 7: Multilingual and Crosslingual Fact-Checked Claim Retrieval. In an era where misinformation spreads rapidly, effective fact-checking is increasingly critical. We introduce {textbf{TriAligner}}, a novel approach that leverages a dual-encoder architecture with contrastive learning and incorporates both native and English translations across different modalities. Our method effectively retrieves claims across multiple languages by learning the relative importance of different sources in alignment. To enhance robustness, we employ efficient data preprocessing and augmentation using large language models while incorporating hard negative sampling to improve representation learning. We evaluate our approach on monolingual and crosslingual benchmarks, demonstrating significant improvements in retrieval accuracy and fact-checking performance over baselines.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们用于 SemEval-2025 任务 7 的系统：多语言和跨语言事实检查声明检索。在错误信息迅速传播的时代，有效的事实核查变得越来越重要。我们引入了 {textbf{TriAligner}}，这是一种新颖的方法，它利用双编码器架构和对比学习，并结合了不同模式的母语和英语翻译。我们的方法通过学习不同来源的相对重要性来有效地检索跨多种语言的声明。为了增强鲁棒性，我们使用大型语言模型进行高效的数据预处理和增强，同时结合硬负采样来改进表示学习。我们在单语言和跨语言基准上评估了我们的方法，证明检索准确性和事实检查性能较基线有显着提高。

title: fact checkAIatSemEval-2025 Task 7: Multilingual and Crosslingual Fact-checked Claim Retrieval
abstract_en: The SemEval-2025 Task 7 on Multilingualand Crosslingual Fact-checked Claim Retrievalfocuses on retrieving relevant Fact-checkedclaims for social media Posts across multiplelanguages. This task is particularly challengingdue to linguistic barriers and the vast numberof languages Fact-checkers must consider.In this work, I approach the problem as aLearning-to-Rank task and solve it using abi-encoder-based model, fine-tuned on a pre-trained transformer optimized for sentence sim-ilarity. For the monolingual task, training wasperformed in both the source languages andtheir English translations. For cross-lingualretrieval, the training relied on English transla-tions.Most fine-tuned models have fewer than 500Mparameters, and the training was carried outefficiently using kaggle T4 GPUs with paral-lelization. Despite this lightweight setup, ourapproach achieved 92% Success@10 for mul-tilingual retrieval and 80% Success@10 forcross-lingual retrieval, securing 5th place inthe cross-lingual track and 10th place in themultilingual setting.
abstract_zh: SemEval-2025 任务 7 关于多语言和跨语言事实检查声明检索重点是检索跨多种语言的社交媒体帖子的相关事实检查声明。由于语言障碍和事实检查人员必须考虑的大量语言，这项任务特别具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我将问题作为学习排名任务来解决，并使用基于 abi 编码器的模型来解决它，并在针对句子相似性优化的预训练变压器上进行微调。对于单语任务，以源语言及其英语翻译进行训练。对于跨语言检索，训练依赖于英文翻译。大多数微调模型的参数少于 500M，并且使用具有并行化功能的 Kaggle T4 GPU 高效地进行训练。尽管采用了这种轻量级的设置，我们的方法在多语言检索方面取得了 92% Success@10 的成绩，在跨语言检索方面取得了 80% Success@10 的成绩，在跨语言赛道中排名第 5，在多语言环境中排名第 10。

title: TeamACKatSemEval-2025 Task 2: Beyond Word-for-Word Machine Translation forEnglish-Korean Pairs
abstract_en: Translating knowledge-intensive and entity-rich text between English and Korean requires transcreation to preserve language-specific and cultural nuances beyond literal, phonetic or word-for-word conversion. We evaluate 13 models (LLMs and MT systems) using automatic metrics and human assessment by bilingual annotators. Our findings show LLMs outperform traditional MT systems but struggle with entity translation requiring cultural adaptation. By constructing an error taxonomy, we identify incorrect responses and entity name errors as key issues, with performance varying by entity type and popularity level. This work exposes gaps in automatic evaluation metrics and hope to enable future work in completing culturally-nuanced machine translation.
abstract_zh: 在英语和韩语之间翻译知识密集型和实体丰富的文本需要创译，以保留除字面、语音或逐字转换之外的特定于语言和文化的细微差别。我们使用自动指标和双语注释者的人工评估来评估 13 个模型（LLM 和 MT 系统）。我们的研究结果表明，大语言模型的表现优于传统的机器翻译系统，但在需要文化适应的实体翻译方面遇到了困难。通过构建错误分类法，我们将不正确的响应和实体名称错误确定为关键问题，其性能因实体类型和受欢迎程度而异。这项工作揭示了自动评估指标的差距，并希望能够推动未来完成文化细微差别的机器翻译的工作。

title: Annif atSemEval-2025 Task 5: TraditionalXMTCaugmented byLLMs
abstract_en: This paper presents the Annif system in SemEval-2025 Task 5 (LLMs4Subjects), which focussed on subject indexing using large language models (LLMs). The task required creating subject predictions for bibliographic records from the bilingual TIBKAT database using the GND subject vocabulary. Our approach combines traditional natural language processing and machine learning techniques implemented in the Annif toolkit with innovative LLM-based methods for translation and synthetic data generation, and merging predictions from monolingual models. The system ranked first in the all-subjects category and second in the tib-core-subjects category in the quantitative evaluation, and fourth in qualitative evaluations. These findings demonstrate the potential of combining traditional XMTC algorithms with modern LLM techniques to improve the accuracy and efficiency of subject indexing in multilingual contexts.
abstract_zh: 本文在 SemEval-2025 任务 5 (LLMs4Subjects) 中介绍了 Annif 系统，该系统重点关注使用大型语言模型 (LLM) 的主题索引。该任务需要使用 GND 主题词汇从双语 TIBKAT 数据库中创建书目记录的主题预测。我们的方法将 Annif 工具包中实现的传统自然语言处理和机器学习技术与基于 LLM 的创新方法相结合，用于翻译和合成数据生成，并合并来自单语言模型的预测。该系统在定量评价中在全学科类别中排名第一，在tib核心学科类别中排名第二，在定性评价中排名第四。这些发现证明了将传统 XMTC 算法与现代 LLM 技术相结合的潜力，可以提高多语言环境中主题索引的准确性和效率。

title: SemEval-2025 Task 2: Entity-Aware Machine Translation
abstract_en: Translating text that contains complex or challenging named entities—e.g., cultural-specific book and movie titles, location names, proper nouns, food names, etc.—remains a difficult task for modern machine translation systems, including the latest large language models. To systematically study and advance progress in this area, we organized Entity-Aware Machine Translation, or EA-MT, a shared task that evaluates how well systems handle entity translation across 10 language pairs. With EA-MT, we introduce XC-Translate, a novel gold benchmark comprising over 50K manually-translated sentences with entity names that can deviate significantly from word-to-word translations in their target languages. This paper describes the creation process of XC-Translate, provides an overview of the approaches explored by our participants, presents the main evaluation findings, and points toward open research directions, such as contextual retrieval methods for low-resource entities and more robust evaluation metrics for entity correctness. We hope that our shared task will inspire further research in entity-aware machine translation and foster the development of more culturally-accurate translation systems.
abstract_zh: 对于现代机器翻译系统（包括最新的大型语言模型）来说，翻译包含复杂或具有挑战性的命名实体（例如特定文化的书籍和电影标题、地名、专有名词、食物名称等）的文本仍然是一项艰巨的任务。为了系统地研究和推进这一领域的进展，我们组织了实体感知机器翻译（EA-MT），这是一项共享任务，用于评估系统处理 10 种语言对的实体翻译的能力。通过 EA-MT，我们引入了 XC-Translate，这是一种新颖的黄金基准，包含超过 50K 个手动翻译的句子，其实体名称可能与目标语言的字对字翻译存在显着偏差。本文描述了 XC-Translate 的创建过程，概述了参与者探索的方法，介绍了主要的评估结果，并指出了开放的研究方向，例如低资源实体的上下文检索方法和更强大的实体正确性评估指标。我们希望我们的共同任务能够激发实体感知机器翻译的进一步研究，并促进开发更准确的文化翻译系统。

title: Investment-Driven Social Influence: A Statistical Physics Approach to Advertising Response
abstract_en: This paper explores social influence in consumer responses to advertising through investment-mediated conversational dynamics. We implement conversational engagement via advertising expenditure patterns, recognizing that marketing spend directly translates into conversational volume and reach across multi-channel ecosystems. Our approach integrates social psychology frameworks with statistical physics analogies as epistemic scaffolding following Ruse’s änalogy as heuristic” idea. The model introduces three parameters—Marketing Sensitivity, Response Sensitivity, and Behavioral Sensitivity—quantifying emergent properties of investment-driven influence networks. Validation against three real-world datasets shows competitive performance compared to conventional approaches of modeling the consumer response curve like Michaelis-Menten and Hill equations, with context-dependent advantages in network-driven scenarios. These findings illustrate how advertising ecosystems operate as complex adaptive systems (CAS) where influence propagates through investment-amplified conversational networks.
abstract_zh: 本文通过投资介导的对话动态探讨了消费者对广告反应的社会影响。我们通过广告支出模式实现对话参与，认识到营销支出直接转化为对话量和跨多渠道生态系统的影响力。我们的方法将社会心理学框架与统计物理类比作为认知脚手架，遵循鲁斯的启发式类比思想。该模型引入了三个参数——营销敏感度、响应敏感度和行为敏感度——量化投资驱动的影响网络的新兴属性。针对三个现实世界数据集的验证显示了与传统的消费者响应曲线建模方法（如 Michaelis-Menten 和 Hill 方程）相比具有竞争力的性能，并具有上下文相关的优势这些发现说明了广告生态系统如何作为复杂的自适应系统（CAS）运作，其中影响力通过投资放大的对话网络传播。

title: Unstable Grounds for Beautiful Trees? Testing the Robustness of Concept Translations in the Compilation of Multilingual Wordlists
abstract_en: Multilingual wordlists play a crucial role in comparative linguistics. While many studies have been carried out to test the power of computational methods for language subgrouping or divergence time estimation, few studies have put the data upon which these studies are based to a rigorous test. Here, we conduct a first experiment that tests the robustness of concept translation as an integral part of the compilation of multilingual wordlists. Investigating the variation in concept translations in independently compiled wordlists from 10 dataset pairs covering 9 different language families, we find that on average, only 83% of all translations yield the same word form, while identical forms in terms of phonetic transcriptions can only be found in 23% of all cases. Our findings can prove important when trying to assess the uncertainty of phylogenetic studies and the conclusions derived from them.
abstract_zh: 多语言词汇表在比较语言学中发挥着至关重要的作用。虽然已经进行了许多研究来测试语言分组或发散时间估计的计算方法的能力，但很少有研究对这些研究所依据的数据进行严格的测试。在这里，我们进行了第一个实验，测试概念翻译作为多语言单词列表编译的组成部分的稳健性。通过调查涵盖 9 个不同语系的 10 个数据集对中独立编译的单词表中概念翻译的变化，我们发现平均而言，所有翻译中只有 83% 产生相同的单词形式，而在音标方面的相同形式仅在所有情况下被发现于 23%。当试图评估系统发育研究的不确定性以及由此得出的结论时，我们的发现可能很重要。

title: A discovery procedure for synlexification patterns in the world’s languages
abstract_en: Synlexification is the pattern of crosslinguistic lexical semantic variation whereby what is expressed in a single word in one language, is expressed in multiple words in another (e.g., French ‘monter’ vs. English ‘go+up’). We introduce a computational method for automatically extracting instances of synlexification from a parallel corpus at a large scale (many languages, many domains). The method involves debiasing the seed language by splitting up synlexifications in the seed language where other languages consistently split them. The method was applied to a massively parallel corpus of 198 Bible translations. We validate it on a broad sample of cases, and demonstrate its potential for typological research.
abstract_zh: 联词化是跨语言词汇语义变异的模式，一种语言中的单个单词所表达的内容，另一种语言中的多个单词所表达的内容（例如，法语“monter”与英语“go+up”）。我们引入了一种计算方法，用于从大规模（多种语言、多种领域）的平行语料库中自动提取句法实例。该方法涉及通过拆分种子语言中的同义化来消除种子语言的偏差，而其他语言则一致地拆分它们。该方法被应用于包含 198 个圣经译本的大规模并行语料库。我们在广泛的案例样本中验证了它，并展示了其类型学研究的潜力。

title: Construction-Based Reduction of Translationese for Low-Resource Languages: A Pilot Study onBavarian
abstract_en: When translating into a low-resource language, a language model can have a tendency to produce translations that are close to the source (e.g., word-by-word translations) due to a lack of rich low-resource training data in pretraining. Thus, the output often is translationese that differs considerably from what native speakers would produce naturally. To remedy this, we synthetically create a training set in which the frequency of a construction unique to the low-resource language is artificially inflated. For the case of Bavarian, we show that, after training, the language model has learned the unique construction and that native speakers judge its output as more natural. Our pilot study suggests that construction-based mitigation of translationese is a promising approach. Code and artifacts are available athttps://github.com/cisnlp/BayernGPT.
abstract_zh: 当翻译成低资源语言时，由于预训练中缺乏丰富的低资源训练数据，语言模型可能倾向于生成接近源的翻译（例如逐字翻译）。因此，输出通常是翻译的，与母语人士自然产生的结果有很大不同。为了解决这个问题，我们综合创建了一个训练集，其中低资源语言特有的构造频率被人为地夸大。对于巴伐利亚语的情况，我们表明，经过训练，语言模型已经学会了独特的结构，并且母语人士认为其输出更自然。我们的试点研究表明，基于结构的翻译缓解是一种很有前途的方法。代码和工件可在 https://github.com/cisnlp/BayernGPT 获取。

title: Are Translated Texts Useful for Gradient Word Order Extraction?
abstract_en: Gradient, token-level measures of word order preferences within a language are useful both for cross-linguistic comparison in linguistic typology and for multilingual NLP applications. However, such measures might not be representative of general language use when extracted from translated corpora, due to noise introduced by structural effects of translation. We attempt to quantify this uncertainty in a case study of subject/verb order statistics extracted from a parallel corpus of parliamentary speeches in 21 European languages. We find that word order proportions in translated texts generally resemble those extracted from non-translated texts, but tend to skew somewhat toward the dominant word order of the target language. We also investigate the potential presence of underlying source language-specific effects, but find that they do not sufficiently explain the variation across translations.
abstract_zh: 语言内词序偏好的梯度、标记级度量对于语言类型学中的跨语言比较和多语言 NLP 应用都很有用。然而，由于翻译的结构效应引入了噪音，当从翻译的语料库中提取时，这些措施可能无法代表一般语言的使用。我们试图通过从 21 种欧洲语言的议会演讲平行语料库中提取主语/动词顺序统计数据的案例研究来量化这种不确定性。我们发现翻译文本中的词序比例通常与从非翻译文本中提取的词序比例相似，但往往会稍微偏向目标语言的主导词序。我们还调查了潜在的源语言特定影响的潜在存在，但发现它们并不能充分解释翻译之间的差异。

title: UAlign:LLMAlignment Benchmark for theUkrainian Language
abstract_en: This paper introduces UAlign, the comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) in the Ukrainian language. The benchmark consists of two complementary components: a moral judgment dataset with 3,682 scenarios of varying ethical complexities and a dataset with 1,700 ethical situations presenting clear normative distinctions. Each element provides parallel English-Ukrainian text pairs, enabling cross-lingual comparison. Unlike existing resources predominantly developed for high-resource languages, our benchmark addresses the critical need for evaluation resources in Ukrainian. The development process involved machine translation and linguistic validation using Ukrainian language models for grammatical error correction. Our cross-lingual evaluation of six LLMs confirmed the existence of a performance gap between alignment in Ukrainian and English while simultaneously providing valuable insights regarding the overall alignment capabilities of these models. The benchmark has been made publicly available to facilitate further research initiatives and enhance commercial applications.Warning: The datasets introduced in this paper contain sensitive materials related to ethical and moral scenarios that may include offensive, harmful, illegal, or controversial content.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 UAlign，这是用于评估乌克兰语大型语言模型 (LLM) 对齐情况的综合基准。该基准由两个互补的部分组成：道德判断数据集，其中包含 3,682 种不同道德复杂性的场景；以及一个数据集，包含 1,700 种具有明确规范区别的道德情境。每个元素都提供并行的英语-乌克兰语文本对，从而实现跨语言比较。与主要为高资源语言开发的现有资源不同，我们的基准满足了对乌克兰语评估资源的迫切需求。开发过程涉及机器翻译和使用乌克兰语言模型进行语法错误纠正的语言验证。我们对六个大语言模型的跨语言评估证实了乌克兰语和英语对齐之间存在性能差距，同时提供了有关这些模型的整体对齐能力的宝贵见解。该基准已公开发布，以促进进一步的研究计划并增强商业应用。警告：本文中介绍的数据集包含与伦理和道德场景相关的敏感材料，其中可能包括攻击性、有害、非法或有争议的内容。

title: A Framework for Large-Scale Parallel Corpus Evaluation: Ensemble Quality Estimation Models Versus Human Assessment
abstract_en: We developed a methodology and a framework for automatically evaluating and filtering large-scale parallel corpora for neural machine translation (NMT). We applied six modern Quality Estimation (QE) models to score 55 million English-Ukrainian sentence pairs and conducted human evaluation on a stratified sample of 9,755 pairs. Using the obtained data, we ran a thorough statistical analysis to assess the performance of selected QE models and build linear, quadratic and beta regression models on the ensemble to estimate human quality judgments from automatic metrics. Our best ensemble model explained approximately 60% of the variance in expert ratings. We also found a non-linear relationship between automatic metrics and human quality perception, indicating that automatic metrics can be used to predict the human score. Our findings will facilitate further research in parallel corpus filtering and quality estimation and ultimately contribute to higher-quality NMT systems. We are releasing our framework, the evaluated corpus with quality scores, and the human evaluation dataset to support further research in this area.
abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种方法和框架，用于自动评估和过滤神经机器翻译（NMT）的大规模并行语料库。我们应用了六种现代质量估计 (QE) 模型对 5500 万个英语-乌克兰语句子对进行评分，并对 9,755 对分层样本进行了人工评估。利用获得的数据，我们进行了彻底的统计分析，以评估所选 QE 模型的性能，并在整体上构建线性、二次和 beta 回归模型，以根据自动指标估计人类质量判断。我们最好的集成模型解释了专家评分中大约 60% 的差异。我们还发现自动指标和人类质量感知之间的非线性关系，表明自动指标可以用来预测人类得分。我们的研究结果将促进并行语料库过滤和质量估计方面的进一步研究，并最终为更高质量的 NMT 系统做出贡献。我们正在发布我们的框架、具有质量分数的评估语料库以及人类评估数据集，以支持该领域的进一步研究。

title: Vuyko Mistral: AdaptingLLMs for Low-Resource Dialectal Translation
abstract_en: In this paper we introduce the first effort to adapt large language models (LLMs) to the Ukrainian dialect (in our case Hutsul), a low-resource and morphologically complex dialect spoken in the Carpathian Highlands. We created a parallel corpus of 9852 dialect-to-standard Ukrainian sentence pairs and a dictionary of 7320 dialectal word mappings. We also addressed data shortage by proposing an advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline to generate synthetic parallel translation pairs, expanding the corpus with 52142 examples. We have fine-tuned multiple open-source LLMs using LoRA and evaluated them on a standard-to-dialect translation task, also comparing with few-shot GPT-4o translation. In the absence of human annotators, we adopt a multi-metric evaluation strategy combining BLEU, chrF++, TER, and LLM-based judgment (GPT-4o). The results show that even small(7B) finetuned models outperform zero-shot baselines such as GPT-4o across both automatic and LLM-evaluated metrics. All data, models, and code are publicly released at: https://github.com/woters/vuyko-hutsul.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了使大型语言模型（LLM）适应乌克兰方言（在我们的例子中为 Hutsul）的首次努力，乌克兰方言是喀尔巴阡高地使用的一种资源匮乏且形态复杂的方言。我们创建了一个包含 9852 个方言到标准乌克兰语句子对的平行语料库和一个包含 7320 个方言单词映射的字典。我们还通过提出先进的检索增强生成 (RAG) 管道来生成合成并行翻译对，从而通过 52142 个示例扩展语料库来解决数据短缺问题。我们使用 LoRA 对多个开源 LLM 进行了微调，并在标准到方言的翻译任务上对其进行了评估，同时还与少样本 GPT-4o 翻译进行了比较。在没有人类注释者的情况下，我们采用结合 BLEU、chrF++、TER 和基于 LLM 的判断 (GPT-4o) 的多指标评估策略。结果表明，即使是小型 (7B) 微调模型，在自动和 LLM 评估指标方面也优于 GPT-4o 等零样本基线。所有数据、模型和代码均公开发布于：https://github.com/woters/vuyko-hutsul。

title: Improving Sentiment Analysis forUkrainian Social Media Code-Switching Data
abstract_en: This paper addresses the challenges of sentiment analysis in Ukrainian social media, where users frequently engage in code-switching with Russian and other languages. We introduce COSMUS (COde-Switched MUltilingual Sentiment for Ukrainian Social media), a 12,224-texts corpus collected from Telegram channels, product‐review sites and open datasets, annotated into positive, negative, neutral and mixed sentiment classes as well as language labels (Ukrainian, Russian, code-switched). We benchmark three modeling paradigms: (i) few‐shot prompting of GPT‐4o and DeepSeek V2-chat, (ii) multilingual mBERT, and (iii) the Ukrainian‐centric UkrRoberta. We also analyze calibration and LIME scores of the latter two solutions to verify its performance on various language labels. To mitigate data sparsity we test two augmentation strategies: back‐translation consistently hurts performance, whereas a Large Language Model (LLM) word‐substitution scheme yields up to +2.2% accuracy. Our work delivers the first publicly available dataset and comprehensive benchmark for sentiment classification in Ukrainian code‐switching media. Results demonstrate that language‐specific pre‐training combined with targeted augmentation yields the most accurate and trustworthy predictions in this challenging low‐resource setting.
abstract_zh:
本文解决了乌克兰社交媒体中情绪分析的挑战，其中用户经常与俄语和其他语言进行语码转换。我们引入了 COSMUS（乌克兰社交媒体的 COde-Switched 多语言情感），这是一个从 Telegram 频道、产品评论网站和开放数据集收集的 12,224 文本语料库，注释为积极、消极、中立和混合情绪类别以及语言标签（乌克兰语、俄语、语码转换）。我们对三种建模范例进行了基准测试：(i) GPT-4o 和 DeepSeek V2 聊天的小样本提示，(ii) 多语言 mBERT，以及 (iii) 以乌克兰语为中心的 UkrRoberta。我们还分析了后两种解决方案的校准和 LIME 分数，以验证其在各种语言标签上的性能。为了缓解数据稀疏性，我们测试了两种增强策略：反向翻译始终会损害性能，而大型语言模型 (LLM) 单词替换方案的准确率高达 +2.2%。我们的工作提供了第一个公开可用的数据集和乌克兰语语码转换媒体中情感分类的综合基准。结果表明，在这种具有挑战性的低资源环境中，特定于语言的预训练与有针对性的增强相结合可以产生最准确和最值得信赖的预测。

## 同声传译 (43 篇)

title: Locate-and-Focus: Enhancing Terminology Translation in Speech Language Models
abstract_en: Direct speech translation (ST) has garnered increasing attention nowadays, yet the accurate translation of terminology within utterances remains a great challenge. In this regard, current studies mainly concentrate on leveraging various translation knowledge into ST models. However, these methods often struggle with interference from irrelevant noise and can not fully utilize the translation knowledge. To address these issues, in this paper, we propose a novel Locate-and-Focus method for terminology translation. It first effectively locates the speech clips containing terminologies within the utterance to construct translation knowledge, minimizing irrelevant information for the ST model. Subsequently, it associates the translation knowledge with the utterance and hypothesis from both audio and textual modalities, allowing the ST model to better focus on translation knowledge during translation. Experimental results across various datasets demonstrate that our method effectively locates terminologies within utterances and enhances the success rate of terminology translation, while maintaining robust general translation performance.
abstract_zh: 直接语音翻译（ST）如今受到越来越多的关注，但准确翻译话语中的术语仍然是一个巨大的挑战。在这方面，当前的研究主要集中在将各种翻译知识运用到 ST 模型中。然而，这些方法常常受到不相关噪声的干扰，并且不能充分利用翻译知识。为了解决这些问题，在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的术语翻译定位和聚焦方法。它首先有效地定位话语中包含术语的语音片段来构建翻译知识，最大限度地减少 ST 模型的不相关信息。随后，它将翻译知识与音频和文本模态的话语和假设相关联，使 ST 模型在翻译过程中更好地关注翻译知识。各种数据集的实验结果表明，我们的方法可以有效地定位话语中的术语，提高术语翻译的成功率，同时保持稳健的总体翻译性能。

title: SimulS2S-LLM: Unlocking Simultaneous Inference of SpeechLLMs for Speech-to-Speech Translation
abstract_en: Simultaneous speech translation (SST) outputs translations in parallel with streaming speech input, balancing translation quality and latency. While large language models (LLMs) have been extended to handle the speech modality, streaming remains challenging as speech is pre-pended as a prompt for the entire generation process. To unlock LLM streaming capability, this paper proposes SimulS2S-LLM, which trains speech LLMs offline and employs a test-time policy to guide simultaneous inference. SimulS2S-LLM alleviates the mismatch between training and inference by extracting boundary-aware speech prompts that allows it to be better matched with text input data. SimulS2S-LLM achieves simultaneous speech-to-speech translation (Simul-S2ST) by predicting discrete output speech tokens and then synthesising output speech using a pre-trained vocoder. An incremental beam search is designed to expand the search space of speech token prediction without increasing latency. Experiments on the CVSS speech data show that SimulS2S-LLM offers a better translation quality-latency trade-off than existing methods that use the same training data, such as improving ASR-BLEU scores by 3 points at similar latency.
abstract_zh: 同步语音翻译 (SST) 与流式语音输入并行输出翻译，平衡翻译质量和延迟。虽然大型语言模型 (LLM) 已扩展到处理语音模态，但流式处理仍然具有挑战性，因为语音是预先作为整个生成过程的提示的。为了解锁 LLM 流功能，本文提出了 SimulS2S-LLM，它可以离线训练语音 LLM，并采用测试时间策略来指导同时推理。 SimulS2S-LLM 通过提取边界感知语音提示来减轻训练和推理之间的不匹配，使其能够更好地与文本输入数据匹配。 SimulS2S-LLM 通过预测离散输出语音标记，然后使用预先训练的声码器合成输出语音，实现同步语音到语音翻译 (Simul-S2ST)。增量波束搜索旨在扩展语音标记预测的搜索空间而不增加延迟。对 CVSS 语音数据的实验表明，与使用相同训练数据的现有方法相比，SimulS2S-LLM 提供了更好的翻译质量-延迟权衡，例如在类似延迟下将 ASR-BLEU 分数提高了 3 个百分点。

title: Soundwave: Less is More for Speech-Text Alignment inLLMs
abstract_en: Existing end-to-end speech large language models (LLMs) usually rely on large-scale annotated data for training, while data-efficient training has not been discussed in depth. We focus on two fundamental problems between speech and text: the representation space gap and sequence length inconsistency. We propose Soundwave, which utilizes an efficient training strategy and a novel architecture to address these issues. Results show that Soundwave outperforms other advanced speech LLMs in speech translation and AIR-Bench speech tasks with only a fraction of the training data. Further analysis shows that Soundwave still retains its intelligence during conversation.
abstract_zh: 现有的端到端语音大语言模型（LLM）通常依赖于大规模注释数据进行训练，而数据高效的训练尚未得到深入讨论。我们关注语音和文本之间的两个基本问题：表示空间间隙和序列长度不一致。我们提出了 Soundwave，它利用高效的训练策略和新颖的架构来解决这些问题。结果表明，Soundwave 在仅使用一小部分训练数据的语音翻译和 AIR-Bench 语音任务中优于其他高级语音大语言模型。进一步分析表明，Soundwave 在对话过程中仍然保留了其智能性。

title: Improving Language and Modality Transfer in Translation by Character-level Modeling
abstract_en: Current translation systems, despite being highly multilingual, cover only 5% of the world’s languages. Expanding language coverage to the long-tail of low-resource languages requires data-efficient methods that rely on cross-lingual and cross-modal knowledge transfer. To this end, we propose a character-based approach to improve adaptability to new languages and modalities. Our method leverages SONAR, a multilingual fixed-size embedding space with different modules for encoding and decoding. We use a teacher-student approach with parallel translation data to obtain a character-level encoder. Then, using ASR data, we train a lightweight adapter to connect a massively multilingual CTC ASR model (MMS), to the character-level encoder, potentially enabling speech translation from 1,000+ languages. Experimental results in text translation for 75 languages on FLORES+ demonstrate that our character-based approach can achieve better language transfer than traditional subword-based models, especially outperforming them in low-resource settings, and demonstrating better zero-shot generalizability to unseen languages. Our speech adaptation, maximizing knowledge transfer from the text modality, achieves state-of-the-art results in speech-to-text translation on the FLEURS benchmark on 33 languages, surpassing previous supervised and cascade models, albeit being a zero-shot model with minimal supervision from ASR data.
abstract_zh: 当前的翻译系统尽管具有高度多语言性，但仅涵盖世界语言的 5%。将语言覆盖范围扩大到低资源语言的长尾需要依赖于跨语言和跨模式知识转移的数据高效方法。为此，我们提出了一种基于字符的方法来提高对新语言和模式的适应性。我们的方法利用 SONAR，这是一种多语言固定大小的嵌入空间，具有不同的编码和解码模块。我们使用师生方法和并行翻译数据来获得字符级编码器。然后，使用 ASR 数据，我们训练一个轻量级适配器，将大规模多语言 CTC ASR 模型 (MMS) 连接到字符级编码器，从而有可能实现 1,000 多种语言的语音翻译。 FLORES+ 上 75 种语言的文本翻译实验结果表明，我们基于字符的方法可以比传统的基于子词的模型实现更好的语言迁移，特别是在资源匮乏的环境中优于它们，并展示了对未见过的语言更好的零样本泛化性。我们的语音适应最大化了文本模态的知识转移，在 33 种语言的 FLEURS 基准上实现了最先进的语音到文本翻译结果，超越了之前的监督和级联模型，尽管它是一个零样本模型，来自 ASR 数据的监督最少。

title: Towards Building Large Scale Datasets and State-of-the-Art Automatic Speech Translation Systems for 14Indian Languages
abstract_en: Speech translation for Indian languages remains a challenging task due to the scarcity of large-scale, publicly available datasets that capture the linguistic diversity and domain coverage essential for real-world applications. Existing datasets cover a fraction of Indian languages and lack the breadth needed to train robust models that generalize beyond curated benchmarks. To bridge this gap, we introduce BhasaAnuvaad, the largest speech translation dataset for Indian languages, spanning over 44 thousand hours of audio and 17 million aligned text segments across 14 Indian languages and English. Our dataset is built through a threefold methodology: (a) aggregating high-quality existing sources, (b) large-scale web crawling to ensure linguistic and domain diversity, and (c) creating synthetic data to model real-world speech disfluencies. Leveraging BhasaAnuvaad, we train IndicSeamless, a state-of-the-art speech translation model for Indian languages that performs better than existing models. Our experiments demonstrate improvements in the translation quality, setting a new standard for Indian language speech translation. We will release all the code, data and model weights in the open-source, with permissive licenses to promote accessibility and collaboration.
abstract_zh: 印度语言的语音翻译仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为缺乏大规模、公开可用的数据集来捕获现实世界应用所必需的语言多样性和领域覆盖范围。现有的数据集涵盖了印度语言的一小部分，并且缺乏训练强大模型所需的广度，这些模型无法泛化到策划的基准之外。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了 BhasaAnuvaad，这是最大的印度语言语音翻译数据集，涵盖 14 种印度语言和英语的超过 44000 小时的音频和 1700 万个对齐的文本片段。我们的数据集是通过三重方法构建的：（a）聚合高质量的现有来源，（b）大规模网络爬行以确保语言和领域的多样性，以及（c）创建合成数据以模拟现实世界的语音不流畅。利用 BhasaAnuvaad，我们训练了 IndicSeamless，这是一种最先进的印度语言语音翻译模型，其性能比现有模型更好。我们的实验证明了翻译质量的提高，为印度语言语音翻译设立了新标准。我们将以开源方式发布所有代码、数据和模型权重，并提供许可以促进可访问性和协作。

title: Different Speech Translation Models Encode and Translate Speaker Gender Differently
abstract_en: Recent studies on interpreting the hidden states of speech models have shown their ability to capture speaker-specific features, including gender. Does this finding also hold for speech translation (ST) models? If so, what are the implications for the speaker’s gender assignment in translation? We address these questions from an interpretability perspective, using probing methods to assess gender encoding across diverse ST models. Results on three language directions (English→French/Italian/Spanish) indicate that while traditional encoder-decoder models capture gender information, newer architectures—integrating a speech encoder with a machine translation system via adapters—do not. We also demonstrate that low gender encoding capabilities result in systems’ tendency toward a masculine default, a translation bias that is more pronounced in newer architectures.
abstract_zh: 最近关于解释语音模型隐藏状态的研究表明，它们能够捕获特定于说话者的特征，包括性别。这一发现是否也适用于语音翻译 (ST) 模型？如果是这样，对翻译中说话者的性别分配有何影响？我们从可解释性的角度解决这些问题，使用探究方法来评估不同 ST 模型中的性别编码。三种语言方向（英语→法语/意大利语/西班牙语）的结果表明，虽然传统的编码器-解码器模型可以捕获性别信息，但较新的架构（通过适配器将语音编码器与机器翻译系统集成）却不能。我们还证明，低性别编码能力会导致系统倾向于男性默认，这种翻译偏差在较新的架构中更为明显。

title: MERaLiON-AudioLLM: Advancing Speech and Language Understanding forSingapore
abstract_en: We introduce MERaLiON-AudioLLM, the first general-purpose audio-based large language model designed for multitask learning, with a particular focus on Singlish understanding. Trained on 62 million multimodal instruction samples comprising a total of 260k hours of audio, it exhibits strong generalization across a diverse set of tasks, including—but not limited to—automatic speech recognition, spoken question answering, speech translation, and paralinguistic analysis. Our results show significant improvements in local speech recognition and task-specific understanding, making MERaLiON-AudioLLM a leading solution for region-specific AI applications. An interactive demo has been developed to enable user-friendly interactions, supported by a backend with customized caching and load-balancing mechanisms. We benchmark the model across a broad range of multilingual and multitask scenarios, where it demonstrates competitive performance compared to other open-source models. The demo page, model weights and videos are publically accessible.
abstract_zh: 我们推出 MERaLiON-AudioLLM，这是第一个通用的基于音频的大语言模型，专为多任务学习而设计，特别关注新加坡式英语的理解。它经过 6200 万个多模式指令样本（总共 26 万小时的音频）的训练，在多种任务中表现出强大的泛化能力，包括但不限于自动语音识别、口语问答、语音翻译和副语言分析。我们的结果显示本地语音识别和特定任务理解方面有了显着改进，使 MERaLiON-AudioLLM 成为特定区域人工智能应用的领先解决方案。我们开发了一个交互式演示，以实现用户友好的交互，并由具有定制缓存和负载平衡机制的后端支持。我们在广泛的多语言和多任务场景中对模型进行了基准测试，与其他开源模型相比，它表现出了具有竞争力的性能。演示页面、模型权重和视频均可公开访问。

title: MultiMed: Multilingual Medical Speech Recognition via Attention Encoder Decoder
abstract_en: Multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) in the medical domain serves as a foundational task for various downstream applications such as speech translation, spoken language understanding, and voice-activated assistants. This technology improves patient care by enabling efficient communication across language barriers, alleviating specialized workforce shortages, and facilitating improved diagnosis and treatment, particularly during pandemics. In this work, we introduce MultiMed, the first multilingual medical ASR dataset, along with the first collection of small-to-large end-to-end medical ASR models, spanning five languages: Vietnamese, English, German, French, and Mandarin Chinese. To our best knowledge, MultiMed stands as the world’s largest medical ASR dataset across all major benchmarks: total duration, number of recording conditions, number of accents, and number of speaking roles. Furthermore, we present the first multilinguality study for medical ASR, which includes reproducible empirical baselines, a monolinguality-multilinguality analysis, Attention Encoder Decoder (AED) vs Hybrid comparative study and a linguistic analysis. We present practical ASR end-to-end training schemes optimized for a fixed number of trainable parameters that are common in industry settings. All code, data, and models are available online.
abstract_zh: 医疗领域的多语言自动语音识别（ASR）是语音翻译、口语理解和声控助手等各种下游应用的基础任务。该技术可以跨越语言障碍进行有效沟通，缓解专业劳动力短缺，并促进改善诊断和治疗，特别是在流行病期间，从而改善患者护理。在这项工作中，我们介绍了第一个多语言医学 ASR 数据集 MultiMed，以及第一个从小到大的端到端医学 ASR 模型集合，涵盖五种语言：越南语、英语、德语、法语和普通话。据我们所知，MultiMed 是世界上最大的医学 ASR 数据集，涵盖所有主要基准：总持续时间、录音条件数量、口音数量和说话角色数量。此外，我们提出了第一个医学 ASR 多语言研究，其中包括可重复的经验基线、单语言-多语言分析、注意力编码器解码器 (AED) 与混合比较研究和语言分析。我们提出了实用的 ASR 端到端训练方案，针对行业环境中常见的固定数量的可训练参数进行了优化。所有代码、数据和模型均可在线获取。

title: Leveraging Unit Language Guidance to Advance Speech Modeling in Textless Speech-to-Speech Translation
abstract_en: The success of building textless speech-to-speech translation (S2ST) models has attracted much attention. However, S2ST still faces two main challenges: 1) extracting linguistic features for various speech signals, called cross-modal (CM), and 2) learning alignment of difference languages in long sequences, called cross-lingual (CL). We propose the unit language to overcome the two modeling challenges. The unit language can be considered a text-like representation format, constructed usingn-gram language modeling. We implement multi-task learning to utilize the unit language in guiding the speech modeling process. Our initial results reveal a conflict when applying source and target unit languages simultaneously. We propose task prompt modeling to mitigate this conflict. We conduct experiments on four languages of the Voxpupil dataset. Our method demonstrates significant improvements over a strong baseline and achieves performance comparable to models trained with text.
abstract_zh: 无文本语音到语音翻译（S2ST）模型的成功构建引起了广泛关注。然而，S2ST 仍然面临两个主要挑战：1）提取各种语音信号的语言特征，称为跨模态（CM）；2）学习长序列中不同语言的对齐，称为跨语言（CL）。我们提出单元语言来克服两个建模挑战。单元语言可以被认为是一种类似文本的表示格式，使用 n-gram 语言建模构建。我们实现多任务学习，利用单元语言来指导语音建模过程。我们的初步结果表明，同时应用源单元语言和目标单元语言时存在冲突。我们提出任务提示建模来缓解这种冲突。我们对 Voxpupil 数据集的四种语言进行了实验。我们的方法在强大的基线上展示了显着的改进，并实现了与使用文本训练的模型相当的性能。

title: InfiniSST: Simultaneous Translation of Unbounded Speech with Large Language Model
abstract_en: Simultaneous translation of unbounded streaming speech remains a challenging problem due to the need for effectively processing the historical speech context and past translations so that quality and latency, including computation overhead, can be balanced. Most prior works assume pre-segmented speech, limiting their real-world applicability. In this paper, we propose InfiniSST, a novel approach that formulates SST as a multi-turn dialogue task, enabling seamless translation of unbounded speech. We construct translation trajectories and robust segments from MuST-C with multi-latency augmentation during training and develop a key-value (KV) cache management strategy to facilitate efficient inference. Experiments on MuST-C En-Es, En-De, and En-Zh demonstrate that InfiniSST reduces computation-aware latency by 0.5 to 1 second while maintaining the same translation quality compared to baselines. Ablation studies further validate the contributions of our data construction and cache management strategy. Code is released at https://github.com/LeiLiLab/InfiniSST.
abstract_zh: 无界流语音的同声翻译仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题，因为需要有效地处理历史语音上下文和过去的翻译，以便平衡质量和延迟（包括计算开销）。大多数先前的作品都采用预先分段的语音，限制了它们在现实世界中的适用性。在本文中，我们提出了 InfiniSST，这是一种将 SST 制定为多轮对话任务的新颖方法，从而实现无界语音的无缝翻译。我们在训练期间通过多延迟增强从 MuST-C 构建翻译轨迹和稳健片段，并开发键值 (KV) 缓存管理策略以促进高效推理。 MuST-C En-Es、En-De 和 En-Zh 上的实验表明，与基线相比，InfiniSST 将计算感知延迟减少了 0.5 到 1 秒，同时保持相同的翻译质量。消融研究进一步验证了我们的数据构建和缓存管理策略的贡献。代码发布于 https://github.com/LeiLiLab/InfiniSST。

title: Contrastive Learning for Task-IndependentSpeechLLM-Pretraining
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) excel in natural language processing but adapting these LLMs to speech processing tasks efficiently is not straightforward. Direct task-specific fine-tuning is limited by overfitting risks, data requirements, and computational costs. To address these challenges, we propose a scalable, two-stage training approach: (1) A task-independent speech pretraining stage using contrastive learning to align text and speech representations over all layers, followed by (2) a task-specific fine-tuning stage requiring minimal data. This approach outperforms traditional ASR pretraining and enables the model to surpass models specialized on speech translation and question answering while being trained on only 10% of the task-specific data.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在自然语言处理方面表现出色，但使这些 LLM 有效地适应语音处理任务并不简单。直接针对特定任务的微调受到过度拟合风险、数据要求和计算成本的限制。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种可扩展的两阶段训练方法：（1）独立于任务的语音预训练阶段，使用对比学习来对齐所有层上的文本和语音表示，然后是（2）需要最少数据的特定于任务的微调阶段。这种方法优于传统的 ASR 预训练，并使模型超越专门用于语音翻译和问答的模型，同时仅使用 10% 的特定任务数据进行训练。

title: DoCIA: An Online Document-Level Context Incorporation Agent for Speech Translation
abstract_en: Document-level context is crucial for handling discourse challenges in text-to-text document-level machine translation (MT). Despite the increased discourse challenges introduced by noise from automatic speech recognition (ASR), the integration of document-level context in speech translation (ST) remains insufficiently explored. In this paper, we develop DoCIA, an online framework that enhances ST performance by incorporating document-level context. DoCIA decomposes the ST pipeline into four stages. Document-level context is integrated into the ASR refinement, MT, and MT refinement stages through auxiliary LLM (large language model)-based modules. Furthermore, DoCIA leverages document-level information in a multi-level manner while minimizing computational overhead. Additionally, a simple yet effective determination mechanism is introduced to prevent hallucinations from excessive refinement, ensuring the reliability of the final results. Experimental results show that DoCIA significantly outperforms traditional ST baselines in both sentence and discourse metrics across four LLMs, demonstrating its effectiveness in improving ST performance.
abstract_zh: 文档级上下文对于处理文本到文本文档级机器翻译 (MT) 中的话语挑战至关重要。尽管自动语音识别 (ASR) 的噪声带来了越来越多的话语挑战，但语音翻译 (ST) 中文档级上下文的集成仍然没有得到充分探索。在本文中，我们开发了 DoCIA，这是一个通过合并文档级上下文来增强 ST 性能的在线框架。 DoCIA 将 ST 管道分解为四个阶段。文档级上下文通过基于 LLM（大语言模型）的辅助模块集成到 ASR 细化、MT 和 MT 细化阶段。此外，DoCIA 以多层次的方式利用文档级信息，同时最大限度地减少计算开销。此外，还引入了简单而有效的判定机制，防止过度细化产生幻觉，保证最终结果的可靠性。实验结果表明，在四个大语言模型中，DoCIA 在句子和话语指标方面均显着优于传统 ST 基线，证明了其在提高 ST 性能方面的有效性。

title: Going Beyond Your Expectations in Latency Metrics for Simultaneous Speech Translation
abstract_en: Current evaluation practices in Simultaneous Speech Translation (SimulST) systems typically involve segmenting the input audio and corresponding translations, calculating quality and latency metrics for each segment, and averaging the results. Although this approach may provide a reliable estimation of translation quality, it can lead to misleading values of latency metrics due to an inherent assumption that average latency values are good enough estimators of SimulST systems’ response time. However, our detailed analysis of latency evaluations for state-of-the-art SimulST systems demonstrates that latency distributions are often skewed and subject to extreme variations. As a result, the mean in latency metrics fails to capture these anomalies, potentially masking the lack of robustness in some systems and metrics. In this paper, a thorough analysis of the results of systems submitted to recent editions of the IWSLT simultaneous track is provided to support our hypothesis and alternative ways to report latency metrics are proposed in order to provide a better understanding of SimulST systems’ latency.
abstract_zh: 当前同步语音翻译 (SimulST) 系统中的评估实践通常涉及对输入音频和相应的翻译进行分段、计算每个分段的质量和延迟指标并对结果求平均值。尽管这种方法可以提供可靠的翻译质量估计，但由于平均延迟值足以很好地估计 SimulST 系统响应时间的固有假设，它可能会导致延迟指标值产生误导。然而，我们对最先进的 SimulST 系统的延迟评估的详细分析表明，延迟分布通常是倾斜的，并且会出现极大的变化。因此，延迟指标的平均值无法捕获这些异常情况，可能掩盖了某些系统和指标缺乏稳健性的情况。在本文中，对提交到最新版本的 IWSLT 同时跟踪的系统结果进行了全面分析，以支持我们的假设，并提出了报告延迟指标的替代方法，以便更好地了解 SimulST 系统的延迟。

title: Improving Word Alignment Using Semi-Supervised Learning
abstract_en: Word alignment plays a crucial role in various natural language processing tasks, such as serving as cross-lingual signals for sentence embedding, reducing hallucination and omission in machine translation, and facilitating the construction of training data for simultaneous speech translation.Current state-of-the-art approaches usually rely on: (1) supervised data and large-scale weakly supervised data constructed from Wikipedia and (2) multilingual Transformer encoder-based models.However, we find that the current state-of-the-art encoder-based method, BinaryAlign, suffers from the issue of insufficient labeled data, and we further improve it with self-training with a small amount of parallel data. In addition, considering the impressive performance of multilingual large language models on many natural language processing tasks, we also explore the possibility of using these decoder-based large language models as word aligners. We observe that although fine-tuning large language models with labeled data produces acceptable results, augmenting the training with pseudo-labeled data further enhances model performance. Based on the findings, we propose a semi-supervised framework to improve the large language model-based word aligners. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method with a small amount of parallel data outperforms the current state-of-the-art method on various word alignment datasets.
abstract_zh: 词对齐在各种自然语言处理任务中起着至关重要的作用，例如作为句子嵌入的跨语言信号，减少机器翻译中的幻觉和遗漏，以及促进同步语音翻译训练数据的构建。当前最先进的方法通常依赖于：（1）从维基百科构建的监督数据和大规模弱监督数据和（2）基于多语言 Transformer 编码器的模型。然而，我们发现当前最先进的方法基于编码器的方法 BinaryAlign 存在标记数据不足的问题，我们通过少量并行数据的自训练进一步改进了它。此外，考虑到多语言大语言模型在许多自然语言处理任务上的令人印象深刻的性能，我们还探索了使用这些基于解码器的大语言模型作为单词对齐器的可能性。我们观察到，尽管使用标记数据微调大型语言模型会产生可接受的结果，但使用伪标记数据增强训练可以进一步增强模型性能。基于这些发现，我们提出了一个半监督框架来改进基于大型语言模型的单词对齐器。实验结果表明，所提出的具有少量并行数据的方法在各种单词对齐数据集上优于当前最先进的方法。

title: Streaming Sequence Transduction through Dynamic Compression
abstract_en: We introduce STAR (Stream Transduction with Anchor Representations), a novel Transformer-based model designed for efficient sequence-to-sequence transduction over streams. STAR dynamically segments input streams to create compressed anchor representations, achieving nearly lossless (12x) compression in Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and outperforming existing methods. Moreover, STAR demonstrates superior segmentation and latency-quality trade-offs in simultaneous Speech Translation, optimizing latency, memory footprint, and quality.
