abstract_zh: 我们引入了 STAR（带有锚点表示的流转导），这是一种基于 Transformer 的新颖模型，旨在通过流进行高效的序列到序列转导。 STAR 动态分段输入流以创建压缩的锚点表示，在自动语音识别 (ASR) 中实现近乎无损 (12 倍) 的压缩，并且性能优于现有方法。此外，STAR 在同步语音翻译、优化延迟、内存占用和质量方面展示了卓越的分段和延迟质量权衡。

title: Effects of automatic alignment on speech translation metrics
abstract_en: Research in speech translation (ST) often operates in a setting where human segmentations of the input audio are provided. This simplifying assumption avoids the evaluation-time difficulty of aligning the translated outputs to their references for segment-level evaluation, but it also means that the systems are not evaluated as they will be used in production settings, where automatic audio segmentation is an unavoidable component. A tool, mwerSegmenter, exists for aligning ST output to references, but its behavior is noisy and not well understood. We address this with an investigation of the effects automatic alignment on metric correlation with system-level human judgments; that is, as a metrics task. Using the eleven language tasks from the WMT24 data, we merge each system’s output at the domain level, align them to the references, compute metrics, and evaluate the correlation with the human system-level rankings. In addition to expanding analysis to many target languages, we also experiment with different subword models and with the generation of additional paraphrases. We find that automatic realignment has minimal effect on COMET-level system rankings, with accuracies still way above BLEU scores from manual segmentations. In the process, we also bring the community’s attention to the source code for the tool, which we have updated, modernized, and realized as a Python module, mweralign.
abstract_zh: 语音翻译 (ST) 的研究通常在提供输入音频的人工分段的环境中进行。这种简化的假设避免了将翻译后的输出与其参考进行对齐以进行分段级评估的评估时间困难，但这也意味着系统不会被评估，因为它们将在生产环境中使用，其中自动音频分段是不可避免的组件。 mwerSegmenter 是一个用于将 ST 输出与参考对齐的工具，但其行为噪音较大且不易理解。我们通过调查自动对齐对系统级人类判断的度量相关性的影响来解决这个问题；也就是说，作为度量任务。使用 WMT24 数据中的 11 种语言任务，我们在域级别合并每个系统的输出，将它们与参考文献对齐，计算指标，并评估与人类系统级别排名的相关性。除了将分析扩展到许多目标语言之外，我们还尝试了不同的子词模型并生成额外的释义。我们发现自动重新调整对 COMET 级系统排名的影响很小，准确度仍然远高于手动分割的 BLEU 分数。在此过程中，我们还引起了社区对该工具源代码的关注，我们已对其源代码进行了更新、现代化并实现为 Python 模块 mweralign。

title: ConversationalSimulMT: Efficient Simultaneous Translation with Large Language Models
abstract_en: Simultaneous machine translation (SimulMT) presents a challenging trade-off between translation quality and latency. Recent studies have shown that LLMs can achieve good performance in SimulMT tasks. However, this often comes at the expense of high inference costs and latency. In this paper, we propose a conversational SimulMT framework to enhance the inference efficiency of LLM-based SimulMT through multi-turn-dialogue-based decoding where source and target chunks interleave in translation history, enabling the reuse of Key-Value cache. To adapt LLMs to the proposed conversational decoding, we create supervised fine-tuning training data by segmenting parallel sentences using an alignment tool and a novel augmentation technique to enhance generalization. Our experiments with Llama2-7b-chat on three SimulMT benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method empowers the superiority of LLM in translation quality, meanwhile achieving comparable computational latency with specialized SimulMT models.
abstract_zh: 同步机器翻译 (SimulMT) 在翻译质量和延迟之间提出了具有挑战性的权衡。最近的研究表明，大语言模型可以在 SimulMT 任务中取得良好的表现。然而，这通常是以高推理成本和延迟为代价的。在本文中，我们提出了一种会话式 SimulMT 框架，通过基于多轮对话的解码来提高基于 LLM 的 SimulMT 的推理效率，其中源块和目标块在翻译历史中交错，从而实现键值缓存的重用。为了使 LLM 适应所提出的会话解码，我们通过使用对齐工具和新颖的增强技术分割并行句子来创建有监督的微调训练数据，以增强泛化能力。我们在三个 SimulMT 基准上使用 Llama2-7b-chat 进行的实验表明，所提出的方法增强了 LLM 在翻译质量方面的优势，同时实现了与专门的 SimulMT 模型相当的计算延迟。

title: Kuvost: A Large-Scale Human-AnnotatedEnglish toCentralKurdish Speech Translation Dataset Driven fromEnglish Common Voice
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce the Kuvost, a large-scale English to Central Kurdish speech-to-text-translation (S2TT) dataset. This dataset includes 786k utterances derived from Common Voice 18, translated and revised by 230 volunteers into Central Kurdish. Encompassing 1,003 hours of translated speech, this dataset can play a groundbreaking role for Central Kurdish, which severely lacks public-domain resources for speech translation. Following the dataset division in Common Voice, there are 298k, 6,226, and 7,253 samples in the train, development, and test sets, respectively. The dataset is evaluated on end-to-end English-to-Kurdish S2TT using Whisper V3 Large and SeamlessM4T V2 Large models. The dataset is available under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International License https://huggingface.co/datasets/aranemini/kuvost.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了 Kuvost，这是一个大规模的英语到中部库尔德语语音到文本翻译 (S2TT) 数据集。该数据集包括来自 Common Voice 18 的 786k 话语，由 230 名志愿者翻译和修订为中库尔德语。该数据集包含 1,003 小时的翻译语音，对于严重缺乏语音翻译公共领域资源的中库尔德语来说可以发挥开创性作用。按照 Common Voice 中的数据集划分，训练集、开发集和测试集分别有 298k、6,226 和 7,253 个样本。该数据集使用 Whisper V3 Large 和 SeamlessM4T V2 Large 模型在端到端英语到库尔德语 S2TT 上进行评估。该数据集可根据 Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 国际许可证 https://huggingface.co/datasets/aranemini/kuvost 获取。

title: Human-EvaluatedUrdu-English Speech Corpus: Advancing Speech-to-Text for Low-Resource Languages
abstract_en: This paper presents our contribution to the IWSLT Low Resource Track 2: ‘Training and Evaluation Data Track’. We share a human-evaluated Urdu-English speech-to-text corpus based on Common Voice 13.0 Urdu speech corpus. We followed a three-tier validation scheme which involves an initial automatic translation with corrections from native reviewers, full review by evaluators followed by final validation from a bilingual expert ensuring reliable corpus for subsequent NLP tasks. Our contribution, CV-UrEnST corpus, enriches Urdu speech resources by contributing the first Urdu-English speech-to-text corpus. When evaluated with Whisper-medium, the corpus yielded a significant improvement to the vanilla model in terms of BLEU, chrF++, and COMET scores, demonstrating its effectiveness for speech translation tasks.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们对 IWSLT 低资源轨道 2 的贡献：“培训和评估数据轨道”。我们共享基于 Common Voice 13.0 乌尔都语语音语料库的人工评估乌尔都语-英语语音转文本语料库。我们遵循三层验证方案，其中包括初始自动翻译和本地审稿人的更正，评估人员的全面审阅，然后是双语专家的最终验证，确保后续 NLP 任务的语料库可靠。我们的贡献 CV-UrEnST 语料库通过提供第一个乌尔都语-英语语音到文本语料库丰富了乌尔都语语音资源。当使用 Whisper-medium 进行评估时，该语料库在 BLEU、chrF++ 和 COMET 分数方面比普通模型有了显着改进，证明了其在语音翻译任务中的有效性。

title: FFSTC2: Extending the Fongbe toFrench Speech Translation Corpus
abstract_en: This paper introduced FFSTC 2, an expanded version of the existing Fongbe-to-French speech translation corpus, addressing the critical need for resources in African dialects for speech recognition and translation tasks. We extended the dataset by adding 36 hours of transcribed audio, bringing the total to 61 hours, thereby enhancing its utility for both automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech translation (ST) in Fongbe, a low-resource language. Using this enriched corpus, we developed both cascade and end-to-end speech translation systems. Our models employ AfriHuBERT and HuBERT147, two speech encoders specialized to African languages, and the NLLB and mBART models as decoders. We also investigate the use of the SAMU-XLSR approach to inject sentence-level semantic information to the XSLR-128 model used as an alternative speech encoder. We also introduced a novel diacritic-substitution technique for ASR, which, when combined with NLLB, enables a cascade model to achieve a BLEU score of 37.23 ompared to 39.60 obtained by the best system using original diacritics. Among the end-to-end architectures evaluated, the architectures with data augmentation and NLLB as decoder achieved the highest score respectively, SAMU-NLLB scored the BLEU score of 28.43.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 FFSTC 2，它是现有 Fongbe 到法语语音翻译语料库的扩展版本，解决了语音识别和翻译任务对非洲方言资源的迫切需求。我们通过添加 36 小时的转录音频来扩展数据集，使总时长达到 61 小时，从而增强了其在 Fongbe（一种低资源语言）中的自动语音识别 (ASR) 和语音翻译 (ST) 方面的实用性。利用这个丰富的语料库，我们开发了级联和端到端语音翻译系统。我们的模型采用 AfriHuBERT 和 HuBERT147（两种专门针对非洲语言的语音编码器）以及 NLLB 和 mBART 模型作为解码器。我们还研究了使用 SAMU-XLSR 方法将句子级语义信息注入到用作替代语音编码器的 XSLR-128 模型中。我们还引入了一种新颖的 ASR 变音符号替换技术，该技术与 NLLB 相结合，使级联模型能够获得 37.23 的 BLEU 分数，而使用原始变音符号的最佳系统获得的 BLEU 分数为 39.60。在评估的端到端架构中，以数据增强和NLLB作为解码器的架构分别获得了最高分，SAMU-NLLB的BLEU得分为28.43。

title: HENT-SRT: Hierarchical Efficient Neural Transducer with Self-Distillation for Joint Speech Recognition and Translation
abstract_en: Neural transducers (NT) provide an effective framework for speech streaming, demonstrating strong performance in automatic speech recognition (ASR). However, the application of NT to speech translation (ST) remains challenging, as existing approaches struggle with word reordering and performance degradation when jointly modeling ASR and ST, resulting in a gap with attention-based encoder-decoder (AED) models. Existing NT-based ST approaches also suffer from high computational training costs. To address these issues, we propose HENT-SRT (Hierarchical Efficient Neural Transducer for Speech Recognition and Translation), a novel framework that factorizes ASR and translation tasks to better handle reordering. To ensure robust ST while preserving ASR performance, we use self-distillation with CTC consistency regularization. Moreover, we improve computational efficiency by incorporating best practices from ASR transducers, including a down-sampled hierarchical encoder, a stateless predictor, and a pruned transducer loss to reduce training complexity. Finally, we introduce a blank penalty during decoding, reducing deletions and improving translation quality. Our approach is evaluated on three conversational datasets Arabic, Spanish, and Mandarin achieving new state-of-the-art performance among NT models and substantially narrowing the gap with AED-based systems.
abstract_zh: 神经换能器 (NT) 为语音流提供了有效的框架，在自动语音识别 (ASR) 方面展示了强大的性能。然而，NT 在语音翻译 (ST) 中的应用仍然具有挑战性，因为现有方法在联合建模 ASR 和 ST 时面临着单词重新排序和性能下降的问题，导致与基于注意力的编码器-解码器 (AED) 模型存在差距。现有的基于 NT 的 ST 方法也面临着高昂的计算训练成本。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 HENT-SRT（用于语音识别和翻译的分层高效神经换能器），这是一种新颖的框架，可以分解 ASR 和翻译任务以更好地处理重新排序。为了确保稳健的 ST，同时保持 ASR 性能，我们使用自蒸馏和 CTC 一致性正则化。此外，我们通过结合 ASR 传感器的最佳实践来提高计算效率，包括下采样分层编码器、无状态预测器和修剪传感器损失，以降低训练复杂性。最后，我们在解码过程中引入空白惩罚，减少删除并提高翻译质量。我们的方法在阿拉伯语、西班牙语和普通话三个会话数据集上进行了评估，在 NT 模型中实现了新的最先进的性能，并大大缩小了与基于 AED 的系统的差距。

title: SwissGerman Speech Translation and the Curse of Multidialectality
abstract_en: In many languages, non-standardized varieties make the development of NLP models challenging. This paper explores various fine-tuning techniques and data setups for training Swiss German to Standard German speech-to-text translation models. While fine-tuning on all available Swiss German data yields the best results, ASR pre-training lowers performance by 1.48 BLEU points, and jointly training on Swiss and Standard German data reduces it by 2.29 BLEU. Our dialect transfer experiments suggest that an equivalent of the Curse of Multilinguality (Conneau et al., 2020) exists in dialectal speech processing, as training on multiple dialects jointly tends to decrease single-dialect performance. However, introducing small amounts of dialectal variability can improve the performance for low-resource dialects.
abstract_zh: 在许多语言中，非标准化的品种使得 NLP 模型的开发具有挑战性。本文探讨了用于训练瑞士德语到标准德语语音到文本翻译模型的各种微调技术和数据设置。虽然对所有可用的瑞士德语数据进行微调可以产生最佳结果，但 ASR 预训练将性能降低了 1.48 BLEU 点，而对瑞士和标准德语数据进行联合训练则将性能降低了 2.29 BLEU。我们的方言迁移实验表明，方言语音处理中存在相当于多语言诅咒（Conneau et al., 2020）的情况，因为对多种方言的联合训练往往会降低单一方言的性能。然而，引入少量的方言变异可以提高低资源方言的性能。

title: NYA’s Offline Speech Translation System forIWSLT2025
abstract_en: This paper reports NYA’s submissions to the IWSLT 2025 Offline Speech Translation (ST) task. The task includes three translation directions: English to Chinese, German, and Arabic. In detail, we adopt a cascaded speech translation architecture comprising automatic speech recognition (ASR) and machine translation (MT) components to participate in the unconstrained training track. For the ASR model, we use the Whisper medium model. For the neural machine translation (NMT) model, the wider and deeper Transformer is adopted as the backbone model. Building upon last year’s work, we implement multiple techniques and strategies such as data augmentation, domain adaptation, and model ensemble to improve the translation quality of the NMT model. In addition, we adopt X-ALMA as the foundational LLM-based MT model, with domain-specific supervised fine-tuning applied to train and optimize our LLM-based MT model. Finally, by employing COMET-based Minimum Bayes Risk decoding to integrate and select translation candidates from both NMT and LLM-based MT systems, the translation quality of our ST system is significantly improved, and competitive results are obtained on the evaluation set.
abstract_zh: 本文报告了 NYA 对 IWSLT 2025 离线语音翻译 (ST) 任务的提交内容。任务包括三个翻译方向：英译汉、德文、阿拉伯文。具体来说，我们采用由自动语音识别（ASR）和机器翻译（MT）组件组成的级联语音翻译架构来参与无约束训练轨道。对于 ASR 模型，我们使用 Whisper 介质模型。对于神经机器翻译（NMT）模型，采用更宽、更深的 Transformer 作为主干模型。在去年工作的基础上，我们实施了多种技术和策略，例如数据增强、领域适应和模型集成，以提高 NMT 模型的翻译质量。此外，我们采用 X-ALMA 作为基础的基于 LLM 的 MT 模型，并应用特定领域的监督微调来训练和优化我们基于 LLM 的 MT 模型。最后，通过采用基于 COMET 的最小贝叶斯风险解码来集成和选择来自 NMT 和基于 LLM 的 MT 系统的翻译候选，我们的 ST 系统的翻译质量显着提高，并在评估集上获得了有竞争力的结果。

title: KIT’s Low-resource Speech Translation Systems forIWSLT2025: System Enhancement with Synthetic Data and Model Regularization
abstract_en: This paper presents KIT’s submissions to the IWSLT 2025 low-resource track. We develop both cascaded systems, consisting of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Machine Translation (MT) models, and end-to-end (E2E) Speech Translation (ST) systems for three language pairs: Bemba, North Levantine Arabic, and Tunisian Arabic into English. Building upon pre-trained models, we fine-tune our systems with different strategies to utilize resources efficiently. This study further explores system enhancement with synthetic data and model regularization. Specifically, we investigate MT-augmented ST by generating translations from ASR data using MT models. For North Levantine, which lacks parallel ST training data, a system trained solely on synthetic data slightly surpasses the cascaded system trained on real data. We also explore augmentation using text-to-speech models by generating synthetic speech from MT data, demonstrating the benefits of synthetic data in improving both ASR and ST performance for Bemba. Additionally, we apply intra-distillation to enhance model performance. Our experiments show that this approach consistently improves results across ASR, MT, and ST tasks, as well as across different pre-trained models. Finally, we apply Minimum Bayes Risk decoding to combine the cascaded and end-to-end systems, achieving an improvement of approximately 1.5 BLEU points.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 KIT 向 IWSLT 2025 低资源轨道提交的材料。我们开发了由自动语音识别 (ASR) 和机器翻译 (MT) 模型组成的级联系统，以及针对三种语言对的端到端 (E2E) 语音翻译 (ST) 系统：本巴语、北黎凡特阿拉伯语和突尼斯阿拉伯语翻译成英语。基于预先训练的模型，我们使用不同的策略微调我们的系统，以有效地利用资源。本研究进一步探索通过合成数据和模型正则化增强系统。具体来说，我们通过使用 MT 模型从 ASR 数据生成翻译来研究 MT 增强 ST。对于缺乏并行 ST 训练数据的北黎凡特来说，仅基于合成数据训练的系统略胜于基于真实数据训练的级联系统。我们还通过从 MT 数据生成合成语音来探索使用文本转语音模型的增强功能，展示了合成数据在提高 Bemba 的 ASR 和 ST 性能方面的优势。此外，我们应用内部蒸馏来增强模型性能。我们的实验表明，这种方法能够持续改善 ASR、MT 和 ST 任务以及不同预训练模型的结果。最后，我们应用最小贝叶斯风险解码来结合级联和端到端系统，实现大约 1.5 BLEU 点的改进。

title: AppTek’s Automatic Speech Translation: Generating Accurate and Well-Readable Subtitles
abstract_en: We describe AppTek’s submission to the subtitling track of the IWSLT 2025 evaluation. We enhance our cascaded speech translation approach by adapting the ASR and the MT models on in-domain data. All components, including intermediate steps such as subtitle source language template creation and line segmentation, are optimized to ensure that the resulting target language subtitles respect the subtitling constraints not only on the number of characters per line and the number of lines in each subtitle block, but also with respect to the desired reading speed. AppTek’s machine translation with length control plays the key role in this process, effectively condensing subtitles to these constraints. Our experiments show that this condensation results in high-quality translations that convey the most important information, as measured by metrics such as BLEU or BLEURT, as well as the primary metric subtitle edit rate (SubER).
abstract_zh: 我们描述了 AppTek 对 IWSLT 2025 评估字幕轨道的提交情况。我们通过在域内数据上调整 ASR 和 MT 模型来增强我们的级联语音翻译方法。所有组件，包括字幕源语言模板创建和行分割等中间步骤，都经过优化，以确保生成的目标语言字幕不仅遵守每行字符数和每个字幕块中行数的字幕约束，而且还遵守所需的阅读速度。 AppTek 具有长度控制功能的机器翻译在此过程中发挥了关键作用，有效地将字幕压缩到这些约束条件下。我们的实验表明，这种压缩会产生高质量的翻译，传达最重要的信息，通过 BLEU 或 BLEURT 等指标以及主要指标字幕编辑率 (SubER) 来衡量。

title: KIT’s Offline Speech Translation and Instruction Following Submission forIWSLT2025
abstract_en: In this paper, we present the submissions for the Offline ST and Instruction Following (IF) tracks, where we leverage LLMs to enhance performance across all tasks. For the Offline ST track, we propose a pipeline that employs multiple automatic speech recognition systems, whose outputs are fused using an LLM with document-level context. This is followed by a two-step translation process, incorporating additional contextual refinement step to improve translation quality. For the IF track, we develop an end-to-end model that integrates a speech encoder with an LLM to perform a wide range of instruction-following tasks. We complement it with a final document-level refinement stage to further enhance output quality by using contextual information.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了离线 ST 和指令跟踪 (IF) 轨道的提交内容，其中我们利用大语言模型来提高所有任务的性能。对于离线 ST 轨道，我们提出了一个采用多个自动语音识别系统的管道，其输出使用 LLM 与文档级上下文进行融合。接下来是两步翻译过程，结合额外的上下文细化步骤来提高翻译质量。对于 IF 轨道，我们开发了一个端到端模型，该模型将语音编码器与 LLM 集成，以执行各种指令跟踪任务。我们通过最终的文档级细化阶段对其进行补充，以通过使用上下文信息进一步提高输出质量。

title: ALADANatIWSLT25 Low-resourceArabic Dialectal Speech Translation Task
abstract_en: We present our IWSLT 2025 submission for the low-resource track on North Levantine Arabic to English speech translation, building on our IWSLT 2024 efforts. We retain last year’s cascade ASR architecture that combines a TDNN-F model and a Zipformer for the ASR step. We upgrade the Zipformer to the Zipformer-Large variant (253 M parameters vs. 66 M) to capture richer acoustic representations. For the MT part, to further alleviate data sparsity, we created a crowd-sourced parallel corpus covering five major Arabic dialects (Tunisian, Levantine, Moroccan, Algerian, Egyptian) curated via rigorous qualification and filtering. We show that using crowd-sourced data is feasible in low-resource scenarios as we observe improved automatic evaluation metrics across all dialects. We also experimented with the dataset under a high-resource scenario, where we had access to a large, high-quality Levantine Arabic corpus from LDC. In this setting, adding the crowd-sourced data does not improve the scores on the official validation set anymore. Our final submission scores 20.0 BLEU on the official test set.
abstract_zh: 我们在 IWSLT 2024 工作的基础上，针对北黎凡特阿拉伯语到英语语音翻译的低资源轨道提交了 IWSLT 2025 提交内容。我们保留了去年的级联 ASR 架构，该架构结合了 TDNN-F 模型和用于 ASR 步骤的 Zipformer。我们将 Zipformer 升级为 Zipformer-Large 变体（253 M 参数与 66 M 参数）以捕获更丰富的声学表征。对于机器翻译部分，为了进一步缓解数据稀疏性，我们通过严格的资格和过滤创建了一个涵盖五种主要阿拉伯方言（突尼斯语、黎凡特语、摩洛哥语、阿尔及利亚语、埃及语）的众包平行语料库。我们发现，在资源匮乏的情况下使用众包数据是可行的，因为我们观察到所有方言的自动评估指标都得到了改进。我们还在高资源场景下对数据集进行了实验，我们可以访问来自 LDC 的大型、高质量的黎凡特阿拉伯语语料库。在这种情况下，添加众包数据不会再提高官方验证集上的分数。我们的最终提交在官方测试集上得分为 20.0 BLEU。

title: QUESPASubmission for theIWSLT2025 Dialectal and Low-resource Speech Translation Task
abstract_en: This article describes the QUESPA team speech translation (ST) submissions for the Quechua to Spanish (QUE-SPA) track featured in the Evaluation Campaign of IWSLT 2025: dialectal and low-resource speech translation. This year, there is one main submission type supported in the campaign: unconstrained. This is our third year submitting our ST systems to the IWSLT shared task and we feel that we have achieved novel performance, surpassing last year’s submission. This year we submit three total unconstrained-only systems of which our best (contrastive 2) system uses last year’s best performing pre-trained language (PLM) model for ST (without cascading) and the inclusion of additional Quechua–Collao speech transcriptions found online. Fine-tuning of Microsoft’s SpeechT5 model in a ST setting along with the addition of new data and a data augmentation technique allowed us to achieve 26.7 BLEU. In this article, we present the three submissions along with a detailed description of the updated machine translation system where a comparison is done between synthetic, unconstrained, and other data for fine-tuning.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 QUESPA 团队针对 IWSLT 2025 评估活动中的克丘亚语到西班牙语 (QUE-SPA) 轨道的语音翻译 (ST) 提交内容：方言和低资源语音翻译。今年，活动支持一种主要提交类型：无约束。这是我们第三年向 IWSLT 共享任务提交我们的 ST 系统，我们觉得我们取得了新颖的表现，超越了去年的提交。今年，我们总共提交了三个无约束系统，其中我们最好的（对比 2）系统使用了去年性能最佳的 ST 预训练语言 (PLM) 模型（无级联），并包含了在线找到的额外 Quechua-Collao 语音转录。在 ST 设置中对 Microsoft SpeechT5 模型进行微调，并添加新数据和数据增强技术，使我们能够实现 26.7 BLEU。在本文中，我们介绍了三个提交内容以及更新后的机器翻译系统的详细描述，其中对合成数据、无约束数据和其他数据进行了比较以进行微调。

title: BUINUSatIWSLT: Evaluating the Impact of Data Augmentation andQLoRA-based Fine-Tuning forMaltese toEnglish Speech Translation
abstract_en: This paper investigates approaches for the IWSLT low-resource track, Track 1 (speech-to-text translation) for the Maltese language, focusing on data augmentation and large pre-trained models. Our system combines Whisper for transcription and NLLB for translation, with experiments concentrated mainly on the translation stage. We observe that data augmentation leads to only marginal improvements, primarily for the smaller 600M model, with gains up to 0.0026 COMET points. These gains do not extend to larger models like the 3.3B NLLB, and the overall impact appears somewhat inconsistent. In contrast, fine-tuning larger models using QLoRA outperforms full fine-tuning of smaller models. Moreover, multi-stage fine-tuning consistently improves task-specific performance across all model sizes.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了 IWSLT 低资源轨道、马耳他语言轨道 1（语音到文本翻译）的方法，重点关注数据增强和大型预训练模型。我们的系统结合了用于转录的 Whisper 和用于翻译的 NLLB，实验主要集中在翻译阶段。我们观察到数据增强仅带来了边际改进，主要是对于较小的 600M 模型，增益高达 0.0026 COMET 点。这些收益不会扩展到像 3.3B NLLB 这样的较大模型，而且总体影响似乎有些不一致。相比之下，使用 QLoRA 微调较大模型的效果优于对较小模型进行完全微调的效果。此外，多阶段微调持续提高所有模型大小的特定任务性能。

title: LIAandELYADATAsystems for theIWSLT2025 low-resource speech translation shared task
abstract_en: In this paper, we present the approach and system setup of our participation in the IWSLT 2025 low-resource speech translation shared task. We submitted systems for three language pairs, namely Tunisian Arabic to English, North Levantine Arabic to English, and Fongbé to French. Both pipeline and end-to-end speech translation systems were explored for Tunisian Arabic to English and Fongbé to French pairs. However, only pipeline approaches were investigated for the North Levantine Arabic–English translation direction. All our submissions are based on the usage of pre-trained models that we further fine-tune with the shared task training data.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了我们参与 IWSLT 2025 低资源语音翻译共享任务的方法和系统设置。我们提交了三种语言对的系统，即突尼斯阿拉伯语到英语、北黎凡特阿拉伯语到英语、以及 Fongbé 到法语。针对突尼斯阿拉伯语到英语和 Fongbé 到法语对探索了管道和端到端语音翻译系统。然而，仅对北黎凡特阿拉伯语-英语翻译方向的管道方法进行了研究。我们所有的提交都是基于预训练模型的使用，我们使用共享任务训练数据进一步微调这些模型。

title: CUNI-NL@IWSLT2025: End-to-end Offline Speech Translation and Instruction Following withLLMs
abstract_en: This paper describes the CUNI-NL team’s submission to the IWSLT 2025 Offline Speech Translation and Instruction Following tasks, focusing on transcribing the English audio, and translating the English audio to German text. Our systems follow the end-to-end approach, where each system consists of a pretrained, frozen speech encoder, along with a medium-sized large language model fine-tuned with LoRA on three tasks: 1) transcribing the English audio; 2) directly translating the English audio to German text; and 3) a combination of the above two tasks, i.e. simultaneously transcribing the English audio and translating the English audio to German text.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 CUNI-NL 团队提交的 IWSLT 2025 离线语音翻译和指令跟踪任务，重点是转录英语音频，并将英语音频翻译为德语文本。我们的系统遵循端到端方法，每个系统都包含一个预训练的冻结语音编码器，以及一个在三个任务上使用 LoRA 进行微调的中型大型语言模型：1）转录英语音频； 2）直接将英语音频翻译成德语文本； 3）上述两项任务的组合，即同时转录英语音频并将英语音频翻译成德语文本。

title: GMUSystems for theIWSLT2025 Low-Resource Speech Translation Shared Task
abstract_en: This paper describes the GMU systems for the IWSLT 2025 low-resource speech translation shared task. We trained systems for all language pairs, except for Levantine Arabic. We fine-tuned SeamlessM4T-v2 for automatic speech recognition (ASR), machine translation (MT), and end-to-end speech translation (E2E ST). The ASR and MT models are also used to form cascaded ST systems. Additionally, we explored various training paradigms for E2E ST fine-tuning, including direct E2E fine-tuning, multi-task training, and parameter initialization using components from fine-tuned ASR and/or MT models. Our results show that (1) direct E2E fine-tuning yields strong results; (2) initializing with a fine-tuned ASR encoder improves ST performance on languages SeamlessM4T-v2 has not been trained on; (3) multi-task training can be slightly helpful.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了用于 IWSLT 2025 低资源语音翻译共享任务的 GMU 系统。我们训练了除黎凡特阿拉伯语之外的所有语言对的系统。我们对 SeamlessM4T-v2 进行了微调，以实现自动语音识别 (ASR)、机器翻译 (MT) 和端到端语音翻译 (E2E ST)。 ASR和MT模型也用于形成级联ST系统。此外，我们还探索了 E2E ST 微调的各种训练范例，包括直接 E2E 微调、多任务训练以及使用微调 ASR 和/或 MT 模型的组件进行参数初始化。我们的结果表明（1）直接E2E微调产生了很好的结果； (2) 使用微调的 ASR 编码器进行初始化，提高了 SeamlessM4T-v2 尚未训练过的语言上的 ST 性能； (3) 多任务训练可能会有一点帮助。

title: BeaverTalk:Oregon State University’sIWSLT2025 Simultaneous Speech Translation System
abstract_en: This paper discusses the construction, fine-tuning, and deployment of BeaverTalk, a cascaded system for speech-to-text translation as part of the IWSLT 2025 simultaneous translation task. The system architecture employs a VAD segmenter for breaking a speech stream into segments, Whisper Large V2 for automatic speech recognition (ASR), and Gemma 3 12B for simultaneous translation. Regarding the simultaneous translation LLM, it is fine-tuned via low-rank adaptors (LoRAs) for a conversational prompting strategy that leverages a single prior-sentence memory bank from the source language as context. The cascaded system participated in the English-German and English-Chinese language directions for both the low and high latency regimes. In particular, on the English-German task, the system achieves a BLEU of 24.64 and 27.83 at a StreamLAAL of 1837.86 and 3343.73, respectively. Then, on the English-Chinese task, the system achieves a BLEU of 34.07 and 37.23 at a StreamLAAL of 2216.99 and 3521.35, respectively.
abstract_zh: 本文讨论了 BeaverTalk 的构建、微调和部署，这是一个用于语音到文本翻译的级联系统，作为 IWSLT 2025 同声翻译任务的一部分。该系统架构采用 VAD 分段器将语音流分成多个片段，使用 Whisper Large V2 进行自动语音识别 (ASR)，并使用 Gemma 3 12B 进行同声翻译。关于同声翻译大语言模型，它通过低等级适配器（LoRA）进行微调，以实现对话提示策略，该策略利用源语言中的单个先前句子记忆库作为上下文。级联系统参与了低延迟和高延迟状态的英语-德语和英语-中文语言方向。特别是，在英语-德语任务中，系统在 StreamLAAL 为 1837.86 和 3343.73 时分别实现了 24.64 和 27.83 的 BLEU。然后，在英汉任务中，系统在 StreamLAAL 为 2216.99 和 3521.35 时分别获得了 34.07 和 37.23 的 BLEU。

title: CMU’sIWSLT2025 Simultaneous Speech Translation System
abstract_en: This paper presents CMU’s submission to the IWSLT 2025 Simultaneous Speech Translation (SST) task for translating unsegmented English speech into Chinese and German text in a streaming manner. Our end-to-end speech-to-text system integrates a chunkwise causal Wav2Vec 2.0 speech encoder, an adapter, and the Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct as the decoder. We use a two-stage simultaneous training procedure on robust speech segments synthesized from LibriSpeech, CommonVoice, and VoxPopuli datasets, utilizing standard cross-entropy loss. Our model supports adjustable latency through a configurable latency multiplier. Experimental results demonstrate that our system achieves 44.3 BLEU for English-to-Chinese and 25.1 BLEU for English-to-German translations on the ACL60/60 development set, with computation-aware latencies of 2.7 seconds and 2.3 seconds, and theoretical latencies of 2.2 and 1.7 seconds, respectively.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了卡内基梅隆大学向 IWSLT 2025 同声语音翻译 (SST) 任务提交的内容，该任务旨在以流式方式将未分段的英语语音翻译为中文和德文文本。我们的端到端语音到文本系统集成了块状因果 Wav2Vec 2.0 语音编码器、适配器和作为解码器的 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct。我们利用标准交叉熵损失，对从 LibriSpeech、CommonVoice 和 VoxPopuli 数据集合成的稳健语音片段使用两阶段同步训练过程。我们的模型支持通过可配置的延迟乘数来调整延迟。实验结果表明，我们的系统在 ACL60/60 开发集上实现了英汉翻译 44.3 BLEU 和英德翻译 25.1 BLEU，计算感知延迟分别为 2.7 秒和 2.3 秒，理论延迟分别为 2.2 和 1.7 秒。

title: SYSTRAN@IWSLT2025 Low-resource track
abstract_en: SYSTRAN submitted systems for one language pair in the 2025 Low-Resource Language Track. Our main contribution lies in the tight coupling and light fine-tuning of an ASR encoder (Whisper) with a neural machine translation decoder (NLLB), forming an efficient speech translation pipeline. We present the modeling strategies and optimizations implemented to build a system that, unlike large-scale end-to-end models, performs effectively under constraints of limited training data and computational resources. This approach enables the development of high-quality speech translation in low-resource settings, while ensuring both efficiency and scalability. We also conduct a comparative analysis of our proposed system against various paradigms, including a cascaded Whisper+NLLB setup and direct end-to-end fine-tuning of Whisper.
abstract_zh: SYSTRAN 在 2025 年低资源语言轨道中提交了一种语言对的系统。我们的主要贡献在于 ASR 编码器（Whisper）与神经机器翻译解码器（NLLB）的紧密耦合和轻微微调，形成高效的语音翻译管道。我们提出了构建一个系统的建模策略和优化，与大规模端到端模型不同，该系统在有限的训练数据和计算资源的约束下有效执行。这种方法可以在资源匮乏的环境中开发高质量的语音翻译，同时确保效率和可扩展性。我们还对我们提出的系统与各种范例进行了比较分析，包括级联 Whisper+NLLB 设置和 Whisper 的直接端到端微调。

title: IIITH-BUTsystem forIWSLT2025 low-resourceBhojpuri toHindi speech translation
abstract_en: This paper presents the submission of IIITH-BUT to the IWSLT 2025 shared task on speech translation for the low-resource Bhojpuri-Hindi language pair. We explored the impact of hyperparameter optimisation and data augmentation techniques on the performance of the SeamlessM4T model fine-tuned for this specific task. We systematically investigated a range of hyperparameters including learning rate schedules, number of update steps, warm-up steps, label smoothing, and batch sizes; and report their effect on translation quality. To address data scarcity, we applied speed perturbation and SpecAugment and studied their effect on translation quality. We also examined the use of cross-lingual signal through joint training with Marathi and Bhojpuri speech data. Our experiments reveal that careful selection of hyperparameters and the application of simple yet effective augmentation techniques significantly improve performance in low-resource settings. We also analysed the translation hypotheses to understand various kinds of errors that impacted the translation quality in terms of BLEU
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了向 IWSLT 2025 资源匮乏的博杰普里语-印地语语言对语音翻译共享任务提交的 IIITH-BUT。我们探讨了超参数优化和数据增强技术对针对此特定任务进行微调的 SeamlessM4T 模型性能的影响。我们系统地研究了一系列超参数，包括学习率计划、更新步骤数、预热步骤、标签平滑和批量大小；并报告它们对翻译质量的影响。为了解决数据稀缺问题，我们应用了速度扰动和 SpecAugment，并研究了它们对翻译质量的影响。我们还通过马拉地语和博杰普里语语音数据的联合训练来检查跨语言信号的使用。我们的实验表明，仔细选择超参数并应用简单而有效的增强技术可以显着提高低资源环境中的性能。我们还分析了翻译假设，以了解影响 BLEU 翻译质量的各种错误

title: MLLP-VRAINUPVsystem for theIWSLT2025 Simultaneous Speech Translation Translation task
abstract_en: This work describes the participation of the MLLP-VRAIN research group in the shared task of the IWSLT 2025 Simultaneous Speech Translation track. Our submission addresses the unique challenges of real-time translation of long-form speech by developing a modular cascade system that adapts strong pre-trained models to streaming scenarios. We combine Whisper Large-V3-Turbo for ASR with the multilingual NLLB-3.3B model for MT, implementing lightweight adaptation techniques rather than training new end-to-end models from scratch. Our approach employs document-level adaptation with prefix training to enhance the MT model’s ability to handle incomplete inputs, while incorporating adaptive emission policies including a wait-k strategy and RALCP for managing the translation stream. Specialized buffer management techniques and segmentation strategies ensure coherent translations across long audio sequences. Experimental results on the ACL60/60 dataset demonstrate that our system achieves a favorable balance between translation quality and latency, with a BLEU score of 31.96 and non-computational-aware StreamLAAL latency of 2.94 seconds. Our final model achieves a preliminary score on the official test set (IWSLT25Instruct) of 29.8 BLEU. Our work demonstrates that carefully adapted pre-trained components can create effective simultaneous translation systems for long-form content without requiring extensive in-domain parallel data or specialized end-to-end training.
abstract_zh: 这项工作描述了 MLLP-VRAIN 研究小组参与 IWSLT 2025 同声语音翻译轨道的共享任务。我们提交的内容通过开发模块化级联系统来解决长篇语音实时翻译的独特挑战，该系统使强大的预训练模型适应流媒体场景。我们将用于 ASR 的 Whisper Large-V3-Turbo 与用于 MT 的多语言 NLLB-3.3B 模型相结合，实施轻量级适应技术，而不是从头开始训练新的端到端模型。我们的方法采用带有前缀训练的文档级自适应来增强 MT 模型处理不完整输入的能力，同时结合自适应排放策略，包括 wait-k 策略和用于管理翻译流的 RALCP。专门的缓冲区管理技术和分段策略可确保长音频序列的连贯翻译。 ACL60/60 数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的系统在翻译质量和延迟之间实现了良好的平衡，BLEU 得分为 31.96，非计算感知 StreamLAAL 延迟为 2.94 秒。我们的最终模型在官方测试集 (IWSLT25Instruct) 上获得了 29.8 BLEU 的初步分数。我们的工作表明，经过精心调整的预训练组件可以为长格式内容创建有效的同声翻译系统，而无需大量的域内并行数据或专门的端到端培训。

title: Bemba Speech Translation: Exploring a Low-ResourceAfrican Language
abstract_en: This paper describes our system submission to the International Conference on Spoken Language Translation (IWSLT 2025), low-resource languages track, namely for Bemba-to-English speech translation. We built cascaded speech translation systems based on Whisper and NLLB-200, and employed data augmentation techniques, such as back-translation. We investigate the effect of using synthetic data and discuss our experimental setup.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了我们向国际口语翻译会议 (IWSLT 2025) 低资源语言轨道（即 Bemba 到英语的语音翻译）提交的系统。我们基于 Whisper 和 NLLB-200 构建了级联语音翻译系统，并采用了数据增强技术，例如反向翻译。我们研究使用合成数据的效果并讨论我们的实验设置。

title: NAISTOffline Speech Translation System forIWSLT2025
abstract_en: This paper presents NAIST’s submission to the offline speech translation task of the IWSLT 2025 evaluation campaign, focusing on English-to-German and English-to-Chinese translation. We implemented both cascade and end-to-end frameworks using various components. For the cascade approach, we used Whisper and SALMONN as automatic speech recognition systems, each paired with Qwen2.5 large language model (LLM) for translation. In the end-to-end setting, we used SALMONN as speech translation and also built a custom model combining the Whisper encoder, DeCo projector, and Qwen2.5 LLM. To further leverage the large language model capabilities, we experimented with different prompting strategies. Additionally, since long speech inputs are segmented for processing, we applied hypothesis combination techniques to generate the final translation output. Our results show that combining Whisper and LLMs can yield strong translation performance, even without further fine-tuning in the cascade setup. Moreover, our proposed end-to-end architecture achieved competitive results, despite being trained on significantly less data compared to SALMONN. Finally, we decided to use both SALMONN as an end-to-end speech translation model and our proposed end-to-end model for our IWSLT 2025 submission for both language pairs.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 NAIST 对 IWSLT 2025 评估活动离线语音翻译任务的提交，重点是英德和英汉翻译。我们使用各种组件实现了级联和端到端框架。对于级联方法，我们使用 Whisper 和 SALMONN 作为自动语音识别系统，每个系统都与 Qwen2.5 大语言模型 (LLM) 配对进行翻译。在端到端设置中，我们使用 SALMONN 作为语音翻译，并结合 Whisper 编码器、DeCo 投影仪和 Qwen2.5 LLM 构建了一个自定义模型。为了进一步利用大语言模型的功能，我们尝试了不同的提示策略。此外，由于长语音输入被分段进行处理，因此我们应用假设组合技术来生成最终的翻译输出。我们的结果表明，即使在级联设置中没有进一步微调，Whisper 和 LLM 的结合也可以产生强大的翻译性能。此外，我们提出的端到端架构取得了有竞争力的结果，尽管与 SALMONN 相比，训练数据要少得多。最后，我们决定使用 SALMONN 作为端到端语音翻译模型，并在 IWSLT 2025 提交的两种语言对中使用我们提出的端到端模型。

title: NAISTSimultaneous Speech Translation System forIWSLT2025
abstract_en: This paper describes the NAIST submission to the English-to-German, Japanese, Chinese Simultaneous Speech-to-Text track at IWSLT 2025. Last year, our system was based on an end-to-end speech-to-text translation model that combined HuBERT and mBART. This year, the system consists of a Whisper encoder, the DeCo compressive projector, and the Qwen large language model. The simultaneous translation (SimulST) system is implemented by applying a local agreement policy to an offline-trained translation model. For the streaming translation (StreamST) system, we integrate an online version of the SHAS segmenter into our SimulST architecture. Our results demonstrate that adopting LLMs as the backbone architecture for speech translation tasks yields strong translation performance. Additionally, leveraging robust segmentation capability of SHAS for StreamST achieves good quality-latency trade-off when processing unbounded audio streams.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 NAIST 在 IWSLT 2025 上向英语到德语、日语、中文同步语音到文本赛道提交的内容。去年，我们的系统基于结合了 HuBERT 和 mBART 的端到端语音到文本翻译模型。今年，该系统由 Whisper 编码器、DeCo 压缩投影仪和 Qwen 大语言模型组成。同声翻译（SimulST）系统是通过将本地协议策略应用于离线训练的翻译模型来实现的。对于流式翻译 (StreamST) 系统，我们将在线版本的 SHAS 分段器集成​​到我们的 SimulST 架构中。我们的结果表明，采用大语言模型作为语音翻译任务的骨干架构可以产生强大的翻译性能。此外，在处理无界音频流时，利用 StreamST 的 SHAS 强大的分段功能可以实现良好的质量与延迟权衡。

title: Efficient Speech Translation through Model Compression and Knowledge Distillation
abstract_en: Efficient deployment of large audio-language models for speech translation remains challenging due to their significant computational requirements. In this paper, we address this challenge through our system submissions to the ‘Model Compression’ track at the International Conference on Spoken Language Translation (IWSLT 2025). We experiment with a combination of approaches including iterative layer pruning based on layer importance evaluation, low-rank adaptation with 4-bit quantization (QLoRA), and knowledge distillation. In our experiments, we use Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct for speech translation into German and Chinese. Our pruned (student) models achieve up to a 50% reduction in both model parameters and storage footprint, while retaining 97-100% of the translation quality of the in-domain (teacher) models.
abstract_zh: 由于其巨大的计算要求，有效部署用于语音翻译的大型音频语言模型仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们通过向国际口语翻译会议（IWSLT 2025）的“模型压缩”轨道提交系统来应对这一挑战。我们尝试了多种方法的组合，包括基于层重要性评估的迭代层剪枝、4 位量化的低秩自适应 (QLoRA) 和知识蒸馏。在我们的实验中，我们使用 Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct 将语音翻译为德语和中文。我们的修剪（学生）模型可将模型参数和存储占用空间减少高达 50%，同时保留域内（教师）模型 97-100% 的翻译质量。

title: Simultaneous Translation with Offline Speech andLLMModels inCUNISubmission toIWSLT2025
abstract_en: This paper describes Charles University submission to the Simultaneous Speech Translation Task of the IWSLT 2025. We cover all four language pairs with a direct or cascade approach. The backbone of our systems is the offline Whisper speech model, which we use for both translation and transcription in simultaneous mode with the state-of-the-art simultaneous policy AlignAtt. We further improve the performance by prompting to inject in-domain terminology, and we accommodate context. Our cascaded systems further use EuroLLM for unbounded simultaneous translation. Compared to the Organizers’ baseline, our systems improve by 2 BLEU points on Czech to English and 13-22 BLEU points on English to German, Chinese and Japanese on the development sets. Additionally, we also propose a new enhanced measure of speech recognition latency.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了查尔斯大学向 IWSLT 2025 的同步语音翻译任务提交的内容。我们通过直接或级联方法涵盖了所有四种语言对。我们系统的支柱是离线 Whisper 语音模型，我们使用该模型通过最先进的同步策略 AlignAtt 以同步模式进行翻译和转录。我们通过提示注入域内术语来进一步提高性能，并且我们适应上下文。我们的级联系统进一步使用 EuroLLM 进行无限同声翻译。与组织者的基准相比，我们的系统在开发集上从捷克语到英语提高了 2 BLEU 点，在英语到德语、中文和日语方面提高了 13-22 BLEU 点。此外，我们还提出了一种新的增强型语音识别延迟测量方法。

title: HITSZ’s End-To-End Speech Translation Systems Combining Sequence-to-Sequence Auto Speech Recognition Model andIndic Large Language Model forIWSLT2025 inIndic Track
abstract_en: This paper presents HITSZ’s submission for the IWSLT 2025 Indic track, focusing on speech-to-text translation (ST) for English-to-Indic and Indic-to-English language pairs. To enhance translation quality in this low-resource scenario, we propose an end-to-end system integrating the pre-trained Whisper automated speech recognition (ASR) model with Krutrim, an Indic-specialized large language model (LLM). Experimental results demonstrate that our end-to-end system achieved average BLEU scores of 28.88 for English-to-Indic directions and 27.86 for Indic-to-English directions. Furthermore, we investigated the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) method. While this method showed potential for significant translation quality improvements on successfully parsed outputs (e.g. a 13.84 BLEU increase for Tamil-to-English), we observed challenges in ensuring the model consistently adheres to the required CoT output format.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 HITSZ 在 IWSLT 2025 印度语赛道上提交的材料，重点关注英语到印度语和印度语到英语语言对的语音到文本翻译 (ST)。为了在这种资源匮乏的情况下提高翻译质量，我们提出了一种端到端系统，将预训练的 Whisper 自动语音识别 (ASR) 模型与 Krutrim（一种印度语专用大语言模型 (LLM)）集成。实验结果表明，我们的端到端系统在英语到印度语方向上的平均 BLEU 分数为 28.88，在印度语到英语方向上的平均 BLEU 分数为 27.86。此外，我们还研究了思维链（CoT）方法。虽然这种方法显示出在成功解析输出时显着提高翻译质量的潜力（例如，泰米尔语到英语的 BLEU 提高了 13.84），但我们观察到在确保模型始终遵循所需的 CoT 输出格式方面存在挑战。

title: Generating Diverse Training Samples for Relation Extraction with Large Language Models
abstract_en: Using Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate training data can potentially be a preferable way to improve zero or few-shot NLP tasks. However, many problems remain to be investigated for this direction. For the task of Relation Extraction (RE), we find that samples generated by directly prompting LLMs may easily have high structural similarities with each other. They tend to use a limited variety of phrasing while expressing the relation between a pair of entities. Therefore, in this paper, we study how to effectively improve the diversity of the training samples generated with LLMs for RE, while also maintaining their correctness. We first try to make the LLMs produce dissimilar samples by directly giving instructions in In-Context Learning (ICL) prompts. Then, we propose an approach to fine-tune LLMs for diversity training sample generation through Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Our experiments on commonly used RE datasets show that both attempts can improve the quality of the generated training data. We also find that comparing with directly performing RE with an LLM, training a non-LLM RE model with its generated samples may lead to better performance.
abstract_zh: 使用大型语言模型 (LLM) 生成训练数据可能是改进零样本或少样本 NLP 任务的更好方法。然而，这一方向仍有许多问题有待研究。对于关系提取（RE）任务，我们发现直接提示LLM生成的样本很容易彼此具有很高的结构相似度。他们在表达一对实体之间的关系时倾向于使用有限的措辞。因此，在本文中，我们研究如何有效提高RE的LLM生成的训练样本的多样性，同时又保持其正确性。我们首先尝试通过直接在情境学习（ICL）提示中给出指令来使大语言模型产生不同的样本。然后，我们提出了一种通过直接偏好优化（DPO）微调 LLM 以生成多样性训练样本的方法。我们对常用 RE 数据集的实验表明，这两种尝试都可以提高生成的训练数据的质量。我们还发现，与直接使用 LLM 执行 RE 相比，使用其生成的样本训练非 LLM RE 模型可能会带来更好的性能。

title: Towards a More Generalized Approach in Open Relation Extraction
abstract_en: Open Relation Extraction (OpenRE) seeks to identify and extract novel relational facts between named entities from unlabeled data without pre-defined relation schemas. Traditional OpenRE methods typically assume that the unlabeled data consists solely of novel relations or is pre-divided into known and novel instances. However, in real-world scenarios, novel relations are arbitrarily distributed. In this paper, we propose a generalized OpenRE setting that considers unlabeled data as a mixture of both known and novel instances. To address this, we propose MixORE, a two-phase framework that integrates relation classification and clustering to jointly learn known and novel relations. Experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that MixORE consistently outperforms competitive baselines in known relation classification and novel relation clustering. Our findings contribute to the advancement of generalized OpenRE research and real-world applications.
abstract_zh: 开放关系提取 (OpenRE) 旨在从未标记的数据中识别和提取命名实体之间的新颖关系事实，而无需预定义的关系模式。传统的 OpenRE 方法通常假设未标记的数据仅由新颖的关系组成，或者预先分为已知实例和新颖实例。然而，在现实场景中，新的关系是任意分布的。在本文中，我们提出了一种通用的 OpenRE 设置，它将未标记数据视为已知实例和新颖实例的混合。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 MixORE，一个两阶段框架，集成了关系分类和聚类来共同学习已知和新颖的关系。对三个基准数据集的实验表明，MixORE 在已知关系分类和新颖关系聚类方面始终优于竞争基线。我们的研究结果有助于推动广义 OpenRE 研究和实际应用的进步。

title: Collapse of Dense Retrievers: Short, Early, and Literal Biases Outranking Factual Evidence
abstract_en: Dense retrieval models are commonly used in Information Retrieval (IR) applications, such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Since they often serve as the first step in these systems, their robustness is critical to avoid downstream failures. In this work, we repurpose a relation extraction dataset (e.g., Re-DocRED) to design controlled experiments that quantify the impact of heuristic biases, such as a preference for shorter documents, on retrievers like Dragon+ and Contriever. We uncover major vulnerabilities, showing retrievers favor shorter documents, early positions, repeated entities, and literal matches, all while ignoring the answer’s presence! Notably, when multiple biases combine, models exhibit catastrophic performance degradation, selecting the answer-containing document in less than 10% of cases over a synthetic biased document without the answer. Furthermore, we show that these biases have direct consequences for downstream applications like RAG, where retrieval-preferred documents can mislead LLMs, resulting in a 34% performance drop than providing no documents at all.https://huggingface.co/datasets/mohsenfayyaz/ColDeR
abstract_zh: 密集检索模型通常用于信息检索（IR）应用，例如检索增强生成（RAG）。由于它们通常作为这些系统的第一步，因此它们的稳健性对于避免下游故障至关重要。在这项工作中，我们重新利用关系提取数据集（例如 Re-DocRED）来设计受控实验，以量化启发式偏差（例如对较短文档的偏好）对 Dragon+ 和 Contriever 等检索器的影响。我们发现了主要漏洞，表明检索器喜欢较短的文档、早期的位置、重复的实体和文字匹配，同时忽略答案的存在！值得注意的是，当多个偏差结合在一起时，模型会表现出灾难性的性能下降，在不到 10% 的情况下选择包含答案的文档，而不是选择没有答案的合成偏差文档。此外，我们表明这些偏差对 RAG 等下游应用程序有直接影响，在 RAG 中，检索首选文档可能会误导大语言模型，导致性能比根本不提供文档下降 34%。 https://huggingface.co/datasets/mohsenfayyaz/ColDeR

title: Introducing Graph Context into Language Models through Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Lexical Relation Mining
abstract_en: Lexical relation refers to the way words are related within a language. Prior work has demonstrated that pretrained language models (PLMs) can effectively mine lexical relations between word pairs. However, they overlook the potential of graph structures composed of lexical relations, which can be integrated with the semantic knowledge of PLMs. In this work, we propose a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method through graph context, which integrates graph features and semantic representations for lexical relation classification (LRC) and lexical entailment (LE) tasks. Our experiments show that graph features can help PLMs better understand more complex lexical relations, establishing a new state-of-the-art for LRC and LE. Finally, we perform an error analysis, identifying the bottlenecks of language models in lexical relation mining tasks and providing insights for future improvements.
abstract_zh: 词汇关系是指语言中单词之间的关联方式。先前的工作已经证明，预训练语言模型（PLM）可以有效地挖掘单词对之间的词汇关系。然而，他们忽视了由词汇关系组成的图结构的潜力，这种结构可以与 PLM 的语义知识集成。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种通过图上下文进行参数高效的微调方法，该方法集成了词汇关系分类（LRC）和词汇蕴涵（LE）任务的图特征和语义表示。我们的实验表明，图特征可以帮助 PLM 更好地理解更复杂的词汇关系，为 LRC 和 LE 建立新的最先进技术。最后，我们进行错误分析，识别词汇关系挖掘任务中语言模型的瓶颈，并为未来的改进提供见解。

title: Mitigating Non-Representative Prototypes and Representation Bias in Few-Shot Continual Relation Extraction
abstract_en: To address the phenomenon of similar classes, existing methods in few-shot continual relation extraction (FCRE) face two main challenges: non-representative prototypes and representation bias, especially when the number of available samples is limited. In our work, we propose Minion to address these challenges. Firstly, we leverage the General Orthogonal Frame (GOF) structure, based on the concept of Neural Collapse, to create robust class prototypes with clear separation, even between analogous classes. Secondly, we utilize label description representations as global class representatives within the fast-slow contrastive learning paradigm. These representations consistently encapsulate the essential attributes of each relation, acting as global information that helps mitigate overfitting and reduces representation bias caused by the limited local few-shot examples within a class. Extensive experiments on well-known FCRE benchmarks show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, demonstrating its effectiveness for advancing RE system.
abstract_zh: 为了解决相似类的现象，现有的少样本连续关系提取（FCRE）方法面临两个主要挑战：非代表性原型和表示偏差，特别是当可用样本数量有限时。在我们的工作中，我们建议 Minion 来应对这些挑战。首先，我们利用基于神经崩溃概念的通用正交框架（GOF）结构来创建具有清晰分离的鲁棒类原型，即使在类似的类之间也是如此。其次，我们利用标签描述表示作为快慢对比学习范式中的全局类代表。这些表示一致地封装了每个关系的基本属性，充当全局信息，有助于减轻过度拟合并减少由类内有限的局部少数样本引起的表示偏差。对著名 FCRE 基准的大量实验表明，我们的方法优于最先进的方法，证明了其对于推进 RE 系统的有效性。

title: ProbingLLMs for Multilingual Discourse Generalization Through a Unified Label Set
abstract_en: Discourse understanding is essential for many NLP tasks, yet most existing work remains constrained by framework-dependent discourse representations. This work investigates whether large language models (LLMs) capture discourse knowledge that generalizes across languages and frameworks. We address this question along two dimensions: (1) developing a unified discourse relation label set to facilitate cross-lingual and cross-framework discourse analysis, and (2) probing LLMs to assess whether they encode generalizable discourse abstractions. Using multilingual discourse relation classification as a testbed, we examine a comprehensive set of 23 LLMs of varying sizes and multilingual capabilities. Our results show that LLMs, especially those with multilingual training corpora, can generalize discourse information across languages and frameworks. Further layer-wise analyses reveal that language generalization at the discourse level is most salient in the intermediate layers. Lastly, our error analysis provides an account of challenging relation classes.
abstract_zh: 话语理解对于许多 NLP 任务至关重要，但大多数现有工作仍然受到依赖于框架的话语表征的限制。这项工作调查大型语言模型（LLM）是否捕获跨语言和框架泛化的话语知识。我们从两个维度解决这个问题：（1）开发统一的话语关系标签集以促进跨语言和跨框架的话语分析，（2）探索大语言模型以评估它们是否编码可概括的话语抽象。我们使用多语言话语关系分类作为测试平台，对 23 个不同规模和多语言能力的大语言模型进行了综合考察。我们的结果表明，大语言模型，尤其是那些拥有多语言培训语料库的大语言模型，可以跨语言和框架泛化话语信息。进一步的分层分析表明，话语层面的语言泛化在中间层最为突出。最后，我们的错误分析提供了具有挑战性的关系类的说明。

title: Improving Automatic Evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Biomedical Relation Extraction viaLLMs-as-the-Judge
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in biomedical relation extraction, even in zero-shot scenarios. However, evaluating LLMs in this task remains challenging due to their ability to generate human-like text, often producing synonyms or abbreviations of gold-standard answers, making traditional automatic evaluation metrics unreliable. On the other hand, while human evaluation is more reliable, it is costly and time-consuming, making it impractical for real-world applications. This paper investigates the use of LLMs-as-the-Judge as an alternative evaluation method for biomedical relation extraction. We benchmark 8 LLMs as judges to evaluate the responses generated by 5 other LLMs across 3 biomedical relation extraction datasets. Unlike other text-generation tasks, we observe that LLM-based judges perform quite poorly (usually below 50% accuracy) in the biomedical relation extraction task. Our findings reveal that it happens mainly because relations extracted by LLMs do not adhere to any standard format. To address this, we propose structured output formatting for LLM-generated responses that helps LLM-Judges to improve their performance by about 15% (on average). We also introduce a domain adaptation technique to further enhance LLM-Judge performance by effectively transferring knowledge between datasets. We release both our human-annotated and LLM-annotated judgment data (36k samples in total) for public use here: https://github.com/tahmedge/llm_judge_biomedical_re.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在生物医学关系提取方面表现出了令人印象深刻的性能，即使在零样本场景中也是如此。然而，在这项任务中评估大语言模型仍然具有挑战性，因为它们能够生成类似人类的文本，通常会生成黄金标准答案的同义词或缩写，使得传统的自动评估指标变得不可靠。另一方面，虽然人工评估更可靠，但成本高昂且耗时，使其在实际应用中不切实际。本文研究了使用大语言模型作为法官作为生物医学关系提取的替代评估方法。我们以 8 名大语言模型为评委，评估其他 5 名大语言模型在 3 个生物医学关系提取数据集中生成的响应。与其他文本生成任务不同，我们观察到基于 LLM 的法官在生物医学关系提取任务中表现相当差（通常低于 50% 的准确率）。我们的研究结果表明，这种情况的发生主要是因为大语言模型提取的关系不遵循任何标准格式。为了解决这个问题，我们建议对 LLM 生成的回复进行结构化输出格式，以帮助 LLM 法官将其表现提高约 15%（平均）。我们还引入了领域适应技术，通过在数据集之间有效地转移知识来进一步提高 LLM-Judge 的性能。我们在这里发布了人类注释和大语言模型注释的判断数据（总共 36k 个样本）供公众使用：https://github.com/tahmedge/llm_judge_biomedical_re。

title: Temporal Relation Extraction in Clinical Texts: A Span-based Graph Transformer Approach
abstract_en: Temporal information extraction from unstructured text is essential for contextualizing events and deriving actionable insights, particularly in the medical domain. We address the task of extracting clinical events and their temporal relations using the well-studied I2B2 2012 Temporal Relations Challenge corpus. This task is inherently challenging due to complex clinical language, long documents, and sparse annotations. We introduce GraphTREx, a novel method integrating span-based entity-relation extraction, clinical large pre-trained language models (LPLMs), and Heterogeneous Graph Transformers (HGT) to capture local and global dependencies. Our HGT component facilitates information propagation across the document through innovative global landmarks that bridge distant entities and improves the state-of-the-art with 5.5% improvement in the tempeval F1 score over the previous best and up to 8.9% improvement on long-range relations, which presents a formidable challenge. We further demonstrate generalizability by establishing a strong baseline on the E3C corpus. Not only does this work advance temporal information extraction, but also lays the groundwork for improved diagnostic and prognostic models through enhanced temporal reasoning.
abstract_zh: 从非结构化文本中提取时间信息对于将事件置于情境中并得出可操作的见解至关重要，特别是在医学领域。我们使用经过充分研究的 I2B2 2012 时间关系挑战语料库来解决提取临床事件及其时间关系的任务。由于复杂的临床语言、长文档和稀疏注释，这项任务本质上具有挑战性。我们引入了 GraphTREx，这是一种集成基于跨度的实体关系提取、临床大型预训练语言模型 (LPLM) 和异构图转换器 (HGT) 的新颖方法，以捕获本地和全局依赖性。我们的 HGT 组件通过创新的全球地标促进整个文档中的信息传播，这些地标桥接了遥远的实体，并提高了最先进的水平，tempeval F1 分数比之前的最佳成绩提高了 5.5%，远程关系提高了 8.9%，这是一个巨大的挑战。我们通过在 E3C 语料库上建立强大的基线来进一步证明普遍性。这项工作不仅推进了时间信息提取，而且还为通过增强时间推理改进诊断和预后模型奠定了基础。

title: Exploring Multimodal Relation Extraction of Hierarchical Tabular Data with Multi-task Learning
abstract_en: Relation Extraction (RE) is a key task in table understanding, aiming to extract semantic relations between columns. However, complex tables with hierarchical headers are hard to obtain high-quality textual formats (e.g., Markdown) for input under practical scenarios like webpage screenshots and scanned documents, while table images are more accessible and intuitive. Besides, existing works overlook the need of mining relations among multiple columns rather than just the semantic relation between two specific columns in real-world practice. In this work, we explore utilizing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to address RE in tables with complex structures. We creatively extend the concept of RE to include calculational relations, enabling multi-task learning of both semantic and calculational RE for mutual reinforcement. Specifically, we reconstruct table images into graph structure based on neighboring nodes to extract graph-level visual features. Such feature enhancement alleviates the insensitivity of MLLMs to the positional information within table images. We then propose a Chain-of-Thought distillation framework with self-correction mechanism to enhance MLLMs’ reasoning capabilities without increasing parameter scale. Our method significantly outperforms most baselines on wide datasets. Additionally, we release a benchmark dataset for calculational RE in complex tables.
abstract_zh: 关系提取（RE）是表理解中的一个关键任务，旨在提取列之间的语义关系。然而，具有分层标题的复杂表格在网页截图、扫描文档等实际场景下很难获得高质量的文本格式（例如Markdown）进行输入，而表格图像更易于访问和直观。此外，现有的工作忽略了挖掘多个列之间的关系的需要，而不仅仅是现实世界实践中两个特定列之间的语义关系。在这项工作中，我们探索利用多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）来解决具有复杂结构的表中的 RE。我们创造性地将RE的概念扩展到包括计算关系，从而实现语义RE和计算RE的多任务学习以相互强化。具体来说，我们基于相邻节点将表格图像重建为图结构，以提取图级视觉特征。这种特征增强减轻了 MLLM 对表格图像内位置信息的不敏感性。然后，我们提出了一种具有自我修正机制的思维链蒸馏框架，以在不增加参数规模的情况下增强 MLLM 的推理能力。我们的方法在广泛的数据集上显着优于大多数基线。此外，我们还发布了复杂表中计算 RE 的基准数据集。

title: A Self-Denoising Model for Robust Few-Shot Relation Extraction
abstract_en: The few-shot relation extraction (FSRE) aims at enhancing the model’s generalization to new relations with very few labeled instances (support instances). Most existing studies use prototype networks (ProtoNets) for FSRE and assume that the support set, adapting the model to new relations, only contains accurately labeled instances. However, this assumption is usually unrealistic, as even carefully-annotated datasets often contain mislabeled instances. Thus, it is essential to enhance the robustness of FSRE models to noisy labels in support set, but this issue remains unexplored. In this paper, we first conduct a preliminary study, revealing the high sensitivity of ProtoNets to such noisy labels. Meanwhile, we discover that fully leveraging mislabeled support instances is crucial for enhancing the model’s robustness. To do this, we propose a self-denoising model for FSRE, which can automatically correct noisy labels of support instances. Specifically, our model comprises two core components: 1) a label correction module (LCM), used to correct mislabeled support instances based on the distances between them in the embedding space, and 2) a relation classification module (RCM), designed to achieve more robust relation prediction using the corrected labels generated by the LCM. Moreover, we propose a feedback-based training strategy, which focuses on training LCM and RCM to synergistically handle noisy labels in support set. Experimental results on two public datasets show the effectiveness and robustness of our model. Notably, even in scenarios without noisy labels, our model significantly outperforms all competitive baselines.
abstract_zh: 少镜头关系提取（FSRE）旨在增强模型对具有很少标记实例（支持实例）的新关系的泛化能力。大多数现有研究使用原型网络 (ProtoNets) 进行 FSRE，并假设使模型适应新关系的支持集仅包含准确标记的实例。然而，这种假设通常是不现实的，因为即使是经过仔细注释的数据集也经常包含错误标记的实例。因此，增强 FSRE 模型对支持集中噪声标签的鲁棒性至关重要，但这个问题仍未得到探索。在本文中，我们首先进行了初步研究，揭示了 ProtoNet 对此类噪声标签的高敏感性。同时，我们发现充分利用错误标记的支持实例对于增强模型的稳健性至关重要。为此，我们提出了 FSRE 的自降噪模型，它可以自动纠正支持实例的噪声标签。具体来说，我们的模型包含两个核心组件：1）标签校正模块（LCM），用于根据嵌入空间中支持实例之间的距离来校正错误标记的支持实例；2）关系分类模块（RCM），旨在使用 LCM 生成的校正标签实现更稳健的关系预测。此外，我们提出了一种基于反馈的训练策略，其重点是训练 LCM 和 RCM 以协同处理支持集中的噪声标签。两个公共数据集的实验结果表明了我们模型的有效性和鲁棒性。值得注意的是，即使在没有噪声标签的情况下，我们的模型也显着优于所有竞争基线。

title: A Variational Approach for Mitigating Entity Bias in Relation Extraction
abstract_en: Mitigating entity bias is a critical challenge in Relation Extraction (RE), where models often rely excessively on entities, resulting in poor generalization. This paper presents a novel approach to address this issue by adapting a Variational Information Bottleneck (VIB) framework. Our method compresses entity-specific information while preserving task-relevant features. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on both general and financial domain RE datasets, excelling in in-domain settings (original test sets) and out-of-domain (modified test sets with type-constrained entity replacements). Our approach offers a robust, interpretable, and theoretically grounded methodology.
abstract_zh: 减轻实体偏差是关系提取 (RE) 中的一个关键挑战，其中模型通常过度依赖实体，导致泛化能力较差。本文提出了一种通过采用变分信息瓶颈（VIB）框架来解决此问题的新方法。我们的方法压缩特定于实体的信息，同时保留与任务相关的特征。它在一般和金融领域 RE 数据集上都实现了最先进的性能，在域内设置（原始测试集）和域外（具有类型约束实体替换的修改测试集）方面表现出色。我们的方法提供了一种稳健、可解释且有理论依据的方法论。

title: ODDA: AnOODA-Driven Diverse Data Augmentation Framework for Low-Resource Relation Extraction
abstract_en: Data Augmentation (DA) has emerged as a promising solution to address the scarcity of high-quality annotated data in low-resource relation extraction (LRE). Leveraging large language models (LLMs), DA has significantly improved the performance of RE models with considerably fewer parameters. However, existing DA methods struggle with diversity misalignments, as they neglect the diversity required by the model and generate homogeneous augmentations that do not cover the inter-sample and inter-relation variability, leading to suboptimal performance. Inspired by the Observe-Orient-Decide-Act (OODA) framework, which provides a robust theoretical foundation for iterative decision-making under dynamic conditions, we propose an OODA-driven Diverse DA method (ODDA), guiding the data generation and selection process. DDA firstobservesthe RE model’s behavior to select effective demonstrations for LLMs. Next, itorientsLLMs towards generating diverse data by replacing schema constraints with attribute constraints. Then ODDAdecideson the final augmented dataset with overall diversity from a global search and finallyactsto train the RE model. Extensive experiments on three widely-used benchmarks demonstrate that ODDA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving average F1 improvements of 3.1% across various LRE scenarios while maintaining enhanced model stability.
abstract_zh: 数据增强 (DA) 已成为解决低资源关系提取 (LRE) 中高质量注释数据稀缺问题的一种有前景的解决方案。利用大型语言模型 (LLM)，DA 以相当少的参数显着提高了 RE 模型的性能。然而，现有的 DA 方法与多样性错位问题作斗争，因为它们忽略了模型所需的多样性，并生成不涵盖样本间和相互关系变异性的同质增强，从而导致性能不佳。受观察-东方-决策-行动（OODA）框架的启发，该框架为动态条件下的迭代决策提供了坚实的理论基础，我们提出了一种OODA驱动的多样化DA方法（ODDA），指导数据生成和选择过程。 DDA 首先观察 RE 模型的行为，为 LLM 选择有效的演示。接下来，它通过用属性约束替换模式约束来引导大语言模型生成多样化的数据。然后 ODDA 通过全局搜索决定最终的具有整体多样性的增强数据集，并最终训练 RE 模型。对三个广泛使用的基准进行的大量实验表明，ODDA 始终优于最先进的基准，在各种 LRE 场景中实现了 3.1% 的平均 F1 改进，同时保持了增强的模型稳定性。

title: GLiM: Integrating Graph Transformer andLLMfor Document-Level Biomedical Relation Extraction with Incomplete Labeling
abstract_en: Document-level relation extraction (DocRE) identifies relations between entities across an entire document. However, as the number and complexity of entities and entity-pair relations grow, the problem space expands quadratically, causing incomplete annotations and frequent false negatives, especially in biomedical datasets due to high construction costs. This leads to low recall in real-world scenarios. To address this, we propose GLiM, a novel framework that reduces the problem space using a graph-enhanced Transformer-based model and leverages large language models (LLMs) for reasoning. GLiM employs a cascaded approach: first, a graph-enhanced Transformer processes entity-pair relations with finer granularity by dynamically adjusting the graph size based on the number of entities; then, LLM inference handles challenging cases. Experiments show that GLiM boosts average recall and F1 scores by +6.34 and +4.41, respectively, outperforming state-of-the-art models on biomedical benchmarks. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining graph-enhanced Transformers with LLM inference for biomedical DocRE. Code will be released at https://github.com/HaoFang10/GLiM.
abstract_zh: 文档级关系提取 (DocRE) 识别整个文档中实体之间的关系。然而，随着实体和实体对关系的数量和复杂性的增长，问题空间呈二次扩展，导致注释不完整和频繁的漏报，特别是在生物医学数据集中，由于构建成本高昂。这导致现实场景中的召回率较低。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 GLiM，这是一种新颖的框架，它使用基于图形增强 Transformer 的模型来减少问题空间，并利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 进行推理。 GLiM采用级联方法：首先，图增强型Transformer通过根据实体数量动态调整图大小来处理更细粒度的实体对关系；然后，LLM 推理可以处理具有挑战性的案例。实验表明，GLiM 将平均召回率和 F1 分数分别提高了 +6.34 和 +4.41，在生物医学基准上优于最先进的模型。这些结果证明了将图增强型 Transformer 与 LLM 推理相结合对于生物医学 DocRE 的有效性。代码将在 https://github.com/HaoFang10/GLiM 发布。

title: Conservative Bias in Large Language Models: Measuring Relation Predictions
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit pronounced conservative bias in relation extraction tasks, frequently defaulting to no_relation label when an appropriate option is unavailable. While this behavior helps prevent incorrect relation assignments, our analysis reveals that it also leads to significant information loss when reasoning is not explicitly included in the output. We systematically evaluate this trade-off across multiple prompts, datasets, and relation types, introducing the concept of Hobson’s choice to capture scenarios where models opt for safe but uninformative labels over hallucinated ones. Our findings suggest that conservative bias occurs twice as often as hallucination. To quantify this effect, we use SBERT and LLM prompts to capture the semantic similarity between conservative bias behaviors in constrained prompts and labels generated from semi-constrained and open-ended prompts.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在关系提取任务中表现出明显的保守偏见，当适当的选项不可用时，经常默认为 no_relation 标签。虽然这种行为有助于防止错误的关系分配，但我们的分析表明，当输出中未明确包含推理时，它也会导致重大信息丢失。我们系统地评估了多种提示、数据集和关系类型之间的这种权衡，引入了霍布森选择的概念，以捕获模型选择安全但无信息标签而不是幻觉标签的场景。我们的研究结果表明，保守偏见的发生频率是幻觉的两倍。为了量化这种影响，我们使用 SBERT 和 LLM 提示来捕获受限提示中的保守偏见行为与半受限和开放式提示生成的标签之间的语义相似性。

title: Document-Level Relation Extraction with Global Relations and Entity Pair Reasoning
abstract_en: Document-level relation extraction (DocRE) aims to extract structured relational triples from unstructured text based on given entities. Existing methods are mainly categorized into transformer-based models and graph-based models. While transformer-based models capture global contextual information, they typically focus on individual entity pairs, making it challenging to capture complex interactions between multiple entity pairs. Graph-based models build document graphs using entities or sentences as nodes for reasoning but often lack explicit mechanisms to model fine-grained interactions between entity pairs, limiting their ability to handle complex relational reasoning tasks. Additionally, previous research has not considered predicting all possible relations in advance to assist with DocRE tasks. To address these issues, we propose a new framework namely **GREP** (**g**lobal **r**elations and **e**ntity **p**air reasoning) for DocRE tasks. GREP leverages the global interdependencies between entity pairs to capture fine-grained interactions and perform multi reasoning at the entity pair level. In addtion, GREP for the first time proposes an auxiliary task that predicts all possible relations in advance that exist in a document, which enables the model to filter out the most unlikely relations. Experimental results on widely-used datasets demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code is available at https://github.com/yanyi74/GREP.
abstract_zh: 文档级关系提取（DocRE）旨在基于给定实体从非结构化文本中提取结构化关系三元组。现有的方法主要分为基于变压器的模型和基于图的模型。虽然基于变压器的模型捕获全局上下文信息，但它们通常关注单个实体对，这使得捕获多个实体对之间的复杂交互变得具有挑战性。基于图的模型使用实体或句子作为推理节点来构建文档图，但通常缺乏明确的机制来建模实体对之间的细粒度交互，从而限制了它们处理复杂关系推理任务的能力。此外，之前的研究并未考虑提前预测所有可能的关系来协助 DocRE 任务。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一个新的 DocRE 任务框架，即 **GREP**（**g**lobal **r**elations 和 **e**ntity **p**air Reasoning）。 GREP 利用实体对之间的全局相互依赖关系来捕获细粒度交互并在实体对级别执行多重推理。此外，GREP首次提出了一个辅助任务，可以提前预测文档中存在的所有可能的关系，这使得模型能够过滤掉最不可能的关系。在广泛使用的数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的模型实现了最先进的性能。代码可在 https://github.com/yanyi74/GREP 获取。

title: An Adaptive Multi-Threshold Loss and a General Framework for Collaborating Losses in Document-Level Relation Extraction
abstract_en: The goal of document-level relation extraction (DocRE) is to identify relations for a given entity pair within a document. As a multilabel classification task, the most commonly employed method involves introducing an adaptive threshold. Specifically, for an entity pair, if the scores of predicted relations exceed the threshold, the relations exist. However, we observe two phenomena that significantly weaken the model’s performance in DocRE: (1) as the label space (the number of relations) expands, the model’s performance gradually declines; (2) the model tends to prioritize predicting high-frequency relations in the long-tail problem. To address these challenges, we propose an innovative **A**daptive **M**ulti-**T**hreshold **L**oss (AMTL), which for the first time proposes to partition the label space into different sub-label spaces (thus reducing its overall size) and learn an adaptive threshold for each sub-label space. This approach allows for more precise tuning of the model’s sensitivity to diverse relations, mitigating the performance degradation associated with label space expansion and the long-tail problem. Moreover, our adaptive multi-threshold method can be considered as a general framework that seamlessly integrates different losses in different sub-label spaces, facilitating the concurrent application of multiple losses. Experimental results demonstrate that AMTL significantly enhances the performance of existing DocRE models across four datasets, achieving state-of-the-art results. The experiments on the concurrent application of multiple losses with our framework show stable performance and outperform single-loss methods. Code is available at https://github.com/xhm-code/AMTL.
abstract_zh: 文档级关系提取 (DocRE) 的目标是识别文档中给定实体对的关系。作为多标签分类任务，最常用的方法是引入自适应阈值。具体来说，对于实体对，如果预测关系的分数超过阈值，则关系存在。然而，我们观察到两个现象在DocRE中显着削弱了模型的性能：（1）随着标签空间（关系数量）的扩大，模型的性能逐渐下降； （2）模型倾向于优先预测长尾问题中的高频关系。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种创新的**A**daptive **M**ulti-**T**hreshold **L**oss（AMTL），它首次提出将标签空间划分为不同的子标签空间（从而减小其整体大小），并学习每个子标签空间的自适应阈值。这种方法可以更精确地调整模型对不同关系的敏感性，减轻与标签空间扩展和长尾问题相关的性能下降。此外，我们的自适应多阈值方法可以被视为一个通用框架，可以无缝集成不同子标签空间中的不同损失，从而促进多个损失的并发应用。实验结果表明，AMTL 显着增强了四个数据集上现有 DocRE 模型的性能，实现了最先进的结果。使用我们的框架并发应用多个损失的实验显示出稳定的性能并且优于单一损失方法。代码可在 https://github.com/xhm-code/AMTL 获取。

title: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Relation Extraction within a Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework
abstract_en: Information Extraction (IE) plays a pivotal role in transforming unstructured data into structured formats, such as Knowledge Graphs. One of the main tasks within IE is Relation Extraction (RE), which identifies relations between entities in text data. This process enriches the semantic understanding of documents, enabling more precise information retrieval and query answering. Recent works leveraging pre-trained language models have demonstrated significant performance improvements in RE. In the current era of Large Language Models (LLMs), fine-tuning these LLMs can mitigate the limitations of zero-shot RE methods, particularly in overcoming the domain adaptation challenges inherent in RE. This work explores not only the effectiveness of fine-tuned LLMs but also their integration into a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based RE approach to address domain adaptation challenges when general-purpose LLMs serve as generators within the RAG framework. Empirical evaluations on the TACRED, TACRED-Revisited (TACREV), and Re-TACRED datasets reveal substantial performance improvements with fine-tuned LLMs, such as Llama2-7B, Mistral-7B, and Flan-T5 Large and surpass previous methods on these datasets.
abstract_zh: 信息提取（IE）在将非结构化数据转换为结构化格式（例如知识图）方面发挥着关键作用。 IE 中的主要任务之一是关系提取 (RE)，它识别文本数据中实体之间的关系。这个过程丰富了文档的语义理解，从而实现更精确的信息检索和查询回答。最近利用预训练语言模型的工作已经证明 RE 的性能得到显着提高。在当前大型语言模型 (LLM) 时代，微调这些 LLM 可以减轻零样本 RE 方法的局限性，特别是在克服 RE 固有的领域适应挑战方面。这项工作不仅探讨了微调 LLM 的有效性，还探讨了它们与基于检索增强生成 (RAG) 的 RE 方法的集成，以解决当通用 LLM 充当 RAG 框架内的生成器时的领域适应挑战。对 TACRED、TACRED-Revisited (TACREV) 和 Re-TACRED 数据集的实证评估揭示了经过微调的 LLM（例如 Llama2-7B、Mistral-7B 和 Flan-T5 Large）的显着性能改进，并超越了这些数据集上以前的方法。

title: From Syntax to Semantics: Evaluating the Impact of Linguistic Structures onLLM-Based Information Extraction
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have brought significant breakthroughs across all areas of Natural Language Processing (NLP), including Information Extraction (IE). However, knowledge gaps remain regarding their effectiveness in extracting entity-relation triplets, i.e. Joint Relation Extraction (JRE). JRE has been a key operation in creating knowledge bases that can be used to enhance Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Prior work highlights low-quality triplets generated by LLMs. Thus, this work investigates the impact of incorporating linguistic structures, such as constituency and dependency trees and semantic role labeling, to enhance the quality of the extracted triplets. The findings suggest that incorporating specific structural information enhances the uniqueness and topical relevance of the triplets, particularly in scenarios where multiple relationships are present.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在自然语言处理 (NLP) 的所有领域（包括信息提取 (IE)）带来了重大突破。然而，关于它们在提取实体关系三元组（即联合关系提取（JRE））方面的有效性仍然存在知识差距。 JRE 一直是创建可用于增强检索增强生成 (RAG) 系统的知识库的关键操作。之前的工作强调了大语言模型产生的低质量三元组。因此，这项工作研究了合并语言结构（例如选区和依存树以及语义角色标签）的影响，以提高提取的三元组的质量。研究结果表明，纳入特定的结构信息可以增强三元组的独特性和主题相关性，特别是在存在多种关系的场景中。

title: Cognitive Mirroring forDocRE: A Self-Supervised Iterative Reflection Framework with Triplet-Centric Explicit and Implicit Feedback
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have advanced document-level relation extraction (DocRE), but DocRE is more complex than sentence-level relation extraction (SentRE), facing challenges like diverse relation types, coreference resolution and long-distance dependencies. Traditional pipeline methods, which detect relations before generating triplets, often propagate errors and harm performance. Meanwhile, fine-tuning methods require extensive human-annotated data, and in-context learning (ICL) underperforms compared to supervised approaches. We propose an iterative reflection framework for DocRE, inspired by human non-linear reading cognition. The framework leverages explicit and implicit relations between triplets to provide feedback for LLMs refinement. Explicit feedback uses logical rules-based reasoning, while implicit feedback reconstructs triplets into documents for comparison. This dual-process iteration mimics human semantic cognition, enabling dynamic optimization through self-generated supervision. For the first time, this achieves zero-shot performance comparable to fully supervised models. Experiments show our method surpasses existing LLM-based approaches and matches state-of-the-art BERT-based methods.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）具有先进的文档级关系提取（DocRE），但DocRE比句子级关系提取（SentRE）更复杂，面临关系类型多样化、共指解析和长距离依赖等挑战。传统的管道方法在生成三元组之前检测关系，通常会传播错误并损害性能。与此同时，微调方法需要大量的人工注释数据，而上下文学习（ICL）与监督方法相比表现不佳。受人类非线性阅读认知的启发，我们提出了 DocRE 的迭代反射框架。该框架利用三元组之间的显式和隐式关系为大语言模型的改进提供反馈。显式反馈使用基于逻辑规则的推理，而隐式反馈将三元组重建为文档以进行比较。这种双进程迭代模仿人类语义认知，通过自我生成的监督实现动态优化。这首次实现了与完全监督模型相当的零样本性能。实验表明，我们的方法超越了现有的基于 LLM 的方法，并与最先进的基于 BERT 的方法相匹配。

title: DocIE@XLLM25:ZeroSemble - Robust and Efficient Zero-Shot Document Information Extraction with Heterogeneous Large Language Model Ensembles
abstract_en: The schematization of knowledge, including the extraction of entities and relations from documents, poses significant challenges to traditional approaches because of the document’s ambiguity, heterogeneity, and high cost domain-specific training. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) allow for extraction without prior training on the dataset, the requirement of fine-tuning along with low precision, especially in relation extraction, serves as an obstacle. In absence of domain-specific training, we present a new zero-shot ensemble approach using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B, Llama-3.3-70B, and Qwen-2.5-32B. Our key innovation is a two-stage pipeline that first consolidates high-confidence entities through ensemble techniques, then leverages Qwen-2.5-32B with engineered prompts to generate precise semantic triples. This approach effectively resolves the low precision problem typically encountered in relation extraction. Experiments demonstrate significant gains in both accuracy and efficiency across diverse domains, with our method ranking in the top 2 on the official leaderboard in Shared Task-IV of The 1st Joint Workshop on Large Language Models and Structure Modeling. This competitive performance validates our approach as a compelling solution for practitioners seeking robust document-level information extraction without the burden of task-specific fine-tuning. Our code can be found at https://github.com/dinhthienan33/ZeroSemble.
abstract_zh: 由于文档的模糊性、异构性和特定领域培训的高成本，知识的图式化（包括从文档中提取实体和关系）对传统方法提出了重大挑战。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）允许在不事先对数据集进行训练的情况下进行提取，但微调的要求和低精度，特别是在关系提取中，成为了障碍。在缺乏特定领域训练的情况下，我们使用 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B、Llama-3.3-70B 和 Qwen-2.5-32B 提出了一种新的零样本集成方法。我们的关键创新是一个两阶段管道，首先通过集成技术整合高置信度实体，然后利用 Qwen-2.5-32B 和工程提示来生成精确的语义三元组。该方法有效解决了关系抽取中常见的精度低的问题。实验表明，不同领域的准确性和效率都有显着提高，我们的方法在第一届大型语言模型和结构建模联合研讨会共享任务 IV 的官方排行榜上排名前 2。这种具有竞争力的性能证明我们的方法对于寻求强大的文档级信息提取而无需进行特定于任务的微调的负担的从业者来说是一种引人注目的解决方案。我们的代码可以在 https://github.com/dinhthienan33/ZeroSemble 找到。

title: DocIE@XLLM25: In-Context Learning for Information Extraction using Fully Synthetic Demonstrations
abstract_en: Large, high-quality annotated corpora remain scarce in document-level entity and relation extraction in zero-shot or few-shot settings.In this paper, we present a fully automatic, LLM-based pipeline for synthetic data generation and in-context learning for document-level entity and relation extraction.In contrast to existing approaches that rely on manually annotated demonstrations or direct zero-shot inference, our method combines synthetic data generation with retrieval-based in-context learning, using a reasoning-optimized language model.This allows us to build a high-quality demonstration database without manual annotation and to dynamically retrieve relevant examples at inference time.Based on our approach we produce a synthetic dataset of over5kWikipedia abstracts with approximately59kentities and30krelation triples.Finally, we evaluate in-context learning performance on the DocIE shared task, extracting entities and relations from long documents in a zero-shot setting.The code and synthetic dataset are made available for future research.
abstract_zh:
在零镜头或少镜头设置下的文档级实体和关系提取中，大型、高质量的带注释语料库仍然稀缺。在本文中，我们提出了一种全自动、基于 LLM 的管道，用于文档级实体和关系提取的合成数据生成和上下文学习。与依赖手动注释演示或直接零镜头推理的现有方法相比，我们的方法使用推理优化的语言模型，将合成数据生成与基于检索的上下文学习相结合。这允许我们构建了一个无需手动注释的高质量演示数据库，并在推理时动态检索相关示例。基于我们的方法，我们生成了超过 5k 维基百科摘要的合成数据集，其中包含大约 59 个实体和 30k 个关系三元组。最后，我们评估了 DocIE 共享任务的上下文学习性能，在零样本设置中从长文档中提取实体和关系。代码和合成数据集可用于未来的研究。

## 信息抽取 (31 篇)

title: Cuckoo: AnIEFree Rider Hatched by Massive Nutrition inLLM’s Nest
abstract_en: Massive high-quality data, both pre-training raw texts and post-training annotations, have been carefully prepared to incubate advanced large language models (LLMs). In contrast, for information extraction (IE), pre-training data, such as BIO-tagged sequences, are hard to scale up. We show that IE models can act as free riders on LLM resources by reframing next-tokenpredictionintoextractionfor tokens already present in the context. Specifically, our proposed next tokens extraction (NTE) paradigm learns a versatile IE model,Cuckoo, with 102.6M extractive data converted from LLM’s pre-training and post-training data. Under the few-shot setting, Cuckoo adapts effectively to traditional and complex instruction-following IE with better performance than existing pre-trained IE models. As a free rider, Cuckoo can naturally evolve with the ongoing advancements in LLM data preparation, benefiting from improvements in LLM training pipelines without additional manual effort.
abstract_zh: 海量高质量数据，包括训练前的原始文本和训练后的注释，都经过精心准备，用于孵化高级大语言模型（LLM）。相比之下，对于信息提取（IE），预训练数据（例如 BIO 标记序列）很难扩展。我们表明，IE 模型可以通过将下一个令牌预测重新构建为上下文中已存在令牌的提取来充当 LLM 资源的搭便车者。具体来说，我们提出的下一个令牌提取（NTE）范式学习了一个通用的 IE 模型 Cuckoo，具有从 LLM 的训练前和训练后数据转换而来的 102.6M 提取数据。在few-shot设置下，Cuckoo有效地适应了传统且复杂的指令跟踪IE，并且比现有的预训练IE模型具有更好的性能。作为搭便车者，Cuckoo 可以自然地随着 LLM 数据准备方面的不断进步而发展，受益于 LLM 培训管道的改进，而无需额外的手动操作。

title: TST: A Schema-Based Top-Down and Dynamic-Aware Agent of Text-to-Table Tasks
abstract_en: As a bridge between natural texts and information systems like structured storage, statistical analysis, retrieving, and recommendation, the text-to-table task has received widespread attention recently. Existing researches have gone through a paradigm shift from traditional bottom-up IE (Information Extraction) to top-down LLMs-based question answering with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Furthermore, these methods mainly adopt end-to-end models or use multi-stage pipelines to extract text content based on static table structures. However, they neglect to deal with precise inner-document evidence extraction and dynamic information such as multiple entities and events, which can not be defined in static table head format and are very common in natural texts.To address this issue, we propose a two-stage dynamic content extraction agent framework called TST (Text-Schema-Table), which uses type recognition methods to extract context evidences with the conduction of domain schema sequentially. Based on the evidence, firstly we quantify the total instances of each dynamic object and then extract them with ordered numerical prompts. Through extensive comparisons with existing methods across different datasets, our extraction framework exhibits state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Our codes are available athttps://github.com/jiangpw41/TST.
