abstract_zh: 医疗对话系统 (MDS) 已成为与患者进行多轮、情境感知对话的重要在线平台。然而，现有的 MDS 通常难以 (1) 识别相关的医学知识和 (2) 生成个性化的、医学上准确的响应。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 MedRef，这是一种结合了知识提炼和动态提示调整的新型 MDS。首先，我们采用知识提炼机制来过滤掉不相关的医疗数据，改进对关键医疗实体的响应预测。此外，我们设计了一个全面的提示结构，其中包含历史细节和明显细节。为了实现对不同患者状况的实时适应，我们实施了两个关键模块：三元组过滤器和演示选择器，在系统提示中提供适当的知识和演示。对 MedDG 和 KaMed 基准的大量实验表明，MedRef 在生成质量和医疗实体准确性方面均优于最先进的基线，强调了其在现实世界医疗保健应用中的有效性和可靠性。

title: Enhancing Complex Reasoning in Knowledge Graph Question Answering through Query Graph Approximation
abstract_en: Knowledge-grounded Question Answering (QA) aims to provide answers to structured queries or natural language questions by leveraging Knowledge Graphs (KGs). Existing approaches are mainly divided into Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) and Complex Query Answering (CQA). Both approaches have limitations: the first struggles to utilize KG context effectively when essential triplets related to the questions are missing in the given KGs, while the second depends on structured first-order logic queries. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel framework termed Aqua-QA. Aqua-QAapproximates query graphs from natural language questions, enabling reasoning over KGs. We evaluate Aqua-QA on challenging QA tasks where KGs are incomplete in the context of QA, and complex logical reasoning is required to answer natural language questions. Experimental results on these datasets demonstrate that Aqua-QA outperforms existing methods, showcasing its effectiveness in handling complex reasoning tasks in knowledge-grounded QA settings.
abstract_zh: 基于知识的问答 (QA) 旨在利用知识图 (KG) 为结构化查询或自然语言问题提供答案。现有的方法主要分为知识图问答（KGQA）和复杂查询回答（CQA）。这两种方法都有局限性：当给定的知识图谱中缺少与问题相关的基本三元组时，第一种方法很难有效地利用知识图谱上下文，而第二种方法则依赖于结构化的一阶逻辑查询。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一个名为 Aqua-QA 的新颖框架。 Aqua-QA 近似自然语言问题的查询图，从而能够对知识图谱进行推理。我们在具有挑战性的 QA 任务上评估 Aqua-QA，其中 KG 在 QA 环境中不完整，并且需要复杂的逻辑推理来回答自然语言问题。这些数据集的实验结果表明，Aqua-QA 优于现有方法，展示了其在基于知识的 QA 设置中处理复杂推理任务的有效性。

title: ABayesian Approach to Inferring Prerequisite Structures and Topic Difficulty in Language Learning
abstract_en: Understanding how linguistic topics are related to each another is essential for designing effective and adaptive second-language (L2) instruction. We present a data-driven framework to model topic dependencies and their difficulty within a L2 learning curriculum. First, we estimate topic difficulty and student ability using a three-parameter Item Response Theory (IRT) model. Second, we construct topic-level knowledge graphs—as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs)—to capture the prerequisite relations among the topics, comparing a threshold-based method with the statistical Grow-Shrink Markov Blanket algorithm. Third, we evaluate the alignment between IRT-inferred topic difficulty and the structure of the graphs using edge-level and global ordering metrics. Finally, we compare the IRT-based estimates of learner ability with assessments of the learners provided by teachers to validate the model’s effectiveness in capturing learner proficiency. Our results show a promising agreement between the inferred graphs, IRT estimates, and human teachers’ assessments, highlighting the framework’s potential to support personalized learning and adaptive curriculum design in intelligent tutoring systems.
abstract_zh: 了解语言主题如何相互关联对于设计有效且适应性强的第二语言 (L2) 教学至关重要。我们提出了一个数据驱动的框架来模拟第二语言学习课程中的主题依赖性及其难度。首先，我们使用三参数项目反应理论（IRT）模型来估计主题难度和学生能力。其次，我们构建主题级知识图（有向无环图（DAG））来捕获主题之间的先决关系，将基于阈值的方法与统计增长-收缩马尔可夫毯算法进行比较。第三，我们使用边缘级和全局排序指标来评估 IRT 推断的主题难度与图结构之间的一致性。最后，我们将基于 IRT 的学习者能力估计与教师提供的学习者评估进行比较，以验证该模型在捕获学习者熟练程度方面的有效性。我们的结果显示，推断图、IRT 估计和人类教师的评估之间存在良好的一致性，凸显了该框架在支持智能辅导系统中的个性化学习和自适应课程设计方面的潜力。

title: Enhancing Antimicrobial Drug Resistance Classification by Integrating Sequence-Based and Text-Based Representations
abstract_en: Antibiotic resistance identification is essential for public health, medical treatment, and drug development. Traditional sequence-based models struggle with accurate resistance prediction due to the lack of biological context. To address this, we propose an NLP-based model that integrates genetic sequences with structured textual annotations, including gene family classifications and resistance mechanisms. Our approach leverages pretrained language models for both genetic sequences and biomedical text, aligning biological metadata with sequence-based embeddings. We construct a novel dataset based on the Antibiotic Resistance Ontology (ARO), consolidating gene sequences with resistance-related textual information. Experiments show that incorporating domain knowledge significantly improves classification accuracy over sequence-only models, reducing reliance on exhaustive laboratory testing. By integrating genetic sequence processing with biomedical text understanding, our approach provides a scalable and interpretable solution for antibiotic resistance prediction.
abstract_zh: 抗生素耐药性鉴定对于公共卫生、医疗和药物开发至关重要。由于缺乏生物背景，传统的基于序列的模型难以准确预测耐药性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种基于 NLP 的模型，将基因序列与结构化文本注释相结合，包括基因家族分类和耐药机制。我们的方法利用针对基因序列和生物医学文本的预训练语言模型，将生物元数据与基于序列的嵌入对齐。我们构建了一个基于抗生素耐药性本体论（ARO）的新颖数据集，将基因序列与耐药性相关文本信息整合在一起。实验表明，与仅序列模型相比，结合领域知识显着提高了分类准确性，减少了对详尽实验室测试的依赖。通过将基因序列处理与生物医学文本理解相结合，我们的方法为抗生素耐药性预测提供了可扩展且可解释的解决方案。

title: Beyond Citations: Integrating Finding-Based Relations for Improved Biomedical Article Representations
abstract_en: High-quality scientific article embeddings are essential for tasks like document retrieval, citation recommendation, and classification. Traditional citation-based approaches assume citations reflect semantic similarity—an assumption that introduces bias and noise. Recent models like SciNCL and SPECTER2 have attempted to refine citation-based representations but still struggle with noisy citation edges and fail to fully leverage textual information. To address these limitations, we propose a hybrid approach that combines Finding-Citation Graphs (FCG) with contrastive learning. Our method improves triplet selection by filtering out less important citations and incorporating finding similarity relations, leading to better semantic relationship capture. Evaluated on the SciRepEval benchmark, our approach consistently outperforms citation-only baselines, showing the value of text-based semantic structures. While we do not surpass state-of-the-art models in most tasks, our results reveal the limitations of purely citation-based embeddings and suggest paths for improvement through enhanced semantic integration and domain-specific adaptations.
abstract_zh: 高质量的科学文章嵌入对于文档检索、引文推荐和分类等任务至关重要。传统的基于引文的方法假设引文反映了语义相似性，这一假设引入了偏见和噪音。最近的模型，如 SciNCL 和 SPECTRE2，试图改进基于引文的表示，但仍然与嘈杂的引文边缘作斗争，并且无法充分利用文本信息。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了一种将查找引文图（FCG）与对比学习相结合的混合方法。我们的方法通过过滤掉不太重要的引用并结合寻找相似关系来改进三元组选择，从而更好地捕获语义关系。根据 SciRepEval 基准进行评估，我们的方法始终优于仅引用基线，显示了基于文本的语义结构的价值。虽然我们在大多数任务中没有超越最先进的模型，但我们的结果揭示了纯粹基于引用的嵌入的局限性，并提出了通过增强语义集成和特定领域适应来改进的路径。

title: MuCoS: Efficient Drug–Target Discovery via Multi-Context-Aware Sampling in Knowledge Graphs
abstract_en: Accurate prediction of drug–target interactions is critical for accelerating drug discovery. In this work, we frame drug–target prediction as a link prediction task on heterogeneous biomedical knowledge graphs (KG) that integrate drugs, proteins, diseases, pathways, and other relevant entities. Conventional KG embedding methods such as TransE and ComplEx-SE are hindered by their reliance on computationally intensive negative sampling and their limited generalization to unseen drug–target pairs. To address these challenges, we propose Multi-Context-Aware Sampling (MuCoS), a novel framework that prioritizes high-density neighbours to capture salient structural patterns and integrates these with contextual embeddings derived from BERT. By unifying structural and textual modalities and selectively sampling highly informative patterns, MuCoS circumvents the need for negative sampling, significantly reducing computational overhead while enhancing predictive accuracy for novel drug–target associations and drug targets. Extensive experiments on the KEGG50k and PharmKG-8k datasets demonstrate that MuCoS outperforms baselines, achieving up to a 13% improvement in MRR for general relation prediction on KEGG50k, a 22% improvement on PharmKG-8k, and a 6% gain in dedicated drug–target relation prediction on KEGG50k.
abstract_zh: 准确预测药物与靶点相互作用对于加速药物发现至关重要。在这项工作中，我们将药物-靶点预测框架为异构生物医学知识图（KG）上的链接预测任务，整合了药物、蛋白质、疾病、途径和其他相关实体。传统的 KG 嵌入方法（例如 TransE 和 ComplEx-SE）因其对计算密集型负采样的依赖以及对看不见的药物靶点对的泛化有限而受到阻碍。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了多上下文感知采样（MuCoS），这是一种新颖的框架，它优先考虑高密度邻居以捕获显着的结构模式，并将其与源自 BERT 的上下文嵌入相集成。通过统一结构和文本模式并选择性地对信息丰富的模式进行采样，MuCoS 避免了负采样的需要，显着减少了计算开销，同时提高了新型药物靶点关联和药物靶点的预测准确性。在 KEGG50k 和 PharmKG-8k 数据集上进行的大量实验表明，MuCoS 的性能优于基线，在 KEGG50k 上的一般关系预测中，MRR 提高了 13%，在 PharmKG-8k 上提高了 22%，在 KEGG50k 上的专用药物-靶点关系预测中提高了 6%。

title: razreshili atArchEHR-QA2025: Contrastive Fine-Tuning for Retrieval-Augmented BiomedicalQA
abstract_en: We present a retrieval-augmented system for the ArchEHR-QA 2025 shared task, which focuses on generating concise, medically accurate answers to clinical questions based on a patient’s electronic health record (EHR). A key challenge is following a strict cita- tion format that references relevant sentence IDs. To improve retrieval, we fine-tuned an all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedding model using contrastive learning on over 2,300 question–sentence triplets, with DoRA for efficient adaptation. Sentences were selected using cosine similarity thresholds and passed into a quantized Mistral-7B-Instruct model along with a structured prompt. Our system achieved similar relevance to the baseline but lower overall performance (19.3 vs. 30.7), due to issues with citation formatting and generation quality. We discuss limitations such as threshold tuning, prompt-following ability, and model size, and suggest future directions for improving structured biomedical QA.
abstract_zh: 我们为 ArchEHR-QA 2025 共享任务提出了一个检索增强系统，该系统侧重于根据患者的电子健康记录 (EHR) 为临床问题生成简洁、医学上准确的答案。一个关键的挑战是遵循引用相关句子 ID 的严格引用格式。为了改进检索，我们使用对 2,300 多个问题句三元组的对比学习来微调全 MiniLM-L6-v2 嵌入模型，并使用 DoRA 进行有效适应。使用余弦相似度阈值选择句子，并将其与结构化提示一起传递到量化的 Mistral-7B-Instruct 模型中。由于引文格式和生成质量问题，我们的系统实现了与基线相似的相关性，但总体性能较低（19.3 比 30.7）。我们讨论了阈值调整、提示跟踪能力和模型大小等限制，并提出了改进结构化生物医学 QA 的未来方向。

title: Capacity Matters: a Proof-of-Concept for Transformer Memorization on Real-World Data
abstract_en: This paper studies how the model architecture and data configurations influence the empirical memorization capacity of generative transformers. The models are trained using synthetic text datasets derived from the Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine (SNOMED) knowledge graph: triplets, representing static connections, and sequences, simulating complex relation patterns. The results show that embedding size is the primary determinant of learning speed and capacity, while additional layers provide limited benefits and may hinder performance on simpler datasets. Activation functions play a crucial role, and Softmax demonstrates greater stability and capacity. Furthermore, increasing the complexity of the data set seems to improve the final memorization. These insights improve our understanding of transformer memory mechanisms and provide a framework for optimizing model design with structured real-world data.
abstract_zh: 本文研究模型架构和数据配置如何影响生成变压器的经验记忆能力。这些模型使用源自医学系统命名法 (SNOMED) 知识图的合成文本数据集进行训练：三元组，表示静态连接和序列，模拟复杂的关系模式。结果表明，嵌入大小是学习速度和容量的主要决定因素，而附加层提供的好处有限，并且可能会阻碍更简单数据集的性能。激活函数起着至关重要的作用，Softmax 表现出更高的稳定性和容量。此外，增加数据集的复杂性似乎可以提高最终的记忆力。这些见解提高了我们对变压器内存机制的理解，并提供了一个利用结构化现实数据优化模型设计的框架。

title: Creating Hierarchical Relations in a Multilingual Event-type Ontology
abstract_en: This paper describes the work on hierarchization of the SynSemClass event-type ontology. The original resource has been extended by a hierarchical structure to model specialization and generalization relations between classes that are formally and technically unrelated in the original ontology. The goal is to enable one to use the ontology enriched by the hierarchical concepts for annotation of running texts in symbolic meaning representations, such as UMR or PDT. The hierarchy is in principle built bottom-up, based on existing SSC classes (concepts). This approach differs from other approaches to semantic classes, such as in WordNet or VerbNet. Although the hierarchical relations are similar, the underlying nodes in the hierarchy are not. In this paper, we describe the challenges related to the principles chosen: single-tree constraint and finding features for the definitions of specificity/generality. Also, a pilot inter-annotator experiment is described that shows the difficulty of the hierarchization task.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了 SynSemClass 事件类型本体的层次化工作。原始资源已通过层次结构进行了扩展，以对原始本体中在形式和技术上不相关的类之间的专业化和泛化关系进行建模。目标是使人们能够使用由分层概念丰富的本体来注释符号含义表示中的运行文本，例如 UMR 或 PDT。该层次结构原则上是基于现有的 SSC 类（概念）自下而上构建的。这种方法不同于其他语义类方法，例如 WordNet 或 VerbNet。尽管层次关系相似，但层次结构中的底层节点却不同。在本文中，我们描述了与所选原则相关的挑战：单树约束和寻找特殊性/通用性定义的特征。此外，还描述了一个试点间注释器实验，该实验显示了层次化任务的难度。

title: What Counts UnderlyingLLMs’ Moral Dilemma Judgments?
abstract_en: Moral judgments in LLMs increasingly capture the attention of researchers in AI ethics domain. This study explores moral judgments of three open-source large language models (LLMs)—Qwen-1.5-14B, Llama3-8B, and DeepSeek-R1 in plausible moral dilemmas, examining their sensitivity to social exposure and collaborative decision-making. Using a dual-process framework grounded in deontology and utilitarianism, we evaluate LLMs’ responses to moral dilemmas under varying social contexts. Results reveal that all models are significantly influenced by moral norms rather than consequences, with DeepSeek-R1 exhibiting a stronger action tendency compared to Qwen-1.5-14B and Llama3-8B, which show higher inaction preferences. Social exposure and collaboration impact LLMs differently: Qwen-1.5-14B becomes less aligned with moral norms under observation, while DeepSeek-R1’s action tendency is moderated by social collaboration. These findings highlight the nuanced moral reasoning capabilities of LLMs and their varying sensitivity to social cues, providing insights into the ethical alignment of AI systems in socially embedded contexts.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型的道德判断越来越引起人工智能伦理领域研究人员的关注。本研究探讨了三种开源大语言模型（LLM）——Qwen-1.5-14B、Llama3-8B 和 DeepSeek-R1 在看似合理的道德困境中的道德判断，检验了它们对社会暴露和协作决策的敏感性。我们使用基于义务论和功利主义的双流程框架，评估大语言模型在不同社会背景下对道德困境的反应。结果显示，所有模型都受到道德规范而非后果的显着影响，与 Qwen-1.5-14B 和 Llama3-8B 相比，DeepSeek-R1 表现出更强的行动倾向，后者表现出更高的不行动偏好。社会暴露和协作对大语言模型的影响不同：Qwen-1.5-14B 与观察下的道德规范不太一致，而 DeepSeek-R1 的行动倾向则受到社会协作的调节。这些发现凸显了大语言模型微妙的道德推理能力及其对社会线索的不同敏感性，为深入了解人工智能系统在社会嵌入环境中的道德一致性提供了见解。

title: TCQA2: A Tiered ConversationalQ&AAgent in Gaming
abstract_en: This paper focuses on intelligent Q&A assistants in gaming, providing timely and accurate services by integrating structured game knowledge graphs, semi-structured FAQ pairs, and unstructured real-time online content. It offers personalized emotional companionship through customized virtual characters and provides gameplay guidance, data queries, and product recommendations through in-game tools. We propose a Tiered Conversational Q&A Agent (TCQA2), characterized by high precision, personalized chat, low response latency, efficient token cost and low-risk responses. Parallel modules in each tier cut latency via distributed tasks. Multiple retrievers and short-term memory boost multi-turn Q&A. Hallucination and safety checks improve response quality. Player tags and long-term memory enable personalization. Real-world evaluations show TCQA2outperforms prompt-engineered LLMs and RAG-based agents in gaming Q&A, personalized dialogue, and risk mitigation.
abstract_zh: 本文主要研究游戏中的智能问答助手，通过整合结构化的游戏知识图谱、半结构化的FAQ对和非结构化的实时在线内容，提供及时、准确的服务。它通过定制的虚拟角色提供个性化的情感陪伴，并通过游戏内工具提供游戏指导、数据查询和产品推荐。我们提出了一种分层对话式问答代理（TCQA2），其特点是高精度、个性化聊天、低响应延迟、高效的令牌成本和低风险响应。每层中的并行模块通过分布式任务减少延迟。多个检索器和短期记忆促进了多轮问答。幻觉和安全检查可提高响应质量。玩家标签和长期记忆可实现个性化。现实世界的评估表明，TCQA2 在游戏问答、个性化对话和风险缓解方面优于即时设计的 LLM 和基于 RAG 的代理。

title: uir-cis atSemEval-2025 Task 3: Detection of Hallucinations in Generated Text
abstract_en: The widespread deployment of large language models (LLMs) across diverse domains has underscored the critical need to ensure the credibility and accuracy of their generated content, particularly in the presence of hallucinations. These hallucinations can severely compromise both the practical performance of models and the security of their applications. In response to this issue, SemEval-2025 Task 3 Mu-SHROOM: Multilingual Shared-task on Hallucinations and Related Observable Overgeneration Mistakes introduces a more granular task for hallucination detection. This task seeks to identify hallucinations in text, accurately locate hallucinated segments, and assess their credibility. In this paper, we present a three-stage method for fine-grained hallucination detection and localization. First, we transform the text into a triplet representation, facilitating more precise hallucination analysis. Next, we leverage a large language model to generate fact-reference texts that correspond to the triplets. Finally, we employ a fact alignment strategy to identify and localize hallucinated segments by evaluating the semantic consistency between the extracted triplets and the generated reference texts. We evaluate our method on the unlabelled test set across all languages in Task 3, demonstrating strong detection performance and validating its effectiveness in multilingual contexts.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在不同领域的广泛部署强调了确保其生成内容的可信度和准确性的迫切需要，特别是在存在幻觉的情况下。这些幻觉可能会严重损害模型的实际性能及其应用程序的安全性。针对这一问题，SemEval-2025 任务 3 Mu-SHROOM：关于幻觉和相关可观察过度生成错误的多语言共享任务引入了更细粒度的幻觉检测任务。该任务旨在识别文本中的幻觉，准确定位幻觉片段并评估其可信度。在本文中，我们提出了一种细粒度幻觉检测和定位的三阶段方法。首先，我们将文本转换为三元组表示，以促进更精确的幻觉分析。接下来，我们利用大型语言模型来生成与三元组相对应的事实参考文本。最后，我们采用事实对齐策略通过评估提取的三元组和生成的参考文本之间的语义一致性来识别和定位幻觉片段。我们在任务 3 中所有语言的未标记测试集上评估了我们的方法，展示了强大的检测性能并验证了其在多语言环境中的有效性。

title: TueCLatSemEval-2025 Task 1: Image-Augmented Prompting and Multimodal Reasoning for Enhanced Idiom Understanding
abstract_en: This paper presents our approach for SemEval-2025 Task 1, Advancing Multimodal Idiomaticity Representation (AdMIRe), which focuses on idiom image ranking via semantic similarity. We explore multiple strategies, including neural networks on extracted embeddings and Siamese networks with triplet loss. A key component of our methodology is the application of advanced prompt engineeringtechniques within multimodal in-context learning (ManyICL), leveraging GPT-4o, CLIP.Our experiments demonstrate that structured and optimized prompts significantly enhancethe model’s ability to interpret idiomatic expressions in a multimodal setting.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们的 SemEval-2025 任务 1 的方法，即推进多模态惯用表达 (AdMIRe)，该方法侧重于通过语义相似性对习语图像进行排序。我们探索了多种策略，包括提取嵌入的神经网络和具有三元组损失的连体网络。我们方法的一个关键组成部分是利用 GPT-4o、CLIP 在多模态上下文学习 (ManyICL) 中应用先进的提示工程技术。我们的实验表明，结构化和优化的提示显着增强了模型在多模态环境中解释惯用表达的能力。

title: Homa atSemEval-2025 Task 5: Aligning Librarian Records withOntoAligner for Subject Tagging
abstract_en: This paper presents our system, Homa, for SemEval-2025 Task 5: Subject Tagging, which focuses on automatically assigning subject labels to technical records from TIBKAT using the Gemeinsame Normdatei (GND) taxonomy. We leverage OntoAligner, a modular ontology alignment toolkit, to address this task by integrating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) techniques. Our approach formulates the subject tagging problem as an alignment task, where records are matched to GND categories based on semantic similarity. We evaluate OntoAligner’s adaptability for subject indexing and analyze its effectiveness in handling multilingual records. Experimental results demonstrate the strengths and limitations of this method, highlighting the potential of alignment techniques for improving subject tagging in digital libraries.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们用于 SemEval-2025 任务 5：主题标记的系统 Homa，该系统侧重于使用 Gemeinsame Normdatei (GND) 分类法自动为 TIBKAT 中的技术记录分配主题标签。我们利用模块化本体对齐工具包 OntoAligner，通过集成检索增强生成 (RAG) 技术来解决此任务。我们的方法将主题标记问题表述为对齐任务，其中根据语义相似性将记录与 GND 类别进行匹配。我们评估了 OntoAligner 对主题索引的适应性，并分析了其处理多语言记录的有效性。实验结果证明了该方法的优点和局限性，突出了对齐技术在改进数字图书馆主题标记方面的潜力。

title: LA²I²FatSemEval-2025 Task 5: Reasoning in Embedding Space – Fusing Analogical and Ontology-based Reasoning for Document Subject Tagging
abstract_en: The LLMs4Subjects shared task invited system contributions that leverage a technical library’s tagged document corpus to learn document subject tagging, i.e., proposing adequate subjects given a document’s title and abstract. To address the imbalance of this training corpus, team LA²I²F devised a semantic retrieval-based system fusing the results of ontological and analogical reasoning in embedding vector space. Our results outperformed a naive baseline of prompting a llama 3.1-based model, whilst being computationally more efficient and competitive with the state of the art.
abstract_zh: LLMs4Subjects 共享任务邀请系统贡献，利用技术图书馆的标记文档语料库来学习文档主题标记，即根据文档的标题和摘要提出足够的主题。为了解决训练语料库的不平衡问题，LA²I²F 团队设计了一种基于语义检索的系统，将本体论和类比推理的结果融合到嵌入向量空间中。我们的结果优于基于 llama 3.1 的模型的简单基线，同时在计算上更加高效，并且与现有技术相比更具竞争力。

title: silp_nlp atSemEval-2025 Task 5: Subject Recommendation With Sentence Transformer
abstract_en: This work explored subject recommendation using sentence transformers within the SemEval-2025 Task 5 (LLMs4Subjects) challenge. Our approach leveraged embedding-based cosine similarity and hierarchical clustering to predict relevant GND subjects for TIB technical records in English and German. By experimenting with different models, including JinaAi, Distiluse-base-multilingual, and TF-IDF, we found that the JinaAi sentence transformer consistently outperformed other methods in terms of precision, recall, and F1-score.Our results highlight the effectiveness of transformer-based embeddings in semantic similarity tasks for subject classification. Additionally, hierarchical clustering helped reduce computational complexity by narrowing down candidate subjects efficiently. Despite the improvements, future work can focus on fine-tuning domain-specific embeddings, exploring knowledge graph integration, and enhancing multilingual capabilities for better generalization.
abstract_zh: 这项工作探索了 SemEval-2025 任务 5 (LLMs4Subjects) 挑战中使用句子转换器的主题推荐。我们的方法利用基于嵌入的余弦相似性和层次聚类来预测英语和德语 TIB 技术记录的相关 GND 主题。通过对 JinaAi、Distiluse-base-multilingual 和 TF-IDF 等不同模型进行实验，我们发现 JinaAi 句子转换器在精度、召回率和 F1 分数方面始终优于其他方法。我们的结果突出了基于转换器的嵌入在主题分类语义相似性任务中的有效性。此外，层次聚类通过有效地缩小候选主题范围，有助于降低计算复杂性。尽管有所改进，未来的工作可以集中在微调特定领域的嵌入、探索知识图集成以及增强多语言能力以实现更好的泛化。

title: OrQA– Open Data Retrieval for Question Answering dataset generation
abstract_en: We present OrQA, a novel agentic framework to generate large-scale tabular question-answering (TQA) datasets based on real-world open data.Such datasets are needed to overcome the limitations of existing benchmark datasets, which rely on synthetic questions or limited web tables.OrQA employs LLM agents to retrieve related open data tables, generate natural questions, and synthesize executableSQLqueries—involving joins, unions, and other non-trivial operations.By leveraging hundreds of GPU hours on four NVIDIA A100, we applied OrQA to Canadian and UK government open data to produce 1,000 question-tables–SQL triples, a representative sample of which has been human‐validated.This open‐source dataset is now publicly available to drive transparency, reproducibility, and progress in table‐based question answering.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了 OrQA，一种新颖的代理框架，用于基于现实世界的开放数据生成大规模表格问答 (TQA) 数据集。此类数据集需要克服现有基准数据集的局限性，这些数据集依赖于合成问题或有限的 Web 表。OrQA 采用 LLM 代理来检索相关的开放数据表，生成自然问题，并合成可执行的 SQL 查询 - 涉及联接、并集和其他重要操作。通过在四个 NVIDIA 上利用数百个 GPU 小时A100，我们将 OrQA 应用于加拿大和英国政府的开放数据，生成 1,000 个问题表 - SQL 三元组，其中的代表性样本已经过人工验证。这个开源数据集现已公开，以提高基于表的问答的透明度、可重复性和进步。

title: Red-Teaming for Uncovering Societal Bias in Large Language Models
abstract_en: Ensuring the safe deployment of AI systems is critical in industry settings where biased outputs can lead to significant operational, reputational, and regulatory risks. Thorough evaluation before deployment is essential to prevent these hazards. Red-teaming addresses this need by employing adversarial attacks to develop guardrails that detect and reject biased or harmful queries, enabling models to be retrained or steered away from harmful outputs. However, red-teaming techniques are often limited, and malicious actors may discover new vulnerabilities that bypass safety fine-tuning, underscoring the need for ongoing research and innovative approaches. Notably, most red-teaming efforts focus on harmful or unethical instructions rather than addressing social bias, leaving this critical area under-explored despite its significant real-world impact, especially in customer-facing AI systems. We propose two bias-specific red-teaming methods, Emotional Bias Probe (EBP) and BiasKG, to evaluate how standard safety measures for harmful content mitigate bias. For BiasKG, we refactor natural language stereotypes into a knowledge graph. and use adversarial attacking strategies to induce biased responses from several open- and closed-source language models. We find our method increases bias in all models, even those trained with safety guardrails. Our work emphasizes uncovering societal bias in LLMs through rigorous evaluation, addressing adversarial challenges to ensure AI safety in high-stakes industry deployments.
abstract_zh: 确保人工智能系统的安全部署在行业环境中至关重要，因为偏差的输出可能会导致重大的运营、声誉和监管风险。部署前进行彻底评估对于防止这些危险至关重要。红队通过采用对抗性攻击来开发检测和拒绝有偏见或有害查询的护栏来满足这一需求，从而使模型能够重新训练或远离有害输出。然而，红队技术通常是有限的，恶意行为者可能会发现绕过安全微调的新漏洞，这凸显了持续研究和创新方法的必要性。值得注意的是，大多数红队工作都集中在有害或不道德的指令上，而不是解决社会偏见，尽管这一关键领域在现实世界中产生了重大影响，但仍未得到充分探索，尤其是在面向客户的人工智能系统中。我们提出了两种特定于偏见的红队方法，即情感偏见探针 (EBP) 和 BiasKG，以评估针对有害内容的标准安全措施如何减轻偏见。对于 BiasKG，我们将自然语言刻板印象重构为知识图谱。并使用对抗性攻击策略来诱导几种开源和闭源语言模型的有偏见的反应。我们发现我们的方法增加了所有模型的偏差，甚至是那些接受过安全护栏训练的模型。我们的工作强调通过严格的评估揭示大语言模型的社会偏见，解决对抗性挑战，以确保高风险行业部署中的人工智能安全。

title: Injecting Structured Knowledge intoLLMs via Graph Neural Networks
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in natural language processing (NLP), but they often struggle to capture explicit linguistic structures and world knowledge. To address this limitation, we propose a hybrid model that integrates LLMs with graph neural networks (GNNs) to inject structured knowledge into NLP tasks. Our approach leverages the strengths of both components: LLMs provide rich contextual representations, while GNNs encode explicit structural priors from sources such as dependency trees, Abstract Meaning Representations (AMRs), and knowledge graphs. We evaluate the hybrid model on a diverse set of tasks, including semantic parsing, multi-hop question answering, text summarization, commonsense reasoning, and dependency parsing. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements over both standalone baselines and state-of-the-art methods, with relative gains of up to 2.3% in Exact Match scores for multi-hop QA and 1.7% in accuracy for commonsense reasoning. Ablation studies and sensitivity analyses further highlight the importance of balancing contextual and structural information. By bridging the gap between unstructured textual data and structured knowledge, our work advances the state of the art in NLP and paves the way for more interpretable and robust language models.
abstract_zh:
大型语言模型 (LLM) 在自然语言处理 (NLP) 方面取得了显着的成功，但它们常常难以捕获明确的语言结构和世界知识。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了一种混合模型，将大语言模型与图神经网络（GNN）集成，将结构化知识注入 NLP 任务中。我们的方法利用了这两个组件的优势：LLM 提供丰富的上下文表示，而 GNN 对来自依赖树、抽象含义表示 (AMR) 和知识图等来源的显式结构先验进行编码。我们在一系列不同的任务上评估混合模型，包括语义解析、多跳问答、文本摘要、常识推理和依存解析。实验结果表明，与独立基线和最先进的方法相比，均取得了一致的改进，多跳 QA 的精确匹配分数相对提高了 2.3%，常识推理的准确度提高了 1.7%。消融研究和敏感性分析进一步强调了平衡背景信息和结构信息的重要性。通过弥合非结构化文本数据和结构化知识之间的差距，我们的工作推进了 NLP 的最新技术，并为更具可解释性和稳健性的语言模型铺平了道路。

## 命名实体识别 (49 篇)

title: Large Margin Representation Learning for Robust Cross-lingual Named Entity Recognition
abstract_en: Cross-lingual named entity recognition (NER) aims to build an NER model that generalizes to the low-resource target language with labeled data from the high-resource source language. Current state-of-the-art methods typically combine self-training mechanism with contrastive learning paradigm, in order to develop discriminative entity clusters for cross-lingual adaptation. Despite the promise, we identify that these methods neglect two key problems: distribution skewness and pseudo-label bias, leading to indistinguishable entity clusters with small margins. To this end, we propose a novel framework, MARAL, which optimizes an adaptively reweighted contrastive loss to handle the class skewness and theoretically guarantees the optimal feature arrangement with maximum margin. To further mitigate the adverse effects of unreliable pseudo-labels, MARAL integrates a progressive cross-lingual adaptation strategy, which first selects reliable samples as anchors and then refines the remaining unreliable ones. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MARAL significantly outperforms the current state-of-the-art methods on multiple benchmarks, e.g., +2.04% on the challenging MultiCoNER dataset.
abstract_zh: 跨语言命名实体识别（NER）旨在构建一个 NER 模型，利用来自高资源源语言的标记数据泛化到低资源目标语言。当前最先进的方法通常将自我训练机制​​与对比学习范式相结合，以开发用于跨语言适应的判别性实体簇。尽管有这样的承诺，我们发现这些方法忽略了两个关键问题：分布偏度和伪标签偏差，导致难以区分的边缘较小的实体簇。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的框架MARAL，它优化了自适应重新加权对比损失来处理类别偏度，并从理论上保证了具有最大余量的最佳特征排列。为了进一步减轻不可靠伪标签的不利影响，MARAL 集成了渐进式跨语言适应策略，该策略首先选择可靠样本作为锚点，然后细化剩余的不可靠样本。大量实验表明，MARAL 在多个基准测试中显着优于当前最先进的方法，例如在具有挑战性的 MultiCoNER 数据集上提高了 2.04%。

title: Selecting and Merging: Towards Adaptable and Scalable Named Entity Recognition with Large Language Models
abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is widely used to align large language models (LLMs) with information extraction (IE) tasks, such as named entity recognition (NER). However, annotating such fine-grained labels and training domain-specific models is costly. Existing works typically train a unified model across multiple domains, but such approaches lack adaptation and scalability since not all training data benefits target domains and scaling trained models remains challenging. We propose the SaM framework, which dynamically Selects and Merges expert models at inference time. Specifically, for a target domain, we select domain-specific experts pre-trained on existing domains based on (i) domain similarity to the target domain and (ii) performance on sampled instances, respectively. The experts are then merged to create task-specific models optimized for the target domain. By dynamically merging experts beneficial to target domains, we improve generalization across various domains without extra training. Additionally, experts can be added or removed conveniently, leading to great scalability. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate our framework’s effectiveness, which outperforms the unified model by an average of 10%. We further provide insights into potential improvements, practical experience, and extensions of our framework.
abstract_zh: 监督微调（SFT）广泛用于将大型语言模型（LLM）与信息提取（IE）任务（例如命名实体识别（NER））结合起来。然而，注释这种细粒度的标签和训练特定领域的模型成本高昂。现有的工作通常跨多个领域训练统一模型，但此类方法缺乏适应性和可扩展性，因为并非所有训练数据都有利于目标领域，并且扩展训练模型仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了 SaM 框架，它在推理时动态选择和合并专家模型。具体来说，对于目标域，我们分别根据（i）与目标域的域相似性和（ii）采样实例的性能来选择在现有域上预先训练的特定域专家。然后，专家们会合并起来，创建针对目标领域优化的特定任务模型。通过动态合并对目标领域有益的专家，我们无需额外培训即可提高各个领域的泛化能力。此外，可以方便地添加或删除专家，从而实现良好的可扩展性。对多个基准的大量实验证明了我们的框架的有效性，其平均性能比统一模型高出 10%。我们进一步提供有关框架的潜在改进、实践经验和扩展的见解。

title: EAGLE: Expert-Guided Self-Enhancement for Preference Alignment in Pathology Large Vision-Language Model
abstract_en: Recent advancements in Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) show promise for pathological diagnosis, yet their application in clinical settings faces critical challenges of multimodal hallucination and biased responses. While preference alignment methods have proven effective in general domains, acquiring high-quality preference data for pathology remains challenging due to limited expert resources and domain complexity. In this paper, we propose EAGLE (Expert-guided self-enhancement for preference Alignment in patholoGy Large vision-languagE model), a novel framework that systematically integrates medical expertise into preference alignment. EAGLE consists of three key stages: initialization through supervised fine-tuning, self-preference creation leveraging expert prompting and medical entity recognition, and iterative preference following-tuning. The self-preference creation stage uniquely combines expert-verified chosen sampling with expert-guided rejected sampling to generate high-quality preference data, while the iterative tuning process continuously refines both data quality and model performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EAGLE significantly outperforms existing pathological LVLMs, effectively reducing hallucination and bias while maintaining pathological accuracy. The source code is available at https://github.com/meidandz/EAGLE.
abstract_zh: 大视觉语言模型（LVLM）的最新进展显示出病理诊断的希望，但它们在临床环境中的应用面临着多模态幻觉和偏见反应的严峻挑战。虽然偏好对齐方法已被证明在一般领域有效，但由于专家资源有限和领域复杂性，获取高质量的病理学偏好数据仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了 EAGLE（病理学大视觉语言模型中偏好调整的专家引导自我增强），这是一种将医学专业知识系统地整合到偏好调整中的新颖框架。 EAGLE 包含三个关键阶段：通过监督微调进行初始化、利用专家提示和医疗实体识别进行自我偏好创建以及迭代偏好跟踪调整。自偏好创建阶段独特地将专家验证的选择抽样与专家指导的拒绝抽样相结合，生成高质量的偏好数据，而迭代调整过程不断完善数据质量和模型性能。大量实验表明，EAGLE 显着优于现有的病理 LVLM，有效减少幻觉和偏差，同时保持病理准确性。源代码可在 https://github.com/meidandz/EAGLE 获取。

title: ECLM: Entity Level Language Model for Spoken Language Understanding with Chain of Intent
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in language generation and general task performance. However, their application to spoken language understanding (SLU) remains challenging, particularly for token-level tasks, where the autoregressive nature of LLMs often leads to misalignment issues. They also struggle to capture nuanced interrelations in semantic-level tasks through direct fine-tuning alone. To address these challenges, we propose the Entity-level Language Model (ECLM) framework, which reformulates slot-filling as an entity recognition task and introduces a novel concept, Chain of Intent, to enable step-by-step multi-intent recognition. Experimental results show that ECLM significantly outperforms strong baselines such as Uni-MIS, achieving gains of 3.7% on MixATIS and 3.1% on MixSNIPS. Compared to standard supervised fine-tuning of LLMs, ECLM further achieves improvements of 8.5% and 21.2% on these datasets, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/SJY8460/ECLM.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在语言生成和一般任务性能方面表现出了令人印象深刻的能力。然而，它们在口语理解（SLU）中的应用仍然具有挑战性，特别是对于标记级任务，大语言模型的自回归性质经常导致错位问题。他们还很难仅通过直接微调来捕捉语义级任务中微妙的相互关系。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了实体级语言模型（ECLM）框架，它将槽填充重新表述为实体识别任务，并引入了一个新概念“意图链”，以实现逐步多意图识别。实验结果表明，ECLM 显着优于 Uni-MIS 等强基线，在 MixATIS 上实现了 3.7% 的增益，在 MixSNIPS 上实现了 3.1% 的增益。与 LLM 的标准监督微调相比，ECLM 在这些数据集上分别进一步实现了 8.5% 和 21.2% 的改进。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/SJY8460/ECLM 获取。

title: Decoding Knowledge Attribution in Mixture-of-Experts: A Framework of Basic-Refinement Collaboration and Efficiency Analysis
abstract_en: The interpretability of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, especially those with heterogeneous designs, remains underexplored. Existing attribution methods for dense models fail to capture dynamic routing-expert interactions in sparse MoE architectures. To address this issue, we propose a cross-level attribution algorithm to analyze sparse MoE architectures (Qwen 1.5-MoE, OLMoE, Mixtral-8x7B) against dense models (Qwen 1.5-7B, Llama-7B, Mistral-7B). Results show MoE models achieve 31% higher per-layer efficiency via a “mid-activation, late-amplification” pattern: early layers screen experts, while late layers refine knowledge collaboratively. Ablation studies reveal a “basic-refinement” framework—shared experts handle general tasks (entity recognition), while routed experts specialize in domain-specific processing (geographic attributes). Semantic-driven routing is evidenced by strong correlations between attention heads and experts (r=0.68), enabling task-aware coordination. Notably, architectural depth dictates robustness: deep Qwen-MoE mitigates expert failures (e.g., 43% MRR drop in geographic tasks when blocking top-10 experts) through shared expert redundancy, whereas shallow Olmoe suffers severe degradation (76% drop). Task sensitivity further guides design: core-sensitive tasks (geography) require concentrated expertise, while distributed-tolerant tasks (object attributes) leverage broader participation. These insights advance MoE interpretability, offering principles to balance efficiency, specialization, and robustness.
abstract_zh: 专家混合 (MoE) 模型的可解释性，尤其是那些具有异构设计的模型，仍未得到充分探索。现有的密集模型归因方法无法捕获稀疏 MoE 架构中的动态路由专家交互。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种跨级归因算法来分析稀疏 MoE 架构（Qwen 1.5-MoE、OLMoE、Mixtral-8x7B）与密集模型（Qwen 1.5-7B、Llama-7B、Mistral-7B）。结果显示，MoE 模型通过“中期激活、后期放大”模式，每层效率提高了 31%：早期层筛选专家，而后期层协作完善知识。消融研究揭示了一个“基本细化”框架——共享专家处理一般任务（实体识别），而路由专家专门从事特定领域的处理（地理属性）。注意力头和专家之间的强相关性证明了语义驱动的路由（r=0.68），从而实现了任务感知协调。值得注意的是，架构深度决定了鲁棒性：深层 Qwen-MoE 通过共享专家冗余来减轻专家故障（例如，当阻止前 10 位专家时，地理任务中的 MRR 下降 43%），而浅层 Olmoe 则遭受严重退化（下降 76%）。任务敏感性进一步指导设计：核心敏感任务（地理）需要集中的专业知识，而分布式容忍任务（对象属性）则利用更广泛的参与。这些见解提高了教育部的可解释性，提供了平衡效率、专业化和稳健性的原则。

title: Data-Constrained Synthesis of Training Data for De-Identification
abstract_en: Many sensitive domains — such as the clinical domain — lack widely available datasets due to privacy risks. The increasing generative capabilities of large language models (LLMs) have made synthetic datasets a viable path forward. In this study, we domain-adapt LLMs to the clinical domain and generate synthetic clinical texts that are machine-annotated with tags for personally identifiable information using capable encoder-based NER models. The synthetic corpora are then used to train synthetic NER models. The results show that training NER models using synthetic corpora incurs only a small drop in predictive performance. The limits of this process are investigated in a systematic ablation study — using both Swedish and Spanish data. Our analysis shows that smaller datasets can be sufficient for domain-adapting LLMs for data synthesis. Instead, the effectiveness of this process is almost entirely contingent on the performance of the machine-annotating NER models trained using the original data.
abstract_zh: 由于隐私风险，许多敏感领域（例如临床领域）缺乏广泛可用的数据集。大型语言模型（LLM）不断增强的生成能力使合成数据集成为一条可行的前进道路。在这项研究中，我们将大语言模型领域适应于临床领域，并使用基于编码器的 NER 模型生成带有个人身份信息标签的机器注释的合成临床文本。然后使用合成语料库来训练合成 NER 模型。结果表明，使用合成语料库训练 NER 模型只会导致预测性能略有下降。使用瑞典和西班牙的数据，在系统消融研究中调查了这一过程的局限性。我们的分析表明，较小的数据集足以满足领域适应大语言模型的数据合成需求。相反，这个过程的有效性几乎完全取决于使用原始数据训练的机器注释 NER 模型的性能。

title: Performance Gap in Entity Knowledge Extraction Across Modalities in Vision Language Models
abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) excel at extracting and reasoning about information from images. Yet, their capacity to leverage internal knowledge about specific entities remains underexplored. This work investigates the disparity in model performance when answering factual questions about an entity described in text versus depicted in an image. Our results reveal a significant accuracy drop — reaching 18% for some models — when the entity is presented visually instead of textually. To study this gap we present PopVQA, a dataset which allows separating entity recognition and question answering, and use it to benchmark several models. We hypothesize that this decline arises from limitations in how information flows from image tokens to query tokens. Thus, we use mechanistic interpretability tools to reveal that, although image tokens are preprocessed by the vision encoder, meaningful information flow from these tokens occurs only in the much deeper layers. Furthermore, critical image processing happens in the language model’s middle layers, allowing few layers for consecutive reasoning, highlighting a potential inefficiency in how the model utilizes its layers for reasoning. These insights shed light on the internal mechanics of VLMs and offer pathways for enhancing their reasoning capabilities. PopVQA can be found at https://huggingface.co/datasets/idoco/PopVQA.
abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型 (VLM) 擅长从图像中提取和推理信息。然而，他们利用有关特定实体的内部知识的能力仍未得到充分探索。这项工作研究了在回答有关文本中描述的实体与图像中描述的实体的事实问题时模型性能的差异。我们的结果显示，当实体以视觉方式而不是文本方式呈现时，准确率会显着下降，某些模型达到 18%。为了研究这一差距，我们提出了 PopVQA，这是一个允许分离实体识别和问题回答的数据集，并用它来对多个模型进行基准测试。我们假设这种下降是由于信息从图像标记流向查询标记的方式的限制所致。因此，我们使用机械可解释性工具来揭示，尽管图像标记是由视觉编码器预处理的，但来自这些标记的有意义的信息流仅发生在更深的层中。此外，关键的图像处理发生在语言模型的中间层，允许很少的层进行连续推理，凸显了模型利用其层进行推理的潜在低效率。这些见解揭示了 VLM 的内部机制，并提供了增强其推理能力的途径。 PopVQA 可以在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/idoco/PopVQA 找到。

title: Basic Reading Distillation
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable abilities in various natural language processing areas, but they demand high computation resources which limits their deployment in real-world. Distillation is one technique to solve this problem through either knowledge distillation or task distillation. Both distillation approaches train small models to imitate specific features of LLMs, but they all neglect basic reading education for small models on generic texts that areunrelatedto downstream tasks. In this paper, we propose basic reading distillation (BRD) which educates a small model to imitate LLMs basic reading behaviors, such as named entity recognition, question raising and answering, on each sentence. After such basic education, we apply the small model on various tasks including language inference benchmarks and BIG-bench tasks. It shows that the small model can outperform or perform comparable to over 20x bigger LLMs. Analysis reveals that BRD effectively influences the probability distribution of the small model, and has orthogonality to either knowledge distillation or task distillation.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在各种自然语言处理领域表现出了卓越的能力，但它们需要大量的计算资源，这限制了它们在现实世界中的部署。蒸馏是通过知识蒸馏或任务蒸馏来解决此问题的一种技术。这两种蒸馏方法都训练小模型来模仿大语言模型的特定特征，但它们都忽略了对与下游任务无关的通用文本的小模型的基础阅读教育。在本文中，我们提出了基本阅读蒸馏（BRD），它训练一个小模型来模仿大语言模型的基本阅读行为，例如每个句子的命名实体识别、提出问题和回答。经过这样的基础教育，我们将小模型应用于各种任务，包括语言推理基准和 BIG-bench 任务。它表明，小型模型的表现可以优于或可与 20 倍以上的大型大语言模型相媲美。分析表明，BRD有效影响小模型的概率分布，并且与知识蒸馏或任务蒸馏具有正交性。

title: Less is More: Explainable and EfficientICDCode Prediction with Clinical Entities
abstract_en: Clinical coding, assigning standardized codes to medical notes, is critical for epidemiological research, hospital planning, and reimbursement. Neural coding models generally process entire discharge summaries, which are often lengthy and contain information that is not relevant to coding. We propose an approach that combines Named Entity Recognition (NER) and Assertion Classification (AC) to filter for clinically important content before supervised code prediction. On MIMIC-IV, a standard evaluation dataset, our approach achieves near-equivalent performance to a state-of-the-art full-text baseline while using only 22% of the content and reducing training time by over half. Additionally, mapping model attention to complete entity spans yields coherent, clinically meaningful explanations, capturing coding-relevant modifiers such as acuity and laterality. We release a newly annotated NER+AC dataset for MIMIC-IV, designed specifically for ICD coding. Our entity-centric approach lays a foundation for more transparent and cost-effective assisted coding.
abstract_zh: 临床编码，即为医疗记录分配标准化代码，对于流行病学研究、医院规划和报销至关重要。神经编码模型通常处理整个出院摘要，这些摘要通常很长并且包含与编码无关的信息。我们提出了一种结合命名实体识别（NER）和断言分类（AC）的方法，在监督代码预测之前过滤临床重要内容。在标准评估数据集 MIMIC-IV 上，我们的方法实现了与最先进的全文基线几乎相同的性能，同时仅使用 22% 的内容并将训练时间减少一半以上。此外，将模型注意力映射到完整的实体范围可以产生连贯的、有临床意义的解释，捕获与编码相关的修饰符，例如敏锐度和偏侧性。我们发布了新注释的 MIMIC-IV NER+AC 数据集，专为 ICD 编码而设计。我们以实体为中心的方法为更透明和更具成本效益的辅助编码奠定了基础。

title: LLMas Entity Disambiguator for Biomedical Entity-Linking
abstract_en: Entity linking involves normalizing a mention in medical text to a unique identifier in a knowledge base, such as UMLS or MeSH. Most entity linkers follow a two-stage process: first, a candidate generation step selects high-quality candidates, and then a named entity disambiguation phase determines the best candidate for final linking. This study demonstrates that leveraging a large language model (LLM) as an entity disambiguator significantly enhances entity linking models’ accuracy and recall. Specifically, the LLM disambiguator achieves remarkable improvements when applied to alias-matching entity linking methods. Without any fine-tuning, our approach establishes a new state-of-the-art (SOTA), surpassing previous methods on multiple prevalent biomedical datasets by up to 16 points in accuracy. We released our code on GitHub at https://github.com/ChristopheYe/llm_disambiguator
abstract_zh: 实体链接涉及将医学文本中的提及规范化为知识库中的唯一标识符，例如 UMLS 或 MeSH。大多数实体链接器遵循两个阶段的过程：首先，候选生成步骤选择高质量候选，然后命名实体消歧阶段确定最终链接的最佳候选。这项研究表明，利用大型语言模型（LLM）作为实体消歧器可以显着提高实体链接模型的准确性和召回率。具体来说，LLM 消歧器在应用于别名匹配实体链接方法时取得了显着的改进。无需任何微调，我们的方法就建立了新的最先进 (SOTA)，在多个流行的生物医学数据集上的准确度比之前的方法高出多达 16 个点。我们在 GitHub 上发布了代码：https://github.com/ChristopheYe/llm_disambiguator

title: EnhancingNERby Harnessing Multiple Datasets with Conditional Variational Autoencoders
abstract_en: We propose a novel method to integrate a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) into a span-based Named Entity Recognition (NER) model to model the shared and unshared information among labels in multiple datasets and ease the training on the datasets. Experimental results using multiple biomedical datasets show the effectiveness of the proposed method, achieving improved performance on the BioRED dataset.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法，将条件变分自动编码器（CVAE）集成到基于跨度的命名实体识别（NER）模型中，以对多个数据集中标签之间的共享和非共享信息进行建模，并简化数据集的训练。使用多个生物医学数据集的实验结果表明了所提出方法的有效性，在 BioRED 数据集上实现了改进的性能。

title: NameTag 3: A Tool and a Service for Multilingual/MultitagsetNER
abstract_en: We introduce NameTag 3, an open-source tool and cloud-based web service for multilingual, multidataset, and multitagset named entity recognition (NER), supporting both flat and nested entities. NameTag 3 achieves state-of-the-art results on 21 test datasets in 15 languages and remains competitive on the rest, even against larger models. It is available as a command-line tool and as a cloud-based service, enabling use without local installation. NameTag 3 web service currently provides flat NER for 17 languages, trained on 21 corpora and three NE tagsets, all powered by a single 355M-parameter fine-tuned model; and nested NER for Czech, powered by a 126M fine-tuned model. The source code is licensed under open-source MPL 2.0, while the models are distributed under non-commercial CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Documentation is available at https://ufal.mff.cuni.cz/nametag, source code at https://github.com/ufal/nametag3, and trained models via https://lindat.cz. The REST service and the web application can be found at https://lindat.mff.cuni.cz/services/nametag/. A demonstration video is available at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-gaGnP0IV8A.
abstract_zh: 我们推出了 NameTag 3，这是一种开源工具和基于云的 Web 服务，用于多语言、多数据集和多标签集命名实体识别 (NER)，支持平面和嵌套实体。 NameTag 3 在 15 种语言的 21 个测试数据集上取得了最先进的结果，并且在其他数据集上保持了竞争力，甚至与更大的模型相比也是如此。它可以作为命令行工具和基于云的服务提供，无需本地安装即可使用。 NameTag 3 Web 服务目前为 17 种语言提供平面 NER，在 21 个语料库和三个 NE 标签集上进行训练，全部由单个 355M 参数微调模型提供支持；以及捷克语的嵌套 NER，由 126M 微调模型提供支持。源代码根据开源 MPL 2.0 获得许可，而模型则根据非商业 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 进行分发。文档可在 https://ufal.mff.cuni.cz/nametag 获取，源代码可在 https://github.com/ufal/nametag3 获取，训练模型可通过 https://lindat.cz 获取。 REST 服务和 Web 应用程序可以在 https://lindat.mff.cuni.cz/services/nametag/ 中找到。演示视频位于 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-gaGnP0IV8A。

title: LIP-NER: Literal Patterns BenefitLLM-BasedNER
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) can enhance the performance of Named Entity Recognition (NER) tasks by leveraging external knowledge through in-context learning. When it comes to entity-type-related external knowledge, existing methods mainly provide LLMs with semantic information such as the definition and annotation guidelines of an entity type, leaving the effect of orthographic or morphological information on LLM-based NER unexplored. Besides, it is non-trivial to obtain literal patterns written in natural language to serve LLMs. In this work, we propose LiP-NER, an LLM-based NER framework that utilizesLiteralPatterns, the entity-type-related knowledge that directly describes the orthographic and morphological features of entities. We also propose an LLM-based method to automatically acquire literal patterns, which requires only several sample entities rather than any annotation example, thus further reducing human labor. Our extensive experiments suggest that literal patterns can enhance the performance of LLMs in NER tasks. In further analysis, we found that entity types with relatively standardized naming conventions but limited world knowledge in LLMs, as well as entity types with broad and ambiguous names or definitions yet low internal variation among entities, benefit most from our approach. We found that the most effective written literal patterns are (1) detailed in classification, (2) focused on majority cases rather than minorities, and (3) explicit about obvious literal features.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 可以通过上下文学习利用外部知识来增强命名实体识别 (NER) 任务的性能。当涉及到实体类型相关的外部知识时，现有方法主要为LLM提供实体类型的定义和注释指南等语义信息，而没有探索拼写或形态信息对基于LLM的NER的影响。此外，获取用自然语言编写的文字模式来为大语言模型提供服务也并非易事。在这项工作中，我们提出了 LiP-NER，一个基于 LLM 的 NER 框架，它利用 LiteralPatterns，即直接描述实体的拼写和形态特征的实体类型相关知识。我们还提出了一种基于LLM的方法来自动获取文字模式，该方法只需要几个样本实体而不需要任何注释示例，从而进一步减少了人力。我们大量的实验表明，文字模式可以提高大语言模型在 NER 任务中的表现。在进一步的分析中，我们发现具有相对标准化的命名约定但大语言模型的世界知识有限的实体类型，以及具有广泛和模糊的名称或定义但实体之间内部差异较小的实体类型，从我们的方法中受益最多。我们发现最有效的书面文字模式是（1）详细分类，（2）关注大多数情况而不是少数，以及（3）明确明显的文字特征。

title: Advanced Messaging Platform (AMP): Pipeline for Automated Enterprise Email Processing
abstract_en: Understanding and effectively responding to email communication remains a critical yet complex challenge for current AI techniques, especially in corporate environments. These tasks are further complicated by the need for domain-specific knowledge, accurate entity recognition, and high precision to prevent costly errors. While recent advances in AI, specifically Large Language Models (LLMs), have made strides in natural language understanding, they often lack business-specific expertise required in such settings. In this work, we present Advanced Messaging Platform (AMP), a production-grade AI pipeline that automates email response generation at scale in real-world enterprise settings. AMP has been in production for more than a year, processing thousands of emails daily while maintaining high accuracy and adaptability to evolving business needs.
abstract_zh: 对于当前的人工智能技术来说，理解并有效地响应电子邮件通信仍然是一个关键而复杂的挑战，尤其是在企业环境中。由于需要特定领域的知识、准确的实体识别以及防止代价高昂的错误的高精度，这些任务变得更加复杂。尽管人工智能（特别是大型语言模型 (LLM)）的最新进展在自然语言理解方面取得了长足进步，但它们往往缺乏此类环境中所需的特定于业务的专业知识。在这项工作中，我们提出了高级消息传递平台 (AMP)，这是一种生产级 AI 管道，可在现实企业环境中大规模自动生成电子邮件响应。 AMP 已投入生产一年多，每天处理数千封电子邮件，同时保持高精度和对不断变化的业务需求的适应性。

title: SLENDER: Structured Outputs forSLM-basedNERin Low-Resource Englishes
abstract_en: Named Entity Recognition (NER) for low-resource variants of English remains challenging, as most NER models are trained on datasets predominantly focused on American or British English. While recent work has shown that proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs) can perform NER effectively in low-resource settings through in-context learning, practical deployment is limited by their high computational costs and privacy concerns. Open-source Small Language Models (SLMs) offer promising alternatives, but the tendency of these Language Models (LM) to hallucinate poses challenges for production use. To address this, we introduce SLENDER, a novel output format for LM-based NER that achieves a three-fold reduction in inference time on average compared to JSON format, which is widely used for structured outputs. Our approach using Gemma-2-9B-it with the SLENDER output format and constrained decoding in zero-shot settings outperforms the en_core_web_trf model from SpaCy, an industry-standard NER tool, in all five regions of the Worldwide test set.
abstract_zh: 针对低资源英语变体的命名实体识别 (NER) 仍然具有挑战性，因为大多数 NER 模型都是在主要针对美式英语或英式英语的数据集上进行训练的。虽然最近的研究表明，专有的大型语言模型 (LLM) 可以通过上下文学习在资源匮乏的情况下有效地执行 NER，但实际部署却因其高计算成本和隐私问题而受到限制。开源小语言模型 (SLM) 提供了有前途的替代方案，但这些语言模型 (LM) 的幻觉倾向给生产使用带来了挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 SLENDER，这是一种基于 LM 的 NER 的新颖输出格式，与广泛用于结构化输出的 JSON 格式相比，平均推理时间减少了三倍。我们使用具有 SLENDER 输出格式的 Gemma-2-9B-it 和零样本设置中的约束解码的方法在全球测试集的所有五个区域中均优于 SpaCy（行业标准 NER 工具）中的 en_core_web_trf 模型。

title: A Framework for Flexible Extraction of Clinical Event Contextual Properties from Electronic Health Records
abstract_en: Electronic Health Records contain vast amounts of valuable clinical data, much of which is stored as unstructured text. Extracting meaningful clinical events (e.g., disorders, symptoms, findings, medications, and procedures etc.) in context within real-world healthcare settings is crucial for enabling downstream applications such as disease prediction, clinical coding for billing and decision support.After Named Entity Recognition and Linking (NER+L) methodology, the identified concepts need to be further classified (i.e. contextualized) for distinct properties such as their relevance to the patient, their temporal and negated status for meaningful clinical use. We present a solution that, using an existing NER+L approach - MedCAT, classifies and contextualizes medical entities at scale. We evaluate the NLP approaches through 14 distinct real-world clinical text classification projects, testing our suite of models tailored to different clinical NLP needs. For tasks requiring high minority class recall, BERT proves the most effective when coupled with class imbalance mitigation techniques, outperforming Bi-LSTM with up to 28%. For majority class focused tasks, Bi-LSTM offers a lightweight alternative with, on average, 32% faster training time and lower computational cost. Importantly, these tools are integrated into an openly available library, enabling users to select the best model for their specific downstream applications.
abstract_zh: 电子健康记录包含大量有价值的临床数据，其中大部分以非结构化文本形式存储。在现实世界的医疗保健环境中提取有意义的临床事件（例如，疾病、症状、发现、药物和程序等）对于实现疾病预测、计费临床编码和决策支持等下游应用至关重要。在命名实体识别和链接（NER+L）方法之后，需要对识别的概念进行进一步分类（即上下文化）以获取不同的属性，例如它们与患者的相关性、它们的时间和否定状态，以便有意义的临床使用。我们提出了一种解决方案，使用现有的 NER+L 方法 - MedCAT，对医疗实体进行大规模分类和情境化。我们通过 14 个不同的现实世界临床文本分类项目来评估 NLP 方法，测试我们针对不同临床 NLP 需求定制的模型套件。对于需要高少数类召回率的任务，事实证明，与类不平衡缓解技术相结合时，BERT 是最有效的，其性能优于 Bi-LSTM 高达 28%。对于以大多数类别为中心的任务，Bi-LSTM 提供了一种轻量级替代方案，平均训练时间缩短了 32%，计算成本更低。重要的是，这些工具被集成到一个开放的库中，使用户能够为其特定的下游应用程序选择最佳模型。

title: GUM-SAGE: A Novel Dataset and Approach for Graded Entity Salience Prediction
abstract_en: Determining and ranking the most salient entities in a text is critical for user-facing systems, especially as users increasingly rely on models to interpret long documents they only partially read. Graded entity salience addresses this need by assigning entities scores that reflect their relative importance in a text. Existing approaches fall into two main categories: subjective judgments of salience, which allow for gradient scoring but lack consistency, and summarization-based methods, which define salience as mention-worthiness in a summary, promoting explainability but limiting outputs to binary labels (entities are either summary-worthy or not). In this paper, we introduce a novel approach for graded entity salience that combines the strengths of both approaches. Using an English dataset spanning 12 spoken and written genres, we collect 5 summaries per document and calculate each entity’s salience score based on its presence across these summaries. Our approach shows stronger correlation with scores based on human summaries and alignments, and outperforms existing techniques, including LLMs. We release our data and code at https://github.com/jl908069/gum_sum_salience to support further research on graded salient entity extraction.
abstract_zh: 确定和排名文本中最显着的实体对于面向用户的系统至关重要，特别是当用户越来越依赖模型来解释他们只阅读了部分内容的长文档时。分级实体显着性通过分配反映实体在文本中相对重要性的分数来满足这一需求。现有方法分为两大类：显着性的主观判断，允许梯度评分，但缺乏一致性；基于摘要的方法，将显着性定义为摘要中的提及价值，促进可解释性，但将输出限制为二进制标签（实体要么值得摘要，要么不值得摘要）。在本文中，我们介绍了一种结合了两种方法优点的分级实体显着性的新方法。使用涵盖 12 种口语和书面语流派的英语数据集，我们为每个文档收集 5 个摘要，并根据每个实体在这些摘要中的存在情况计算其显着性得分。我们的方法与基于人工总结和比对的分数显示出更强的相关性，并且优于包括大语言模型在内的现有技术。我们在 https://github.com/jl908069/gum_sum_salience 发布了我们的数据和代码，以支持分级显着实体提取的进一步研究。

title: Dynamic Prefix as Instructor for Incremental Named Entity Recognition: A UnifiedSeq2Seq Generation Framework
abstract_en: The Incremental Named Entity Recognition (INER) task aims to update a model to extract entities from an expanding set of entity type candidates due to concerns related to data privacy and scarcity. However, conventional sequence labeling approaches to INER often suffer from the catastrophic forgetting problem, which leads to the degradation of the model’s performance on previously encountered entity types. In this paper, we formalize INER as a unified seq2seq generation task and propose a parameter-efficient dynamic prefix method. By employing the dynamic prefix as a task instructor to guide the generative model, our approach can preserve task-invariant knowledge while adapting to new entities with minimal parameter updates, making it particularly effective in low-resource scenarios. Additionally, we introduce a generative label augmentation strategy with dual optimization objectives including a self-entropy loss and a task-aware similarity loss to enable optimal balance between stability and plasticity. Empirical experiments on NER benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method in addressing the challenges associated with INER.
abstract_zh: 出于与数据隐私和稀缺性相关的担忧，增量命名实体识别 (INER) 任务旨在更新模型，以从不断扩大的实体类型候选集中提取实体。然而，传统的 INER 序列标记方法经常会遇到灾难性的遗忘问题，这会导致模型在以前遇到的实体类型上的性能下降。在本文中，我们将 INER 形式化为统一的 seq2seq 生成任务，并提出了一种参数高效的动态前缀方法。通过使用动态前缀作为任务指导者来指导生成模型，我们的方法可以保留任务不变的知识，同时以最少的参数更新适应新实体，使其在资源匮乏的情况下特别有效。此外，我们引入了一种具有双重优化目标的生成标签增强策略，包括自熵损失和任务感知相似性损失，以实现稳定性和可塑性之间的最佳平衡。 NER 基准的实证实验证明了我们提出的方法在解决与 INER 相关的挑战方面的有效性。

title: Konooz: Multi-domain Multi-dialect Corpus for Named Entity Recognition
abstract_en: We introduce , a novel multi-dimensional corpus covering 16 Arabic dialects across 10 domains, resulting in 160 distinct corpora. The corpus comprises about 777k tokens, carefully collected and manually annotated with 21 entity types using both nested and flat annotation schemes - using the Wojood guidelines. While is useful for various NLP tasks like domain adaptation and transfer learning, this paper primarily focuses on benchmarking existing Arabic Named Entity Recognition (NER) models, especially cross-domain and cross-dialect model performance. Our benchmarking of four Arabic NER models using reveals a significant drop in performance of up to 38% when compared to the in-distribution data. Furthermore, we present an in-depth analysis of domain and dialect divergence and the impact of resource scarcity. We also measured the overlap between domains and dialects using the Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) metric, and illustrated why certain NER models perform better on specific dialects and domains. is open-source and publicly available athttps://sina.birzeit.edu/wojood/#download
abstract_zh: 我们引入了一种新颖的多维语料库，涵盖 10 个领域的 16 种阿拉伯方言，从而产生了 160 个不同的语料库。该语料库包含大约 777k 个标记，这些标记是精心收集的，并使用嵌套和平面注释方案（使用 Wojood 指南）手动注释了 21 种实体类型。虽然本文对于域适应和迁移学习等各种 NLP 任务很有用，但它主要侧重于对现有的阿拉伯语命名实体识别 (NER) 模型进行基准测试，特别是跨域和跨方言模型的性能。我们对四个阿拉伯语 NER 模型进行的基准测试显示，与分布内数据相比，性能显着下降高达 38%。此外，我们还深入分析了领域和方言的差异以及资源稀缺的影响。我们还使用最大平均差异 (MMD) 指标测量了域和方言之间的重叠，并说明了为什么某些 NER 模型在特定方言和域上表现更好。是开源的，可在 https://sina.birzeit.edu/wojood/#download 上公开获取

title: Random Splitting Negatively ImpactsNEREvaluation: Quantifying and Eliminating the Overestimation ofNERPerformance
abstract_en: In named entity recognition (NER), models are evaluated on their ability to identify entity mentions in text. However, standard evaluation methods often rely on test sets that contain named entities already present in the training data, raising concerns about overestimation of model performance.This work investigates the impact of varying degrees of entity contamination on a dataset level on the generalization ability and reported F1 scores of three state-of-the-art NER models.Experiments on five standard benchmarks show that F1 scores for contaminated entities statistically significantly inflate reported F1 scores as contamination rates increase, with F1 performance gaps ranging from 2-10% compared to entities not seen during training.To address these inflated F1 scores, we additionally propose a novel NER dataset splitting method using a minimum cut algorithm to minimize train-test entity leakage.While our splitting method ensures near-zero entity contamination, we also compare new and existing dataset splits on named entity sample counts.
abstract_zh: 在命名实体识别 (NER) 中，根据模型识别文本中实体提及的能力来评估模型。然而，标准评估方法通常依赖于包含训练数据中已存在的命名实体的测试集，引发了对模型性能高估的担忧。这项工作研究了数据集级别上不同程度的实体污染对泛化能力的影响，并报告了三个最先进的 NER 模型的 F1 分数。对五个标准基准的实验表明，随着污染率的增加，受污染实体的 F1 分数在统计上显着夸大了报告的 F1 分数，与为了解决这些夸大的 F1 分数问题，我们还提出了一种新颖的 NER 数据集分割方法，使用最小切割算法来最小化训练测试实体泄漏。虽然我们的分割方法确保接近零的实体污染，但我们还比较了命名实体样本计数上的新数据集分割和现有数据集分割。

title: CROSSAGENTIE: Cross-Type and Cross-Task Multi-AgentLLMCollaboration for Zero-Shot Information Extraction
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) excel in generating unstructured text. However, they struggle with producing structured output while maintaining accuracy in zero-shot information extraction (IE), such as named entity recognition (NER) and relation extraction (RE). To address these challenges, we propose CROSSAGENTIE, a multi-agent framework that enhances zero-shot IE through multi-agent LLM collaboration. CROSSAGENTIE refines LLM predictions iteratively through two mechanisms: intra-group cross-type debate, which resolves entity-label conflicts through context-based evidence and confidence aggregation, and inter-group cross-task debate, where NER and RE mutually refine outputs via bidirectional feedback. Furthermore, we introduce template fine-tuning, distilling high-confidence multi-agent outputs into a single model, significantly reducing inference cost while preserving accuracy. Experiments across five NER and five RE datasets show that CROSSAGENTIE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art zero-shot baselines by a large margin. CROSSAGENTIE effectively addresses LLMs limitations in structured prediction with an effective and efficient approach for zero-shot information extraction.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 擅长生成非结构化文本。然而，他们在生成结构化输出的同时保持零样本信息提取（IE）（例如命名实体识别（NER）和关系提取（RE））的准确性方面遇到了困难。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 CROSSAGENTIE，这是一个多智能体框架，通过多智能体 LLM 协作增强零样本 IE。 CROSSAGENTIE 通过两种机制迭代地完善 LLM 预测：组内跨类型辩论，通过基于上下文的证据和置信度聚合来解决实体标签冲突；以及组间跨任务辩论，其中 NER 和 RE 通过双向反馈相互完善输出。此外，我们引入了模板微调，将高置信度的多智能体输出提炼成单个模型，在保持准确性的同时显着降低推理成本。五个 NER 和五个 RE 数据集的实验表明，CROSSAGENTIE 的性能大幅优于最先进的零样本基线。 CROSSAGENTIE 通过一种有效且高效的零样本信息提取方法，有效解决了大语言模型在结构化预测中的局限性。

title: The Effectiveness of Uncased Tokeniziaion for Clinical Notes
abstract_en: The impact of case-sensitive tokenization on clinical notes is not well understood. While clinical notes share similarities with biomedical text in terminology, they often lack the proper casing found in polished publications. Language models, unlike humans, require a fixed vocabulary and case sensitivity is a trade-off that must be considered carefully. Improper casing can lead to sub-optimal tokenization and increased sequence length, degrading downstream performance and increasing computational costs. While most recent open-domain encoder language models use uncased tokenization for all tasks, there is no clear trend in biomedical and clinical models. In this work we (1) show that uncased models exceed the performance of cased models on clinical notes, even on traditionally case-sensitive tasks such as named entity recognition and (2) introduce independent case encoding to better balance model performance on case-sensitive and improperly-cased tasks.
abstract_zh: 区分大小写的标记化对临床记录的影响尚不清楚。虽然临床笔记在术语上与生物医学文本有相似之处，但它们通常缺乏精美出版物中的正确外壳。与人类不同，语言模型需要固定的词汇量，并且区分大小写是必须仔细考虑的权衡。不正确的大小写可能导致次优标记化和序列长度增加，从而降低下游性能并增加计算成本。虽然最近的开放域编码器语言模型对所有任务都使用无外壳标记化，但生物医学和临床模型没有明显的趋势。在这项工作中，我们（1）表明，即使在传统的区分大小写的任务（例如命名实体识别）上，无大小写模型也超过了有大小写模型在临床记录上的性能，并且（2）引入了独立的大小写编码，以更好地平衡大小写敏感和不正确大小写任务上的模型性能。

title: DeRAGEC: Denoising Named Entity Candidates with Synthetic Rationale forASRError Correction
abstract_en: We present DeRAGEC, a method for improving Named Entity (NE) correction in Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems. By extending the Retrieval-Augmented Generative Error Correction (RAGEC) framework, DeRAGEC employs synthetic denoising rationales to filter out noisy NE candidates before correction. By leveraging phonetic similarity and augmented definitions, it refines noisy retrieved NEs using in-context learning, requiring no additional training. Experimental results on CommonVoice and STOP datasets show significant improvements in Word Error Rate (WER) and NE hit ratio, outperforming baseline ASR and RAGEC methods. Specifically, we achieved a 28% relative reduction in WER compared to ASR without postprocessing.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了 DeRAGEC，一种用于改进自动语音识别 (ASR) 系统中的命名实体 (NE) 校正的方法。通过扩展检索增强生成错误校正 (RAGEC) 框架，DeRAGEC 采用合成去噪原理在校正之前过滤掉嘈杂的 NE 候选者。通过利用语音相似性和增强定义，它可以使用上下文学习来细化嘈杂的检索到的 NE，而无需额外的训练。 CommonVoice 和 STOP 数据集上的实验结果表明，字错误率 (WER) 和 NE 命中率显着提高，优于基线 ASR 和 RAGEC 方法。具体来说，与没有进行后处理的 ASR 相比，我们的 WER 相对降低了 28%。

title: ZeroNER: Fueling Zero-Shot Named Entity Recognition via Entity Type Descriptions
abstract_en: What happens when a named entity recognition (NER) system encounters entities it has never seen before? In practical applications, models must generalize to unseen entity types where labeled training data is either unavailable or severely limited—a challenge that demands zero-shot learning capabilities. While large language models (LLMs) offer extensive parametric knowledge, they fall short in cost-effectiveness compared to specialized small encoders. Existing zero-shot methods predominantly adopt a relaxed definition of the term with potential leakage issues and rely on entity type names for generalization, overlooking the value of richer descriptions for disambiguation. In this work, we introduce ZeroNER, a description-driven framework that enhances hard zero-shot NER in low-resource settings. By leveraging general-domain annotations and entity type descriptions with LLM supervision, ZeroNER enables a BERT-based student model to successfully identify unseen entity types. Evaluated on three real-world benchmarks, ZeroNER consistently outperforms LLMs by up to 16% in F1 score, and surpasses lightweight baselines that use type names alone. Our analysis further reveals that LLMs derive significant benefits from incorporating type descriptions in the prompts.
abstract_zh: 当命名实体识别 (NER) 系统遇到以前从未见过的实体时会发生什么？在实际应用中，模型必须泛化到看不见的实体类型，其中标记的训练数据要么不可用，要么严重受限——这是需要零样本学习能力的挑战。虽然大型语言模型 (LLM) 提供广泛的参数知识，但与专门的小型编码器相比，它们在成本效益方面存在不足。现有的零样本方法主要采用对术语的宽松定义，存在潜在的泄漏问题，并依赖实体类型名称进行泛化，忽视了更丰富的描述对消歧的价值。在这项工作中，我们引入了 ZeroNER，这是一种描述驱动的框架，可以在资源匮乏的情况下增强硬零样本 NER。通过在 LLM 监督下利用通用领域注释和实体类型描述，ZeroNER 使基于 BERT 的学生模型能够成功识别看不见的实体类型。根据三个现实世界基准进行评估，ZeroNER 在 F1 分数上始终比大语言模型高出 16%，并且超过了仅使用类型名称的轻量级基线。我们的分析进一步表明，大语言模型可以通过在提示中纳入类型描述来获得显着的好处。

title: PM3-KIE: A Probabilistic Multi-Task Meta-Model for Document Key Information Extraction
abstract_en: Key Information Extraction (KIE) from visually rich documents is commonly approached as either fine-grained token classification or coarse-grained entity extraction. While token-level models capture spatial and visual cues, entity-level models better represent logical dependencies and align with real-world use cases.We introduce PM3-KIE, a probabilistic multi-task meta-model that incorporates both fine-grained and coarse-grained models. It serves as a lightweight reasoning layer that jointly predicts entities and all appearances in a document. PM3-KIE incorporates domain-specific schema constraints to enforce logical consistency and integrates large language models for semantic validation, thereby reducing extraction errors.Experiments on two public datasets, DeepForm and FARA, show that PM3-KIE outperforms three state-of-the-art models and a stacked ensemble, achieving a statistically significant 2% improvement in F1 score.
abstract_zh: 从视觉丰富的文档中提取关键信息 (KIE) 通常被视为细粒度标记分类或粗粒度实体提取。虽然令牌级模型捕获空间和视觉线索，但实体级模型可以更好地表示逻辑依赖性并与现实世界的用例保持一致。我们引入 PM3-KIE，这是一种概率多任务元模型，它结合了细粒度和粗粒度模型。它充当轻量级推理层，共同预测文档中的实体和所有外观。 PM3-KIE 结合了特定于领域的模式约束来强制逻辑一致性，并集成大型语言模型进行语义验证，从而减少提取错误。在 DeepForm 和 FARA 两个公共数据集上进行的实验表明，PM3-KIE 的性能优于三个最先进的模型和堆叠集成，在 F1 分数上实现了统计上显着的 2% 提高。

title: Synergistic Augmentation: Enhancing Cross-Domain Zero-Shot Slot Filling with Small Model-Assisted Large Language Models
abstract_en: In real-world scenarios, cross-domain slot filling in spoken language understanding remains a significant challenge due to data scarcity. Previous works exhibit limited generalization ability in the target domain, demonstrating effective knowledge transfer only on seen slots while performing poorly on unseen slots. Although large language models (LLMs) can alleviate this issue to some extent, they underperform on seen slots compared to small models. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel framework that harnesses the power of a small model to augment the inferential capabilities of LLMs without additional training. Initially, we utilize target domain samples synthesized by LLMs as pre-calculated demonstrations, which are curated and chosen using confidence metrics derived from a small model. We further extract slot predictions from the small model to fully exploit its robust learning of familiar slots. Finally, during the inference process for test inputs, we integrate these demonstrations and slot prediction insights as references to enhance the slot filling performance of LLMs. Experiments on a slot filling dataset and a NER dataset including eight cross-domain settings show our framework achieves the best results. Our codes are publicly available at https://github.com/SIGSDSscau/SLSF.
abstract_zh: 在现实场景中，由于数据稀缺，口语理解中的跨域槽填充仍然是一个重大挑战。以前的工作在目标领域表现出有限的泛化能力，仅在见过的槽位上展示了有效的知识转移，而在未见的槽位上表现不佳。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）可以在一定程度上缓解这个问题，但与小型模型相比，它们在已见插槽上的表现较差。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了一种新颖的框架，该框架利用小型模型的力量来增强大语言模型的推理能力，而无需额外的培训。最初，我们利用大语言模型合成的目标领域样本作为预先计算的演示，这些演示是使用从小模型导出的置信度指标来策划和选择的。我们进一步从小模型中提取槽位预测，以充分利用其对熟悉槽位的稳健学习。最后，在测试输入的推理过程中，我们整合这些演示和槽位预测见解作为参考，以增强大语言模型的槽位填充性能。在槽填充数据集和包含八个跨域设置的 NER 数据集上进行的实验表明，我们的框架取得了最佳结果。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/SIGSDSscau/SLSF 上公开获取。

title: GUIDEX: Guided Synthetic Data Generation for Zero-Shot Information Extraction
abstract_en: Information Extraction (IE) systems are traditionally domain-specific, requiring costlyadaptation that involves expert schema design,data annotation, and model training. WhileLarge Language Models have shown promisein zero-shot IE, performance degrades significantly in unseen domains where label definitions differ. This paper introduces GUIDEX,a novel method that automatically definesdomain-specific schemas, infers guidelines,and generates synthetically labeled instances,allowing for better out-of-domain generalization. Fine-tuning Llama 3.1 with GUIDEXsets a new state-of-the-art across seven zeroshot Named Entity Recognition benchmarks.Models trained with GUIDEX gain up to 7 F1points over previous methods without humanlabeled data, and nearly 2 F1 points higherwhen combined with it. Models trained onGUIDEX demonstrate enhanced comprehension of complex, domain-specific annotationschemas. Code, models, and synthetic datasetsare available at neilus03.github.io/guidex.com
abstract_zh: 信息提取（IE）系统传统上是特定领域的，需要昂贵的适应，其中涉及专家模式设计、数据注释和模型训练。虽然大型语言模型在零样本 IE 中表现出了希望，但在标签定义不同的看不见的领域中，性能会显着下降。本文介绍了 GUIDEX，这是一种自动定义特定领域模式、推断指南并生成综合标记实例的新颖方法，从而实现更好的域外泛化。使用 GUIDEX 对 Llama 3.1 进行微调，在七个零样本命名实体识别基准中树立了新的最先进水平。使用 GUIDEX 训练的模型比之前没有人工标记数据的方法获得了高达 7 个 F1 点，与它结合使用时，提高了近 2 个 F1 点。在 GUIDEX 上训练的模型展示了对复杂的、特定于领域的注释模式的增强的理解。代码、模型和综合数据集可在 neilus03.github.io/guidex.com 获取

title: Fine-tuning Whisper Tiny forSwahiliASR: Challenges and Recommendations for Low-Resource Speech Recognition
abstract_en: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) technologies have seen significant advancements, yet many widely spoken languages remain underrepresented. This paper explores the fine-tuning of OpenAI’s Whisper Tiny model (39M parameters) for Swahili, a lingua franca for over 100 million people across East Africa. Using a dataset of 5,520 Swahili audio samples, we analyze the model’s performance, error patterns, and limitations after fine-tuning. Our results demonstrate the potential of fine-tuning for improving transcription accuracy, while also highlighting persistent challenges such as phonetic misinterpretations, named entity recognition failures, and difficulties with morphologically complex words. We provide recommendations for improving Swahili ASR, including scaling to larger model variants, architectural adaptations for agglutinative languages, and data enhancement strategies. This work contributes to the growing body of research on adapting pre-trained multilingual ASR systems to low-resource languages, emphasizing the need for approaches that account for the unique linguistic features of Bantu languages.
abstract_zh: 自动语音识别 (ASR) 技术取得了显着进步，但许多广泛使用的语言仍然代表性不足。本文探讨了 OpenAI 的 Whisper Tiny 模型（39M 参数）针对斯瓦希里语的微调，斯瓦希里语是东非超过 1 亿人口的通用语言。使用包含 5,520 个斯瓦希里语音频样本的数据集，我们分析了模型微调后的性能、错误模式和局限性。我们的结果证明了微调在提高转录准确性方面的潜力，同时也强调了持续存在的挑战，例如语音误解、命名实体识别失败以及形态复杂的单词的困难。我们提供改进斯瓦希里语 ASR 的建议，包括扩展到更大的模型变体、粘着语言的架构适应以及数据增强策略。这项工作有助于越来越多的关于将预训练的多语言 ASR 系统适应低资源语言的研究，强调需要考虑班图语言独特语言特征的方法。

title: AdaBioBERT: Adaptive Token Sequence Learning for Biomedical Named Entity Recognition
abstract_en: Accurate identification and labeling of biomedical entities, such as diseases, genes, chemical and species, within scientific texts are crucial for understanding complex relationships. We propose Adaptive BERT or AdaBioBERT, a robust named entity recognition (NER) model that builds upon BioBERT (Biomedical Bidirectional Encoded Representation from Transformers) based on an adaptive loss function to learn different types of biomedical token sequence. This adaptive loss function combines the standard Cross Entropy (CE) loss and Conditional Random Field (CRF) loss to optimize both token level accuracy and sequence-level coherence. AdaBioBERT captures rich semantic nuances by leveraging pre-trained contextual embeddings from BioBERT. On the other hand, the CRF loss of AdaBioBERT ensures proper identification of complex multi-token biomedical entities in a sequence and the CE loss can capture the simple unigram entities in a sequence. The empirical analysis on multiple standard biomedical coprora demonstrates that AdaBioBERT performs better than the state of the arts for most of the datasets in terms of macro and micro averaged F1 score.’
abstract_zh: 科学文本中生物医学实体（例如疾病、基因、化学物质和物种）的准确识别和标记对于理解复杂关系至关重要。我们提出了 Adaptive BERT 或 AdaBioBERT，这是一种强大的命名实体识别 (NER) 模型，它建立在 BioBERT（来自 Transformers 的生物医学双向编码表示）的基础上，基于自适应损失函数来学习不同类型的生物医学标记序列。这种自适应损失函数结合了标准交叉熵 (CE) 损失和条件随机场 (CRF) 损失，以优化令牌级别的准确性和序列级别的一致性。 AdaBioBERT 通过利用 BioBERT 预先训练的上下文嵌入来捕获丰富的语义细微差别。另一方面，AdaBioBERT 的 CRF 损失确保了序列中复杂的多标记生物医学实体的正确识别，而 CE 损失可以捕获序列中的简单一元实体。对多个标准生物医学粪便的实证分析表明，在宏观和微观平均 F1 分数方面，AdaBioBERT 在大多数数据集上的表现都优于现有技术。

title: Benchmarking zero-shot biomedical relation triplet extraction across language model architectures
abstract_en: Many language models (LMs) in the literature claim excellent zero-shot and/or few-shot capabilities for named entity recognition (NER) and relation extraction (RE) tasks and assert their ability to generalize beyond their training datasets. However, these claims have yet to be tested across different model architectures. This paper presents a performance evaluation of zero-shot relation triplet extraction (NER followed by RE of the entities) for both small and large LMs, utilizing 13,867 texts from 61 biomedical corpora and encompassing 151 unique entity types. This comprehensive evaluation offers valuable insights into the practical applicability and performance of LMs within the intricate domain of biomedical relation triplet extraction, highlighting their effectiveness in managing a diverse range of relations and entity types. Gemini 1.5 Pro, the largest LM included in the study, was the top-performing zero-shot model, achieving an average partial match micro F1 of 0.492 for NER, followed closely by SciLitLLM 1.5 14B with a score of 0.475. Fine-tuned models generally outperformed others on the corpora they were trained on, even in a few-shot setting, but struggled to generalize across all datasets with similar entity types. No models achieved an F1 score above 0.5 for the RTE task on any dataset, and their scores fluctuated based on the specific class of entity and the dataset involved. This observation highlights that there is still large room for improvement on the zero-shot utility of LMs in biomedical RTE applications.
abstract_zh: 文献中的许多语言模型 (LM) 声称对于命名实体识别 (NER) 和关系提取 (RE) 任务具有出色的零样本和/或少样本能力，并断言它们具有超出训练数据集的泛化能力。然而，这些说法还需要在不同的模型架构上进行测试。本文利用来自 61 个生物医学语料库的 13,867 篇文本，涵盖 151 种独特的实体类型，对小型和大型 LM 的零样本关系三元组提取（实体的 NER 和 RE）进行性能评估。这项综合评估为 LM 在生物医学关系三元组提取的复杂领域中的实际适用性和性能提供了宝贵的见解，突出了它们在管理各种关系和实体类型方面的有效性。 Gemini 1.5 Pro 是研究中包含的最大的 LM，是性能最好的零样本模型，NER 的平均部分匹配微 F1 为 0.492，紧随其后的是 SciLitLLM 1.5 14B，得分为 0.475。经过微调的模型在其训练的语料库上通常表现优于其他模型，即使在几次镜头设置中也是如此，但很难在具有相似实体类型的所有数据集上进行泛化。对于任何数据集上的 RTE 任务，没有模型的 F1 分数高于 0.5，并且它们的分数根据实体的特定类别和所涉及的数据集而波动。这一观察结果强调，LM 在生物医学 RTE 应用中的零样本效用仍有很大的改进空间。

title: Improving Barrett’s Oesophagus Surveillance Scheduling with Large Language Models: A Structured Extraction Approach
abstract_en: Gastroenterology (GI) cancer surveillance scheduling relies on extracting structured data from unstructured clinical texts, such as endoscopy and pathology reports. Traditional Natural Language Processing (NLP) models have been employed for this task, but recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) present a new opportunity for automation without requiring extensive labeled datasets. In this study, we propose an LLM-based entity extraction and rule-based decision support framework for Barrett’s Oesophagus (BO) surveillance timing prediction. Our approach processes endoscopy and pathology reports to extract clinically relevant information and structures it into a standardised format, which is then used to determine appropriate surveillance intervals. We evaluate multiple state-of-the-art LLMs on real-world clinical datasets from two hospitals, assessing their performance in accuracy and running time cost. The results demonstrate that LLMs, particularly Phi-4 and (DeepSeek distilled) Qwen-2.5, can effectively automate the extraction of BO surveillance-related information with high accuracy, while Phi-4 is also efficient during inference. We also compared the trade-offs between LLMs and fine-tuned non-LLMs. Our findings indicate that LLM extraction based methods can support clinical decision-making by providing justifications from report extractions, reducing manual workload, and improving guideline adherence in BO surveillance scheduling.
abstract_zh: 胃肠病学 (GI) 癌症监测计划依赖于从非结构化临床文本（例如内窥镜检查和病理报告）中提取结构化数据。这项任务已采用传统的自然语言处理 (NLP) 模型，但大型语言模型 (LLM) 的最新进展为自动化提供了新的机会，而无需大量标记数据集。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于大语言模型的实体提取和基于规则的决策支持框架，用于巴雷特食管（BO）监测时间预测。我们的方法处理内窥镜检查和病理报告，以提取临床相关信息并将其构建为标准化格式，然后用于确定适当的监测间隔。我们在两家医院的真实临床数据集上评估了多个最先进的大语言模型，评估他们在准确性和运行时间成本方面的表现。结果表明，LLM，特别是 Phi-4 和（DeepSeek distilled）Qwen-2.5，可以有效地以高精度自动提取 BO 监视相关信息，而 Phi-4 在推理过程中也很高效。我们还比较了大语言模型和经过微调的非大语言模型之间的权衡。我们的研究结果表明，基于 LLM 提取的方法可以通过提供报告提取的理由、减少人工工作量并提高 BO 监测计划中指南的遵守程度来支持临床决策。

title: Effective Multi-Task Learning for Biomedical Named Entity Recognition
abstract_en: Biomedical Named Entity Recognition presents significant challenges due to the complexity of biomedical terminology and inconsistencies in annotation across datasets. This paper introduces SRU-NER (Slot-based Recurrent Unit NER), a novel approach designed to handle nested named entities while integrating multiple datasets through an effective multi-task learning strategy. SRU-NER mitigates annotation gaps by dynamically adjusting loss computation to avoid penalizing predictions of entity types absent in a given dataset. Through extensive experiments, including a cross-corpus evaluation and human assessment of the model’s predictions, SRU-NER achieves competitive performance in biomedical and general-domain NER tasks, while improving cross-domain generalization.
