Our method demonstrates superior results in emotion detection and intensity prediction across multiple subtasks, highlighting its effectiveness, especially in language adaptability.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们为 SemEval-2025 任务 11：基于文本的情绪检测 (TBED) 任务开发的系统，该系统旨在识别大多数人从说话者的短文本中感知到的情绪。我们引入了用于情绪识别的多代理框架，包括两个关键代理：识别文本中的情绪的情绪感知刻画器和评估这些情绪强度的强度感知刻画器。我们利用 BERT 系列和大规模生成语言模型 (LLM)，使用生成方法和判别方法对任务进行建模。采用多系统协作机制，进一步提高准确性、稳定性和鲁棒性。此外，我们还结合跨语言知识转移来提高不同语言场景中的表现。我们的方法在多个子任务中的情绪检测和强度预测方面表现出优异的结果，突出了其有效性，特别是在语言适应性方面。

title: Lotus atSemEval-2025 Task 11:RoBERTa with Llama-3 Generated Explanations for Multi-Label Emotion Classification
abstract_en: This paper presents a novel approach for multi-label emotion detection, where Llama-3 is used to generate explanatory content that clarifies ambiguous emotional expressions, thereby enhancing RoBERTa’s emotion classification performance. By incorporating explanatory context, our method improves F1-scores, particularly for emotions like fear, joy, and sadness, and outperforms text-only models. The addition of explanatory content helps resolve ambiguity, addresses challenges like overlapping emotional cues, and enhances multi-label classification, marking a significant advancement in emotion detection tasks.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种多标签情绪检测的新方法，其中 Llama-3 用于生成解释性内容，澄清模糊的情绪表达，从而增强 RoBERTa 的情绪分类性能。通过结合解释性上下文，我们的方法提高了 F1 分数，特别是对于恐惧、快乐和悲伤等情绪，并且优于纯文本模型。添加解释性内容有助于解决歧义，解决情感线索重叠等挑战，并增强多标签分类，标志着情感检测任务的重大进步。

title: TeamUnibuc -NLPatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Few-shot text-based emotion detection
abstract_en: This paper describes the approach of the Unibuc - NLP team in tackling the SemEval 2025 Workshop, Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection. We mainly focused on experiments using large language models (Gemini, Qwen, DeepSeek) with either few-shot prompting or fine-tuning. Withour final system, for the multi-label emotion detection track (track A), we got an F1-macro of 0.7546 (26/96 teams) for the English subset, 0.1727 (35/36 teams) for the Portuguese (Mozambican) subset and 0.325 (1/31 teams) for the Emakhuwa subset.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 Unibuc - NLP 团队解决 SemEval 2025 研讨会任务 11：弥合基于文本的情绪检测的差距的方法。我们主要专注于使用大型语言模型（Gemini、Qwen、DeepSeek）进行实验，并进行少量提示或微调。在我们的最终系统中，对于多标签情绪检测轨道（轨道 A），我们得到的英语子集的 F1 宏为 0.7546（26/96 队），葡萄牙语（莫桑比克）子集为 0.1727（35/36 队），Emakhuwa 子集为 0.325（1/31 队）。

title: Angeliki Linardatou atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Multi-label Emotion Detection
abstract_en: This study, competing in SemEval 2025 Task 11 - Track A, detects anger, surprise, joy, fear, and sadness. We propose a hybrid approach combining fine-tuned BERT transformers, TF-IDF for lexical analysis, and a Voting Classifier (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, SVM, KNN, XG-Boost, LightGBM, CatBoost), with grid search optimizing thresholds. Our model achieves a macro F1-score of0.6864. Challenges include irony, ambiguity, and label imbalance. Future work will explore larger transformers, data augmentation, and cross-lingual adaptation. This research underscores the benefits of hybrid models, showing that combining deep learning with traditional NLP improves multi-label emotion detection.
abstract_zh: 这项研究参加了 SemEval 2025 任务 11 - Track A，检测愤怒、惊讶、喜悦、恐惧和悲伤。我们提出了一种混合方法，将微调的 BERT 转换器、用于词法分析的 TF-IDF 和投票分类器（逻辑回归、随机森林、SVM、KNN、XG-Boost、LightGBM、CatBoost）与网格搜索优化阈值相结合。我们的模型的宏观 F1 分数为 0.6864。挑战包括讽刺、歧义和标签不平衡。未来的工作将探索更大的变压器、数据增强和跨语言适应。这项研究强调了混合模型的好处，表明深度学习与传统 NLP 的结合可以改善多标签情绪检测。

title: YNWA_PZatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Multilingual Multi-Label Emotion Classification
abstract_en: This paper explores multilingual emotion classification across binary classification, intensity estimation, and cross-lingual detection tasks. To address linguistic variability and limited annotated data, we evaluate various deep learning approaches, including transformer-based embeddings and traditional classifiers. After extensive experimentation, language-specific embedding models were selected as the final approach, given their superior ability to capture linguistic and cultural nuances. Experiments on high- and low-resource languages demonstrate that this method significantly improves performance, achieving competitive macro-average F1 scores. Notably, in languages such as Tigrinya and Kinyarwanda for cross-lingual detection task, our approach achieved a second-place ranking, driven by the incorporation of advanced preprocessing techniques. Despite these advances, challenges remain due to limited annotated data in underrepresented languages and the complexity of nuanced emotional expressions. The study highlights the need for robust, language-aware emotion recognition systems and emphasizes future directions, including expanding multilingual datasets and refining models.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了二元分类、强度估计和跨语言检测任务中的多语言情感分类。为了解决语言变异性和有限的注释数据，我们评估了各种深度学习方法，包括基于变压器的嵌入和传统分类器。经过广泛的实验，选择特定于语言的嵌入模型作为最终方法，因为它们具有捕捉语言和文化细微差别的卓越能力。对高资源和低资源语言的实验表明，该方法显着提高了性能，实现了具有竞争力的宏观平均 F1 分数。值得注意的是，在提格里尼亚语和基尼亚卢旺达语等语言的跨语言检测任务中，由于采用了先进的预处理技术，我们的方法取得了第二名的排名。尽管取得了这些进展，但由于代表性不足的语言的注释数据有限以及微妙的情感表达的复杂性，挑战仍然存在。该研究强调了对强大的、语言感知的情感识别系统的需求，并强调了未来的方向，包括扩展多语言数据集和完善模型。

title: IEGPS-CSICatSemEval-2025 Task 11:BERT-based approach for Multi-label Emotion Detection inEnglish andRussian texts
abstract_en: This paper presents an original approach for SemEval 2025 Task 11. Our study investigates various strategies to improve Text-Based Multi-label Emotion Detection task. Through experimental endeavors, we explore the benefits of contextualized vector representations by comparing multiple BERT models, including those specifically trained for emotion recognition. Additionally, we examine the impact of hyperparameters adjustments on model performance. For Subtask A, our approach achieved F1 scores of 0.71 on the English dataset and 0.84 on the Russian dataset. Our findings underscore that (1) monolingual BERT models demonstrate superior performance for English, whereas multilingual BERT models perform better for Russian; (2) pretrained emotion detection models proving less effective for this specific task compared to models with reduced vocabulary and embeddings focused on specific languages;(3) exclusive use of BERT-based models, without incorporating additional methods or optimization techniques, demonstrates promising results for multilabel emotion detection.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了 SemEval 2025 任务 11 的原始方法。我们的研究调查了改进基于文本的多标签情绪检测任务的各种策略。通过实验努力，我们通过比较多个 BERT 模型（包括专门针对情感识别训练的模型）来探索情境化向量表示的好处。此外，我们还研究了超参数调整对模型性能的影响。对于子任务 A，我们的方法在英语数据集上获得了 0.71 的 F1 分数，在俄语数据集上获得了 0.84 的 F1 分数。我们的研究结果强调，(1) 单语言 BERT 模型在英语方面表现出优异的性能，而多语言 BERT 模型在俄语方面表现更好； (2) 与减少词汇量和专注于特定语言的嵌入的模型相比，预训练的情绪检测模型对于这一特定任务的效果较差；(3) 单独使用基于 BERT 的模型，而不结合额外的方法或优化技术，为多标签情绪检测展示了有希望的结果。

title: MRSatSemEval-2025 Task 11: A Hybrid Approach for Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection
abstract_en: We tackle the challenge of multi-label emotion detection in short texts, focusing on SemEval-2025 Task 11 Track A. Our approach, RoEmo, combines generative and discriminative models in an ensemble strategy to classify texts into five emotions: anger, fear, joy, sadness, and surprise.The generative model, instruction-finetuned on emotion detection datasets, undergoes additional fine-tuning on the SemEval-2025 Task 11 Track A dataset to enhance its performance for this specific task. Meanwhile, the discriminative model, based on binary classification, offers a straightforward yet effective approach to classification.We review recent advancements in multi-label emotion detection and analyze the task dataset. Our results show that RoEmo ranks among the top-performing systems, demonstrating high accuracy and reliability.
abstract_zh: 我们解决短文本中多标签情感检测的挑战，重点关注 SemEval-2025 任务 11 轨道 A。我们的方法 RoEmo 将生成模型和判别模型结合在一个集成策略中，将文本分为五种情感：愤怒、恐惧、喜悦、悲伤和惊讶。生成模型在情感检测数据集上进行了指令微调，并在 SemEval-2025 任务 11 轨道 A 上进行了额外的微调数据集以增强其针对此特定任务的性能。同时，基于二元分类的判别模型提供了一种简单而有效的分类方法。我们回顾了多标签情感检测的最新进展并分析了任务数据集。我们的结果表明，RoEmo 跻身性能最佳的系统之列，表现出高精度和可靠性。

title: Pixel Phantoms atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Enhancing Multilingual Emotion Detection with a T5 and mT5-Based Approach
abstract_en: Emotion recognition in textual data is a crucial NLP task with applications in sentiment analysis and mental health monitoring. SemEval 2025 Task 11 introduces a multilingual dataset spanning 28 languages, including low-resource ones, to improve cross-lingual emotion detection. Our approach utilizes T5 for English and mT5 for other languages, fine-tuning them for multi-label classification and emotion intensity estimation. Our findings demonstrate the effectiveness of transformer-based models in capturing nuanced emotional expressions across diverse languages.
abstract_zh: 文本数据中的情绪识别是一项重要的 NLP 任务，可应用于情绪分析和心理健康监测。 SemEval 2025 任务 11 引入了涵盖 28 种语言（包括资源匮乏的语言）的多语言数据集，以改进跨语言情绪检测。我们的方法将 T5 用于英语，将 mT5 用于其他语言，并对它们进行微调以进行多标签分类和情绪强度估计。我们的研究结果证明了基于 Transformer 的模型在捕获不同语言的细微情感表达方面的有效性。

title: GT-NLPatSemEval-2025 Task 11:EmoRationale, Evidence-Based Emotion Detection via Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract_en: Emotion detection in multilingual settings presents significant challenges, particularly for low-resource languages where labeled datasets are scarce. To address these limitations, we introduce EmoRationale, a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework designed to enhance explainability and cross-lingual generalization in emotion detection. Our approach combines vector-based retrieval with in-context learning in large language models (LLMs), using semantically relevant examples to enhance classification accuracy and interpretability. Unlike traditional fine-tuning methods, our system provides evidence-based reasoning for its predictions, making emotion detection more transparent and adaptable across diverse linguistic contexts. Experimental results on the SemEval-2025 Task 11 dataset demonstrate that our RAG-based method achieves strong performance in multi-label emotion classification, emotion intensity assessment, and cross-lingual emotion transfer, surpassing conventional models in interpretability while remaining cost-effective.
abstract_zh: 多语言环境中的情绪检测提出了重大挑战，特别是对于标记数据集稀缺的资源匮乏的语言。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了 EmoRationale，这是一种检索增强生成（RAG）框架，旨在增强情绪检测中的可解释性和跨语言泛化。我们的方法将基于向量的检索与大型语言模型（LLM）中的上下文学习相结合，使用语义相关的示例来提高分类准确性和可解释性。与传统的微调方法不同，我们的系统为其预测提供基于证据的推理，使情绪检测更加透明，并且能够适应不同的语言环境。 SemEval-2025 Task 11 数据集上的实验结果表明，我们基于 RAG 的方法在多标签情感分类、情感强度评估和跨语言情感转移方面取得了强大的性能，在可解释性方面超越了传统模型，同时保持了成本效益。

title: STFXNLPatSemEval-2025 Task 11 Track A: Neural Network, Schema, and Next Word Prediction-based Approaches to Perceived Emotion Detection
abstract_en: In this work, we discuss our models that were applied to the SemEval-2025 Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection (Muhammad et al., 2025b). We focused on the English data set of track A, which involves determining what emotions the reader of a snippet of text is feeling. We applied three different types of models that vary in their approaches and reported our findings on the task’s test set. We found that the performance of our models differed from each other, but neither of our models outperformed the task’s baseline model.
abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们讨论了应用于 SemEval-2025 任务 11 的模型：弥合基于文本的情绪检测中的差距（Muhammad 等人，2025b）。我们专注于轨道 A 的英语数据集，其中涉及确定文本片段的读者的感受。我们应用了三种不同类型的模型，它们的方法各不相同，并报告了我们在任务测试集上的发现。我们发现我们的模型的性能彼此不同，但我们的模型都没有优于任务的基线模型。

title: LATE-GIL-NLPatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Multi-Language Emotion Detection and Intensity Classification Using Transformer Models with Optimized Loss Functions for Imbalanced Data
authors: Jesús V á z q u e z - O s o r i o
abstract_en: This paper addresses our approach to Task 11 (Track A and B) at the SemEval-2025, which focuses on the challenge of multilingual emotion detection in text, specifically identifying perceived emotions. The task is divided into tracks, we participated in two tracks: Track A, involving multilabel emotion detection, and Track B, which extends this to predicting emotion intensity on an ordinal scale. Addressing the challenges of imbalanced data and linguistic diversity, we propose a robust approach using pre-trained language models, fine-tuned with techniques such as extensive and deep hyperparameter optimization, along with loss function combinations to improve performance on imbalanced datasets and underrepresented languages. Our results demonstrate strong performance on Track A, particularly in low-resource languages such as Tigrinya (ranked 2nd), Igbo (ranked 3rd), and Oromo (ranked 4th). This work offers a scalable framework for emotion detection with applications in cross-cultural communication and human-computer interaction.
abstract_zh: 本文阐述了我们在 SemEval-2025 上完成任务 11（轨道 A 和 B）的方法，该方法重点关注文本中多语言情绪检测的挑战，特别是识别感知情绪。该任务分为多个轨道，我们参与了两个轨道：轨道 A，涉及多标签情绪检测；轨道 B，将其扩展到按序数尺度预测情绪强度。为了解决数据不平衡和语言多样性的挑战，我们提出了一种鲁棒的方法，使用预先训练的语言模型，通过广泛和深入的超参数优化等技术进行微调，以及损失函数组合，以提高不平衡数据集和代表性不足的语言的性能。我们的结果表明在 Track A 上表现强劲，特别是在提格里尼亚语（排名第二）、伊博语（排名第三）和奥罗莫语（排名第四）等低资源语言中。这项工作为跨文化交流和人机交互中的应用提供了一个可扩展的情绪检测框架。

title: HTUatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Divide and Conquer - Multi-Label emotion classification using 6DziriBERTs submodels with Label-fused Iterative Mask Filling technique for low-resource data augmentation.
abstract_en: In this paper, the authors address the challenges of multi-label emotion detection in the Algerian dialect by proposing a novel Label-fused Iterative Mask Filling (L-IMF) data augmentation technique combined with a multi-model architecture. The approach leverages DziriBERT, a BERT variant pre-trained on Algerian text, to generate contextually and label-sensitive aug- mented data, mitigating class imbalance while preserving label consistency. The proposed method uses six independent classifiers, each trained on balanced datasets for dedicated la- bel, to improve performance. The results show significant improvement on mutli-label classification task using Deep Learning, with an F1 macro score of 0.536 on the validation dataset and 0.486 on the test dataset, the sys- tem ranked 28/41 on the Algerian dialect score- board; which is more than 7% higher than the task baseline using RemBERT.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，作者通过提出一种新颖的标签融合迭代掩模填充（L-IMF）数据增强技术与多模型架构相结合，解决了阿尔及利亚方言中多标签情感检测的挑战。该方法利用 DziriBERT（一种在阿尔及利亚文本上预训练的 BERT 变体）来生成上下文和标签敏感的增强数据，在保持标签一致性的同时减轻类别不平衡。所提出的方法使用六个独立的分类器，每个分类器都在专用标签的平衡数据集上进行训练，以提高性能。结果表明，使用深度学习对多标签分类任务有显着改进，验证数据集上的 F1 宏观分数为 0.536，测试数据集上的 F1 宏观分数为 0.486，该系统在阿尔及利亚方言评分板上排名 28/41；比使用 RemBERT 的任务基线高出 7% 以上。

title: IASBSatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Ensembling Transformers for Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection
abstract_en: In this paper, we address the challenges of text-based emotion detection, focusing on multi-label classification, emotion intensity prediction, and cross-lingual emotion detection across various languages. We explore the use of advanced machine learning models, particularly transformers, in three tracks: emotion detection, emotion intensity prediction, and cross-lingual emotion detection. Our approach utilizes pre-trained transformer models, such as Gemini, DeBERTa, M-BERT, and M-DistilBERT, combined with techniques like majority voting and average ensemble voting (AEV) to enhance performance. We also incorporate multilingual strategies and prompt engineering to effectively handle the complexities of emotion detection across diverse linguistic and cultural contexts. Our findings demonstrate the success of ensemble methods and multilingual models in improving the accuracy and generalization of emotion detection, particularly for low-resource languages.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们解决了基于文本的情感检测的挑战，重点关注多标签分类、情感强度预测和跨多种语言的跨语言情感检测。我们在三个方面探索先进机器学习模型（特别是 Transformer）的使用：情绪检测、情绪强度预测和跨语言情绪检测。我们的方法利用预训练的 Transformer 模型（例如 Gemini、DeBERTa、M-BERT 和 M-DistilBERT），并结合多数投票和平均集成投票 (AEV) 等技术来提高性能。我们还结合多语言策略和提示工程来有效处理跨不同语言和文化背景的情绪检测的复杂性。我们的研究结果证明了集成方法和多语言模型在提高情绪检测的准确性和泛化方面的成功，特别是对于资源匮乏的语言。

title: RSSNatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Optimizing Multi-Label Emotion Detection with Transformer-Based Models and Threshold Tuning
abstract_en: Our study explores multi-label emotion classification using fine-tuned BERT models, achieving superior performance over traditional methods such as logistic regression. The intricate nature of overlapping emotional expressions in text necessitates a robust classification framework. Fine-tuning BERT with weighted binary cross-entropy loss enhances predictive accuracy, particularly for underrepresented emotions like anger and joy. Moreover, threshold optimization plays a pivotal role in refining decision boundaries, boosting recall, and increasing the macro F1-score. Comparative analysis against RoBERTa and XGBoost further underscores the effectiveness of contextual embeddings in capturing subtle emotional nuances. Despite these improvements, challenges such as class imbalance and inter-class confusion persist, highlighting the need for future advancements in ensemble learning, contrastive pretraining, and domain-adaptive fine-tuning.
abstract_zh: 我们的研究探索使用微调的 BERT 模型进行多标签情感分类，取得了优于逻辑回归等传统方法的性能。文本中重叠的情感表达的复杂性需要一个强大的分类框架。使用加权二元交叉熵损失对 BERT 进行微调可以提高预测准确性，特别是对于愤怒和快乐等未被充分代表的情绪。此外，阈值优化在细化决策边界、提高召回率和增加宏观 F1 分数方面发挥着关键作用。与 RoBERTa 和 XGBoost 的比较分析进一步强调了上下文嵌入在捕捉微妙的情感细微差别方面的有效性。尽管有这些改进，类不平衡和类间混乱等挑战仍然存在，凸显了未来在集成学习、对比预训练和领域自适应微调方面取得进展的必要性。

title: GOLDXatSemEval-2025 Task 11:RoBERTa for Text-Based Emotion Detection
abstract_en: This is an ensemble of RoBERTa models based approach to classify emotions from texts.
abstract_zh: 这是基于 RoBERTa 模型的集合，用于对文本中的情感进行分类。

title: EMO-NLPatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Multi-label Emotion Detection in Multiple Languages Based onXLMCNN
abstract_en: This paper describes the system implemented by the EMO-NLP team for track A of task 11 in SemEval-2025: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection. The task focuses on multiple datasets covering 28 languages for multi-label emotion detection. Most of these languages are low-resource languages. To achieve this goal, we propose a multilingual multi-label emotion detection system called XLMCNN, which can perform multi-label emotion detection across multiple languages. To enable emotion detection in various languages, we utilize the pre-trained model XLM-RoberTa-large to obtain embeddings for the text in different languages. Subsequently, we apply a two-dimensional convolutional operation to the embeddings to extract text features, thereby enhancing the accuracy of multi-label emotion detection. Additionally, we assign weights to different emotion labels to mitigate the impact of uneven label distribution. In this task, we focus on nine languages, among which the Amharic language achieves the best performance with our system, ranking 21st out of 45 teams.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了 EMO-NLP 团队针对 SemEval-2025 中任务 11 的轨道 A 实现的系统：弥合基于文本的情绪检测的差距。该任务重点关注涵盖 28 种语言的多个数据集，用于多标签情感检测。这些语言大多数都是低资源语言。为了实现这一目标，我们提出了一种名为XLMCNN的多语言多标签情感检测系统，它可以跨多种语言进行多标签情感检测。为了实现各种语言的情感检测，我们利用预训练模型 XLM-RoberTa-large 来获取不同语言文本的嵌入。随后，我们对嵌入应用二维卷积运算来提取文本特征，从而提高多标签情感检测的准确性。此外，我们为不同的情感标签分配权重，以减轻标签分布不均匀的影响。在这项任务中，我们关注了 9 种语言，其中阿姆哈拉语在我们的系统中取得了最好的表现，在 45 个团队中排名第 21 位。

title: Tue-JMSatSemEval-2025 Task 11:KReLax: An Ensemble-Based Approach for Multilingual Emotion Detection and Addressing Data Imbalance
abstract_en: Emotion detection research has primarily focused on English, leaving a gap for low-resource languages. To address this, we present KReLaX, a multilingual ensemble model for multi-label emotion detection, combining three BERT-based encoders with a weighted voting layer. Within the shared task, our system performed well in multi-label classification, ranking 3rd in Tatar and achieving strong results in Hindi, Russian, Marathi, and Spanish. In emotion intensity classification, we achieved 6th place in Amharic and Hausa. While our system struggled in the zero-shot track, it achieved 7th place in Indonesian. These results highlight both the potential and the challenges of multilingual emotion detection, emphasizing the need for improved generalization in low-resource settings.
abstract_zh: 情绪检测研究主要集中在英语上，为资源匮乏的语言留下了空白。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 KReLaX，一种用于多标签情感检测的多语言集成模型，它将三个基于 BERT 的编码器与加权投票层相结合。在共享任务中，我们的系统在多标签分类方面表现良好，在鞑靼语中排名第三，在印地语、俄语、马拉地语和西班牙语中取得了优异的成绩。在情绪强度分类中，我们在阿姆哈拉语和豪萨语中取得了第六名。虽然我们的系统在零样本赛道上举步维艰，但它在印度尼西亚语比赛中取得了第七名。这些结果凸显了多语言情绪检测的潜力和挑战，强调在资源匮乏的环境中需要改进泛化能力。

title: Trans-Sent atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Text-based Multi-label Emotion Detection using Pre-TrainedBERTTransformer Models
abstract_en: We have introduced Trans-Sent, a Transformer-based model designed for multi-label emotion classification in SemEval-2025 Task 11. The model predicts perceived emotions such as joy, sadness, anger, fear, surprise, and disgust from text across seven languages, including Amharic, German, English, Hindi, Marathi, Russian, and Romanian. To handle data imbalance, the system incorporates preprocessing techniques, SMOTE oversampling, and feature engineering to enhance classification accuracy. The model was trained using the BRIGHTER and EthioEmo datasets, which contain diverse textual sources, such as social media, news, literature, and personal narratives. Traditional machine learning models, including Logistic Regression and Decision Trees, were tested but proved inadequate for multi-label classification due to their limited ability to capture contextual and semantic meaning. Fine-tuned BERT models demonstrated superior performance, with Russian achieving the highest ranking (9th overall), while languages with complex grammar, such as German and Amharic, performed lower. Future enhancements may include advanced data augmentation, cross-lingual learning, and multimodal emotion analysis to improve classification across different languages. Trans-Sent contributes to NLP by advancing multi-label emotion detection, particularly in underrepresented languages.
abstract_zh: 我们在 SemEval-2025 任务 11 中引入了 Trans-Sent，这是一种基于 Transformer 的模型，专为多标签情感分类而设计。该模型可以预测七种语言（包括阿姆哈拉语、德语、英语、印地语、马拉地语、俄语和罗马尼亚语）文本中感知到的情绪，例如快乐、悲伤、愤怒、恐惧、惊讶和厌恶。为了处理数据不平衡，该系统结合了预处理技术、SMOTE 过采样和特征工程来提高分类准确性。该模型使用 BRIGHTER 和 EthioEmo 数据集进行训练，其中包含多种文本来源，例如社交媒体、新闻、文学和个人叙述。传统的机器学习模型（包括逻辑回归和决策树）经过了测试，但由于捕获上下文和语义的能力有限，被证明不足以进行多标签分类。经过微调的 BERT 模型表现出了卓越的性能，其中俄语排名最高（总体排名第 9），而语法复杂的语言（例如德语和阿姆哈拉语）表现较低。未来的增强功能可能包括高级数据增强、跨语言学习和多模态情感分析，以改进不同语言之间的分类。 Trans-Sent 通过推进多标签情感检测，特别是在代表性不足的语言中，为 NLP 做出贡献。

title: QMULatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Explicit Emotion Detection withEmoLex, Feature Engineering, and Threshold-Optimized Multi-Label Classification
abstract_en: SemEval 2025 Task 11 Track A explores the detection of multiple emotions in text samples. Our best model combined BERT (fine-tuned on an emotion dataset) predictions and engineered features with EmoLex words appended. Together, these were used as input to train a multi-layer perceptron. This achieved a final test set Macro F1 score of 0.56. Compared to only using BERT predictions, our system improves performance by 43.6%.
abstract_zh: SemEval 2025 任务 11 Track A 探索文本样本中多种情绪的检测。我们最好的模型结合了 BERT（在情感数据集上进行微调）预测和附加了 EmoLex 单词的工程特征。这些一起用作训练多层感知器的输入。最终测试集 Macro F1 得分为 0.56。与仅使用 BERT 预测相比，我们的系统性能提高了 43.6%。

title: Emotion Train atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Comparing Generative and Discriminative Models in Emotion Recognition
abstract_en: The emotion recognition task has become increasingly popular as it has a wide range of applications in many fields, such as mental health, product management, and population mood state monitoring. SemEval 2025 Task 11 Track A framed the emotion recognition problem as a multi-label classification task. This paper presents our proposed system submissions in the following languages: English, Algerian and Moroccan Arabic, Brazilian and Mozambican Portuguese, German, Spanish, Nigerian-Pidgin, Russian, and Swedish. Here, we compare the emotion-detecting abilities of generative and discriminative pre-trained language models, exploring multiple approaches, including curriculum learning, in-context learning, and instruction and few-shot fine-tuning. We also propose an extended architecture method with a feature fusion technique enriched with emotion scores and a self-attention mechanism. We find that BERT-based models fine-tuned on data of a corresponding language achieve the best results across multiple languages for multi-label text-based emotion classification, outperforming both baseline and generative models.
abstract_zh: 情绪识别任务越来越受欢迎，在心理健康、产品管理、人群情绪状态监测等许多领域都有广泛的应用。 SemEval 2025 任务 11 Track A 将情感识别问题定义为多标签分类任务。本文以以下语言介绍了我们提议的系统提交内容：英语、阿尔及利亚和摩洛哥阿拉伯语、巴西和莫桑比克葡萄牙语、德语、西班牙语、尼日利亚洋泾浜语、俄语和瑞典语。在这里，我们比较了生成式和判别式预训练语言模型的情绪检测能力，探索了多种方法，包括课程学习、上下文学习、教学和小样本微调。我们还提出了一种扩展的架构方法，具有丰富的情感分数和自注意力机制的特征融合技术。我们发现，基于 BERT 的模型对相应语言的数据进行微调，可以在多种语言中实现基于多标签文本的情感分类的最佳结果，优于基线模型和生成模型。

title: NLP_goats atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Multi-Label Emotion Classification Using Fine-Tuned Roberta-Large Tranformer
abstract_en: This paper serves as a solution for multi-label emotion classification and intensity for text, developed for SemEval-2025 Task 11. The method uses a fine-tuned RoBERTa-Large transformer model. The system represents a multi-label classification approach to identifying multiple emotions, and uses regression models to estimate emotion strength. The model performed with ranks of 31st and 17th place in the corresponding tracks. The findings show impressive performance and it remains possible to improve the performance of ambiguous or low-frequency emotion recognition using the state-of-the-art contextual embeddings and threshold optimization techniques.
abstract_zh: 本文是为 SemEval-2025 任务 11 开发的多标签情感分类和文本强度的解决方案。该方法使用微调的 RoBERTa-Large 变压器模型。该系统代表了一种识别多种情绪的多标签分类方法，并使用回归模型来估计情绪强度。该模型在相应赛道上的排名分别为第31名和第17名。研究结果显示了令人印象深刻的性能，并且仍然有可能使用最先进的上下文嵌入和阈值优化技术来提高模糊或低频情绪识别的性能。

title: AGHNAatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Predicting Emotion and Its Intensity within a Text withEmoBERTa
abstract_en: This paper presents our system that have been developed for SemEval-2025 Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection. The system is able to do two sub-tasks: Track A, related to detecting emotion(s) in a given text; Track B, related to calculate intensity of emotion(s) in a given text. The system will have EmoBERTa as the model baseline, despite some minor differences used in the system approach between these tracks. With the system designed above, Track A achieved a Macro-F1 Score of 0.7372, while Track B achieved Average Pearson r Score of 0.7618.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们为 SemEval-2025 任务 11 开发的系统：弥合基于文本的情绪检测的差距。该系统能够执行两个子任务：轨道 A，与检测给定文本中的情绪相关；轨道 B，与计算给定文本中的情感强度相关。该系统将以 EmoBERTa 作为模型基线，尽管这些轨道之间的系统方法存在一些细微的差异。通过上述设计的系统，轨道 A 的 Macro-F1 得分为 0.7372，而轨道 B 的平均 Pearson r 得分为 0.7618。

title: NITK-VITALatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Focal-RoBERTa: Addressing Class Imbalance in Multi-Label Emotion Classification
abstract_en: This paper presents our approach to SemEval Task 11, which focuses on multi-label emotion detection in English textual data. We experimented with multiple methodologies, including traditional machine learning models, deep learning architectures, and transformer-based models. Our best-performing approach employed RoBERTa with focal loss, which effectively mitigated class imbalances and achieved a macro F1-score of 0.7563, outperforming other techniques. Comparative analyses between different embedding strategies, such as TF-IDF, BERT, and MiniLM, revealed that transformer-based models consistently provided superior performance. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of focal loss in handling highly skewed emotion distributions. Our system contributes to advancing multi-label emotion detection by leveraging robust pre-trained models and loss function optimization.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们的 SemEval Task 11 方法，该方法重点关注英语文本数据中的多标签情感检测。我们尝试了多种方法，包括传统的机器学习模型、深度学习架构和基于 Transformer 的模型。我们表现​​最好的方法采用了具有焦点损失的 RoBERTa，它有效地缓解了类别不平衡，并实现了 0.7563 的宏观 F1 分数，优于其他技术。不同嵌入策略（例如 TF-IDF、BERT 和 MiniLM）之间的比较分析表明，基于 Transformer 的模型始终提供卓越的性能。结果证明了焦点损失在处理高度倾斜的情绪分布方面的有效性。我们的系统通过利用强大的预训练模型和损失函数优化，有助于推进多标签情绪检测。

title: CharsiuRice atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection
abstract_en: This paper presents our participation in SemEval-2025 Task 11, which focuses on bridging the gap in text-based emotion detection. Our team took part in both Tracks A and B, addressing different aspects of emotion classification. We fine-tuned a RoBERTa base model on the provided dataset in Track A, achieving a Macro-F1 score of 0.7264. For Track B, we built on top of the Track A model by incorporating an additional non-linear layer, in the hope of enhancing Track A model’s understanding of emotion detection. Track B model resulted with an average Pearson’s R of 0.5658. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of fine-tuning in Track A and the potential improvements from architectural modifications in Track B for emotion intensity detection tasks.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们对 SemEval-2025 任务 11 的参与，该任务的重点是缩小基于文本的情绪检测方面的差距。我们的团队参加了赛道 A 和赛道 B，解决了情绪分类的不同方面。我们在 Track A 中提供的数据集上对 RoBERTa 基础模型进行了微调，实现了 0.7264 的 Macro-F1 分数。对于 Track B，我们在 Track A 模型的基础上添加了一个额外的非线性层，希望增强 Track A 模型对情绪检测的理解。 Track B 模型的平均 Pearson R 值为 0.5658。结果证明了 Track A 中微调的有效性以及 Track B 中架构修改对情绪强度检测任务的潜在改进。

title: Dianchi atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Multilabel Emotion Recognition via Orthogonal Knowledge Distillation
abstract_en: This paper presents KDBERT-MLDistill, a novel framework for multi-label emotion recognition developed for SemEval-2025 Task 11. Addressing challenges of fine-grained emotion misdetection and small-data overfitting, the method synergizes BERT-based text encoding with orthogonal knowledge distillation. Key innovations include: (1) Orthogonal regularization on classifier weights to minimize redundant feature correlations, coupled with dynamic pseudo-labeling for periodic data augmentation; (2) A hierarchical distillation mechanism where dual teacher-student models iteratively exchange parameters to balance knowledge retention and exploration.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了 KDBERT-MLDistill，这是一种为 SemEval-2025 任务 11 开发的多标签情感识别新框架。该方法解决了细粒度情感误检和小数据过拟合的挑战，将基于 BERT 的文本编码与正交知识蒸馏相结合。主要创新包括：（1）对分类器权重进行正交正则化，以最大限度地减少冗余特征相关性，并结合用于定期数据增强的动态伪标签； （2）分层蒸馏机制，双师生模型迭代交换参数以平衡知识保留和探索。

title: zhouyijiang1 atSemEval-2025 Task 11: A Multi-tag Detection Method based on Pre-training Language Models
abstract_en: In order to effectively predict the speaker’s informing emotion from text fragments, we propose a transfer learning framework based on the BERT pre-training model through deep semantic feature extraction and cascade structure of dynamic weight linear classifier. In the speaker informing emotion prediction task, a 0.70 F1 score is achieved, illustrating the effectiveness of cross-domain emotion recognition.
abstract_zh: 为了有效地从文本片段中预测说话者的告知情绪，我们通过深度语义特征提取和动态权重线性分类器的级联结构，提出了一种基于BERT预训练模型的迁移学习框架。在说话人告知情绪预测任务中，取得了0.70的F1分数，说明了跨域情绪识别的有效性。

title: NYCU-NLPatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Assembling Small Language Models for Multilabel Emotion Detection and Intensity Prediction
abstract_en: This study describes the design of the NYCU-NLP system for the SemEval-2025 Task 11 that focuses on multi-lingual text-based emotion analysis. We instruction-tuned three small language models: Gemma-2 (27B), Mistral-small-3 (22B), and Phi-4 (14B) and then assembled them as our main system architecture. Our NYCU-NLP system participated the English Track A for multilabel emotion detection and English Track B for emotion intensity prediction. Experimental results show our best-performing submission produced a macro-averaging F1 score of 0.8225, ranking second of 90 participating teams for Track A, and ranked second among 41 teams for Track B with a Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.8373.
abstract_zh: 本研究描述了 NYCU-NLP 系统针对 SemEval-2025 任务 11 的设计，该系统侧重于基于多语言文本的情感分析。我们对三种小型语言模型进行了指令调优：Gemma-2 (27B)、Mistral-small-3 (22B) 和 Phi-4 (14B)，然后将它们组装为我们的主要系统架构。我们的 NYCU-NLP 系统参加了用于多标签情绪检测的英语 Track A 和用于情绪强度预测的英语 Track B。实验结果显示，我们表现最好的提交作品的宏观平均 F1 分数为 0.8225，在赛道 A 的 90 支参赛队伍中排名第二，在赛道 B 的 41 支队伍中排名第二，皮尔逊相关系数为 0.8373。

title: PAIatSemEval-2025 Task 11: A Large Language Model Ensemble Strategy for Text-Based Emotion Detection
abstract_en: This paper describes our system used in the SemEval-2025 Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection. To address the highly subjective nature of emotion detection tasks, we propose a model ensemble strategy designed to capture the varying subjective perceptions of different users towards textual content. The base models of this ensemble strategy consist of several large language models, which are then combined using methods such as neural networks, decision trees, linear regression, and weighted voting. In Track A, out of 28 languages, our system achieved first place in 19 languages. In Track B, out of 11 languages, our system ranked first in 10 languages. Furthermore, our system attained the highest average performance across all languages in both Track A and Track B.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了我们在 SemEval-2025 任务 11：弥合基于文本的情绪检测中的差距中使用的系统。为了解决情绪检测任务的高度主观性，我们提出了一种模型集成策略，旨在捕获不同用户对文本内容的不同主观感知。该集成策略的基础模型由多个大型语言模型组成，然后使用神经网络、决策树、线性回归和加权投票等方法将这些模型组合起来。在 A 组中，我们的系统在 28 种语言中以 19 种语言获得了第一名。在B轨中，在11种语言中，我们的系统在10种语言中排名第一。此外，我们的系统在轨道 A 和轨道 B 的所有语言中均获得了最高的平均性能。

title: Tarbiat_Modares_SemEval2025_Task11_MultiLabel_Emotion_TransferLearning
abstract_en: The SemEval-2025 Task 11 addresses multi-label emotion detection, classifying perceived emotions in text. Our system targets Amharic, a morphologically complex, low-resource language. We fine-tune LaBSE with class-weighted loss for multi-label prediction.Our architecture consists of: (i) text tokenization via LaBSE, (ii) a fully connected layer with sigmoid activation for classification, and (iii) optimization using BCEWithLogitsLoss and AdamW. Ablation studies on class balancing and data augmentation showed that simple upsampling did not improve performance, highlighting the need for more sophisticated techniques.Our system ranked 14th out of 43 teams, achieving 0.4938 accuracy, 0.6931 micro-F1, and 0.6450 macro-F1, surpassing the task baseline (0.6383 macro-F1). Error analysis revealed that anger and disgust were well detected, while fear and surprise were frequently misclassified due to overlapping linguistic cues. Our findings underscore the challenges of multi-label emotion detection in low-resource languages. Future work could explore context-aware embeddings, improved data augmentation, and adaptive loss functions.
abstract_zh: SemEval-2025 任务 11 致力于多标签情绪检测，对文本中感知的情绪进行分类。我们的系统以阿姆哈拉语为目标，这是一种形态复杂、资源匮乏的语言。我们通过类加权损失对 LaBSE 进行微调，以进行多标签预测。我们的架构包括：(i) 通过 LaBSE 进行文本标记化，(ii) 具有用于分类的 sigmoid 激活的全连接层，以及 (iii) 使用 BCEWithLogitsLoss 和 AdamW 进行优化。关于类平衡和数据增强的消融研究表明，简单的上采样并不能提高性能，这凸显了对更复杂技术的需求。我们的系统在 43 个团队中排名第 14，实现了 0.4938 准确度、0.6931 micro-F1 和 0.6450 Macro-F1，超过了任务基线（0.6383 Macro-F1）。错误分析显示，愤怒和厌恶被很好地检测到，而恐惧和惊讶由于语言线索重叠而经常被错误分类。我们的研究结果强调了低资源语言中多标签情感检测的挑战。未来的工作可以探索上下文感知嵌入、改进的数据增强和自适应损失函数。

title: Zero atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Multilingual Emotion Classification withBERTVariants: A Comparative Study
abstract_en: Emotion detection in text plays a very crucial role in NLP applications such as sentiment analysis and feedback analysis. This study tackles two tasks: multi-label emotion detection, where the goal is to classify text based on six emotions (joy, sadness, fear, anger, surprise, and disgust) in a multilingual setting, and emotion intensity prediction, which assigns an ordinal intensity score to each of the above-given emotions. Using the BRIGHTER dataset, a multilingual corpus spanning 28 languages, the paper addresses issues like class imbalances by treating each emotion as an independent binary classification problem. The paper first explores strategies such as static embeddings such as GloVe with logistic regression classifiers on top of it. To capture contextual nuances more effectively, we fine-tune transformer based models, such as BERT and RoBERTa. Our approach demonstrates the benefits of fine-tuning for improved emotion prediction, while also highlighting the challenges of multilingual and multi-label classification.
abstract_zh: 文本中的情感检测在情感分析和反馈分析等自然语言处理应用中起着非常重要的作用。这项研究解决两个任务：多标签情绪检测，其目标是在多语言环境中根据六种情绪（快乐、悲伤、恐惧、愤怒、惊讶和厌恶）对文本进行分类；情绪强度预测，为上述每种情绪分配一个序数强度分数。该论文使用 BRIGHTER 数据集（涵盖 28 种语言的多语言语料库），通过将每种情绪视为独立的二元分类问题来解决类不平衡等问题。本文首先探讨了静态嵌入等策略，例如在其之上带有逻辑回归分类器的 GloVe。为了更有效地捕捉上下文的细微差别，我们对基于 Transformer 的模型进行了微调，例如 BERT 和 RoBERTa。我们的方法展示了微调改进情绪预测的好处，同时也强调了多语言和多标签分类的挑战。

title: UTBNLPatSemeval-2025 Task 11: Predicting Emotion Intensity withBERTandVAD-Informed Attention.
abstract_en: Emotion intensity prediction plays a crucial role in affective computing, allowing for a more precise understanding of how emotions are conveyed in text. This study proposes a system that estimates emotion intensity levels by integrating contextual language representations with numerical emotion-based features derived from Valence, Arousal, and Dominance (VAD). The methodology combines BERT embeddings, predefined VAD values per emotion, and machine learning techniques to enhance emotion detection, without relying on external lexicons. The system was evaluated on the SemEval-2025 Task 11 Track B dataset, predicting five emotions (anger, fear, joy, sadness, and surprise) on an ordinal scale.The results highlight the effectiveness of integrating contextual representations with predefined VAD values, enabling a more nuanced representation of emotional intensity. However, challenges arose in distinguishing intermediate intensity levels, affecting classification accuracy for certain emotions. Despite these limitations, the study provides insights into the strengths and weaknesses of combining deep learning with numerical emotion modeling, contributing to the development of more robust emotion prediction systems. Future research will explore advanced architectures and additional linguistic features to enhance model generalization across diverse textual domains.
abstract_zh: 情绪强度预测在情感计算中起着至关重要的作用，可以更准确地理解文本中情绪的表达方式。本研究提出了一种系统，通过将上下文语言表示与源自效价、唤醒度和优势 (VAD) 的基于数字情感的特征相结合来估计情绪强度水平。该方法结合了 BERT 嵌入、每种情绪的预定义 VAD 值和机器学习技术来增强情绪检测，而无需依赖外部词典。该系统在 SemEval-2025 Task 11 Track B 数据集上进行了评估，按顺序预测五种情绪（愤怒、恐惧、喜悦、悲伤和惊讶）。结果凸显了将上下文表示与预定义的 VAD 值相结合的有效性，从而能够更细致地表示情绪强度。然而，在区分中间强度级别时出现了挑战，影响了某些情绪的分类准确性。尽管存在这些局限性，该研究仍深入了解了深度学习与数值情绪建模相结合的优点和缺点，有助于开发更强大的情绪预测系统。未来的研究将探索先进的架构和额外的语言特征，以增强跨不同文本领域的模型泛化。

title: OPI-DRO-HELat atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Few-shot prompting for Text-based Emotion Recognition
abstract_en: This paper presents our system, developed as our contribution to SemEval-2025 Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection task, in particular track A, Multi-label Emotion Detection subtask. Our approach relies on two distinct components: semantic search for top N most similar inputs from training set and an interface to pretrained LLM being prompted using the found examples. We examine several prompting strategies and their impact on overall performance of the proposed solution.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们的系统，该系统是我们对 SemEval-2025 任务 11 的贡献而开发的：弥合基于文本的情绪检测任务中的差距，特别是轨道 A，多标签情绪检测子任务。我们的方法依赖于两个不同的组件：从训练集中搜索前 N 个最相似的输入的语义，以及使用找到的示例提示的预训练 LLM 的接口。我们研究了几种提示策略及其对所提议解决方案整体性能的影响。

title: NLP-DUatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Analyzing Multi-label Emotion Detection
abstract_en: This paper describes NLP-DU’s entry to SemEval-2025 Task 11 on multi-label emotion detection. We investigated the efficacy of transformer-based models and propose an ensemble approach that combines multiple models. Our experiments demonstrate that the ensemble outperforms individual models under the dataset constraints, yielding superior performance on key evaluation metrics. These findings underscore the potential of ensemble techniques in enhancing multi-label emotion detection and contribute to the broader understanding of emotion analysis in natural language processing.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 NLP-DU 进入 SemEval-2025 Task 11 关于多标签情绪检测的情况。我们研究了基于 Transformer 的模型的有效性，并提出了一种结合多个模型的集成方法。我们的实验表明，在数据集约束下，该集成优于单个模型，在关键评估指标上产生了卓越的性能。这些发现强调了集成技术在增强多标签情感检测方面的潜力，并有助于更广泛地理解自然语言处理中的情感分析。

title: CSECU-Learners atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Multilingual Emotion Recognition and Intensity Prediction with Language-tuned Transformers and Multi-sample Dropout
abstract_en: In today’s digital era, individuals convey their feelings, viewpoints, and perspectives across various platforms in nuanced and intricate ways. At times, these expressions can be challenging to articulate and interpret. Emotion recognition aims to identify the most relevant emotions in a text that accurately represent the author’s psychological state. Despite its substantial impact on natural language processing (NLP), this task has primarily been researched only in high-resource languages. To bridge this gap, SemEval-2025 Task 11 introduces a multilingual emotion recognition challenge encompassing 32 languages, promoting broader linguistic inclusivity in emotion recognition. This paper presents our participation in this task, where we introduce a language-specific fine-tuned transformer-based system for emotion recognition and emotion intensity prediction. To enhance generalization, we incorporate a multi-sample dropout strategy. Our approach is evaluated across 11 languages, and experimental results demonstrate its competitive performance, achieving top-tier results in certain languages.
abstract_zh: 在当今的数字时代，个人通过各种平台以微妙而复杂的方式表达自己的感受、观点和观点。有时，这些表达方式可能难以清晰表达和解释。情绪识别旨在识别文本中最相关的情绪，准确地代表作者的心理状态。尽管它对自然语言处理（NLP）有重大影响，但该任务主要仅在高资源语言中进行研究。为了弥补这一差距，SemEval-2025 任务 11 引入了涵盖 32 种语言的多语言情感识别挑战，促进情感识别中更广泛的语言包容性。本文介绍了我们对这项任务的参与，其中我们引入了一种基于语言特定的微调变压器的系统，用于情感识别和情感强度预测。为了增强泛化能力，我们采用了多样本 dropout 策略。我们的方法在 11 种语言中进行了评估，实验结果证明了其具有竞争力的性能，在某些语言中取得了顶级结果。

title: Amado atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Multi-label Emotion Detection inAmharic andEnglish Data
abstract_en: Recently, social media has become a platform for different human emotions. Although most existing works treat the user’s opinions into a single emotion, the reality is that one user can have more than one emotion at a time, representing multiple emotions at the same time. Multi-label emotion detection is a more advanced and realistic approach, as it acknowledges the complexity of human emotions and their overlapping nature. This paper presents multi-label emotion detection in Amharic and English data. The work is part of SemEval2025 shared task 11, where tasks and datasets are offered by task organizers. To accomplish the aim of the given task, we fine-tune transformers base BERT model, passing through all different workflow pipelines. On unseen test data, the model evaluation achieved 0.6300 and 0.7025 an average macro F1-score for Amharic and English, respectively.
abstract_zh: 近年来，社交媒体已成为人类不同情感的平台。尽管大多数现有作品将用户的意见视为单一情感，但现实情况是一个用户可以同时拥有多种情感，同时代表多种情感。多标签情绪检测是一种更先进、更现实的方法，因为它承认人类情绪的复杂性及其重叠性质。本文提出了阿姆哈拉语和英语数据中的多标签情绪检测。这项工作是 SemEval2025 共享任务 11 的一部分，其中任务和数据集由任务组织者提供。为了实现给定任务的目标，我们对 Transformer 基础 BERT 模型进行了微调，通过所有不同的工作流程管道。在未见过的测试数据上，模型评估的阿姆哈拉语和英语的平均宏观 F1 分数分别为 0.6300 和 0.7025。

title: SyntaxMind atSemEval-2025 Task 11:BERTBase Multi-label Emotion Detection Using Gated Recurrent Unit
abstract_en: Emotions influence human behavior, speech, and expression, making their detection crucial in Natural Language Processing (NLP). While most prior research has focused on single-label emotion classification, real-world emotions are often multi-faceted. This paper describes our participation in SemEval-2025 Task 11, Track A (Multi-label Emotion Detection) and Track B (Emotion Intensity). We employed BERT as a feature extractor with stacked GRUs, which resulted in better stability and convergence. Our system was evaluated across 19 languages for Track A and 9 languages for Track B.
abstract_zh: 情绪影响人类行为、言语和表达，因此情绪检测在自然语言处理 (NLP) 中至关重要。虽然大多数先前的研究都集中在单标签情绪分类上，但现实世界的情绪通常是多方面的。本文描述了我们参与 SemEval-2025 任务 11、Track A（多标签情绪检测）和 Track B（情绪强度）的情况。我们采用 BERT 作为具有堆叠 GRU 的特征提取器，这带来了更好的稳定性和收敛性。我们的系统针对轨道 A 进行了 19 种语言的评估，针对轨道 B 进行了 9 种语言的评估。

title: ITF-NLPatSemEval-2025 Task 11 An Exploration ofEnglish andGerman Multi-label Emotion Detection using Fine-tuned Transformer Models
abstract_en: We present our submission to Task 11, Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection, of the 19th International Workshop on Semantic Evaluation (SemEval) 2025. We participated in track A, multi-label emotion detection, in both German and English. Our approach is based on fine-tuning transformer models for each language, and our models achieve a Macro F1 of 0.75 and 0.62 for English and German respectively. Furthermore, we analyze the data available for training to gain insight into the model predictions.
abstract_zh: 我们向 2025 年第 19 届国际语义评估 (SemEval) 研讨会的任务 11“弥合基于文本的情绪检测的差距”提交了我们的意见。我们参加了赛道 A，多标签情绪检测，以德语和英语进行。我们的方法基于每种语言的微调 Transformer 模型，我们的模型对于英语和德语分别实现了 0.75 和 0.62 的 Macro F1。此外，我们分析可用于训练的数据，以深入了解模型预测。

title: TeamKiAmSo atSemEval-2025 Task 11: A Comparison of Classification Models for Multi-label Emotion Detection
abstract_en: The aim of this paper is to take on the challenge of multi-label emotion detection for a variety of languages as part of Track A in SemEval 2025 Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection. We fine-tune different pre-trained mono- and multilingual language models and compare their performance on multi-label emotion detection on a variety of high-resource and low-resource languages. Overall, we find that monolingual models tend to perform better, but for low-resource languages that do not have state-of-the-art pre-trained language models, multilingual models can achieve comparable results.
abstract_zh: 本文的目的是应对多种语言的多标签情感检测挑战，作为 SemEval 2025 任务 11 中轨道 A 的一部分：弥合基于文本的情感检测的差距。我们对不同的预训练单语言和多语言语言模型进行微调，并比较它们在各种高资源和低资源语言上的多标签情感检测性能。总体而言，我们发现单语言模型往往表现更好，但对于没有最先进的预训练语言模型的低资源语言，多语言模型可以取得可比的结果。

title: UoB-NLPatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Leveraging Adapters for Multilingual and Cross-Lingual Emotion Detection
abstract_en: Emotion detection in natural language processing is a challenging task due to the complexity of human emotions and linguistic diversity. While significant progress has been made in high-resource languages, emotion detection in low-resource languages remains underexplored. In this work, we address multilingual and cross-lingual emotion detection by leveraging adapter-based fine-tuning with multilingual pre-trained language models. Adapters introduce a small number of trainable parameters while keeping the pre-trained model weights fixed, offering a parameter-efficient approach to adaptation. We experiment with different adapter tuning strategies, including task-only adapters, target-language-ready task adapters, and language-family-based adapters. Our results show that target-language-ready task adapters achieve the best overall performance, particularly for low-resource African languages with our team ranking 7th for Tigrinya, and 8th for Kinyarwanda. In Track C, our system ranked 5th for Oromo, Tigrinya, Kinyarwanda, Amharic, and Igbo. Our approach outperforms large language models in 11 languages and matches their performance in four others, despite using significantly fewer parameters. Furthermore, we find that adapter-based models retain cross-linguistic transfer capabilities while requiring fewer computational resources compared to full fine-tuning for each language.
abstract_zh: 由于人类情感的复杂性和语言的多样性，自然语言处理中的情感检测是一项具有挑战性的任务。虽然高资源语言已经取得了重大进展，但低资源语言的情绪检测仍然没有得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们通过利用基于适配器的微调和多语言预训练语言模型来解决多语言和跨语言情绪检测。适配器引入少量可训练参数，同时保持预训练模型权重固定，从而提供参数高效的适应方法。我们尝试了不同的适配器调整策略，包括仅任务适配器、目标语言就绪任务适配器和基于语言系列的适配器。我们的结果表明，目标语言就绪任务适配器实现了最佳的整体性能，特别是对于资源匮乏的非洲语言，我们的团队在提格里尼亚语中排名第七，在基尼亚卢旺达语中排名第八。在 C 轨中，我们的系统在奥罗莫语、提格里尼亚语、基尼亚卢旺达语、阿姆哈拉语和伊博语中排名第五。尽管使用的参数少得多，但我们的方法在 11 种语言中的性能优于大型语言模型，并且在其他四种语言中的性能与它们的性能相当。此外，我们发现基于适配器的模型保留了跨语言传输能力，同时与每种语言的完全微调相比需要更少的计算资源。

title: CIC-IPNatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Transformer-Based Approach to Multi-Class Emotion Detection
abstract_en: This paper presents a multi-step approach for multi-label emotion classification as our system description paper for the SEMEVAL-2025 workshop Task A using machine learning and deep learning models. We test our methodology on English, Spanish, and low-resource Yoruba datasets, with each dataset labeled with five emotion categories: anger, fear, joy, sadness, and surprise. Our preprocessing involves text cleaning and feature extraction using bigrams and TF-IDF. We employ logistic regression for baseline classification and fine-tune Transformer models, such as BERT and XLM-RoBERTa, for improved performance. The Transformer-based models outperformed the logistic regression model, achieving micro-F1 scores of 0.7061, 0.7321, and 0.2825 for English, Spanish, and Yoruba, respectively. Notably, our Yoruba fine-tuned model outperformed the baseline model of the task organizers with micro-F1 score of 0.092, demonstrating the effectiveness of Transformer models in handling emotion classification tasks across diverse languages.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种多标签情感分类的多步骤方法，作为我们使用机器学习和深度学习模型的 SEMEVAL-2025 研讨会任务 A 的系统描述论文。我们在英语、西班牙语和资源匮乏的约鲁巴语数据集上测试了我们的方法，每个数据集都标记了五种情绪类别：愤怒、恐惧、快乐、悲伤和惊讶。我们的预处理涉及使用二元组和 TF-IDF 进行文本清理和特征提取。我们采用逻辑回归进行基线分类，并微调 Transformer 模型（例如 BERT 和 XLM-RoBERTa）以提高性能。基于 Transformer 的模型优于逻辑回归模型，英语、西班牙语和约鲁巴语的 micro-F1 分数分别为 0.7061、0.7321 和 0.2825。值得注意的是，我们的约鲁巴语微调模型的 micro-F1 得分为 0.092，优于任务组织​​者的基线模型，证明了 Transformer 模型在处理跨不同语言的情感分类任务方面的有效性。

title: NLP-Cimat atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Prompt Optimization forLLMs via Genetic Algorithms and Systematic Mutation applied on Emotion Detection
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable performance across diverse natural language processing tasks in recent years. However, optimizing instructions to maximize model performance remains a challenge due to the vast search space and the nonlinear relationship between input structure and output quality. This work explores an alternative prompt optimization technique based on genetic algorithms with different structured mutation processes. Unlike traditional random mutations, our method introduces variability in each generation through a guided mutation, enhancing the likelihood of obtaining better prompts for each generation. We apply this approach to emotion detection in the context of SemEval 2025 Task 11, demonstrating the potential to improve prompt efficiency, and consequently task performance. Experimental results show that our method yields competitive results compared to standard optimization techniques while maintaining interpretability and scalability.
abstract_zh: 近年来，大型语言模型（LLM）在各种自然语言处理任务中表现出了卓越的性能。然而，由于巨大的搜索空间以及输入结构和输出质量之间的非线性关系，优化指令以最大化模型性能仍然是一个挑战。这项工作探索了一种基于具有不同结构化突变过程的遗传算法的替代提示优化技术。与传统的随机突变不同，我们的方法通过引导突变在每一代中引入变异性，从而提高了为每一代获得更好提示的可能性。我们在 SemEval 2025 Task 11 的背景下应用这种方法进行情绪检测，展示了提高提示效率以及任务性能的潜力。实验结果表明，与标准优化技术相比，我们的方法产生了有竞争力的结果，同时保持了可解释性和可扩展性。

title: McGill-NLPatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection
abstract_en: In this paper, we present the results of our SemEval-2025 Emotion Detection Shared Task Track A which focuses on multi-label emotion detection. Our team’s approach leverages prompting GPT-4o, fine-tuning NLLB- LLM2Vec encoder, and an ensemble of these two approaches to solve Track A. Our ensemble method beats the baseline method that fine-tuned RemBERT encoder in 24 of the 28 languages. Furthermore, our results shows that the average performance is much worse for under-resourced languages in the Afro- Asiatic, Niger-Congo and Austronesia with per- formance scores at 50 F1 points and below.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了 SemEval-2025 情绪检测共享任务轨道 A 的结果，该任务专注于多标签情绪检测。我们团队的方法利用提示 G​​PT-4o、微调 NLLB-LLM2Vec 编码器以及这两种方法的集成来解决 Track A。我们的集成方法击败了在 28 种语言中的 24 种语言中微调 RemBERT 编码器的基线方法。此外，我们的结果表明，亚非语系、尼日尔刚果语和南岛语系的资源贫乏语言的平均表现要差得多，其表现分数为 50 F1 分及以下。

title: NTAatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Enhanced Multilingual Textual Multi-label Emotion Detection via Integrated Augmentation Learning
abstract_en: Emotion detection in text is crucial for various applications, but progress, especially in multi-label scenarios, is often hampered by data scarcity, particularly for low-resource languages like Emakhuwa and Tigrinya. This lack of data limits model performance and generalizability. To address this, the NTA team developed a system for SemEval-2025 Task 11, leveraging data augmentation techniques: swap, deletion, oversampling, emotion-focused synonym insertion and synonym replacement to enhance baseline models for multilingual textual multi-label emotion detection. Our proposed system achieved significantly higher macro F1-scores compared to the baseline across multiple languages, demonstrating a robust approach to tackling data scarcity. This resulted in a 17th place overall ranking on the private leaderboard, and remarkably, we achieved the highest score and became the winner in Tigrinya language, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach in a low-resource setting.
abstract_zh: 文本中的情绪检测对于各种应用至关重要，但进展，特别是在多标签场景中，常常受到数据稀缺的阻碍，特别是对于 Emakhuwa 和 Tigrinya 等资源匮乏的语言。数据的缺乏限制了模型的性能和普遍性。为了解决这个问题，NTA 团队为 SemEval-2025 任务 11 开发了一个系统，利用数据增强技术：交换、删除、过采样、以情感为中心的同义词插入和同义词替换，以增强多语言文本多标签情感检测的基线模型。与多种语言的基线相比，我们提出的系统取得了显着更高的宏观 F1 分数，展示了解决数据稀缺问题的稳健方法。这使得我们在私人排行榜上获得了第 17 位的总排名，值得注意的是，我们获得了最高分并成为提格里尼亚语的获胜者，这证明了我们的方法在资源匮乏的环境中的有效性。

title: Exploration LabIITKatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection
abstract_en: This paper presents our approach to SemEval-2025 Task 11 (Track A): Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection, with a focus on multi-label emotion classification for the English dataset. Our methodology leverages an ensemble of transformer-based models, incorporating full fine-tuning along with additional classification layers to enhance predictive performance. Through extensive experimentation, we demonstrate that fine-tuning significantly improves emotion classification accuracy compared to baseline models. Furthermore, we provide an in-depth analysis of the dataset, highlighting key patterns and challenges. The study also evaluates the impact of ensemble modeling on performance, demonstrating its effectiveness in capturing nuanced emotional expressions. Finally, we outline potential directions for further refinement and domain-specific adaptations to enhance model robustness.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们的 SemEval-2025 任务 11（轨道 A）的方法：弥合基于文本的情绪检测的差距，重点关注英语数据集的多标签情绪分类。我们的方法利用基于变压器的模型集合，结合全面的微调和额外的分类层来增强预测性能。通过广泛的实验，我们证明与基线模型相比，微调显着提高了情绪分类的准确性。此外，我们还对数据集进行了深入分析，突出了关键模式和挑战。该研究还评估了集成建模对性能的影响，证明了其在捕捉细微情感表达方面的有效性。最后，我们概述了进一步细化和特定领域适应以增强模型稳健性的潜在方向。

title: Zero_Shot atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Fine-Tuning Deep Learning and Transformer-based Models for Emotion Detection in Multi-label Classification, Intensity Estimation, and Cross-lingual Adaptation
abstract_en: Language is a rich medium employed to convey emotions subtly and intricately, as abundant as human emotional experiences themselves. Emotion recognition in natural language processing (NLP) is now a core element in facilitating human-computer interaction and interpreting intricate human behavior via text. It has potential applications in every sector i.e., sentiment analysis, mental health surveillance. However, prior research on emotion recognition is primarily from high-resource languages while low-resource languages (LRLs) are not well represented. This disparity has been a limitation to the development of universally applicable emotion detection models. To address this, the SemEval-2025 Shared Task 11 focused on perceived emotions, aiming to identify the emotions conveyed by a text snippet. It includes three tracks: Multi-label Emotion Detection (Track A), Emotion Intensity (Track B), and Cross-lingual Emotion Detection (Track C). This paper explores various models, including machine learning (LR, SVM, RF, NB), deep learning (BiLSTM+CNN, BiLSTM+BiGRU), and transformer-based models (XLM-R, mBERT, ModernBERT). The results showed that XLM-R outperformed other models in Tracks A and B, while BiLSTM+CNN performed better for Track C across most languages.
abstract_zh: 语言是一种丰富的媒介，用于微妙而复杂地传达情感，与人类的情感体验本身一样丰富。自然语言处理 (NLP) 中的情绪识别现已成为促进人机交互和通过文本解释复杂人类行为的核心要素。它在每个领域都有潜在的应用，即情绪分析、心理健康监测。然而，先前关于情感识别的研究主要来自高资源语言，而低资源语言（LRL）没有得到很好的体现。这种差异一直限制着普遍适用的情绪检测模型的发展。为了解决这个问题，SemEval-2025 共享任务 11 重点关注感知情绪，旨在识别文本片段传达的情绪。它包括三个轨道：多标签情绪检测（轨道A）、情绪强度（轨道B）和跨语言情绪检测（轨道C）。本文探讨了各种模型，包括机器学习（LR、SVM、RF、NB）、深度学习（BiLSTM+CNN、BiLSTM+BiGRU）和基于 Transformer 的模型（XLM-R、mBERT、ModernBERT）。结果表明，XLM-R 在 Track A 和 B 中优于其他模型，而 BiLSTM+CNN 在大多数语言的 Track C 中表现更好。

title: UB_Tel-UatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Emotions Without Borders - A Unified Framework for Multilingual Classification Using Augmentation and Ensemble
abstract_en: In this SemEval 2025 Task 11 paper, we tackled three tracks: Multi-label Emotion Detection, Emotion Intensity, and Cross-lingual Emotion Detection. Our approach harnesses diverse external corpora and robust data augmentation techniques across Spanish, English, and Arabic, enhancing both the diversity and resilience of the dataset. Instead of developing separate models for each language, we merge the data into a unified multilingual dataset, enabling our model to learn cross-lingual patterns and relationships simultaneously. Our ensemble architecture integrates the multilingual strengths of XLM-RoBERTa, a zero-shot classification capability via LLaMA 3, and a specialized pretrained model fine-tuned on English emotion classification. Notably, our system achieved strong performance, ranking 13th for Afrikaans (afr) in Track A, 13th for Amharic (amh) in Track B, and 4th for Hindi (hin) in Track C.
abstract_zh: 在这篇 SemEval 2025 任务 11 论文中，我们解决了三个问题：多标签情绪检测、情绪强度和跨语言情绪检测。我们的方法利用西班牙语、英语和阿拉伯语的多样化外部语料库和强大的数据增强技术，增强了数据集的多样性和弹性。我们没有为每种语言开发单独的模型，而是将数据合并到统一的多语言数据集中，使我们的模型能够同时学习跨语言模式和关系。我们的集成架构集成了 XLM-RoBERTa 的多语言优势、通过 LLaMA 3 的零样本分类功能以及针对英语情感分类进行微调的专门预训练模型。值得注意的是，我们的系统取得了强劲的性能，在轨道 A 中的南非荷兰语 (afr) 排名第 13 位，在轨道 B 中的阿姆哈拉语 (amh) 排名第 13 位，在轨道 C 中的印地语 (hin) 排名第 4 位。

title: Deep atSemEval-2025 Task 11: A Multi-Stage Approach to Emotion Detection
abstract_en: This paper presents a novel text-based emotion detection approach for low-resource languages in SemEval-2025 Task 11. We fine-tuned Google Gemma 2 using tailored data augmentation and Chain-of-Thought prompting. Our method, incorporating supervised fine-tuning and model ensembling, significantly improved multi-label emotion recognition, intensity prediction, and cross-lingual performance. Results show strong performance in diverse low-resource settings. Challenges remain in fine-grained sentiment analysis. Future work will explore advanced data augmentation and knowledge transfer methods. This research demonstrates the potential of large language models for inclusive emotion analysis.
abstract_zh: 本文在 SemEval-2025 任务 11 中提出了一种针对低资源语言的新颖的基于文本的情感检测方法。我们使用定制的数据增强和思维链提示对 Google Gemma 2 进行了微调。我们的方法结合了监督微调和模型集成，显着改进了多标签情感识别、强度预测和跨语言性能。结果显示在各种资源匮乏的环境中表现强劲。细粒度情绪分析仍然面临挑战。未来的工作将探索先进的数据增强和知识转移方法。这项研究证明了大型语言模型在包容性情感分析方面的潜力。

title: Empaths atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Retrieval-Augmented Approach to Perceived Emotions Prediction
abstract_en: The paper introduces EmoRAG, a retrieval-augmented emotion detection system designed for the SemEval-2025 Task 11. It uses an ensemble of models, retrieving similar examples to prompt large language models (LLMs) for emotion predictions. The retriever component fetches the most relevant examples from a database, which are then used as few-shot prompts for the models. EmoRAG achieves strong, scalable performance across languages with no training at all, demonstrating effectiveness in both high and low-resource languages.
abstract_zh: 该论文介绍了 EmoRAG，这是一种为 SemEval-2025 任务 11 设计的检索增强情绪检测系统。它使用模型集合，检索相似的示例，以提示大型语言模型 (LLM) 进行情绪预测。检索器组件从数据库中获取最相关的示例，然后将其用作模型的少量提示。 EmoRAG 无需任何培训即可跨语言实现强大、可扩展的性能，在高资源语言和低资源语言中都展示了有效性。

title: HausaNLPatSemEval-2025 Task 11: AdvancingHausa Text-based Emotion Detection
abstract_en: This paper presents our approach to multi-label emotion detection in Hausa, a low-resource African language, as part of SemEval Track A. We fine-tuned AfriBERTa, a transformer-based model pre-trained on African languages, to classify Hausa text into six emotions: anger, disgust, fear, joy, sadness, and surprise. Our methodology involved data preprocessing, tokenization, and model fine-tuning using the Hugging Face Trainer API. The system achieved a validation accuracy of 74.00%, with an F1-score of 73.50%, demonstrating the effectiveness of transformer-based models for emotion detection in low-resource languages.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们在豪萨语（一种资源匮乏的非洲语言）中进行多标签情感检测的方法，作为 SemEval Track A 的一部分。我们对 AfriBERTa（一种针对非洲语言进行预训练的基于 Transformer 的模型）进行了微调，将豪萨语文本分为六种情感：愤怒、厌恶、恐惧、喜悦、悲伤和惊讶。我们的方法涉及使用 Hugging Face Trainer API 进行数据预处理、标记化和模型微调。该系统的验证准确度为 74.00%，F1 分数为 73.50%，证明了基于 Transformer 的模型在低资源语言中进行情感检测的有效性。

title: indiDataMiner atSemEval-2025 Task 11: From Text to Emotion: Transformer-Based Models for Emotions Detection inIndian Languages
abstract_en: Emotion detection is essential for applications like mental health monitoring and social media analysis, yet remains underexplored for Indian languages. This paper presents our system for SemEval-2025 Task 11 (Track A), focusing on multilabel emotion detection in Hindi and Marathi, two widely spoken Indian languages. We fine-tune IndicBERT v2 on the BRIGHTER dataset, achieving F1 scores of 87.37 (Hindi) and 88.32 (Marathi), outperforming baseline models. Our results highlight the effectiveness of fine-tuning a language-specific pretrained model for emotion detection, contributing to advancements in multilingual NLP research.
abstract_zh: 情绪检测对于心理健康监测和社交媒体分析等应用至关重要，但对于印度语言的研究仍然不足。本文介绍了我们的 SemEval-2025 任务 11（轨道 A）系统，重点关注印地语和马拉地语（两种广泛使用的印度语言）的多标签情绪检测。我们在 BRIGHTER 数据集上对 IndicBERT v2 进行微调，取得了 87.37（印地语）和 88.32（马拉地语）的 F1 分数，优于基线模型。我们的结果强调了微调特定于语言的预训练模型用于情绪检测的有效性，有助于多语言 NLP 研究的进步。

title: GinGer atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Leveraging Fine-Tuned Transformer Models andLoRAfor Sentiment Analysis in Low-Resource Languages
abstract_en: Emotion recognition is a crucial task in natural language processing, particularly in the domain of multi-label emotion classification, where a single text can express multiple emotions with varying intensities. In this work, we participated in Task 11, Track A and Track B of the SemEval-2025 competition, focusing on emotion detection in low-resource languages. Our approach leverages transformer-based models combined with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) techniques to effectively address the challenges posed by data scarcity. We specifically applied our method to multiple languages and achieved 9th place in the Arabic Algerian track among 40 competing teams. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of PEFT in improving emotion recognition performance for low-resource languages. The code for our implementation is publicly available at: https://github.com/AylinNaebzadeh/Text-Based-Emotion-Detection-SemEval-2025.
abstract_zh: 情感识别是自然语言处理中的一项关键任务，特别是在多标签情感分类领域，单个文本可以表达不同强度的多种情感。在这项工作中，我们参与了 SemEval-2025 竞赛的任务 11、Track A 和 Track B，重点关注低资源语言中的情绪检测。我们的方法利用基于变压器的模型与参数高效微调（PEFT）技术相结合，有效解决数据稀缺带来的挑战。我们专门将我们的方法应用于多种语言，并在阿拉伯语阿尔及利亚赛道上的 40 支参赛队伍中获得了第九名。我们的结果证明了 PEFT 在提高低资源语言的情感识别性能方面的有效性。我们的实现代码可在以下位置公开获取：https://github.com/AylinNaebzadeh/Text-Based-Emotion-Detection-SemEval-2025。

title: TILeNatSemEval-2025 Task 11: A Transformer-Based Model for Sentiment Classification Applied to theRussian Language
abstract_en: We present our approach to tackle the Sentiment Classification Task. The task was divided into 3 categories: 1) Track A: Multi-label Emotion Detection 2) Track B: Emotion Intensity, and 3) Cross-lingual Emotion Detection. We participate in subtasks 1 and 2 for the Russian language. Our main approach is summarized as using pre-trained language models and afterwords working with fine-tuning aside the corpora provided. During the development phase, we had promising outcomes. Later during the test phase, we got similar scores to the Semeval baseline. Our approach is easy to replicate and we proportionate every detail of the process performed.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了解决情感分类任务的方法。该任务分为 3 类：1）轨道 A：多标签情绪检测 2）轨道 B：情绪强度，以及 3）跨语言情绪检测。我们参与俄语的子任务 1 和 2。我们的主要方法概括为使用预先训练的语言模型和后记，并在提供的语料库之外进行微调。在开发阶段，我们取得了可喜的成果。后来在测试阶段，我们得到了与 Semeval 基线相似的分数。我们的方法很容易复制，并且我们会平衡所执行流程的每个细节。

title: JellyKatSemEval-2025 Task 11:Russian Multi-label Emotion Detection with Pre-trainedBERT-based Language Models
abstract_en: This paper presents our approach for SemEval-2025 Task 11, we focus on on multi-label emotion detection in Russian text (track A). We preprocess the data by handling special characters, punctuation, and emotive expressions to improve feature-label relationships. To select the best model performance, we fine-tune various pre-trained language models specialized in Russian and evaluate them using K-FOLD Cross-Validation. Our results indicated that ruRoberta-large achieved the best Macro F1-score among tested models. Finally, our system achieved fifth place in the unofficial competition ranking.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们针对 SemEval-2025 任务 11 的方法，我们重点关注俄语文本中的多标签情感检测（轨道 A）。我们通过处理特殊字符、标点符号和情感表达来预处理数据，以改善特征标签关系。为了选择最佳模型性能，我们对各种专门针对俄语的预训练语言模型进行了微调，并使用 K-FOLD 交叉验证对其进行评估。我们的结果表明，ruRoberta-large 在测试模型中获得了最佳的 Macro F1 分数。最终，我们的系统在非官方竞赛排名中获得了第五名。

title: JUNLP_Sarika atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Bridging Contextual Gaps in Text-Based Emotion Detection using Transformer Models
abstract_en: Because language is subjective, it can be difficult to infer human emotions from textual data. This work investigates the categorization of emotions using BERT, classifying five emotions—angry, fearful, joyful, sad, and surprised—by utilizing its contextual embeddings. Preprocessing techniques like tokenization and stop-word removal are used on the dataset, which comes from social media and personal tales. With a weighted F1-score of 0.75, our model was trained using a multi-label classification strategy. BERT has the lowest F1-score when it comes to rage, but it does well when it comes to identifying fear and surprise. The findings demonstrate the difficulties presented by unbalanced datasets while also highlighting the promise of transformer-based models for text-based emotion identification. Future research will use data augmentation methods, domain-adapted BERT models, and other methods to improve classification performance.
abstract_zh: 由于语言是主观的，因此很难从文本数据推断出人类的情感。这项工作使用 BERT 研究情绪分类，利用其上下文嵌入对五种情绪进行分类：愤怒、恐惧、快乐、悲伤和惊讶。数据集使用了标记化和停用词删除等预处理技术，这些技术来自社交媒体和个人故事。我们的模型使用多标签分类策略进行训练，加权 F1 分数为 0.75。 BERT 在愤怒方面的 F1 分数最低，但在识别恐惧和惊讶方面表现良好。研究结果证明了不平衡数据集带来的困难，同时也强调了基于变压器的模型在基于文本的情感识别方面的前景。未来的研究将使用数据增强方法、领域适应的 BERT 模型和其他方法来提高分类性能。

title: PromotionGo atSemEval-2025 Task 11: A Feature-Centric Framework for Cross-Lingual Multi-Emotion Detection in Short Texts
abstract_en: This paper presents our system for SemEval 2025 Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection (Track A), which focuses on multi-label emotion detection in short texts. We propose a feature-centric framework that dynamically adapts document representations and learning algorithms to optimize language-specific performance. Our study evaluates three key components: document representation, dimensionality reduction, and model training in 28 languages, highlighting five for detailed analysis. The results show that TF-IDF remains highly effective for low-resource languages, while contextual embeddings like FastText and Contextual String Embeddings (CSEs) exhibit language-specific strengths. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) reduces training time without compromising performance, particularly benefiting FastText and neural models such as Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLP). Computational efficiency analysis underscores the trade-off between model complexity and processing cost. Our framework provides a scalable solution for multilingual emotion detection, addressing the challenges of linguistic diversity and resource constraints.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们用于 SemEval 2025 任务 11 的系统：弥合基于文本的情绪检测的差距（轨道 A），该系统专注于短文本中的多标签情绪检测。我们提出了一个以特征为中心的框架，可以动态调整文档表示和学习算法以优化特定于语言的性能。我们的研究评估了三个关键组成部分：文档表示、降维和 28 种语言的模型训练，并重点介绍了其中 5 个部分进行详细分析。结果表明，TF-IDF 对于低资源语言仍然非常有效，而 FastText 和上下文字符串嵌入 (CSE) 等上下文嵌入则表现出特定于语言的优势。主成分分析 (PCA) 在不影响性能的情况下减少了训练时间，特别有利于 FastText 和多层感知器 (MLP) 等神经模型。计算效率分析强调模型复杂性和处理成本之间的权衡。我们的框架为多语言情感检测提供了可扩展的解决方案，解决了语言多样性和资源限制的挑战。

title: University ofIndonesia atSemEval-2025 Task 11: Evaluating State-of-the-Art Encoders for Multi-Label Emotion Detection
abstract_en: This paper presents our approach for SemEval 2025 Task 11 Track A, focusing on multilabel emotion classification across 28 languages. We explore two main strategies: fully fine-tuning transformer models and classifier-only training, evaluating different settings such as fine-tuning strategies, model architectures, loss functions, encoders, and classifiers. Our findings suggest that training a classifier on top of prompt-based encoders such as mE5 and BGE yields significantly better results than fully fine-tuning XLMR and mBERT. Our best-performing model on the final leaderboard is an ensemble combining multiple BGE models, where CatBoost serves as the classifier, with different configurations. This ensemble achieves an average F1-macro score of 56.58 across all languages.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们针对 SemEval 2025 任务 11 Track A 的方法，重点关注跨 28 种语言的多标签情感分类。我们探索了两种主要策略：完全微调 Transformer 模型和仅分类器训练，评估不同的设置，例如微调策略、模型架构、损失函数、编码器和分类器。我们的研究结果表明，在基于提示的编码器（例如 mE5 和 BGE）上训练分类器比完全微调 XLMR 和 mBERT 能产生更好的结果。我们在最终排行榜上表现最好的模型是结合了多个 BGE 模型的集成，其中 CatBoost 用作分类器，具有不同的配置。该集成在所有语言中的 F1 宏平均得分为 56.58。

title: UT-NLPatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Evaluating Zero-Shot Capability ofGPT-4o mini on Emotion Recognition via Role-Play and Contrastive Judging
abstract_en: Emotion recognition in text is crucial in natural language processing but challenging in multilingual settings due to varying cultural and linguistic cues. In this study, we assess the zero-shot capability of GPT-4o Mini, a cost-efficient small-scale LLM, for multilingual emotion detection. Since small LLMs tend to perform better with task decomposition, we introduce a two-step approach: (1) Role-Play Rewriting, where the model minimally rewrites the input sentence to reflect different emotional tones, and (2) Contrastive Judging, where the original sentence is compared against these rewrites to determine the most suitable emotion label. Our approach requires no labeled data for fine-tuning or few-shot in-context learning, enabling a plug-and-play solution that can seamlessly integrate with any LLM. Results show promising performance, particularly in low-resource languages, though with a performance gap between high- and low-resource settings. These findings highlight how task decomposition techniques like role-play and contrastive judging can enhance small LLMs’ zero-shot capabilities for real-world, data-scarce scenarios.
abstract_zh: 文本中的情感识别对于自然语言处理至关重要，但由于不同的文化和语言线索，在多语言环境中具有挑战性。在本研究中，我们评估了 GPT-4o Mini（一种经济高效的小型大语言模型）用于多语言情感检测的零样本能力。由于小型大语言模型往往在任务分解方面表现更好，因此我们引入了一种两步方法：（1）角色扮演重写，其中模型最小程度地重写输入句子以反映不同的情绪基调，以及（2）对比判断，其中将原始句子与这些重写进行比较，以确定最合适的情绪标签。我们的方法不需要用于微调或少量上下文学习的标记数据，从而实现了可以与任何大语言模型无缝集成的即插即用解决方案。结果显示出良好的性能，特别是在低资源语言中，尽管高资源设置和低资源设置之间存在性能差距。这些发现强调了角色扮演和对比判断等任务分解技术如何增强小型大语言模型针对现实世界、数据稀缺场景的零样本能力。

title: NUSTTitans atSemEval-2025 Task 11:AfroEmo: Multilingual Emotion Detection with AdaptiveAfro-XLM-R
abstract_en: This paper presents AfroEmo, a multilingual, multi label emotion classification system designed for SemEval 2025 Task 11, leveraging the Afro XLMR model. Our approach integrates adaptive pretraining on domain specific corpora followed by fine tuning on low resource languages. Through comprehensive exploratory data analysis, we assess label distribution and model performance across diverse linguistic settings. By incorporating perceived emotions, how emotions are interpreted rather than explicitly stated, we enhance emotion recognition capabilities in underrepresented languages. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance particularly in Amharic, while addressing key challenges in low resource emotion detection.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 AfroEmo，这是一种利用 Afro XLMR 模型，为 SemEval 2025 任务 11 设计的多语言、多标签情感分类系统。我们的方法集成了对特定领域语料库的自适应预训练，然后对低资源语言进行微调。通过全面的探索性数据分析，我们评估不同语言环境中的标签分布和模型性能。通过结合感知到的情绪，以及如何解释情绪而不是明确表达情绪，我们增强了代表性不足的语言中的情绪识别能力。实验结果表明，我们的方法实现了有竞争力的性能，特别是在阿姆哈拉语中，同时解决了低资源情绪检测中的关键挑战。

title: QiMPatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Optimizing Text-based Emotion Classification inEnglish Beyond Traditional Methods
abstract_en: As human-machine interactions become increasingly natural through text, accurate emotion recognition is essential. Detecting emotions provides valuable insights across various applications. In this paper, we present our approach for SemEval-2025 Task 11, Track A, which focuses on multi-label text-based detection of perceived emotions. Our system was designed for and tested on English language text. To classify emotions present in text snippets, we initially experimented with traditional techniques such as Logistic Regression, Gradient Boosting, and SVM. We then explored state-of-the-art LLMs (OpenAI o1 and DeepSeek V3) before developing our final system, a fine-tuned Transformer-based model. Our best-performing approach employs an ensemble of fine-tuned DeBERTa-large instances with multiple seeds, optimized using Optuna and StratifiedKFold cross-validation. This approach achieves an F1-score of 0.75, demonstrating promising results with room for further improvement.
abstract_zh: 随着人机交互通过文本变得越来越自然，准确的情绪识别至关重要。检测情绪可以为各种应用提供有价值的见解。在本文中，我们提出了 SemEval-2025 任务 11，轨道 A 的方法，该方法侧重于基于多标签文本的感知情绪检测。我们的系统是针对英语文本设计并进行测试的。为了对文本片段中存在的情感进行分类，我们最初尝试了逻辑回归、梯度提升和支持向量机等传统技术。然后，在开发我们的最终系统（基于 Transformer 的微调模型）之前，我们探索了最先进的大语言模型（OpenAI o1 和 DeepSeek V3）。我们性能最佳的方法采用了一组经过微调的具有多个种子的 DeBERTa 大型实例，并使用 Optuna 和 StratifiedKFold 交叉验证进行了优化。该方法的 F1 分数为 0.75，显示出有前景的结果，并且还有进一步改进的空间。

title: SemEval-2025 Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection
abstract_en: We present our shared task on text-based emotion detection, covering more than 30 languages from seven distinct language families. These languages are predominantly low-resource and spoken across various continents. The data instances are multi-labeled into six emotional classes, with additional datasets in 11 languages annotated for emotion intensity. Participants were asked to predict labels in three tracks: (a) emotion labels in monolingual settings, (b) emotion intensity scores, and (c) emotion labels in cross-lingual settings.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了基于文本的情感检测的共同任务，涵盖来自七个不同语系的 30 多种语言。这些语言主要是资源匮乏的语言，并且在各大洲使用。数据实例被多重标记为 6 个情感类别，并有 11 种语言的附加数据集注释了情感强度。参与者被要求预测三个轨道中的标签：（a）单语言环境中的情绪标签，（b）情绪强度分数，以及（c）跨语言环境中的情绪标签。

title: Multilingual Analysis of Narrative Properties in Conspiracist vs Mainstream Telegram Channels
abstract_en: Conspiracist narratives posit an omnipotent, evil group causing harm throughout domains. However, modern-day online conspiracism is often more erratic, consisting of loosely connected posts displaying a general anti-establishment attitude pervaded by negative emotions. We gather a dataset of 300 conspiracist and mainstream, Telegram channels in Italian and English and use the automatic extraction of entities and emotion detection to compare structural characteristics of both types of channels. We create a co-occurrence network of entities to analyze how the different types of channels introduce and use them across posts and topics. We find that conspiracist channels are characterized by anger. Moreover, co-occurrence networks of entities appearing in conspiracist channels are more dense. We theorize that this reflects a narrative structure where all actants are pushed into a single domain. Conspiracist channels disproportionately associate the most central group of entities with anger and fear. We do not find evidence that entities in conspiracist narratives occur across more topics. This could indicate an erratic type of online conspiracism where everything can be connected to everything and that is characterized by a high number of entities and high levels of anger.
abstract_zh:
阴谋论叙述假设一个无所不能的邪恶团体在整个领域造成伤害。然而，现代的网络阴谋论往往更加不稳定，由松散关联的帖子组成，表现出普遍的反建制态度，弥漫着负面情绪。我们收集了 300 个意大利语和英语的阴谋论和主流 Telegram 频道的数据集，并使用实体自动提取和情感检测来比较两种类型频道的结构特征。我们创建一个实体共现网络来分析不同类型的渠道如何跨帖子和主题引入和使用它们。我们发现阴谋论渠道的特点是愤怒。此外，出现在阴谋论渠道中的实体的共现网络更加密集。我们推测这反映了一种叙事结构，其中所有参与者都被推入一个单一的领域。阴谋论渠道不成比例地将最核心的实体群体与愤怒和恐惧联系在一起。我们没有发现证据表明阴谋主义叙事中的实体出现在更多主题中。这可能表明一种不稳定的在线阴谋论类型，其中一切都可以连接到一切，其特点是实体数量多和愤怒程度高。

## 立场检测 (28 篇)

title: MPVStance: Mitigating Hallucinations in Stance Detection with Multi-Perspective Verification
abstract_en: Stance detection is a pivotal task in Natural Language Processing (NLP), identifying textual attitudes toward various targets. Despite advances in using Large Language Models (LLMs), challenges persist due to hallucination-models generating plausible yet inaccurate content. Addressing these challenges, we introduce MPVStance, a framework that incorporates Multi-Perspective Verification (MPV) with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) across a structured five-step verification process. Our method enhances stance detection by rigorously validating each response from factual accuracy, logical consistency, contextual relevance, and other perspectives. Extensive testing on the SemEval-2016 and VAST datasets, including scenarios that challenge existing methods and comprehensive ablation studies, demonstrates that MPVStance significantly outperforms current models. It effectively mitigates hallucination issues and sets new benchmarks for reliability and accuracy in stance detection, particularly in zero-shot, few-shot, and challenging scenarios.
abstract_zh: 姿态检测是自然语言处理 (NLP) 中的一项关键任务，可识别对各种目标的文本态度。尽管大型语言模型 (LLM) 的使用取得了进步，但由于幻觉模型生成看似合理但不准确的内容，挑战仍然存在。为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了 MPVStance，这是一个框架，在结构化的五步验证过程中将多视角验证 (MPV) 与检索增强生成 (RAG) 相结合。我们的方法通过从事实准确性、逻辑一致性、上下文相关性和其他角度严格验证每个响应来增强立场检测。对 SemEval-2016 和 VAST 数据集的广泛测试（包括挑战现有方法的场景和全面的消融研究）表明 MPVStance 显着优于当前模型。它有效地缓解了幻觉问题，并为姿态检测的可靠性和准确性设立了新的基准，特别是在零镜头、少镜头和具有挑战性的场景中。

title: Towards Comprehensive Argument Analysis in Education: Dataset, Tasks, and Method
abstract_en: Argument mining has garnered increasing attention over the years, with the recent advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) further propelling this trend. However, current argument relations remain relatively simplistic and foundational, struggling to capture the full scope of argument information. To address this limitation, we propose a systematic framework comprising 14 fine-grained relation types from the perspectives of vertical argument relations and horizontal discourse relations, thereby capturing the intricate interplay between argument components for a thorough understanding of argument structure. On this basis, we conducted extensive experiments on three tasks: argument component prediction, relation prediction, and automated essay grading. Additionally, we explored the impact of writing quality on argument component prediction and relation prediction, as well as the connections between discourse relations and argumentative features. The findings highlight the importance of fine-grained argumentative annotations for argumentative writing assessment and encourage multi-dimensional argument analysis.
abstract_zh: 多年来，参数挖掘越来越受到关注，最近大型语言模型（LLM）的进步进一步推动了这一趋势。然而，当前的论证关系仍然相对简单和基础，难以捕获完整的论证信息。为了解决这一局限性，我们从纵向论证关系和横向话语关系的角度提出了一个由 14 种细粒度关系类型组成的系统框架，从而捕捉论证成分之间错综复杂的相互作用，从而全面理解论证结构。在此基础上，我们对三个任务进行了广泛的实验：论点成分预测、关系预测和自动论文评分。此外，我们还探讨了写作质量对论点成分预测和关系预测的影响，以及篇章关系和论点特征之间的联系。研究结果强调了细粒度的论证注释对于论证性写作评估的重要性，并鼓励多维论证分析。

title: How to Compare Things Properly? A Study of Argument Relevance in Comparative Question Answering
abstract_en: Comparative Question Answering (CQA) lies at the intersection of Question Answering, Argument Mining, and Summarization. It poses unique challenges due to the inherently subjective nature of many questions and the need to integrate diverse perspectives. Although the CQA task can be addressed using recently emerged instruction-following Large Language Models (LLMs), challenges such as hallucinations in their outputs and the lack of transparent argument provenance remain significant limitations.To address these challenges, we construct a manually curated dataset comprising arguments annotated with their relevance. These arguments are further used to answer comparative questions, enabling precise traceability and faithfulness.
