abstract_en: This paper describes a multi-hop LLM agent for tabular question answering developed for SemEval-2025 Task 8 and ranked 6th with 87% accuracy. Our approach combines proprietary LLM (ChatGPT-3.5-turbo) for code generation and open source LLM (Llama-3.2-3B) for answer validation.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了为 SemEval-2025 Task 8 开发的用于表格问答的多跳 LLM 代理，并以 87% 的准确率排名第六。我们的方法结合了用于代码生成的专有 LLM (ChatGPT-3.5-turbo) 和用于答案验证的开源 LLM (Llama-3.2-3B)。

title: QleverAnswering-PUCRSatSemEval-2025 Task 8: ExploringLLMagents, code generation and correction for Table Question Answering
abstract_en: Table Question Answering (TQA) is a challenging task that requires reasoning over structured data to extract accurate answers. This paper presents QleverAnswering-PUCRS, our submission to SemEval-2025 Task 8: DataBench, Question-Answering over Tabular Data. QleverAnswering-PUCRS is a modular multi-agent system that employs a structured approach to TQA. The approach revolves around breaking down the task into specialized agents, each dedicated to handling a specific aspect of the problem. Our system was evaluated on benchmark datasets and achieved competitive results, ranking mid-to-top positions in the SemEval-2025 competition. Despite these promising results, we identify areas for improvement, particularly in handling complex queries and nested data structures.
abstract_zh: 表问答 (TQA) 是一项具有挑战性的任务，需要对结构化数据进行推理以提取准确的答案。本文介绍了 QleverAnswering-PUCRS，这是我们提交给 SemEval-2025 任务 8：DataBench，表格数据问答的内容。 QleverAnswering-PUCRS 是一个模块化多代理系统，采用结构化方法进行 TQA。该方法围绕将任务分解为专门的代理，每个代理专门处理问题的特定方面。我们的系统在基准数据集上进行了评估，并取得了有竞争力的结果，在 SemEval-2025 竞赛中排名中上。尽管取得了这些令人鼓舞的结果，但我们还是确定了需要改进的领域，特别是在处理复杂查询和嵌套数据结构方面。

title: ITUNLPatSemEval-2025 Task 8: Question-Answering over Tabular Data: A Zero-Shot Approach usingLLM-Driven Code Generation
abstract_en: This paper presents our system for SemEval-2025 Task 8: DataBench, Question-Answeringover Tabular Data. The primary objective ofthis task is to perform question answering ongiven tabular datasets from diverse domains;under two subtasks: DataBench QA (SubtaskI) and DataBench Lite QA (Subtask II). Totackle both subtasks, we developed a zero-shotsolution with a particular emphasis on lever-aging Large Language Model (LLM)-basedcode generation. Specifically, we proposeda Python code generation framework, utiliz-ing state-of-the-art open-source LLMs to gen-erate executable Pandas code via optimizedprompting strategies. Our experiments revealthat different LLMs exhibit varying levels ofeffectiveness in Python code generation. Addi-tionaly, results show that Python code genera-tion achieves superior performance in tabularquestion answering compared to alternative ap-proaches. Although our ranking among zero-shot systems is unknown at the time of this pa-per’s submission, our system achieved eighthplace in Subtask I and sixth place in Subtask IIamong the 30 systems that outperformed thebaseline in the open-source models category.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们用于 SemEval-2025 任务 8 的系统：DataBench，表格数据问答。此任务的主要目标是在两个子任务下对来自不同领域的给定表格数据集执行问答：DataBench QA（子任务 I）和 DataBench Lite QA（子任务 II）。为了解决这两个子任务，我们开发了一个零样本解决方案，特别强调利用基于大型语言模型 (LLM) 的代码生成。具体来说，我们提出了一个Python代码生成框架，利用最先进的开源LLM通过优化的提示策略生成可执行的Pandas代码。我们的实验表明，不同的大语言模型在 Python 代码生成方面表现出不同程度的有效性。此外，结果表明，与其他方法相比，Python 代码生成在表格问题回答中实现了卓越的性能。尽管我们在零样本系统中的排名在本文提交时尚不清楚，但我们的系统在开源模型类别中表现优于基线的 30 个系统中，在子任务 I 中排名第八，在子任务 II 中排名第六。

title: CSIROLTatSemEval-2025 Task 8: Answering Questions over Tabular Data usingLLMs
abstract_en: Question Answering over large tables is challenging due to the difficulty of reasoning required in linking information from different parts of a table, such as heading and metadata to the values in the table and information needs. We investigate using Large Language Models (LLM) for tabular reasoning, where, given a pair of a table and a question from the DataBench benchmark, the models generate answers. We experiment with three techniques that enables symbolic reasoning through code execution: a direct code prompting (DCP) approach, ‘DCP_Py’, which uses Python, multi-step code (MSC) prompting ‘MSC_SQL+FS’ using SQL and ReAct prompting, ‘MSR_Py+FS’, which combines multi-step reasoning (MSR), few-shot (FS) learning and Python tools. We also conduct an analysis exploring the impact of answer types, data size, and multi-column dependencies on LLMs’ answer generation performance, including an assessment of the models’ limitations and the underlying challenges of tabular reasoning in LLMs.
abstract_zh: 对大型表格进行问答具有挑战性，因为将表格不同部分的信息（例如标题和元数据）链接到表格中的值和信息需求所需的推理很困难。我们研究使用大型语言模型 (LLM) 进行表格推理，其中，给定一对表格和 DataBench 基准测试中的一个问题，模型会生成答案。我们尝试了三种通过代码执行实现符号推理的技术：直接代码提示（DCP）方法“DCP_Py”，它使用Python；多步代码（MSC）提示“MSC_SQL+FS”，使用SQL和ReAct提示；“MSR_Py+FS”，它结合了多步推理（MSR）、少样本（FS）学习和Python工具。我们还进行了一项分析，探讨答案类型、数据大小和多列依赖性对大语言模型答案生成性能的影响，包括评估模型的局限性以及大语言模型表格推理的潜在挑战。

title: HowardUniversity-AI4PCatSemEval-2025 Task 8:DeepTabCoder - Code-based Retrieval and In-context Learning for Question-Answering over Tabular Data
abstract_en: This paper presents our approach, named DeepTabCoder, to SemEval 2025 - Task 8: DataBench, which focuses on question-answering over tabular data. We utilize a code-based retrieval system combined with in-context learning, which generates and executes code to answer questions, leveraging DeepSeek-V3 for code generation. DeepTabCoder outperforms the baseline, achieving accuracies of 81.42% on the DataBench dataset and 80.46% on the DataBench Lite dataset.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们针对 SemEval 2025 - 任务 8：DataBench 的方法，名为 DeepTabCoder，该方法侧重于表格数据的问答。我们利用基于代码的检索系统与上下文学习相结合，生成并执行代码来回答问题，并利用 DeepSeek-V3 进行代码生成。 DeepTabCoder 的表现优于基线，在 DataBench 数据集上达到 81.42% 的准确率，在 DataBench Lite 数据集上达到 80.46% 的准确率。

title: TeleAIatSemEval-2025 Task 8: Advancing Table Reasoning Framework with Large Language Models
abstract_en: The paper presents our system developed for SemEval-2025 Task 8, which focuses on table question answering (TQA). The TQA tasks face challenges due to the characteristics of real-world tabular data, such as large size, incomplete column semantics, and entity ambiguity. To address these issues, we propose a large language model (LLM)-powered and programming-based framework, named Flow-of-Table-Reasoning. We introduce the table schema integrating verbalized structure and semantics for query decomposition and programming, enabling a holistic understanding of tables and the ability to process large-size tables. We design a multi-step schema linking plan to derive a focused table schema that retains only information relevant to the query, aiming to eliminate ambiguity and reduce hallucinations. Furthermore, we incorporate reasoning workflow into an iterative thinking architecture, allowing incremental cycles of thinking, reasoning and reflection. Our system achieves first place on both TQA and Lite TQA subtasks.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们为 SemEval-2025 任务 8 开发的系统，该系统专注于表格问答 (TQA)。由于现实世界表格数据的特点，如数据量大、列语义不完整、实体模糊等，TQA 任务面临着挑战。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一个由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动且基于编程的框架，名为 Flow-of-Table-Reasoning。我们引入了集成语言结构和语义的表模式，用于查询分解和编程，从而实现对表的整体理解和处理大型表的能力。我们设计了一个多步骤模式链接计划来派生一个集中的表模式，该模式仅保留与查询相关的信息，旨在消除歧义并减少幻觉。此外，我们将推理工作流程纳入迭代思维架构中，允许思维、推理和反思的增量循环。我们的系统在 TQA 和 Lite TQA 子任务上均获得第一名。

title: IUST_Champs atSemEval-2025 Task 8: Structured Prompting and Retry Policy for Tabular Question Answering
abstract_en: This paper presents a novel approach to Question Answering over Tabular Data, as part of SemEval-2025 Task 8. Our system generates executable Python code to derive answers directly from structured data, leveraging open-source large language models. Key innovations include structured prompting, semantic column filtering, and a one-time retry mechanism to enhance accuracy and robustness. We evaluate our approach on the DataBench and DataBench_Lite datasets, significantly outperforming the baseline accuracy (26-27%) with our best system achieving 70.49% accuracy on the test set. Ablation studies confirm that few-shot prompting and rule-based type classification are crucial for improved performance. Despite these advancements, challenges remain in handling complex table structures and ambiguous queries. Our findings highlight the effectiveness of code-generation based methods for tabular question answering and provide insights for further research in this area.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种通过表格数据进行问答的新颖方法，作为 SemEval-2025 任务 8 的一部分。我们的系统生成可执行的 Python 代码，利用开源大型语言模型直接从结构化数据中得出答案。主要创新包括结构化提示、语义列过滤和一次性重试机制，以提高准确性和稳健性。我们在 DataBench 和 DataBench_Lite 数据集上评估我们的方法，显着优于基线准确率 (26-27%)，我们最好的系统在测试集上达到 70.49% 的准确率。消融研究证实，少量提示和基于规则的类型分类对于提高性能至关重要。尽管取得了这些进步，但在处理复杂的表结构和不明确的查询方面仍然存在挑战。我们的研究结果强调了基于代码生成的表格问答方法的有效性，并为该领域的进一步研究提供了见解。

title: Exploration LabIITKatSemEval-2025 Task 8: Multi-LLMAgentQAover Tabular Data
abstract_en: This paper presents our Multi-LLM Agentic System that helps solve the problem of tabular question answering as posed in the SemEval Task-8: Question Answering over Tabular Data. Our system incorporates an Agentic Workflow where we assign each agent a role along with the context from other agents to better help resolve the ambiguity. As the user poses their question along with the dataframe, we firstly try to infer the types of the columns from the dataframe and also the expected answer type given the question and the column types. Then, the planner agent gives out a plan that tells us about the steps that we have to take to get the answer. Each step is written such that it helps us write one line of Python code. Then, we call the coding agent, which attempts to write the code given the information from the previous agents. After that, we perform a debugging pass through a debugging agent, which tries to resolve the issue given the previous context and finally deliver the answer if the code runs error-free. Our system achieved 14th place on the overall open-source models track.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们的多大语言模型代理系统，该系统有助于解决 SemEval Task-8：表格数据问答中提出的表格问答问题。我们的系统包含一个代理工作流程，我们为每个代理分配一个角色以及其他代理的上下文，以更好地帮助解决歧义。当用户与数据帧一起提出问题时，我们首先尝试从数据帧中推断列的类型，以及给定问题和列类型的预期答案类型。然后，规划代理给出一个计划，告诉我们为得到答案而必须采取的步骤。每一步的编写都有助于我们编写一行Python代码。然后，我们调用编码代理，它尝试根据先前代理的信息编写代码。之后，我们通过调试代理执行调试过程，该代理尝试解决给定先前上下文的问题，并在代码运行无错误的情况下最终提供答案。我们的系统在整个开源模型赛道上排名第 14 位。

title: MINDSatSemEval-2025 Task 8: Question Answering Over Tabular Data via Large Language Model-generatedSQLQueries
abstract_en: The growing capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) have opened up new opportunities for answering questions based on structured data. However, LLMs often struggle to directly handle tabular data and provide accurate, grounded answers. This paper addresses the challenge of Question Answering (QA) over tabular data, specifically in the context of SemEval-2025 Task 8. We propose an LLM-based pipeline that generates SQL queries to extract answers from tabular datasets. Our system leverages In-Context Learning to produce queries, which are then executed on structured tables, to produce the final answers. We demonstrate that our solution performs effectively in a few-shot setup and scales well across tables of different sizes. Additionally, we conduct a data-driven error analysis to highlight scenarios where the model encounters difficulties. We make the code available at https://github.com/fgiobergia/SemEval2025-Task8.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 的功能不断增强，为回答基于结构化数据的问题提供了新的机会。然而，大语言模型通常很难直接处理表格数据并提供准确、有根据的答案。本文解决了表格数据的问答 (QA) 挑战，特别是在 SemEval-2025 任务 8 的背景下。我们提出了一个基于 LLM 的管道，可生成 SQL 查询以从表格数据集中提取答案。我们的系统利用上下文学习来生成查询，然后在结构化表上执行查询，以生成最终答案。我们证明我们的解决方案在几次设置中有效执行，并且可以在不同大小的桌子上很好地扩展。此外，我们还进行数据驱动的错误分析，以突出显示模型遇到困难的场景。我们在 https://github.com/fgiobergia/SemEval2025-Task8 提供代码。

title: Aestar atSemEval-2025 Task 8: AgenticLLMs for Question Answering over Tabular Data
abstract_en: Question Answering over Tabular Data (Table QA) presents unique challenges due to the diverse structure, size, and data types of real-world tables. The SemEval 2025 Task 8 (DataBench) introduced a benchmark composed of large-scale, domain-diverse datasets to evaluate the ability of models to accurately answer structured queries. We propose a Natural Language to SQL (NL-to-SQL) approach leveraging large language models (LLMs) such as GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, and DeepSeek v2:16b to generate SQL queries dynamically. Our system follows a multi-stage pipeline involving example selection, SQL query generation, answer extraction, verification, and iterative refinement. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, achieving 70.5% accuracy on DataBench QA and 71.6% on DataBench Lite QA, significantly surpassing baseline scores of 26% and 27% respectively. This paper details our methodology, experimental results, and alternative approaches, providing insights into the strengths and limitations of LLM-driven Table QA.
abstract_zh: 由于现实世界表的不同结构、大小和数据类型，表格数据问答（表 QA）提出了独特的挑战。 SemEval 2025 Task 8 (DataBench) 引入了由大规模、领域多样化数据集组成的基准，用于评估模型准确回答结构化查询的能力。我们提出了一种自然语言到 SQL (NL-to SQL) 方法，利用 GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini 和 DeepSeek v2:16b 等大型语言模型 (LLM) 动态生成 SQL 查询。我们的系统遵循多阶段管道，涉及示例选择、SQL 查询生成、答案提取、验证和迭代细化。实验证明了我们方法的有效性，在 DataBench QA 上实现了 70.5% 的准确率，在 DataBench Lite QA 上实现了 71.6% 的准确率，显着超过了分别为 26% 和 27% 的基线分数。本文详细介绍了我们的方法、实验结果和替代方法，深入了解 LLM 驱动的表 QA 的优点和局限性。

title: YNU-HPCCatSemEval-2025 Task 8: Enhancing Question-Answering over Tabular Data withTableGPT2
abstract_en: This paper describes our systems for SemEval 2025 Task8, Question Answering over Tabular Data. This task encourages us to develop a system that answers questions of the kind present in DataBench over day-to-day datasets, where the answer is either a number, a categorical value, a boolean value, or lists of several types. Participating in Task 8, we engage in all subtasks. The challenge lies in the multi-step reasoning process of converting natural language queries into executable code. This challenge is exacerbated by the limitations of current methods, such as chaining reasoning, which have difficulty handling complex multi-step reasoning paths due to difficulty evaluating intermediate steps. In the official ranking, we obtain a score of 65.64. On the final competition test set, our DataBench accuracy is 65.64%, and DataBench Lite accuracy is 66.62%. Both exceed the baseline (26%). The competitive results in two subtasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our systems.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们用于 SemEval 2025 Task8（表格数据问答）的系统。这项任务鼓励我们开发一个系统，可以回答 DataBench 中针对日常数据集出现的此类问题，其中答案可以是数字、分类值、布尔值或多种类型的列表。参与任务8，我们参与所有子任务。挑战在于将自然语言查询转换为可执行代码的多步骤推理过程。当前方法的局限性加剧了这一挑战，例如链接推理，由于难以评估中间步骤，因此难以处理复杂的多步骤推理路径。在官方排名中，我们获得了65.64分。在最终的竞赛测试集上，我们的DataBench准确率为65.64%，DataBench Lite准确率为66.62%。两者均超过基线（26%）。两个子任务的竞争结果证明了我们系统的有效性。

title: AlphaPro atSemEval-2025 Task 8: A Code Generation Approach for Question-Answering over Tabular Data
abstract_en: This work outlines the AlphaPro team’s solution to SemEval-2025 Task 8: Question Answering on Tabular Data. Our system utilizes a three-stage pipeline that uses natural language questions along with the table’s structural information to generate executable Python code, which is subsequently used to query the table and produce answers. The method achieves up to 67% accuracy in task data, demonstrating the feasibility of code generation for tabular question answering. The strengths and limitations of the approach are outlined and suggestions for further research are provided. The code has been made available in a public code repository to promote reproducibility and research in this area.
abstract_zh: 这项工作概述了 AlphaPro 团队对 SemEval-2025 任务 8：表格数据问答的解决方案。我们的系统采用三阶段管道，该管道使用自然语言问题以及表的结构信息来生成可执行的 Python 代码，随后用于查询表并生成答案。该方法在任务数据中实现了高达 67% 的准确率，证明了表格问答代码生成的可行性。概述了该方法的优点和局限性，并提供了进一步研究的建议。该代码已在公共代码存储库中提供，以促进该领域的可重复性和研究。

title: SemEval-2025 Task 8: Question Answering over Tabular Data
abstract_en: We introduce the findings and results of SemEval-2025 Task 8: Question Answering over Tabular Data. We featured two subtasks, DataBench and DataBench Lite. DataBench consists on question answering over tabular data, and DataBench Lite small comprising small datasets that might be easier to manage by current models by for example fitting them into a prompt. The task was open for any approach, but their answer has to conform to a required typing format. In this paper we present the task, analyze a number of system submissions and discuss the results. The results show how approaches leveraging LLMs dominated the task, with larger models exhibiting a considerably superior performance compared to small models.
abstract_zh: 我们介绍 SemEval-2025 任务 8：表格数据问答的发现和结果。我们有两个子任务：DataBench 和 DataBench Lite。 DataBench 包括对表格数据的问答，而 DataBench Lite 则包含小型数据集，这些数据集可能更容易通过当前模型进行管理，例如将它们放入提示中。该任务对任何方法都是开放的，但他们的答案必须符合所需的打字格式。在本文中，我们提出了任务，分析了一些系统提交并讨论了结果。结果表明，利用大语言模型的方法如何主导这项任务，与小型模型相比，较大的模型表现出相当优越的性能。

title: iTBLS: A Dataset of Interactive Conversations Over Tabular Information
abstract_en: This paper introduces Interactive Tables (iTBLS), a dataset of interactive conversations that focuses on natural-language manipulation of tabular information sourced from academic pre-prints on ArXiv. The iTBLS dataset consists of three types of tabular tasks – interpretation, modification, and generation. Interpretation focuses on tabular understanding, modification focuses on manipulating tabular information, and generation focuses on the addition of new natural-language evidence. In addition, the paper presents a novel framework that reformulates tabular operations as question-answering, where an appropriate question is formulated based on the nature of interaction and the question is answered using the user request as evidence. The developed approach results in an improvement on all tasks on a sequence-to-sequence modeling baseline on iTBLS. In addition, the question-answering-based reformulation is applied to datasets from prior work for the text-to-table task where textual paragraphs are summarized into tables. The novel approach results in up to 13% improvement in Exact-Match accuracy and up to 16% improvement in BERTScores compared to the prior state-of-the-art.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 Interactive Tables (iTBLS)，这是一个交互式对话数据集，专注于对来自 ArXiv 学术预印本的表格信息进行自然语言操作。 iTBLS 数据集由三种类型的表格任务组成：解释、修改和生成。解释侧重于表格理解，修改侧重于操纵表格信息，生成侧重于添加新的自然语言证据。此外，本文提出了一种新颖的框架，将表格操作重新表述为问答，其中根据交互的性质制定适当的问题，并使用用户请求作为证据来回答问题。所开发的方法改进了 iTBLS 上序列到序列建模基线的所有任务。此外，基于问答的重新表述适用于文本到表格任务的先前工作的数据集，其中文本段落被汇总到表格中。与之前最先进的技术相比，这种新颖的方法使精确匹配准确率提高了 13%，BERTScore 提高了 16%。

title: RITT: A Retrieval-Assisted Framework with Image and Text Table Representations for Table Question Answering
abstract_en: Tables can be represented either as text or as images. Previous works on table question answering (TQA) typically rely on only one representation, neglecting the potential benefits of combining both. In this work, we explore integrating textual and visual table representations using multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) for TQA. Specifically, we propose RITT, a retrieval-assisted framework that first identifies the most relevant part of a table for a given question, then dynamically selects the optimal table representations based on the question type. Experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms the baseline MLLMs by an average of 13 Exact Match and surpasses two text-only state-of-the-art TQA methods on four TQA benchmarks, highlighting the benefits of leveraging both textual and visual table representations.
abstract_zh: 表格可以表示为文本或图像。之前有关表格问答（TQA）的研究通常仅依赖于一种表示形式，而忽略了将两者结合起来的潜在好处。在这项工作中，我们探索使用用于 TQA 的多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 来集成文本和可视表表示。具体来说，我们提出了 RITT，一种检索辅助框架，它首先识别给定问题的表格中最相关的部分，然后根据问题类型动态选择最佳表格表示。实验表明，我们的框架平均显着优于基线 MLLM 13 个精确匹配，并且在四个 TQA 基准上超过了两种纯文本的最先进的 TQA 方法，凸显了利用文本和可视化表表示的好处。

title: Improving Table Retrieval with Question Generation from Partial Tables
abstract_en: Recent advances in open-domain question answering over tables have widely adopted large language models (LLMs) under the Retriever-Reader architecture. Prior works have effectively leveraged LLMs to tackle the complex reasoning demands of the Reader component, such as text-to-text, text-to-SQL, and multi-hop reasoning. In contrast, the Retriever component has primarily focused on optimizing the query representation—training retrievers to retrieve relevant tables based on questions, or to select keywords from questions for matching table segments. However, little attention has been given to enhancing how tables themselves are represented in embedding space to better align with questions. To address this, we propose QGpT (Question Generation from Partial Tables), a simple yet effective method that uses an LLM to generate synthetic questions based on small portions of a table. These questions are generated to simulate how a user might query the content of the table currently under consideration. The generated questions are then jointly embedded with the partial table segments used for generation, enhancing semantic alignment with user queries. Without the need to embed entire tables, our method significantly improves retrieval performance across multiple benchmarks for both dense and late-interaction retrievers.
abstract_zh:
表格开放域问答的最新进展已广泛采用 Retriever-Reader 架构下的大型语言模型 (LLM)。之前的工作有效地利用了 LLM 来解决 Reader 组件的复杂推理需求，例如文本到文本、文本到 SQL 和多跳推理。相比之下，检索器组件主要专注于优化查询表示——训练检索器根据问题检索相关表，或者从问题中选择关键字来匹配表段。然而，很少有人关注如何增强表格本身在嵌入空间中的表示方式，以更好地与问题保持一致。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 QGpT（从部分表生成问题），这是一种简单而有效的方法，它使用 LLM 根据表的一小部分生成综合问题。生成这些问题是为了模拟用户如何查询当前正在考虑的表的内容。然后，生成的问题与用于生成的部分表段联合嵌入，增强与用户查询的语义对齐。无需嵌入整个表，我们的方法显着提高了密集检索器和后期交互检索器的多个基准的检索性能。

## 阅读理解 (16 篇)

title: Contrastive Perplexity for Controlled Generation: An Application in Detoxifying Large Language Models
abstract_en: The generation of toxic content by large language models (LLMs) remains a critical challenge for the safe deployment of language technology. We propose a novel framework for implicit knowledge editing and controlled text generation by fine-tuning LLMs with a prototype-based contrastive perplexity objective. Central to our method is the construction of hard negatives—toxic outputs that are generated through adversarial paraphrasing to be semantically similar and model probability to their non-toxic counterparts. By training on these challenging and realistic pairs, our approach ensures robust and stable contrastive optimization. Experimental results in the domain of detoxification demonstrate that our method significantly reduces toxic generation while maintaining strong performance on downstream tasks such as commonsense reasoning and reading comprehension. Our findings highlight the effectiveness of exploiting hard negatives for attribute-aware fine-tuning.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 生成的有毒内容仍然是语言技术安全部署的关键挑战。我们通过使用基于原型的对比困惑度目标对大语言模型进行微调，提出了一种用于隐式知识编辑和受控文本生成的新颖框架。我们方法的核心是构建硬负例——通过对抗性释义生成的有毒输出，使其在语义上与无毒对应物相似并建模概率。通过对这些具有挑战性和现实性的对进行训练，我们的方法确保了稳健且稳定的对比优化。解毒领域的实验结果表明，我们的方法显着减少了有毒物质的产生，同时在常识推理和阅读理解等下游任务上保持了良好的性能。我们的研究结果强调了利用硬负例进行属性感知微调的有效性。

title: VMLUBenchmarks: A comprehensive benchmark toolkit forVietnameseLLMs
abstract_en: The evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) has underscored the necessity for benchmarks designed for various languages and cultural contexts. To address this need for Vietnamese, we present the first Vietnamese Multitask Language Understanding (VMLU) Benchmarks. The VMLU benchmarks consist of four datasets that assess different capabilities of LLMs, including general knowledge, reading comprehension, reasoning, and conversational skills. This paper also provides an insightful overview of the current state of some dominant LLMs, such as Llama-3, Qwen2.5, and GPT-4, highlighting their performances and limitations when measured against these benchmarks. Furthermore, we provide insights into how prompt design can influence VMLU’s evaluation outcomes, as well as suggest that open-source LLMs can serve as effective, cost-efficient evaluators within the Vietnamese context. By offering a comprehensive and accessible benchmarking framework, the VMLU Benchmarks aim to foster the development and fine-tuning of Vietnamese LLMs, thereby establishing a foundation for their practical applications in language-specific domains.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 的发展强调了为各种语言和文化背景设计基准的必要性。为了满足越南语的这一需求，我们推出了第一个越南语多任务语言理解 (VMLU) 基准。 VMLU 基准由四个数据集组成，用于评估大语言模型的不同能力，包括常识、阅读理解、推理和会话技能。本文还对一些主流大语言模型（例如 Llama-3、Qwen2.5 和 GPT-4）的现状进行了深入的概述，强调了根据这些基准进行衡量时它们的性能和局限性。此外，我们还深入探讨了即时设计如何影响 VMLU 的评估结果，并建议开源大语言模型可以在越南背景下充当有效、具有成本效益的评估者。通过提供全面且易于使用的基准测试框架，VMLU 基准测试旨在促进越南大语言模型的发展和微调，从而为其在特定语言领域的实际应用奠定基础。

title: Evaluating Multimodal Language Models as Visual Assistants for Visually Impaired Users
abstract_en: This paper explores the effectiveness of Multimodal Large Language models (MLLMs) as assistive technologies for visually impaired individuals. We conduct a user survey to identify adoption patterns and key challenges users face with such technologies. Despite a high adoption rate of these models, our findings highlight concerns related to contextual understanding, cultural sensitivity, and complex scene understanding, particularly for individuals who may rely solely on them for visual interpretation. Informed by these results, we collate five user-centred tasks with image and video inputs, including a novel task on Optical Braille Recognition. Our systematic evaluation of twelve MLLMs reveals that further advancements are necessary to overcome limitations related to cultural context, multilingual support, Braille reading comprehension, assistive object recognition, and hallucinations. This work provides critical insights into the future direction of multimodal AI for accessibility, underscoring the need for more inclusive, robust, and trustworthy visual assistance technologies.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）作为视障人士辅助技术的有效性。我们进行用户调查，以确定用户使用此类技术的模式和面临的主要挑战。尽管这些模型的采用率很高，但我们的研究结果强调了与情境理解、文化敏感性和复杂场景理解相关的担忧，特别是对于可能仅依赖它们进行视觉解释的个人而言。根据这些结果，我们将五个以用户为中心的任务与图像和视频输入进行了比较，其中包括一项关于光学盲文识别的新颖任务。我们对 12 个 MLLM 的系统评估表明，需要进一步的进步来克服与文化背景、多语言支持、盲文阅读理解、辅助物体识别和幻觉相关的限制。这项工作为多模式人工智能无障碍的未来方向提供了重要的见解，强调了对更具包容性、强大和值得信赖的视觉辅助技术的需求。

title: DocSpiral: A Platform for Integrated Assistive Document Annotation through Human-in-the-Spiral
abstract_en: Acquiring structured data from domain-specific, image-based documents—such as scanned reports—is crucial for many downstream tasks but remains challenging due to document variability. Many of these documents exist as images rather than as machine-readable text, which requires human annotation to train automated extraction systems.We presentDocSpiral, the first Human-in-the-Spiral assistive document annotation platform, designed to address the challenge of extracting structured information from domain-specific, image-based document collections.Our spiral design establishes an iterative cycle in which human annotations train models that progressively require less manual intervention.DocSpiralintegrates document format normalization, comprehensive annotation interfaces, evaluation metrics dashboard, and API endpoints for the development of AI / ML models into a unified workflow.Experiments demonstrate that our framework reduces annotation time by at least 41% while showing consistent performance gains across three iterations during model training.By making this annotation platform freely accessible, we aim to lower barriers to AI/ML models development in document processing, facilitating the adoption of large language models in image-based, document-intensive fields such as geoscience and healthcare. The system is freely available at:https://app.ai4wa.com. The demonstration video is available:https://app.ai4wa.com/docs/docspiral/demo.
abstract_zh: 从特定领域的基于图像的文档（例如扫描报告）获取结构化数据对于许多下游任务至关重要，但由于文档的可变性，仍然具有挑战性。其中许多文档以图像而不是机器可读的文本形式存在，这需要人工注释来训练自动提取系统。我们推出了 DocSpiral，第一个 Human-in-the-Spiral 辅助文档注释平台，旨在解决从特定领域、基于图像的文档集合中提取结构化信息的挑战。我们的螺旋设计建立了一个迭代循环，其中人工注释训练模型逐渐需要更少的手动干预。DocSpiral 集成了文档格式规范化、综合注释接口、评估指标仪表板和 API 端点将 AI / ML 模型开发为统一的工作流程。实验表明，我们的框架将注释时间减少了至少 41％，同时在模型训练期间的三个迭代中显示出一致的性能增益。通过使该注释平台可免费访问，我们的目标是降低文档处理中 AI / ML 模型开发的障碍，促进大型语言模型在基于图像的文档密集型领域（例如地球科学和医疗保健）的采用。该系统可在以下网址免费获取：https://app.ai4wa.com。演示视频可见：https://app.ai4wa.com/docs/docspiral/demo。

title: GeneratingOpenAPISpecifications from OnlineAPIDocumentation with Large Language Models
abstract_en: AI agents and business automation tools interacting with external web services require standardized, machine-readable information about their APIs in the form of API specifications. However, the information about APIs available online is often presented as unstructured, free-form HTML documentation, requiring external users to spend significant time manually converting it into a structured format. To address this, we introduce , a novel framework that transforms long and diverse API documentation pages into consistent, machine-readable API specifications. This is achieved through a carefully crafted pipeline that integrates large language models and rule-based algorithms which are guided by domain knowledge of the structure of documentation webpages. Our experiments demonstrate that generalizes well across hundreds of APIs, and produces valid OpenAPI specifications that encapsulate most of the information from the original documentation. has been successfully implemented in an enterprise environment, saving thousands of hours of manual effort and making hundreds of complex enterprise APIs accessible as tools for LLMs.
abstract_zh: 与外部 Web 服务交互的 AI 代理和业务自动化工具需要以 API 规范的形式提供有关其 API 的标准化、机器可读的信息。然而，有关在线可用 API 的信息通常以非结构化、自由格式的 HTML 文档的形式呈现，需要外部用户花费大量时间手动将其转换为结构化格式。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一个新颖的框架，它将冗长且多样化的 API 文档页面转换为一致的、机器可读的 API 规范。这是通过精心设计的管道实现的，该管道集成了大型语言模型和基于规则的算法，这些算法由文档网页结构的领域知识指导。我们的实验表明，它可以很好地推广到数百个 API，并生成有效的 OpenAPI 规范，其中封装了原始文档中的大部分信息。已在企业环境中成功实施，节省了数千小时的手动工作，并使数百个复杂的企业 API 可作为大语言模型的工具进行访问。

title: HICD: Hallucination-Inducing via Attention Dispersion for Contrastive Decoding to Mitigate Hallucinations in Large Language Models
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) often generate hallucinations, producing outputs that are contextually inaccurate or factually incorrect. We introduce HICD, a novel method designed to induce hallucinations for contrastive decoding to mitigate hallucinations. Unlike existing contrastive decoding methods, HICD selects attention heads crucial to the model’s prediction as inducing heads, then induces hallucinations by dispersing attention of these inducing heads and compares the hallucinated outputs with the original outputs to obtain the final result. Our approach significantly improves performance on tasks requiring contextual faithfulness, such as context completion, reading comprehension, and question answering. It also improves factuality in tasks requiring accurate knowledge recall. We demonstrate that our inducing heads selection and attention dispersion method leads to more “contrast-effective” hallucinations for contrastive decoding, outperforming other hallucination-inducing methods. Our findings provide a promising strategy for reducing hallucinations by inducing hallucinations in a controlled manner, enhancing the performance of LLMs in a wide range of tasks.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 经常会产生幻觉，产生上下文不准确或事实上不正确的输出。我们介绍 HICD，这是一种旨在诱发幻觉的新颖方法，通过对比解码来减轻幻觉。与现有的对比解码方法不同，HICD选择对模型预测至关重要的注意力头作为诱导头，然后通过分散这些诱导头的注意力来诱发幻觉，并将幻觉输出与原始输出进行比较以获得最终结果。我们的方法显着提高了需要上下文忠实度的任务的性能，例如上下文完成、阅读理解和问题回答。它还提高了需要准确回忆知识的任务的真实性。我们证明，我们的诱导头选择和注意力分散方法会导致对比解码产生更多“对比有效”的幻觉，优于其他幻觉诱导方法。我们的研究结果提供了一种有前景的策略，通过以受控方式诱发幻觉来减少幻觉，从而提高大语言模型在各种任务中的表现。

title: 2M-BELEBELE: Highly Multilingual Speech andAmericanSignLanguage Comprehension Dataset DownloadPDF
abstract_en: We introduce the first highly multilingual speech and American Sign Language (ASL) comprehension dataset by extending BELEBELE. Our dataset covers 91 spoken languages at the intersection of BELEBELE and FLEURS, and one sign language (ASL). As a by-product we also extend the Automatic Speech Recognition Benchmark, FLEURS, by 20%. We evaluate 2M-BELEBELE dataset for both 5-shot and zero-shot settings and across languages, the speech comprehension accuracy is ≈ 10% average lower compared to reading comprehension.
abstract_zh: 我们通过扩展 BELEBELE 引入了第一个高度多语言语音和美国手语 (ASL) 理解数据集。我们的数据集涵盖 BELEBELE 和 FLEURS 交叉点的 91 种口语以及一种手语 (ASL)。作为副产品，我们还将自动语音识别基准 FLEURS 扩展了 20%。我们针对 5-shot 和 0-shot 设置以及跨语言评估 2M-BELEBELE 数据集，与阅读理解相比，语音理解准确率平均低约 10%。

title: Y-NQ:English-Yorùbá Evaluation dataset for Open-Book Reading Comprehension with Open-Ended Questions
abstract_en: The purpose of this work is to share an English-Yorùbá evaluation dataset for openbook reading comprehension with open-ended questions to assess the performance of models both in a high- and a low-resource language. The dataset contains 358 questions and answers on 338 English documents and 208 Yorùbá documents. Experiments show a consistent disparity in performance between the two languages, with Yorùbá falling behind English for automatic metrics even if documents are much shorter for this language. For a small set of documents with comparable length, performance of Yorùbá drops by 2.5 times and this comparison is validated with humanevaluation. When analyzing performance by length, we observe that Yorùbá decreases performance dramatically for documents that reach 1500 words while English performance is barely affected at that length. Our dataset opens the door to showcasing if English LLM reading comprehension capabilities extend to Yorùbá, which for the evaluated LLMs is not the case.
abstract_zh: 这项工作的目的是共享一个用于开放式阅读理解的英语-约鲁巴语评估数据集，其中包含开放式问题，以评估高资源语言和低资源语言模型的性能。该数据集包含 338 个英语文档和 208 个约鲁巴语文档的 358 个问题和答案。实验表明，两种语言之间的性能始终存在差异，约鲁巴语在自动指标方面落后于英语，即使这种语言的文档要短得多。对于长度相当的一小组文档，Yorùbá 的性能下降了 2.5 倍，并且这种比较通过人性化评估得到了验证。在按长度分析性能时，我们发现约鲁巴语会显着降低达到 1500 个单词的文档的性能，而英语性能在该长度上几乎没有受到影响。我们的数据集打开了展示英语 LLM 阅读理解能力是否扩展到约鲁巴语的大门，但对于评估的 LLM 来说并非如此。

title: DoLLMs Give Psychometrically Plausible Responses in Educational Assessments?
abstract_en: Knowing how test takers answer items in educational assessments is essential for test development, to evaluate item quality, and to improve test validity. However, this process usually requires extensive pilot studies with human participants. If large language models (LLMs) exhibit human-like response behavior to test items, this could open up the possibility of using them as pilot participants to accelerate test development. In this paper, we evaluate the human-likeness or psychometric plausibility of responses from 18 instruction-tuned LLMs with two publicly available datasets of multiple-choice test items across three subjects: reading, U.S. history, and economics. Our methodology builds on two theoretical frameworks from psychometrics which are commonly used in educational assessment, classical test theory and item response theory. The results show that while larger models are excessively confident, their response distributions can be more human-like when calibrated with temperature scaling. In addition, we find that LLMs tend to correlate better with humans in reading comprehension items compared to other subjects. However, the correlations are not very strong overall, indicating that LLMs should not be used for piloting educational assessments in a zero-shot setting.
abstract_zh: 了解考生如何回答教育评估中的项目对于测试开发、评估项目质量和提高测试有效性至关重要。然而，这个过程通常需要对人类参与者进行广泛的试点研究。如果大型语言模型 (LLM) 对测试项目表现出类似人类的响应行为，则可能会开启使用它们作为试点参与者来加速测试开发的可能性。在本文中，我们使用两个公开的数据集评估了 18 名经过指令调整的大语言模型的反应的人类相似性或心理测量合理性，这些数据集涉及三个科目：阅读、美国历史和经济学。我们的方法建立在教育评估中常用的心理测量学的两个理论框架之上：经典测试理论和项目反应理论。结果表明，虽然较大的模型过于自信，但在使用温度缩放进行校准时，它们的响应分布可能更像人类。此外，我们发现与其他科目相比，大语言模型在阅读理解项目上往往与人类更好地相关。然而，整体相关性并不是很强，这表明大语言模型不应该用于在零样本环境中试点教育评估。

title: Automatic Generation of Inference Making Questions for Reading Comprehension Assessments
abstract_en: Inference making is an essential but complex skill in reading comprehension (RC). Some inferences require resolving references across sentences, and some rely on using prior knowledge to fill in the detail that is not explicitly written in the text. Diagnostic RC questions can help educators provide more effective and targeted reading instruction and interventions for school-age students. We introduce a taxonomy of inference types for RC and use it to analyze the distribution of items within a diagnostic RC item bank. Next, we present experiments using GPT-4o to generate bridging-inference RC items for given reading passages via few-shot prompting, comparing conditions with and without chain-of-thought prompts. Generated items were evaluated on three aspects: overall item quality, appropriate inference type, and LLM reasoning, achieving high inter-rater agreements above 0.90. Our results show that GPT-4o produced 93.8% good-quality questions suitable for operational use in grade 3-12 contexts; however, only 42.6% of the generated questions accurately matched the targeted inference type. We conclude that combining automatic item generation with human judgment offers a promising path toward scalable, high-quality diagnostic RC assessments.
abstract_zh: 推理是阅读理解（RC）中一项重要但复杂的技能。有些推论需要解决跨句子的引用，有些则依赖于使用先验知识来填充文本中未明确写入的细节。诊断 RC 问题可以帮助教育工作者为学龄学生提供更有效、更有针对性的阅读指导和干预措施。我们引入了 RC 推理类型的分类法，并用它来分析诊断 RC 项目库中项目的分布。接下来，我们展示了使用 GPT-4o 通过几次提示生成给定阅读段落的桥接推理 RC 项目的实验，比较有和没有思维链提示的条件。生成的项目从三个方面进行评估：整体项目质量、适当的推理类型和 LLM 推理，实现了 0.90 以上的高评估者间一致性。我们的结果表明，GPT-4o 生成了 93.8% 适合 3-12 年级环境中操作使用的高质量问题；然而，生成的问题中只有 42.6% 与目标推理类型准确匹配。我们的结论是，将自动项目生成与人类判断相结合，为可扩展、高质量的诊断 RC 评估提供了一条有希望的道路。

title: From End-Users to Co-Designers: Lessons from Teachers
abstract_en: This study presents a teacher-centered evaluation of an AI-powered reading comprehension tool, developed to support learners with language-based difficulties. Drawing on the Social Acceptance of Technology (SAT) framework, we investigate not only technical usability but also the pedagogical, ethical, and contextual dimensions of AI integration in classrooms. We explore how teachers perceive the platform’s alignment with inclusive pedagogies, instructional workflows, and professional values through a mixed-methods approach, including questionnaires and focus groups with educators. Findings a shift from initial curiosity to critical, practice-informed reflection, with trust, transparency, and adaptability emerging as central concerns. The study contributes a replicable evaluation framework and highlights the importance of engaging teachers as co-designers in the development of educational technologies.
abstract_zh: 这项研究提出了以教师为中心的人工智能阅读理解工具评估，该工具旨在为有语言困难的学习者提供支持。借鉴技术的社会接受度 (SAT) 框架，我们不仅研究技术可用性，还研究人工智能在课堂中集成的教学、道德和情境维度。我们通过混合方法（包括问卷调查和教育工作者焦点小组）探索教师如何看待该平台与包容性教学法、教学工作流程和专业价值观的一致性。发现从最初的好奇心到批判性的、基于实践的反思的转变，信任、透明度和适应性成为中心问题。该研究提供了一个可复制的评估框架，并强调了让教师作为共同设计师参与教育技术开发的重要性。

title: Beyond Linear Digital Reading: AnLLM-Powered Concept Mapping Approach for Reducing Cognitive Load
abstract_en: This paper presents an LLM-powered approach for generating concept maps to enhance digital reading comprehension in higher education. While particularly focused on supporting neurodivergent students with their distinct information processing patterns, this approach benefits all learners facing the cognitive challenges of digital text. We use GPT-4o-mini to extract concepts and relationships from educational texts across ten diverse disciplines using open-domain prompts without predefined categories or relation types, enabling discipline-agnostic extraction. Section-level processing achieved higher precision (83.62%) in concept extraction, while paragraph-level processing demonstrated superior recall (74.51%) in identifying educationally relevant concepts. We implemented an interactive web-based visualization tool https://simplified-cognitext.streamlit.app that transforms extracted concepts into navigable concept maps. User evaluation (n=14) showed that participants experienced a 31.5% reduction in perceived cognitive load when using concept maps, despite spending more time with the visualization (22.6% increase). They also completed comprehension assessments more efficiently (14.1% faster) with comparable accuracy. This work demonstrates that LLM-based concept mapping can significantly reduce cognitive demands while supporting non-linear exploration.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种由大语言模型支持的方法，用于生成概念图，以增强高等教育中的数字阅读理解能力。虽然特别注重支持具有独特信息处理模式的神经分歧学生，但这种方法有利于所有面临数字文本认知挑战的学习者。我们使用 GPT-4o-mini 使用开放域提示从十个不同学科的教育文本中提取概念和关系，无需预定义类别或关系类型，从而实现与学科无关的提取。章节级处理在概念提取方面实现了更高的精确度（83.62%），而段落级处理在识别教育相关概念方面表现出出色的召回率（74.51%）。我们实现了一个基于网络的交互式可视化工具 https://simplified-cognitext.streamlit.app，它将提取的概念转换为可导航的概念图。用户评估 (n=14) 显示，尽管参与者在可视化上花费了更多时间（增加了 22.6%），但使用概念图时，参与者的感知认知负荷减少了 31.5%。他们还以相当的准确度更高效地完成了理解评估（快了 14.1%）。这项工作表明，基于大语言模型的概念图可以显着降低认知需求，同时支持非线性探索。

title: CanLLMs Reliably Simulate Real Students’ Abilities in Mathematics and Reading Comprehension?
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as proxy students in the development of Intelligent Tutoring Systems (ITSs) and in piloting test questions. However, to what extent these proxy students accurately emulate the behavior and characteristics of real students remains an open question. To investigate this, we collected a dataset of 489 items from the National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP), covering mathematics and reading comprehension in grades 4, 8, and 12. We then apply an Item Response Theory (IRT) model to position 11 diverse and state-of-the-art LLMs on the same ability scale as real student populations. Our findings reveal that, without guidance, strong general-purpose models consistently outperform the average student at every grade, while weaker or domain-mismatched models may align incidentally. Using grade-enforcement prompts changes models’ performance, but whether they align with the average grade-level student remains highly model- and prompt-specific: no evaluated model–prompt pair fits the bill across subjects and grades, underscoring the need for new training and evaluation strategies. We conclude by providing guidelines for the selection of viable proxies based on our findings. All related code and data have been made available (https://github.com/kvadityasrivatsa/IRT-for-LLMs-as-Students).
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地用作学生的代理，用于开发智能辅导系统 (ITS) 和试题。然而，这些代理学生在多大程度上准确模仿真实学生的行为和特征仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。为了调查这一问题，我们从国家教育进步评估 (NAEP) 中收集了包含 489 个项目的数据集，涵盖 4、8 和 12 年级的数学和阅读理解。然后，我们应用项目反应理论 (IRT) 模型将 11 名多样化且最先进的大语言模型置于与真实学生群体相同的能力量表上。我们的研究结果表明，在没有指导的情况下，强大的通用模型在每个年级的表现始终优于普通学生，而较弱或领域不匹配的模型可能会偶然对齐。使用成绩强制提示会改变模型的表现，但它们是否与学生的平均年级水平保持一致仍然是高度特定于模型和提示的：没有经过评估的模型 - 提示对适合跨学科和年级的要求，这强调了新的培训和评估策略的需要。最后，我们根据我们的发现提供了选择可行代理的指南。所有相关代码和数据均已提供（https://github.com/kvadityasrivatsa/IRT-for-LLMs-as-Students）。

title: RadQA-DPO: A Radiology Question Answering System with Encoder-Decoder Models Enhanced by Direct Preference Optimization
abstract_en: Extractive question answering over clinical text is a crucial need to help deal with the deluge of clinical text generated in hospitals. While encoder models (e.g., BERT) have been popular for this reading comprehension–style question answering task, recently encoder-decoder models (e.g., T5) are on the rise. There is also the emergence of preference optimization techniques to align decoder-only LLMs with human preferences. In this paper, we combine encoder-decoder models with the direct preference optimization (DPO) method for the RadQA radiology question answering task. Our approach achieves a 12–15 F1 point improvement over previous state-of-the-art models. To the best of our knowledge, this effort is the first to show that DPO method also works for reading comprehension via novel heuristics to generate preference data without human inputs.
abstract_zh: 对临床文本进行提取式问答是帮助处理医院生成的大量临床文本的关键需求。虽然编码器模型（例如 BERT）在这种阅读理解式问答任务中很受欢迎，但最近编码器-解码器模型（例如 T5）正在兴起。还出现了偏好优化技术，使仅解码器的 LLM 与人类偏好保持一致。在本文中，我们将编码器-解码器模型与直接偏好优化（DPO）方法结合起来用于 RadQA 放射学问答任务。与之前最先进的模型相比，我们的方法实现了 12-15 F1 点的改进。据我们所知，这项工作首次表明 DPO 方法也适用于通过新颖的启发式方法进行阅读理解，无需人工输入即可生成偏好数据。

title: NCL-UoRatSemEval-2025 Task 3: Detecting Multilingual Hallucination and Related Observable Overgeneration Text Spans with ModifiedRefChecker and ModifiedSelfCheckGPT
abstract_en: SemEval-2025 Task 3 (Mu-SHROOM) focuses on detecting hallucinations in content generated by various large language models (LLMs) across multiple languages. This task involves not only identifying the presence of hallucinations but also pinpointing their specific occurrences. To tackle this challenge, this study introduces two methods: Modified-RefChecker (MRC) and Modified-SelfCheckGPT-H (MSCGH). MRC integrates prompt-based factual verification into References, structuring them as claim-based tests rather than single external knowledge sources. MSCGH incorporates external knowledge to overcome its reliance on internal knowledge. In addition, both methods’ original prompt designs are enhanced to identify hallucinated words within LLM-generated texts. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach, achieving a high ranking on the test dataset in detecting hallucinations across various languages, with an average IoU of 0.5310 and an average COR of 0.5669. The source code used in this paper is available athttps://github.com/jianfeixu95/NCL-UoR.
abstract_zh: SemEval-2025 任务 3 (Mu-SHROOM) 重点检测跨多种语言的各种大型语言模型 (LLM) 生成的内容中的幻觉。这项任务不仅涉及识别幻觉的存在，还涉及查明其具体发生情况。为了应对这一挑战，本研究引入了两种方法：Modified-RefChecker (MRC) 和 Modified-SelfCheckGPT-H (MSCGH)。 MRC 将基于提示的事实验证集成到参考文献中，将其构建为基于声明的测试，而不是单一的外部知识源。 MSCGH 结合外部知识来克服对内部知识的依赖。此外，这两种方法的原始提示设计都得到了增强，可以识别大语言模型生成的文本中的幻觉单词。实验结果证明了该方法的有效性，在跨语言幻觉检测的测试数据集上取得了较高的排名，平均 IoU 为 0.5310，平均 COR 为 0.5669。本文使用的源代码可以在https://github.com/jianfeixu95/NCL-UoR获取。

title: YNU-HPCCatSemEval-2025 Task 6: UsingBERTModel withR-drop for Promise Verification
abstract_en: This paper presents our participation in the SemEval-2025 task 6: multinational, multilingual, multi-industry promise verification. The SemEval-2025 Task 6 aims to extract Promise Identification, Supporting Evidence, Clarity of the Promise-Evidence Pair, and Timing for Verification from the commitments made to businesses and governments. Use these data to verify whether companies and governments have fulfilled their commitments. In this task, we participated in the English task, whichincluded analysis of numbers in the text, reading comprehension of the text content and multi-label classification. Our model introduces regularization dropout based on Bert-base to focus on the stability of non-target classes, improve the robustness of the model, and ultimately improve the indicators. Our approach obtained competitive results in subtasks.
abstract_zh:
本文介绍了我们参与的 SemEval-2025 任务 6：跨国、多语言、多行业承诺验证。 SemEval-2025 任务 6 旨在从向企业和政府做出的承诺中提取承诺识别、支持证据、承诺-证据对的清晰度以及验证时机。利用这些数据来验证企业和政府是否履行了承诺。在这个任务中，我们参与了英语任务，其中包括文本中数字的分析、文本内容的阅读理解和多标签分类。我们的模型引入了基于Bert-base的正则化dropout来关注非目标类的稳定性，提高模型的鲁棒性，最终提高指标。我们的方法在子任务中获得了有竞争力的结果。

## 作文评分 (11 篇)

title: DREsS: Dataset for Rubric-based Essay Scoring onEFLWriting
abstract_en: Automated essay scoring (AES) is a useful tool in English as a Foreign Language (EFL) writing education, offering real-time essay scores for students and instructors. However, previous AES models were trained on essays and scores irrelevant to the practical scenarios of EFL writing education and usually provided a single holistic score due to the lack of appropriate datasets. In this paper, we release DREsS, a large-scale, standard dataset for rubric-based automated essay scoring with 48.9K samples in total. DREsS comprises three sub-datasets: DREsS_New, DREsS_Std., and DREsS_CASE. We collect DREsS_New, a real-classroom dataset with 2.3K essays authored by EFL undergraduate students and scored by English education experts. We also standardize existing rubric-based essay scoring datasets as DREsS_Std. We suggest CASE, a corruption-based augmentation strategy for essays, which generates 40.1K synthetic samples of DREsS_CASE and improves the baseline results by 45.44%. DREsS will enable further research to provide a more accurate and practical AES system for EFL writing education.
abstract_zh: 自动论文评分 (AES) 是英语作为外语 (EFL) 写作教育中的一个有用工具，可为学生和教师提供实时论文评分。然而，以前的 AES 模型是根据与 EFL 写作教育实际场景无关的论文和分数进行训练的，并且由于缺乏适当的数据集，通常提供单一的整体分数。在本文中，我们发布了 DREsS，这是一个基于评分标准的自动化论文评分的大规模标准数据集，共有 48.9K 个样本。 DREsS 包含三个子数据集：DREsS_New、DREsS_Std. 和 DREsS_CASE。我们收集了 DREsS_New，这是一个真实的课堂数据集，包含 2.3K 篇由 EFL 本科生撰写并由英语教育专家评分的论文。我们还将现有的基于评分标准的论文评分数据集标准化为 DREsS_Std。我们建议使用 CASE，一种基于损坏的论文增强策略，它生成 40.1K 个 DREsS_CASE 合成样本，并将基线结果提高了 45.44%。 DREsS 将使进一步的研究成为可能，为 EFL 写作教育提供更准确、更实用的 AES 系统。

title: Mixture of Ordered Scoring Experts for Cross-prompt Essay Trait Scoring
abstract_en: Automated Essay Scoring (AES) plays a crucial role in language assessment. In particular, cross-prompt essay trait scoring provides learners with valuable feedback to improve their writing skills. However, due to the scarcity of prompts, most existing methods overlook critical information, such as content from prompts or essays, resulting in incomplete assessment perspectives. In this paper, we propose a robust AES framework, the Mixture of Ordered Scoring Experts (MOOSE), which integrates information from both prompts and essays. MOOSE employs three specialized experts to evaluate (1) the overall quality of an essay, (2) the relative quality across multiple essays, and (3) the relevance between an essay and its prompt. MOOSE introduces the ordered aggregation of assessment results from these experts along with effective feature learning techniques. Experimental results demonstrate that MOOSE achieves exceptionally stable and state-of-the-art performance in both cross-prompt scoring and multi-trait scoring on the ASAP++ dataset. The source code is released at https://github.com/antslabtw/MOOSE-AES.
abstract_zh: 自动作文评分（AES）在语言评估中发挥着至关重要的作用。特别是，交叉提示论文特征评分为学习者提供了宝贵的反馈，以提高他们的写作技能。然而，由于提示的缺乏，大多数现有方法都忽略了关键信息，例如提示或论文中的内容，导致评估视角不完整。在本文中，我们提出了一个强大的 AES 框架，即有序评分专家混合 (MOOSE)，它集成了提示和论文中的信息。 MOOSE 聘请了三位专业专家来评估 (1) 一篇论文的整体质量，(2) 多篇论文的相对质量，以及 (3) 一篇论文与其提示之间的相关性。 MOOSE 引入了这些专家的评估结果的有序聚合以及有效的特征学习技术。实验结果表明，MOOSE 在 ASAP++ 数据集上的交叉提示评分和多特征评分方面均取得了异常稳定和最先进的性能。源代码发布于 https://github.com/antslabtw/MOOSE-AES。

title: Beyond the Gold Standard in Analytic Automated Essay Scoring
abstract_en: Originally developed to reduce the manual burden of grading standardised language tests, Automated Essay Scoring (AES) research has long focused on holistic scoring methods which offer minimal formative feedback in the classroom. With the increasing demand for technological tools that support language acquisition, the field is turning to analytic AES (evaluating essays according to different linguistic traits). This approach holds promise for generating more detailed essay feedback, but relies on analytic scoring data that is both more cognitively demanding for humans to produce, and prone to bias. The dominant paradigm in AES is to aggregate disagreements between raters into a single gold-standard label, which fails to account for genuine examiner variability. In an attempt to make AES more representative and trustworthy, we propose to explore the sources of disagreements and lay out a novel AES system design that learns from individual raters instead of the gold standard labels.
abstract_zh: 自动作文评分 (AES) 研究最初是为了减轻标准化语言测试评分的人工负担而开发的，长期以来一直专注于在课堂上提供最少形成性反馈的整体评分方法。随着对支持语言习得的技术工具的需求不断增加，该领域正在转向分析 AES（根据不同的语言特征评估论文）。这种方法有望生成更详细的论文反馈，但依赖于分析评分数据，这些数据对人类产生的认知要求更高，而且容易产生偏见。 AES 的主导范式是将评估者之间的分歧汇总到一个单一的黄金标准标签中，这无法考虑真正的审查者差异。为了使 AES 更具代表性和可信度，我们建议探索分歧的根源，并提出一种新颖的 AES 系统设计，该设计向个体评估者而不是黄金标准标签学习。

title: Enhancing Marker Scoring Accuracy through Ordinal Confidence Modelling in Educational Assessments
abstract_en: A key ethical challenge in Automated Essay Scoring (AES) is ensuring that scores are only released when they meet high reliability standards. Confidence modelling addresses this by assigning a reliability estimate measure, in the form of a confidence score, to each automated score. In this study, we frame confidence estimation as a classification task: predicting whether an AES-generated score correctly places a candidate in the appropriate CEFR level. While this is a binary decision, we leverage the inherent granularity of the scoring domain in two ways. First, we reformulate the task as ann-ary classification problem using score binning. Second, we introduce a set of novel Kernel Weighted Ordinal Categorical Cross Entropy (KWOCCE) loss functions that incorporate the ordinal structure of CEFR labels. Our best-performing model achieves an F1 score of 0.97, and enables the system to release 47% of scores with 100% CEFR agreement and 99% with at least 95% CEFR agreement — compared to ≈ 92 % CEFR agreement from the standalone AES model where we release all AM predicted scores.
abstract_zh: 自动作文评分 (AES) 的一个关键道德挑战是确保分数仅在满足高可靠性标准时才发布。置信度建模通过将置信度分数形式的可靠性估计度量分配给每个自动分数来解决这个问题。在本研究中，我们将置信度估计视为一项分类任务：预测 AES 生成的分数是否正确地将候选人置于适当的 CEFR 级别。虽然这是一个二元决策，但我们通过两种方式利用评分域的固有粒度。首先，我们使用分数分箱将任务重新表述为年分类问题。其次，我们介绍了一组新颖的内核加权序数分类交叉熵 (KWOCCE) 损失函数，其中包含 CEFR 标签的序数结构。我们性能最佳的模型达到了 0.97 的 F1 分数，使系统能够发布 47% 的分数与 100% CEFR 一致，99% 的分数与至少 95% CEFR 一致 — 相比之下，我们发布所有 AM 预测分数的独立 AES 模型的 CEFR 接近 92%。

title: EssayJudge: A Multi-Granular Benchmark for Assessing Automated Essay Scoring Capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract_en: Automated Essay Scoring (AES) plays a crucial role in educational assessment by providing scalable and consistent evaluations of writing tasks. However, traditional AES systems face three major challenges: (i) reliance on handcrafted features that limit generalizability, (ii) difficulty in capturing fine-grained traits like coherence and argumentation, and (iii) inability to handle multimodal contexts. In the era of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), we propose **EssayJudge**, the **first multimodal benchmark to evaluate AES capabilities across lexical-, sentence-, and discourse-level traits**. By leveraging MLLMs’ strengths in trait-specific scoring and multimodal context understanding, EssayJudge aims to offer precise, context-rich evaluations without manual feature engineering, addressing longstanding AES limitations. Our experiments with 18 representative MLLMs reveal gaps in AES performance compared to human evaluation, particularly in discourse-level traits, highlighting the need for further advancements in MLLM-based AES research. Our dataset and code will be available upon acceptance.
abstract_zh: 自动作文评分 (AES) 通过提供可扩展且一致的写作任务评估，在教育评估中发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，传统的 AES 系统面临三大挑战：(i) 依赖手工制作的特征，限制了泛化性；(ii) 难以捕捉连贯性和论证等细粒度特征；(iii) 无法处理多模态上下文。在多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 时代，我们提出**EssayJudge**，这是**第一个跨词汇、句子和话语级别特征评估 AES 能力的多模态基准**。通过利用 MLLM 在特定特征评分和多模态上下文理解方面的优势，EssayJudge 旨在提供精确、上下文丰富的评估，而无需手动特征工程，从而解决长期存在的 AES 限制。我们对 18 个代表性 MLLM 进行的实验揭示了 AES 性能与人类评估相比的差距，特别是在话语层面特征方面，这凸显了基于 MLLM 的 AES 研究进一步发展的必要性。我们的数据集和代码将在接受后提供。

title: NarGINA: Towards Accurate and Interpretable Children’s Narrative Ability Assessment via Narrative Graphs
abstract_en: The assessment of children’s narrative ability is crucial for diagnosing language disorders and planning interventions. Distinct from the typical automated essay scoring, this task focuses primarily on evaluating the completeness of narrative content and the coherence of expression, as well as the interpretability of assessment results. To address these issues, we propose a novel computational assessing framework NarGINA, under which the narrative graph is introduced to provide a concise and structured summary representation of narrative text, allowing for explicit narrative measurement. To this end, we construct the first Chinese children’s narrative assessment corpus based on real children’s narrative samples, and we then design a narrative graph construction model and a narrative graph-assisted scoring model to yield accurate narrative ability assessment. Particularly, to enable the scoring model to understand narrative graphs, we propose a multi-view graph contrastive learning strategy to pre-train the graph encoder and apply instruction-tuned large language models to generate scores. The extensive experimental results show that NarGINA can achieve significant performance improvement over the baselines, simultaneously possessing good interpretability. Our findings reveal that the utilization of structured narrative graphs beyond flat text is well suited for narrative ability assessment. The model and data are publicly available at https://github.com/JlexZzz/NarGINA.
abstract_zh: 儿童叙事能力的评估对于诊断语言障碍和规划干预措施至关重要。与典型的自动作文评分不同，该任务主要侧重于评估叙述内容的完整性和表达的连贯性，以及评估结果的可解释性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的计算评估框架 NarGINA，在该框架下引入叙述图来提供叙述文本的简洁且结构化的摘要表示，从而允许明确的叙述测量。为此，我们基于真实儿童叙事样本构建了中国首个儿童叙事评估语料库，并设计了叙事图构建模型和叙事图辅助评分模型，以实现准确的叙事能力评估。特别是，为了使评分模型能够理解叙述图，我们提出了一种多视图图对比学习策略来预训练图编码器并应用指令调整的大型语言模型来生成分数。大量的实验结果表明，NarGINA 可以在基线上实现显着的性能改进，同时具有良好的可解释性。我们的研究结果表明，使用平面文本之外的结构化叙事图非常适合叙事能力评估。该模型和数据可在 https://github.com/JlexZzz/NarGINA 上公开获取。

title: TRATES: Trait-Specific Rubric-Assisted Cross-Prompt Essay Scoring
abstract_en: Research on holistic Automated Essay Scoring (AES) is long-dated; yet, there is a notable lack of attention for assessing essays according to individual traits. In this work, we propose TRATES, a novel trait-specific and rubric-based cross-prompt AES framework that is generic yet specific to the underlying trait. The framework leverages a Large Language Model (LLM) that utilizes the trait grading rubrics to generate trait-specific features (represented by assessment questions), then assesses those features given an essay. The trait-specific features are eventually combined with generic writing-quality and prompt-specific features to train a simple classical regression model that predicts trait scores of essays from an unseen prompt. Experiments show that TRATES achieves a new state-of-the-art performance across all traits on a widely-used dataset, with the generated LLM-based features being the most significant.
abstract_zh: 整体自动作文评分（AES）的研究由来已久；然而，人们明显缺乏根据个人特征评估论文的关注。在这项工作中，我们提出了 TRATES，这是一种新颖的特定于特征且基于标题的交叉提示 AES 框架，该框架是通用的但特定于潜在特征。该框架利用大型语言模型（LLM），该模型利用特质评分标准来生成特定特质的特征（由评估问题表示），然后评估给定论文的这些特征。最终，特定特征的特征与通用写作质量和特定提示的特征相结合，训练一个简单的经典回归模型，该模型可以根据看不见的提示预测论文的特征分数。实验表明，TRATES 在广泛使用的数据集上的所有特征上都实现了新的最先进的性能，其中生成的基于 LLM 的特征最为重要。

title: Increasing the Generalizability of Similarity-Based Essay Scoring Through Cross-Prompt Training
abstract_en: In this paper, we address generic essay scoring, i.e., the use of training data from one writing task to score data from a different task. We approach this by generalizing a similarity-based essay scoring method (Xie et al., 2022) to learning from texts that are written in response to a mixture of different prompts. In our experiments, we compare within-prompt and cross-prompt performance on two large datasets (ASAP and PERSUADE). We combine different amounts of prompts in the training data and show that our generalized method substantially improves cross-prompt performance, especially when an increasing number of prompts is used to form the training data. In the most extreme case, this leads to more than double the performance, increasing QWK from .26 to .55.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们讨论通用论文评分，即使用一项写作任务的训练数据对另一项任务的数据进行评分。我们通过推广基于相似性的论文评分方法（Xie et al., 2022）来从针对不同提示的混合而编写的文本中学习来解决这个问题。在我们的实验中，我们比较了两个大型数据集（ASAP 和 PERSUADE）的提示内和交叉提示性能。我们在训练数据中组合了不同数量的提示，并表明我们的广义方法大大提高了交叉提示性能，特别是当使用越来越多的提示来形成训练数据时。在最极端的情况下，这会导致性能提高一倍以上，QWK 从 0.26 增加到 0.55。

title: Explaining Holistic Essay Scores in Comparative Judgment Assessments by Predicting Scores on Rubrics
abstract_en: Comparative judgment (CJ) is an assessment method in which multiple assessors determine the holistic quality of essays through pairwise comparisons.While CJ is recognized for generating reliable and valid scores, it falls short in providing transparency about the specific quality aspects these holistic scores represent.Our study addresses this limitation by predicting scores on a set of rubrics that measure text quality, thereby explaining the holistic scores derived from CJ.We developed feature-based machine learning models that leveraged complexity and genre features extracted from a collection of Dutch essays.We evaluated the predictability of rubric scores for text quality based on linguistic features.Subsequently, we evaluated the validity of the predicted rubric scores by examining their ability to explain the holistic scores derived from CJ.Our findings indicate that feature-based prediction models can predict relevant rubric scores moderately well. Furthermore, the predictions can be used to explain holistic scores from CJ, despite certain biases. This automated approach to explain holistic quality scores from CJ can enhance the transparency of CJ assessments and simplify the evaluation of their validity.
abstract_zh: 比较判断 (CJ) 是一种评估方法，其中多个评估者通过成对比较来确定论文的整体质量。虽然 CJ 因生成可靠且有效的分数而闻名，但它在提供这些整体分数所代表的具体质量方面的透明度方面存在不足。我们的研究通过预测一组衡量文本质量的评分标准来解决这一局限性，从而解释从 CJ 得出的整体分数。我们开发了基于特征的机器学习模型，利用从荷兰论文集中提取的复杂性和体裁特征。我们评估了可预测性基于语言特征的文本质量的评分标准。随后，我们通过检查预测的评分标准分数解释 CJ 得出的整体分数的能力来评估预测的评分标准分数的有效性。我们的研究结果表明，基于特征的预测模型可以较好地预测相关的评分标准分数。此外，尽管存在某些偏差，这些预测仍可用于解释 CJ 的整体分数。这种解释 CJ 整体质量分数的自动化方法可以提高 CJ 评估的透明度并简化对其有效性的评估。

title: EnhancingArabic Automated Essay Scoring with Synthetic Data and Error Injection
abstract_en: Automated Essay Scoring (AES) plays a crucial role in assessing language learners’ writingquality, reducing grading workload, and providing real-time feedback. The lack of annotatedessay datasets inhibits the development of Arabic AES systems. This paper leverages LargeLanguage Models (LLMs) and Transformermodels to generate synthetic Arabic essays forAES. We prompt an LLM to generate essaysacross the Common European Framework ofReference (CEFR) proficiency levels and introduce and compare two approaches to errorinjection. We create a dataset of 3,040 annotated essays with errors injected using our twomethods. Additionally, we develop a BERTbased Arabic AES system calibrated to CEFRlevels. Our experimental results demonstratethe effectiveness of our synthetic dataset in improving Arabic AES performance. We makeour code and data publicly available
abstract_zh: 自动作文评分 (AES) 在评估语言学习者的写作质量、减少评分工作量和提供实时反馈方面发挥着至关重要的作用。缺乏带注释的论文数据集阻碍了阿拉伯语 AES 系统的发展。本文利用 LargeLanguage Models (LLM) 和 Transformermodels 生成 AES 的综合阿拉伯语论文。我们促使大语言模型撰写跨欧洲共同参考框架（CEFR）熟练程度的论文，并介绍和比较两种错误注入方法。我们创建了一个包含 3,040 篇带注释文章的数据集，并使用我们的两种方法注入了错误。此外，我们还开发了一个基于 BERT 的阿拉伯语 AES 系统，并根据 CEFR 级别进行了校准。我们的实验结果证明了我们的合成数据集在提高阿拉伯语 AES 性能方面的有效性。我们公开我们的代码和数据

title: ExploringLLM-Based Assessment ofItalian Middle School Writing: A Pilot Study
abstract_en: This study investigates the use of ChatGPT for Automated Essay Scoring (AES) in assessing Italian middle school students’ written texts. Using rubrics targeting grammar, coherence and argumentation, we compare AI-generated feedback with that of a human teacher on a newly collected corpus of students’ essays. Despite some differences, ChatGPT provided detailed and timely feedback that complements the teacher’s role. These findings underscore the potential of generative AI to improve the assessment of writing, providing useful insights for educators and supporting students in developing their writing skills.
abstract_zh: 本研究调查了使用 ChatGPT 自动作文评分 (AES) 来评估意大利中学生的书面文本。我们使用针对语法、连贯性和论证的评分标准，将人工智能生成的反馈与人类教师对新收集的学生论文语料库的反馈进行比较。尽管存在一些差异，ChatGPT 提供了详细且及时的反馈，以补充教师的角色。这些发现强调了生成式人工智能在改善写作评估方面的潜力，为教育工作者提供有用的见解并支持学生发展写作技能。

title: The Impact of Auxiliary Patient Data on Automated ChestX-Ray Report Generation and How to Incorporate It
abstract_en: This study investigates the integration of diverse patient data sources into multimodal language models for automated chest X-ray (CXR) report generation. Traditionally, CXR report generation relies solely on data from a patient’s CXR exam, overlooking valuable information from patient electronic health records. Utilising the MIMIC-CXR and MIMIC-IV-ED datasets, we investigate the use of patient data from emergency department (ED) records — such as vital signs measured and medicines reconciled during an ED stay — for CXR report generation, with the aim of enhancing diagnostic accuracy. We also investigate conditioning CXR report generation on the clinical history section of radiology reports, which has been overlooked in the literature. We introduce a novel approach to transform these heterogeneous data sources into patient data embeddings that prompt a multimodal language model (CXRMate-ED). Our comprehensive evaluation indicates that using a broader set of patient data significantly enhances diagnostic accuracy. The model, training code, and dataset are publicly available.
abstract_zh: 本研究调查了将不同患者数据源集成到多模式语言模型中，以自动生成胸部 X 射线 (CXR) 报告。传统上，CXR 报告的生成仅依赖于患者 CXR 检查的数据，而忽略了患者电子健康记录中的宝贵信息。利用 MIMIC-CXR 和 MIMIC-IV-ED 数据集，我们研究了急诊科 (ED) 记录中的患者数据（例如在 ED 住院期间测量的生命体征和协调的药物）在 CXR 报告生成中的使用情况，目的是提高诊断准确性。我们还研究了放射学报告的临床病史部分的条件 CXR 报告生成，这在文献中被忽视了。我们引入了一种新颖的方法来将这些异构数据源转换为患者数据嵌入，从而促进多模式语言模型（CXRMate-ED）。我们的综合评估表明，使用更广泛的患者数据可以显着提高诊断准确性。模型、训练代码和数据集是公开的。

title: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Understand Spatial Relations?
abstract_en: Spatial relation reasoning is a crucial task for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to understand the objective world. However, current benchmarks have issues like relying on bounding boxes, ignoring perspective substitutions, or allowing questions to be answered using only the model’s prior knowledge without image understanding. To address these issues, we introduce SpatialMQA, a human-annotated spatial relation reasoning benchmark based on COCO2017, which enables MLLMs to focus more on understanding images in the objective world. To ensure data quality, we design a well-tailored annotation procedure, resulting in SpatialMQA consisting of 5,392 samples. Based on this benchmark, a series of closed- and open-source MLLMs are implemented and the results indicate that the current state-of-the-art MLLM achieves only 48.14% accuracy, far below the human-level accuracy of 98.40%. Extensive experimental analyses are also conducted, suggesting the future research directions. The benchmark and codes are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/liuziyan/SpatialMQA.
abstract_zh: 空间关系推理是多模态大语言模型（MLLM）理解客观世界的一项关键任务。然而，当前的基准测试存在诸如依赖边界框、忽略透视替换或仅使用模型的先验知识而不使用图像理解来回答问题等问题。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了 SpatialMQA，这是一个基于 COCO2017 的人工注释的空间关系推理基准，它使 MLLM 能够更加专注于理解客观世界中的图像。为了确保数据质量，我们设计了精心定制的注释程序，生成了由 5,392 个样本组成的 SpatialMQA。基于该基准，实现了一系列闭源和开源MLLM，结果表明，当前最先进的MLLM仅达到48.14%的准确率，远低于人类水平98.40%的准确率。还进行了广泛的实验分析，提出了未来的研究方向。基准测试和代码可在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/liuziyan/SpatialMQA 获取。

title: PunchBench: BenchmarkingMLLMs in Multimodal Punchline Comprehension
abstract_en: Multimodal punchlines, which involve humor or sarcasm conveyed in image-caption pairs, are a popular way of communication on online multimedia platforms. With the rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), it is essential to assess their ability to effectively comprehend these punchlines. However, existing benchmarks on punchline comprehension suffer from three major limitations: 1) language shortcuts that allow models to solely rely on text, 2) lack of question diversity, and 3) narrow focus on a specific domain of multimodal content (e.g., cartoon). To address these limitations, we introduce a multimodal **Punch**line comprehension **Bench**mark, named **PunchBench**, which is tailored for accurate and comprehensive evaluation of punchline comprehension. To enhance the evaluation accuracy, we generate synonymous and antonymous captions by modifying original captions, which mitigates the impact of shortcuts in the captions. To provide a comprehensive evaluation, PunchBench incorporates diverse question formats and image-captions from various domains. On this basis, we conduct extensive evaluations and reveal a significant gap between state-of-the-art MLLMs and humans in punchline comprehension. To improve punchline comprehension, we propose Simple-to-Complex Chain-of-Question (SC-CoQ) strategy, enabling the models to incrementally address complicated questions by first mastering simple ones. SC-CoQ effectively enhances the performance of various MLLMs on PunchBench, surpassing in-context learning and chain-of-thought.
abstract_zh: 多模态妙语是在线多媒体平台上流行的交流方式，其中包含以图像标题对形式表达的幽默或讽刺。随着多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的快速发展，评估它们有效理解这些妙语的能力至关重要。然而，现有的妙语理解基准受到三个主要限制：1）语言快捷方式允许模型仅依赖文本，2）缺乏问题多样性，3）狭隘地关注多模态内容的特定领域（例如卡通）。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了多模态**Punch**台词理解**Bench**mark，名为**PunchBench**，它是为准确、全面地评估台词理解而量身定制的。为了提高评估准确性，我们通过修改原始标题来生成同义和反义标题，这减轻了标题中快捷方式的影响。为了提供全面的评估，PunchBench 结合了来自各个领域的不同问题格式和图像标题。在此基础上，我们进行了广泛的评估，并揭示了最先进的 MLLM 与人类在笑点理解方面的显着差距。为了提高妙语理解力，我们提出了从简单到复杂的问题链（SC-CoQ）策略，使模型能够通过首先掌握简单的问题来逐步解决复杂的问题。 SC-CoQ 有效增强了 PunchBench 上各种 MLLM 的性能，超越了上下文学习和思维链。

title: Modeling Uncertainty in Composed Image Retrieval via Probabilistic Embeddings
abstract_en: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) enables users to search for images using multimodal queries that combine text and reference images. While metric learning methods have shown promise, they rely on deterministic point embeddings that fail to capture the inherent uncertainty in the input data, in which user intentions may be imprecisely specified or open to multiple interpretations. We address this challenge by reformulating CIR through our proposed Composed Probabilistic Embedding (CoPE) framework, which represents both queries and targets as Gaussian distributions in latent space rather than fixed points. Through careful design of probabilistic distance metrics and hierarchical learning objectives, CoPE explicitly captures uncertainty at both instance and feature levels, enabling more flexible, nuanced, and robust matching that can handle polysemy and ambiguity in search intentions. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that CoPE effectively quantifies both quality and semantic uncertainties within Composed Image Retrieval, achieving state-of-the-art performance on recall rate. Code: https://github.com/tanghme0w/ACL25-CoPE.
abstract_zh: 组合图像检索 (CIR) 使用户能够使用结合文本和参考图像的多模式查询来搜索图像。虽然度量学习方法已显示出前景，但它们依赖于确定性点嵌入，无法捕获输入数据中固有的不确定性，其中用户意图可能不精确指定或存在多种解释。我们通过提出的组合概率嵌入 (CoPE) 框架重新表述 CIR 来应对这一挑战，该框架将查询和目标表示为潜在空间中的高斯分布而不是固定点。通过仔细设计概率距离度量和分层学习目标，CoPE 明确捕获实例和特征级别的不确定性，从而实现更灵活、细致和稳健的匹配，可以处理搜索意图中的多义性和歧义性。跨多个基准的大量实验表明，CoPE 有效地量化了组合图像检索中的质量和语义不确定性，在召回率方面实现了最先进的性能。代码：https://github.com/tanghme0w/ACL25-CoPE。

title: SynergizingLLMs with Global Label Propagation for Multimodal Fake News Detection
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) can assist multimodal fake news detection by predicting pseudo labels. However, LLM-generated pseudo labels alone demonstrate poor performance compared to traditional detection methods, making their effective integration non-trivial. In this paper, we propose Global Label Propagation Network with LLM-based Pseudo Labeling (GLPN-LLM) for multimodal fake news detection, which integrates LLM capabilities via label propagation techniques. The global label propagation can utilize LLM-generated pseudo labels, enhancing prediction accuracy by propagating label information among all samples. For label propagation, a mask-based mechanism is designed to prevent label leakage during training by ensuring that training nodes do not propagate their own labels back to themselves. Experimental results on benchmark datasets show that by synergizing LLMs with label propagation, our model achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art baselines.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 可以通过预测伪标签来协助多模式假新闻检测。然而，与传统检测方法相比，LLM 生成的伪标签本身表现出较差的性能，这使得它们的有效集成非常重要。在本文中，我们提出了用于多模态假新闻检测的具有基于 LLM 的伪标签的全局标签传播网络（GLPN-LLM），该网络通过标签传播技术集成了 LLM 功能。全局标签传播可以利用LLM生成的伪标签，通过在所有样本之间传播标签信息来提高预测精度。对于标签传播，设计了基于掩码的机制，通过确保训练节点不会将自己的标签传播回自身，从而防止训练期间标签泄漏。基准数据集的实验结果表明，通过将 LLM 与标签传播相结合，我们的模型实现了优于最先进基线的性能。

title: Open-World Attribute Mining forE-Commerce Products with Multimodal Self-Correction Instruction Tuning
abstract_en: In e-commerce, effective product Attribute Mining (AM) is essential for improving product features and aiding consumer decisions. However, current AM methods often focus on extracting attributes from unimodal text, underutilizing multimodal data. In this paper, we propose a novel framework called Multimodal Self-Correction Instruction Tuning (MSIT) to mine new potential attributes from both images and text with Multimodal Large Language Models. The tuning process involves two datasets: Attribute Generation Tuning Data (AGTD) and Chain-of-Thought Tuning Data (CTTD). AGTD is constructed utilizing in-context learning with a small set of seed attributes, aiding the MLLM in accurately extracting attribute-value pairs from multimodal information. To introduce explicit reasoning and improve the extraction in accuracy, we construct CTTD, which incorporates a structured 5-step reasoning process for self-correction. Finally, we employ a 3-stage inference process to filter out redundant attributes and sequentially validate each generated attribute. Comprehensive experimental results on two datasets show that MSIT outperforms state-of-the-art methods. We will release our code and data in the near future.
abstract_zh: 在电子商务中，有效的产品属性挖掘（AM）对于改善产品功能和帮助消费者决策至关重要。然而，当前的 AM 方法通常侧重于从单模态文本中提取属性，而没有充分利用多模态数据。在本文中，我们提出了一种称为多模态自校正指令调优（MSIT）的新颖框架，用于使用多模态大语言模型从图像和文本中挖掘新的潜在属性。调优过程涉及两个数据集：属性生成调优数据（AGTD）和思维链调优数据（CTTD）。 AGTD 是利用上下文学习和一小组种子属性构建的，有助于 MLLM 从多模态信息中准确提取属性值对。为了引入显式推理并提高提取的准确性，我们构建了 CTTD，它结合了用于自我校正的结构化 5 步推理过程。最后，我们采用三阶段推理过程来过滤掉冗余属性并顺序验证每个生成的属性。两个数据集的综合实验结果表明 MSIT 优于最先进的方法。我们将在不久的将来发布我们的代码和数据。

title: Speaking Beyond Language: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset for Learning Nonverbal Cues from Video-Grounded Dialogues
abstract_en: Nonverbal communication is integral to human interaction, with gestures, facial expressions, and body language conveying critical aspects of intent and emotion. However, existing large language models (LLMs) fail to effectively incorporate these nonverbal elements, limiting their capacity to create fully immersive conversational experiences. We introduce MARS, a multimodal language model designed to understand and generate nonverbal cues alongside text, bridging this gap in conversational AI.Our key innovation is VENUS, a large-scale dataset comprising annotated videos with time-aligned text, facial expressions, and body language.Leveraging VENUS, we train MARS with a next-token prediction objective, combining text with vector-quantized nonverbal representations to achieve multimodal understanding and generation within a unified framework.Based on various analyses of the VENUS datasets, we validate its substantial scale and high effectiveness. Our quantitative and qualitative results demonstrate that MARS successfully generates text and nonverbal languages, corresponding to conversational input.Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/winston1214/nonverbal-conversation.
abstract_zh: 非语言交流是人类互动不可或缺的一部分，手势、面部表情和肢体语言传达了意图和情感的关键方面。然而，现有的大型语言模型（LLM）无法有效地整合这些非语言元素，限制了它们创建完全沉浸式对话体验的能力。我们引入了 MARS，一种多模态语言模型，旨在理解和生成文本旁边的非语言线索，从而弥合对话式 AI 中的这一差距。我们的关键创新是 VENUS，这是一个大型数据集，包含带有时间对齐文本、面部表情和肢体语言的注释视频。利用 VENUS，我们训练具有下一个标记预测目标的 MARS，将文本与矢量量化的非语言表示相结合，以在统一框架内实现多模态理解和生成。 VENUS 数据集，我们验证了其巨大的规模和高效性。我们的定量和定性结果表明，MARS 成功生成了与对话输入相对应的文本和非语言语言。我们的数据集和代码可在 https://github.com/winston1214/nonverbal-conversation 获取。

title: Are Any-to-Any Models More Consistent Across Modality Transfers Than Specialists?
abstract_en: Any-to-any generative models aim to enable seamless interpretation and generation across multiple modalities within a unified framework, yet their ability to preserve relationships across modalities remains uncertain. Do unified models truly achieve cross-modal coherence, or is this coherence merely perceived? To explore this, we introduce ACON, a dataset of 1,000 images (500 newly contributed) paired with captions, editing instructions, and Q&A pairs to evaluate cross-modal transfers rigorously. Using three consistency criteria—cyclic consistency, forward equivariance, and conjugated equivariance—our experiments reveal that any-to-any models do not consistently demonstrate greater cross-modal consistency than specialized models in pointwise evaluations such as cyclic consistency. However, equivariance evaluations uncover weak but observable consistency through structured analyses of the intermediate latent space enabled by multiple editing operations. We release our code and data at https://github.com/JiwanChung/ACON.
abstract_zh: 任何对任何生成模型的目标是在统一框架内实现跨多种模式的无缝解释和生成，但它们保持跨模式关系的能力仍然不确定。统一模型是否真正实现了跨模态一致性，或者这种一致性只是被感知到的？为了探索这一点，我们引入了 ACON，这是一个包含 1,000 张图像（500 张新贡献的）的数据集，配有字幕、编辑说明和问答对，以严格评估跨模式传输。使用三个一致性标准——循环一致性、前向等方差和共轭等方差——我们的实验表明，在逐点评估（如循环一致性）中，任意模型并不始终表现出比专门模型更高的跨模态一致性。然而，等方差评估通过对多个编辑操作启用的中间潜在空间进行结构化分析，发现了较弱但可观察到的一致性。我们在 https://github.com/JiwanChung/ACON 发布了我们的代码和数据。

title: ConInstruction: Universal Jailbreaking of Multimodal Large Language Models via Non-Textual Modalities
abstract_en: Existing attacks against multimodal language models often communicate instruction through text, either as an explicit malicious instruction or a crafted generic prompt, and accompanied by a toxic image. In contrast, here we exploit the capabilities of MLLMs in following non-textual instruction, i.e., an adversarial image or audio, namely Con Instruction. It is a novel gray-box attack method that generates adversarial images or audio to convey specific harmful instructions to MLLMs. We also find that combining our adversarial examples with certain non-empty text inputs amplifies attack success, while appending these after malicious text has limited effects. To evaluate whether an attack is successful, we introduce a new attack response categorization (ARC) that considers the response quality and relevancy concerning the malicious instruction. The results show that Con Instruction effectively bypasses the safety mechanisms in various visual and audio-language models, including LLaVA-v1.5, InternVL, Qwen-VL, and Qwen-Audio, across two standard benchmarks: AdvBench and SafeBench. Specifically, our method achieves the highest attack success rates, reaching 81.3% and 86.6% on LLaVA-v1.5 (13B). We show that larger models are more susceptible toCon Instruction, contrasting observations in their underlying LLMs. On the defense side, we explore various methods against our attacks and find substantial gaps among existing techniques. The code will be made available upon publication.
abstract_zh: 针对多模态语言模型的现有攻击通常通过文本传达指令，要么是明确的恶意指令，要么是精心设计的通用提示，并伴有有毒图像。相比之下，这里我们利用 MLLM 的能力来遵循非文本指令，即对抗性图像或音频，即 Con 指令。它是一种新颖的灰盒攻击方法，可生成对抗性图像或音频以向 MLLM 传达特定的有害指令。我们还发现，将我们的对抗性示例与某些非空文本输入相结合可以放大攻击的成功率，而在恶意文本之后附加这些示例的效果有限。为了评估攻击是否成功，我们引入了一种新的攻击响应分类（ARC），它考虑了恶意指令的响应质量和相关性。结果表明，ConInstruction 在 AdvBench 和 SafeBench 两个标准基准测试中有效绕过了各种视觉和音频语言模型（包括 LLaVA-v1.5、InternVL、Qwen-VL 和 Qwen-Audio）中的安全机制。具体来说，我们的方法实现了最高的攻击成功率，在 LLaVA-v1.5 (13B) 上达到 81.3% 和 86.6%。我们表明，较大的模型更容易受到Con指令的影响，对比其底层大语言模型中的观察结果。在防御方面，我们探索了各种抵御攻击的方法，并发现现有技术之间存在巨大差距。该代码将在发布后提供。

title: Progressive Multimodal Reasoning via Active Retrieval
abstract_en: Multi-step multimodal reasoning tasks pose significant challenges for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), and finding effective ways to enhance their performance in such scenarios remains an unresolved issue. In this paper, we propose AR-MCTS, a universal framework designed to progressively improve the reasoning capabilities of MLLMs through Active Retrieval (AR) and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). AR-MCTS follows the MCTS algorithm and heuristically integrates an active retrieval mechanism during the expansion stage to automatically acquire high-quality step-wise reasoning annotations. Moreover, we further introduce curriculum training objectives to progressively align with a process reward model, ultimately achieving process-level multimodal reasoning verification. Experimental results across three complex multimodal reasoning benchmarks confirm the effectiveness of AR-MCTS. Further analysis demonstrates that it can optimize sampling diversity and accuracy, yielding reliable multimodal reasoning.
abstract_zh: 多步骤多模态推理任务对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）提出了重大挑战，而寻找有效的方法来提高其在此类场景中的性能仍然是一个未解决的问题。在本文中，我们提出了 AR-MCTS，这是一个通用框架，旨在通过主动检索（AR）和蒙特卡罗树搜索（MCTS）逐步提高 MLLM 的推理能力。 AR-MCTS遵循MCTS算法，并在扩展阶段启发式地集成主动检索机制，以自动获取高质量的逐步推理注释。此外，我们进一步引入课程训练目标，逐步与过程奖励模型接轨，最终实现过程级多模态推理验证。三个复杂多模态推理基准的实验结果证实了 AR-MCTS 的有效性。进一步的分析表明，它可以优化采样多样性和准确性，从而产生可靠的多模态推理。

title: AdamMeme: Adaptively Probe the Reasoning Capacity of Multimodal Large Language Models on Harmfulness
