At the same time, we know little about the extent to which these models actually reflect the demographic attributes and behaviors of certain groups or populations, with conflicting findings in empirical research. To shed light on this debate, we review 211 papers on the demographic representativeness of LLMs. We find that while 29% of the studies report positive conclusions on the representativeness of LLMs, 30% of these do not evaluate LLMs across multiple demographic categories or within demographic subcategories. Another 35% and 47% of the papers concluding positively fail to specify these subcategories altogether for gender and race, respectively. Of the articles that do report subcategories, fewer than half include marginalized groups in their study. Finally, more than a third of the papers do not define the target population to whom their findings apply; of those that do define it either implicitly or explicitly, a large majority study only the U.S. Taken together, our findings suggest an inflated perception of LLM representativeness in the broader community. We recommend more precise evaluation methods and comprehensive documentation of demographic attributes to ensure the responsible use of LLMs for social applications.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 的许多应用要求它们模拟人类或提供个性化功能，这使得 LLM 的人口代表性对于公平实用至关重要。与此同时，我们对这些模型在多大程度上实际反映某些群体或人群的人口统计属性和行为知之甚少，实证研究的结果相互矛盾。为了阐明这场争论，我们回顾了 211 篇关于大语言模型人口代表性的论文。我们发现，虽然 29% 的研究报告了关于大语言模型代表性的积极结论，但其中 30% 的研究并未跨多个人口类别或人口子类别评估大语言模型。另外 35% 和 47% 的论文得出肯定结论，未能分别明确性别和种族的这些子类别。在确实报告子类别的文章中，不到一半的研究中包括边缘化群体。最后，超过三分之一的论文没有定义其研究结果适用的目标人群；在那些隐含或明确定义它的人中，绝大多数只对美国进行研究。总而言之，我们的研究结果表明，大语言模型在更广泛的社区中的代表性存​​在夸大的看法。我们建议更精确的评估方法和人口统计属性的全面记录，以确保大语言模型负责任地用于社会应用。

title: Automated main concept generation for narrative discourse assessment in aphasia
abstract_en: We present an interesting application of narrative understanding in the clinical assessment of aphasia, where story retelling tasks are used to evaluate a patient’s communication abilities. This clinical setting provides a framework to help operationalize narrative discourse analysis and an application-focused evaluation method for narrative understanding systems. In particular, we highlight the use of main concepts (MCs)—a list of statements that capture a story’s gist—for aphasic discourse analysis. We then propose automatically generating MCs from novel stories, which experts can edit manually, thus enabling wider adaptation of current assessment tools. We further develop a prompt ensemble method using large language models (LLMs) to automatically generate MCs for a novel story. We evaluate our method on an existing narrative summarization dataset to establish its intrinsic validity. We further apply it to a set of stories that have been annotated with MCs through extensive analysis of retells from non-aphasic and aphasic participants (Kurland et al., 2021, 2025). Our results show that our proposed method can generate most of the gold-standard MCs for stories from this dataset. Finally, we release this dataset of stories with annotated MCs to spur more research in this area.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了叙事理解在失语症临床评估中的有趣应用，其中复述故事任务用于评估患者的沟通能力。这种临床环境提供了一个框架来帮助实施叙事话语分析和以应用为中心的叙事理解系统评估方法。我们特别强调了主要概念（MC）（捕捉故事要点的陈述列表）在失语性话语分析中的使用。然后，我们建议从小说故事中自动生成MC，专家可以手动编辑这些MC，从而能够更广泛地适应当前的评估工具。我们进一步开发了一种使用大语言模型（LLM）的即时集成方法来自动生成小说故事的 MC。我们在现有的叙述总结数据集上评估我们的方法，以确定其内在有效性。我们通过对非失语症和失语症参与者的复述进行广泛分析，进一步将其应用于一组用 MC 注释的故事（Kurland 等人，2021，2025）。我们的结果表明，我们提出的方法可以为该数据集中的故事生成大部分黄金标准 MC。最后，我们发布了带有注释 MC 的故事数据集，以促进该领域的更多研究。

title: Reranking-based Generation for Unbiased Perspective Summarization
abstract_en: Generating unbiased summaries in real-world settings such as political perspective summarization remains a crucial application of Large Language Models (LLMs). Yet, existing evaluation frameworks rely on traditional metrics for measuring key attributes such as coverage and faithfulness without verifying their applicability, and efforts to develop improved summarizers are still nascent. We address these gaps by (1) identifying reliable metrics for measuring perspective summary quality, and (2) investigating the efficacy of LLM-based methods beyond zero-shot inference. Namely, we build a test set for benchmarking metric reliability using human annotations and show that traditional metrics underperform compared to language model–based metrics, which prove to be strong evaluators. Using these metrics, we show that reranking-based methods yield strong results, and preference tuning with synthetically generated and reranking-labeled data further boosts performance. Our findings aim to contribute to the reliable evaluation and development of perspective summarization methods.
abstract_zh: 在现实环境中生成无偏见的摘要（例如政治观点摘要）仍然是大型语言模型（LLM）的重要应用。然而，现有的评估框架依赖于传统指标来衡量覆盖率和忠实度等关键属性，而没有验证其适用性，并且开发改进的摘要器的努力仍处于起步阶段。我们通过以下方式解决这些差距：（1）确定用于衡量透视摘要质量的可靠指标，以及（2）研究基于 LLM 的方法在零样本推理之外的有效性。也就是说，我们使用人工注释构建了一个用于对度量可靠性进行基准测试的测试集，并表明传统度量与基于语言模型的度量相比表现不佳，而基于语言模型的度量被证明是强大的评估器。使用这些指标，我们表明基于重新排名的方法产生了强大的结果，并且使用综合生成和重新排名标记的数据进行偏好调整进一步提高了性能。我们的研究结果旨在为观点总结方法的可靠评估和开发做出贡献。

title: The Reader is the Metric: How Textual Features and Reader Profiles Explain Conflicting Evaluations ofAICreative Writing
abstract_en: Recent studies comparing AI-generated and human-authored literary texts have produced conflicting results: some suggest AI already surpasses human quality, while others argue it still falls short. We start from the hypothesis that such divergences can be largely explained by genuine differences in how readers interpret and value literature, rather than by an intrinsic quality of the texts evaluated. Using five public datasets (1,471 stories, 101 annotators including critics, students, and lay readers), we (i) extract 17 reference-less textual features (e.g., coherence, emotional variance, average sentence length...); (ii) model individual reader preferences, deriving feature importance vectors that reflect their textual priorities; and (iii) analyze these vectors in a shared “preference space”. Reader vectors cluster into two profiles: _surface-focused readers_ (mainly non-experts), who prioritize readability and textual richness; and _holistic readers_ (mainly experts), who value thematic development, rhetorical variety, and sentiment dynamics. Our results quantitatively explain how measurements of literary quality are a function of how text features align with each reader’s preferences. These findings advocate for reader-sensitive evaluation frameworks in the field of creative text generation.
abstract_zh: 最近对人工智能生成的文学文本和人类创作的文学文本进行比较的研究产生了相互矛盾的结果：一些人认为人工智能已经超越了人类的质量，而另一些人则认为它仍然存在不足。我们从这样的假设开始：这种分歧在很大程度上可以通过读者解释和评价文学的真正差异来解释，而不是通过评估文本的内在质量来解释。使用五个公共数据集（1,471 个故事、101 个注释者，包括评论家、学生和普通读者），我们 (i) 提取 17 个无参考文本特征（例如连贯性、情感差异、平均句子长度……）； (ii) 对个人读者偏好进行建模，得出反映其文本优先级的特征重要性向量； (iii) 在共享的“偏好空间”中分析这些向量。读者向量分为两种类型：_注重表面的读者_（主要是非专家），他们优先考虑可读性和文本丰富性；以及_整体读者_（主要是专家），他们重视主题发展、修辞多样性和情感动态。我们的结果定量地解释了文学质量的衡量如何取决于文本特征如何与每个读者的偏好相一致。这些发现提倡在创意文本生成领域建立读者敏感的评估框架。

title: Memorization vs. Reasoning: UpdatingLLMs with New Knowledge
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) encode vast amounts of pre-trained knowledge in their parameters, but updating them as real-world information evolves remains a challenge. Existing methodologies and benchmarks primarily target entity substitutions, failing to capture the full breadth of complex real-world dynamics. In this paper, we introduceKnowledge Update Playground(KUP), an automatic pipeline for simulating realistic knowledge updates reflected in an evidence corpus. KUP’s evaluation framework includes direct and indirect probes to both test memorization of updated facts and reasoning over them, for any update learning methods. Next, we present a lightweight method calledmemory conditioned training(MCT), which conditions tokens in the update corpus on self-generated ”memory” tokens during training. Our strategy encourages LLMs to surface and reason over newly memorized knowledge at inference. Our results on two LLM families show that (1) KUP benchmark is highly challenging, with the best CPT models achieving <2% in indirect probing setting (reasoning) and (2) MCT training significantly outperforms prior continued pre-training (CPT) baselines, improving direct probing (memorization) results by up to 25.4%.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在其参数中编码大量预先训练的知识，但随着现实世界信息的发展更新它们仍然是一个挑战。现有的方法和基准主要针对实体替换，未能全面捕捉复杂的现实世界动态。在本文中，我们介绍了知识更新游乐场（KUP），这是一种用于模拟证据语料库中反映的现实知识更新的自动管道。 KUP 的评估框架包括直接和间接的探索，以测试更新事实的记忆和对它们的推理，以适应任何更新的学习方法。接下来，我们提出了一种称为记忆条件训练（MCT）的轻量级方法，该方法在训练期间根据自我生成的“记忆”标记来调节更新语料库中的标记。我们的策略鼓励大语言模型在推理时对新记忆的知识进行浮现和推理。我们对两个 LLM 系列的结果表明，(1) KUP 基准具有很高的挑战性，最好的 CPT 模型在间接探测设置（推理）中实现 <2%，并且 (2) MCT 训练显着优于之前的持续预训练 (CPT) 基线，将直接探测（记忆）结果提高高达 25.4%。

title: Can You Share Your Story? Modeling Clients’ Metacognition and Openness forLLMTherapist Evaluation
abstract_en: Understanding clients’ thoughts and beliefs is fundamental in counseling, yet current evaluations of LLM therapists often fail to assess this ability. Existing evaluation methods rely on client simulators that clearly disclose internal states to the therapist, making it difficult to determine whether an LLM therapist can uncover unexpressed perspectives. To address this limitation, we introduce MindVoyager, a novel evaluation framework featuring a controllable and realistic client simulator which dynamically adapts itself based on the ongoing counseling session, offering a more realistic and challenging evaluation environment. We further introduce evaluation metrics that assess the exploration ability of LLM therapists by measuring their thorough understanding of client’s beliefs and thoughts.
abstract_zh: 了解客户的想法和信念是咨询的基础，但目前对大语言模型治疗师的评估往往无法评估这种能力。现有的评估方法依赖于客户模拟器，该模拟器可以清楚地向治疗师透露内部状态，这使得很难确定大语言模型治疗师是否能够发现未表达的观点。为了解决这一限制，我们引入了MindVoyager，这是一种新颖的评估框架，具有可控且真实的客户模拟器，可根据正在进行的咨询会话动态调整自身，提供更真实且更具挑战性的评估环境。我们进一步引入评估指标，通过衡量大语言模型治疗师对客户信念和想法的透彻理解来评估他们的探索能力。

title: Enhancing Persona Consistency forLLMs’ Role-Playing using Persona-Aware Contrastive Learning
abstract_en: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have achieved breakthrough progress in many dialogue generation tasks. However, their lack of emotion and fine-grained role awareness limits the model’s ability to provide personalized and diverse interactions further. Current methods face high costs in collecting high-quality annotated data for scenarios such as role-playing, and traditional human alignment methods are difficult to deploy due to the inherent diversity of model behavior in role-playing scenarios. Inspired by the alignment of models for safety behaviors through RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback), in this paper, we revisit model role-playing behavior from the perspective of persona alignment and propose a novel annotation-free framework named Persona-Aware Contrastive Learning (PCL) to align LLMs’ behavior during role-playing, enhancing the model’s role consistency. Specifically, we first design a role chain method to encourage the model to self-question based on the role characteristics and dialogue context to adjust personality consistency. Then, we further enhance the model’s role-playing strategy through iterative adversarial modeling between the use of role characteristics and not. Experiments on both black-box and white-box LLMs show that LLMs equipped with PCL significantly outperform vanilla LLMs under automatic evaluation methods (CharEval & GPT-4) and human expert evaluation.
abstract_zh: 近年来，大型语言模型（LLM）在许多对话生成任务中取得了突破性进展。然而，他们缺乏情感和细粒度的角色意识，限制了模型进一步提供个性化和多样化交互的能力。当前的方法在为角色扮演等场景收集高质量的注释数据方面面临着高昂的成本，并且由于角色扮演场景中模型行为固有的多样性，传统的人体对齐方法难以部署。受RLHF（人类反馈强化学习）安全行为模型对齐的启发，本文从角色对齐的角度重新审视模型角色扮演行为，并提出一种名为角色感知对比学习（PCL）的新型无注释框架，以对齐大语言模型在角色扮演过程中的行为，增强模型的角色一致性。具体来说，我们首先设计了一种角色链方法，鼓励模型根据角色特征和对话情境进行自我质疑，以调整人格一致性。然后，我们通过使用角色特征与不使用角色特征之间的迭代对抗建模，进一步增强模型的角色扮演策略。黑盒和白盒 LLM 的实验表明，在自动评估方法（CharEval 和 GPT-4）和人类专家评估下，配备 PCL 的 LLM 显着优于普通 LLM。

title: T5Score: A Methodology for Automatically Assessing the Quality ofLLMGenerated Multi-Document Topic Sets
abstract_en: Using LLMs for Multi-Document Topic Extraction has recently gained popularity due to their apparent high-quality outputs, expressiveness, and ease of use. However, most existing evaluation practices are not designed for LLM-generated topics and result in low inter-annotator agreement scores, hindering the reliable use of LLMs for the task. To address this, we introduceT5Score, an evaluation methodology that decomposes the quality of a topic set into quantifiable aspects, measurable through easy-to-perform annotation tasks. This framing enables a convenient, manual or automatic, evaluation procedure resulting in a strong inter-annotator agreement score.To substantiate our methodology and claims, we perform extensive experimentation on multiple datasets and report the results.
abstract_zh: 使用大语言模型进行多文档主题提取最近因其明显的高质量输出、表现力和易用性而受到欢迎。然而，大多数现有的评估实践并不是针对大语言模型生成的主题而设计的，导致注释者间的一致性分数较低，从而阻碍了大语言模型在任务中的可靠使用。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 T5Score，一种评估方法，它将主题集的质量分解为可量化的方面，可以通过易于执行的注释任务来衡量。该框架支持方便的手动或自动评估程序，从而产生强大的注释者间一致性分数。为了证实我们的方法和主张，我们对多个数据集进行了广泛的实验并报告结果。

title: Rethinking Prompt-based Debiasing in Large Language Model
abstract_en: Investigating bias in large language models (LLMs) is crucial for developing trustworthy AI. While prompt-based through prompt engineering is common, its effectiveness relies on the assumption that models inherently understand biases. Our study systematically analyzed this assumption using the BBQ and StereoSet benchmarks on both open-source models as well as commercial GPT model. Experimental results indicate that prompt-based is often superficial; for instance, the Llama2-7B-Chat model misclassified over 90% of unbiased content as biased, despite achieving high accuracy in identifying bias issues on the BBQ dataset. Additionally, specific evaluation and question settings in bias benchmarks often lead LLMs to choose “evasive answers”, disregarding the core of the question and the relevance of the response to the context. Moreover, the apparent success of previous methods may stem from flawed evaluation metrics. Our research highlights a potential “false prosperity” in prompt-base efforts and emphasizes the need to rethink bias evaluation metrics to ensure truly trustworthy AI. We will release our data and code upon acceptance.
abstract_zh: 研究大型语言模型 (LLM) 中的偏见对于开发值得信赖的人工智能至关重要。虽然通过提示工程进行基于提示的操作很常见，但其有效性依赖于模型本质上理解偏差的假设。我们的研究使用 BBQ 和 StereoSet 基准对开源模型和商业 GPT 模型系统地分析了这一假设。实验结果表明，基于提示的做法往往是肤浅的；例如，Llama2-7B-Chat 模型将超过 90% 的无偏见内容错误分类为有偏见，尽管在识别 BBQ 数据集上的偏见问题方面取得了很高的准确度。此外，偏见基准中的具体评估和问题设置通常会导致大语言模型选择“回避的答案”，忽视问题的核心以及答案与上下文的相关性。此外，先前方法的明显成功可能源于评估指标的缺陷。我们的研究强调了即时基础工作中潜在的“虚假繁荣”，并强调需要重新考虑偏见评估指标，以确保真正值得信赖的人工智能。我们将在接受后发布我们的数据和代码。

title: From Complexity to Clarity:AI/NLP’s Role in Regulatory Compliance
abstract_en: Regulatory data compliance is a cornerstone of trust and accountability in critical sectors like finance, healthcare, and technology, yet its complexity poses significant challenges for organizations worldwide. Recent advances in natural language processing, particularly large language models, have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in text analysis and reasoning, offering promising solutions for automating compliance processes. This survey examines the current state of automated data compliance, analyzing key challenges and approaches across problem areas. We identify critical limitations in current datasets and techniques, including issues of adaptability, completeness, and trust. Looking ahead, we propose research directions to address these challenges, emphasizing standardized evaluation frameworks and balanced human-AI collaboration.
abstract_zh: 监管数据合规性是金融、医疗保健和技术等关键领域信任和问责的基石，但其复杂性给全球组织带来了重大挑战。自然语言处理（特别是大型语言模型）的最新进展在文本分析和推理方面表现出了卓越的能力，为自动化合规流程提供了有前景的解决方案。这项调查研究了自动化数据合规性的现状，分析了跨问题领域的关键挑战和方法。我们确定了当前数据集和技术的关键局限性，包括适应性、完整性和信任问题。展望未来，我们提出了应对这些挑战的研究方向，强调标准化的评估框架和平衡的人机协作。

title: MEXA: Multilingual Evaluation ofEnglish-CentricLLMs via Cross-Lingual Alignment
abstract_en: English-centric large language models (LLMs) often show strong multilingual capabilities. However, their multilingual performance remains unclear and is under-evaluated for many other languages. Most benchmarks for multilinguality focus on classic NLP tasks or cover a minimal number of languages. We introduce MEXA, a method for assessing the multilingual capabilities of pre-trained English-centric LLMs using parallel sentences, which are available for more languages than existing downstream tasks. MEXA leverages that English-centric LLMs use English as a pivot language in their intermediate layers. MEXA computes the alignment between English and non-English languages using parallel sentences to evaluate the transfer of language understanding from English to other languages. This alignment can be used to estimate model performance in different languages. We conduct controlled experiments using various parallel datasets (FLORES-200 and Bible), models (Llama family, Gemma family, Mistral, and OLMo), and established downstream tasks (Belebele, m-MMLU, and m-ARC). We explore different methods to compute embeddings in decoder-only models. Our results show that MEXA, in its default settings, achieves an average Pearson correlation of 0.90 between its predicted scores and actual task performance across languages. This suggests that MEXA is a reliable method for estimating the multilingual capabilities of English-centric LLMs, providing a clearer understanding of their multilingual potential and the inner workings of LLMs. Leaderboard: https://cis-lmu-mexa.hf.space, Code: https://github.com/cisnlp/MEXA.
abstract_zh: 以英语为中心的大语言模型（LLM）通常表现出强大的多语言能力。然而，它们的多语言性能仍不清楚，并且对于许多其他语言的评价也被低估。大多数多语言性基准都侧重于经典的 NLP 任务或涵盖最少数量的语言。我们引入了 MEXA，一种使用平行句子评估预训练的以英语为中心的大语言模型的多语言能力的方法，该方法可用于比现有下游任务更多的语言。 MEXA 利用以英语为中心的大语言模型在中间层使用英语作为关键语言。 MEXA 使用平行句子计算英语和非英语语言之间的对齐，以评估从英语到其他语言的语言理解迁移。这种对齐可用于估计不同语言的模型性能。我们使用各种并行数据集（FLORES-200 和 Bible）、模型（Llama family、Gemma family、Mistral 和 OLMo）进行对照实验，并建立下游任务（Belebele、m-MMLU 和 m-ARC）。我们探索了在仅解码器模型中计算嵌入的不同方法。我们的结果表明，MEXA 在默认设置下，跨语言的预测分数与实际任务表现之间的平均 Pearson 相关性为 0.90。这表明 MEXA 是评估以英语为中心的大语言模型的多语言能力的可靠方法，可以更清楚地了解其多语言潜力和大语言模型的内部运作。排行榜：https://cis-lmu-mexa.hf.space，代码：https://github.com/cisnlp/MEXA。

title: LLM-Assisted, Iterative Curriculum Writing: A Human-CenteredAIApproach inFinnish Higher Education
abstract_en: This paper details an LLM-assisted system designed to support curriculum writing within a Finnish higher education institution. Developed over 18 months through iterative prototyping, workshops, and user testing with faculty, the tool functions as a collaborative partner. It provides structured suggestions and analyzes course content for alignment with institutional goals and standards like UN SDGs, aiming to reduce educator cognitive load while keeping humans central to the process. The paper presents the system’s technical architecture, findings from user feedback (including quotes and evaluation metrics), and discusses its potential to aid complex educational planning compared to generic AI tools.
abstract_zh: 本文详细介绍了一个大语言模型辅助系统，旨在支持芬兰高等教育机构内的课程编写。该工具经过 18 个月的迭代原型设计、研讨会和与教职人员的用户测试而开发，可充当协作伙伴。它提供结构化建议并分析课程内容，以符合联合国可持续发展目标等机构目标和标准，旨在减少教育者的认知负担，同时保持人在这一过程中的中心地位。该论文介绍了该系统的技术架构、用户反馈的结果（包括引用和评估指标），并讨论了与通用人工智能工具相比，它在帮助复杂的教育规划方面的潜力。

title: LLMs as Medical Safety Judges: Evaluating Alignment with Human Annotation in Patient-FacingQA
abstract_en: The increasing deployment of LLMs in patient-facing medical QA raises concerns about the reliability and safety of their responses. Traditional evaluation methods rely on expert human annotation, which is costly, time-consuming, and difficult to scale. This study explores the feasibility of using LLMs as automated judges for medical QA evaluation. We benchmark LLMs against human annotators across eight qualitative safety metrics and introduce adversarial question augmentation to assess LLMs’ robustness in evaluating medical responses. Our findings reveal that while LLMs achieve high accuracy in objective metrics such as scientific consensus and grammaticality, they struggle with more subjective categories like empathy and extent of harm. This work contributes to the ongoing discussion on automating safety assessments in medical AI and informs the development of more reliable evaluation methodologies.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的大语言模型在面向患者的医疗质量保证中的部署引起了人们对其响应的可靠性和安全性的担忧。传统的评估方法依赖于专家的人工注释，成本高昂、耗时且难以扩展。本研究探讨了使用大语言模型作为医学质量保证评估自动法官的可行性。我们通过八个定性安全指标对大语言模型与人类注释者进行基准测试，并引入对抗性问题增强来评估大语言模型在评估医疗反应方面的稳健性。我们的研究结果表明，虽然大语言模型在科学共识和语法性等客观指标上取得了很高的准确性，但他们在同理心和伤害程度等更主观的类别上遇到了困难。这项工作促进了有关医疗人工智能自动化安全评估的持续讨论，并为更可靠的评估方法的开发提供了信息。

title: HKCanto-Eval: A Benchmark for EvaluatingCantonese Language Understanding and Cultural Comprehension inLLMs
abstract_en: The ability of language models to comprehend and interact in diverse linguistic and cultural landscapes is crucial. The Cantonese language used in Hong Kong presents unique challenges for natural language processing due to its rich cultural nuances and lack of dedicated evaluation datasets. The HKCanto-Eval benchmark addresses this gap by evaluating the performance of large language models (LLMs) on Cantonese language understanding tasks, extending to English and Written Chinese for cross-lingual evaluation. HKCanto-Eval integrates cultural and linguistic nuances intrinsic to Hong Kong, providing a robust framework for assessing language models in realistic scenarios. Additionally, the benchmark includes questions designed to tap into the underlying linguistic metaknowledge of the models. Our findings indicate that while proprietary models generally outperform open-weight models, significant limitations remain in handling Cantonese-specific linguistic and cultural knowledge, highlighting the need for more targeted training data and evaluation methods. The code can be accessed at https://github.com/hon9kon9ize/hkeval2025.
abstract_zh: 语言模型在不同语言和文化环境中理解和交互的能力至关重要。由于其丰富的文化差异和缺乏专门的评估数据集，香港使用的粤语给自然语言处理带来了独特的挑战。 HKCanto-Eval 基准通过评估大型语言模型 (LLM) 在粤语语言理解任务上的表现来弥补这一差距，并扩展到英语和书面汉语进行跨语言评估。 HKCanto-Eval 整合了香港固有的文化和语言细微差别，为评估现实场景中的语言模型提供了一个强大的框架。此外，该基准还包括旨在挖掘模型的底层语言元知识的问题。我们的研究结果表明，虽然专有模型通常优于开放权重模型，但在处理粤语特定的语言和文化知识方面仍然存在显着的局限性，这凸显了需要更有针对性的训练数据和评估方法。该代码可以在 https://github.com/hon9kon9ize/hkeval2025 访问。

title: Automated Claim–Evidence Extraction for Political Discourse Analysis: A Large Language Model Approach to Rodong Sinmun Editorials
abstract_en: This study investigates the feasibility of automating political discourse analysis using large language models (LLMs), with a focus on 87 editorials from Rodong Sinmun, North Korea’s official newspaper. We introduce a structured analytical framework that integrates Chain-of-Thought prompting for claim–evidence extraction and a GPT-4o–based automated evaluation system (G-Eval). Experimental results demonstrate that LLMs possess emerging discourse-level reasoning capabilities, showing notably improved alignment with expert analyses under one-shot prompting conditions. However, the models often reproduced ideological rhetoric uncritically or generated interpretive hallucinations, highlighting the risks of fully automated analysis. To address these issues, we propose a Hybrid Human-in-the-Loop evaluation framework that combines expert judgment with automated scoring. This study presents a novel approach to analyzing politically sensitive texts and offers empirical insights into the quantitative assessment of ideological discourse, underscoring the scalability and potential of automation-driven methodologies.
abstract_zh: 本研究调查了使用大语言模型 (LLM) 进行自动化政治话语分析的可行性，重点关注朝鲜官方报纸《劳动新闻》的 87 篇社论。我们引入了一个结构化的分析框架，该框架集成了用于主张证据提取的思维链提示和基于 GPT-4o 的自动评估系统（G-Eval）。实验结果表明，大语言模型拥有新兴的话语级推理能力，在一次性提示条件下与专家分析的一致性显着提高。然而，这些模型经常不加批判地再现意识形态言论或产生解释性幻觉，凸显了全自动分析的风险。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种混合人机循环评估框架，将专家判断与自动评分相结合。这项研究提出了一种分析政治敏感文本的新颖方法，并为意识形态话语的定量评估提供了实证见解，强调了自动化驱动方法的可扩展性和潜力。

title: When Scale Meets Diversity: Evaluating Language Models on Fine-Grained Multilingual Claim Verification
abstract_en: The rapid spread of multilingual misinformation requires robust automated fact verification systems capable of handling fine-grained veracity assessments across diverse languages. While large language models have shown remarkable capabilities across many NLP tasks, their effectiveness for multilingual claim verification with nuanced classification schemes remains understudied. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of five state-of-the-art language models on the X-Fact dataset, which spans 25 languages with seven distinct veracity categories. Our experiments compare small language models (encoder-based XLM-R and mT5) with recent decoder-only LLMs (Llama 3.1, Qwen 2.5, Mistral Nemo) using both prompting and fine-tuning approaches. Surprisingly, we find that XLM-R (270M parameters) substantially outperforms all tested LLMs (7-12B parameters), achieving 57.7% macro-F1 compared to the best LLM performance of 16.9%. This represents a 15.8% improvement over the previous state-of-the-art (41.9%), establishing new performance benchmarks for multilingual fact verification. Our analysis reveals problematic patterns in LLM behavior, including systematic difficulties in leveraging evidence and pronounced biases toward frequent categories in imbalanced data settings. These findings suggest that for fine-grained multilingual fact verification, smaller specialized models may be more effective than general-purpose large models, with important implications for practical deployment of fact-checking systems.
abstract_zh: 多语言错误信息的快速传播需要强大的自动化事实验证系统，能够处理跨多种语言的细粒度准确性评估。虽然大型语言模型在许多 NLP 任务中表现出了卓越的能力，但它们通过细致入微的分类方案进行多语言声明验证的有效性仍未得到充分研究。我们对 X-Fact 数据集上的五种最先进的语言模型进行了全面评估，该数据集涵盖 25 种语言，具有七个不同的准确性类别。我们的实验使用提示和微调方法将小型语言模型（基于编码器的 XLM-R 和 mT5）与最近仅解码器的 LLM（Llama 3.1、Qwen 2.5、Mistral Nemo）进行比较。令人惊讶的是，我们发现 XLM-R（270M 参数）大大优于所有测试的 LLM（7-12B 参数），实现了 57.7% 的宏 F1，而最佳 LLM 性能为 16.9%。这比之前的最先进水平 (41.9%) 提高了 15.8%，为多语言事实验证建立了新的性能基准。我们的分析揭示了大语言模型行为的问题模式，包括利用证据的系统性困难以及对不平衡数据设置中频繁类别的明显偏见。这些发现表明，对于细粒度的多语言事实验证，较小的专用模型可能比通用大型模型更有效，这对事实检查系统的实际部署具有重要意义。

title: FACT5: A Novel Benchmark and Pipeline for Nuanced Fact-Checking of Complex Statements
abstract_en: Fact-checking complex statements is integral to combating misinformation, but manual approaches are time-consuming, while automated approaches often oversimplify truthfulness into binary classifications and rely on resource-intensive models. This paper introduces: (i) FACT5, a curated dataset of 150 real-world statements with five ordinal classes of truthfulness, designed to capture the nuanced nature of factual accuracy and (ii) an open-source end-to-end pipeline using large language models (LLMs) that decomposes statements into atomic claims, generates targeted questions, retrieves evidence from the web, and produces justified verdicts. We evaluate our pipeline on FACT5 using Mistral-7B-v0.3 and Google’s Gemini-1.5-Flash. Our findings demonstrate significant improvements over baseline LLM performance, with Mistral-7B showing a 71.9% reduction in MSE for pass@3 evaluation. The FACT5 dataset, pipeline implementation, and evaluation framework are anonymized and provided at https://github.com/shayantist/FACT5/, and a demo of the pipeline can be interacted with at https://fact5check.streamlit.app/.
abstract_zh: 对复杂的陈述进行事实核查是打击错误信息不可或缺的一部分，但手动方法非常耗时，而自动化方法往往将真实性过度简化为二元分类，并依赖于资源密集型模型。本文介绍了：(i) FACT5，这是一个由 150 个现实世界陈述组成的精选数据集，具有五个真实性等级，旨在捕捉事实准确性的细微差别；(ii) 使用大型语言模型 (LLM) 的开源端到端管道，可将陈述分解为原子声明、生成有针对性的问题、从网络检索证据并生成合理的判决。我们使用 Mistral-7B-v0.3 和 Google 的 Gemini-1.5-Flash 在 FACT5 上评估我们的流程。我们的研究结果表明，与基线 LLM 表现相比，Mistral-7B 表现出显着改善，pass@3 评估的 MSE 降低了 71.9%。 FACT5 数据集、管道实现和评估框架都是匿名的，并在 https://github.com/shayantist/FACT5/ 上提供，管道的演示可以在 https://fact5check.streamlit.app/ 上进行交互。

title: Colombian Waitresses y Jueces canadienses: Gender and Country Biases in Occupation Recommendations fromLLMs
abstract_en: One of the goals of fairness research in NLP is to measure and mitigate stereotypical biases that are propagated by NLP systems. However, such work tends to focus on single axes of bias (most often gender) and the English language. Addressing these limitations, we contribute the first study of multilingual intersecting country and gender biases, with a focus on occupation recommendations generated by large language models. We construct a benchmark of prompts in English, Spanish and German, where we systematically vary country and gender, using 25 countries and four pronoun sets. Then, we evaluate a suite of 5 Llama-based models on this benchmark, finding that LLMs encode significant gender and country biases. Notably, we find that even when models show parity for gender or country individually, intersectional occupational biases based on both country and gender persist. We also show that the prompting language significantly affects bias, and instruction-tuned models consistently demonstrate the lowest and most stable levels of bias. Our findings highlight the need for fairness researchers to use intersectional and multilingual lenses in their work.
abstract_zh: NLP 公平性研究的目标之一是衡量和减轻 NLP 系统传播的刻板偏见。然而，此类工作往往侧重于单一偏见（最常见的是性别）和英语。为了解决这些局限性，我们贡献了第一项关于多语言交叉国家和性别偏见的研究，重点是大型语言模型生成的职业建议。我们构建了英语、西班牙语和德语的提示基准，其中我们使用 25 个国家和四个代词集系统地改变国家和性别。然后，我们在此基准上评估了一套 5 个基于 Llama 的模型，发现大语言模型存在显着的性别和国家偏见。值得注意的是，我们发现，即使模型显示出性别或国家的平等性，基于国家和性别的交叉职业偏见仍然存在。我们还表明，提示语言会显着影响偏见，并且经过指令调整的模型始终表现出最低和最稳定的偏见水平。我们的研究结果强调了公平研究人员在工作中使用交叉和多语言视角的必要性。

title: ArGAN:Arabic Gender, Ability, and Nationality Dataset for Evaluating Biases in Large Language Models
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are pretrained on substantial, unfiltered corpora, assembled from a variety of sources. This risks inheriting the deep-rooted biases that exist within them, both implicit and explicit. This is even more apparent in low-resource languages, where corpora may be prioritized by quantity over quality, potentially leading to more unchecked biases. More specifically, we address the biases present in the Arabic language in both general-purpose and Arabic-specialized architectures in three dimensions of demographics: gender, ability, and nationality. To properly assess the fairness of these models, we experiment with bias-revealing prompts and estimate the performance using existing evaluation metrics, and propose adaptations to others.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在从各种来源组装的大量未经过滤的语料库上进行预训练。这有可能继承他们内部存在的根深蒂固的偏见，无论是隐性的还是显性的。这在资源匮乏的语言中更为明显，其中语料库可能会优先考虑数量而不是质量，这可能会导致更多不受控制的偏见。更具体地说，我们解决了阿拉伯语在通用和阿拉伯语专用架构中在人口统计三个维度上存在的偏见：性别、能力和国籍。为了正确评估这些模型的公平性，我们尝试了揭示偏差的提示，并使用现有的评估指标来估计性能，并提出对其他模型的调整建议。

title: From Measurement to Mitigation: Exploring the Transferability of Debiasing Approaches to Gender Bias inMaltese Language Models
abstract_en: The advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has transformed Natural Language Processing (NLP), enabling performance across diverse tasks with little task-specific training. However, LLMs remain susceptible to social biases, particularly reflecting harmful stereotypes from training data, which can disproportionately affect marginalised communities.We measure gender bias in Maltese LMs, arguing that such bias is harmful as it reinforces societal stereotypes and fails to account for gender diversity, which is especially problematic in gendered, low-resource languages.While bias evaluation and mitigation efforts have progressed for English-centric models, research on low-resourced and morphologically rich languages remains limited. This research investigates the transferability of debiasing methods to Maltese language models, focusing on BERTu and mBERTu, BERT-based monolingual and multilingual models respectively. Bias measurement and mitigation techniques from English are adapted to Maltese, using benchmarks such as CrowS-Pairs and SEAT, alongside debiasing methods Counterfactual Data Augmentation, Dropout Regularization, Auto-Debias, and GuiDebias. We also contribute to future work in the study of gender bias in Maltese by creating evaluation datasets.Our findings highlight the challenges of applying existing bias mitigation methods to linguistically complex languages, underscoring the need for more inclusive approaches in the development of multilingual NLP.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 的进步改变了自然语言处理 (NLP)，只需很少的特定任务培训即可实现跨不同任务的性能。然而，大语言模型仍然容易受到社会偏见的影响，特别是反映了培训数据中的有害刻板印象，这可能会对边缘化社区产生不成比例的影响。我们测量了马耳他大语言模型中的性别偏见，认为这种偏见是有害的，因为它强化了社会刻板印象，并且未能考虑到性别多样性，这在性别化、资源匮乏的语言中尤其成问题。虽然以英语为中心的模型的偏见评估和缓解工作取得了进展，但对资源匮乏和形态学的研究丰富的语言仍然有限。本研究研究了去偏差方法到马耳他语言模型的可迁移性，分别关注 BERTu 和 mBERTu、基于 BERT 的单语言模型和多语言模型。英语中的偏差测量和缓解技术适用于马耳他语，使用 CrowS-Pairs 和 SEAT 等基准，以及去偏差方法 Counterfactual Data Augmentation、Dropout Regularization、Auto-Debias 和 GuiDebias。我们还通过创建评估数据集为马耳他语性别偏见研究的未来工作做出贡献。我们的研究结果强调了将现有偏见缓解方法应用于语言复杂的语言所面临的挑战，强调了在开发多语言 NLP 时需要更具包容性的方法。

title: Ableism, Ageism, Gender, and Nationality bias inNorwegian and Multilingual Language Models
abstract_en: We investigate biases related to ageism, ableism, nationality, and gender in four Norwegian and two multilingual language models. Our methodology involves using a set of templates. constructed around stimuli and attributes relevant to these categories. We use statistical and predictive evaluation methods, including Kendall’s Tau correlation and dependent variable prediction rates, to assess model behaviour and output bias. Our findings indicate that models frequently associate older individuals, people with disabilities, and poorer countries with negative attributes, potentially reinforcing harmful stereotypes. However, most tested models appear to handle gender-related biases more effectively. Our findings indicate a correlation between the sentiment of the input and that of the output.
abstract_zh: 我们在四种挪威语和两种多语言语言模型中调查了与年龄歧视、体能歧视、国籍和性别相关的偏见。我们的方法涉及使用一组模板。围绕与这些类别相关的刺激和属性构建。我们使用统计和预测评估方法，包括 Kendall 的 Tau 相关性和因变量预测率，来评估模型行为和输出偏差。我们的研究结果表明，模型经常将老年人、残疾人和较贫穷的国家与负面属性联系起来，这可能会强化有害的刻板印象。然而，大多数经过测试的模型似乎能够更有效地处理与性别相关的偏见。我们的研究结果表明输入情绪和输出情绪之间存在相关性。

title: Exploring Gender Bias in Large Language Models: An In-depth Dive into theGerman Language
abstract_en: In recent years, various methods have been proposed to evaluate gender bias in large language models (LLMs). A key challenge lies in the transferability of bias measurement methods initially developed for the English language when applied to other languages. This work aims to contribute to this research strand by presenting five German datasets for gender bias evaluation in LLMs. The datasets are grounded in well-established concepts of gender bias and are accessible through multiple methodologies. Our findings, reported for eight multilingual LLM models, reveal unique challenges associated with gender bias in German, including the ambiguous interpretation of male occupational terms and the influence of seemingly neutral nouns on gender perception. This work contributes to the understanding of gender bias in LLMs across languages and underscores the necessity for tailored evaluation frameworks.
abstract_zh: 近年来，人们提出了各种方法来评估大型语言模型（LLM）中的性别偏见。一个关键的挑战在于最初为英语开发的偏差测量方法在应用于其他语言时的可转移性。这项工作旨在通过提供五个用于大语言模型性别偏见评估的德国数据集来为这一研究领域做出贡献。这些数据集基于既定的性别偏见概念，并且可以通过多种方法访问。我们针对八个多语言大语言模型模型的研究结果揭示了与德语性别偏见相关的独特挑战，包括对男性职业术语的模糊解释以及看似中性名词对性别认知的影响。这项工作有助于理解跨语言大语言模型中的性别偏见，并强调了量身定制评估框架的必要性。

title: Leveraging Large Language Models to Measure Gender Representation Bias in Gendered Language Corpora
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often inherit and amplify social biases embedded in their training data. A prominent social bias is gender bias. In this regard, prior work has mainly focused on gender stereotyping bias – the association of specific roles or traits with a particular gender – in English and on evaluating gender bias in model embeddings or generated outputs. In contrast, gender representation bias – the unequal frequency of references to individuals of different genders – in the training corpora has received less attention. Yet such imbalances in the training data constitute an upstream source of bias that can propagate and intensify throughout the entire model lifecycle. To fill this gap, we propose a novel LLM-based method to detect and quantify gender representation bias in LLM training data in gendered languages, where grammatical gender challenges the applicability of methods developed for English. By leveraging the LLMs’ contextual understanding, our approach automatically identifies and classifies person-referencing words in gendered language corpora. Applied to four Spanish-English benchmarks and five Valencian corpora, our method reveals substantial male-dominant imbalances. We show that such biases in training data affect model outputs, but can surprisingly be mitigated leveraging small-scale training on datasets that are biased towards the opposite gender. Our findings highlight the need for corpus-level gender bias analysis in multilingual NLP. We make our code and data publicly available.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 通常会继承并放大其训练数据中嵌入的社会偏见。一个突出的社会偏见是性别偏见。在这方面，之前的工作主要集中在英语中的性别刻板印象偏见（特定角色或特征与特定性别的关联）以及评估模型嵌入或生成的输出中的性别偏见。相比之下，培训语料库中的性别代表性偏见（即提及不同性别个体的频率不平等）受到的关注较少。然而，训练数据中的这种不平衡构成了偏差的上游来源，可以在整个模型生命周期中传播和加剧。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种基于大语言模型的新方法来检测和量化性别语言的大语言模型训练数据中的性别代表性偏差，其中语法性别挑战了为英语开发的方法的适用性。通过利用大语言模型的语境理解，我们的方法可以自动识别性别语言语料库中的人指词并对其进行分类。我们的方法应用于四个西班牙语-英语基准和五个巴伦西亚语料库，揭示了严重的男性主导失衡。我们表明，训练数据中的这种偏差会影响模型输出，但令人惊讶的是，可以利用对偏向异性的数据集进行小规模训练来减轻这种偏差。我们的研究结果强调了多语言 NLP 中进行语料库级别性别偏见分析的必要性。我们公开我们的代码和数据。

title: Towards Comprehensive Evaluation of Open-Source Language Models: A Multi-Dimensional, User-Driven Approach
abstract_en: With rapid advancements in large language models (LLMs) across artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data sci-ence, there is a growing need for evaluation frameworks that go beyond traditional performance metrics. Conventional methods focus mainly on accuracy and computational metrics, often neglecting user experience and community interaction—key elements in open-source environments. This paper intro-duces a multi-dimensional, user-centered evaluation frame-work, integrating metrics like User Engagement Index (UEI), Community Response Rate (CRR), and a Time Weight Factor (TWF) to assess LLMs’ real-world impact. Additionally, we propose an adaptive weighting mechanism using Bayesian op-timization to dynamically adjust metric weights for more ac-curate model evaluation. Experimental results confirm that our framework effectively identifies models with strong user engagement and community support, offering a balanced, data-driven approach to open-source LLM evaluation. This frame-work serves as a valuable tool for developers and researchers in selecting and improving open-source models.
abstract_zh: 随着人工智能、机器学习和数据科学领域的大型语言模型 (LLM) 的快速发展，对超越传统性能指标的评估框架的需求日益增长。传统方法主要关注准确性和计算指标，常常忽略用户体验和社区互动——开源环境中的关键要素。本文介绍了一个多维度、以用户为中心的评估框架，整合用户参与指数（UEI）、社区响应率（CRR）和时间权重因子（TWF）等指标来评估大语言模型的现实影响。此外，我们提出了一种使用贝叶斯优化的自适应加权机制来动态调整指标权重，以实现更准确的模型评估。实验结果证实，我们的框架有效地识别了具有强大用户参与度和社区支持的模型，为开源 LLM 评估提供了一种平衡的、数据驱动的方法。该框架是开发人员和研究人员选择和改进开源模型的宝贵工具。

title: Are Bias Evaluation Methods Biased ?
abstract_en: The creation of benchmarksto evaluate the safety of Large Language Models is one of the key activities within the trusted AI community. These benchmarks allow models to be compared for different aspects of safety such as toxicity, bias, harmful behavior etc. Independent benchmarks adopt different approacheswith distinct data sets and evaluation methods. We investigate how robust such benchmarks are by using different approachesto rank a set of representative models for bias andcompare how similar are the overall rankings. We show that different but widely used bias evaluations methods result in disparate model rankings. We conclude with recommendations for the community in the usage of such benchmarks.
abstract_zh: 创建评估大型语言模型安全性的基准是可信人工智能社区的关键活动之一。这些基准允许对模型的安全性的不同方面进行比较，例如毒性、偏见、有害行为等。独立基准采用不同的方法、不同的数据集和评估方法。我们通过使用不同的方法对一组代表性模型的偏差进行排名，并比较总体排名的相似程度，来研究此类基准的稳健程度。我们表明，不同但广泛使用的偏差评估方法会导致不同的模型排名。最后，我们向社区提出了使用此类基准的建议。

title: Modeling the One-to-Many Property in Open-Domain Dialogue withLLMs
abstract_en: Open-domain Dialogue (OD) exhibits a one-to-many (o2m) property, whereby multiple appropriate responses exist for a single dialogue context. Despite prior research showing that modeling this property boosts response diversity, most modern LLM-based dialogue agents do not explicitly do so. In this work, we model the o2m property of OD in LLMs by decomposing OD generation into two key tasks: Multi-Response Generation (MRG) and Preference-based Selection (PS), which entail generating a set ofnsemantically and lexically diverse high-quality responses for a given dialogue context, followed by selecting a single response based on human preference, respectively. To facilitate MRG and PS, we introduce o2mDial, a dialogue corpus explicitly designed to capture the o2m property by featuring multiple plausible responses for each context. Leveraging o2mDial, we propose new in-context learning and instruction-tuning strategies, as well as novel evaluation metrics for MRG, alongside a model-based approach for PS. Empirical results demonstrate that applying the proposed two-stage framework to smaller LLMs for OD generation enhances overall response diversity while maintaining contextual coherence, improving response quality by up to 90%, bringing them closer to the performance of larger models.
abstract_zh: 开放域对话 (OD) 具有一对多 (o2m) 属性，其中单个对话上下文存在多个适当的响应。尽管之前的研究表明，对这一属性进行建模可以提高响应多样性，但大多数现代基于大语言模型的对话代理并没有明确这样做。在这项工作中，我们通过将 OD 生成分解为两个关键任务：多重响应生成（MRG）和基于偏好的选择（PS），对大语言模型中 OD 的 o2m 属性进行建模，这需要为给定的对话上下文生成一组语义和词汇上多样化的高质量响应，然后分别根据人类偏好选择单个响应。为了促进 MRG 和 PS，我们引入了 o2mDial，这是一个对话语料库，专门设计用于通过针对每个上下文提供多个合理的响应来捕获 o2m 属性。利用 o2mDial，我们提出了新的上下文学习和指令调整策略，以及 MRG 的新颖评估指标，以及基于模型的 PS 方法。实证结果表明，将所提出的两阶段框架应用于较小的 LLM 来生成 OD 可以增强整体响应多样性，同时保持上下文连贯性，将响应质量提高高达 90%，使它们更接近大型模型的性能。

title: Metric assessment protocol in the context of answer fluctuation onMCQtasks
abstract_en: Using multiple-choice questions (MCQs) has become a standard for assessing LLM capabilities efficiently. A variety of metrics can be employed for this task. However, previous research has not conducted a thorough assessment of them. At the same time, MCQ evaluation suffers from answer fluctuation: models produce different results given slight changes in prompts. We suggest a metric assessment protocol in which evaluation methodologies are analyzed through their connection with fluctuation rates, as well as original performance. Our results show that there is a strong link between existing metrics and the answer changing, even when computed without any additional prompt variants. Highest association on the protocol is demonstrated by a novel metric, worst accuracy.
abstract_zh: 使用多项选择题 (MCQ) 已成为有效评估 LLM 能力的标准。此任务可以采用多种指标。然而，之前的研究尚未对它们进行彻底的评估。与此同时，MCQ 评估会受到答案波动的影响：提示的微小变化模型会产生不同的结果。我们建议采用一种度量评估协议，其中通过评估方法与波动率以及原始绩效的联系进行分析。我们的结果表明，即使在没有任何其他提示变体的情况下进行计算，现有指标和答案变化之间也存在紧密的联系。协议上的最高关联性是通过一种新颖的指标（最差的准确性）来证明的。

title: (Towards) Scalable Reliable Automated Evaluation with Large Language Models
abstract_en: Evaluating the quality and relevance of textual outputs from Large Language Models (LLMs) remains challenging and resource-intensive.Existing automated metrics often fail to capture the complexity and variability inherent in LLM-generated outputs.Moreover, these metrics typically rely on explicit reference standards, limiting their use mostly to domains with objective benchmarks.This work introduces a novel evaluation framework designed to approximate expert-level assessments of LLM-generated content.The proposed method employs pairwise comparisons of outputs by multiple LLMs, reducing biases from individual models.An Elo rating system is used to generate stable and interpretable rankings.Adjustable agreement thresholds—from full unanimity to majority voting—allow flexible control over evaluation confidence and coverage.The method’s effectiveness is demonstrated through evaluating competency profiles extracted from scientific abstracts.Preliminary results show that automatically derived rankings correlate well with expert judgments, significantly reducing the need for extensive human intervention.By offering a scalable, consistent, and domain-agnostic evaluation layer, the framework supports more efficient and reliable quality assessments of LLM outputs across diverse applications.
abstract_zh: 评估大型语言模型 (LLM) 文本输出的质量和相关性仍然具有挑战性且需要大量资源。现有的自动化指标通常无法捕获 LLM 生成的输出中固有的复杂性和可变性。此外，这些指标通常依赖于明确的参考标准，将其使用主要限制在具有客观基准的领域。这项工作引入了一种新颖的评估框架，旨在近似对 LLM 生成的内容进行专家级评估。所提出的方法采用多个 LLM 输出的成对比较，减少了个人的偏差Elo 评级系统用于生成稳定且可解释的排名。可调节的协议阈值（从完全一致到多数投票）允许灵活控制评估置信度和覆盖范围。该方法的有效性通过评估从科学摘要中提取的能力概况来证明。初步结果表明，自动得出的排名与专家判断密切相关，显着减少了对广泛人工干预的需要。通过提供可扩展、一致且与领域无关的评估层，该框架支持更高效、更可靠的质量评估跨不同应用程序的大语言模型输出。

title: Clustering Zero-Shot Uncertainty Estimations to AssessLLMResponse Accuracy for Yes/NoQ&A
abstract_en: The power of Large Language Models (LLMs) in user workflows has increased the desire to access such technology in everyday work. While the ability to interact with models provides noticeable benefits, it also presents challenges in terms of how much trust a user should put in the system’s responses. This is especially true for external commercial and proprietary models where there is seldom direct access and only a response from an API is provided. While standard evaluation metrics, such as accuracy, provide starting points, they often may not provide enough information to users in settings where the confidence in a system’s response is important due to downstream or real-world impact, such as in Question & Answering (Q&A) workflows. To support users in assessing how accurate Q&A responses from such black-box LLMs scenarios are, we develop an uncertainty estimation framework that provides users with an analysis using a Dirichlet mixture model accessed from probabilities derived from a zero-shot classification model. We apply our framework to responses on the BoolQ Yes/No questions from GPT models, finding the resulting clusters allow a better quantification of uncertainty, providing a more fine-grained quantification of accuracy and precision across the space of model output while still being computationally practical. We further demonstrate its generalizability and reusability of the uncertainty model by applying it to a small set of Q&A collected from U.S. government websites.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在用户工作流程中的强大功能增加了在日常工作中使用此类技术的愿望。虽然与模型交互的能力带来了显着的好处，但它也带来了用户对系统响应的信任程度方面的挑战。对于很少直接访问且仅提供 API 响应的外部商业和专有模型尤其如此。虽然标准评估指标（例如准确性）提供了起点，但由于下游或现实世界的影响，在系统响应的置信度非常重要的环境中（例如问答 (Q&A) 工作流程），它们通常可能无法向用户提供足够的信息。为了支持用户评估此类黑盒大语言模型场景中的问答响应的准确性，我们开发了一个不确定性估计框架，该框架为用户提供使用狄利克雷混合模型的分析，该模型是从零样本分类模型派生的概率访问的。我们将我们的框架应用于 GPT 模型中 BoolQ 是/否问题的回答，发现生成的聚类可以更好地量化不确定性，在模型输出空间中提供更细粒度的准确度和精度量化，同时仍然具有计算实用性。我们通过将其应用于从美国政府网站收集的一小组问答，进一步证明了不确定性模型的通用性和可重用性。

title: Fine-Tune on the Format: First Improving Multiple-Choice Evaluation for IntermediateLLMCheckpoints
abstract_en: Evaluation of intermediate language model checkpoints during training is critical for effective model development and selection. How-ever, reliable evaluation using the popular multiple-choice question (MCQ) format is challenging, as small and non instruction-tunedmodels often lack the symbolic reasoning required for the task. This is despite the fact that MCQ evaluation is often used and needed todistinguish between the performance of different training runs. In particular, when prompted with a question and a set of labeled answerchoices (e.g., “A. . . . , B. . . . , C. . . . ”), many models struggle to emit the correct label (e.g., “C”), even when they can select the correct string answer choice. We propose an alternative evaluation method: fine-tuning the model on an auxiliary MCQ dataset prior to outputting labels. We validate this approach empirically by showing that training on auxiliary data improves MCQ ability on all our test datasets except 1. This approach provides a more accurate signal of model capability at intermediate checkpoints, as it disentangles the evaluation of core knowledge from the model’s emerging ability to follow formatting instructions.
abstract_zh: 训练期间中间语言模型检查点的评估对于有效的模型开发和选择至关重要。然而，使用流行的多项选择题 (MCQ) 格式进行可靠评估具有挑战性，因为小型且非指令调整的模型通常缺乏任务所需的符号推理。尽管事实上 MCQ 评估经常被使用并且需要来区分不同训练运行的性能。特别是，当提示一个问题和一组带标签的答案选项（例如，“A. . . , B. . . , C. . . . ”）时，许多模型很难发出正确的标签（例如“C”），即使它们可以选择正确的字符串答案选项。我们提出了一种替代评估方法：在输出标签之前在辅助 MCQ 数据集上微调模型。我们通过经验验证了这种方法，证明辅助数据的训练提高了除 1 之外的所有测试数据集的 MCQ 能力。这种方法在中间检查点提供了更准确的模型能力信号，因为它将核心知识的评估与模型遵循格式化指令的新兴能力分开。

title: ReproHum #0067-01: A Reproduction of the Evaluation of Cross-Lingual Summarization
abstract_en: Human evaluation is crucial as it offers a nuanced understanding that automated metrics often miss. By reproducing human evaluation, we can gain a better understanding of the original results. This paper is part of the ReproHum project, where our goal is to reproduce human evaluations from previous studies. We report the reproduction results of the human evaluation of cross-lingual summarization conducted by (CITATION). By comparing the original and reproduction studies, we find that our overall evaluation findings are largely consistent with those of the previous study. However, there are notable differences in evaluation scores between the two studies for certain model outputs. These discrepancies highlight the importance of carefully selecting evaluation methodologies and human annotators.
abstract_zh: 人工评估至关重要，因为它提供了自动化指标经常忽略的细致入微的理解。通过重现人类评估，我们可以更好地理解原始结果。本文是 ReproHum 项目的一部分，我们的目标是重现以前研究中的人类评估。我们报告了（CITATION）进行的跨语言摘要的人工评估的再现结果。通过比较原始研究和复制研究，我们发现我们的总体评价结果与之前的研究基本一致。然而，两项研究对于某些模型输出的评估分数存在显着差异。这些差异凸显了仔细选择评估方法和人工注释者的重要性。

title: Finance Language Model Evaluation (FLaME)
abstract_en: Language Models (LMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities with core Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. The effectiveness of LMs for highly specialized knowledge-intensive tasks in finance remains difficult to assess due to major gaps in the methodologies of existing evaluation frameworks, which have caused an erroneous belief in a far lower bound of LMs’ performance on common Finance NLP (FinNLP) tasks. To demonstrate the potential of LMs for these FinNLP tasks, we present the first holistic benchmarking suite for Financial Language Model Evaluation (FLaME). We are the first research paper to comprehensively study LMs against ‘reasoning-reinforced’ LMs, with an empirical study of 23 foundation LMs over 20 core NLP tasks in finance. We open-source our framework software along with all data and results.
abstract_zh: 语言模型 (LM) 在核心自然语言处理 (NLP) 任务中展示了令人印象深刻的功能。由于现有评估框架的方法存在重大差距，LM 在金融领域高度专业化的知识密集型任务的有效性仍然难以评估，这导致人们错误地认为 LM 在常见金融 NLP (FinNLP) 任务上的表现远低于预期。为了展示语言模型在这些 FinNLP 任务中的潜力，我们推出了第一个用于金融语言模型评估 (FLaME) 的整体基准测试套件。我们是第一篇全面研究 LM 与“推理强化”LM 的研究论文，对金融领域 20 个核心 NLP 任务的 23 个基础 LM 进行了实证研究。我们开源我们的框架软件以及所有数据和结果。

title: Towards a Principled Evaluation of Knowledge Editors
abstract_en: Model editing has been gaining increasing attention over the past few years. For Knowledge Editing in particular, more challenging evaluation datasets have recently been released. These datasets use different methodologies to score the success of editors. Yet, it remains under-explored how robust these methodologies are and whether they unfairly favor some editors. Moreover, the disruptive impact of these editors on overall model capabilities remains a constant blind spot.We address both of these problems and show that choosing different metrics and evaluation methodologies as well as different edit batch sizes can lead to a different ranking of knowledge editors. Crucially we demonstrate this effect also on general language understanding tasks evaluated alongside the knowledge editing tasks. Further we include a manual assessment of the string matching based evaluation method for knowledge editing that is favored by recently released datasets, revealing a tendency to produce false positive matches.
abstract_zh: 在过去的几年里，模型编辑越来越受到人们的关注。特别是对于知识编辑，最近发布了更具挑战性的评估数据集。这些数据集使用不同的方法来对编辑的成功进行评分。然而，这些方法的稳健性以及它们是否不公平地偏袒某些编辑仍然没有得到充分探索。此外，这些编辑器对整体模型能力的破坏性影响仍然是一个持续的盲点。我们解决了这两个问题，并表明选择不同的指标和评估方法以及不同的编辑批量大小可能会导致知识编辑器的不同排名。至关重要的是，我们还在与知识编辑任务一起评估的一般语言理解任务上展示了这种效果。此外，我们还对基于字符串匹配的知识编辑评估方法进行了手动评估，该方法受到最近发布的数据集的青睐，揭示了产生误报匹配的趋势。

title: FrontierScience Bench: EvaluatingAIResearch Capabilities inLLMs
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across various tasks, yet their potential to reason about and construct scientific methodologies remains under explored. This work introduces a novel benchmark evaluating LLMs’ capacity to predict methodological details in AI research papers. We construct a dataset of 88 papers with redacted methodology sections and zero-shot prompt several state-of-the-art LLMs to generate methodology predictions. Our evaluation framework then employs a LLM-as-judge system with multiple LLM judges, majority voting, and self-omission techniques to minimize biases. We validate our LLM judge scores against human judgments. We then briefly analyze the judging results of our zero-shot prediction pipeline, suggesting that even state-of-the-art LLMs struggle with the task of methodology generation without more advanced techniques. This benchmark lays the groundwork for future research into evaluating LLMs’ potential for aiding in AI research.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在各种任务中表现出了卓越的能力，但它们推理和构建科学方法的潜力仍有待探索。这项工作引入了一种新颖的基准，评估大语言模型预测人工智能研究论文中方法细节的能力。我们构建了一个包含 88 篇论文的数据集，其中包含经过编辑的方法论部分，并且零样本提示几位最先进的大语言模型生成方法论预测。然后，我们的评估框架采用大语言模型作为法官系统，由多名大语言模型法官、多数投票和自我省略技术来最大限度地减少偏见。我们根据人类的判断来验证我们的大语言模型法官分数。然后，我们简要分析了零样本预测流程的判断结果，这表明即使是最先进的大语言模型，在没有更先进技术的情况下也很难完成方法生成的任务。该基准为未来评估大语言模型协助人工智能研究潜力的研究奠定了基础。

title: ZJUKLABatSemEval-2025 Task 4: Unlearning via Model Merging.
abstract_en: This paper presents the ZJUKLAB team’s submission for {emph{SemEval-2025 Task 4: Unlearning Sensitive Content from Large Language Models}}. This task aims to selectively erase sensitive knowledge from large language models, avoiding both over-forgetting and under-forgetting issues. We propose an unlearning system that leverages Model Merging (specifically TIES-Merging), combining two specialized models into a more balanced unlearned model.Our system achieves competitive results, ranking {textbf{second among 26 teams}}, with an online score of 0.944 for Task Aggregate and 0.487 for overall Aggregate. In this paper, we also conduct local experiments and perform a comprehensive analysis of the unlearning process, examining performance trajectories, loss dynamics, and weight perspectives, along with several supplementary experiments, to understand the effectiveness of our method.Furthermore, we analyze the shortcomings of our method and evaluation metrics, emphasizing that MIA scores and ROUGE-based metrics alone are insufficient to fully evaluate successful unlearning. Finally, we emphasize the need for more comprehensive evaluation methodologies and rethinking of unlearning objectives in future research.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 ZJUKLAB 团队提交的 {emph{SemEval-2025 任务 4：从大型语言模型中学习敏感内容}}。该任务旨在有选择地从大型语言模型中删除敏感知识，避免过度遗忘和遗忘不足的问题。我们提出了一个利用模型合并（特别是 TIES-Merging）的去学习系统，将两个专门的模型组合成一个更平衡的未学习模型。我们的系统取得了有竞争力的结果，排名{textbf{26个团队中第二}}，任务聚合在线得分为 0.944，整体聚合在线得分为 0.487。在本文中，我们还进行了局部实验并对忘却过程进行了全面分析，检查了表现轨迹、损失动态和权重视角，以及几个补充实验，以了解我们方法的有效性。此外，我们分析了我们的方法和评估指标的缺点，强调仅 MIA 分数和基于 ROUGE 的指标不足以充分评估成功的忘却。最后，我们强调在未来的研究中需要更全面的评估方法和重新思考遗忘目标。

title: NeuroReset :LLMUnlearning via Dual Phase Mixed Methodology
abstract_en: This paper presents the method for the unlearning of sensitive information from large language models as applied in the SemEval 2025 Task 4 challenge. The unlearning pipeline consists of two phases. In phase I, the model is instructed to forget specific datasets, and in phase II, the model is stabilized using a retention dataset. Unlearning with these methods secured a final score of 0.420 with the 2nd honorary mention in the 7B parameter challenge and a score of 0.36 in the 13th position for the 1B parameter challenge. The paper presents a background study, a brief literature review, and a gap analysis, as well as the methodology employed in our work titled NeuroReset. The training methodology and evaluation metrics are also presented, and the trade-offs between unlearning efficiency and model performance are discussed. The contributions of the paper are systematic unlearning, a comparative analysis of unlearning methods, and an empirical analysis of model performance post-unlearning.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了在 SemEval 2025 Task 4 挑战中应用的从大型语言模型中消除敏感信息的方法。遗忘管道由两个阶段组成。在第一阶段，模型被指示忘记特定的数据集，在第二阶段，使用保留数据集来稳定模型。使用这些方法进行 Unlearning 的最终得分为 0.420，在 7B 参数挑战中获得第二名荣誉奖，并在 1B 参数挑战中获得 0.36 的第 13 位。本文介绍了背景研究、简短的文献综述和差距分析，以及我们题为 NeuroReset 的工作中采用的方法。还介绍了训练方法和评估指标，并讨论了遗忘效率和模型性能之间的权衡。该论文的贡献在于系统性的遗忘、遗忘方法的比较分析以及遗忘后模型性能的实证分析。

title: NarrativeMiners atSemEval-2025 Task 10: Combating Manipulative Narratives in Online News
abstract_en: Our team, Narrative Miners, participated in SemEval-2025 Task 10 to tackle the challenge of detecting manipulative narratives in online news, focusing on the Ukraine-Russia war and climate change. We worked on three key subtasks: classifying entity roles, categorizing narratives and subnarratives, and generating concise narrative explanations. Using transformer-based models like BART, BERT, GPT-2, and Flan-T5, we implemented a structured pipeline and applied data augmentation to enhance performance. BART-CNN proved to be our best-performing model, significantly improving classification accuracy and explanation generation. Despite challenges like dataset limitations and class imbalance, our approach demonstrated the effectiveness of hierarchical classification and multilingual analysis in combating online disinformation. We made use of different data augmentation techniques to cover the class imbalances present in the dataset. We had different evaluation metrics set for each subtask, specifically focusing on the need of that particular outcome. With this paper, we hope to play our part in mitigating the impact of harmful disinformation.
abstract_zh: 我们的叙事矿工团队参加了 SemEval-2025 任务 10，以应对检测在线新闻中的操纵性叙事的挑战，重点关注乌克兰-俄罗斯战争和气候变化。我们致力于三个关键的子任务：对实体角色进行分类、对叙事和子叙事进行分类以及生成简洁的叙事解释。使用 BART、BERT、GPT-2 和 Flan-T5 等基于 Transformer 的模型，我们实现了结构化管道并应用数据增强来增强性能。 BART-CNN 被证明是我们性能最好的模型，显着提高了分类准确性和解释生成。尽管存在数据集限制和类别不平衡等挑战，我们的方法证明了分层分类和多语言分析在打击在线虚假信息方面的有效性。我们利用不同的数据增强技术来覆盖数据集中存在的类不平衡。我们为每个子任务设置了不同的评估指标，特别关注特定结果的需求。通过本文，我们希望在减轻有害虚假信息的影响方面发挥自己的作用。

title: HowardUniversity-AI4PCatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Combining Expert Personas via Prompting for Enhanced Multilingual Emotion Analysis
abstract_en: For our approach to SemEval-2025 Task 11, we employ a multi-tier evaluation framework for perceived emotion analysis. Our system consists of a smaller-parameter-size large language model that independently predicts a given text’s perceived emotion while explaining the reasoning behind its decision. The initial model’s persona is varied through careful prompting, allowing it to represent multiple perspectives. These outputs, including both predictions and reasoning, are aggregated and fed into a final decision-making model that determines the ultimate emotion classification. We evaluated our approach in official SemEval Task 11 on subtasks A and C in all the languages provided.
abstract_zh: 对于 SemEval-2025 任务 11 的方法，我们采用多层评估框架来进行感知情绪分析。我们的系统由一个较小参数的大型语言模型组成，该模型可以独立预测给定文本的感知情感，同时解释其决策背后的原因。通过仔细的提示，初始模型的角色会发生变化，使其能够代表多种观点。这些输出（包括预测和推理）被汇总并输入到最终决策模型中，该模型确定最终的情绪分类。我们在官方 SemEval 任务 11 中针对所提供的所有语言的子任务 A 和 C 评估了我们的方法。

title: Predicting Emotion Intensity in Text Using Transformer-Based Models
abstract_en: Emotion intensity prediction in text enhances conversational AI by enabling a deeper understanding of nuanced human emotions, a crucial yet underexplored aspect of natural language processing (NLP). This study employs Transformer-based models to classify emotion intensity levels (0–3) for five emotions: anger, fear, joy, sadness, and surprise. The dataset, sourced from the SemEval shared task, was preprocessed to address class imbalance, and model training was performed using fine-tuned *bert-base-uncased*. Evaluation metrics showed that *sadness* achieved the highest accuracy (0.8017) and F1-macro (0.5916), while *fear* had the lowest accuracy (0.5690) despite a competitive F1-macro (0.5207). The results demonstrate the potential of Transformer-based models in emotion intensity prediction while highlighting the need for further improvements in class balancing and contextual representation.
abstract_zh: 文本中的情绪强度预测可以更深入地理解人类微妙的情绪，从而增强对话式人工智能，这是自然语言处理 (NLP) 的一个重要但尚未充分探索的方面。本研究采用基于 Transformer 的模型对五种情绪的情绪强度级别 (0-3) 进行分类：愤怒、恐惧、喜悦、悲伤和惊讶。该数据集源自 SemEval 共享任务，经过预处理以解决类别不平衡问题，并使用微调的 *bert-base-uncased* 执行模型训练。评估指标显示，“悲伤”达到了最高的准确度（0.8017）和 F1 宏（0.5916），而“恐惧”尽管具有竞争性的 F1 宏（0.5207），但准确度最低（0.5690）。结果证明了基于 Transformer 的模型在情绪强度预测方面的潜力，同时强调需要进一步改进类别平衡和上下文表示。

title: JU-CSE-NLP’25 atSemEval-2025 Task 4: Learning to UnlearnLLMs
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved enormous success recently due to their ability to understand and solve various non-trivial tasks in natural language. However, they have been shown to memorize their training data which, among other concerns, increases the risk of the model regurgitating creative or private content, potentially leading to legal issues for the model developer and/or vendors. Such issues are often discovered post-model training during testing or red teaming. While unlearning has been studied for some time in classification problems, it is still a relatively underdeveloped area of study in LLM research since the latter operates in a potentially unbounded output label space. Specifically, robust evaluation frameworks are lacking to assess the accuracy of these unlearning strategies. In this challenge, we aim to bridge this gap by developing a comprehensive evaluation challenge for unlearning sensitive datasets in LLMs.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）最近取得了巨大的成功，因为它们能够理解和解决自然语言中的各种重要任务。然而，他们已被证明会记住他们的训练数据，除其他问题外，这增加了模型反刍创意或私人内容的风险，可能导致模型开发人员和/或供应商面临法律问题。此类问题通常是在测试或红队期间进行模型训练后发现的。虽然在分类问题中取消学习已经被研究了一段时间，但它仍然是大语言模型研究中相对不发达的研究领域，因为后者在潜在的无界输出标签空间中运行。具体来说，缺乏强大的评估框架来评估这些遗忘策略的准确性。在这个挑战中，我们的目标是通过开发一个全面的评估挑战来弥合这一差距，以消除大语言模型中敏感数据集的学习。

title: SenWiCh: Sense-Annotation of Low-Resource Languages forWiCusing Hybrid Methods
abstract_en: This paper addresses the critical need for high-quality evaluation datasets in low-resource languages to advance cross-lingual transfer. While cross-lingual transfer offers a key strategy for leveraging multilingual pretraining to expand language technologies to understudied and typologically diverse languages, its effectiveness is dependent on quality and suitable benchmarks. We release new sense-annotated datasets of sentences containing polysemous words, spanning nine low-resource languages across diverse language families and scripts. To facilitate dataset creation, the paper presents a demonstrably beneficial semi-automatic annotation method. The utility of the datasets is demonstrated through Word-in-Context (WiC) formatted experiments that evaluate transfer on these low-resource languages. Results highlight the importance of targeted dataset creation and evaluation for effective polysemy disambiguation in low-resource settings and transfer studies. The released datasets and code aim to support further research into fair, robust, and truly multilingual NLP.
abstract_zh: 本文解决了对低资源语言的高质量评估数据集以推进跨语言迁移的迫切需求。虽然跨语言迁移提供了利用多语言预训练将语言技术扩展到未充分研究和类型多样的语言的关键策略，但其有效性取决于质量和合适的基准。我们发布了包含多义词的新的带语义注释的句子数据集，涵盖不同语系和脚本的九种低资源语言。为了促进数据集创建，本文提出了一种明显有益的半自动注释方法。通过评估这些低资源语言的迁移的 Word-in-Context (WiC) 格式的实验证明了数据集的实用性。结果强调了有针对性的数据集创建和评估对于在资源匮乏环境和转移研究中有效消除多义词歧义的重要性。发布的数据集和代码旨在支持公平、稳健和真正的多语言 NLP 的进一步研究。

title: TheUNLP2025 Shared Task on Detecting Social Media Manipulation
abstract_en: This paper presents the results of the UNLP 2025 Shared Task on Detecting Social Media Manipulation. The task included two tracks: Technique Classification and Span Identification. The benchmark dataset contains 9,557 posts from Ukrainian Telegram channels manually annotated by media experts. A total of 51 teams registered, 22 teams submitted systems, and 595 runs were evaluated on a hidden test set via Kaggle. Performance was measured with macro F1 for classification and token‐level F1 for identification. The shared task provides the first publicly available benchmark for manipulation detection in Ukrainian social media and highlights promising directions for low‐resource propaganda research. The Kaggle leaderboard is left open for further submissions.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 UNLP 2025 检测社交媒体操纵共享任务的结果。该任务包括两个轨道：技术分类和跨度识别。基准数据集包含来自乌克兰 Telegram 频道的 9,557 个帖子，并由媒体专家手动注释。共有 51 个团队注册，22 个团队提交系统，并通过 Kaggle 在隐藏测试集上评估了 595 次运行。使用用于分类的宏 F1 和用于识别的令牌级 F1 来测量性能。该共享任务为乌克兰社交媒体中的操纵检测提供了第一个公开可用的基准，并强调了低资源宣传研究的有希望的方向。 Kaggle 排行榜仍开放供进一步提交。

title: On the Path to MakeUkrainian a High-Resource Language
abstract_en: Recent advances in multilingual language modeling have highlighted the importance of high-quality, large-scale datasets in enabling robust performance across languages. However, many low- and mid-resource languages, including Ukrainian, remain significantly underrepresented in existing pretraining corpora. We present Kobza, a large-scale Ukrainian text corpus containing nearly 60 billion tokens, aimed at improving the quality and scale of Ukrainian data available for training multilingual language models. We constructed Kobza from diverse, high-quality sources and applied rigorous deduplication to maximize data utility. Using this dataset, we pre-trained Modern-LiBERTa, the first Ukrainian transformer encoder capable of handling long contexts (up to 8192 tokens). Modern-LiBERTa achieves competitive results on various standard Ukrainian NLP benchmarks, particularly benefiting tasks that require broader contextual understanding or background knowledge. Our goal is to support future efforts to develop robust Ukrainian language models and to encourage greater inclusion of Ukrainian data in multilingual NLP research.
abstract_zh: 多语言建模的最新进展凸显了高质量、大规模数据集在实现跨语言稳健性能方面的重要性。然而，包括乌克兰语在内的许多中低资源语言在现有预训练语料库中的代表性仍然严重不足。我们推出了 Kobza，这是一个包含近 600 亿个标记的大型乌克兰语文本语料库，旨在提高可用于训练多语言语言模型的乌克兰语数据的质量和规模。我们从多样化、高质量的来源构建了 Kobza，并应用严格的重复数据删除来最大限度地提高数据效用。使用此数据集，我们预训练了 Modern-LiBERTa，这是第一个能够处理长上下文（最多 8192 个标记）的乌克兰 Transformer 编码器。 Modern-LiBERTa 在各种标准乌克兰 NLP 基准上取得了有竞争力的结果，特别是有利于需要更广泛的上下文理解或背景知识的任务。我们的目标是支持未来开发强大的乌克兰语言模型的努力，并鼓励更多地将乌克兰数据纳入多语言 NLP 研究中。

title: Proper Noun Diacritization forArabicWikipedia: A Benchmark Dataset
abstract_en: Proper nouns in Arabic Wikipedia are frequently undiacritized, creating ambiguity in pronunciation and interpretation, especially for transliterated named entities of foreign origin. While transliteration and diacritization have been well-studied separately in Arabic NLP, their intersection remains underexplored. In this paper, we introduce a new manually diacritized dataset of Arabic proper nouns of various origins with their English Wikipedia equivalent glosses, and present the challenges and guidelines we followed to create it. We benchmark GPT-4o on the task of recovering full diacritization given the undiacritized Arabic and English forms, and analyze its performance. Achieving 73% accuracy, our results underscore both the difficulty of the task and the need for improved models and resources. We release our dataset to facilitate further research on Arabic Wikipedia proper noun diacritization.
abstract_zh:
阿拉伯语维基百科中的专有名词经常不受批评，在发音和解释上造成歧义，特别是对于音译的外国起源命名实体。虽然音译和变音符号在阿拉伯语 NLP 中已分别得到充分研究，但它们的交叉点仍未得到充分探索。在本文中，我们介绍了一个新的手动变音数据集，其中包含各种来源的阿拉伯语专有名词及其英语维基百科的等效注释，并介绍了我们创建它所遵循的挑战和指南。我们对 GPT-4o 进行基准测试，以恢复完全变音符号化的任务，并分析其性能。我们的结果达到了 73% 的准确率，凸显了任务的难度以及改进模型和资源的需求。我们发布数据集以促进对阿拉伯语维基百科专有名词变音的进一步研究。

## 教育应用 (36 篇)

title: Silencing Empowerment, Allowing Bigotry: Auditing the Moderation of Hate Speech on Twitch
abstract_en: To meet the demands of content moderation, online platforms have resorted to automated systems. Newer forms of real-time engagement (e.g., users commenting on live streams) on platforms like Twitch exert additional pressures on the latency expected of such moderation systems. Despite their prevalence, relatively little is known about the effectiveness of these systems. In this paper, we conduct an audit of Twitch’s automated moderation tool (AutoMod) to investigate its effectiveness in flagging hateful content. For our audit, we create streaming accounts to act as siloed test beds, and interface with the live chat using Twitch’s APIs to send over 107,000 comments collated from 4 datasets. We measureAutoMod‘s accuracy in flagging blatantly hateful content containing misogyny, racism, ableism and homophobia. Our experiments reveal that a large fraction of hateful messages, up to 94% on some datasets,bypass moderation. Contextual addition of slurs to these messages results in 100% removal, revealingAutoMod‘s reliance on slurs as a hate signal. We also find that contrary to Twitch’s community guidelines,AutoModblocks up to 89.5% of benign examples that use sensitive words in pedagogical or empowering contexts. Overall, our audit points to large gaps inAutoMod‘s capabilities and underscores the importance for such systems to understand context effectively.
abstract_zh: 为了满足内容审核的需求，在线平台采用了自动化系统。 Twitch 等平台上的新型实时参与（例如，用户在直播中评论）对此类审核系统的预期延迟施加了额外的压力。尽管它们很普遍，但人们对这些系统的有效性知之甚少。在本文中，我们对 Twitch 的自动审核工具 (AutoMod) 进行了审核，以调查其标记仇恨内容的有效性。为了进行审计，我们创建了流媒体帐户作为孤立的测试平台，并使用 Twitch 的 API 与实时聊天交互，发送从 4 个数据集整理而来的超过 107,000 条评论。我们衡量 AutoMod 在标记包含厌女症、种族主义、体能歧视和恐同症的公然仇恨内容方面的准确性。我们的实验表明，很大一部分仇恨消息（在某​​些数据集上高达 94%）都绕过了审核。在这些消息中根据上下文添加诽谤性内容会导致 100% 删除，这表明 AutoMod 依赖诽谤性内容作为仇恨信号。我们还发现，与 Twitch 的社区准则相反，AutoMod 屏蔽了高达 89.5% 在教学或授权环境中使用敏感词汇的良性示例。总体而言，我们的审计指出了 AutoMod 的能力存在巨大差距，并强调了此类系统有效理解上下文的重要性。

title: Delta-KNN: Improving Demonstration Selection in In-Context Learning forAlzheimer’s Disease Detection
abstract_en: Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that leads to dementia, and early intervention can greatly benefit from analyzing linguistic abnormalities. In this work, we explore the potential of Large Language Models as health assistants for AD diagnosis from patient-generated text using in-context learning (ICL), where tasks are defined through a few input-output examples. Empirical results reveal that conventional ICL methods, such as similarity-based selection, perform poorly for AD diagnosis, likely due to the inherent complexity of this task. To address this, we introduce Delta-KNN, a novel demonstration selection strategy that enhances ICL performance. Our method leverages a delta score to assess the relative gains of each training example, coupled with a KNN-based retriever that dynamically selects optimal “representatives” for a given input.Experiments on two AD detection datasets across three models demonstrate that Delta-KNN consistently outperforms existing ICL baselines. Notably, when using the Llama-3.1 model, our approach achieves new state-of-the-art results, surpassing even supervised classifiers.
abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，会导致痴呆，分析语言异常可以使早期干预受益匪浅。在这项工作中，我们探索了大型语言模型作为健康助手的潜力，使用上下文学习（ICL）从患者生成的文本中进行 AD 诊断，其中任务是通过一些输入输出示例来定义的。经验结果表明，传统的 ICL 方法（例如基于相似性的选择）在 AD 诊断方面表现不佳，可能是由于该任务固有的复杂性。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 Delta-KNN，这是一种新颖的演示选择策略，可以增强 ICL 性能。我们的方法利用 Delta 分数来评估每个训练示例的相对增益，并结合基于 KNN 的检索器，为给定的输入动态选择最佳“代表”。对三个模型的两个 AD 检测数据集进行的实验表明，Delta-KNN 始终优于现有的 ICL 基线。值得注意的是，当使用 Llama-3.1 模型时，我们的方法取得了新的最先进的结果，甚至超越了监督分类器。

title: R2D2: Remembering, Replaying and Dynamic Decision Making with a Reflective Agentic Memory
abstract_en: The proliferation of web agents necessitates advanced navigation and interaction strategies within complex web environments. Current models often struggle with efficient navigation and action execution due to limited visibility and understanding of web structures. Our proposed R2D2 framework addresses these challenges by integrating two paradigms: Remember and Reflect. The Remember paradigm utilizes a replay buffer that aids agents in reconstructing the web environment dynamically, thus enabling the formulation of a detailed “map” of previously visited pages. This helps in reducing navigational errors and optimizing the decision-making process during web interactions. Conversely, the Reflect paradigm allows agents to learn from past mistakes by providing a mechanism for error analysis and strategy refinement, enhancing overall task performance. We evaluate R2D2 using the WEBARENA benchmark, demonstrating significant improvements over existing methods, including a 50% reduction in navigation errors and a threefold increase in task completion rates. Our findings suggest that a combination of memory-enhanced navigation and reflective learning promisingly advances the capabilities of web agents, potentially benefiting various applications such as automated customer service and personal digital assistants.
abstract_zh: Web 代理的激增需要在复杂的 Web 环境中采用先进的导航和交互策略。由于对网络结构的可见性和理解有限，当前的模型常常难以有效导航和执行操作。我们提出的 R2D2 框架通过集成两个范例来解决这些挑战：记住和反思。 Remember范例利用重放缓冲区来帮助代理动态重建网络环境，从而能够制定先前访问过的页面的详细“地图”。这有助于减少网络交互过程中的导航错误并优化决策过程。相反，反思范式允许代理通过提供错误分析和策略细化的机制从过去的错误中学习，从而提高整体任务绩效。我们使用 WEBARENA 基准评估 R2D2，证明其比现有方法有显着改进，包括导航错误减少 50%，任务完成率提高三倍。我们的研究结果表明，记忆增强导航和反思性学习的结合有望提高网络代理的能力，从而可能使自动化客户服务和个人数字助理等各种应用受益。

title: EducationQ: EvaluatingLLMs’ Teaching Capabilities Through Multi-Agent Dialogue Framework
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as educational tools, yet evaluating their teaching capabilities remains challenging due to the resource-intensive, context-dependent, and methodologically complex nature of teacher-student interactions. We introduce EducationQ, a multi-agent dialogue framework that efficiently assesses teaching capabilities through simulated dynamic educational scenarios, featuring specialized agents for teaching, learning, and evaluation. Testing 14 LLMs across major AI Organizations (OpenAI, Meta, Google, Anthropic, and others) on 1,498 questions spanning 13 disciplines and 10 difficulty levels reveals that teaching effectiveness does not correlate linearly with model scale or general reasoning capabilities - with some smaller open-source models outperforming larger commercial counterparts in teaching contexts. This finding highlights a critical gap in current evaluations that prioritize knowledge recall over interactive pedagogy. Our mixed-methods evaluation, combining quantitative metrics with qualitative analysis and expert case studies, identifies distinct pedagogical strengths employed by top-performing models (e.g., sophisticated questioning strategies, adaptive feedback mechanisms). Human expert evaluations show 78% agreement with our automated qualitative analysis of effective teaching behaviors, validating our methodology. EducationQ demonstrates that LLMs-as-Teachers require specialized optimization beyond simple scaling, suggesting next-generation educational AI prioritize targeted enhancement of specific pedagogical effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地用作教育工具，但由于师生互动的资源密集型、情境依赖型和方法复杂性，评估其教学能力仍然具有挑战性。我们推出了EducationQ，这是一个多智能体对话框架，它通过模拟动态教育场景有效评估教学能力，具有专门的教学、学习和评估智能体。对主要 AI 组织（OpenAI、Meta、Google、Anthropic 等）的 14 个大语言模型进行了跨越 13 个学科和 10 个难度级别的 1,498 个问题的测试，结果表明教学效果与模型规模或一般推理能力并不线性相关 - 一些较小的开源模型在教学环境中优于较大的商业模型。这一发现凸显了当前评估中的一个关键差距，即优先考虑知识回忆而不是互动教学法。我们的混合方法评估将定量指标与定性分析和专家案例研究相结合，确定了表现最佳的模型所采用的独特教学优势（例如复杂的提问策略、自适应反馈机制）。人类专家评估显示 78% 的人同意我们对有效教学行为的自动定性分析，验证了我们的方法。 EducationQ 表明，大语言模型作为教师需要进行专门的优化，而不仅仅是简单的扩展，这表明下一代教育人工智能优先考虑有针对性地增强特定的教学效果。

title: Foundations ofPEERS: AssessingLLMRole Performance in Educational Simulations
abstract_en: In education, peer instruction (PI) is widely recognized as an effective active learning strategy. However, real-world evaluations of PI are often limited by logistical constraints and variability in classroom settings. This paper introduces PEERS (Peer Enhanced Educational Realistic Simulation), a simulation framework that integrates Agent-Based Modeling (ABM), Large Language Models (LLMs), and Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) to emulate student learning dynamics. As an initial step, this study focuses on evaluating whether LLM-powered agents can effectively assume the roles of teachers and students within the simulation. Human evaluations and topic-based metrics show that LLMs can generate role-consistent and contextually appropriate classroom dialogues. These results serve as a foundational milestone toward building realistic, AI-driven educational simulations. Future work will include simulating the complete PEERS framework and validating its accuracy through actual classroom-based PI sessions. This research aims to contribute a scalable, cost-effective methodology for studying instructional strategies in controlled yet realistic environments.
abstract_zh: 在教育领域，同伴指导（PI）被广泛认为是一种有效的主动学习策略。然而，现实世界中的 PI 评估往往受到后勤限制和课堂环境变化的限制。本文介绍了 PEERS（同伴增强教育现实模拟），这是一个集成了基于代理的建模 (ABM)、大型语言模型 (LLM) 和贝叶斯知识追踪 (BKT) 的模拟框架，用于模拟学生的学习动态。作为第一步，本研究的重点是评估大语言模型驱动的代理是否可以在模拟中有效地扮演教师和学生的角色。人工评估和基于主题的指标表明，大语言模型可以生成角色一致且适合情境的课堂对话。这些结果是构建现实的、人工智能驱动的教育模拟的基础里程碑。未来的工作将包括模拟完整的 PEERS 框架并通过实际的课堂 PI 课程验证其准确性。这项研究旨在提供一种可扩展的、具有成本效益的方法，用于研究受控但现实的环境中的教学策略。

title: A Large-Scale Real-World Evaluation of anLLM-Based Virtual Teaching Assistant
abstract_en: Virtual Teaching Assistants (VTAs) powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) have the potential to enhance student learning by providing instant feedback and facilitating multi-turn interactions. However, empirical studies on their effectiveness and acceptance in real-world classrooms are limited, leaving their practical impact uncertain. In this study, we develop an LLM-based VTA and deploy it in an introductory AI programming course with 477 graduate students. To assess how student perceptions of the VTA’s performance evolve over time, we conduct three rounds of comprehensive surveys at different stages of the course. Additionally, we analyze 3,869 student–VTA interaction pairs to identify common question types and engagement patterns. We then compare these interactions with traditional student-human instructor interactions to evaluate the VTA’s role in the learning process. Through a large-scale empirical study and interaction analysis, we assess the feasibility of deploying VTAs in real-world classrooms and identify key challenges for broader adoption. Finally, we release the source code of our VTA system, fostering future advancements in AI-driven education.
abstract_zh: 由大型语言模型 (LLM) 提供支持的虚拟助教 (VTA) 有潜力通过提供即时反馈和促进多轮交互来增强学生的学习。然而，关于其在现实课堂中的有效性和接受度的实证研究有限，导致其实际影响不确定。在这项研究中，我们开发了一个基于大语言模型的 VTA，并将其部署到 477 名研究生的人工智能编程入门课程中。为了评估学生对 VTA 表现的看法如何随着时间的推移而变化，我们在课程的不同阶段进行了三轮全面调查。此外，我们还分析了 3,869 个学生与 VTA 互动对，以确定常见问题类型和参与模式。然后，我们将这些交互与传统的学生与教师交互进行比较，以评估 VTA 在学习过程中的作用。通过大规模的实证研究和交互分析，我们评估了在现实世界的课堂中部署 VTA 的可行性，并确定了更广泛采用的关键挑战。最后，我们发布了 VTA 系统的源代码，促进人工智能驱动教育的未来进步。

title: First-Step Advantage: Importance of Starting Right in Multi-Step Math Reasoning
abstract_en: Language models can solve complex reasoning tasks better by learning to generate rationales for their predictions. Often these models know how to solve a task but their auto-regressive decoding nature leads to incorrect results if started incorrectly. We observe that smaller models in particular, when corrected, can solve a task that they would otherwise struggle with. We demonstrate this phenomenon by using a larger model to guide smaller models, which leads to significantly improved performance (up to +24 points on the GSM8K dataset by 7B models). To assist smaller models in initiating the starting step, we propose QuestCoT, where a smaller model first asks how to start before proceeding with a chain of reasoning. On various multistep mathematical reasoning datasets over multiple smaller models, we show that getting the start right can lead to significant performance gains across all models (gains of up to +6 points on GSM8K, +9 on SVAMP, +5 on ASDiv, and +7 on MultiArith).
