To address this, recent research has explored natural language processing (NLP) approaches for automatically predicting item difficulty from text. This paper investigates the use of transformer models to predict the difficulty of second language (L2) English vocabulary test items that have multilingual prompts. We introduce an extended version of the British Council’s Knowledge-based Vocabulary Lists (KVL) dataset, containing 6,768 English words paired with difficulty scores and question prompts written in Spanish, German, and Mandarin Chinese. Using this new dataset for fine-tuning, we explore various transformer-based architectures. Our findings show that a multilingual model jointly trained on all L1 subsets of the KVL achieve the best results, with analysis suggesting that the model is able to learn global patterns of cross-linguistic influence on target word difficulty. This study establishes a foundation for NLP-based item difficulty estimation using the KVL dataset, providing actionable insights for developing multilingual test items.
abstract_zh: 确定测试项目的难度是语言评估开发过程的重要组成部分。然而，传统的项目校准方法通常非常耗时且难以扩展。为了解决这个问题，最近的研究探索了自然语言处理（NLP）方法，用于从文本自动预测项目难度。本文研究了使用 Transformer 模型来预测具有多语言提示的第二语言 (L2) 英语词汇测试项目的难度。我们推出了英国文化协会基于知识的词汇表 (KVL) 数据集的扩展版本，其中包含 6,768 个英语单词，并配有用西班牙语、德语和普通话编写的难度分数和问题提示。使用这个新的数据集进行微调，我们探索了各种基于变压器的架构。我们的研究结果表明，在 KVL 的所有 L1 子集上联合训练的多语言模型取得了最佳结果，分析表明该模型能够学习跨语言影响目标词难度的全局模式。这项研究为使用 KVL 数据集进行基于 NLP 的项目难度估计奠定了基础，为开发多语言测试项目提供了可行的见解。

title: What Causes Knowledge Loss in Multilingual Language Models?
abstract_en: Cross-lingual transfer in natural language processing (NLP) models enhances multilingual performance by leveraging shared linguistic knowledge. However, traditional methods that process all data simultaneously often fail to mimic real-world scenarios, leading to challenges like catastrophic forgetting, where fine-tuning on new tasks degrades performance on previously learned ones. Our study explores this issue in multilingual contexts, focusing on linguistic differences affecting representational learning rather than just model parameters. We experiment with 52 languages using LoRA adapters of varying ranks to evaluate non-shared, partially shared, and fully shared parameters. Our aim is to see if parameter sharing through adapters can mitigate forgetting while preserving prior knowledge. We find that languages using non-Latin scripts are more susceptible to catastrophic forgetting, whereas those written in Latin script facilitate more effective cross-lingual transfer.
abstract_zh: 自然语言处理 (NLP) 模型中的跨语言迁移通过利用共享的语言知识来增强多语言性能。然而，同时处理所有数据的传统方法通常无法模拟现实世界的场景，从而导致灾难性遗忘等挑战，即对新任务的微调会降低先前学习任务的性能。我们的研究在多语言环境中探讨了这个问题，重点关注影响表征学习的语言差异，而不仅仅是模型参数。我们使用不同级别的 LoRA 适配器对 52 种语言进行实验，以评估非共享、部分共享和完全共享参数。我们的目的是看看通过适配器共享参数是否可以在保留先验知识的同时减少遗忘。我们发现使用非拉丁文字的语言更容易遭受灾难性遗忘，而使用拉丁文字书写的语言则有助于更有效的跨语言迁移。

title: Bias Attribution inFilipino Language Models: Extending a Bias Interpretability Metric for Application on Agglutinative Languages
abstract_en: Emerging research on bias attribution and interpretability have revealed how tokens contribute to biased behavior in language models processing English texts. We build on this line of inquiry by adapting the information-theoretic bias attribution score metric for implementation on models handling agglutinative languages—particularly Filipino. We then demonstrate the effectiveness of our adapted method by using it on a purely Filipino model and on three multilingual models—one trained on languages worldwide and two on Southeast Asian data. Our results show that Filipino models are driven towards bias by words pertaining topeople,objects, andrelationships—entity-based themes that stand in contrast to the action-heavy nature of bias-contributing themes in English (i.e.,criminal,sexual, andprosocialbehaviors). These findings point to differences in how English and non-English models process inputs linked to sociodemographic groups and bias.
abstract_zh: 关于偏见归因和可解释性的新兴研究揭示了标记如何导致处理英语文本的语言模型中的偏见行为。我们通过调整信息论偏差归因得分指标来构建这一调查路线，以在处理粘着语言（尤其是菲律宾语）的模型上实施。然后，我们通过在纯菲律宾模型和三个多语言模型上使用我们的改编方法来证明其有效性，其中一个模型接受全球语言训练，两个模型接受东南亚数据。我们的研究结果表明，菲律宾语模型受到与人、物体和关系相关的词语的驱使，这些基于实体的主题与英语中造成偏见的主题（即犯罪、性和亲社会行为）的重行动性质形成鲜明对比。这些发现指出了英语和非英语模​​型处理与社会人口群体和偏见相关的输入的方式存在差异。

title: Curse of bilinguality: Evaluating monolingual and bilingual language models onChinese linguistic benchmarks
abstract_en: We investigate cross-lingual transfer effects in large language models (LLMs) trained on two high-resource languages, English and Chinese. Four monolingual Chinese and four bilingual English–Chinese models are evaluated on two Chinese linguistic benchmarks. The monolingual models consistently outperform the bilingual ones on 12 out of 55 tasks, while the reverse is true for only 4 tasks, highlighting the prevalence of negative (rather than positive) transfer from English to Chinese. Additionally, we carry out a feature attribution analysis in a monolingual and a bilingual model, showing that the differences in their performance may be explained by more predictable attribution patterns in the monolingual model. Our findings have implications for the ongoing effort of training bilingual LLMs.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了用英语和中文这两种高资源语言训练的大型语言模型 (LLM) 的跨语言迁移效应。在两个中文语言基准上评估了四个单语中文模型和四个英汉双语模型。在 55 项任务中，单语模型有 12 项始终优于双语模型，而只有 4 项任务相反，这凸显了从英语到汉语的负迁移（而不是正迁移）的普遍存在。此外，我们在单语和双语模型中进行了特征归因分析，表明它们的表现差异可以通过单语模型中更可预测的归因模式来解释。我们的研究结果对双语大语言模型培训的持续努力具有影响。

title: Multilingual Large Language Models Leak Human Stereotypes across Language Boundaries
abstract_en: Multilingual large language models have gained prominence for their proficiency in processing and generating text across languages. Like their monolingual counterparts, multilingual models are likely to pick up on stereotypes and other social biases during training. In this paper, we study a phenomenon we term “stereotype leakage”, which refers to how training a model multilingually may lead to stereotypes expressed in one language showing up in the models’ behavior in another. We propose a measurement framework for stereotype leakage and investigate its effect in English, Russian, Chinese, and Hindi and with GPT-3.5, mT5, and mBERT. Our findings show a noticeable leakage of positive, negative, and nonpolar associations across all languages. We find that GPT-3.5 exhibits the most stereotype leakage of these models, and Hindi is the most susceptible to leakage effects.
abstract_zh: 多语言大语言模型因其在跨语言处理和生成文本方面的熟练程度而受到关注。与单语言模型一样，多语言模型可能会在训练过程中发现刻板印象和其他社会偏见。在本文中，我们研究了一种称为“刻板印象泄漏”的现象，它指的是多语言训练模型如何导致用一种语言表达的刻板印象出现在另一种语言的模型行为中。我们提出了刻板印象泄漏的测量框架，并使用 GPT-3.5、mT5 和 mBERT 研究了其在英语、俄语、中文和印地语中的影响。我们的研究结果表明，所有语言中的积极、消极和非极性关联都存在明显的泄漏。我们发现 GPT-3.5 在这些模型中表现出最刻板的泄漏，而印地语最容易受到泄漏影响。

title: NotMyNarrative atSemEval-2025 Task 10: Do Narrative Features Share Across Languages in Multilingual Encoder Models?
abstract_en: Narratives are a new tool to propagate ideas that are sometimes well hidden in press articles. The SemEval-2025 Task 10 focuses on detecting and extracting such narratives in multiple languages. In this paper, we explore the capabilities of encoder-based language models to classify texts according to the narrative they contain. We show that multilingual encoders outperform monolingual models on this dataset, which is challenging due to the small number of samples per class per language. We perform additional experiments to measure the generalization of features in multilingual models to new languages.
abstract_zh: 叙述是传播有时隐藏在新闻文章中的想法的新工具。 SemEval-2025 任务 10 侧重于检测和提取多种语言的此类叙述。在本文中，我们探讨了基于编码器的语言模型根据文本所包含的叙述对文本进行分类的能力。我们表明，多语言编码器在此数据集上的性能优于单语言模型，由于每种语言每类的样本数量较少，这具有挑战性。我们进行了额外的实验来测量多语言模型中的特征对新语言的泛化。

title: LazarusNLPatSemEval-2025 Task 11: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Multi-Label Emotion Classification via Sentence-Label Pairing
abstract_en: Multi-label emotion classification in low-resource languages remains challenging due to limited annotated data and model adaptability. To address this, we fine-tune large language models (LLMs) using a sentence-label pairing approach, optimizing efficiency while improving classification performance. Evaluating on Sundanese, Indonesian, and Javanese, our method outperforms conventional classifier-based fine-tuning and achieves strong zero-shot cross-lingual transfer. Notably, our approach ranks first in the Sundanese subset of SemEval-2025 Task 11 Track A. Our findings demonstrate the effectiveness of LLM fine-tuning for low-resource emotion classification, underscoring the importance of tailoring adaptation strategies to specific language families in multilingual contexts.
abstract_zh: 由于注释数据和模型适应性有限，低资源语言中的多标签情感分类仍然具有挑战性。为了解决这个问题，我们使用句子标签配对方法对大型语言模型（LLM）进行微调，在提高分类性能的同时优化效率。对巽他语、印度尼西亚语和爪哇语进行评估，我们的方法优于传统的基于分类器的微调，并实现了强大的零样本跨语言迁移。值得注意的是，我们的方法在 SemEval-2025 任务 11 Track A 的巽他语子集中排名第一。我们的研究结果证明了 LLM 对低资源情感分类进行微调的有效性，强调了在多语言环境中针对特定语系定制适应策略的重要性。

title: Narrlangen atSemEval-2025 Task 10: Comparing (mostly) simple multilingual approaches to narrative classification
abstract_en: Our team focused on Subtask 2 (narrative classification) and tried several conceptually straightforward approaches: (1) prompt engineering of LLMs, (2) a zero-shot approach based on sentence similarities, (3) direct classification of fine-grained labels using SetFit, (4) fine-tuning encoder models on fine-grained labels, and (5) hierarchical classification using encoder models with two different classification heads. We list results for all systems on the development set, which show that the best approach was to fine-tune a pre-trained multilingual model, XLM-RoBERTa, with two additional linear layers and a softmax as classification head.
abstract_zh: 我们的团队专注于子任务 2（叙事分类），并尝试了几种概念上简单的方法：（1）LLM 的快速工程，（2）基于句子相似性的零样本方法，（3）使用 SetFit 对细粒度标签进行直接分类，（4）在细粒度标签上微调编码器模型，以及（5）使用具有两个不同分类头的编码器模型进行分层分类。我们列出了开发集上所有系统的结果，这表明最好的方法是微调预训练的多语言模型 XLM-RoBERTa，并使用两个额外的线性层和一个 softmax 作为分类头。

title: ShouthNLPatSemEval-2025 Task 7: Multilingual Fact-Checking Retrieval Using Contrastive Learning
abstract_en: We present a multilingual fact-checking re-trieval system for the SemEval-2025 task ofmatching social media posts with relevant factchecks. Our approach utilizes a contrastivelearning framework built on the multilingual E5model architecture, fine-tuned on the provideddataset. The system achieves a Success@10score of 0.867 on the official test set, with per-formance variations between languages. Wedemonstrate that input prefixes and language-specific corpus filtering significantly improveretrieval performance. Our analysis reveals in-teresting patterns in cross-lingual transfer, withspecifically strong results on Malaysian andThai languages. We make our code public forfurther research and development.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个多语言事实检查重检索系统，用于将社交媒体帖子与相关事实检查进行匹配的 SemEval-2025 任务。我们的方法利用基于多语言 E5 模型架构构建的对比学习框架，并在提供的数据集上进行了微调。该系统在官方测试集上获得了 0.867 的 Success@10score，但不同语言的性能存在差异。我们证明输入前缀和特定语言的语料库过滤可以显着提高检索性能。我们的分析揭示了跨语言迁移的有趣模式，特别是在马来西亚语和泰语上得到了很好的结果。我们公开我们的代码以供进一步的研究和开发。

title: Detecting Manipulation inUkrainian Telegram: A Transformer-Based Approach to Technique Classification and Span Identification
abstract_en: The Russia-Ukraine war has transformed social media into a critical battleground for information warfare, making the detection of manipulation techniques in online content an urgent security concern. This work presents our system developed for the UNLP 2025 Shared Tasks, which addresses both manipulation technique classification and span identification in Ukrainian Telegram posts. In this paper, we have explored several machine learning approaches (LR, SVC, GB, NB) , deep learning architectures (CNN, LSTM, BiLSTM, GRU hybrid) and state-of-the-art multilingual transformers (mDeBERTa, InfoXLM, mBERT, XLM-RoBERTa). Our experiments showed that fine-tuning transformer models for the specific tasks significantly improved their performance, with XLM-RoBERTa large delivering the best results by securing 3rd place in technique classification task with a Macro F1 score of 0.4551 and 2nd place in span identification task with a span F1 score of 0.6045. These results demonstrate that large pre-trained multilingual models effectively detect subtle manipulation tactics in Slavic languages, advancing the development of tools to combat online manipulation in political contexts.
abstract_zh: 俄罗斯-乌克兰战争已将社交媒体转变为信息战的关键战场，使得在线内容中操纵技术的检测成为紧迫的安全问题。这项工作展示了我们为 UNLP 2025 共享任务开发的系统，该系统解决了乌克兰 Telegram 帖子中的操纵技术分类和跨度识别问题。在本文中，我们探索了几种机器学习方法（LR、SVC、GB、NB）、深度学习架构（CNN、LSTM、BiLSTM、GRU 混合）和最先进的多语言转换器（mDeBERTa、InfoXLM、mBERT、XLM-RoBERTa）。我们的实验表明，针对特定任务的微调 Transformer 模型显着提高了其性能，XLM-RoBERTa Large 提供了最佳结果，在技术分类任务中获得第三名，宏 F1 得分为 0.4551，在跨度识别任务中获得第二名，跨度 F1 得分为 0.6045。这些结果表明，大型预先训练的多语言模型可以有效地检测斯拉夫语言中微妙的操纵策略，从而推动在政治背景下打击在线操纵的工具的开发。

title: Detoxify-IT: AnItalian Parallel Dataset for Text Detoxification
abstract_en: Toxic language online poses growing challenges for content moderation. Detoxification, which rewrites toxic content into neutral form, offers a promising alternative but remains underexplored beyond English. We present Detoxify-IT, the first Italian dataset for this task, featuring toxic comments and their human-written neutral rewrites. Our experiments show that even limited fine-tuning on Italian data leads to notable improvements in content preservation and fluency compared to both multilingual models and LLMs used in zero-shot settings, underlining the need for language-specific resources. This work enables detoxification research in Italian and supports broader efforts toward safer, more inclusive online communication.
abstract_zh:
网上有毒语言给内容审核带来了越来越大的挑战。解毒将有毒内容重写为中性形式，提供了一种有前途的替代方案，但在英语之外仍然没有得到充分探索。我们推出了 Detoxify-IT，这是该任务的第一个意大利数据集，其中包含有毒评论和人工编写的中立重写。我们的实验表明，与零样本设置中使用的多语言模型和大语言模型相比，即使对意大利语数据进行有限的微调，也会在内容保留和流畅性方面带来显着改善，这凸显了对特定语言资源的需求。这项工作使意大利语的戒毒研究成为可能，并支持更广泛的努力，以实现更安全、更具包容性的在线交流。

## 低资源语言 (37 篇)

title: Detection of Human and Machine-Authored Fake News inUrdu
abstract_en: The rise of social media has amplified the spread of fake news, now further complicated by large language models (LLMs) like ChatGPT, which ease the generation of highly convincing, error-free misinformation, making it increasingly challenging for the public to discern truth from falsehood. Traditional fake news detection methods relying on linguistic cues have also become less effective. Moreover, current detectors primarily focus on binary classification and English texts, often overlooking the distinction between machine-generated true vs. fake news and the detection in low-resource languages. To this end, we updated the detection schema to include machine-generated news focusing on Urdu. We further propose a conjoint detection strategy to improve the accuracy and robustness. Experiments show its effectiveness across four datasets in various settings.
abstract_zh: 社交媒体的兴起放大了假新闻的传播，现在像 ChatGPT 这样的大型语言模型 (LLM) 使假新闻的传播变得更加复杂，这些模型缓解了高度令人信服、无错误的错误信息的产生，使公众辨别真假变得越来越困难。依赖语言线索的传统假新闻检测方法也变得不太有效。此外，当前的检测器主要关注二进制分类和英语文本，常常忽略机器生成的真新闻与假新闻之间的区别以及低资源语言的检测。为此，我们更新了检测模式，以包含针对乌尔都语的机器生成新闻。我们进一步提出了联合检测策略来提高准确性和鲁棒性。实验证明了其在不同设置下的四个数据集上的有效性。

title: Building Better: Avoiding Pitfalls in Developing Language Resources when Data is Scarce
abstract_en: Language is a form of symbolic capital that affects people’s lives in many ways (Bourdieu1977,1991). As a powerful means of communication, it reflects identities, cultures, traditions, and societies more broadly. Therefore, data in a given language should be regarded as more than just a collection of tokens. Rigorous data collection and labeling practices are essential for developing more human-centered and socially aware technologies. Although there has been growing interest in under-resourced languages within the NLP community, work in this area faces unique challenges, such as data scarcity and limited access to qualified annotators.In this paper, we collect feedback from individuals directly involved in and impacted by NLP artefacts for medium- and low-resource languages. We conduct both quantitative and qualitative analyses of their responses and highlight key issues related to: (1) data quality, including linguistic and cultural appropriateness; and (2) the ethics of common annotation practices, such as the misuse of participatory research. Based on these findings, we make several recommendations for creating high-quality language artefacts that reflect the cultural milieu of their speakers, while also respecting the dignity and labor of data workers.
abstract_zh: 语言是一种象征资本，它以多种方式影响着人们的生活（Bourdieu1977，1991）。作为一种强大的沟通手段，它更广泛地反映了身份、文化、传统和社会。因此，给定语言中的数据不应被视为只是标记的集合。严格的数据收集和标签实践对于开发更加以人为本和具有社会意识的技术至关重要。尽管 NLP 社区对资源不足的语言越来越感兴趣，但该领域的工作面临着独特的挑战，例如数据稀缺和合格注释者的访问有限。在本文中，我们收集了直接参与中低资源语言 NLP 制品并受其影响的个人的反馈。我们对他们的回答进行定量和定性分析，并强调与以下相关的关键问题：（1）数据质量，包括语言和文化的适当性； (2) 常见注释实践的道德规范，例如参与性研究的滥用。基于这些发现，我们提出了一些建议，以创建反映说话者文化环境的高质量语言制品，同时尊重数据工作者的尊严和劳动。

title: Instruction Tuning on Public Government and Cultural Data for Low-Resource Language: a Case Study inKazakh
abstract_en: Instruction tuning in low-resource languages remains underexplored due to limited text data, particularly in government and cultural domains. To address this, we introduce and open-source a large-scale (10,600 samples) instruction-following (IFT) dataset, covering key institutional and cultural knowledge relevant to Kazakhstan. Our dataset enhances LLMs’ understanding of procedural, legal, and structural governance topics. We employ LLM-assisted data generation, comparing open-weight and closed-weight models for dataset construction, and select GPT-4o as the backbone. Each entity of our dataset undergoes full manual verification to ensure high quality. We also show that fine-tuning Qwen, Falcon, and Gemma on our dataset leads to consistent performance improvements in both multiple-choice and generative tasks, demonstrating the potential of LLM-assisted instruction tuning for low-resource languages.
abstract_zh: 由于文本数据有限，尤其是在政府和文化领域，低资源语言的指令调整仍未得到充分探索。为了解决这个问题，我们引入并开源了一个大规模（10,600 个样本）指令遵循 (IFT) 数据集，涵盖与哈萨克斯坦相关的关键制度和文化知识。我们的数据集增强了大语言模型对程序、法律和结构治理主题的理解。我们采用 LLM 辅助数据生成，比较开放权重和封闭权重模型来构建数据集，并选择 GPT-4o 作为主干。我们数据集的每个实体都经过完整的手动验证，以确保高质量。我们还表明，在我们的数据集上对 Qwen、Falcon 和 Gemma 进行微调可以在多项选择和生成任务中实现一致的性能改进，展示了 LLM 辅助指令调优针对低资源语言的潜力。

title: Multilingual Encoder Knows more than You Realize: Shared Weights Pretraining for Extremely Low-Resource Languages
abstract_en: While multilingual language models like XLM-R have advanced multilingualism in NLP, they still perform poorly in extremely low-resource languages. This situation is exacerbated by the fact that modern LLMs such as LLaMA and Qwen support far fewer languages than XLM-R, making text generation models non-existent for many languages in the world. To tackle this challenge, we propose a novel framework for adapting multilingual encoders to text generation in extremely low-resource languages. By reusing the weights between the encoder and the decoder, our framework allows the model to leverage the learned semantic space of the encoder, enabling efficient learning and effective generalization in low-resource languages. Applying this framework to four Chinese minority languages, we present XLM-SWCM, and demonstrate its superior performance on various downstream tasks even when compared with much larger models.
abstract_zh: 虽然像 XLM-R 这样的多语言模型在 NLP 方面具有先进的多语言能力，但它们在资源极少的语言中仍然表现不佳。由于 LLaMA 和 Qwen 等现代大语言模型支持的语言远少于 XLM-R，导致世界上许多语言不存在文本生成模型，这一事实加剧了这种情况。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，用于使多语言编码器适应资源极少的语言的文本生成。通过重用编码器和解码器之间的权重，我们的框架允许模型利用编码器学习的语义空间，从而实现低资源语言的高效学习和有效泛化。将该框架应用于四种中国少数民族语言，我们提出了 XLM-SWCM，并展示了其在各种下游任务上的优越性能，即使与更大的模型相比也是如此。

title: Multilingual Arbitration: Optimizing Data Pools to Accelerate Multilingual Progress
abstract_en: Synthetic data has driven recent state-of-the-art advancements, but reliance on a single oracle teacher model can lead to model collapse and bias propagation. These issues are particularly severe in multilingual settings, where no single model excels across all languages. In this study, we propose multilingual arbitration, which exploits performance variations among multiple models for each language. By strategically routing samples through a diverse set of models, each with unique strengths, we mitigate these challenges and enhance multilingual performance. Extensive experiments with state-of-the-art models demonstrate that our approach significantly surpasses single-teacher distillation, achieving up to 80% win rates over proprietary and open-weight models like Gemma 2, Llama 3.1, and Mistral v0.3, with the largest improvements in low-resource languages.
abstract_zh: 合成数据推动了最近最先进的进步，但对单一预言机教师模型的依赖可能会导致模型崩溃和偏差传播。这些问题在多语言环境中尤其严重，因为没有一个模型能够胜任所有语言。在本研究中，我们提出了多语言仲裁，它利用每种语言的多个模型之间的性能差异。通过通过一组不同的模型（每个模型都有独特的优势）战略性地路由样本，我们减轻了这些挑战并增强了多语言性能。对最先进模型的大量实验表明，我们的方法显着超越了单教师蒸馏，与 Gemma 2、Llama 3.1 和 Mistral v0.3 等专有和开放权重模型相比，胜率高达 80%，并且在低资源语言方面的改进最大。

title: Partial Colexifications Improve Concept Embeddings
abstract_en: While the embedding of words has revolutionized the field of Natural Language Processing, the embedding of concepts has received much less attention so far. A dense and meaningful representation of concepts, however, could prove useful for several tasks in computational linguistics, especially those involving cross-linguistic data or sparse data from low resource languages. First methods that have been proposed so far embed concepts from automatically constructed colexification networks. While these approaches depart from automatically inferred polysemies, attested across a larger number of languages, they are restricted to the word level, ignoring lexical relations that would only hold for parts of the words in a given language. Building on recently introduced methods for the inference of partial colexifications, we show how they can be used to improve concept embeddings in meaningful ways. The learned embeddings are evaluated against lexical similarity ratings, recorded instances of semantic shift, and word association data. We show that in all evaluation tasks, the inclusion of partial colexifications lead to improved concept representations and better results. Our results further show that the learned embeddings are able to capture and represent different semantic relationships between concepts.
abstract_zh: 虽然单词嵌入彻底改变了自然语言处理领域，但概念嵌入迄今为止受到的关注要少得多。然而，密集且有意义的概念表示对于计算语言学中的多项任务可能是有用的，特别是那些涉及跨语言数据或来自低资源语言的稀疏数据的任务。迄今为止提出的第一种方法嵌入了自动构建的共词化网络中的概念。虽然这些方法偏离了自动推断的多义性，并在大量语言中得到了证明，但它们仅限于单词级别，忽略了仅适用于给定语言中部分单词的词汇关系。基于最近引入的部分共词推理方法，我们展示了如何使用它们以有意义的方式改进概念嵌入。根据词汇相似性评级、记录的语义转移实例和单词关联数据来评估学习到的嵌入。我们表明，在所有评估任务中，包含部分共词可以改善概念表示并获得更好的结果。我们的结果进一步表明，学习到的嵌入能够捕获和表示概念之间的不同语义关系。

title: English-based acoustic models perform well in the forced alignment of twoEnglish-based Pacific Creoles
abstract_en: Expanding the breadth languages used to study sociophonetic variation and change is an important step in the theoretical development of sociophonetics. As data archives grow, forced alignment can accelerate the study of sociophonetic variation in minority languages. This paper examines the application of English and custom-made acoustic models on the alignment of vowels in two Pacific Creoles, Tok Pisin (59 hours) and Bislama (38.5 hours). We find that English models perform acceptably well in both languages, and as well as humans in vowel environments described as ‘Highly Reliable’. Custom models performed better in Bislama than Tok Pisin. We end the paper with recommendations on the use of cross-linguistic acoustic models in the case of English-Based Creoles.
abstract_zh: 扩大用于研究社会语音变异和变化的语言广度是社会语音学理论发展的重要一步。随着数据档案的增长，强制对齐可以加速对少数民族语言的社交语音变异的研究。本文研究了英语和定制声学模型在托克皮辛语（Tok Pisin）（59 小时）和比斯拉马语（38.5 小时）这两种太平洋克里奥尔语元音对齐方面的应用。我们发现英语模型在两种语言中的表现都令人满意，并且在元音环境中的人类模型也被描述为“高度可靠”。定制模型在比斯拉马比托克皮辛表现更好。我们在本文的最后提出了在英语克里奥尔语情况下使用跨语言声学模型的建议。

title: Improving Parallel Sentence Mining for Low-Resource and Endangered Languages
abstract_en: While parallel sentence mining has been extensively covered for fairly well-resourced languages, pairs involving low-resource languages have received comparatively little attention.To address this gap, we present Belopsem, a benchmark of new datasets for parallel sentence mining on three language pairs where the source side is low-resource and endangered: Occitan-Spanish, Upper Sorbian-German, and Chuvash-Russian. These combinations also reflect varying linguistic similarity within each pair. We compare three language models in an established parallel sentence mining pipeline and apply two types of improvements to one of them, Glot500. We observe better mining quality overall by both applying alignment post-processing with an unsupervised aligner and using a cluster-based isotropy enhancement technique. These findings are crucial for optimising parallel data extraction for low-resource languages in a realistic way.
abstract_zh: 虽然并行句子挖掘已广泛应用于资源相当丰富的语言，但涉及资源匮乏的语言对却受到相对较少的关注。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了 Belopsem，这是针对源端资源匮乏且濒临灭绝的三种语言对进行并行句子挖掘的新数据集的基准：奥克西唐语-西班牙语、上索布语-德语和楚瓦什语-俄语。这些组合还反映了每对中不同的语言相似性。我们比较了已建立的并行句子挖掘管道中的三种语言模型，并对其中之一（Glot500）应用了两种类型的改进。通过使用无监督对准器应用对准后处理和使用基于集群的各向同性增强技术，我们观察到总体上更好的挖掘质量。这些发现对于以现实的方式优化低资源语言的并行数据提取至关重要。

title: Cross-Lingual Representation Alignment Through Contrastive Image-Caption Tuning
abstract_en: Multilingual alignment of sentence representations has mostly required bitexts to bridge the gap between languages. We investigate whether visual information can bridge this gap instead. Image caption datasets are very easy to create without requiring multilingual expertise, so this offers a more efficient alternative for low-resource languages. We find that multilingual image-caption alignment can implicitly align the text representations between languages, languages unseen by the encoder in pretraining can be incorporated into this alignment post-hoc, and these aligned representations are usable for cross-lingual Natural Language Understanding (NLU) and bitext retrieval.
abstract_zh: 句子表示的多语言对齐主要需要双文本来弥合语言之间的差距。我们研究视觉信息是否可以弥补这一差距。图像字幕数据集非常容易创建，无需多语言专业知识，因此这为资源匮乏的语言提供了更有效的替代方案。我们发现多语言图像标题对齐可以隐式对齐语言之间的文本表示，编码器在预训练中未看到的语言可以事后合并到这种对齐中，并且这些对齐的表示可用于跨语言自然语言理解（NLU）和双文本检索。

title: Rethinking Full Finetuning from Pretraining Checkpoints in Active Learning forAfrican Languages
abstract_en: Active learning (AL) aims to reduce annotation effort by iteratively selecting the most informative samples for labeling. The dominant strategy in AL involves fully finetuning the model on all acquired data after each round, which is computationally expensive in multilingual and low-resource settings. This paper investigatescontinual finetuning(CF), an alternative update strategy where the model is updated only on newly acquired samples at each round. We evaluate CF against full finetuning (FA) across 28 African languages using MasakhaNEWS and SIB-200. Our analysis reveals three key findings. First, CF matches or outperforms FA for languages included in the model’s pretraining, achieving up to 35% reductions in GPU memory, FLOPs, and training time. Second, CF performs comparably even for languages not seen during pretraining when they are typologically similar to those that were. Third, CF’s effectiveness depends critically on uncertainty-based acquisition; without it, performance deteriorates significantly. While FA remains preferable for some low-resource languages, the overall results establish CF as a robust, cost-efficient alternative for active learning in multilingual NLP. These findings motivate developing hybrid AL strategies that adapt fine-tuning behavior based on pretraining coverage, language typology, and acquisition dynamics.
abstract_zh: 主动学习（AL）旨在通过迭代选择信息最丰富的样本进行标记来减少注释工作。 AL 中的主导策略是在每轮之后根据所有获取的数据对模型进行完全微调，这在多语言和资源匮乏的环境中计算成本很高。本文研究了连续微调（CF），这是一种替代更新策略，其中模型仅在每轮新获取的样本上进行更新。我们使用 MasakhaNEWS 和 SIB-200 来评估 28 种非洲语言的 CF 与完全微调 (FA)。我们的分析揭示了三个关键发现。首先，对于模型预训练中包含的语言，CF 与 FA 相匹配或优于 FA，可将 GPU 内存、FLOP 和训练时间减少高达 35%。其次，即使对于预训练期间未见过的语言，当它们在类型上与那些语言相似时，CF 的表现也相当。第三，CF的有效性关键取决于基于不确定性的收购；如果没有它，性能会显着下降。虽然 FA 对于某些资源匮乏的语言来说仍然更可取，但总体结果表明 CF 是多语言 NLP 主动学习的稳健、经济高效的替代方案。这些发现激励开发混合 AL 策略，根据预训练覆盖范围、语言类型和习得动态来调整微调行为。

title: HYPEROFA: ExpandingLLMVocabulary to New Languages via Hypernetwork-Based Embedding Initialization
abstract_en: Many pre-trained language models (PLMs) exhibit suboptimal performance on mid- and low-resource languages, largely due to limited exposure to these languages during pre-training. A common strategy to address this is to introduce new tokens specific to the target languages, initialize their embeddings, and apply continual pre-training on target-language data. Among such methods, OFA (Liu et al., 2024a) proposes a similarity-based subword embedding initialization heuristic that is both effective and efficient. However, OFA restricts target-language token embeddings to be convex combinations of a fixed number of source-language embeddings, which may limit expressiveness. To overcome this limitation, we propose HYPEROFA, a hypernetwork-based approach for more adaptive token embedding initialization. The hypernetwork is trained to map from an external multilingual word vector space to the PLM’s token embedding space using source-language tokens. Once trained, it can generate flexible embeddings for target-language tokens, serving as a good starting point for continual pretraining. Experiments demonstrate that HYPEROFA consistently outperforms random initialization baseline and matches or exceeds the performance of OFA in both continual pre-training convergence and downstream task performance. We make the code publicly available.
abstract_zh: 许多预训练语言模型 (PLM) 在中低资源语言上表现出次优性能，这主要是由于在预训练期间对这些语言的接触有限。解决这个问题的常见策略是引入特定于目标语言的新标记，初始化其嵌入，并对目标语言数据应用持续的预训练。在这些方法中，OFA（Liu et al., 2024a）提出了一种基于相似性的子词嵌入初始化启发式方法，该方法既有效又高效。然而，OFA 将目标语言标记嵌入限制为固定数量源语言嵌入的凸组合，这可能会限制表达能力。为了克服这个限制，我们提出了 HYPEROFA，一种基于超网络的方法，用于更具适应性的令牌嵌入初始化。超网络经过训练，可以使用源语言标记从外部多语言词向量空间映射到 PLM 的标记嵌入空间。经过训练后，它可以为目标语言标记生成灵活的嵌入，作为持续预训练的良好起点。实验表明，HYPEROFA 始终优于随机初始化基线，并且在持续预训练收敛和下游任务性能方面均匹配或超过 OFA 的性能。我们将代码公开。

title: Fact from Fiction: Finding Serialized Novels in Newspapers
abstract_en: Digitized literary corpora of the 19th century favor canonical and novelistic forms, sidelining a broader and more diverse literary production. Serialized fiction – widely read but embedded in newspapers – remains especially underexplored, particularly in low-resource languages like Danish. This paper addresses this gap by developing methods to identify fiction in digitized Danish newspapers (1818–1848).We (1) introduce a manually annotated dataset of 1,394 articles and (2) evaluate classification pipelines using both selected linguistic features and embeddings, achieving F1-scores of up to 0.91. Finally, we (3) analyze feuilleton fiction via interpretable features to test its drift in discourse from neighboring nonfiction.Our results support the construction of alternative literary corpora and contribute to ongoing work on modeling the fiction–nonfiction boundary by operationalizing discourse-level distinctions at scale.
abstract_zh: 19 世纪的数字化文学语料库偏爱经典和小说形式，而忽视了更广泛、更多样化的文学作品。连载小说——被广泛阅读但嵌入报纸——仍然未被充分开发，特别是在丹麦语等资源匮乏的语言中。本文通过开发识别数字化丹麦报纸（1818-1848）中小说的方法来解决这一差距。我们（1）引入了包含 1,394 篇文章的手动注释数据集，（2）使用选定的语言特征和嵌入来评估分类管道，实现高达 0.91 的 F1 分数。最后，我们（3）通过可解释的特征来分析小品小说，以测试其在话语中与邻近非小说类作品的漂移。我们的结果支持另类文学语料库的构建，并有助于通过大规模操作话语层面的区别来建模小说与非小说类边界的正在进行的工作。

title: The Linguistic Connectivities Within Large Language Models
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable multilingual abilities in various applications. Unfortunately, recent studies have discovered that there exist notable disparities in their performance across different languages. Understanding the underlying mechanisms behind such disparities is crucial ensuring equitable access to LLMs for a global user base. Therefore, this paper conducts a systematic investigation into the behaviors of LLMs across 27 different languages on 3 different scenarios, and reveals a Linguistic Map correlates with the richness of available resources and linguistic family relations. Specifically, high-resource languages within specific language family exhibit greater knowledge consistency and mutual information dissemination, while isolated or low-resource languages tend to remain marginalized. Our research sheds light on a deep understanding of LLM’s cross-language behavior, highlights the inherent biases in LLMs within multilingual environments and underscores the need to address these inequities.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在各种应用中表现出了卓越的多语言能力。不幸的是，最近的研究发现，不同语言的表现存在显着差异。了解这种差异背后的根本机制对于确保全球用户群公平获得大语言模型学位至关重要。因此，本文对 27 种不同语言的大语言模型在 3 个不同场景下的行为进行了系统调查，并揭示了与可用资源的丰富性和语言家族关系相关的语言图。具体而言，特定语系中的高资源语言表现出更大的知识一致性和相互信息传播，而孤立或低资源语言往往保持边缘化。我们的研究揭示了对大语言模型跨语言行为的深入理解，强调了大语言模型在多语言环境中固有的偏见，并强调解决这些不平等问题的必要性。

title: Qorǵau: Evaluating Safety inKazakh-Russian Bilingual Contexts
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are known to have the potential to generate harmful content, posing risks to users. While significant progress has been made in developing taxonomies for LLM risks and safety evaluation prompts, most studies have focused on monolingual contexts, primarily in English. However, language- and region-specific risks in bilingual contexts are often overlooked, and core findings can diverge from those in monolingual settings. In this paper, we introduce Qorǵau, a novel dataset specifically designed for safety evaluation in Kazakh and Russian, reflecting the unique bilingual context in Kazakhstan, where both Kazakh (a low-resource language) and Russian (a high-resource language) are spoken. Experiments with both multilingual and language-specific LLMs reveal notable differences in safety performance, emphasizing the need for tailored, region-specific datasets to ensure the responsible and safe deployment of LLMs in countries like Kazakhstan. Warning: this paper contains example data that may be offensive, harmful, or biased.
abstract_zh: 众所周知，大型语言模型 (LLM) 有可能生成有害内容，给用户带来风险。虽然在开发大语言模型风险分类法和安全评估提示方面取得了重大进展，但大多数研究都集中在单语环境（主要是英语）上。然而，双语环境中特定于语言和地区的风险常常被忽视，核心发现可能与单语环境中的结果有所不同。在本文中，我们介绍了 Qorǵau，这是一个专门为哈萨克语和俄语安全评估而设计的新型数据集，反映了哈萨克斯坦独特的双语环境，该国同时使用哈萨克语（一种低资源语言）和俄语（一种高资源语言）。多语言和特定语言大语言模型的实验揭示了安全性能的显着差异，强调需要定制的、针对特定地区的数据集，以确保大语言模型在哈萨克斯坦等国家负责任和安全的部署。警告：本文包含可能令人反感、有害或有偏见的示例数据。

title: Investigating and Scaling up Code-Switching for Multilingual Language Model Pre-Training
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable multilingual capabilities despite the extreme language imbalance in the pre-training data. In this paper, we closely examine the reasons behind this phenomenon, focusing on the pre-training corpus. We find that the existence of code-switching, alternating between different languages within a context, is key to multilingual capabilities. We conduct an analysis to investigate code-switching in the pre-training corpus, examining its presence and categorizing it into four types within two quadrants. We then assess its impact on multilingual performance. These types of code-switching data are unbalanced in proportions and demonstrate different effects on facilitating language transfer. To better explore the power of code-switching for language alignment during pre-training, we investigate the strategy of synthetic code-switching. We continuously scale up the synthetic code-switching data and observe remarkable improvements in both benchmarks and representation space. Extensive experiments indicate that incorporating synthetic code-switching data enables better language alignment and generalizes well to high, medium, and low-resource languages with pre-training corpora of varying qualities.
abstract_zh: 尽管预训练数据中存在极端的语言不平衡，大型语言模型（LLM）仍表现出卓越的多语言能力。在本文中，我们仔细研究了这种现象背后的原因，重点关注预训练语料库。我们发现，语码转换的存在，即在上下文中不同语言之间的交替，是多语言能力的关键。我们进行了一项分析，以调查预训练语料库中的语码转换，检查其存在并将其分为两个象限内的四种类型。然后我们评估其对多语言性能的影响。这些类型的语码转换数据比例不平衡，对促进语言迁移表现出不同的效果。为了更好地探索预训练过程中语言对齐的语码转换的力量，我们研究了合成语码转换的策略。我们不断扩大合成的代码转换数据，并观察到基准和表示空间的显着改进。大量实验表明，合并合成的语码转换数据可以实现更好的语言对齐，并通过不同质量的预训练语料库很好地推广到高、中、低资源语言。

title: MiLiC-Eval: Benchmarking MultilingualLLMs forChina’s Minority Languages
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) excel in high-resource languages but struggle with low-resource languages (LRLs), particularly those spoken by minority communities in China, such as Tibetan, Uyghur, Kazakh, and Mongolian. To systematically track the progress in these languages, we introduce MiLiC-Eval, a benchmark designed for minority languages in China, featuring 24K instances across 9 tasks. MiLiC-Eval focuses on underrepresented writing systems. Its parallelism between tasks and languages can provide a faithful and fine-grained assessment of linguistic and problem-solving skills. Our evaluation reveals that open-source LLMs perform poorly on syntax-intensive tasks and multi-script languages. We further demonstrate how MiLiC-Eval can help advance LRL research in handling diverse writing systems and understanding the process of language adaptation.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在高资源语言方面表现出色，但在低资源语言 (LRL) 方面表现不佳，尤其是中国少数民族社区使用的语言，如藏语、维吾尔语、哈萨克语和蒙古语。为了系统地跟踪这些语言的进展，我们引入了 MiLiC-Eval，这是一个专为中国小语种设计的基准测试，具有跨 9 项任务的 24K 实例。 MiLiC-Eval 专注于代表性不足的书写系统。它的任务和语言之间的并行性可以提供对语言和解决问题的技能的忠实和细粒度的评估。我们的评估表明，开源大语言模型在语法密集型任务和多脚本语言上表现不佳。我们进一步展示了 MiLiC-Eval 如何帮助推进 LRL 研究，以处理不同的书写系统和理解语言适应过程。

title: BenNumEval: A Benchmark to AssessLLMs’ Numerical Reasoning Capabilities inBengali
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate exceptional proficiency in general-purpose tasks but struggle with numerical reasoning, particularly in low-resource languages like Bengali. Despite advancements, limited research has explored their numerical reasoning capabilities in these languages. To address this gap, we present BenNumEval (Bengali Numerical Evaluation), a benchmark designed to assess LLMs on numerical reasoning tasks in Bengali. It comprises six diverse tasks and a total of 3.2k samples curated from real-world problem-solving scenarios. Our extensive evaluations reveal that even with advanced prompting techniques such as Cross-Lingual Prompting (XLP) and Cross-Lingual Chain-of-Thought Prompting (XCoT), LLMs fall notably short of human-level performance, particularly when using Bengali Native Prompting (BNaP). These findings underscore the substantial gap between current LLM capabilities and human expertise in numerical reasoning, highlighting the need for more robust and linguistically inclusive AI models to advance Bengali Language Processing and equitable AI development. The source code for the system and evaluation pipeline is publicly available on GitHub.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在通用任务中表现出卓越的熟练程度，但在数字推理方面表现不佳，尤其是在孟加拉语等资源匮乏的语言中。尽管取得了进步，但探索这些语言的数字推理能力的研究仍然有限。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了 BenNumEval（孟加拉语数值评估），这是一个旨在评估大语言模型孟加拉语数字推理任务的基准。它包含六项不同的任务和从现实世界的问题解决场景中精选的总共 3,200 个样本。我们的广泛评估表明，即使使用跨语言提示 (XLP) 和跨语言思维链提示 (XCoT) 等先进的提示技术，大语言模型的表现仍明显低于人类水平，特别是在使用孟加拉语母语提示 (BNaP) 时。这些发现强调了当前大语言模型的能力与人类在数字推理方面的专业知识之间的巨大差距，强调需要更强大和具有语言包容性的人工智能模型来推进孟加拉语语言处理和公平的人工智能开发。该系统和评估管道的源代码可在 GitHub 上公开获取。

title: AdaptiveLoRAMerge with Parameter Pruning for Low-Resource Generation
abstract_en: This study proposes a simple yet effective LoRA merge method to achieve LLM adaptation for low-resource language generation tasks. The LoRA merge technique, which integrates multiple LoRA modules trained on different tasks, has gained attention as an effective and efficient approach for adapting LLMs to target tasks. However, previous methods are limited in adaptability as they keep the LoRA parameters frozen. Additionally, the low-resource problem has been out of their scope. We propose a LoRA merge method that updates and prunes LoRA parameters through fine-tuning with minimal target task data, which allows finer-grained adjustments of LoRA parameters and enhancement of task adaptability. Extensive experiments have been conducted taking summarization as a benchmark task. Our datasets cover various domains and multiple languages of English and Japanese. The results confirm that the proposed method achieves significant and consistent improvements in task adaptability over the previous methods.
abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种简单而有效的 LoRA 合并方法，以实现 LLM 对低资源语言生成任务的适应。 LoRA 合并技术集成了在不同任务上训练的多个 LoRA 模块，作为使 LLM 适应目标任务的有效且高效的方法而受到关注。然而，以前的方法在适应性方面受到限制，因为它们保持 LoRA 参数冻结。此外，资源匮乏问题已经超出了他们的范围。我们提出了一种 LoRA 合并方法，通过用最少的目标任务数据进行微调来更新和修剪 LoRA 参数，从而可以更细粒度地调整 LoRA 参数并增强任务适应性。以总结为基准任务进行了大量的实验。我们的数据集涵盖英语和日语的各个领域和多种语言。结果证实，所提出的方法比以前的方法在任务适应性方面取得了显着且一致的改进。

title: Dialect Normalization using Large Language Models and Morphological Rules
abstract_en: Natural language understanding systems struggle with low-resource languages, including many dialects of high-resource ones. Dialect-to-standard normalization attempts to tackle this issue by transforming dialectal text so that it can be used by standard-language tools downstream. In this study, we tackle this task by introducing a new normalization method that combines rule-based linguistically informed transformations and large language models (LLMs) with targeted few-shot prompting, without requiring any parallel data. We implement our method for Greek dialects and apply it on a dataset of regional proverbs, evaluating the outputs using human annotators. We then use this dataset to conduct downstream experiments, finding that previous results regarding these proverbs relied solely on superficial linguistic information, including orthographic artifacts, while new observations can still be made through the remaining semantics.
abstract_zh: 自然语言理解系统很难处理低资源语言，包括高资源语言的许多方言。方言到标准规范化试图通过转换方言文本来解决这个问题，以便下游的标准语言工具可以使用它。在本研究中，我们通过引入一种新的规范化方法来解决此任务，该方法将基于规则的语言通知转换和大型语言模型（LLM）与有针对性的几次提示相结合，而不需要任何并行数据。我们针对希腊方言实现了我们的方法，并将其应用于区域谚语数据集，使用人类注释器评估输出。然后，我们使用该数据集进行下游实验，发现之前有关这些谚语的结果仅依赖于表面语言信息，包括拼写错误，而仍然可以通过剩余的语义进行新的观察。

title: TituLLMs: A Family ofBanglaLLMs with Comprehensive Benchmarking
abstract_en: In this paper, we present TituLLMs, the first large pretrained Bangla LLMs, available in 1b and 3b parameter sizes. Due to computational constraints during both training and inference, we focused on smaller models. To train TituLLMs, we collected a pretraining dataset of approximately ∼ 37 billion tokens. We extended the Llama-3.2 tokenizer to incorporate language- and culture-specific knowledge, which also enables faster training and inference. There was a lack of benchmarking datasets to benchmark LLMs for Bangla. To address this gap, we developed five benchmarking datasets. We benchmarked various LLMs, including TituLLMs, and demonstrated that TituLLMs outperforms its initial multilingual versions. However, this is not always the case, highlighting the complexities of language adaptation. Our work lays the groundwork for adapting existing multilingual open models to other low-resource languages. To facilitate broader adoption and further research, we have made the TituLLMs models and benchmarking datasets publicly available.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 TituLLM，这是第一个大型预训练的 Bangla LLM，可提供 1b 和 3b 参数大小。由于训练和推理期间的计算限制，我们专注于较小的模型。为了训练 TituLLM，我们收集了大约 ∼ 370 亿个代币的预训练数据集。我们扩展了 Llama-3.2 分词器，以纳入特定于语言和文化的知识，这也可以实现更快的训练和推理。缺乏基准数据集来对孟加拉大语言模型进行基准测试。为了解决这一差距，我们开发了五个基准测试数据集。我们对包括 TituLLM 在内的各种 LLM 进行了基准测试，并证明 TituLLM 的性能优于其最初的多语言版本。然而，情况并非总是如此，凸显了语言适应的复杂性。我们的工作为将现有的多语言开放模型适应其他资源匮乏的语言奠定了基础。为了促进更广泛的采用和进一步的研究，我们公开了 TituLLM 模型和基准数据集。

title: Dictionaries to the Rescue: Cross-Lingual Vocabulary Transfer for Low-Resource Languages Using Bilingual Dictionaries
abstract_en: Cross-lingual vocabulary transfer plays a promising role in adapting pre-trained language models to new languages, including low-resource languages.Existing approaches that utilize monolingual or parallel corpora face challenges when applied to languages with limited resources.In this work, we propose a simple yet effective vocabulary transfer method that utilizes bilingual dictionaries, which are available for many languages, thanks to descriptive linguists.Our proposed method leverages a property of BPE tokenizers where removing a subword from the vocabulary causes a fallback to shorter subwords.The embeddings of target subwords are estimated iteratively by progressively removing them from the tokenizer.The experimental results show that our approach outperforms existing methods for low-resource languages, demonstrating the effectiveness of a dictionary-based approach for cross-lingual vocabulary transfer.
abstract_zh: 跨语言词汇迁移在使预先训练的语言模型适应新语言（包括资源匮乏的语言）方面发挥着大有前途的作用。利用单语或并行语料库的现有方法在应用于资源有限的语言时面临着挑战。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种简单而有效的词汇迁移方法，该方法利用双语词典，由于描述性语言学家，该词典可用于多种语言。我们提出的方法利用了 BPE 分词器的属性，从词汇中删除子词会导致回退到较短的子词。通过逐步从标记器中删除目标子词的嵌入来迭代估计它们。实验结果表明，我们的方法优于低资源语言的现有方法，证明了基于字典的跨语言词汇迁移方法的有效性。

title: Supervised Machine Learning basedAmharic Text Complexity Classification Using Automatic Annotator Tool
abstract_en: Understanding written content can vary significantly based on the linguistic complexity of the text. In the context of Amharic, a morphologically rich and low-resource language, the use of complex vocabulary and less frequent expressions often hinders understanding, particularly among readers with limited literacy skills. Such complexity poses challenges for both human comprehension and NLP applications. Addressing this complexity in Amharic is therefore important for text readability and accessibility. In this study, we developed a text complexity annotation tool using curated list of 1,113 complex Amharic terms. Utilizing this tool, we collected and annotated a dataset comprising 20,000 sentences. Based on the annotated corpus, we developed a text complexity classification model using both traditional and deep learning approaches. For traditional machine learning models, the dataset was vectorized using the Bag-of-Words representation. For deep learning and pre-trained models, we implemented embedding layers based on Word2Vec and BERT, trained on a vocabulary consisting of 24,148 tokens. The experiment is conducted using Support Vector Machine and Random Forest for classical machine learning, and Long Short-Term Memory, Bidirectional LSTM, and BERT for deep learning and pre-trained models. The classification accuracies achieved were 83.5% for SVM, 80.3% for RF, 84.1% for LSTM, 85.0% for BiLSTM, and 89.4% for the BERT-based model. Among these, the BERT-based approaches shows optimal performance for text complexity classifications which have abilityto capture long-range dependencies and contextual relationships within the text.
abstract_zh: 根据文本的语言复杂性，对书面内容的理解可能会有很大差异。阿姆哈拉语是一种形态丰富但资源匮乏的语言，在阿姆哈拉语中，复杂的词汇和不太频繁的表达方式的使用往往会阻碍理解，特别是对于识字能力有限的读者来说。这种复杂性给人类理解和 NLP 应用带来了挑战。因此，解决阿姆哈拉语的这种复杂性对于文本的可读性和可访问性非常重要。在本研究中，我们使用 1,113 个复杂阿姆哈拉语术语的精选列表开发了一种文本复杂性注释工具。利用这个工具，我们收集并注释了一个包含 20,000 个句子的数据集。基于带注释的语料库，我们使用传统和深度学习方法开发了文本复杂性分类模型。对于传统的机器学习模型，数据集使用词袋表示进行矢量化。对于深度学习和预训练模型，我们实现了基于 Word2Vec 和 BERT 的嵌入层，并在包含 24,148 个标记的词汇表上进行了训练。该实验使用支持向量机和随机森林进行经典机器学习，使用长短期记忆、双向 LSTM 和 BERT 进行深度学习和预训练模型。 SVM 的分类准确率为 83.5%，RF 为 80.3%，LSTM 为 84.1%，BiLSTM 为 85.0%，基于 BERT 的模型为 89.4%。其中，基于 BERT 的方法显示了文本复杂性分类的最佳性能，能够捕获文本内的远程依赖性和上下文关系。

title: Who Wrote This? Identifying Machine vs Human-Generated Text inHausa
abstract_en: The advancement of large language models (LLMs) has allowed them to be proficient in various tasks, including content generation. However, their unregulated usage can lead to malicious activities such as plagiarism and generating and spreading fake news, especially for low-resource languages. Most existing machine-generated text detectors are trained on high-resource languages like English, French, etc. In this study, we developed the first large-scale detector that can distinguish between human- and machine-generated content in Hausa. We scraped seven Hausa-language media outlets for the human-generated text and the Gemini-2.0 flash model to automatically generate the corresponding Hausa-language articles based on the human-generated article headlines. We fine-tuned four pre-trained African-centric models (AfriTeVa, AfriBERTa, AfroX LMR, and AfroXLMR-76L) on the resulting dataset and assessed their performance using accuracy and F1-score metrics. AfroXLMR achieved the highest performance with an accuracy of 99.23% and an F1 score of 99.21%, demonstrating its effectiveness for Hausa text detection. Our dataset is made publicly available to enable further research.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的进步使他们能够精通各种任务，包括内容生成。然而，它们不受管制的使用可能会导致恶意活动，例如剽窃以及生成和传播假新闻，特别是对于资源匮乏的语言。大多数现有的机器生成的文本检测器都接受过英语、法语等高资源语言的训练。在这项研究中，我们开发了第一个可以区分豪萨语中人类和机器生成内容的大型检测器。我们抓取了七个豪萨语媒体的人工生成文本，并使用 Gemini-2.0 flash 模型根据人工生成的文章标题自动生成相应的豪萨语文章。我们在生成的数据集上微调了四个预先训练的以非洲为中心的模型（AfriTeVa、AfriBERTa、AfroX LMR 和 AfroXLMR-76L），并使用准确性和 F1 分数指标评估了它们的性能。 AfroXLMR 取得了最高的性能，准确率为 99.23%，F1 分数为 99.21%，证明了其对豪萨语文本检测的有效性。我们的数据集已公开，以便进一步研究。

title: Towards a Real-timeSwedish Speech Analyzer for Language Learning Games: A HybridAIApproach to Language Assessment
abstract_en: This paper presents an automatic speech assessment system designed for Swedish language learners. We introduce a novel hybrid approach that integrates Microsoft Azure speech services with open-source Large Language Models (LLMs). Our system is implemented as a web-based application that provides real-time quick assessment with a game-like experience. Through testing against COREFL English corpus data and Swedish L2 speech data, our system demonstrates effectiveness in distinguishing different language proficiencies, closely aligning with CEFR levels. This ongoing work addresses the gap in current low-resource language assessment technologies with a pilot system developed for automated speech analysis.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种专为瑞典语学习者设计的自动言语评估系统。我们引入了一种新颖的混合方法，将 Microsoft Azure 语音服务与开源大型语言模型 (LLM) 集成。我们的系统作为基于网络的应用程序实现，提供实时快速评估和游戏般的体验。通过针对 COREFL 英语语料库数据和瑞典语 L2 语音数据的测试，我们的系统展示了区分不同语言能力的有效性，与 CEFR 水平紧密结合。这项正在进行的工作通过为自动语音分析开发的试点系统来解决当前资源匮乏的语言评估技术的差距。

title: Few-Shot Prompting, Full-Scale Confusion: Evaluating Large Language Models for Humor Detection inCroatian Tweets
abstract_en: Humor detection in low-resource languages is hampered by cultural nuance and subjective annotation. We test two large language models, GPT-4 and Gemini 2.5 Flash, on labeling humor in 6,000 Croatian tweets with expert gold labels generated through a rigorous annotation pipeline. LLM–human agreement (κ = 0.28) matches human–human agreement (κ = 0.27), while LLM–LLM agreement is substantially higher (κ = 0.63). Although concordance with expert adjudication is lower, additional metrics imply that the models equal a second human annotator while working far faster and at negligible cost. These findings suggest, even with simple prompting, LLMs can efficiently bootstrap subjective datasets and serve as practical annotation assistants in linguistically under-represented settings.
abstract_zh: 低资源语言中的幽默检测受到文化差异和主观注释的阻碍。我们测试了两种大型语言模型 GPT-4 和 Gemini 2.5 Flash，在 6,000 条克罗地亚推文中标记幽默，并使用通过严格的注释管道生成的专家黄金标签。 LLM-人类一致性 (κ = 0.28) 与人与人类一致性 (κ = 0.27) 相匹配，而 LLM-LLM 一致性要高得多 (κ = 0.63)。尽管与专家裁决的一致性较低，但额外的指标意味着模型相当于第二个人类注释者，同时工作速度更快且成本可以忽略不计。这些发现表明，即使有简单的提示，大语言模型也可以有效地引导主观数据集，并在语言代表性不足的环境中充当实用的注释助手。

title: Dialects, Topic Models, and Border Effects: TheRusyn Case
abstract_en: In this contribution, we present, discuss, and apply a data-driven approach for analyzing varieties of the Slavic minority language Carpathian Rusyn spoken in different countries in the Carpathian region. Using topic modeling, a method originally developed for text mining, we show that the Rusyn varieties are subject to border effects, i.e., vertical convergence and horizontal divergence, due to language contacts with their respective umbrella languages Polish, Slovak and Standard Ukrainian. Additionally, we show that the method is suitable for uncovering fieldworker isoglosses, i.e., different transcription principles in an otherwise homogeneous dataset.
abstract_zh: 在这篇文章中，我们提出、讨论和应用一种数据驱动的方法来分析喀尔巴阡地区不同国家使用的斯拉夫少数民族语言喀尔巴阡鲁森语的变体。使用主题建模（一种最初为文本挖掘而开发的方法），我们发现 Rusyn 变体由于与各自的保护语言波兰语、斯洛伐克语和标准乌克兰语的语言接触而受到边界效应的影响，即垂直趋同和水平发散。此外，我们表明该方法适用于揭示现场工作人员的同义语，即在同质数据集中的不同转录原则。

title: Towards Open Foundation Language Model and Corpus forMacedonian: A Low-Resource Language
abstract_en: The increase in technological adoption worldwide comes with demands for novel tools to be used by the general population. Large Language Models (LLMs) provide a great opportunity in this respect, but their capabilities remain limited for low-resource languages, restricting applications in countries where such languages are spoken. We create several resources to facilitate the adoption of LLMs and to support research advancements for Macedonian. We collect the largest Macedonian corpus to date, consisting of 40GB of textual data and totaling 3.5B words. To support conversational applications, we collect a 106k-instance instruction dataset, carefully built to be culturally grounded. For evaluation, we construct a Macedonian evaluation suite covering seven benchmarks. Finally, we train domestic-yak, a state-of-the-art 8B-parameter model, on our curated datasets and evaluate it against eight baseline models using the newly constructed benchmark suite. Our model outperforms all existing models in the 8B parameter range across all benchmarks, and achieves performance comparable to models up to 10× larger. Furthermore, a qualitative analysis with native speakers reveals that our model is preferred over larger counterparts, receiving higher ratings for grammatical correctness and cultural appropriateness. All datasets, code, and model weights are openly released, setting a foundation for advancing LLMs in similarly underrepresented languages. These resources are publicly available at https://github.com/LVSTCK for source code, and at https://huggingface.co/LVSTCK for pretrained model weights and data.
abstract_zh: 全球技术采用的增加伴随着对普通大众使用新工具的需求。大型语言模型（LLM）在这方面提供了很好的机会，但它们的能力对于资源匮乏的语言仍然有限，限制了在使用此类语言的国家的应用。我们创建了多种资源来促进大语言模型的采用并支持马其顿语的研究进展。我们收集了迄今为止最大的马其顿语语料库，包含 40GB 文本数据，总共 3.5B 个单词。为了支持对话式应用程序，我们收集了一个包含 106k 实例的指令数据集，这些数据集经过精心构建，具有文化基础。为了进行评估，我们构建了一个涵盖七个基准的马其顿评估套件。最后，我们在我们策划的数据集上训练了 Domestic-yak（一种最先进的 8B 参数模型），并使用新构建的基准套件针对八个基线模型对其进行了评估。我们的模型在所有基准测试中的 8B 参数范围内均优于所有现有模型，并且其性能可与高达 10 倍大的模型相媲美。此外，对母语人士的定性分析表明，我们的模型比更大的模型更受青睐，在语法正确性和文化适当性方面获得了更高的评价。所有数据集、代码和模型权重均公开发布，为以类似的代表性不足的语言推进大语言模型奠定了基础。这些资源可在 https://github.com/LVSTCK 上公开获取源代码，在 https://huggingface.co/LVSTCK 上公开获取预训练模型权重和数据。

title: Compositionality and Event Retrieval in Complement Coercion: A Study of Language Models in a Low-resource Setting
abstract_en: In sentences such as John began the book, the complement noun, lexically denoting an entity, is interpreted as an event. This phenomenon is known in linguistics as complement coercion: the event associated with the verb is not overtly expressed but can be recovered from the meanings of other constituents, context and world knowledge. We investigate whether language models (LMs) can exploit sentence structure and compositional meaning to recover plausible events in complement coercion. For the first time, we tested different LMs in Norwegian, a low-resource language with high syntactic variation in coercion constructions across aspectual verbs. Results reveal that LMs struggle with retrieving plausible events and with ranking them above less plausible ones. Moreover, we found that LMs do not exploit the compositional properties of coercion sentences in their predictions.
abstract_zh: 在诸如约翰开始这本书之类的句子中，补语名词在词汇上表示一个实体，被解释为一个事件。这种现象在语言学中被称为补语强制：与动词相关的事件不是公开表达的，而是可以从其他成分、上下文和世界知识的含义中恢复。我们研究语言模型（LM）是否可以利用句子结构和组成意义来恢复补体强制中的合理事件。我们第一次用挪威语测试了不同的语言模型，挪威语是一种资源匮乏的语言，在跨体动词的强制结构中具有很高的句法变化。结果表明，语言模型很难检索出合理的事件，并将其排在不太合理的事件之上。此外，我们发现语言模型在预测中没有利用强制句子的组成特性。

title: Multilingual Symptom Detection on Social Media: Enhancing Health-related Fact-checking withLLMs
abstract_en: Social media has emerged as a valueable source for early pandemic detection, as repeated mentions of symptoms by users may signal the onset of an outbreak. However, to be a reliable system, validation through fact-checking and verification against official health records is essential. Without this step, systems risk spreading misinformation to the public. The effectiveness of these systems also depend on their ability to process data in multiple languages, given the multilingual nature of social media data.Yet, many NLP datasets and disease surveillance system remain heavily English-centric, leading to significant performance gaps for low-resource languages.This issue is especially critical in Southeast Asia, where symptom expression may vary culturally and linguistically.Therefore, this study evaluates the symptom detection capabilities of LLMs in social media posts across multiple languages, models, and symptoms to enhance health-related fact-checking. Our results reveal significant language-based discrepancies, with European languages outperforming under-resourced Southeast Asian languages. Furthermore, we identify symptom-specific challenges, particularly in detecting respiratory illnesses such as influenza, which LLMs tend to overpredict.The overestimation or misclassification of symptom mentions can lead to false alarms or public misinformation when deployed in real-world settings. This underscores the importance of symptom detection as a critical first step in medical fact-checking within early outbreak detection systems.
abstract_zh: 社交媒体已成为早期大流行检测的宝贵来源，因为用户反复提及症状可能预示着疫情爆发。然而，要成为一个可靠的系统，通过事实核查和官方健康记录验证进行验证至关重要。如果没有这一步，系统就有向公众传播错误信息的风险。鉴于社交媒体数据的多语言性质，这些系统的有效性还取决于它们处理多种语言数据的能力。然而，许多 NLP 数据集和疾病监测系统仍然严重以英语为中心，导致资源匮乏的语言存在显着的性能差距。这个问题在东南亚尤其重要，因为那里的症状表达可能因文化和语言而异。因此，本研究评估了大语言模型在跨多种语言、模型和症状的社交媒体帖子中的症状检测能力，以加强与健康相关的事实核查。我们的结果揭示了基于语言的显着差异，欧洲语言的表现优于资源贫乏的东南亚语言。此外，我们还确定了特定症状的挑战，特别是在检测流感等呼吸道疾病方面，大语言模型往往会高估这些疾病。在现实环境中部署时，对症状提及的高估或错误分类可能会导致误报或公众错误信息。这强调了症状检测作为早期疫情检测系统中医学事实检查的关键第一步的重要性。

title: WoNBias: A Dataset for Classifying Bias & Prejudice Against Women inBengali Text
abstract_en: This paper presents WoNBias, a curated Bengali dataset to identify gender-based biases, stereotypes, and harmful language directed at women. It merges digital sources- social media, blogs, news- with offline tactics comprising surveys and focus groups, alongside some existing corpora to compile a total of 31,484 entries (10,656 negative; 10,170 positive; 10,658 neutral). WoNBias reflects the sociocultural subtleties of bias in both Bengali digital and offline conversations. By bridging online and offline biased contexts, the dataset supports content moderation, policy interventions, and equitable NLP research for Bengali, a low-resource language critically underserved by existing tools. WoNBias aims to combat systemic gender discrimination against women on digital platforms, empowering researchers and practitioners to combat harmful narratives in Bengali-speaking communities.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 WoNBias，这是一个精心策划的孟加拉语数据集，用于识别针对女性的基于性别的偏见、刻板印象和有害语言。它将数字来源（社交媒体、博客、新闻）与包括调查和焦点小组在内的线下策略以及一些现有语料库相结合，总共编制了 31,484 个条目（10,656 个负面条目；10,170 个正面条目；10,658 个中立条目）。 WoNBias 反映了孟加拉数字和线下对话中偏见的社会文化微妙之处。通过弥合线上和线下有偏见的环境，该数据集支持孟加拉语的内容审核、政策干预和公平的 NLP 研究，孟加拉语是一种资源匮乏的语言，现有工具的服务严重不足。 WoNBias 旨在打击数字平台上针对女性的系统性性别歧视，使研究人员和从业者能够打击孟加拉语社区中的有害叙事。

title: Assessing Gender Bias of PretrainedBangla Language Models inSTEMandSHAPEFields
abstract_en: Gender bias continues to shape societal perceptions across both STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) and SHAPE (Social Sciences, Humanities, and the Arts for People and the Economy) domains. While existing studies have explored such biases in English language models, similar analyses in Bangla—spoken by over 240 million people—remain scarce. In this work, we investigate gender-profession associations in Bangla language models. We introducePokkhopat, a curated dataset of gendered terms and profession-related words across STEM and SHAPE disciplines. Using a suite of embedding-based bias detection methods—including WEAT, ECT, RND, RIPA, and cosine similarity visualizations—we evaluate 11 Bangla language models. Our findings show that several widely-used open-source Bangla NLP models (e.g., sagorsarker/bangla-bert-base) exhibit significant gender bias, underscoring the need for more inclusive and bias-aware development in low-resource languages like Bangla. We also find that many STEM and SHAPE-related words are absent from these models’ vocabularies, complicating bias detection and possibly amplifying existing biases. This emphasizes the importance of incorporating more diverse and comprehensive training data to mitigate such biases moving forward. Code available athttps://github.com/HerWILL-Inc/ACL-2025/.
abstract_zh: 性别偏见继续影响着 STEM（科学、技术、工程和数学）和 SHAPE（社会科学、人文以及人类与经济艺术）领域的社会观念。尽管现有研究已经探讨了英语语言模型中的此类偏差，但对超过 2.4 亿人使用的孟加拉语进行的类似分析仍然很少。在这项工作中，我们研究了孟加拉语言模型中的性别职业关联。我们介绍 Pokhopat，这是一个跨 STEM 和 SHAPE 学科的性别术语和职业相关单词的精选数据集。使用一套基于嵌入的偏差检测方法（包括 WEAT、ECT、RND、RIPA 和余弦相似性可视化），我们评估了 11 种孟加拉语言模型。我们的研究结果表明，几种广泛使用的开源孟加拉语 NLP 模型（例如 sagorsarker/bangla-bert-base）表现出明显的性别偏见，这强调了在孟加拉语等低资源语言中进行更具包容性和偏见意识的开发的必要性。我们还发现这些模型的词汇表中缺少许多与 STEM 和 SHAPE 相关的单词，这使得偏差检测变得复杂，并可能放大现有偏差。这强调了纳入更多样化和更全面的训练数据以减轻此类偏见的重要性。代码可在 https://github.com/HerWILL-Inc/ACL-2025/ 获取。

title: Can Perplexity Predict Finetuning Performance? An Investigation of Tokenization Effects on Sequential Language Models forNepali
abstract_en: The impact of subword tokenization on language model performance is well-documented for perplexity, with finer granularity consistently reducing this intrinsic metric. However, research on how different tokenization schemes affect a model’s understanding capabilities remains limited, particularly for non-Latin script languages. Addressing this gap, we conducted a comprehensive evaluation of six distinct tokenization strategies by pretraining transformer-based language models for Nepali and evaluating their performance across multiple downstream tasks. While recent prominent models like GPT, RoBERTa, Claude, LLaMA, Mistral, Falcon, and MPT have adopted byte-level BPE tokenization, our findings demonstrate that for Nepali, SentencePiece tokenization consistently yields superior results on understanding-based tasks. Unlike previous studies that primarily focused on BERT-based architectures, our research specifically examines sequential transformer models, providing valuable insights for language model development in low-resource languages and highlighting the importance of tokenization strategy beyond perplexity reduction.
abstract_zh: 子词标记化对语言模型性能的影响有据可查，因为更细的粒度会不断降低这一内在指标。然而，关于不同标记化方案如何影响模型理解能力的研究仍然有限，特别是对于非拉丁脚本语言。为了解决这一差距，我们通过预训练尼泊尔语基于 Transformer 的语言模型并评估其在多个下游任务中的表现，对六种不同的标记化策略进行了全面评估。虽然最近的著名模型，如 GPT、RoBERTa、Claude、LLaMA、Mistral、Falcon 和 MPT 都采用了字节级 BPE 标记化，但我们的研究结果表明，对于尼泊尔语，SentencePiece 标记化在基于理解的任务上始终能产生优异的结果。与之前主要关注基于 BERT 的架构的研究不同，我们的研究专门研究了顺序 Transformer 模型，为低资源语言中的语言模型开发提供了宝贵的见解，并强调了标记化策略在减少复杂性之外的重要性。

title: FiRC-NLPatSemEval-2025 Task 11: To Prompt or to Fine-Tune? Approaches for Multilingual Emotion Classification
abstract_en: In this paper, we describe our system devel-oped for participation in SemEval-2025 Task11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based EmotionDetection. We compare three approaches formultilingual, multi-label emotion classification:XLM-R, an ensemble of models (XLM-5), anda prompt-based approach. We evaluate the per-formance of these models across a diverse setof languages, ranging from high-resource tolow-resource languages
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们描述了为参与 SemEval-2025 Task11：弥合基于文本的情绪检测中的差距而开发的系统。我们比较了三种多语言、多标签情感分类方法：XLM-R、模型集成 (XLM-5) 和基于提示的方法。我们评估这些模型在多种语言（从高资源语言到低资源语言）中的性能

title: SemEval-2025 Task 7: Multilingual and Crosslingual Fact-Checked Claim Retrieval
abstract_en: The rapid spread of online disinformation presents a global challenge, and machine learning has been widely explored as a potential solution. However, multilingual settings and low-resource languages are often neglected in this field. To address this gap, we conducted a shared task on multilingual claim retrieval at SemEval 2025, aimed at identifying fact-checked claims that match newly encountered claims expressed in social media posts across different languages. The task includes two subtracks: 1) a monolingual track, where social posts and claims are in the same language 2) a crosslingual track, where social posts and claims might be in different languages. A total of 179 participants registered for the task contributing to 52 test submissions. 23 out of 31 teams have submitted their system papers. In this paper, we report the best-performing systems as well as the most common and the most effective approaches across both subtracks. This shared task, along with its dataset and participating systems, provides valuable insights into multilingual claim retrieval and automated fact-checking, supporting future research in this field.
abstract_zh: 在线虚假信息的快速传播构成了全球性挑战，而机器学习作为一种潜在的解决方案已被广泛探索。然而，多语言环境和资源匮乏的语言在这一领域经常被忽视。为了解决这一差距，我们在 SemEval 2025 上开展了一项关于多语言声明检索的共享任务，旨在识别与不同语言的社交媒体帖子中新遇到的声明相匹配的经过事实检查的声明。该任务包括两个子轨道：1）单语言轨道，其中社交帖子和声明使用同一种语言；2）跨语言轨道，其中社交帖子和声明可能使用不同语言。共有 179 名参与者注册了该任务，提交了 52 份测试。 31 个团队中有 23 个团队提交了系统论文。在本文中，我们报告了两个子轨道中性能最佳的系统以及最常见和最有效的方法。这项共享任务及其数据集和参与系统为多语言索赔检索和自动事实检查提供了宝贵的见解，支持该领域的未来研究。

title: Transforming CausalLLMintoMLMEncoder for Detecting Social Media Manipulation in Telegram
abstract_en: We participated in the Fourth UNLP shared task on detecting social media manipulation in Ukrainian Telegram posts, addressing both multilabel technique classification and token-level span identification. We propose two complementary solutions: for classification, we fine-tune the decoder-only model with class-balanced grid-search thresholding and ensembling. For span detection, we convert causal LLM into a bidirectional encoder via masked language modeling pretraining on large Ukrainian and Russian news corpora before fine-tuning. Our solutions achieve SOTA metric results on both shared task track. Our work demonstrates the efficacy of bidirectional pretraining for decoder-only LLMs and robust threshold optimization, contributing new methods for disinformation detection in low-resource languages.
abstract_zh: 我们参与了第四次 UNLP 共享任务，即检测乌克兰 Telegram 帖子中的社交媒体操纵行为，解决多标签技术分类和令牌级跨度识别问题。我们提出了两种互补的解决方案：对于分类，我们通过类平衡网格搜索阈值和集成来微调仅解码器模型。对于跨度检测，我们在微调之前通过对大型乌克兰和俄罗斯新闻语料库进行掩码语言建模预训练，将因果 LLM 转换为双向编码器。我们的解决方案在两个共享任务轨道上均实现了 SOTA 指标结果。我们的工作证明了仅解码器 LLM 的双向预训练和强大的阈值优化的有效性，为低资源语言中的虚假信息检测提供了新方法。

title: Exploring Multilingual Probing in Large Language Models: A Cross-Language Analysis
abstract_en: Probing techniques for large language models (LLMs) have primarily focused on English, overlooking the vast majority of other world’s languages. In this paper, we extend these probing methods to a multilingual context, investigating how LLMs encode linguistic structures across diverse languages. We conduct experiments on several open-source LLM models, analyzing probing accuracy, trends across layers, and similarities between probing vectors for multiple languages. Our key findings reveal: (1) a consistent performance gap between high-resource and low-resource languages, with high-resource languages achieving significantly higher probing accuracy; (2) divergent layer-wise accuracy trends, where high-resource languages show substantial improvement in deeper layers similar to English; and (3) higher representational similarities among high-resource languages, with low-resource languages demonstrating lower similarities both among themselves and with high-resource languages. These results provide insights into how linguistic structures are represented differently across languages in LLMs and emphasize the need for improved structure modeling for low-resource languages.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 的探测技术主要集中在英语上，忽略了世界上绝大多数其他语言。在本文中，我们将这些探索方法扩展到多语言环境，研究大语言模型如何跨不同语言编码语言结构。我们对几个开源 LLM 模型进行了实验，分析探测准确性、跨层趋势以及多种语言探测向量之间的相似性。我们的主要发现揭示了：（1）高资源语言和低资源语言之间存在一致的性能差距，高资源语言实现了显着更高的探测精度； (2) 不同层次的准确率趋势，其中高资源语言在类似于英语的更深层次上表现出显着的改进； (3) 高资源语言之间具有较高的代表性相似性，而低资源语言之间以及与高资源语言之间的相似性较低。这些结果提供了关于大语言模型中语言结构如何以不同的方式表示的见解，并强调了改进低资源语言的结构建模的必要性。

title: Combining Automated and Manual Data for Effective Downstream Fine-Tuning of Transformers for Low-Resource Language Applications
abstract_en: This paper addresses the constraints of down-stream applications of pre-trained language models (PLMs) for low-resource languages. These constraints are pre-train data deficiency preventing a low-resource language from being well represented in a PLM and inaccessibility of high-quality task-specific data annotation that limits task learning. We propose to use automatically labeled texts combined with manually annotated data in a two-stage task fine-tuning approach. The experiments revealed that utilizing such methodology combined with vocabulary adaptation may compensate for the absence of a targeted PLM or the deficiency of manually annotated data. The methodology is validated on the morphological tagging task for the Udmurt language. We publish our best model that achieved 93.25% token accuracy on HuggingFace Hub along with the training code1.
abstract_zh: 本文解决了低资源语言的预训练语言模型（PLM）下游应用的限制。这些限制包括训练前数据不足，导致低资源语言无法在 PLM 中得到很好的表示，以及无法访问高质量的特定于任务的数据注释，从而限制了任务学习。我们建议在两阶段任务微调方法中使用自动标记的文本与手动注释的数据相结合。实验表明，利用这种方法与词汇适应相结合可以弥补目标 PLM 的缺失或手动注释数据的不足。该方法在乌德穆尔特语言的形态标记任务中得到了验证。我们在 HuggingFace Hub 上发布了达到 93.25% 标记准确率的最佳模型以及训练代码1。

title: Delving into Multilingual Ethical Bias: TheMSQADwith Statistical Hypothesis Tests for Large Language Models
abstract_en: Despite the recent strides in large language models, studies have underscored the existence of social biases within these systems. In this paper, we delve into the validation and comparison of the ethical biases of LLMs concerning globally discussed and potentially sensitive topics, hypothesizing that these biases may arise from language-specific distinctions. Introducing the Multilingual Sensitive Questions & Answers Dataset (**MSQAD**), we collected news articles from Human Rights Watch covering 17 topics, and generated socially sensitive questions along with corresponding responses in multiple languages. We scrutinized the biases of these responses across languages and topics, employing two statistical hypothesis tests. The results showed that the null hypotheses were rejected in most cases, indicating biases arising from cross-language differences. It demonstrates that ethical biases in responses are widespread across various languages, and notably, these biases were prevalent even among different LLMs. By making the proposed MSQAD openly available, we aim to facilitate future research endeavors focused on examining cross-language biases in LLMs and their variant models.
abstract_zh: 尽管大型语言模型最近取得了长足的进步，但研究强调了这些系统中存在社会偏见。在本文中，我们深入研究了大语言模型关于全球讨论和潜在敏感主题的道德偏见的验证和比较，假设这些偏见可能源于特定于语言的差异。引入多语言敏感问题与解答数据集 (**MSQAD**)，我们收集了人权观察组织涵盖 17 个主题的新闻文章，并生成了社会敏感问题以及多种语言的相应回复。我们采用两种统计假设检验，仔细检查了这些跨语言和主题的回答的偏差。结果表明，在大多数情况下，零假设被拒绝，表明跨语言差异引起的偏差。它表明，反应中的道德偏见在各种语言中普遍存在，值得注意的是，这些偏见甚至在不同的大语言模型中也很普遍。通过公开提议的 MSQAD，我们的目标是促进未来的研究工作，重点是检查大语言模型及其变体模型中的跨语言偏差。

title: On the Mutual Influence of Gender and Occupation inLLMRepresentations
abstract_en: We examine LLM representations of gender for first names in various occupational contexts to study how occupations and the gender perception of first names in LLMs influence each other mutually. We find that LLMs’ first-name gender representations correlate with real-world gender statistics associated with the name, and are influenced by the co-occurrence of stereotypically feminine or masculine occupations. Additionally, we study the influence of first-name gender representations on LLMs in a downstream occupation prediction task and their potential as an internal metric to identify extrinsic model biases. While feminine first-name embeddings often raise the probabilities for female-dominated jobs (and vice versa for male-dominated jobs), reliably using these internal gender representations for bias detection remains challenging.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了大语言模型在各种职业背景下名字的性别表征，以研究大语言模型中职业和名字的性别认知如何相互影响。我们发现大语言模型的名字性别表征与与名字相关的现实世界性别统计数据相关，并且受到刻板印象中女性或男性职业同时出现的影响。此外，我们研究了名字性别表征对下游职业预测任务中大语言模型的影响，以及它们作为识别外在模型偏差的内部指标的潜力。虽然女性名字嵌入通常会提高女性主导工作的概率（反之亦然，男性主导工作也如此），但可靠地使用这些内部性别表征进行偏见检测仍然具有挑战性。

title: White Men Lead, Black Women Help? Benchmarking and Mitigating Language Agency Social Biases inLLMs
abstract_en: Social biases can manifest in language agency. However, very limited research has investigated such biases in Large Language Model (LLM)-generated content. In addition, previous works often rely on string-matching techniques to identify agentic and communal words within texts, falling short of accurately classifying language agency. We introduce the **Language Agency Bias Evaluation (LABE)** benchmark, which comprehensively evaluates biases in LLMs by analyzing agency levels attributed to different demographic groups in model generations. LABE tests for gender, racial, and intersectional language agency biases in LLMs on 3 text generation tasks: biographies, professor reviews, and reference letters. Using LABE, we unveil language agency social biases in 3 recent LLMs: ChatGPT, Llama3, and Mistral. We observe that: (1) LLM generations tend to demonstrate greater gender bias than human-written texts; (2) Models demonstrate remarkably higher levels of intersectional bias than the other bias aspects. (3) Prompt-based mitigation is unstable and frequently leads to bias exacerbation. Based on our observations, we propose **Mitigation via Selective Rewrite (MSR)**, a novel bias mitigation strategy that leverages an agency classifier to identify and selectively revise parts of generated texts that demonstrate communal traits. Empirical results prove MSR to be more effective and reliable than prompt-based mitigation method, showing a promising research direction.
abstract_zh: 社会偏见可以体现在语言能动性中。然而，调查大型语言模型 (LLM) 生成内容中的此类偏差的研究非常有限。此外，以前的工作通常依赖于字符串匹配技术来识别文本中的代理词和公共词，无法对语言代理进行准确分类。我们引入了**语言代理偏见评估（LABE）**基准，该基准通过分析模型生成中不同人口群体的代理水平来综合评估大语言模型的偏见。 LABE 在 3 项文本生成任务上测试大语言模型的性别、种族和交叉语言机构偏见：传记、教授评论和推荐信。使用 LABE，我们揭示了最近 3 个大语言模型中的语言机构社会偏见：ChatGPT、Llama3 和 Mistral。我们观察到：（1）大语言模型一代往往比人类书写的文本表现出更大的性别偏见； (2) 模型表现出比其他偏差方面明显更高水平的交叉偏差。 (3) 基于提示的缓解不稳定，经常导致偏差加剧。根据我们的观察，我们提出**通过选择性重写（MSR）进行缓解**，这是一种新颖的偏见缓解策略，它利用机构分类器来识别和选择性地修改生成的文本中表现出共同特征的部分。实证结果证明MSR比基于提示的缓解方法更有效、更可靠，显示出一个有前途的研究方向。

title: The MaleCEOand the Female Assistant: Evaluation and Mitigation of Gender Biases in Text-To-Image Generation of Dual Subjects
abstract_en: Recent large-scale T2I models like DALLE-3 have made progress in reducing gender stereotypes when generating single-person images. However, significant biases remain when generating images with more than one person. To systematically evaluate this, we propose the **Paired Stereotype Test (PST)** framework, which queries T2I models to depict two individuals assigned with male-stereotyped and female-stereotyped social identities, respectively (e.g. “a CEO” and “an Assistant”). This contrastive setting often triggers T2I models to generate gender-stereotyped images. Using PST, we evaluate two aspects of gender biases – the well-known **bias in gendered occupation** and a novel aspect: **bias in organizational power**. Experiments show that **over 74% images generated by DALLE-3 display gender-occupational biases**. Additionally, compared to single-person settings, DALLE-3 is more likely to perpetuate male-associated stereotypes under PST. We further propose **FairCritic**, a novel and interpretable framework that leverages an LLM-based critic model to i) detect bias in generated images, and ii) adaptively provide feedback to T2I models for improving fairness. FairCritic achieves near-perfect fairness on PST, overcoming the limitations of previous prompt-based intervention approaches.
abstract_zh: 最近的大型 T2I 模型（如 DALLE-3）在生成单人图像时减少性别刻板印象方面取得了进展。然而，当生成超过一个人的图像时，仍然存在显着的偏差。为了系统地评估这一点，我们提出了**配对刻板印象测试（PST）**框架，该框架查询T2I模型来描述分别被分配了男性刻板印象和女性刻板印象社会身份的两个人（例如“首席执行官”和“助理”）。这种对比设置通常会触发 T2I 模型生成性别刻板印象。使用 PST，我们评估了性别偏见的两个方面——众所周知的**性别职业偏见**和一个新颖的方面：**组织权力偏见**。实验表明，**DALLE-3 生成的超过 74% 的图像显示出性别职业偏见**。此外，与单人环境相比，DALLE-3 更有可能在 PST 下延续与男性相关的刻板印象。我们进一步提出 **FairCritic**，这是一种新颖且可解释的框架，它利用基于 LLM 的批评者模型来 i）检测生成图像中的偏差，以及 ii）自适应地向 T2I 模型提供反馈以提高公平性。 FairCritic 在 PST 上实现了近乎完美的公平性，克服了之前基于提示的干预方法的局限性。

title: GenderAlign: An Alignment Dataset for Mitigating Gender Bias in Large Language Models
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are prone to generating content that exhibits gender biases, raising significant ethical concerns. Alignment, the process of fine-tuning LLMs to better align with desired behaviors, is recognized as an effective approach to mitigate gender biases. Although proprietary LLMs have made significant strides in mitigating gender bias, their alignment datasets are not publicly available. The commonly used and publicly available alignment dataset, HH-RLHF, still exhibits gender bias to some extent. There is a lack of publicly available alignment datasets specifically designed to address gender bias. Hence, we developed a new dataset named GenderAlign, aiming at mitigating a comprehensive set of gender biases in LLMs. This dataset comprises 8k single-turn dialogues, each paired with a “chosen” and a “rejected” response. Compared to the “rejected” responses, the “chosen” responses demonstrate lower levels of gender bias and higher quality. Furthermore, we categorized the gender biases in the “rejected” responses of GenderAlign into 4 principal categories. The experimental results show the effectiveness of GenderAlign in reducing gender bias in LLMs.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 很容易生成表现出性别偏见的内容，引发严重的道德问题。调整是对大语言模型进行微调以更好地符合所需行为的过程，被认为是减轻性别偏见的有效方法。尽管专有大语言模型在减轻性别偏见方面取得了重大进展，但其一致性数据集并未公开。常用且公开的比对数据集 HH-RLHF 在一定程度上仍然表现出性别偏见。缺乏专门为解决性别偏见而设计的公开可用的对齐数据集。因此，我们开发了一个名为 GenderAlign 的新数据集，旨在减轻大语言模型中的一系列全面的性别偏见。该数据集包含 8k 个单轮对话，每个对话都配有一个“选择”和一个“拒绝”响应。与“拒绝”的回复相比，“选择”的回复表现出较低程度的性别偏见和较高的质量。此外，我们将 GenderAlign“拒绝”的回复中的性别偏见分为 4 个主要类别。实验结果显示了 GenderAlign 在减少大语言模型性别偏见方面的有效性。

title: Understanding Large Language Model Vulnerabilities to Social Bias Attacks
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become foundational in human-computer interaction, demonstrating remarkable linguistic capabilities across various tasks. However, there is a growing concern about their potential to perpetuate social biases present in their training data. In this paper, we comprehensively investigate the vulnerabilities of contemporary LLMs to various social bias attacks, including prefix injection, refusal suppression, and learned attack prompts. We evaluate popular models such as LLaMA-2, GPT-3.5, and GPT-4 across gender, racial, and religious bias types. Our findings reveal that models are generally more susceptible to gender bias attacks compared to racial or religious biases. We also explore novel aspects such as cross-bias and multiple-bias attacks, finding varying degrees of transferability across bias types. Additionally, our results show that larger models and pretrained base models often exhibit higher susceptibility to bias attacks. These insights contribute to the development of more inclusive and ethically responsible LLMs, emphasizing the importance of understanding and mitigating potential bias vulnerabilities. We offer recommendations for model developers and users to enhance the robustness of LLMs against social bias attacks.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 已成为人机交互的基础，在各种任务中展示了卓越的语言能力。然而，人们越来越担心它们可能会延续训练数据中存在的社会偏见。在本文中，我们全面研究了当代大语言模型对各种社会偏见攻击的脆弱性，包括前缀注入、拒绝抑制和学习攻击提示。我们评估了跨性别、种族和宗教偏见类型的 LLaMA-2、GPT-3.5 和 GPT-4 等流行模型。我们的研究结果表明，与种族或宗教偏见相比，模型通常更容易受到性别偏见的攻击。我们还探索了交叉偏见和多重偏见攻击等新颖的方面，发现跨偏见类型的不同程度的可转移性。此外，我们的结果表明，较大的模型和预训练的基础模型通常对偏差攻击表现出更高的敏感性。这些见解有助于发展更具包容性和道德责任感的大语言模型，强调理解和减轻潜在偏见漏洞的重要性。我们为模型开发者和用户提供建议，以增强大语言模型抵御社会偏见攻击的稳健性。

title: TheAIGap: How Socioeconomic Status Affects Language Technology Interactions
abstract_en: Socioeconomic status (SES) fundamentally influences how people interact with each other and, more recently, with digital technologies like large language models (LLMs). While previous research has highlighted the interaction between SES and language technology, it was limited by reliance on proxy metrics and synthetic data. We survey 1,000 individuals from ‘diverse socioeconomic backgrounds’ about their use of language technologies and generative AI, and collect 6,482 prompts from their previous interactions with LLMs. We find systematic differences across SES groups in language technology usage (i.e., frequency, performed tasks), interaction styles, and topics.
