title: Pre-annotation Matters: A Comparative Study onPOSand Dependency Annotation for anAlsatian Dialect
abstract_en: The annotation of corpora for lower-resource languages can benefit from automatic pre-annotation to increase the throughput of the annotation process in a a context where human resources are scarce. However, this can be hindered by the lack of available pre-annotation tools. In this work, we compare three pre-annotation methods in zero-shot or near-zero-shot contexts for part-of-speech (POS) and dependency annotation of an Alsatian Alemannic dialect. Our study shows that good levels of annotation quality can be achieved, with human annotators adapting their correction effort to the perceived quality of the pre-annotation. The pre-annotation tools also vary in efficiency depending on the task, with better global results for a system trained on closely related languages and dialects.
abstract_zh: 资源较低的语言的语料库注释可以受益于自动预注释，以在人力资源稀缺的情况下提高注释过程的吞吐量。然而，由于缺乏可用的预注释工具，这可能会受到阻碍。在这项工作中，我们比较了零样本或接近零样本上下文中阿尔萨斯阿勒曼尼方言的词性（POS）和依存注释的三种预注释方法。我们的研究表明，通过人类注释者根据预注释的感知质量调整其校正工作，可以实现良好的注释质量水平。预注释工具的效率也因任务而异，对于经过密切相关的语言和方言训练的系统来说，具有更好的全局结果。

title: Where it’s at: Annotating Verb Placement Types in Learner Language
abstract_en: The annotation of learner language is an often ambiguous and challenging task. It is therefore surprising that in Second Language Acquisition research, information on annotation quality is hardly ever published. This is also true for verb placement, a linguistic feature that has re- ceived much attention within SLA. This paper presents an annotation on verb placement in German learner texts at different proficiency levels. We argue that as part of the annotation process target hypotheses should be provided as ancillary annotations that make explicit each annotator’s interpretation of a learner sentence. Our study demonstrates that verb placement can be annotated with high agreement between multiple annotators, for texts at all proficiency levels and across sentences of varying complex- ity. We release our corpus with annotations by four annotators on more than 600 finite clauses sampled across 5 CEFR levels.
abstract_zh: 学习者语言的注释通常是一项模糊且具有挑战性的任务。因此，令人惊讶的是，在第二语言习得研究中，有关注释质量的信息几乎从未发表过。对于动词位置也是如此，这是一种在 SLA 中受到广泛关注的语言特征。本文对不同熟练程度的德语学习者文本中的动词位置进行了注释。我们认为，作为注释过程的一部分，目标假设应该作为辅助注释提供，以明确每个注释者对学习者句子的解释。我们的研究表明，对于所有熟练程度的文本以及不同复杂程度的句子，动词位置可以在多个注释者之间以高度一致性进行注释。我们发布了我们的语料库，其中包含四位注释者对跨 5 个 CEFR 级别采样的 600 多个有限子句的注释。

title: ICLE-RC: International Corpus of LearnerEnglish for Relative Clauses
abstract_en: We present the ICLE-RC, a corpus of learner English texts annotated for relative clauses and related phenomena. The corpus contains a collection of 144 academic essays from the International Corpus of Learner English (ICLE; Granger et al., 2002), representing six L1 backgrounds – Finnish, Italian, Polish, Swedish, Turkish, and Urdu. These texts are annotated for over 900 relative clauses, with respect to a wide array of lexical, syntactic, semantic, and discourse features. The corpus also provides annotation of over 400 related phenomena (it-clefts, pseudo-clefts, existential-relatives, etc.). Here, we describe the corpus annotation framework, report on the IAA study, discuss the prospects of (semi-)automating annotation, and present the first results from our corpus analysis. We envisage the ICLE-RC to be used as a valuable resource for research on relative clauses in SLA, language typology, World Englishes, and discourse analysis.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了 ICLE-RC，这是一个学习英语文本的语料库，带有关系从句和相关现象的注释。该语料库包含来自国际英语学习者语料库（ICLE；Granger 等，2002）的 144 篇学术论文，代表了六种 L1 背景：芬兰语、意大利语、波兰语、瑞典语、土耳其语和乌尔都语。这些文本针对广泛的词汇、句法、语义和篇章特征对 900 多个关系从句进行了注释。该语料库还提供了 400 多种相关现象的注释（it-cleaves、pseudo-cleaves、existential-relatives 等）。在这里，我们描述了语料库注释框架，报告了 IAA 研究，讨论了（半）自动化注释的前景，并展示了我们语料库分析的第一个结果。我们设想 ICLE-RC 将成为研究 SLA 相关子句、语言类型学、世界英语和话语分析的宝贵资源。

title: ExpLay: A new Corpus Resource for the Research on Expertise as an Influential Factor on Language Production
abstract_en: This paper introduces the ExpLay-Pipeline, a novel semi-automated processing tool designed for the analysis of language production data from experts in comparison to the language production of a control group of laypeople. The pipeline combines manual annotation and curation with state-of-the-art machine learning and rule-based methods, following a silver standard approach. It integrates various analysis modules specifically for the syntactic and lexical evaluation of parsed linguistic data. While implemented initially for the creation of the ExpLay-Corpus, it is designed for the processing of linguistic data in general. The paper details the design and implementation of this pipeline.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 ExpLay-Pipeline，这是一种新颖的半自动处理工具，旨在分析专家的语言产生数据，并与非专业人员对照组的语言产生进行比较。该管道将​​手动注释和管理与最先进的机器学习和基于规则的方法结合起来，遵循银标准方法。它集成了各种分析模块，专门用于解析语言数据的句法和词汇评估。虽然最初是为了创建 ExpLay-Corpus 而实现的，但它是为一般语言数据的处理而设计的。本文详细介绍了该管道的设计和实现。

title: Visual Representations of Temporal Relations between Events and Time Expressions in News Stories
abstract_en: High-quality annotation is paramount for effective predictions of machine learning models. When the annotation is dense, achieving superior human labeling can be challenging since the most used annotation tools present an overloaded visualization of labels. Thus, we present a tool for viewing annotations made in corpora, specifically for temporal relations between events and temporal expressions, filling a gap in this type of tool. We focus on narrative text, which is a rich source for these types of elements.
abstract_zh: 高质量的注释对于机器学习模型的有效预测至关重要。当注释很密集时，实现卓越的人工标记可能具有挑战性，因为最常用的注释工具呈现超载的标签可视化。因此，我们提出了一种用于查看语料库中所做的注释的工具，特别是针对事件和时间表达式之间的时间关系，填补了此类工具的空白。我们专注于叙事文本，这是此类元素的丰富来源。

title: Annotating candy speech inGermanYouTube comments
abstract_en: We describe the phenomenon of candy speech – positive emotional speech in online communication – and introduce a classification of its various types based on the theoretical framework of social interaction by Goffman (1967). We provide a dataset of 46,286 German YouTube comments manually annotated with candy speech
abstract_zh: 我们描述了糖果言语现象——在线交流中的积极情绪言语——并根据戈夫曼（Goffman，1967）的社交互动理论框架对其各种类型进行了分类。我们提供了包含 46,286 条德国 YouTube 评论的数据集，并用糖果语音手动注释

title: Variety delights (sometimes) - Annotation differences in morphologically annotated corpora
abstract_en: The goal of annotation standards is to ensure consistency across different corpora and languages. But do they succeed? In our paper we experiment with morphologically annotated Hungarian corpora of different sizes (ELTE DH gold standard corpus, NYTK-NerKor, and Szeged Treebank) to assess their compatibility as a merged training corpus for morphological analysis and disambiguation. Our results show that combining any two corpora not only failed to improve the results of the trained tagger but even degraded them due the inconsistent annotations. Further analysis of the annotation differences among the corpora revealed inconsistencies of several sources: different theoretical approach, lack of consensus, and tagset conversion issues.
abstract_zh: 注释标准的目标是确保不同语料库和语言之间的一致性。但他们成功了吗？在我们的论文中，我们对不同大小的形态注释匈牙利语语料库（ELTE DH 金标准语料库、NYTK-NerKor 和 Szeged Treebank）进行了实验，以评估它们作为用于形态分析和消歧的合并训练语料库的兼容性。我们的结果表明，组合任意两个语料库不仅无法改善经过训练的标注器的结果，甚至还会由于不一致的注释而降低它们的性能。对语料库之间注释差异的进一步分析揭示了多个来源的不一致：不同的理论方法、缺乏共识以及标签集转换问题。

title: Addressing Variability in Interlinear Glossed Texts with Linguistic Linked Data
abstract_en: In this paper, we identify types of uncertainty in interlinear glossed text (IGT) annotation, a common notation for language data in linguistic research.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们识别了行间注释文本（IGT）注释中的不确定性类型，这是语言研究中语言数据的常见表示法。

title: Cheap Annotation of Complex Information: A Study on the Annotation of Information Status inGermanTEDx Talks
abstract_en: We present an annotation experiment for the annotation of information status in German TEDx Talks with the main goal to reduce annotation costs in terms of time and personnel. We aim for maximizing efficiency while keeping annotation quality constant by testing various different annotation scenarios for an optimal ratio of annotation expenses to resulting quality of the annotations. We choose the RefLex scheme of Riester and Baumann (2017) as a basis for our annotations, refine their annotation guidelines for a more generalizable tagset and conduct the experiment on German Tedx talks, applying different constellations of annotators, curators and correctors to test for an optimal annotation scenario. Our results show that we can achieve equally good and possibly even better results with significantly less effort, by using correctors instead of additional annotators.
abstract_zh: 我们在德国 TEDx 演讲中提出了一个信息状态标注的标注实验，主要目标是减少时间和人员方面的标注成本。我们的目标是通过测试各种不同的注释场景来最大限度地提高效率，同时保持注释质量不变，以获得注释费用与注释质量的最佳比率。我们选择 Riester 和 Baumann (2017) 的 RefLex 方案作为注释的基础，完善他们的注释指南以获得更通用的标签集，并在德国 Tedx 演讲中进行实验，应用不同的注释者、策展人和校正者来测试最佳注释场景。我们的结果表明，通过使用校正器而不是额外的注释器，我们可以以更少的努力获得同样好的甚至可能更好的结果。

title: AGitHub-based Workflow for Annotated Resource Development
abstract_en: Computational linguists have long recognized the value of version control systems such as Git (and related platforms, e.g., GitHub) when it comes to managing and distributing computer code. However, the benefits of version control remain under-explored for a central activity within computational linguistics: the development of annotated natural language resources. We argue that researchers can employ version control practices to make development workflows more transparent, efficient, consistent, and participatory. We report a proof-of-concept, GitHub-based solution which facilitated the creation of a legal English treebank.
abstract_zh: 计算语言学家很早就认识到 Git（以及相关平台，例如 GitHub）等版本控制系统在管理和分发计算机代码方面的价值。然而，对于计算语言学的核心活动：带注释的自然语言资源的开发，版本控制的好处仍未得到充分探索。我们认为，研究人员可以采用版本控制实践来使开发工作流程更加透明、高效、一致和参与。我们报告了一个基于 GitHub 的概念验证解决方案，该解决方案促进了合法英语树库的创建。

title: The Incremental Process of Building an Annotation Scheme for Clinical Narratives inPortuguese: the Contribution of Human Variation Analysis
abstract_en: The development of a robust annotation scheme and corresponding guidelines is crucial for producing annotated datasets that advance both linguistic and computational research. This paper presents a case study that outlines a methodology for designing an annotation scheme and its guidelines, specifically aimed at representing morphosyntactic and semantic information regarding temporal features, as well as medical information in medical reports written in Portuguese. We detail a multi-step process that includes reviewing existing frameworks, conducting an annotation experiment to determine the optimal approach, and designing a model based on these findings. We validated the approach through a pilot experiment where we assessed the reliability and applicability of the annotation scheme and guidelines. In this experiment, two annotators independently annotated a patient’s medical report consisting of six documents using the proposed model, while a curator established the ground truth. The analysis of inter-annotator agreement and the annotation results enabled the identification of sources of human variation and provided insights for further refinement of the annotation scheme and guidelines.
abstract_zh: 开发强大的注释方案和相应的指南对于生成可促进语言和计算研究的注释数据集至关重要。本文提出了一个案例研究，概述了设计注释方案的方法及其指南，特别旨在表示有关时间特征的形态句法和语义信息，以及用葡萄牙语编写的医疗报告中的医疗信息。我们详细介绍了一个多步骤过程，包括审查现有框架、进行注释实验以确定最佳方法，以及根据这些发现设计模型。我们通过试点实验验证了该方法，评估了注释方案和指南的可靠性和适用性。在这个实验中，两名注释者使用所提出的模型独立注释了由六个文档组成的患者医疗报告，而一名策展人则建立了基本事实。对注释者间一致性和注释结果的分析能够识别人类变异的来源，并为进一步细化注释方案和指南提供见解。

title: Insights into Climate Change Narratives: Emotional Alignment and Engagement Analysis onTikTok
abstract_en: TikTok has emerged as a key platform for discussing polarizing topics, including climate change. Despite its growing influence, there is limited research exploring how content features shape emotional alignment between video creators and audience comments, as well as their impact on user engagement. Using a combination of pretrained and fine-tuned textual and visual models, we analyzed 7,110 TikTok videos related to climate change, focusing on content features such as semantic clustering of video transcriptions, visual elements, tonal shifts, and detected emotions. (1) Our findings reveal that positive emotions and videos featuring factual content or vivid environmental visuals exhibit stronger emotional alignment. Furthermore, emotional intensity and tonal coherence in video speech are significant predictors of higher engagement levels, offering new insights into the dynamics of climate change communication on social media. (2) Our preference learning analysis reveals that comment emotions play a dominant role in predicting video shareability, with both positive and negative emotional responses acting as key drivers of content diffusion. We conclude that user engagement—particularly emotional discourse in comments—significantly shapes climate change content shareability.
abstract_zh: TikTok 已成为讨论气候变化等两极分化话题的重要平台。尽管其影响力越来越大，但探索内容特征如何塑造视频创作者和观众评论之间的情感一致性及其对用户参与度的影响的研究仍然有限。我们结合预训练和微调的文本和视觉模型，分析了 7,110 个与气候变化相关的 TikTok 视频，重点关注视频转录的语义聚类、视觉元素、色调变化和检测到的情绪等内容特征。 (1) 我们的研究结果表明，积极的情绪和具有事实内容或生动的环境视觉效果的视频表现出更强的情绪一致性。此外，视频语音中的情绪强度和语气连贯性是较高参与水平的重要预测因素，为社交媒体上气候变化传播的动态提供了新的见解。 （2）我们的偏好学习分析表明，评论情绪在预测视频可共享性方面起着主导作用，积极和消极的情绪反应都是内容传播的关键驱动因素。我们的结论是，用户参与度——尤其是评论中的情感话语——显着影响气候变化内容的可共享性。

title: OperationalizingAIfor Good: Spotlight on Deployment and Integration ofAIModels in Humanitarian Work
abstract_en: Publications in the AI for Good space have tended to focus on the research and model development that can support high-impact applications. However, very few AI for Good papers discuss the process of deploying and collaborating with the partner organization, and the resulting real-world impact. In this work, we share details about the close collaboration with a humanitarian-to-humanitarian (H2H) organization and how to not only deploy the AI model in a resource-constrained environment, but also how to maintain it for continuous performance updates, and share key takeaways for practitioners.
abstract_zh: AI for Good 领域的出版物往往侧重于支持高影响力应用的研究和模型开发。然而，很少有 AI for Good 论文讨论部署和与合作伙伴组织协作的过程以及由此产生的现实世界影响。在这项工作中，我们分享了与人道主义对人道主义（H2H）组织密切合作的详细信息，以及如何在资源有限的环境中部署人工智能模型，以及如何维护它以实现持续的性能更新，并分享了从业者的关键要点。

title: Multi-Task Learning approach to identify sentences with impact and affected location in a disaster news report
abstract_en: The first priority of action in the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015-2030 advocates the understanding of disaster risk by collecting and processing practical information related to disasters. A smart collection may be the compilation of relevant and summarized news articles focused on some key pieces of information such as disaster event type, geographic location(s), and impacts. In this article, a Multi-Task Learning (MTL) based end-to-end model has been developed to perform three related tasks: sentence classification depending on the presence of (1) relevant locations and (2) impact information to generate a summary,and (3) identification of the causes or event types in disaster news. Each of the three tasks is formulated as a multilabel binary classification problem. The results of the proposed MTL model have been compared with three popular transformer models: BERT, RoBERTa, and ALBERT. It is observed that the proposed model showed better performance scores than the other models in most cases.
abstract_zh: 《2015-2030 年仙台减少灾害风险框架》的首要行动优先事项是倡导通过收集和处理与灾害相关的实用信息来了解灾害风险。智能集合可以是相关和概括的新闻文章的汇编，重点关注一些关键信息，例如灾难事件类型、地理位置和影响。在本文中，开发了基于多任务学习（MTL）的端到端模型来执行三个相关任务：根据（1）相关位置和（2）影响信息的存在来进行句子分类以生成摘要，以及（3）识别灾难新闻中的原因或事件类型。这三个任务中的每一个都被表述为多标签二元分类问题。所提出的 MTL 模型的结果与三种流行的 Transformer 模型进行了比较：BERT、RoBERTa 和 ALBERT。据观察，在大多数情况下，所提出的模型比其他模型表现出更好的性能分数。

title: STAR: Strategy-Aware Refinement Module in Multitask Learning for Emotional Support Conversations
abstract_en: Effective emotional support in conversation requires strategic decision making, as it involves complex, context-sensitive reasoning tailored to diverse individual needs. The Emotional Support Conversation framework addresses this by organizing interactions into three distinct phases—exploration, comforting, and action—which guide strategy selection during response generation. While multitask learning has been applied to jointly optimize strategy prediction and response generation, it often suffers from task interference due to conflicting learning objectives. To overcome this, we propose the Strategy-Aware Refinement Module (STAR), which disentangles the decoder’s hidden states for each task and selectively fuses them via a dynamic gating mechanism. This design preserves task-specific representations while allowing controlled information exchange between tasks, thus reducing interference. Experimental results demonstrate that STAR effectively reduces task interference and achieves state-of-the-art performance in both strategy prediction and supportive response generation.
abstract_zh: 对话中有效的情感支持需要制定战略决策，因为它涉及针对不同个人需求量身定制的复杂、上下文敏感的推理。情感支持对话框架通过将交互组织为三个不同的阶段（探索、安慰和行动）来解决这个问题，这指导了响应生成过程中的策略选择。虽然多任务学习已被应用于联合优化策略预测和响应生成，但由于学习目标相互冲突，它经常受到任务干扰。为了克服这个问题，我们提出了策略感知细化模块（STAR），它解开每个任务的解码器的隐藏状态，并通过动态门控机制有选择地融合它们。这种设计保留了特定于任务的表示，同时允许任务之间进行受控的信息交换，从而减少干扰。实验结果表明，STAR 有效减少了任务干扰，并在策略预测和支持性响应生成方面均实现了最先进的性能。

title: Tapping into Social Media in Crisis: A Survey
abstract_en: When a crisis hits, people often turn to social media to ask for help, offer help, find out how others are doing, and decide what they should do. The growth of social media use during crises has been helpful to aid providers as well, giving them a nearly immediate read of the on-the-ground situation that they might not otherwise have. The amount of crisis-related content posted to social media over the past two decades has been explosive, which, in turn, has been a boon to Language Technology (LT) researchers. In this study, we conducted a systematic survey of 355 papers published in the past five years to better understand the expanding growth of LT as it is applied to crisis content, specifically focusing on corpora built over crisis social media data as well as systems and applications that have been developed on this content. We highlight the challenges and possible future directions of research in this space. Our goal is to engender interest in the LT field writ large, in particular in an area of study that can have dramatic impacts on people’s lives. Indeed, the use of LT in crisis response has already been shown to save people’s lives.
abstract_zh: 当危机袭来时，人们经常转向社交媒体寻求帮助、提供帮助、了解他人的情况并决定自己应该做什么。危机期间社交媒体使用的增长也对援助提供者有所帮助，让他们几乎可以立即了解他们可能无法了解的实地情况。过去二十年来，社交媒体上发布的与危机相关的内容数量呈爆炸性增长，这反过来又给语言技术 (LT) 研究人员带来了福音。在这项研究中，我们对过去五年发表的 355 篇论文进行了系统调查，以更好地了解 LT 在应用于危机内容时的不断增长，特别关注基于危机社交媒体数据构建的语料库以及基于此内容开发的系统和应用程序。我们强调了该领域的挑战和未来可能的研究方向。我们的目标是引起人们对 LT 领域的广泛兴趣，特别是在一个可以对人们的生活产生巨大影响的研究领域。事实上，事实证明，在危机应对中使用 LT 可以挽救人们的生命。

title: Oversight Structures for AgenticAIin Public-Sector Organizations
abstract_en: This paper finds that agentic AI systems intensify existing challenges to traditional public sector oversight mechanisms — which rely on siloed compliance units and episodic approvals rather than continuous, integrated supervision. We identify five governance dimensions essential for responsible agent deployment: cross-departmental implementation, comprehensive evaluation, enhanced security protocols, operational visibility, and systematic auditing. We evaluate the capacity of existing oversight structures to meet these challenges, via a mixed-methods approach consisting of a literature review and interviews with civil servants in AI-related roles. We find that agent oversight poses intensified versions of three existing governance challenges: continuous oversight, deeper integration of governance and operational capabilities, and interdepartmental coordination. We propose approaches that both adapt institutional mechanisms and design agent architectures compatible with public sector constraints.
abstract_zh: 本文发现，代理人工智能系统加剧了传统公共部门监督机制面临的挑战——传统公共部门监督机制依赖于孤立的合规部门和间歇性批准，而不是持续、综合的监督。我们确定了负责任的代理部署所必需的五个治理维度：跨部门实施、综合评估、增强的安全协议、运营可见性和系统审计。我们通过文献综述和人工智能相关职位的公务员访谈等混合方法来评估现有监督结构应对这些挑战的能力。我们发现，代理监督带来了三个现有治理挑战的强化版本：持续监督、治理和运营能力的更深层次整合以及部门间协调。我们提出的方法既要适应制度机制，又要设计与公共部门约束兼容的代理架构。

title: Analyzing the Evolution of Scientific Misconduct Based on the Language of Retracted Papers
abstract_en: Amid rising numbers of organizations producing counterfeit scholarly articles, it is important to quantify the prevalence of scientific misconduct.We assess the feasibility of automated text-based methods to determine the rate of scientific misconduct by analyzing linguistic differences between retracted and non-retracted papers.We find that retracted works show distinct phrase patterns and higher word repetition.Motivated by this, we evaluatetwo misconduct detection methods, a mixture distribution approach and a Transformer-based one.The best models achieve high accuracy (>0.9 F1) on detection of paper mill articles and automatically generated content, making them viable tools for flagging papers for closer review.We apply the classifiers to more than 300,000 paper abstracts, to quantify misconduct over time and find that our estimation methods accurately reproduce trends observed in the real data.
abstract_zh: 在制作假冒学术文章的组织数量不断增加的情况下，量化科学不端行为的普遍程度非常重要。我们通过分析撤回论文和非撤回论文之间的语言差异，评估基于文本的自动化方法确定科学不端行为率的可行性。我们发现撤回的作品表现出明显的短语模式和更高的单词重复率。受此启发，我们评估了两种不当行为检测方法，一种是混合分布方法，另一种是基于 Transformer 的方法。最好的模型实现了高精度 (>0.9 F1)检测造纸厂文章和自动生成的内容，使它们成为标记论文以供仔细审查的可行工具。我们将分类器应用于超过 300,000 份论文摘要，以量化一段时间内的不当行为，并发现我们的估计方法准确地再现了在真实数据中观察到的趋势。

title: VerbaNexAIatSemEval-2025 Task 9: Advances and Challenges in the Automatic Detection of Food Hazards
abstract_en: Ensuring food safety requires effective detection of potential hazards in food products. This paper presents the participation of VerbaNexAI in the SemEval-2025 Task 9 challenge, which focuses on the automatic identification and classification of food hazards from descriptive texts. Our approach employs a machine learning-based strategy, leveraging a Random Forest classifier combined with TF-IDF vectorization and character n-grams (n=2-5) to enhance linguistic pattern recognition. The system achieved competitive performance in hazard and product classification tasks, obtaining notable macro and micro F1 scores. However, we identified challenges such as handling underrepresented categories and improving generalization in multilingual contexts. Our findings highlight the need to refine preprocessing techniques and model architectures to enhance food hazard detection. We made the source code publicly available to encourage reproducibility and collaboration in future research.
abstract_zh: 确保食品安全需要有效检测食品中的潜在危害。本文介绍了 VerbaNexAI 参与 SemEval-2025 Task 9 挑战的情况，该挑战的重点是从描述性文本中自动识别和分类食品危害。我们的方法采用基于机器学习的策略，利用随机森林分类器结合 TF-IDF 矢量化和字符 n-gram (n=2-5) 来增强语言模式识别。该系统在危险和产品分类任务中取得了有竞争力的表现，获得了显着的宏观和微观 F1 分数。然而，我们发现了一些挑战，例如处理代表性不足的类别和提高多语言环境中的泛化能力。我们的研究结果强调需要改进预处理技术和模型架构以增强食品危害检测。我们公开源代码，以鼓励未来研究中的可重复性和协作。

title: ChuenSumi atSemEval-2025 Task 1: Sentence Transformer Models and Processing Idiomacity
abstract_en: This paper participates Task 1 of SemEval2025, specifically Subtask A’s English Text-Only track, where we develop a model to rank text descriptions of images with respect to how well it represents a the use of a given multi-word expression in its respective context sentence. We trained sentence transformer models from huggingface to rank the text descriptions, finding the RoBERTa model to be the better performing model. For the final evaluation, the fine-tuned RoBERTa model achieved an accuracy of 0.4 for the first developer’s evaluation set, and 0.2 for the second, ranking 9th in the English Text Only category for Subtask A. Overall, our results show that a vanilla sentence transformerapproach performs adequately in the task and processing idioms. They also suggest that RoBERTa models may be stronger in idiom processing than other models.
abstract_zh: 本文参与了 SemEval2025 的任务 1，特别是子任务 A 的纯英语文本轨道，我们开发了一个模型，根据图像的文本描述在各自的上下文句子中表示给定多词表达的使用情况对图像的文本描述进行排名。我们训练了 Huggingface 的句子转换器模型来对文本描述进行排名，发现 RoBERTa 模型是性能更好的模型。在最终评估中，经过微调的 RoBERTa 模型在第一个开发人员的评估集上达到了 0.4 的准确度，在第二个开发人员的评估集上达到了 0.2 的准确度，在子任务 A 的纯英语文本类别中排名第 9。总体而言，我们的结果表明，普通句子转换器方法在任务和处理习语方面表现良好。他们还认为 RoBERTa 模型在习语处理方面可能比其他模型更强。

title: GateNLPatSemEval-2025 Task 10: Hierarchical Three-Step Prompting for Multilingual Narrative Classification
abstract_en: The proliferation of online news and the increasing spread of misinformation necessitate robust methods for automated narrative classification. This paper presents our approach to SemEval 2025 Task 10 Subtask 2, which aims to classify news articles into a predefined two-level taxonomy of main narratives and sub-narratives across multiple languages. We propose Hierarchical Three-Step Prompting (H3Prompt) for multilingual narrative classification. Our methodology follows a three-step prompting strategy, where the model first categorises an article into one of two domains (Ukraine-Russia War or Climate Change), then identifies the most relevant main narratives, and finally assigns sub-narratives. Our approach secured the top position on the English test set among 28 competing teams worldwide. This result highlights the effectiveness of our method in improving narrative classification performance over the baselines.
abstract_zh: 在线新闻的激增和错误信息的日益传播需要强大的自动叙事分类方法。本文介绍了我们执行 SemEval 2025 任务 10 子任务 2 的方法，该方法旨在将新闻文章分类为跨多种语言的主要叙述和子叙述的预定义两级分类法。我们提出了用于多语言叙述分类的分层三步提示（H3Prompt）。我们的方法遵循三步提示策略，其中模型首先将文章分为两个领域之一（乌克兰-俄罗斯战争或气候变化），然后确定最相关的主要叙述，最后分配子叙述。我们的方法在全球 28 个参赛团队的英语测试集上获得了最高位置。这一结果凸显了我们的方法在提高基线叙事分类性能方面的有效性。

title: DKE-Research atSemEval-2025 Task 7: A Unified Multilingual Framework for Cross-Lingual and Monolingual Retrieval with Efficient Language-specific Adaptation
abstract_en: This paper presents a unified framework for fact-checked claim retrieval, integrating contrastive learning with an in-batch multiple negative ranking loss and a conflict-aware batch sampler to enhance query-document alignment across languages. Additionally, we introduce language-specific adapters for efficient fine-tuning, enabling adaptation to previously unseen languages.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个用于事实检查声明检索的统一框架，将对比学习与批内多重负排名损失和冲突感知批量采样器相结合，以增强跨语言的查询文档对齐。此外，我们还引入了特定于语言的适配器来进行高效的微调，从而能够适应以前未见过的语言。

title: PuerAIatSemEval-2025 Task 9: Research on Food Safety Data Classification UsingModernBERT
abstract_en: This paper presents our research in the SemEval-2025 Task 9: Food Hazard Detection Challenge, with a focus on the application of ModernBERT for food safety data classification. We applied the ModernBERT model for the food hazard classification task, achieving a score of 0.7952 on the validation set and 0.7729 on the final test set, outperforming other models. Through comparative experiments with various deep learning architectures, we further confirmed the superiority of ModernBERT in food hazard detection. The results demonstrate the significant potential of ModernBERT in food safety management, providing strong support for its practical applications in the field. The code of this paper is available at: https://github.com/daojiaxu/semeval_2025_Task-9.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们在 SemEval-2025 任务 9：食品危害检测挑战中的研究，重点是 ModernBERT 在食品安全数据分类中的应用。我们将 ModernBERT 模型应用于食品危害分类任务，在验证集上获得 0.7952 的分数，在最终测试集上获得 0.7729 的分数，优于其他模型。通过与各种深度学习架构的对比实验，我们进一步证实了ModernBERT在食品危害检测方面的优越性。结果证明了ModernBERT在食品安全管理方面的巨大潜力，为其在该领域的实际应用提供了强有力的支持。本文代码可参见：https://github.com/daojiaxu/semeval_2025_Task-9。
