title: adithjrajeev atSemEval-2025 Task 10: Sequential Learning for Role Classification Using Entity-Centric News Summaries
abstract_en: There is a high prevalence of disinformation and manipulative narratives in online news sources today, and verification of its informative integrity is a vital need as online audience is highly susceptible to being affected by such propaganda or disinformation. The task of verifying any online information is, however, a significant challenge. The task Multilingual Characterization and Extraction of Narratives from Online News, therefore focuses on developing novel methods of analyzing news ecosystems and detecting manipulation attempts to address this challenge. As a part of this effort, we focus on the subtask of Entity Framing, which involves assigning named entities in news articles one of three main roles ( Protagonist, Antagonist, and Innocent) with a further fine-grained role distinction. We propose a pipeline that involves summarizing the article with the summary being centered around the entity. The entity and its entity-centric summary is then used as input for a BERT-based classifier to carry out the final role classification. Finally, we experiment with different approaches in the steps of the pipeline and compare the results obtained by them.
abstract_zh: 如今，在线新闻来源中虚假信息和操纵性叙述非常普遍，验证其信息完整性至关重要，因为在线受众很容易受到此类宣传或虚假信息的影响。然而，验证任何在线信息的任务是一项重大挑战。因此，“在线新闻中的多语言特征描述和叙事提取”任务侧重于开发分析新闻生态系统和检测操纵尝试的新方法来应对这一挑战。作为这项工作的一部分，我们专注于实体框架的子任务，其中涉及将新闻文章中的命名实体分配为三个主要角色之一（主角、对手和无辜者），并进一步进行细粒度的角色区分。我们提出了一个管道，涉及总结文章，摘要以实体为中心。然后，实体及其以实体为中心的摘要将用作基于 BERT 的分类器的输入，以执行最终的角色分类。最后，我们在管道的步骤中尝试不同的方法并比较它们获得的结果。

title: UniBuc atSemEval-2025 Task 9: Similarity Approaches to Classification
abstract_en: In this paper, we present a similarity-based method for explainable classification in the context of the SemEval 2025 Task 9: The Food Hazard Detection Challenge. Our proposed system is essentially unsupervised, leveraging the semantic properties of the labels. This approach brings some key advantages over typical classification systems. First, similarity metrics offer a more intuitive interpretation. Next, this technique allows for inference on novel labels. Finally, there is a non-negligible amount of ambiguous labels, so learning a direct mapping does not lead to meaningful representations.Our team ranks 13th for the second sub-task among participants that used only the title and the text as features. Our method is generic and can be applied to any classification task.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们在 SemEval 2025 任务 9：食品危害检测挑战的背景下提出了一种基于相似性的可解释分类方法。我们提出的系统本质上是无监督的，利用标签的语义属性。与典型的分类系统相比，这种方法具有一些关键优势。首先，相似性度量提供了更直观的解释。接下来，该技术允许推断新颖的标签。最后，存在不可忽略的模糊标签数量，因此学习直接映射不会产生有意义的表示。在仅使用标题和文本作为特征的参与者中，我们的团队在第二个子任务中排名第 13 位。我们的方法是通用的，可以应用于任何分类任务。

title: NCL-ARatSemEval-2025 Task 7: A Sieve Filtering Approach to Refute the Misinformation within Harmful Social Media Posts
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a sieve filtering-based approach that can retrieve facts to invalidate claims made in social media posts. The fact filters are initially coarse-grained, based on the original language of the social media posts, and end with fine-grained filters based on the exact time frame in which the posts were uploaded online. This streamlined approach achieved a 0.883 retrieval success rate in the monolingual task while maintaining a scalable efficiency level of processing a social media post per 0.07 seconds.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种基于筛式过滤的方法，可以检索事实以使社交媒体帖子中的主张无效。事实过滤器最初是基于社交媒体帖子的原始语言的粗粒度过滤器，最后是基于帖子在线上传的确切时间范围的细粒度过滤器。这种简化的方法在单语任务中实现了 0.883 的检索成功率，同时保持了每 0.07 秒处理社交媒体帖子的可扩展效率水平。

title: ClaimCatchers atSemEval-2025 Task 7: Sentence Transformers for Claim Retrieval
abstract_en: Retrieving previously fact-checked claims from verified databases has become a crucial area of research in automated fact-checking, given the impracticality of manual verification of massive online content. To address this challenge, SemEval 2025 Task 7 focuses on multilingual previously fact-checked claim retrieval. This paper presents the experiments conducted for this task, evaluating the effectiveness of various sentence transformer models—ranging from 22M to 9B parameters—in conjunction with retrieval strategies such as nearest neighbor search and reranking techniques. Further, we explore the impact of learning context-specific text representation via finetuning these models. Our results demonstrate that smaller and medium-sized models, when optimized with effective finetuning and reranking, can achieve retrieval accuracy comparable to larger models, highlighting their potential for scalable and efficient misinformation detection.
abstract_zh: 鉴于手动验证大量在线内容的不切实际，从经过验证的数据库检索先前经过事实核查的声明已成为自动事实核查研究的一个重要领域。为了应对这一挑战，SemEval 2025 任务 7 重点关注多语言先前经过事实检查的声明检索。本文介绍了为此任务进行的实验，评估了各种句子转换器模型（参数范围从 22M 到 9B）与最近邻搜索和重新排序技术等检索策略的有效性。此外，我们通过微调这些模型来探索学习特定于上下文的文本表示的影响。我们的结果表明，中小型模型在通过有效的微调和重新排名进行优化时，可以实现与大型模型相当的检索精度，突显了它们在可扩展和高效的错误信息检测方面的潜力。

title: TechSSN3 atSemEval-2025 Task 9: Food Hazard and Product Detection - Category Identification and Vector Prediction
abstract_en: Food safety is a critical global concern, and timely detection of food-related hazards is essential for public health and economic stability. The automated detection of food hazards from textual data can enhance food safety monitoring by enabling early identification of potential risks. In the Food Hazard Detection task, we address two key challenges: (ST1) food hazard-category and product-category classification and (ST2) food hazard and product vector detection. For ST1, we employ BertForSequenceClassification, leveraging its powerful contextual understanding for accurate food hazard classification. For ST2, we utilize a Random Forest Classifier, which effectively captures patterns in the extracted features for food hazard and product vector detection. This paper presents the results of the TechSSN3 team at SemEval-2025 Food Hazard Detection Task .
abstract_zh: 食品安全是全球关注的一个重要问题，及时发现食品相关危害对于公共卫生和经济稳定至关重要。从文本数据中自动检测食品危害可以通过早期识别潜在风险来加强食品安全监控。在食品危害检测任务中，我们解决了两个关键挑战：（ST1）食品危害类别和产品类别分类以及（ST2）食品危害和产品媒介检测。对于 ST1，我们采用 BertForSequenceClassification，利用其强大的上下文理解来进行准确的食品危害分类。对于 ST2，我们利用随机森林分类器，它可以有效地捕获提取的特征中的模式，以进行食品危害和产品矢量检测。本文介绍了 TechSSN3 团队在 SemEval-2025 食品危害检测任务中的结果。

title: Zuifeng atSemEval-2025 Task 9: Multitask Learning with Fine-TunedRoBERTa for Food Hazard Detection
abstract_en: This paper describes our system used in theSemEval-2025 Task 9 The Food Hazard Detec-tion Challenge. Through data processing thatremoves elements and shared multi-task archi-tecture improve the performance of detection.Without complex architectural modificationsthe proposed method achieves competitive per-formance with 0.7835 Marco F1-score on sub-task 1 and 0.4712 Marco F1-score on sub-task2. Comparative experiments reveal that jointprediction outperforms separate task trainingby 1.3% F1-score, showing the effectiveness ofmulti-task learning of this challenge
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们在 SemEval-2025 任务 9 食品危害检测挑战赛中使用的系统。通过删除元素的数据处理和共享的多任务架构提高了检测性能。无需复杂的架构修改，所提出的方法就实现了具有竞争力的性能，子任务1上的Marco F1得分为0.7835，子任务2上的Marco F1得分为0.4712。比较实验表明，联合预测比单独任务训练的 F1 分数高出 1.3%，显示了该挑战的多任务学习的有效性

title: AlexUNLP-NBatSemEval-2025 Task 1: A Pipeline for Idiom Disambiguation and Visual Representation
abstract_en: This paper describes our system developed for SemEval-2025 Task 1, subtask A. This sharedsubtask focuses on multilingual idiom recognition and the ranking of images based on howwell they represent the sense in which a nominal compound is used within a given contextual sentence. This study explores the use of a pipeline, where task-specific models are sequentially employed to address each problem step by step. The process involves three key steps: first, identifying whether idioms are in their literal or figurative form; second, transforming them if necessary; and finally, usingthe final form to rank the input images.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们为 SemEval-2025 任务 1 子任务 A 开发的系统。该共享子任务侧重于多语言习语识别以及图像排名，该排名基于图像在给定上下文句子中表示名词性复合词的含义的程度。本研究探索了管道的使用，其中按顺序采用特定于任务的模型来逐步解决每个问题。这个过程涉及三个关键步骤：首先，确定习语是字面形式还是比喻形式；第二，必要时进行改造；最后，使用最终形式对输入图像进行排名。

title: GPLSICORTEXatSemEval-2025 Task 10: Leveraging Intentions for Generating Narrative Extractions
abstract_en: This paper describes our approach to address the SemEval-2025 Task 10 subtask 3, which is focused on narrative extraction given news articles with a dominant narrative. We design an external knowledge injection approach to fine-tune a Flan-T5 model so the generated narrative explanations are in line with the dominant narrative determined in each text. We also incorporate pragmatic information in the form of communicative intentions, using them as external knowledge to assist the model. This ensures that the generated texts align more closely with the intended explanations and effectively convey the expected meaning. The results show that our approach ranks 3rd in the task leaderboard (0.7428 in Macro-F1) with concise and effective news explanations. The analyses highlight the importance of adding pragmatic information when training systems to generate adequate narrative extractions.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了我们解决 SemEval-2025 任务 10 子任务 3 的方法，该方法的重点是给定具有主导叙述的新闻文章进行叙述提取。我们设计了一种外部知识注入方法来微调 Flan-T5 模型，以便生成的叙述解释与每个文本中确定的主导叙述一致。我们还以交流意图的形式纳入实用信息，将它们用作外部知识来辅助模型。这确保生成的文本与预期的解释更加一致，并有效地传达预期的含义。结果表明，我们的方法在任务排行榜上排名第三（Macro-F1 中为 0.7428），并具有简洁有效的新闻解释。这些分析强调了在训练系统生成足够的叙述提取时添加实用信息的重要性。

title: CICLatSemEval-2025 Task 9: A Pilot Study on Different Machine Learning Models for Food Hazard Detection Challenge
abstract_en: This paper describes our approaches to SemEval-2025 task 9, a multiclass classification task to detect food hazards and affected products, given food incident reports from web resources. The training data consists of the date of the incidents and the text of the incident reports, as well as the labels: “hazard-category” and “product-category” for task 1, “hazard” and “product” for task 2. We primarily focused on solving task 1 of this challenge. Our approach is in two directions: Firstly, we fine-tuned BERT-based models (BERT and ModernBERT); secondly, in addition to BERT-based models, linearSVC, random forest classifier, and LightGBM were also used to tackle the challenge. From the experiment, we have learned that BERT-based models outperformed the other models mentioned above, and applying focal loss to BERT-based models optimized their performance on imbalanced classification tasks.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了我们执行 SemEval-2025 任务 9 的方法，这是一项多类分类任务，根据来自网络资源的食品事件报告来检测食品危害和受影响的产品。训练数据包括事件日期和事件报告文本以及标签：任务 1 的“危险类别”和“产品类别”，任务 2 的“危险”和“产品”。我们主要专注于解决此挑战的任务 1。我们的方法有两个方向：首先，我们微调基于 BERT 的模型（BERT 和 ModernBERT）；其次，除了基于BERT的模型之外，还使用了线性SVC、随机森林分类器和LightGBM来应对挑战。从实验中我们了解到，基于 BERT 的模型优于上述其他模型，并且将焦点损失应用于基于 BERT 的模型优化了它们在不平衡分类任务上的性能。

title: iLostTheCode atSemEval-2025 Task 10: Bottom-up Multilevel Classification of Narrative Taxonomies
abstract_en: This paper describes the approach used to address the task of narrative classification, which has been proposed as a subtask of Task 10 on Multilingual Characterization and Extraction of Narratives from Online News at the SemEval 2025 campaign. The task consists precisely in assigning all relevant sub-narrative labels from a two-level taxonomy to a given news article in multiple languages (i.e., Bulgarian, English, Hindi, Portuguese and Russian). This involves performing both multi-label and multi-class classification. The model developed for this purpose uses multiple pretrained BERT-based models to create contextualized embeddings that are concatenated and then fed into a simple neural network to compute classification probabilities. Results on the official test set, evaluated using samples $F_1$, range from $0.15$ in Hindi (rank #9) to $0.41$ in Russian (rank #3). Besides an overview of the system and the results obtained in the task, the paper also includes some additional experiments carried out after the evaluation phase along with a brief discussion of the observed errors.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了用于解决叙事分类任务的方法，该方法已被提议作为 SemEval 2025 活动中关于多语言表征和从在线新闻中提取叙事的任务 10 的子任务。该任务恰恰包括将二级分类中的所有相关子叙述标签分配给多种语言（即保加利亚语、英语、印地语、葡萄牙语和俄语）的给定新闻文章。这涉及执行多标签和多类分类。为此目的开发的模型使用多个基于 BERT 的预训练模型来创建上下文化嵌入，这些嵌入被连接起来，然后输入到一个简单的神经网络中以计算分类概率。使用样本 $F_1$ 评估的官方测试集结果范围从印地语的 0.15 美元（排名第 9）到俄语的 0.41 美元（排名第 3）。除了系统概述和任务中获得的结果之外，本文还包括在评估阶段之后进行的一些附加实验以及对观察到的错误的简要讨论。

title: UniBuc-AEatSemEval-2025 Task 7: Training Text Embedding Models for Multilingual and Crosslingual Fact-Checked Claim Retrieval
abstract_en: This paper describes our approach to the SemEval-2025 Task 7: Multilingual and Crosslingual Fact-Checked Claim Retrieval on both the monolingual and crosslingual tracks. Our training methodology for text embedding models combines contrastive pre-training and hard negatives mining in order to fine-tune models from the E5 family. Additionally, we introduce a novel approach for merging the results from multiple models by finding the best majority vote weighted configuration for each subtask using the validation dataset. Our team ranked 6th in the monolingual track scoring a 0.934 S@10 averaged over all languages and achieved a 0.79 S@10 on the crosslingual task, ranking 8th in this track.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了我们执行 SemEval-2025 任务 7 的方法：在单语言和跨语言轨道上进行多语言和跨语言事实检查声明检索。我们的文本嵌入模型训练方法结合了对比预训练和硬底片挖掘，以微调 E5 系列模型。此外，我们引入了一种新颖的方法，通过使用验证数据集为每个子任务找到最佳多数投票加权配置来合并多个模型的结果。我们的团队在单语言任务中排名第六，所有语言的平均得分为 0.934 S@10，在跨语言任务上取得了 0.79 S@10，在该轨道中排名第八。

title: QUST_NLPatSemEval-2025 Task 7: A Three-Stage Retrieval Framework for Monolingual and Crosslingual Fact-Checked Claim Retrieval
abstract_en: This paper describes the participation of team QUST_NLP in the SemEval-2025 Task 7. We propose a three-stage retrieval framework specifically designed for fact-checked claim retrieval. Initially, we evaluate the performance of several retrieval models and select the one that yields the best results for candidate retrieval. Next, we employ multiple re-ranking models to enhance the candidate results, with each model selecting the Top-10 outcomes. In the final stage, we utilize weighted voting to determine the final retrieval outcomes. Our approach achieved 5th place in the monolingual track and 7th place in the crosslingual track. We release our system code at: https://github.com/warmth27/SemEval2025_Task7.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了 QUST_NLP 团队参与 SemEval-2025 任务 7 的情况。我们提出了一个专门为经过事实检查的声明检索而设计的三阶段检索框架。首先，我们评估几种检索模型的性能，并选择能够为候选检索产生最佳结果的模型。接下来，我们采用多个重新排序模型来增强候选结果，每个模型都会选择前 10 个结果。在最后阶段，我们利用加权投票来确定最终的检索结果。我们的方法在单语言赛道上获得了第五名，在跨语言赛道上获得了第七名。我们在以下位置发布了系统代码：https://github.com/warmth27/SemEval2025_Task7。

title: KostasThesis2025 atSemEval-2025 Task 10 Subtask 2: A Continual Learning Approach to Propaganda Analysis in Online News
abstract_en: In response to the growing challenge of propagandistic presence through online media inonline news, the increasing need for automated systems that are able to identify and classify narrative structures in multiple languages is evident. We present our approach to the SemEval-2025 Task 10 Subtask 2, focusing on the challenge of hierarchical multi-label, multi-class classification in multilingual news articles. We present methods to handle long articles with respect to how they are naturally structured in the dataset, propose a hierarchical classification neural network model with respect to the taxonomy, and a continual learning training approach that leverages cross-lingual knowledge transfer.
abstract_zh: 为了应对在线新闻中在线媒体宣传存在日益增长的挑战，对能够识别和分类多种语言叙事结构的自动化系统的需求日益增长。我们提出了 SemEval-2025 任务 10 子任务 2 的方法，重点关注多语言新闻文章中分层多标签、多类分类的挑战。我们提出了处理长文章的方法，涉及它们在数据集中的自然结构，提出了一种关于分类的分层分类神经网络模型，以及一种利用跨语言知识迁移的持续学习训练方法。

title: NBFatSemEval-2025 Task 5: Light-Burst Attention Enhanced System for Multilingual Subject Recommendation
abstract_en: This paper presents a system for automated subject tagging in a bilingual academic setting. Our approach leverages a novel burst attention mechanism to enhance the alignment between article and subject embeddings, derived from a large cross-lingual subject corpus. By employing a margin-based loss with negative sampling, our resource-efficient model achieves competitive performance in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations. Experimental results demonstrate average recall rates of 32.24% on the full test set, along with robust performance on specialized subsets, making our system well-suited for large-scale subject recommendation tasks.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在双语学术环境中自动进行主题标记的系统。我们的方法利用一种新颖的突发注意力机制来增强源自大型跨语言主题语料库的文章和主题嵌入之间的一致性。通过采用基于边际的损失和负采样，我们的资源效率模型在定量和定性评估方面都实现了具有竞争力的表现。实验结果表明，整个测试集的平均召回率为 32.24%，并且在专门的子集上具有强大的性能，使我们的系统非常适合大规模主题推荐任务。

title: ipezoTUatSemEval-2025 Task 7: Hybrid Ensemble Retrieval for Multilingual Fact-Checking
abstract_en: Fact-check retrieval plays a crucial role in combating misinformation by ensuring that claims are accurately matched with relevant fact-checks. In this work, we present a hybrid retrieval pipeline that integrates lexical and semantic retrieval models, leveraging their complementary strengths. We evaluate different retrieval and reranking strategies, demonstrating that hybrid ensembling consistently outperforms individual models, while reranking provides only marginal improvements.
abstract_zh: 事实核查检索通过确保声明与相关事实核查准确匹配，在打击错误信息方面发挥着至关重要的作用。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种混合检索管道，它集成了词汇和语义检索模型，利用了它们的互补优势。我们评估了不同的检索和重新排序策略，证明混合集成始终优于单个模型，而重新排序仅提供了边际改进。

title: CSECU-Learners atSemEval-2025 Task 9: Enhancing Transformer Model for Explainable Food Hazard Detection in Text
abstract_en: Food contamination and associated illnesses represent significant global health challenges, leading to thousands of deaths worldwide. As the volume of food-related incident reports on web platforms continues to grow, there is a pressing demand for systems capable of detecting food hazards effectively. Furthermore, explainability in food risk detection is crucial for building trust in automated systems, allowing humans to validate predictions. SemEval-2025 Task 9 proposes a food hazard detection challenge to address this issue, utilizing content extracted from websites. This task is divided into two sub-tasks. Sub-task 1 involves classifying the type of hazard and product, while sub-task 2 focuses on identifying precise hazard and product “vectors” to offer detailed explanations for the predictions. This paper presents our participation in this task, where we introduce a transformer-based method. We fine-tune an enhanced version of the BERT transformer to process lengthy food incident reports. Additionally, we combine the transformer’s contextual embeddings to enhance its contextual representation for hazard and product “vectors” prediction. The experimental results reveal the competitive performance of our proposed method in this task. We have released our code at https://github.com/AhmadMonirCSECU/SemEval-2025_Task9.
abstract_zh: 食品污染和相关疾病是全球健康面临的重大挑战，导致全球数千人死亡。随着网络平台上食品相关事件报告数量的持续增长，迫切需要能够有效检测食品危害的系统。此外，食品风险检测的可解释性对于建立对自动化系统的信任至关重要，从而使人类能够验证预测。 SemEval-2025 任务 9 提出了一项食品危害检测挑战，利用从网站提取的内容来解决这一问题。该任务分为两个子任务。子任务 1 涉及对危害和产品的类型进行分类，而子任务 2 则侧重于识别精确的危害和产品“向量”，以便为预测提供详细的解释。本文介绍了我们对这项任务的参与，其中我们介绍了一种基于变压器的方法。我们对 BERT 转换器的增强版进行了微调，以处理冗长的食品事故报告。此外，我们结合了变压器的上下文嵌入来增强其对危险和产品“向量”预测的上下文表示。实验结果揭示了我们提出的方法在此任务中的竞争性能。我们已在 https://github.com/AhmadMonirCSECU/SemEval-2025_Task9 发布了我们的代码。

title: WCTeam atSemEval-2025 Task 6:PromiseEval: Multinational, Multilingual, Multi-Industry Promise Verification leveraging monolingual and multilingualBERTmodels
abstract_en: This paper presents our system developed for SemEval-2025 Task 6: PromiseEval: Multinational, Multilingual, Multi-Industry Promise Verification. The task aims at identifying “promises” made and “evidence” provided in company ESG statements for various languages. Our team participated in Subtasks 1 and 2 for the languages English, French, and Japanese. In this work, we propose using BERT and finetuning it to better address the task. We achieve competitive results, especially for English and Japanese.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们为 SemEval-2025 任务 6 开发的系统：PromiseEval：跨国、多语言、多行业承诺验证。该任务旨在识别公司 ESG 声明中针对各种语言所做的“承诺”和提供的“证据”。我们的团队参与了英语、法语和日语的子任务 1 和 2。在这项工作中，我们建议使用 BERT 并对其进行微调以更好地解决任务。我们取得了有竞争力的成绩，尤其是英语和日语方面。

title: CLaCatSemEval-2025 Task 6: A Multi-Architecture Approach for Corporate Environmental Promise Verification
abstract_en: This paper presents our approach to the PromiseEval task at SemEval-2025, which focuses on verifying promises in corporate ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) reports. We explore three model architectures to address the four subtasks of promise identification, supporting evidence assessment, clarity evaluation, and verification timing. Our first model utilizes ESG-BERT with task-specific classifier heads, while our second model enhances this architecture with linguistic features tailored for each subtask. Our third approach implements a combined subtask model with attention-based sequence pooling, transformer representations augmented with document metadata, and multi-objective learning. Experiments on the English portion of the ML-Promise dataset demonstrate progressive improvement across our models, with our combined subtask approach achieving a private leaderboard score of 0.5268, outperforming the provided baseline of 0.5227. Our work highlights the effectiveness of linguistic feature extraction, attention pooling, and multi-objective learning in promise verification tasks, despite challenges posed by class imbalance and limited training data.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们在 SemEval-2025 上执行 PromiseEval 任务的方法，该任务侧重于验证企业 ESG（环境、社会和治理）报告中的承诺。我们探索了三种模型架构来解决承诺识别、支持证据评估、清晰度评估和验证时机这四个子任务。我们的第一个模型利用 ESG-BERT 和特定于任务的分类器头，而我们的第二个模型则通过为每个子任务量身定制的语言特征来增强此架构。我们的第三种方法实现了一个组合子任务模型，具有基于注意力的序列池、用文档元数据增强的转换器表示以及多目标学习。对 ML-Promise 数据集的英语部分进行的实验表明，我们的模型不断得到改进，我们的组合子任务方法实现了 0.5268 的私人排行榜分数，优于所提供的 0.5227 基线。我们的工作强调了语言特征提取、注意力池和多目标学习在承诺验证任务中的有效性，尽管类别不平衡和有限的训练数据带来了挑战。

title: HowardUniversity-AI4PCatSemEval-2025 Task 7: Crosslingual Fact-Checked Claim Retrieval-Combining Zero-Shot Claim Extraction andKNN-Based Classification for Multilingual Claim Matching
abstract_en: SemEval Task 7 introduced a dataset for multilingual and cross-lingual fact checking. We propose a system that leverages similarity matching, KNN, zero-shot classification and summarization to retrieve fact-checks for social media posts across multiple languages. Our approach achieves performance within the expected range, aligning with baseline results. Although competitive, the findings highlight the potential and challenges of zero-shot methods, providing a foundation for future research in cross-lingual information verification.
abstract_zh: SemEval Task 7 引入了用于多语言和跨语言事实检查的数据集。我们提出了一个系统，利用相似性匹配、KNN、零样本分类和摘要来检索跨多种语言的社交媒体帖子的事实检查。我们的方法实现了预期范围内的性能，与基线结果保持一致。尽管具有竞争力，但研究结果凸显了零样本方法的潜力和挑战，为未来跨语言信息验证的研究奠定了基础。

title: CSECU-DSGatSemEval-2025 Task 6: Exploiting Multilingual Feature Fusion-based Approach for Corporate Promise Verification
abstract_en: In SemEval-2025, we participated on the multilingual corporate promise verification task. In the task, we mainly focused on the promise and evidence identification task, and illustrated the performance for the five different languages. For all the languages, we proposed a unified state-of-the-art framework to classify the target labels. For the framework, we incorporated the pre-feature fusion approach, then integrate it with the neural network architecture. Additionally, in the dataset description and discussion section, we provide different insights of our finding through visualization of the dataset structures and explainability of the model’s performance.
abstract_zh: 在SemEval-2025中，我们参与了多语言企业承诺验证任务。在任务中，我们主要关注承诺和证据识别任务，并说明了五种不同语言的性能。对于所有语言，我们提出了一个统一的最先进的框架来对目标标签进行分类。对于该框架，我们采用了预特征融合方法，然后将其与神经网络架构集成。此外，在数据集描述和讨论部分，我们通过数据集结构的可视化和模型性能的可解释性提供了对我们发现的不同见解。

title: HowardUniversity-AI4PCatSemEval-2025 Task 9: Using Open-weightBART-MNLIfor Zero Shot Classification of Food Recall Documents
abstract_en: We present our system for SemEval-2025 Task 9: Food Hazard Detection, a shared task focused on the explainable classification of food-incident reports. The task involves predicting hazard and product categories (ST1) and their exact vectors (ST2) from short texts. Our approach leverages zero-shot classification using the BART-large-MNLI model, which allows classification without task-specific fine-tuning. Our model achieves competitive performance, emphasizing hazard prediction accuracy, as evaluated by the macro-F1 score.
abstract_zh: 我们展示了 SemEval-2025 任务 9 的系统：食品危害检测，这是一项专注于食品事件报告的可解释分类的共享任务。该任务涉及从短文本预测危险和产品类别 (ST1) 及其精确向量 (ST2)。我们的方法利用 BART-large-MNLI 模型进行零样本分类，无需针对特定任务进行微调即可进行分类。我们的模型实现了具有竞争力的性能，强调了危险预测的准确性，如宏观 F1 分数所评估的那样。

title: CSCUatSemEval-2025 Task 6: Enhancing Promise Verification with Paraphrase and Synthesis Augmentation: Effects on Model Performance
abstract_en: 无

title: CDHFatSemEval-2025 Task 9: A Multi-Task Learning Approach for Food Hazard Classification
abstract_en: We present our system in SemEval-2025 Task 9: Food Hazard Detection. Our approach focuses on multi-label classification of food recall titles into predefined hazard and product categories. We fine-tune pre-trained transformer models, comparing BERT and BART. Our results show that BART significantly outperforms BERT, achieving an F1-score of 0.8033 during development. However, in the final evaluation phase, our system obtained an F1-score of 0.7676, ranking 54th in Subtask 1. While our performance is not among the top, our findings highlight the importance of model choice in food hazard classification. Future work can explore additional improvements, such as ensemble methods and domain adaptation
abstract_zh: 我们在 SemEval-2025 任务 9：食品危害检测中展示了我们的系统。我们的方法侧重于将食品召回标题进行多标签分类，分为预定义的危害和产品类别。我们对预训练的 Transformer 模型进行微调，比较 BERT 和 BART。我们的结果表明，BART 显着优于 BERT，在开发过程中实现了 0.8033 的 F1 分数。然而，在最终评估阶段，我们的系统获得了 0.7676 的 F1 分数，在子任务 1 中排名第 54。虽然我们的表现不是顶尖的，但我们的发现凸显了模型选择在食品危害分类中的重要性。未来的工作可以探索其他改进，例如集成方法和领域适应

title: FactDebug atSemEval-2025 Task 7: Hybrid Retrieval Pipeline for Identifying Previously Fact-Checked Claims Across Multiple Languages
abstract_en: The proliferation of multilingual misinformation demands robust systems for crosslingual fact-checked claim retrieval. This paper addresses SemEval-2025 Shared Task 7, which challenges participants to retrieve fact-checks for social media posts across 14 languages, even when posts and fact-checks are in different languages. We propose a hybrid retrieval pipeline that combines sparse lexical matching (BM25, BGE-m3) and dense semantic retrieval (pretrained and fine-tuned BGE-m3) with dynamic fusion and curriculum-trained rerankers. Our system achieves 67.2% crosslingual and 86.01% monolingual accuracy on the Shared Task MultiClaim dataset.
abstract_zh: 多语言错误信息的激增需要强大的跨语言事实检查声明检索系统。本文讨论了 SemEval-2025 共享任务 7，该任务要求参与者检索 14 种语言的社交媒体帖子的事实核查，即使帖子和事实核查使用不同的语言。我们提出了一种混合检索管道，它将稀疏词汇匹配（BM25、BGE-m3）和密集语义检索（预训练和微调的 BGE-m3）与动态融合和课程训练的重新排序相结合。我们的系统在共享任务 MultiClaim 数据集上实现了 67.2% 的跨语言准确率和 86.01% 的单语准确率。

title: TECHSSNatSemEval-2025 Task 10: A Comparative Analysis of Transformer Models for Dominant Narrative-Based News Summarization
abstract_en: This paper presents an approach to Task 10 of SemEval 2025, which focuses on summarizing English news articles using a given dominant narrative. The dataset comprises news articles on the Russia-Ukraine war and climate change, introducing challenges related to bias, information compression, and contextual coherence. Transformer-based models, specifically BART variants, are utilized to generate concise and coherent summaries. Our team TechSSN, achieved 4th place on the official test leaderboard with a BERTScore of 0.74203, employing the DistilBART-CNN-12-6 model.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了 SemEval 2025 任务 10 的方法，该方法侧重于使用给定的主导叙述来总结英语新闻文章。该数据集包含有关俄罗斯-乌克兰战争和气候变化的新闻文章，介绍了与偏见、信息压缩和上下文连贯性相关的挑战。基于 Transformer 的模型，特别是 BART 变体，用于生成简洁且连贯的摘要。我们的团队 TechSSN 使用 DistilBART-CNN-12-6 模型，以 0.74203 的 BERTScore 在官方测试排行榜上获得第四名。

title: MINDSatSemEval-2025 Task 9: Multi-Task Transformers for Food Hazard Coarse-Fine Classification
abstract_en: Food safety is a critical concern: hazardous incident reports need to be classified to be able to take appropriate measures in a timely manner. The SemEval-2025 Task 9 on Food Hazard Detection aims to classify food-related incident reports by identifying both the type of hazard and the product involved, at both coarse and fine levels of granularity. In this paper, we present our solution that approaches the problem by leveraging two independent encoder-only transformer models, each fine-tuned separately to classify hazards and food products, at the two levels of granularity of interest. Experimental results show that our approach effectively addresses the classification task, achieving high-quality performance on both subtasks. We additionally include a discussion on potential improvements for future iterations, and a brief description of failed attempts. We make the code available at https://github.com/fgiobergia/SemEval2025-Task9.
abstract_zh: 食品安全是一个至关重要的问题：危险事件报告需要进行分类，以便能够及时采取适当的措施。 SemEval-2025 关于食品危害检测的任务 9 旨在通过粗粒度和细粒度识别危害类型和所涉及的产品，对食品相关事件报告进行分类。在本文中，我们提出了通过利用两个独立的仅编码器变压器模型来解决该问题的解决方案，每个模型分别进行微调，以在两个感兴趣的粒度级别对危险和食品进行分类。实验结果表明，我们的方法有效地解决了分类任务，在两个子任务上都实现了高质量的性能。我们还讨论了未来迭代的潜在改进，以及对失败尝试的简要描述。我们在 https://github.com/fgiobergia/SemEval2025-Task9 提供代码。

title: KyuHyunChoi atSemEval-2025 Task 10: Narrative Extraction Using a Summarization-Specific Pretrained Model
abstract_en: Task 11 of SemEval 2025 was proposed to develop supporting information for analyzing the risks of misinformation and propaganda in news articles. In this study, we selected Sub-task 3—which involves generating evidence explaining why a particular dominant narrative is labeled in an article—and fine-tuned PEGASUS for this purpose, achieving the best performance in the competition.
abstract_zh: SemEval 2025 的任务 11 旨在开发支持信息，以分析新闻文章中错误信息和宣传的风险。在这项研究中，我们选择了子任务 3（涉及生成证据来解释为什么在文章中标记特定的主导叙述），并为此目的对 PEGASUS 进行了微调，从而在比赛中取得了最佳表现。

title: SemEval 2025 Task 10: Multilingual Characterization and Extraction of Narratives from Online News
abstract_en: We introduce SemEval-2025 Task 10 on Multilingual Characterization and Extraction of Narratives from Online News, which focuses on the identification and analysis of narratives in online news media. The task is structured into three subtasks: (1) Entity Framing, to identify the roles that relevant entities play within narratives, (2) Narrative Classification, to assign documents fine-grained narratives according to a given, topic-specific taxonomy of narrative labels, and (3) Narrative Extraction, to provide a justification for the dominant narrative of the document. To this end, we analyze news articles across two critical domains, Ukraine-Russia War and Climate Change, in five languages: Bulgarian, English, Hindi, Portuguese, and Russian. This task introduces a novel multilingual and multifaceted framework for studying how online news media construct and disseminate manipulative narratives. By addressing these challenges, our work contributes to the broader effort of detecting, understanding, and mitigating the spread of propaganda and disinformation. The task attracted a lot of interest: 310 teams registered, with 66 submitting official results on the test set.
abstract_zh: 我们介绍了 SemEval-2025 任务 10：在线新闻中的多语言表征和叙事提取，该任务重点关注在线新闻媒体中叙事的识别和分析。该任务分为三个子任务：(1) 实体框架，识别相关实体在叙述中扮演的角色；(2) 叙述分类，根据给定的、特定于主题的叙述标签分类法为文档分配细粒度叙述；(3) 叙述提取，为文档的主导叙述提供理由。为此，我们分析了乌克兰-俄罗斯战争和气候变化这两个关键领域的新闻文章，涉及五种语言：保加利亚语、英语、印地语、葡萄牙语和俄语。这项任务引入了一种新颖的多语言和多方面框架，用于研究在线新闻媒体如何构建和传播操纵性叙事。通过应对这些挑战，我们的工作有助于更广泛地发现、理解和减轻宣传和虚假信息的传播。这项任务吸引了很多人的兴趣：有 310 个团队注册，其中 66 个团队提交了测试集的官方结果。

title: Beyond the Data: The Impact of Annotation Inconsistencies inUDTreebanks on Typological Universals and Complexity Assessment
abstract_en: This study explores the impact of annotation inconsistencies in Universal Dependencies (UD) treebanks on typological research in computational linguistics. UD provides a standardized framework for cross-linguistic annotation, facilitating large-scale empirical studies on linguistic diversity and universals. However, despite rigorous guidelines, annotation inconsistencies persist across treebanks. The objective of this paper is to assess how these inconsistencies affect typological universals, linguistic descriptions, and complexity metrics. We analyze systematic annotation errors in multiple UD treebanks, focusing on morphological features. Case studies on Spanish and Dutch demonstrate how differing annotation decisions within the same language create contradictory typological profiles. We classify the errors into two main categories: overgeneration errors (features incorrectly annotated, since do not actually exist in a language) and data omission errors (inconsistent or incomplete annotation of features that do exist). Our results show that these inconsistencies significantly distort typological analyses, leading to false generalizations and miscalculations of linguistic complexity. We propose methodological safeguards for typological research using UD data. Our findings highlight the need for methodological improvements to ensure more reliable cross-linguistic generalizations in computational typology.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了通用依赖关系 (UD) 树库中注释不一致对计算语言学类型学研究的影响。 UD 为跨语言注释提供了标准化框架，促进了对语言多样性和共性的大规模实证研究。然而，尽管有严格的指导方针，但树库之间仍然存在注释不一致的情况。本文的目的是评估这些不一致如何影响类型学共性、语言描述和复杂性度量。我们分析了多个 UD 树库中的系统注释错误，重点关注形态特征。对西班牙语和荷兰语的案例研究表明，同一语言中的不同注释决策如何产生矛盾的类型学特征。我们将错误分为两大类：过度生成错误（功能注释不正确，因为实际上并不存在于语言中）和数据遗漏错误（确实存在的功能注释不一致或不完整）。我们的结果表明，这些不一致严重扭曲了类型学分析，导致错误的概括和对语言复杂性的错误计算。我们为使用 UD 数据的类型学研究提出了方法论保障。我们的研究结果强调需要改进方法，以确保计算类型学中更可靠的跨语言概括。

title: Beyond cognacy
abstract_en: Computational phylogenetics has become an established tool in historical linguistics, with many language families now analyzed using likelihood-based inference. However, standard approaches rely on expert-annotated cognate sets, which are sparse, labor-intensive to produce, and limited to individual language families. This paper explores alternatives by comparing the established method to two fully automated methods that extract phylogenetic signal directly from lexical data. One uses automatic cognate clustering with unigram/concept features; the other applies multiple sequence alignment (MSA) derived from a pair-hidden Markov model. Both are evaluated against expert classifications from Glottolog and typological data from Grambank. Also, the intrinsic strengths of the phylogenetic signal in the characters are compared. Results show that MSA-based inference yields trees more consistent with linguistic classifications, better predicts typological variation, and provides a clearer phylogenetic signal, suggesting it as a promising, scalable alternative to traditional cognate-based methods. This opens new avenues for global-scale language phylogenies beyond expert annotation bottlenecks.
abstract_zh: 计算系统发育学已成为历史语言学的既定工具，现在使用基于可能性的推理来分析许多语系。然而，标准方法依赖于专家注释的同源集，这些同源集稀疏，生产起来需要大量劳动力，并且仅限于单个语系。本文通过将已建立的方法与直接从词汇数据中提取系统发育信号的两种全自动方法进行比较来探索替代方案。一种使用具有一元/概念特征的自动同源聚类；另一个应用源自配对隐藏马尔可夫模型的多重序列比对（MSA）。两者均根据 Glottolog 的专家分类和 Grambank 的类型学数据进行评估。此外，还比较了性状中系统发育信号的内在强度。结果表明，基于 MSA 的推理生成的树与语言分类更加一致，可以更好地预测类型变异，并提供更清晰的系统发育信号，这表明它是传统基于同源的方法的一种有前途的、可扩展的替代方法。这为超越专家注释瓶颈的全球规模语言系统发育开辟了新途径。

title: Domain Meets Typology: Predicting Verb-Final Order fromUniversalDependencies for Financial and BlockchainNLP
abstract_en: This paper introduces a domain-adapted approach for verb-order prediction across general and specialized texts (financial/blockchain), combining Universal Dependencies syntax with novel features (AVAR, DLV) and dynamic threshold calibration. We evaluate on 53 languages from UD v2.11, 12K financial sentences (FinBench), and 1,845 blockchain whitepapers (CryptoUD), outperforming four baselines by 6-19% F1. Key findings include: (1) 62% SOV prevalence in SEC filings (+51% over general English), (2) 88% technical whitepaper alignment with Solidity’s SOV patterns, and (3) 9% gains from adaptive thresholds. The system processes 1,150 sentences/second - 2.4× faster than XLM-T - while maintaining higher accuracy, demonstrating that lightweight feature-based methods can surpass neural approaches for domain-specific syntactic analysis.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种跨通用和专业文本（金融/区块链）的动词顺序预测的领域自适应方法，将通用依赖语法与新功能（AVAR、DLV）和动态阈值校准相结合。我们对 UD v2.11 中的 53 种语言、12K 金融句子 (FinBench) 和 1,845 份区块链白皮书 (CryptoUD) 进行了评估，比四个基线高出 6-19% F1。主要发现包括：(1) SEC 文件中 SOV 的流行率为 62%（比普通英语高出 51%），(2) 88% 的技术白皮书与 Solidity 的 SOV 模式一致，(3) 自适应阈值带来了 9% 的收益。该系统每秒处理 1,150 个句子，比 XLM-T 快 2.4 倍，同时保持更高的准确性，这表明基于轻量级特征的方法可以超越用于特定领域句法分析的神经方法。

title: Token-level semantic typology without a massively parallel corpus
abstract_en: This paper presents a computational method for token-level lexical semantic comparative research in an original text setting, as opposed to the more common massively parallel setting. Given a set of (non-massively parallel) bitexts, the method consists of leveraging pre-trained contextual vectors in a reference language to induce, for a token in one target language, the lexical items that all other target languages would have used, thus simulating a massively parallel set-up. The method is evaluated on its extraction and induction quality, and the use of the method for lexical semantic typological research is demonstrated.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在原始文本设置中进行标记级词汇语义比较研究的计算方法，而不是更常见的大规模并行设置。给定一组（非大规模并行）双文本，该方法包括利用参考语言中预先训练的上下文向量来针对一种目标语言中的标记归纳所有其他目标语言将使用的词汇项，从而模拟大规模并行设置。对该方法的提取和归纳质量进行了评估，并论证了该方法在词汇语义类型学研究中的应用。

title: Something’s Fishy in the Data Lake: A Critical Re-evaluation of Table Union Search Benchmarks
abstract_en: Recent table representation learning and data discovery methods tackle table union search (TUS) within data lakes, which involves identifying tables that can be unioned with a given query table to enrich its content. These methods are commonly evaluated using benchmarks that aim to assess semantic understanding in real-world TUS tasks. However, our analysis of prominent TUS benchmarks reveals several limitations that allow simple baselines to perform surprisingly well, often outperforming more sophisticated approaches. This suggests that current benchmark scores are heavily influenced by dataset-specific characteristics and fail to effectively isolate the gains from semantic understanding. To address this, we propose essential criteria for future benchmarks to enable a more realistic and reliable evaluation of progress in semantic table union search.
abstract_zh: 最近的表表示学习和数据发现方法解决了数据湖中的表联合搜索（TUS）问题，其中涉及识别可以与给定查询表联合以丰富其内容的表。这些方法通常使用旨在评估现实 TUS 任务中语义理解的基准进行评估。然而，我们对著名 TUS 基准的分析揭示了一些限制，这些限制使得简单的基线表现出惊人的好，通常优于更复杂的方法。这表明当前的基准分数很大程度上受到数据集特定特征的影响，并且无法有效地将语义理解的收益隔离开来。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了未来基准的基本标准，以便能够对语义表联合搜索的进展进行更现实和更可靠的评估。

title: Perspective: Leveraging Domain Knowledge for Tabular Machine Learning in the Medical Domain
abstract_en: There has been limited exploration of how to effectively integrate domain knowledge into machine learning for medical tabular data. Traditional approaches often rely on non-generalizable processes tailored to specific datasets. In contrast, recent advances in deep learning for language and tabular data are leading the way toward more generalizable and scalable methods of domain knowledge inclusion. In this paper, we first explore the need for domain knowledge in medical tabular data, categorize types of medical domain knowledge, and discuss how each can be leveraged in tabular machine learning. We then outline strategies for integrating this knowledge at various stages of the machine learning pipeline. Finally, building on recent advances in tabular deep learning, we propose future research directions to support the integration of domain knowledge.
abstract_zh: 关于如何有效地将领域知识整合到医学表格数据的机器学习中的探索有限。传统方法通常依赖于针对特定数据集定制的不可概括的过程。相比之下，语言和表格数据深度学习的最新进展正在引领领域知识包含的更通用和可扩展的方法。在本文中，我们首先探讨医学表格数据中对领域知识的需求，对医学领域知识的类型进行分类，并讨论如何在表格机器学习中利用每种知识。然后，我们概述了在机器学习流程的各个阶段整合这些知识的策略。最后，基于表格深度学习的最新进展，我们提出了未来的研究方向以支持领域知识的整合。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Forecasting with Tabular Time Series Data
abstract_en: This paper presents Retrieval-Augmented Forecasting (RAF), a novel framework for tabular time-series prediction that dynamically retrieves and integrates relevant historical table slices. RAF addresses three key limitations of existing methods: 1) schema rigidity through dynamic hashing of column metadata, 2) temporal myopia via cross-attention with learned decay, and 3) pipeline sub-optimality via end-to-end retriever-forecaster co-training. Experiments across macroeconomic (FRED-MD), financial (Yahoo Finance), and development (WorldBank) benchmarks demonstrate RAF’s superiority over six baselines, reducing sMAPE by 19.1-26.5% while maintaining robustness to schema changes (+3.2% sMAPE increase vs. +6.7-12.7% for alternatives). The architecture’s computational overhead (1.8 vs. 1.2 hours/epoch vs. TFT) is justified by significant accuracy gains in critical scenarios like market shocks (61.7% vs. 55.1% directional accuracy).
abstract_zh: 本文提出了检索增强预测（RAF），这是一种用于表格时间序列预测的新颖框架，可以动态检索和集成相关的历史表切片。 RAF 解决了现有方法的三个关键局限性：1）通过列元数据的动态哈希来实现模式刚性，2）通过交叉注意力和学习衰减来实现时间近视，3）通过端到端检索器-预测器协同训练来实现管道次优。宏观经济（FRED-MD）、金融（雅虎财经）和发展（世界银行）基准的实验证明了 RAF 相对于六个基准的优越性，将 sMAPE 降低了 19.1-26.5%，同时保持了对模式变化的鲁棒性（sMAPE 增加了 3.2%，而替代方案增加了 +6.7-12.7%）。该架构的计算开销（1.8 小时与 1.2 小时/纪元与 TFT）在市场冲击等关键场景中的准确度显着提升（61.7% 与 55.1% 方向准确度）证明是合理的。

title: Embeddings for Numerical Features Using tanh Activation
abstract_en: Recent advances in tabular deep learning have demonstrated the importance of embeddings for numerical features, where scalar values are mapped to high-dimensional spaces before being processed by the main model. Here, we propose an embedding method using the hyperbolic tangent (tanh) activation function that allows neural networks to achieve better accuracy on tabular data via an inductive bias similar to that of decision trees. To make training with the new embedding method reliable and efficient, we additionally propose a principled initialization method. Experiments demonstrate that the new approach improves upon or matches accuracy results from previously proposed embedding methods across multiple tabular datasets and model architectures.
abstract_zh: 表格深度学习的最新进展证明了嵌入对于数值特征的重要性，其中标量值在被主模型处理之前被映射到高维空间。在这里，我们提出了一种使用双曲正切（tanh）激活函数的嵌入方法，该方法允许神经网络通过类似于决策树的归纳偏差在表格数据上获得更好的准确性。为了使新嵌入方法的训练可靠且高效，我们还提出了一种有原则的初始化方法。实验表明，新方法改进或匹配了先前提出的跨多个表格数据集和模型架构的嵌入方法的准确性结果。

title: Developing aUniversalDependencies Treebank forUkrainian Parliamentary Speech
abstract_en: This paper presents a new Universal Dependencies (UD) treebank based on Ukrainian parliamentary transcripts, complementing the existing UD resources for Ukrainian. The corpus includes manually annotated texts from key historical sessions of the Verkhovna Rada, capturing not only official rhetoric but also features of colloquial spoken language. The annotation combines UDPipe2 and TagText parsers, with subsequent manual correction to ensure syntactic and morphological accuracy. A detailed comparison of tagsets and the disambiguation strategy employed by TagText is provided. To demonstrate the applicability of the resource, the study examines vocative and nominative case variation in direct address using a large-scale UD-annotated corpus of parliamentary texts.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个基于乌克兰议会记录的新通用依赖关系 (UD) 树库，补充了乌克兰语现有的 UD 资源。该语料库包括最高拉达关键历史会议的手动注释文本，不仅捕捉官方修辞，还捕捉口语的特征。该注释结合了 UDPipe2 和 TagText 解析器，并进行后续手动校正以确保语法和形态的准确性。提供了标签集和 TagText 采用的消歧策略的详细比较。为了证明该资源的适用性，该研究使用大规模 UD 注释的议会文本语料库检查了直接称呼中的呼格和主格变化。

title: A Comprehensive Taxonomy of Bias Mitigation Methods for Hate Speech Detection
abstract_en: Algorithmic hate speech detection is widely used today. However, biases within these systems can lead to discrimination. This research presents an overview of bias mitigation strategies in the field of hate speech detection. The identified principles are grouped into four categories, based on their operation principles. A novel taxonomy of bias mitigation methods is proposed. The mitigation strategies are characterized based on their key concepts and analyzed in terms of their application stage and their need for knowledge of protected attributes. Additionally, the paper discusses potential combinations of these strategies. This research shifts the focus from identifying present biases to examining the similarities and differences between mitigation strategies, thereby facilitating the exchange, stacking, and ensembling of these strategies in future research.
abstract_zh: 仇恨言论算法检测如今已被广泛使用。然而，这些系统内的偏见可能导致歧视。这项研究概述了仇恨言论检测领域的偏见缓解策略。根据其操作原理，已确定的原则分为四类。提出了一种新的偏差缓解方法分类法。缓解策略根据其关键概念进行表征，并根据其应用阶段和对受保护属性知识的需求进行分析。此外，本文还讨论了这些策略的潜在组合。这项研究将重点从识别当前的偏见转移到研究缓解策略之间的异同，从而促进未来研究中这些策略的交换、堆叠和集成。

title: From civility to parity: Marxist-feminist ethics for context-aware algorithmic content moderation
abstract_en: Algorithmic content moderation governs online speech on large-scale commercial platforms, often under the guise of neutrality. Yet, it routinely reproduces white, middle-class norms of civility and penalizes marginalized voices for unruly and resistant speech. This paper critiques the prevailing ‘pathological’ approach to moderation that prioritizes sanitization over justice. Drawing on Marxist-feminist ethics, this paper advances three theses for the future of context-aware algorithmic moderation: (1) prioritizing participatory parity over civility, (2) incorporating identity- and context-aware analysis of speech; and (3) replacing purely numerical evaluations with justice-oriented, community-sensitive metrics. While acknowledging the structural limitations posed by platform capitalism, this paper positions the proposed framework as both critique and provocation, guiding regulatory reform, civil advocacy, and visions for mission-driven online content moderation serving digital commons.
abstract_zh: 算法内容审核通常打着中立的幌子，管理大型商业平台上的在线言论。然而，它经常复制白人中产阶级的文明规范，并惩罚边缘化的不守规矩和抵制言论的声音。本文批评了流行的“病态”节制方法，这种方法将消毒置于正义之上。借鉴马克思主义女权主义伦理学，本文为情境感知算法调节的未来提出了三个论点：（1）优先考虑参与平等而非文明；（2）结合身份和情境感知的言论分析； (3) 用面向正义、社区敏感的指标取代纯粹的数字评估。在承认平台资本主义带来的结构性局限性的同时，本文将拟议的框架定位为批评和挑衅，指导监管改革、公民倡导以及服务于数字公共的任务驱动的在线内容审核的愿景。

title: A Novel Dataset for ClassifyingGerman Hate Speech Comments with Criminal Relevance
abstract_en: The consistently high prevalence of hate speech on the Internet continues to pose significant social and individual challenges. Given the centrality of social networks in public discourse, automating the identification of criminally relevant content is a pressing challenge. This study addresses the challenge of developing an automated system that is capable of classifying online comments in a criminal justice context and categorising them into relevant sections of the criminal code. Not only technical, but also ethical and legal requirements must be considered. To this end, 351 comments were annotated by public prosecutors from the Central Office for Combating Internet and Computer Crime (ZIT) according to previously formed paragraph classes. These groupings consist of several German criminal law statutes that most hate comments violate. In the subsequent phase of the research, a further 839 records were assigned to the classes by student annotators who had been trained previously.
abstract_zh: 互联网上仇恨言论的持续高发继续带来重大的社会和个人挑战。鉴于社交网络在公共话语中的中心地位，自动识别犯罪相关内容是一项紧迫的挑战。这项研究解决了开发自动化系统的挑战，该系统能够对刑事司法背景下的在线评论进行分类，并将其分类为刑法的相关部分。不仅必须考虑技术要求，还必须考虑道德和法律要求。为此，中央打击互联网和计算机犯罪办公室 (ZIT) 的检察官根据先前形成的段落类别对 351 条评论进行了注释。这些分组由大多数仇恨言论所违反的几项德国刑法法规组成。在研究的后续阶段，之前接受过培训的学生注释员将另外 839 条记录分配给各个班级。

title: Web(er) of Hate: A Survey on How Hate Speech Is Typed
abstract_en: The curation of hate speech datasets involves complex design decisions that balance competing priorities. This paper critically examines these methodological choices in a diverse range of datasets, highlighting common themes and practices, and their implications for dataset reliability. Drawing on Max Weber’s notion of ideal types, we argue for a reflexive approach in dataset creation, urging researchers to acknowledge their own value judgments during dataset construction, fostering transparency and methodological rigour.
abstract_zh: 仇恨言论数据集的管理涉及平衡竞争优先事项的复杂设计决策。本文批判性地研究了各种数据集中的这些方法选择，强调了共同的主题和实践，及其对数据集可靠性的影响。借鉴马克斯·韦伯的理想类型概念，我们主张在数据集创建中采用反思性方法，敦促研究人员在数据集构建过程中承认自己的价值判断，从而提高透明度和方法论的严谨性。

title: Beyond the Binary: Analysing Transphobic Hate and Harassment Online
abstract_en: Online communities provide support and help to individuals transitioning gender. However, this point of transition also increases vulnerability, coupled with increased exposure to online harms. In this research, we analyse a popular hate and harassment site known for targeting minority groups, including transgender people. We analyse 17 million posts dating back to 2012 to gain insights into the types of information collected about targets. We find users commonly link to social media sites such as Twitter/X and meticulously archive links related to their targets. We scrape over 150,000 relevant links posted to Twitter/X and their archived versions and analyse the profiles and posts. We find targets often tweet about harassment, popculture, and queer and gender-related discussions. We develop and evaluate classifiers to detect calls for harassment, doxxing, mention of transgender individuals, and toxic/abusive speech within the forum posts. The results of our classifiers show that forum posts about transgender individuals are significantly more likely to contain other harmful content.
abstract_zh: 在线社区为个人转变性别提供支持和帮助。然而，这一转变点也增加了脆弱性，并增加了遭受在线危害的风险。在这项研究中，我们分析了一个以针对少数群体（包括跨性别者）而闻名的流行仇恨和骚扰网站。我们分析了 2012 年以来的 1700 万条帖子，以深入了解所收集的有关目标的信息类型。我们发现用户通常链接到 Twitter/X 等社交媒体网站，并精心存档与其目标相关的链接。我们抓取了发布到 Twitter/X 的超过 150,000 个相关链接及其存档版本，并分析了个人资料和帖子。我们发现目标经常发布有关骚扰、流行文化以及酷儿和性别相关讨论的推文。我们开发和评估分类器，以检测论坛帖子中骚扰、人肉搜索、提及变性人以及有毒/辱骂性言论的呼声。我们的分类器的结果显示，有关跨性别者的论坛帖子更有可能包含其他有害内容。

title: Catching Stray Balls: Football, fandom, and the impact on digital discourse
abstract_en: This paper examines how emotional responses to football matches influence online discourse across digital spaces on Reddit. By analysing millions of posts from dozens of subreddits, it demonstrates that real-world events trigger sentiment shifts that move across communities. It shows that negative sentiment correlates with problematic language; match outcomes directly influence sentiment and posting habits; sentiment can transfer to unrelated communities; and offers insights into the content of this shifting discourse. These findings reveal how digital spaces function not as isolated environments, but as interconnected emotional ecosystems vulnerable to cross-domain contagion triggered by real-world events, contributing to our understanding of the propagation of online toxicity. While football is used as a case-study to computationally measure affective causes and movements, these patterns have implications for understanding online communities broadly.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了足球比赛的情绪反应如何影响 Reddit 数字空间中的在线话语。通过分析来自数十个 Reddit 子版块的数百万条帖子，它表明现实世界的事件会引发跨社区的情绪变化。它表明负面情绪与有问题的语言相关；比赛结果直接影响情绪和发帖习惯；情绪可以转移到不相关的社区；并提供了对这种不断变化的话语内容的见解。这些发现揭示了数字空间的功能不是作为孤立的环境，而是作为相互关联的情感生态系统，容易受到现实世界事件引发的跨域传染，有助于我们理解网络毒性的传播。虽然足球被用作案例研究来通过计算测量情感原因和运动，但这些模式对于广泛理解在线社区具有重要意义。

title: Who leads? Who follows? Temporal dynamics of political dogwhistles inSwedish online communities
abstract_en: A dogwhistle is a communicative act intended to broadcast a message only understood by a select in-group while going unnoticed by others (out-group). We illustrate that political dogwhistle behavior in a more radical community precedes the occurrence of the dogwhistles in a less radical community, but the reverse does not hold. We study two Swedish online communities – Flashback and Familjeliv – which both contain discussions of life and society, with the former having a stronger anti-immigrant subtext. Expressions associated with dogwhistles are substantially more frequent in Flashback than in Familjeliv. We analyze the time series of changes in intensity of three dogwhistle expressions (DWEs), i.e., the strength of association of a DWE and its in-group meaning modeled by Swedish Sentence-BERT, and model the dynamic temporal relationship of intensity in the two communities for the three DWEs using Vector Autoregression (VAR). We show that changes in intensity in Familjeliv are explained by the changes of intensity observed at previous lags in Flashback but not the other way around. This suggests a direction of travel for dogwhistles associated with radical ideologies to less radical contexts.
abstract_zh: 狗哨是一种交流行为，旨在广播只有选定的内群体才能理解的消息，而不会被其他人（外群体）注意到。我们说明，较激进的社区中的政治狗哨行为先于较不激进的社区中的政治狗哨行为发生，但反之则不成立。我们研究了两个瑞典在线社区——Flashback 和 Familjeliv——它们都包含有关生活和社会的讨论，其中前者具有更强的反移民潜台词。与狗口哨相关的表达在闪回中比在 Familjeliv 中更频繁。我们分析了三种狗哨表达（DWE）强度变化的时间序列，即由瑞典句子-BERT 建模的 DWE 的关联强度及其组内含义，并使用向量自回归（VAR）对这三个 DWE 的两个社区中强度的动态时间关系进行建模。我们表明，Familjeliv 中的强度变化可以通过在闪回中先前滞后时观察到的强度变化来解释，但反之则不然。这表明与激进意识形态相关的狗哨声的传播方向是不那么激进的环境。

title: Hate Explained: EvaluatingNER-Enriched Text in Human and Machine Moderation of Hate Speech
abstract_en: Hate speech detection is vital for creating safe online environments, as harmful content can drive social polarization. This study explores the impact of enriching text with intent and group tags on machine performance and human moderation workflows. For machine performance, we enriched text with intent and group tags to train hate speech classifiers. Intent tags were the most effective, achieving state-of-the-art F1-score improvements on the IHC, SBIC, and DH datasets, respectively. Cross-dataset evaluations further demonstrated the superior generalization of intent-tagged models compared to other pre-trained approaches. Then, through a user study (N=100), we evaluated seven moderation settings, including intent tags, group tags, model probabilities, and randomized counterparts. Intent annotations significantly improved the accuracy of the moderators, allowing them to outperform machine classifiers by 12.9%. Moderators also rated intent tags as the most useful explanation tool, with a 41% increase in perceived helpfulness over the control group. Our findings demonstrate that intent-based annotations enhance both machine classification performance and human moderation workflows.
abstract_zh: 仇恨言论检测对于创建安全的在线环境至关重要，因为有害内容可能会加剧社会两极分化。本研究探讨了使用意图和组标签丰富文本对机器性能和人工审核工作流程的影响。对于机器性能，我们用意图和组标签丰富了文本，以训练仇恨言论分类器。意图标签是最有效的，分别在 IHC、SBIC 和 DH 数据集上实现了最先进的 F1 分数改进。跨数据集评估进一步证明了与其他预训练方法相比，意图标记模型具有卓越的泛化能力。然后，通过用户研究 (N=100)，我们评估了七种审核设置，包括意图标签、组标签、模型概率和随机对应项。意图注释显着提高了主持人的准确性，使他们的表现比机器分类器高出 12.9%。主持人还将意图标签评为最有用的解释工具，与对照组相比，感知有用性增加了 41%。我们的研究结果表明，基于意图的注释增强了机器分类性能和人工审核工作流程。

title: Transfer of Structural Knowledge from Synthetic Languages
abstract_en: This work explores transfer learning from several synthetic languages to English. We investigate the structure of the embeddings in the fine-tuned models, the information they contain, and the capabilities of the fine-tuned models on simple linguistic tasks. We also introduce a new synthetic language that leads to better transfer to English than the languages used in previous research. Finally, we introduce Tiny-Cloze Benchmark — a new synthetic benchmark for natural language understanding that is more informative for less powerful models. We use Tiny-Cloze Benchmark to evaluate fine-tuned models in several domains demonstrating that fine-tuning on a new synthetic language allows for better performance on a variety of tasks.
abstract_zh: 这项工作探索了从几种合成语言到英语的迁移学习。我们研究了微调模型中嵌入的结构、它们包含的信息以及微调模型在简单语言任务上的能力。我们还引入了一种新的合成语言，与之前研究中使用的语言相比，它可以更好地迁移到英语。最后，我们介绍 Tiny-Cloze Benchmark——一种新的自然语言理解综合基准，对于功能较弱的模型来说，它可以提供更多信息。我们使用 Tiny-Cloze Benchmark 来评估多个领域的微调模型，证明对新的合成语言进行微调可以在各种任务上获得更好的性能。
